description_zh_TW: microRNA miR-297 和 miR-421 作为 SIRT3 的上游调节剂，抑制其表达，从而影响细胞凋亡相关途径。从方向上看，这些 microRNA 位于 SIRT3 输出减少的上游。它們的失調改變了壓力細胞中的凋亡平衡，並為 SIRT3 對老化和惡性腫瘤中細胞命運決定的控制添加了非編碼 RNA 調節層。

label: SHMT2
description: In colorectal cancer, SIRT3 deacetylates SHMT2 (serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2) at Lys95, enhancing its activity and promoting serine metabolism. This increases serine consumption, NADPH levels, and nucleotide precursor availability, driving colorectal carcinogenesis in an oncogenic context.
description_zh_TW: 在結直腸癌中，SIRT3 在 Lys95 去乙醯化 SHMT2（絲胺酸羥甲基轉移酶 2），增強其活性並促進絲胺酸代謝。這增加絲胺酸消耗、NADPH 水平和核苷酸前體可用性，在致癌情境中驅動結直腸癌發生。

label: ATP5O
description: In healthy mitochondria a pool of SIRT3 is sequestered by ATP synthase via the ATP5O (OSCP) subunit. When matrix pH drops upon depolarization, SIRT3 dissociates from ATP5O (requiring H135 of ATP5O) and redistributes to matrix substrates, enabling rapid deacetylation of metabolic enzymes and recovery of membrane potential within minutes.
description_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，一部分 SIRT3 被 ATP 合成酶透過 ATP5O（OSCP）亞基封存。當去極化導致基質 pH 下降時，SIRT3 從 ATP5O 解離（需要 ATP5O 的 H135），並重新分佈到基質受質上，實現對代謝酶的快速去乙醯化並在數分鐘內恢復膜電位。

label: PYCR1
description: SIRT3 catalyzes Lys228 deacetylation on PYCR1 (pyrroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1), enhancing its enzymatic activity and facilitating proline biosynthesis, a critical process for tumor cell proliferation. This represents an oncogenic axis of SIRT3 in specific cancer contexts.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 對 PYCR1（吡咯啉-5-羧酸還原酶 1）催化 Lys228 去乙醯化，增強其酶活性並促進脯胺酸生物合成，這是腫瘤細胞增殖的關鍵過程。這代表 SIRT3 在特定癌症情境中的致癌軸。

label: SLC25A22
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and stabilizes the mitochondrial glutamate transporter SLC25A22 at K83, preventing its ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation and sustaining mitochondrial glutathione supply. This protects lung adenocarcinoma from ferroptosis, a microenvironment- and redox-dependent survival role.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 K83 去乙醯化並穩定粒線體穀氨酸轉運蛋白 SLC25A22，防止其泛素化和蛋白酶體降解，並維持粒線體麩胱甘肽供應。這保護肺腺癌免受鐵死亡，是一項依賴微環境和氧化還原的存活作用。

label: AceCS2
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and thereby activates AceCS2, the mitochondrial isoform of acetyl-CoA synthetase, regulating carbon entry into the TCA cycle for ATP production. Since SIRT3 is induced by caloric restriction, this couples fasting to the rate of fatty acid synthesis and TCA fueling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並從而活化 AceCS2（乙醯輔酶A合成酶的粒線體異構型），調節碳進入 TCA 循環以產生 ATP。由於 SIRT3 受熱量限制誘導，這將禁食與脂肪酸合成速率和 TCA 燃料供應偶聯起來。

label: ME2
description: SIRT3 removes K352 lactylation from the mitochondrial malic enzyme ME2, inhibiting ME2 and disrupting tumor redox balance by raising ROS and the NADP+/NADPH ratio, thereby suppressing colorectal cancer growth. This is a non-canonical delactylase action of SIRT3 on the metabolic-plasticity/redox interface.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 從粒線體蘋果酸酶 ME2 移除 K352 乳醯化，抑制 ME2 並透過提高 ROS 和 NADP+/NADPH 比值來破壞腫瘤氧化還原平衡，從而抑制結直腸癌生長。這是 SIRT3 在代謝可塑性/氧化還原界面上的一種非典型去乳醯化作用。

label: Circadian Rhythm
description: CLOCK/BMAL1-NAMPT-NAD+ oscillations gate daily SIRT3 activity rhythms. Circadian control of NAD+ availability thereby regulates SIRT3 activity over the day.
description_zh_TW: CLOCK/BMAL1-NAMPT-NAD+ 的振盪調控 SIRT3 活性的每日節律。因此 NAD+ 可用性的晝夜控制會在一天中調節 SIRT3 活性。

label: O-GlcNAcylation
description: O-GlcNAcylation of SIRT3 at Ser190 enhances its activity during ischemia-reperfusion, operating through the SIRT3-SOD2-MROS axis. This modification strengthens SIRT3's protective antioxidant function.
description_zh_TW: 缺血再灌注期間，SIRT3 於 Ser190 的 O-GlcNAc 修飾會增強其活性，經由 SIRT3-SOD2-MROS 軸運作。此修飾強化 SIRT3 的保護性抗氧化功能。

label: Metabolic Plasticity
description: SIRT3 couples the glycolysis-to-OXPHOS switch to the redox setpoint, conferring metabolic plasticity in a tumor-type-, stage- and microenvironment-dependent manner. This makes SIRT3 a context-dependent tumor suppressor or oncogene.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 將糖解作用至氧化磷酸化的轉換與氧化還原設定點相耦合，賦予代謝可塑性，且此作用依腫瘤類型、分期與微環境而定。這使 SIRT3 成為依情境而異的腫瘤抑制子或致癌基因。

label: Post-translational Modification
description: SIRT3 is a major mitochondrial post-translational modification eraser, removing acetyl and other marks from mitochondrial proteins. This deacetylase/PTM-eraser activity underlies most of SIRT3's metabolic and antioxidant functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是粒線體主要的轉譯後修飾清除者，可移除粒線體蛋白上的乙醯化及其他修飾。此去乙醯化/PTM 清除活性是 SIRT3 大多代謝與抗氧化功能的基礎。

label: SLC25A51
description: SLC25A51 is a spatial NAD+ import gate that supplies NAD+ to mitochondria for SIRT3. Its expression is fasting-induced, circadian and BMAL1-dependent, gating SIRT3 activity.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A51 是空間性 NAD+ 輸入通道，為粒線體供應 SIRT3 所需的 NAD+。其表現受斷食誘導、具晝夜節律且依賴 BMAL1，進而調控 SIRT3 活性。

label: Tumor-Associated Macrophage
description: The SENP1-SIRT3-cholesterol axis polarizes tumor-associated macrophages toward an immunosuppressive phenotype. SIRT3 thereby influences the tumor immune microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SENP1-SIRT3-膽固醇軸會使腫瘤相關巨噬細胞極化為免疫抑制表型。因此 SIRT3 影響腫瘤免疫微環境。

label: Kidney Stones
description: SIRT3 is downregulated in patients with kidney stones and is protective via the Nrf2/heme oxygenase-1 pathway. SIRT3-dependent antioxidant defense protects tubular epithelium from crystal-induced injury.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在腎結石患者中表現降低，並經由 Nrf2/血基質加氧酶-1 途徑具有保護作用。SIRT3 依賴的抗氧化防禦保護腎小管上皮免受晶體誘導的損傷。

label: Dicer
description: Dicer is an RNase III enzyme that processes microRNA precursors into mature, functional miRNAs. After the nuclear processing of pri-miRNA to pre-miRNA by Drosha and export to the cytoplasm, Dicer cleaves the pre-miRNA duplex to produce the mature 18 to 22 nucleotide miRNA. The mature miRNA then binds complementary sequences in target mRNAs, typically in the 3' untranslated region, to repress their expression; Dicer levels decline with age, contributing to reduced miRNA production in aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: Dicer 是一種 RNase III 酶，可將 microRNA 前體加工成成熟的功能性 miRNA。在 Drosha 將 pri-miRNA 核加工為 pre-miRNA 並輸出到細胞質後，Dicer 裂解 pre-miRNA 雙股體，產生成熟的 18 至 22 核苷酸 miRNA。然後，成熟的 miRNA 結合目標 mRNA 中的互補序列（通常在 3' 非翻譯區），以抑制其表達； Dicer 水平隨著年齡的增長而下降，導致衰老組織中 miRNA 的產生減少。

label: Selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions
description: Silver ion is reported to disrupt selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions by inhibiting glutathione peroxidase, a selenium-dependent enzyme. Because selenium is a cofactor in antioxidant redox systems, silver's interference with selenoenzymes tilts cellular redox balance toward oxidation. This mechanism helps explain how silver, despite being relatively inert as a bulk metal, exerts biological effects through disruption of thiol redox circuits in both microbial and mammalian cells.
description_zh_TW: 報導稱銀離子通過抑制穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶（一種硒依賴性酶）來干擾硒催化的硫氫基氧化還原反應。由於硒是抗氧化氧化還原系統中的輔因子，銀對硒酶的干擾使細胞氧化還原平衡向氧化傾斜。此機制有助於解釋銀如何作為塊狀金屬相對惰性，卻通過干擾微生物和哺乳動物細胞中的硫醇氧化還原電路發揮生物效應。

label: Inflammatory Pain
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol attenuates inflammatory pain, reducing formalin-induced paw-licking behavior in the inflammatory phase and thermal hyperalgesia in mice. It blocks nociceptive signaling evoked by NMDA, glutamate, substance P, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), and decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in superficial laminae (I-II) of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn. Compared with magnolol, honokiol is more selective for NMDA-induced behavioral responses and hyperalgesia. Its analgesic effects are multifactorial, involving both the inflammatory cascade and glutamatergic/NMDA receptor pathways.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可減輕發炎性疼痛，降低福馬林誘發之發炎期的舔足行為及小鼠的熱痛覺過敏。它能阻斷由 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及前列腺素 E2（PGE2）引發的傷害性訊號傳遞，並降低福馬林誘發的 c-Fos 蛋白在 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的表現。與和厚朴酚相比，厚朴酚對 NMDA 誘發的行為反應與痛覺過敏更具選擇性。其鎮痛作用是多重因素共同造成的，同時涉及發炎級聯反應及麩胺酸能/NMDA 受體路徑。

label: c-Fos
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in the superficial (I-II) laminae of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn in mice, a marker of spinal nociceptive neuron activation. Along with reducing formalin-induced paw-licking, this shows honokiol acts at the spinal level to dampen pain transmission during the inflammatory phase of the formalin model. Honokiol's ability to suppress dorsal-horn c-Fos parallels its blockade of NMDA-, glutamate-, substance P-, and PGE2-evoked nociception, supporting a spinal component to its analgesic activity.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚降低小鼠福馬林誘發之 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的 c-Fos 蛋白表現，此為脊髓傷害性神經元活化的標記。加上減少福馬林誘發的舔足行為，顯示厚朴酚在脊髓層次發揮作用，於福馬林模型的發炎期減弱疼痛傳遞。厚朴酚抑制背角 c-Fos 的能力，與其阻斷 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及 PGE2 誘發之傷害感受的作用並行，支持其鎮痛活性中的脊髓組成。

label: Glutamic Acid Decarboxylase
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol increases the activity of glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD), the enzyme responsible for GABA synthesis, in the cortex and hippocampus of mice. By enhancing GAD(65) and GAD(67) activity, honokiol can augment the brain's synthesis of the inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA, which may complement its direct positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors. This combined effect on GABAergic tone is consistent with honokiol's central depressant, anticonvulsant, anxiolytic, and sleep-promoting pharmacological profile.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚會提高小鼠皮質與海馬迴中麩胺酸脫羧酶（GAD）的活性，此酶負責 GABA 的合成。透過增強 GAD(65) 與 GAD(67) 的活性，厚朴酚可增強大腦合成抑制性神經傳導物質 GABA，這可能與其對 GABA-A 受體的直接正向異位調節相輔相成。這種對 GABA 能張力的綜合作用，與厚朴酚中樞抑制、抗驚厥、抗焦慮及促睡眠的藥理特性一致。

label: Arterial Thrombosis
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol is a potent inhibitor of arterial thrombosis, acting through endothelial cell protection and stimulation of prostacyclin production. This antithrombotic effect is a safety consideration: caution is advised in coagulopathic patients, those with hemorrhagic stroke or hemorrhagic transformation after ischemic stroke, patients on warfarin or low-molecular-weight heparin, and individuals with clotting disorders such as hemophilia or von Willebrand's deficiency. The bleeding risk must be weighed against honokiol's neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory benefits before clinical use.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是動脈血栓的強效抑制劑，其作用機制為保護內皮細胞並刺激前列環素生成。此抗血栓作用是安全考量點：凝血功能異常病患、出血性中風或缺血性中風後出血性轉化的病患、服用華法林或低分子量肝素的病患，以及患有血友病或 von Willebrand 因子缺乏等凝血疾病者，均應謹慎使用。臨床使用前必須權衡出血風險與厚朴酚的神經保護及抗發炎效益。

label: Non-REM Sleep
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol promotes non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep and shortens sleep latency. In mouse studies, honokiol at 10 and 20 mg/kg significantly decreased sleep latency and increased the amount of NREM sleep without affecting REM sleep or EEG power density, and it excited sleep-promoting neurons in the ventrolateral preoptic area. These effects occur through the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor. The combined sleep-promoting and anxiolytic actions suggest a potential role for honokiol as an anesthetic adjunct.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可促進非快速動眼（NREM）睡眠並縮短入睡潛伏期。在小鼠研究中，厚朴酚在 10 及 20 mg/kg 劑量下顯著縮短入睡潛伏期並增加 NREM 睡眠量，但不影響 REM 睡眠或 EEG 功率密度，且會興奮腹外側視前區的促睡眠神經元。這些效應經由 GABA-A 受體的苯二氮平位點產生。促睡眠與抗焦慮作用的結合，顯示厚朴酚可能作為麻醉輔助劑的潛力。

label: Diazepam
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: In animal behavioral models, honokiol produces anxiolysis at doses as low as 0.2 mg/kg with fewer motor and cognitive side effects than the benzodiazepine diazepam. The anxiolytic effect of honokiol is blocked by flumazenil, bicuculline, CCK-4, and caffeine, whereas these agents differentially affect diazepam's anxiolysis (e.g., caffeine enhances diazepam's effect), suggesting honokiol may act through partly alternative pathways in addition to GABA-A potentiation. This favorable side-effect profile is a key rationale for developing honokiol as an anxiolytic.
description_zh_TW: 在動物行為模型中，厚朴酚在低至 0.2 mg/kg 的劑量下即產生抗焦慮作用，且運動與認知副作用少於苯二氮平類藥物地西泮。厚朴酚的抗焦慮作用可被氟馬西尼、荷包牡丹鹼、CCK-4 及咖啡因阻斷，而這些藥劑對地西泮抗焦慮作用的影響則各不相同（例如咖啡因會增強地西泮的效果），顯示厚朴酚除了 GABA-A 強化之外，可能部分經由替代路徑發揮作用。這種良好的副作用特性是開發厚朴酚為抗焦慮藥物的關鍵理由。

label: Magnolol
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Magnolol is the structural analog of honokiol, both being lipid-soluble polyphenolic lignans from Magnolia species. The two compounds show broadly overlapping pharmacology - both are positive allosteric modulators of GABA-A receptors, inhibit NMDA receptor signaling and NF-kappaB activation, protect neurons against beta-amyloid toxicity, and reduce inflammatory pain - but magnolol is generally slightly less potent or less selective, particularly for NMDA-driven responses where honokiol shows greater selectivity. The structural homology with the anesthetic propofol likely explains some shared pharmacologic actions.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚（magnolol）是和厚朴酚（honokiol）的結構類似物，兩者皆為來自木蘭屬（Magnolia）物種的脂溶性多酚木脂素。這兩種化合物展現大致重疊的藥理作用——兩者皆為 GABA-A 受體的正向異位調節劑、抑制 NMDA 受體訊息傳導與 NF-kappaB 活化、保護神經元免受 beta-類澱粉毒性，並減輕發炎性疼痛——但厚朴酚通常效力稍低或選擇性較差，尤其對於和厚朴酚展現較高選擇性的 NMDA 驅動反應。與麻醉劑異丙酚（propofol）的結構同源性可能解釋某些共享的藥理作用。

label: Neuronal Death
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: While honokiol is neuroprotective at low doses, it increases neuronal death in vitro at higher concentrations: 100 uM applied directly to fetal cortical neurons is toxic. This dose-dependent biphasic behavior underscores the need to define human pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic parameters before clinical administration. The potential neurotoxicity at supraphysiological concentrations, combined with honokiol's antithrombotic activity, highlights the importance of careful dosing and patient selection for any therapeutic use.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚在低劑量下具有神經保護作用，但在較高濃度下會增加體外神經元死亡：100 uM 直接施加於胎兒皮質神經元即具毒性。這種劑量依賴的雙相行為凸顯了在臨床投藥前須先確立人體藥動學與藥效學參數。超生理濃度下的潛在神經毒性，加上厚朴酚的抗血栓活性，強調了任何治療用途都需謹慎給藥並審慎選擇病患。

label: Water
description: Honokiol is highly lipophilic with very poor water solubility, so hot-water tea extraction is inefficient and ethanol tinctures or supercritical CO2 extracts are needed for therapeutic dosing. Directionally, the physicochemical property sits upstream of formulation requirement. Its lipophilicity also aids cell and mitochondrial membrane penetration, supporting SIRT3 engagement and explaining its potency despite poor aqueous solubility. This is a practical caveat for honokiol use, since the delivery vehicle determines both absorption and bioavailability. Nanoparticle and other advanced formulations are being explored to improve honokiol's pharmacokinetics.
description_zh_TW: 和厚朴酚（Honokiol）具有高度親脂性和極差的水溶性，因此熱水茶提取效率低，需要乙醇酊劑或超臨界 CO2 萃取物才能達到治療劑量。在方向性上，此物理化學性質位於製劑需求的上游。其親脂性也有助於細胞和粒線體膜穿透，支持 SIRT3 的結合並解釋了其儘管水溶性差仍具有高效力的原因。這是和厚朴酚使用的實際注意事項，因為遞送載體決定了吸收和生物利用度。正在探索奈米粒子和其他先進製劑以改善和厚朴酚的藥動學。

label: Renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis
description: Honokiol suppresses renal tubulointerstitial fibrosis by activating SIRT3, which inhibits the NF-κB/TGF-β1 pathway and limits fibrogenic signaling in kidney tubules. Directionally, honokiol activates SIRT3 to drive antifibrotic transcription. This reduces collagen deposition and inflammatory infiltrate, protecting renal architecture during injury. It illustrates SIRT3's broad tissue-protective role beyond the heart, and it is consistent with the general antifibrotic action of mitochondrial sirtuins. Given that tubulointerstitial fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic kidney disease, SIRT3 activation represents a promising strategy to slow renal decline.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚通過活化 SIRT3 抑制腎小管間質纖維化，SIRT3 抑制 NF-κB/TGF-β1 通路並限制腎小管中的纖維化信號。在方向性上，厚朴酚活化 SIRT3 以驅動抗纖維化轉錄。這減少膠原蛋白沉積和發炎浸潤，在損傷期間保護腎臟結構。它說明了 SIRT3 超越心臟的廣泛組織保護作用，與粒線體 sirtuin 的一般抗纖維化作用一致。鑑於小管間質纖維化是慢性腎病的共同最終通路，SIRT3 活化代表了一種延緩腎臟退化的有前景策略。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of H2A.Z
description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation and degradation of H2A.Z helps protect the heart from failure by removing a histone variant that drives maladaptive cardiac hypertrophic gene programs. Deacetylated H2A.Z is targeted for proteasomal degradation, reducing its presence at promoters that would otherwise sustain pathological remodeling. Directionally, SIRT1 promotes H2A.Z loss, which attenuates hypertrophy. This is a mechanistically plausible explanation for why SIRT1 activation is cardioprotective, though the in vivo evidence carries moderate confidence.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 H2A.Z 去乙醯化和降解通過移除驅動適應不良心臟肥大基因程序的組蛋白變體，幫助保護心臟免於衰竭。去乙醯化的 H2A.Z 被標記進行蛋白酶體降解，減少其在否則會維持病理性重塑的啟動子處的存在。在方向性上，SIRT1 促進 H2A.Z 的缺失，從而減弱肥大。這是 SIRT1 活化具有心臟保護作用的一個機制上合理的解釋，儘管體內證據的信心程度為中等。

label: NMDA receptor
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol blocks NMDA receptor-, glutamate-, and K+-evoked cationic influx and raises seizure threshold. A key neuroprotective mechanism is the disruption of the postsynaptic PSD95-nNOS coupling at the NMDA receptor complex, preventing Ca2+-dependent neurotoxic nitric oxide production after ischemia-reperfusion.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 阻斷 NMDA 受體、穀氨酸和 K+ 誘發的陽離子內流並提高癲癇閾值。一個關鍵的神經保護機制是在 NMDA 受體複合體處破壞突觸後 PSD95–nNOS 偶聯，防止缺血再灌注後依賴 Ca2+ 的神經毒性一氧化氮產生。

label: Thrombosis
description: Honokiol inhibits arterial thrombosis via endothelial protection and stimulation of prostacyclin. Because of this potent antithrombotic action, it should be avoided in coagulopathic patients, hemorrhagic stroke, or those on anticoagulants.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 透過內皮保護和刺激前列環素來抑制動脈血栓形成。由於這種強效的抗血栓作用，凝血病變患者、出血性中風或服用抗凝血劑者應避免使用。

label: GABA_A receptor
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol is a positive allosteric modulator (PAM) of the GABA-A receptor, including both synaptic and extrasynaptic receptors, acting at the benzodiazepine site. It shows higher efficacy at delta-subunit-containing receptors and its anxiolytic effect is blocked by the antagonist bicuculline and by flumazenil.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 是 GABA-A 受體的正面異位調節劑（PAM），涵蓋突觸和突觸外受體，作用於苯二氮平類藥物位點。它在含 δ 亞基的受體上表現出更高效能，其抗焦慮作用會被拮抗劑 bicuculline 和 flumazenil 阻斷。

label: DLK1-DIO3 locus
description: In humans, miR-543 maps to the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 locus on chromosome 14q32, one of the largest mammalian miRNA megaclusters. Its expression is controlled by parent-of-origin DNA methylation, making it both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，miR-543 定位於染色體 14q32 的基因銘印 DLK1-DIO3 基因座，這是哺乳動物最大的 miRNA 巨簇之一。其表現受親源 DNA 甲基化控制，使其既是表觀基因組的效應器也是感測器。

label: Mitochondrial Metabolism
description: miR-378 modulates mitochondrial energy metabolism through targets including ERRgamma (ESRRG), GABPA, and CRAT/MED13. It counterbalances PGC-1beta activity and is co-transcribed with its host gene PPARGC1B, tying its expression to mitochondrial biogenesis programs.
description_zh_TW: miR-378 透過包括 ERRgamma（ESRRG）、GABPA 和 CRAT/MED13 在內的靶標調節粒線體能量代謝。它平衡 PGC-1beta 的活性，並與宿主基因 PPARGC1B 共同轉錄，將其表現與粒線體生合成程式連結起來。

label: PGC-1beta
description: miR-378a is encoded within the first intron of the PPARGC1B gene (PGC-1beta) on chromosome 5q32. Because it sits inside the metabolic master regulator locus, its dysregulation couples mitochondrial metabolic decline with the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: miR-378a 編碼在染色體 5q32 的 PPARGC1B 基因（PGC-1beta）第一個內含子中。由於它位於代謝主調控基因座內，其失調將粒線體代謝衰退與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸耦合起來。

label: Exportin-5
description: Exportin-5 is a RanGTP-dependent nuclear export receptor that transports precursor microRNA (pre-miRNA) hairpins from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. There the pre-miRNA is matured by Dicer and loaded onto Argonaute in the RISC.
description_zh_TW: Exportin-5 是 RanGTP 依賴的核輸出受體，將 microRNA 前驅物（pre-miRNA）髮夾從細胞核運送至細胞質。在那裡 pre-miRNA 由 Dicer 成熟並裝載到 RISC 中的 Argonaute。

label: RNA Interference
description: RNA interference is a conserved post-transcriptional gene-silencing pathway in which double-stranded RNA is processed into siRNAs or microRNAs that guide RISC to repress complementary target mRNAs. MicroRNAs are a key effector class of this pathway.
description_zh_TW: RNA 干擾是保守的轉錄後基因靜默途徑，雙股 RNA 被加工為 siRNA 或 microRNA，引導 RISC 抑制互補的目標 mRNA。MicroRNA 是此途徑的關鍵效應類別。

label: Ribonuclease III
description: Ribonuclease III (RNase III) is a family of enzymes that specifically cleave double-stranded RNA, including Drosha and Dicer that initiate and mature microRNA biogenesis. These RNase III enzymes process microRNA precursors into functional guides.
description_zh_TW: 核糖核酸酶 III（RNase III）是特異性剪切雙股 RNA 的酶家族，包括起始與成熟 microRNA 生合成的 Drosha 與 Dicer。這些 RNase III 酶將 microRNA 前驅物加工為功能性引導。

label: RISC
description: The RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC) is the effector machinery of small-RNA silencing, centered on an Argonaute protein loaded with a guide microRNA or siRNA. RISC directs sequence-specific translational repression or cleavage of target mRNAs.
description_zh_TW: RNA 誘導靜默複合體（RISC）是小 RNA 靜默的效應機制，以裝載引導 microRNA 或 siRNA 的 Argonaute 蛋白為中心。RISC 對目標 mRNA 進行序列特異的轉譯抑制或剪切。

label: Double-stranded RNA-binding domain
description: The double-stranded RNA-binding domain (dsRBD) binds double-stranded RNA in a structure-specific manner and positions RNA substrates for processing enzymes. DGCR8 and Dicer use tandem dsRBDs to recognize and process microRNA precursors.
description_zh_TW: 雙股 RNA 結合結構域（dsRBD）以結構特異方式結合雙股 RNA，並將 RNA 受質定位給加工酶。DGCR8 與 Dicer 利用串聯 dsRBD 來辨識與加工 microRNA 前驅物。

label: Citrate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: SLC25A1, the mitochondrial citrate carrier, exports citrate from the mitochondrial matrix to the cytosol, where it can be converted to acetyl-CoA. SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels in multiple senescence contexts, and this citrate export sustains the nucleocytosolic acetyl-CoA pool required for histone acetylation. Genetic ablation of SLC25A1 does not alter CDK inhibitor expression or cell cycle arrest but markedly reduces SASP gene expression, and inhibition with the third-generation inhibitor CTPI2 selectively suppresses SASP-associated inflammation without clearing senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A1，線粒體枸櫞酸載體，將枸櫞酸從線粒體基質輸出到細胞質，在那裡可以轉化為乙酰輔酶A。SLC25A1表達在多種衰老背景下在mRNA和蛋白質水平上都顯著增加，這種枸櫞酸輸出維持組蛋白乙酰化所需的核質乙酰輔酶A池。SLC25A1的基因消融不改變CDK抑製劑表達或細胞週期停滯，但顯著減少SASP基因表達，使用第三代抑製劑CTPI2的抑製選擇性地抑制SASP相關炎症而不清除衰老細胞。

label: Epigenetic Alterations
description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Viral Translation
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
description_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。

label: Purine Nucleoside Phosphorylase
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which can then be converted back to NAD+ via NMN through the NAMPT and NMNAT enzymes. This NP-mediated cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR to NAM in the gut, potentially explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR. NAM is the most common NAD+ precursor in mammals, and when administered at higher doses it can exert sirtuin-inhibiting effects. The balance between the direct NMRK pathway and this NP/NAMPT route determines how efficiently supplemented NR is converted to NAD+ in different tissues.
description_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP）將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），後者隨後可透過 NMN 經由 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 酵素轉回 NAD+。此種由 NP 介導的裂解被認為是在腸道中將 NR 降解為 NAM 的變異步驟，可能解釋了 NR 口服生體可用率偏低且在個體間存在差異的現象。NAM 是哺乳動物中最常見的 NAD+ 前體，當以較高劑量投予時，可產生抑制 sirtuin 的效應。直接 NMRK 路徑與此 NP/NAMPT 途徑之間的平衡，決定了補充的 NR 在不同組織中轉化為 NAD+ 的效率。

label: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。

label: mTOR, Rictor, mSIN1, Protor-1, mLST8, Deptor
description: mTOR complex 2 (mTORC2) comprises six core proteins: mTOR, Rictor (its defining scaffold), mSIN1 (required for mTORC2 integrity and Akt phosphorylation), Protor-1, mLST8, and the negative regulator Deptor. mTORC2 is best known for phosphorylating and activating Akt at Ser473 and for regulating cytoskeletal organization and cell survival. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2 is not acutely rapamycin-sensitive and is not directly recruited to lysosomes by Rag GTPases. Its distinct composition underlies its separate physiological roles in metabolism and actin dynamics.
description_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 2（mTORC2）包含六個核心蛋白：mTOR、Rictor（其定義性支架）、mSIN1（mTORC2 完整性與 Akt 磷酸化所需）、Protor-1、mLST8，以及負向調節者 Deptor。mTORC2 最為人所知的是在 Ser473 磷酸化並活化 Akt，以及調節細胞骨架組織和細胞存活。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 不會被雷帕黴素急性抑制，也不會被 Rag GTPases 直接招募至溶酶體。其獨特組成奠定了其在代謝和肌動蛋白動力學中各自獨立的生理角色。

label: Akt at Ser473
description: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
description_zh_TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

label: Cytoskeletal organization
description: mTORC2 regulates actin cytoskeleton organization and cell migration through phosphorylation of PKCα and via effects on paxillin, RhoA, and Rac1 signaling. These outputs control cell polarity, stress-fiber formation, and the ability of cells to remodel their architecture during growth and movement. Unlike mTORC1, mTORC2's roles are more closely tied to spatial organization and survival than to bulk nutrient sensing. Dysregulation of mTORC2-dependent cytoskeletal control contributes to cancer cell invasion and metastasis.
description_zh_TW: mTORC2 透過磷酸化 PKCα 以及經由對 paxillin、RhoA 和 Rac1 信號的效應，調節肌動蛋白細胞骨架組織和細胞遷移。這些輸出控制了細胞極性、應力纖維形成，以及細胞在生長和移動期間重塑其架構的能力。不同於 mTORC1，mTORC2 的角色更密切地與空間組織和存活相關，而非大規模的營養感知。mTORC2 依賴的細胞骨架控制失調促成癌細胞侵襲和轉移。

label: catecholamine balance in Prefrontal Cortex
description: NET is critical for catecholamine balance in the prefrontal cortex because, in the relative absence of DAT, it is a major mechanism clearing both norepinephrine and dopamine, while COMT handles O-methylation. Disruption of NET, whether genetic or pharmacological, markedly alters prefrontal catechol tone and thus attention, arousal, working memory, and stress responses. Its role makes it a target for antidepressants and attention-deficit treatments. It functions in concert with COMT to maintain prefrontal dopamine homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: NET 對於前額葉皮質中的兒茶酚胺平衡至關重要，因為在相對缺乏 DAT 的情況下，它是清除 norepinephrine 和多巴胺的主要機制，而 COMT 則處理 O-甲基化。 NET 的破壞，無論是遺傳的還是藥理學的，都會顯著改變前額葉兒茶酚的張力，從而改變注意力、喚醒、工作記憶和壓力反應。它的作用使其成為抗憂鬱藥物和注意力缺陷治療的目標。它與 COMT 協同作用，維持前額多巴胺穩態。

label: dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) also reuptakes dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, because DAT is sparse there and NET, with modest affinity for dopamine, clears a meaningful fraction of extracellular dopamine. This dual substrate specificity means prefrontal dopamine clearance is shared between NET and COMT, with both contributing to setting dopamine tone. The arrangement explains why noradrenergic drugs, such as NET inhibitors used as antidepressants and attention treatments, can influence prefrontal dopamine levels. It is a key feature of prefrontal catecholamine regulation.
description_zh_TW: norepinephrine 轉運蛋白 (NET) 也在前額葉皮質中重新攝取多巴胺，因為那裡的 DAT 很稀疏，而 NET 對多巴胺具有適度的親和力，可以清除相當一部分細胞外多巴胺。這種雙重底物特異性意味著 NET 和 COMT 共享前額多巴胺清除率，兩者都有助於設定多巴胺基調。這種安排解釋了為什麼去甲腎上腺素能藥物，例如用作抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的 NET 抑制劑，可以影響前額葉多巴胺水平。這是前額葉兒茶酚胺調節的關鍵特徵。

label: sparse Dopamine Transporter in Prefrontal Cortex
description: In the prefrontal cortex, where the dopamine transporter is sparsely expressed, NET assumes an outsized role by clearing a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine in addition to norepinephrine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes. The complementary actions of NET and COMT define prefrontal dopamine dynamics.
description_zh_TW: 在前額葉皮質，多巴胺轉運蛋白表達稀疏，NET 除了清除 norepinephrine 外還清除大量細胞外 dopamine，因此承擔了超乎尋常的角色。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。NET 和 COMT 的互補作用定義了前額葉多巴胺動力學。

label: atomoxetine
description: NET can be inhibited by drugs such as atomoxetine and methylphenidate, which raise both norepinephrine and dopamine in the prefrontal cortex. These NET inhibitors enhance attention and executive function, relevant to ADHD and the cognitive effects of Modafinil. Amphetamine-like compounds reverse NET transport, causing catecholamine efflux.
description_zh_TW: NET 可被 atomoxetine 和 methylphenidate 等藥物抑制，這些藥物會升高前額葉皮質中的 norepinephrine 和 dopamine。這些 NET 抑制劑增強注意力和 executive function，與 ADHD 和 Modafinil 的認知效應相關。安非他命類化合物會逆轉 NET 運輸，導致兒茶酚胺外流。

label: SLC6A2 sodium-dependent symporter
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) is a sodium- and chloride-dependent symporter of the SLC6 family encoded by SLC6A2. It couples the inward transport of one norepinephrine molecule with the co-transport of one Na+ and one Cl-. NET is the target of many antidepressants such as reboxetine and of psychostimulants.
description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter (NET) 是 SLC6 家族的鈉和氯依賴性共同轉運體，由 SLC6A2 編碼。它將一個 norepinephrine 分子的向內運輸與一個 Na+ 和一個 Cl- 的共同運輸耦合。NET 是許多抗憂鬱藥（如 reboxetine）和精神興奮劑的靶點。

label: NET
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) clears approximately 80-90 percent of released norepinephrine by high-affinity reuptake into the presynaptic varicosity at sympathetic nerve endings. The recaptured norepinephrine is either repackaged into vesicles or metabolized. NET-mediated reuptake is the dominant mechanism for terminating sympathetic neurotransmission.
description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter（NET）透過高親和力再攝取，清除交感神經末梢突觸前膨體中約 80-90% 已釋放的 norepinephrine。被再攝取的 norepinephrine 會被重新包裝入囊泡或被代謝。NET 介導的再攝取是終止交感神經傳遞的主要機制。

label: ER stress
description: TFE3 is activated in response to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress through a pathway that is mTORC1-independent but requires the ER stress sensor PERK. Under unfolded protein accumulation, PERK signaling promotes TFE3 nuclear translocation, engaging lysosomal and autophagic genes to alleviate proteotoxic burden. This distinct trigger allows TFE3 to contribute to the integrated stress response without relying on nutrient sensing. The mechanism expands the repertoire of stressors that can recruit the MiT/TFE degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 在回應內質網（ER）壓力時透過一條不依賴 mTORC1、但需要 ER 壓力感測器 PERK 的途徑被活化。在未折疊蛋白累積時，PERK 信號促進 TFE3 核轉位，啟動溶酶體和自噬基因以減輕蛋白毒性負擔。此獨特觸發因子使 TFE3 能在不依賴營養感知的情況下，貢獻於整合性壓力反應。此機制擴展了能夠招募 MiT/TFE 降解程序的壓力因子 repertoire。

label: Xp11 translocation RCC
description: TFE3 is recurrently involved in Xp11.2 translocation renal cell carcinomas, in which it fuses with partner genes such as ASPSCR1, PRCC, or SFPQ, creating chimeric transcription factors that drive tumorigenesis. These gene fusions define a distinct subset of RCC, often arising in children and young adults, with characteristic clear-cell or papillary features. The fusion proteins typically retain the TFE3 DNA-binding domain and are constitutively active, deregulating MiT/TFE target genes. Detection of TFE3 rearrangement is important for correct diagnosis and classification of these tumors.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 反覆參與 Xp11.2 轉位性腎細胞癌，在此它與 ASPSCR1、PRCC 或 SFPQ 等夥伴基因融合，創造出驅動腫瘤發生的嵌合轉錄因子。這些基因融合定義了 RCC 的一個獨特亞群，常發生於兒童和年輕成人，具有特徵性的透明細胞或乳突狀特徵。融合蛋白通常保留 TFE3 的 DNA 結合域並呈組成型活化，使 MiT/TFE 標的基因失調。偵測 TFE3 重排對於正確診斷和分類這些腫瘤至為重要。

label: TFEB for CLEAR element
description: The oncogenic transcription factor MYC competes with TFEB for binding to CLEAR elements in the promoters of lysosomal and autophagy genes. By occupying these sites, MYC represses the TFEB-driven transcriptional program while simultaneously driving its own proliferative gene network. This competitive binding creates a molecular antagonism between growth-promoting and degradative transcriptional programs. The interplay explains how MYC-high tumors suppress autophagy-lysosomal capacity even as they increase metabolic demand.
description_zh_TW: 致癌轉錄因子 MYC 與 TFEB 競爭結合溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的 CLEAR 元件。透過佔據這些位點，MYC 抑制 TFEB 驅動的轉錄程序，同時驅動其自身的增生基因網絡。這種競爭性結合在促生長和降解的轉錄程序之間創造了分子拮抗。此交互作用解釋了 MYC 高表現的腫瘤如何抑制自噬—溶酶體能力，即使它們增加了代謝需求。

label: Osteoclast development
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFE3 regulates osteoclast development by promoting the transition of mononucleated to multinucleated osteoclasts. This activation occurs downstream of the growth factors M-CSF and RANK and requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation. TFE3 thereby contributes to skeletal formation and remodeling through its control of osteoclast maturation. The role highlights TFE3's function in cell lineage decisions beyond lysosomal biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 透過促進單核細胞向多核破骨細胞的轉變，調節破骨細胞發育。此活化發生於生長因子 M-CSF 和 RANK 下游，並需要依賴 MAPK 的 TFE3 磷酸化。因此 TFE3 透過控制破骨細胞成熟，促成骨骼形成和重塑。此角色凸顯 TFE3 在細胞譜系決定中超越溶酶體生物發生的功能。

label: Autonomic Nervous System
description: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
description_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

label: Sympathetic Nervous System
description: The sympathetic nervous system is the fight, flight, or freeze branch of the autonomic nervous system. It releases adrenaline and cortisol to prepare the body for action during events such as a HIIT workout, cold plunge, or fasting. When the SNS is active, it forces the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, thereby lowering HRV. Chronic sympathetic dominance keeps the system stuck in the on position, producing a chronically depressed HRV that signals under-recovery and overtraining rather than adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 交感神經系統是自主神經系統的戰鬥、逃跑或凍結分支。它釋放腎上腺素和皮質醇，使身體在HIIT鍛煉、冷水浸泡或禁食等事件期間準備行動。當SNS活躍時，它迫使心臟跳動更快、更規律，從而降低HRV。慢性交感神經主導地位使系統卡在開啟位置，產生慢性抑鬱的HRV，表示恢復不足和過度訓練而非適應。

label: ACTH
description: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) released from the anterior pituitary under hypothalamic CRH stimulation binds the adrenal cortex to drive cortisol synthesis and release, forming the effector arm of the HPA-axis stress response. Chronic ACTH–cortisol activation suppresses heart-rate variability and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 促腎上腺皮質激素（ACTH）在下視丘 CRH 刺激下由腦下垂體前葉釋放，作用於腎上腺皮質以驅動 cortisol 的合成與釋放，構成 HPA 軸壓力反應的效應臂。慢性的 ACTH–cortisol 活化會抑制心率變異度並損害粒線體生合成。

label: IL-1R
description: IL-1R recruits MyD88 via TIR-TIR interactions, and MyD88 assembles the myddosome to propagate IL-1alpha/IL-1beta signals in senescent cells and responding macrophages. This transduction is essential for the NF-kB activation that drives SASP and paracrine arrest, and it requires the death-domain-mediated recruitment of IRAK kinases. The relationship positions MyD88 as the immediate downstream effector of IL-1R and is a canonical IL-1R signaling mechanism. Blocking this interaction can suppress IL-1-dependent inflammatory output.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 從 IL-1R 轉導訊號，在 IL-1alpha 或 IL-1beta 接合受體後招募 IRAK4 與 IRAK1 以活化 NF-κB。此轉導是 IL-1 介導旁分泌衰老與 SASP 放大所必需的，且連結頂層 SASP 放大器到下游轉錄。透過 MyD88 缺失阻斷此路徑可抑制衰老擴散，確認其在衰老溝通中的功能必要。它是 IL-1R 訊號至核心發炎輸出的確立橋樑。

label: Myddosome
description: MyD88 assembles into the helical oligomeric myddosome with IRAK4 and IRAK1/2, serving as the scaffolding platform that activates downstream kinases such as TAK1 and transcription factors such as NF-kB. This supramolecular complex is the mechanistic core of IL-1R/TLR signaling and is assembled through death-domain homotypic interactions. In senescence, myddosome formation underlies IL-1alpha-driven SASP, translating IL-1 receptor engagement into inflammatory transcription. The assembly is a defining structural feature of MyD88-dependent signaling and a validated drug target.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 與 IRAK4、IRAK1 及 TRAF6 組裝成稱為 Myddosome 的高階寡聚複合體，作為 IL-1R 與 TLR 下游訊號傳遞的平台。此支架將受體接合轉化為 NF-κB 與 MAPK 活化，驅動 SASP。Myddosome 形成整合 MyD88 的銜接功能與激酶級聯，使其成為衰老發炎輸出的分子引擎。其組裝是連結 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器到分泌組的關鍵步驟。

label: Adaptor Protein
description: MyD88 is a cytoplasmic adaptor protein serving as the central hub of Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling, linking receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Its classification as an adaptor reflects its role in assembling signaling complexes rather than performing enzymatic catalysis, and it does so through death domain and TIR domain interactions. In senescence, MyD88 transduces IL-1alpha signals that sustain the SASP, placing it at the interface of innate immunity and senescence. It is a foundational innate immune signaling scaffold conserved across species.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是一種銜接蛋白（adaptor protein），將先天免疫受體如 IL-1R 與 TLR 的胞質訊號域連結到下游 IRAK 激酶與 TRAF6。作為 Toll/IL-1R（TIR）訊號的主要轉接器，其歸類為銜接蛋白反映其在組裝訊號複合體中的支架角色。在衰老中，MyD88 是將 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器連結到 NF-κB 與 SASP 的核心節點。其銜接功能使其成為衰老發炎級聯的中央中樞。

label: Senescent Cells to Macrophages
description: Senescent-cell surface IL-1alpha engages IL-1R on macrophages, recruiting MyD88 to activate NF-kB and amplify SASP both in the sender cell through autocrine signaling and in recruited immune cells through paracrine signaling. This bridges the senescent cell and the macrophage through IL-1R/MyD88 signaling, propagating inflammation across the tissue. The relationship situates MyD88 at the interface of senescence and innate immunity and explains how local senescence ignites broader inflammatory responses. It is a key mechanism of SASP-driven immune amplification.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 橋接衰老細胞與巨噬細胞，使巨噬細胞中的 IL-1R 訊號感知源自衰老細胞的 IL-1alpha 並引發其對衰老細胞的發炎反應。此橋接將分泌組連結到免疫效應器，促進清除但也發炎，並使 MyD88 成為衰老—巨噬細胞交互作用的關鍵介體。透過將 SASP 轉化為巨噬細胞活化，MyD88 同時支持監視與潜在的 chronic inflammaging。其必要角色在 MyD88 缺失模型中顯示。

label: Cathepsin B
description: Cathepsin B is a lysosomal cysteine protease that, together with cathepsin D, is a major enzyme responsible for breaking down AGE-modified proteins. Glycated proteins are directed to lysosomes for degradation, and these cathepsins ensure that proteins damaged by non-enzymatic glycation are cleared rather than allowed to accumulate. The activity of such lysosomal proteases declines with age and under UV exposure, which correlates with accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Maintaining lysosomal cathepsin function is therefore important for proteolytic clearance of glycated material and limiting AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B）是一種溶酶體半胱氨酸蛋白酶，與組織蛋白酶 D 一起是負責分解 AGE 修飾蛋白的主要酵素。糖化蛋白被導向溶酶體進行降解，而這些組織蛋白酶確保因非酵素性糖化而受損的蛋白質被清除而非堆積。此類溶酶體蛋白酶的活性隨年齡增長與紫外線暴露而下降，這與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，維持溶酶體組織蛋白酶功能對於糖化物質的蛋白水解清除與限制 AGE 負擔十分重要。

label: Arterial Stiffening
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a prominent advanced glycation end product formed from glycated proteins. There is a marked correlation between the serum concentration of CML and vessel stiffness in elderly individuals, reflecting the role of AGE accumulation and ECM cross-linking in arterial stiffening. CML also accumulates in heart tissue with age, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice. Serum CML is therefore used as a biomarker of glycation burden and age-related vascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是由 glycated proteins 形成的重要 advanced glycation end product。Elderly individuals 血清 CML concentration 與 vessel stiffness 之間存在顯著相關性，反映了 AGE accumulation 與 ECM cross-linking 在 arterial stiffening 中的作用。CML 也隨年齡堆積於 heart tissue，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。因此，血清 CML 被用作 glycation burden 與 age-related vascular pathology 的 biomarker。

label: Troponin
description: Troponin is a heterotrimeric complex regulating striated muscle contraction, and cardiac troponin I and T are highly cardiac-specific gold-standard biomarkers of myocardial injury. Troponin release from the heart signals myocardial damage.
description_zh_TW: 肌鈣蛋白（troponin）是調控橫紋肌收縮的異三聚體複合體，而心肌肌鈣蛋白 I 與 T 是高度心臟特異的心肌損傷金標準生物標記。心臟釋放的肌鈣蛋白指示心肌損傷。

label: Schiff base
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: During the second phase of the Maillard reaction, the initially reversible Schiff base undergoes a chemical rearrangement over a period of days to form Amadori products, also known as early glycation products. Amadori products are more stable than the Schiff base but the reaction remains reversible; hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized Amadori product and serves as an indicator of blood glucose management. If Amadori products accumulate, they undergo further oxidations, reductions, and hydrations over weeks or months to form irreversibly crosslinked proteins and ultimately advanced glycation end products.
description_zh_TW: 在Maillard reaction的second phase，最初reversible的Schiff base在days期間undergoes a chemical rearrangement，形成Amadori products，亦稱early glycation products。Amadori products比Schiff base更stable但reaction remains reversible；hemoglobin A1c是最widely recognized Amadori product，並serves as an indicator of blood glucose management。若Amadori products accumulate，它們會在weeks或months內undergo further oxidations、reductions與hydrations，形成irreversibly crosslinked proteins，ultimately advanced glycation end products。

label: protein function
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycation is a spontaneous non-enzymatic reaction of reducing sugars with free amino groups of proteins, DNA, and lipids that leads to loss of protein function and impaired elasticity of tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons. The process is highly accelerated in the presence of hyperglycemia and tissue oxidative stress, implicating it in diabetic complications and aging. Intracellular AGE modification of signaling molecules can impair cellular functions and gene expression, and glycation of antioxidant enzymes such as catalase, glutathione peroxidase, and glutathione reductase reduces their activity, further increasing cellular oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Glycation 是 reducing sugars 與蛋白質、DNA 和脂質的游離 amino groups 自發性非酵素反應，會導致蛋白質功能喪失以及 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等組織彈性受損。此過程在 hyperglycemia 與組織 oxidative stress 存在下大幅加速，使其涉及 diabetic complications 與 aging。細胞內 signaling molecules 的 intracellular AGE modification 會損害細胞功能與 gene expression，而 catalase、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione reductase 等 antioxidant enzymes 的 glycation 會降低其活性，進一步增加細胞 oxidative stress。

label: Hemoglobin A1c
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Hemoglobin A1c is the most widely recognized early glycation product, an Amadori product formed when glucose attaches non-enzymatically to the amino terminus of hemoglobin in red blood cells. It is used clinically as an indicator of blood glucose management in people with diabetes because its level reflects average glycemia over the preceding weeks. As an Amadori product, hemoglobin A1c is a reversible early intermediate on the pathway to irreversible advanced glycation end products. Its clinical utility demonstrates that even early, reversible glycation products are valuable biomarkers of glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 糖化血色素 A1c（Hemoglobin A1c）是最廣為人知的早期糖化產物，是一種當葡萄糖非酵素性地附著於紅血球中血紅素的胺基端時所形成的阿馬多里產物（Amadori product）。它在臨床上用作糖尿病患者血糖控制的指標，因為其濃度反映前幾週的平均血糖狀態。作為一種阿馬多里產物，糖化血色素 A1c 是通往不可逆晚期糖化終產物路徑上的一個可逆早期中間產物。其臨床效用證明，即使是早期、可逆的糖化產物也是糖化負擔的有價值生物標記。

label: serum AGE levels
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。

label: Branched-Chain Amino Acids
description: High circulating branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels - leucine, isoleucine, and valine - are associated with obesity, insulin resistance, and mortality in humans. High-BCAA diets promote obesity, insulin resistance, inflammation, and decreased lifespan in rodents, whereas dietary restriction of BCAAs promotes metabolic health, reduces frailty, and extends lifespan, recapitulating many benefits of protein restriction. BCAA restriction reduces mTORC1 signaling, induces Fgf21, reduces hepatic cellular senescence, and in human studies improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis while increasing circulating FGF21. Although BCAAs are often considered as a group, each individual BCAA plays distinct roles in aging.
description_zh_TW: 循環中高濃度的支鏈胺基酸（BCAA）——白胺酸（leucine）、異白胺酸（isoleucine）與纈胺酸（valine）——與人類的肥胖、胰島素阻抗及死亡率相關。高BCAA飲食會在囓齒類中促進肥胖、胰島素阻抗、發炎並縮短壽命；而膳食限制BCAA則可促進代謝健康、減少衰弱並延長壽命，重現蛋白質限制的許多益處。限制BCAA可降低mTORC1訊息傳導、誘導Fgf21、減少肝臟細胞衰老；在人體研究中則可改善胰島素敏感性與葡萄糖/胰島素恆定，同時提高循環中的FGF21。儘管BCAA常被視為一個群體，但每一種BCAA在衰老中都扮演著不同的角色。

label: Glutaminolysis
description: SIRT5 enhances glutaminolysis in colorectal cancer in a deglutarylation-dependent manner to drive colorectal carcinogenesis, and it deacetylates lactate dehydrogenase B to induce hyperactive autophagy and tumorigenesis. SIRT5 overexpression is associated with poor prognosis in CRC, contrasting with protective SIRT6.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 以去戊二醯化依賴的方式增強大腸癌中的麩醯胺分解，驅動大腸癌發生，且去乙醯化 lactate dehydrogenase B 以誘發過度活化的自噬與腫瘤發生。SIRT5 過度表現與 CRC 不良預後相關，與保護性 SIRT6 形成對比。

label: LDHB
description: SIRT5 is protumorigenic in CRC, HCC, and NSCLC by reprogramming metabolism toward glycolysis and glutaminolysis; it desuccinylates lactate dehydrogenase B (LDHB) to hyperactivate autophagy, feeding cancer cells recycled nutrients. SIRT5 is a desuccinylase largely resistant to nicotinamide inhibition.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 在 CRC、HCC 與 NSCLC 中透過將代謝重編程為糖解與麩醯胺分解而促腫瘤；它去琥珀醯化 lactate dehydrogenase B（LDHB）以過度活化自噬，供養癌細胞回收的營養。SIRT5 是主要對菸鹼醯胺抑制具抗性的去琥珀醯酶。

label: H2O2-induced cell death in cardiomyocytes
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: A finding suggests that in cardiomyocytes, SIRT5 is a key moderator in cell death induced by H2O2. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the cardiomyocyte response to oxidative stress, dampening or modulating hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death. This places SIRT5 in the cardiac stress response network and suggests that modulating SIRT5 activity could influence oxidative injury in the heart.
description_zh_TW: 一項發現表明，在心肌細胞中，SIRT5是H2O2誘導的細胞死亡的關鍵調節因子。方向上，SIRT5位於心肌細胞對氧化壓力反應的上游，抑制或調節過氧化氫誘導的細胞死亡。這將SIRT5置於心臟壓力反應網路中，並表明調節SIRT5活性可能影響心臟的氧化損傷。

label: HCC growth and metastasis via glycolysis reprogramming
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Activation of mitochondrial SIRT5 promotes the growth and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma cells via glucose metabolism reprogramming from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the glycolytic switch that fuels liver cancer progression. By favoring glycolysis, SIRT5 supplies the biosynthetic and bioenergetic demands of rapidly growing HCC cells, supporting tumor aggressiveness. This oncogenic role is opposed by SIRT5's bile-acid-metabolism-mediated suppression of HCC, underscoring the dual, context-dependent functions of SIRT5 in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體SIRT5的活化透過從氧化磷酸化到糖解作用的葡萄糖代謝重編程促進肝細胞癌細胞的生長和轉移。方向上，SIRT5位於驅動肝癌進展的糖解轉換的上游。透過有利於糖解作用，SIRT5為快速生長的HCC細胞提供生物合成和生物能量需求，支持腫瘤的侵襲性。此致癌角色與SIRT5透過膽汁酸代謝介導的HCC抑制相對抗，突顯了SIRT5在肝癌中的雙重、環境依賴性功能。

label: cellular energy metabolism and AMPK activity under energy stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As a result of energy stress, SIRT5 modulates cellular energy metabolism and AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of metabolic adaptation and AMPK activation during energy deprivation. By influencing energy metabolism and engaging AMPK signalling, SIRT5 helps cells maintain energy homeostasis under stress conditions, linking mitochondrial deacylation to the cellular energy sensing network.
description_zh_TW: 作為能量壓力的結果，SIRT5調節細胞能量代謝和AMP活化蛋白激酶活性。方向上，SIRT5位於能量剝奪期間代謝適應和AMPK活化的上游。透過影響能量代謝並參與AMPK訊號，SIRT5幫助細胞在壓力條件下維持能量恆定，將粒線體去醯基化與細胞能量感知網路聯繫起來。

label: FOXO3a in lung epithelial cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
description_zh_TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。

label: IDH2 (via desuccinylation)
description: SIRT5 activates IDH2 through desuccinylation, enhancing its NADPH-producing activity and thereby supporting glutathione reduction and ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of IDH2-dependent redox buffering. This complements SOD1 activation in antioxidant defense, and it shows SIRT5's desuccinylation broadly strengthens reductive capacity. By boosting NADPH production, SIRT5 ensures sufficient reducing equivalents for glutathione and thioredoxin systems. This regulation links SIRT5 to both energy metabolism and redox homeostasis, particularly during fasting when oxidative stress rises.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化 IDH2，增強其 NADPH 產生活性，從而支持穀胱甘肽還原和 ROS 清除。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於 IDH2 依賴性紅氧緩衝的上游。這與 SOD1 活化在抗氧化防禦中互補，並表明 SIRT5 的去琥珀醯化廣泛增強還原能力。透過增強 NADPH 產生，SIRT5 確保穀胱甘肽和硫氧還蛋白系統有足夠的還原當量。此調控將 SIRT5 與能量代謝和紅氧恆定性聯繫起來，特別是在禁食期間氧化壓力升高時。

label: VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA (fatty acid oxidation)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT5 activates multiple fatty acid beta-oxidation enzymes through desuccinylation, including very-long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (MCAD), and the alpha subunit of enoyl-CoA hydratase (ECHA). Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatic activation of these enzymes sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. Deficiency of SIRT5 compromises fatty acid metabolism, leading to acylcarnitine accumulation and decreased ATP production.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過去琥珀醯化作用活化多種脂肪酸β-氧化酶，包括極長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（VLCAD）、長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）、中鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（MCAD）和烯醯CoA水合酶的α亞基（ECHA）。方向上，SIRT5對這些酶的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。SIRT5的缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝，導致醯基肉鹼積累和ATP產量減少。

label: SOD1 (via desuccinylation)
description: SIRT5 activates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) through desuccinylation, enhancing NADPH production and glutathione recycling for ROS detoxification. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This bolsters cytosolic antioxidant capacity, and it extends SIRT5's protective actions beyond the mitochondria's own enzymes. By promoting NADPH generation and glutathione recycling, SOD1 activation supports the detoxification of superoxide and the maintenance of redox balance. This antioxidant function complements SIRT5's metabolic roles and contributes to cellular protection against oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增強 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收以進行 ROS 解毒。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 SOD1。這增強了細胞質抗氧化能力，並將 SIRT5 的保護作用延伸到粒線體自身酶之外。透過促進 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收，SOD1 活化支持超氧陰離子的解毒和紅氧平衡的維護。這種抗氧化功能與 SIRT5 的代謝角色互補，並有助於細胞對抗氧化壓力的保護。

label: Nrf2/HO-1-mediated ROS suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 can promote cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner via regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of reduced ROS, diminished DNA damage, and enhanced survival of ovarian cancer cells treated with cisplatin. By activating Nrf2/HO-1-dependent antioxidant defense, SIRT5 protects ovarian cancer cells from platinum-induced damage, contributing to chemoresistance. This contrasts with SIRT2, whose overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5可以透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷來促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於接受順鉑治療的卵巢癌細胞中ROS降低、DNA損傷減少和存活增強的上游。透過活化Nrf2/HO-1依賴性抗氧化防禦，SIRT5保護卵巢癌細胞免受鉑誘導的損傷，促成化療耐藥性。這與過表達增強耐藥卵巢癌細胞順鉑敏感性的SIRT2形成對比。

label: CPS1 (Carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 deacetylates (and desuccinylates) carbamoyl-phosphate synthetase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification; SIRT5-KO mice show elevated blood ammonia under fasting (Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378).
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去乙醯化（並去琥珀酰化）氨甲醯磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1）——尿素循環的限速酶——增強氨解毒；SIRT5-KO 小鼠在禁食時顯示血氨升高（Nakagawa et al., 2009, Cell 137:560-570, PMID 19410549; Du et al., 2011, Science 334:806-809, PMID 22076378）。

label: IDH2 and SDHA (TCA cycle)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates TCA-cycle enzymes IDH2 and SDHA, tuning their activity and coordinating mitochondrial energy metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically modulates TCA flux. This helps match oxidation to demand during fasting or stress, and it reinforces SIRT5's role as a central mitochondrial metabolic regulator. By adjusting the activity of key TCA-cycle enzymes, SIRT5 balances carbon entry, ATP production, and the supply of reducing equivalents. This regulation supports the metabolic flexibility that allows cells to adapt fuel utilization to nutrient availability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化 TCA 循環酶 IDH2 和 SDHA，調節其活性並協調粒線體能量代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式調節 TCA 通量。這有助於在禁食或壓力期間使氧化與需求匹配，並強化 SIRT5 作為核心粒線體代謝調節因子的角色。透過調整關鍵 TCA 循環酶的活性，SIRT5 平衡碳的進入、ATP 產生和還原當量的供應。此調控支持使細胞能根據營養可用性調整燃料利用的代謝靈活性。

label: urea cycle
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates CPS1, the rate-limiting urea-cycle enzyme, enhancing ammonia detoxification during fasting; SIRT5-knockout mice show elevated blood ammonia under nitrogen load.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀酰化並活化 CPS1——尿素循環的限速酶——增強禁食期間的氨解毒；SIRT5 敲除小鼠在氮負荷下顯示血氨升高。

label: HMGCS2 (ketogenesis)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates HMGCS2 (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2), the rate-limiting enzyme of ketone-body synthesis, supporting energy production during fasting. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates HMGCS2. This promotes ketogenesis when carbohydrate is scarce, and it is a fasting-adaptive function of SIRT5. By enabling ketone-body production from acetyl-CoA, SIRT5 supports the brain and other tissues during prolonged fasting. This regulation complements SIRT5's activation of urea-cycle and fatty-acid-oxidation enzymes, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化 HMGCS2（3-羥基-3-甲基戊二醯-CoA 合酶 2）——酮體合成的限速酶——在禁食期間支持能量產生。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 HMGCS2。這在碳水化合物稀缺時促進酮體生成，是 SIRT5 的禁食適應性功能。透過使酮體能從乙醯-CoA 產生，SIRT5 在長期禁食期間支持大腦和其他組織。此調控與 SIRT5 對尿素循環和脂肪酸氧化酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為分解代謝的協調者。

label: CPS1 (carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates carbamoyl phosphate synthase 1 (CPS1), the rate-limiting enzyme of the urea cycle, enhancing ammonia detoxification into urea. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates CPS1. This is especially important during fasting or high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared, and SIRT5-deficient mice show elevated ammonia under such conditions. It exemplifies SIRT5's role as a regulator of mitochondrial acyl-metabolism and nitrogen homeostasis, and complements its activation of HMGCS2, fatty-acid oxidation enzymes, and TCA-cycle dehydrogenases, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic flux during nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 1（CPS1），這是尿素循環的限速酶，增強氨解毒為尿素。在方向性上，SIRT5 在酶學上活化 CPS1。這在禁食或高蛋白負荷期間（需要清除氮時）尤為重要，SIRT5 缺乏的小鼠在這種條件下顯示升高的氨。它例示了 SIRT5 作為粒線體醯基代謝和氮穩態調節者的角色，並與其對 HMGCS2、脂肪酸氧化酶和 TCA 循環脫氫酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為營養匱乏期間分解代謝通量的協調者。

label: LCAD and ACADS (fatty acid β-oxidation)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates multiple fatty-acid β-oxidation enzymes including LCAD and ACADS, coordinating mitochondrial lipid catabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates these acyl-CoA dehydrogenases. This supports energy harvest from fat, and it exemplifies SIRT5's broad desuccinylase control of metabolism. By activating the enzymes of β-oxidation, SIRT5 promotes the use of fatty acids as fuel, particularly during fasting. This catabolic role aligns SIRT5 with SIRT3 in supporting lipid oxidation, in contrast to SIRT4's inhibition of the same pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化多種脂肪酸 β-氧化酶，包括 LCAD 和 ACADS，協調粒線體脂質分解代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化這些醯基-CoA 脫氫酶。這支持從脂肪獲取能量，並體現了 SIRT5 對代謝的廣泛去琥醯化酶控制。透過活化 β-氧化酶，SIRT5 促進脂肪酸作為燃料的使用，特別是在禁食期間。這種分解代謝角色使 SIRT5 與 SIRT3 在支持脂質氧化方面一致，與 SIRT4 對相同途徑的抑制形成對比。

label: GLS (glutaminase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 inhibits glutaminase (GLS) via desuccinylation, suppressing glutaminolysis in cancer metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化抑制穀氨醯胺酶（GLS），抑制癌症代謝中的穀氨醯胺分解。

label: Preadipocyte differentiation
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation and lipid deposition by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of suppressed adipogenesis. This keeps progenitors from becoming lipid-laden fat cells and positions mitochondrial SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat accumulation. The AMPK arm likely raises NAD+ and reinforces catabolic metabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the mitogenic signaling required for adipocyte maturation. SIRT5's anti-adipogenic function is consistent with the sirtuin family's general opposition to lipid storage and its promotion of oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 通過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 信號通路來抑制前脂肪細胞分化和脂質沉積。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於被抑制的脂肪生成的上游。這防止前體細胞成為富含脂質的脂肪細胞，將粒線體 SIRT5 定位為脂肪累積的負調節因子。AMPK 分支可能提高 NAD+ 並強化分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的促有絲分裂信號。SIRT5 的抗脂肪生成功能與 sirtuin 家族對脂質儲存的一般反對和對氧化代謝的促進一致。

label: AMPK (preadipocyte differentiation)
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling, analogous to its broader adipogenesis-blocking role. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of AMPK activation in adipogenic progenitors. Activated AMPK shifts cells away from lipogenesis and toward catabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the proliferative signals needed for adipocyte maturation. It reaffirms SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat formation, and it is consistent with the general anti-adipogenic theme across sirtuins. By restraining adipocyte differentiation, SIRT5 contributes to the maintenance of metabolic flexibility and the prevention of excessive fat accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 訊號來抑制前脂肪細胞分化，類似於其更廣泛的脂肪生成阻斷角色。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於脂肪生成前體細胞中 AMPK 活化的上游。活化的 AMPK 使細胞從脂肪生成轉向分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的增殖訊號。它再次確認 SIRT5 作為脂肪形成的負調節因子，與 sirtuin 整體的抗脂肪生成主題一致。透過抑制脂肪細胞分化，SIRT5 有助於維護代謝靈活性和預防過度脂肪積累。

label: breast tumor, HCC, and NSCLC cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is important in the growth of breast tumour cells, hepatocellular carcinoma, and human non-small cell lung cancer tissues. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of tumour growth in these cancer types, and its overexpression indicates a poor prognosis in human non-small cell lung cancer. SIRT5 thereby acts as a tumour-promoting factor in breast cancer, HCC, and lung cancer, making it a candidate therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在乳腺腫瘤細胞、肝細胞癌和人類非小細胞肺癌組織的生長中很重要。方向上，SIRT5位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤生長的上游，其過表達在人類非小細胞肺癌中預示不良預後。因此SIRT5在乳腺癌、HCC和肺癌中作為促腫瘤因子，使其成為候選治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class III (prokaryotic origin)
description: SIRT5 is the sole mammalian member of phylogenetic Class III, a group distributed widely across prokaryotes, marking it as one of the most ancient mammalian sirtuins. Directionally, this is an evolutionary classification. Its prokaryotic origin aligns with SIRT5's fundamental mitochondrial metabolic functions, and this situates SIRT5 at the root of sirtuin biology. Because Class III sirtuins predate the eukaryotic sirtuins, SIRT5's desuccinylase activity may represent an ancestral enzymatic function retained through evolution. SIRT5's phylogenetic position helps explain its resistance to nicotinamide inhibition and its distinct substrate preferences.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 是系統發育 III 類唯一的哺乳動物成員，該類群廣泛分布於原核生物中，標誌著它是最古老的哺乳動物 sirtuin 之一。在方向性上，這是演化分類。其原核生物起源與 SIRT5 基本的粒線體代謝功能一致，並將 SIRT5 置於 sirtuin 生物學的根源。由於 III 類 sirtuin 先於真核 sirtuin，SIRT5 的去琥珀醯酶活性可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶功能。SIRT5 的系統發育位置有助於解釋其對菸鹼醯胺抑制的抗性和其獨特的底物偏好。

label: SHMT2 desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is upregulated during cellular transformation and is involved in cancer and its proliferation by desuccinylating serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2). Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SHMT2 sits upstream of enhanced one-carbon metabolism and cancer cell proliferation. By activating SHMT2, SIRT5 supports the biosynthetic demands of proliferating cancer cells, contributing to tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在細胞轉化期間上調，並透過去琥珀醯化絲氨酸羥甲基轉移酶2（SHMT2）參與癌症及其增殖。方向上，SIRT5對SHMT2的去琥珀醯化位於一碳代謝增強和癌細胞增殖的上游。透過活化SHMT2，SIRT5支持增殖癌細胞的生物合成需求，促成腫瘤發生。

label: ammonia detoxification
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 mediates ammonia detoxification by activating CPS1 in the urea cycle, converting ammonia to urea; this is critical during fasting and high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過在尿素循環中活化 CPS1 來調介氨解毒，將氨轉化為尿素；這在禁食和高蛋白負荷期間至關重要，因為此時必須清除氮。

label: intracellular signaling
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 participates in intracellular signaling by deacylating metabolic enzymes and transcription-linked targets (e.g., FOXO3a, SOD1) and by modulating AMPK, linking mitochondrial acylation state to cellular signaling and redox responses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去酰基化代謝酶和轉錄相關靶點（例如 FOXO3a、SOD1）以及調節 AMPK 來參與細胞內信號傳導，將粒線體酰化狀態與細胞信號和氧化還原反應聯繫起來。

label: bile acid metabolism orchestration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 prevents tumor immune evasion and suppresses the development of hepatocellular carcinoma by orchestrating bile acid metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of anti-tumor immunity and restrained HCC growth. By shaping the bile acid milieu, SIRT5 influences the immune microenvironment of the liver tumor, reducing the ability of HCC to evade immune destruction. This tumor-suppressive metabolic function contrasts with SIRT5's glycolysis-reprogramming role that can promote HCC growth, reflecting SIRT5's context-dependent effects in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過協調膽汁酸代謝來預防腫瘤免疫逃逸並抑制肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT5位於抗腫瘤免疫和HCC生長抑制的上游。透過塑造膽汁酸環境，SIRT5影響肝腫瘤的免疫微環境，降低HCC逃避免疫破壞的能力。此腫瘤抑制性代謝功能與SIRT5促進HCC生長的糖解重編程角色形成對比，反映了SIRT5在肝癌中的環境依賴性效果。

label: Nrf2/HO-1 pathway (ovarian cancer)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 promotes cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner through regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of Nrf2-mediated chemoresistance. By activating this antioxidant program, SIRT5 helps cancer cells neutralize the reactive oxygen species that contribute to cisplatin-induced DNA damage. This reduces the genotoxic burden of the drug and blunts its cytotoxicity, allowing tumor cells to survive treatment. Inhibiting SIRT5, therefore, could re-sensitize ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin by dismantling their antioxidant defenses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷，從而促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於Nrf2介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過活化此抗氧化程序，SIRT5幫助癌細胞中和促成順鉑誘導的DNA損傷的活性氧。這降低了藥物的基因毒性負荷並削弱其細胞毒性，使腫瘤細胞能够在治療中存活。因此抑制SIRT5可能透過瓦解其抗氧化防禦來使卵巢癌細胞對順鉑重新敏感。

label: ATP synthesis regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 supports ATP synthesis by desuccinylating electron-transport and TCA-cycle enzymes, maintaining mitochondrial function; its loss compromises energy production under metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化電子傳輸和 TCA 循環酶來支持 ATP 合成，維持粒線體功能；其缺失在代謝壓力下損害能量產生。

label: Tofersen
description: Tofersen (Qalsody) is an intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide against SOD1 mRNA, approved April 2023 on biomarker grounds (plasma NfL −55%) for SOD1-ALS and now tested presymptomatically in the ATLAS trial — the first precision neurodegenerative therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tofersen（Qalsody）是針對 SOD1 mRNA 的鞘內反義寡核苷酸，2023 年 4 月依生物標記（血漿 NfL −55%）獲准用於 SOD1-ALS，現於 ATLAS 試驗中做症狀前測試——是第一個精準神經退化療法。

label: Neurotoxin
description: Neurotoxin and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neurotoxin and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neurotoxin 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neurotoxin 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Stem Cell Exhaustion
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues. mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability, reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output. Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues。mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability，reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output。Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals。In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity。

label: neuroprotective properties
description: Luteolin has neuroprotective properties, including suppression of neuroinflammation, reduction of oxidative stress, and modulation of microglial activation, which may protect neurons in models of neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation. These effects are mediated through pathways such as Nrf2 and NF-kappaB rather than through COMT. Its catechol structure, however, means high doses can interact with COMT as both substrate and competitive inhibitor. It is studied for potential benefit in cognitive decline and brain injury.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 neuroprotective properties，包括抑制神經發炎、減少氧化壓力和調節小膠質細胞活化，這可能會保護神經退化性和神經發炎模型中的神經元。這些作用是透過 Nrf2 和 NF-kappaB 等途徑介導的，而不是透過 COMT 介導的。然而，其茶酚結構意味著高劑量可以與作為底物和競爭性抑制劑的 COMT 相互作用。研究了它對認知能力下降和 brain 損傷的潛在益處。

label: Nrf2 pathway
description: Luteolin upregulates endogenous antioxidant enzymes such as heme oxygenase-1 via activation of the Nrf2 pathway. This Nrf2-dependent action helps it scavenge reactive oxygen species and counter oxidative stress. It contributes to luteolin's neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory profile.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 透過活化 Nrf2 途徑上調內源性抗氧化酶，例如血紅素加氧酶-1。這種依賴 Nrf2 的作用幫助它清除活性氧物種並對抗氧化壓力。這有助於 luteolin 的神經保護和抗發炎特性。

label: methionine synthase activity
description: MTRR maintains methionine synthase activity by reducing the enzyme's bound cobalamin (vitamin B12) cofactor back to its active form after oxidative inactivation, using FAD and NADPH. Without MTRR, methionine synthase loses function, halting homocysteine remethylation and depleting the methionine and SAMe pool. This positions MTRR as essential for methylation cycle continuity and for sustaining the methyl donor supply that COMT requires. Its activity links B12 status directly to one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 透過使用 FAD 和 NADPH 將酵素的結合鈷胺素（維生素 B12）輔因子還原至氧化失活後的活性形式來維持 methionine synthase activity。如果沒有 MTRR，蛋胺酸合成酶就會失去功能，停止同型半胱胺酸再甲基化並耗盡甲硫胺酸和 SAMe 池。這使得 MTRR 對於 methylation cycle 的連續性和維持 COMT 所需的 methyl donor 供應至關重要。其活性將 B12 狀態直接與一碳代謝連結起來。

label: Methionine Synthase
description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is a flavoprotein reductase that sustains the activity of methionine synthase by reducing its oxidized cobalt center back to the active Co1+ state. Without continuous reduction by MTRR, the cobalt center becomes oxidized to an inactive form, halting methyl transfer. This reductase step preserves methylation flux.
description_zh_TW: MTRR（methionine synthase reductase）是黃素蛋白還原酶，透過將其氧化的鈷中心還原回活性的 Co1+ 狀態來維持 methionine synthase 的活性。若沒有 MTRR 的持續還原，鈷中心會氧化為不活躍形式，停止甲基轉移。此還原步驟維持甲基化通量。

label: Vitamin B12 cofactor
description: MTRR maintains the Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) cofactor of methionine synthase in its active reduced state, preventing the futile cycling that would halt methyl transfer. Every catalytic cycle of MTR carries a risk of oxidative inactivation of the B12 cofactor. MTRR preserves methylation flux by reducing the cobalt center.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 將 methionine synthase 的 Vitamin B12（鈷胺素）輔因子維持在活性的還原狀態，防止會停止甲基轉移的無效循環。MTR 的每個催化循環都有 B12 輔因子氧化失活的風險。MTRR 透過還原鈷中心來維持甲基化通量。

label: oxidized cobalamin cofactor
description: MTRR uses FAD and NADPH to reduce the oxidized (Co2+/Co3+) form of methionine synthase's methylcobalamin cofactor back to its active Co1+ state. This allows the enzyme to accept a methyl group from methylfolate and transfer it to homocysteine. MTRR rescues the enzyme from oxidative inactivation after each catalytic cycle.
description_zh_TW: MTRR 使用 FAD 和 NADPH 將 methionine synthase 的甲基鈷胺素輔因子氧化（Co2+/Co3+）形式還原回其活性的 Co1+ 狀態。這使酶能從 methylfolate 接受甲基並將其轉移至同型半胱氨酸。MTRR 在每個催化循環後將酶從氧化失活中救回。

label: Sirtuin activity (SIRT1, SIRT3)
description: 78c indirectly boosts SIRT1 and SIRT3 by maintaining NAD+ co-substrate availability, restoring their deacetylase function in aged tissue. Directionally, NAD+ preservation sits upstream of sirtuin reactivation. This is an indirect pan-sirtuin approach distinct from direct STACs, and it links CD38 pharmacology to longevity pathways. By preventing NAD+ consumption, 78c ensures that sirtuins have the co-substrate they require, effectively restoring the NAD+-dependent regulation that declines with age. This strategy is complementary to NAD+ precursor supplementation, and the two approaches are often combined.
description_zh_TW: 78c 透過維護 NAD+ 共同底物的可用性間接增強 SIRT1 和 SIRT3，恢復其在老年組織中的去乙醯酶功能。在方向性上，NAD+ 保存位於 sirtuin 重新活化的上游。這是與直接 STAC 不同的間接全 sirtuin 方法，將 CD38 藥理學與長壽途徑聯繫起來。透過防止 NAD+ 消耗，78c 確保 sirtuin 擁有所需的共同底物，有效恢復隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 依賴性調控。此策略與 NAD+ 前驅物補充互補，兩種方法經常結合使用。

label: CD38 (NAD+-glycohydrolase)
description: 78c is a highly potent, selective, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of CD38 NAD+-glycohydrolase activity. Directionally, 78c sits upstream of CD38 blockade. By stopping NAD+ consumption, it spares the co-substrate for sirtuins and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, and it is a leading age-reversal NAD+-preservation strategy. 78c's potency and oral bioavailability make it suitable for chronic in vivo studies, and its administration to aged mice restores NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity. These properties positioned 78c as the key pharmacological tool for validating CD38 as a longevity target.
description_zh_TW: 78c 是一種高效力、高選擇性、口服可利用的 CD38 NAD+ 糖水解酶活性小分子抑制劑。在方向性上，78c 位於 CD38 阻斷的上游。透過阻止 NAD+ 消耗，它節省了 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶的共同底物，是領先的衰老逆轉 NAD+ 保存策略。78c 的效力和口服可利用性使其適用於長期體內研究，其對老年小鼠的施用恢復了 NAD+ 水平和 sirtuin 活性。這些特性使 78c 成為驗證 CD38 作為長壽靶標的關鍵藥理學工具。

description: Administration of 78c to naturally aged male mice yields about a 14% lifespan extension, demonstrating in vivo geroprotective efficacy. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of prolonged lifespan. This effect is attributed to restored NAD+ and sirtuin function, and it validates CD38 as a longevity drug target. The lifespan benefit in naturally aged animals, rather than in accelerated-aging models, provides particularly strong evidence for translational relevance. 78c's efficacy, combined with its NAD+-sparing mechanism, established CD38 inhibition as a leading pharmacological strategy in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: 對自然衰老雄性小鼠施用 78c 可獲得約 14% 的壽命延長，展示了體內抗衰老療效。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於延長壽命的上游。此效應歸因於恢復的 NAD+ 和 sirtuin 功能，驗證了 CD38 作為長壽藥物靶標。在自然衰老動物（而非加速衰老模型）中的壽命益處提供了特別強的轉化相關性證據。78c 的療效結合其 NAD+ 節省機制，確立了 CD38 抑制作為老年科學中領先的藥理學策略。

label: NAD+ levels
description: By selectively inhibiting CD38, 78c prevents age-related NAD+ degradation, keeping cellular pools high in aged animals. Directionally, CD38 inhibition sits upstream of preserved NAD+. Higher NAD+ then fuels sirtuin and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, reversing a hallmark of aging. Because CD38 expression rises with age, its inhibition becomes increasingly important for maintaining NAD+ homeostasis in older organisms. 78c's NAD+-preserving effect underlies its ability to restore sirtuin activity and extend lifespan, and it established the concept that pharmacologically limiting NAD+ consumption can counteract age-related decline.
description_zh_TW: 透過選擇性抑制 CD38，78c 防止年齡相關的 NAD+ 降解，在老年動物中保持較高的細胞 NAD+ 池。在方向性上，CD38 抑制位於保存 NAD+ 的上游。較高的 NAD+ 隨後為 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶提供燃料，逆轉衰老的一個標誌。由於 CD38 表達隨年齡增長而升高，其抑制在維護老年機體的 NAD+ 恆定性方面變得越來越重要。78c 的 NAD+ 保存效應構成了其恢復 sirtuin 活性和延長壽命能力的基礎，並確立了藥理學限制 NAD+ 消耗可以對抗年齡相關退化的概念。

label: High-AGE diet
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: In a study of three groups of mice fed a caloric restriction (CR) diet, a regular diet, or a CR diet high in AGEs, CR mice lived longer than regular or CR-high mice, with median and maximal survival increased by 13.2% and 6%, respectively. Survival in CR-high mice was shorter than in regular-fed mice, and the CR-high group showed significantly increased oxidative stress and accelerated aging-related cardiovascular and renal disease. High dietary AGEs thus compete with the benefits of caloric restriction, indicating that the AGE content of the diet modulates lifespan.
