description_zh_TW: 在一項針對三組小鼠的研究中，分別餵食熱量限制（CR）飲食、一般飲食或高 AGE 的 CR 飲食，CR 小鼠比一般或 CR-高 AGE 小鼠活得更久，中位與最大存活分別增加 13.2% 與 6%。CR-高 AGE 小鼠的存活短於一般飲食小鼠，且 CR-高 AGE 組顯示氧化壓力顯著增加與加速老化的心血管及腎臟疾病。因此，高飲食性 AGE 與熱量限制的好處相抗衡，顯示飲食的 AGE 含量會調節壽命。

label: NAD+/NADH redox imbalance
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The hallmark hyperglycemia of diabetes mellitus causes a redox imbalance between NAD+ and NADH that can lead to oxidative stress and a variety of metabolic syndromes. In cells whose glucose uptake is not insulin-dependent, glucose oversupply leads to NADH overproduction by both the conventional glucose combustion pathways (glycolysis and the Krebs cycle) and the polyol pathway. This NAD+/NADH imbalance, also known as pseudohypoxia, initially causes reductive stress and mitochondrial overload and dysfunction, which lead to oxidative stress and oxidative damage to DNA, lipids, and proteins. Additionally, PARP overactivation depletes NAD+, and this redox imbalance is a major factor contributing to the development of diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 糖尿病的標誌性高血糖造成 NAD+ 與 NADH 之間的氧化還原失衡，可能導致氧化壓力與多種代謝症候群。在葡萄糖攝取不依賴胰島素的細胞中，葡萄糖過量供給透過傳統的葡萄糖燃燒路徑（糖解作用與克氏循環）以及多元醇路徑導致 NADH 過度生成。這種 NAD+/NADH 失衡，亦稱為假性缺氧，最初造成還原壓力與粒線體超載及功能障礙，進而導致氧化壓力以及對 DNA、脂質與蛋白質的氧化損傷。此外，PARP 過度活化耗竭 NAD+，而此氧化還原失衡是促成糖尿病併發症發展的主要因素。

label: AGE inhibition
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: The inhibition of AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can lead to an increase in lifespan, as concluded from extensive evidence that AGE accumulation accompanies aging and age-related diseases. Because there are no enzymes to remove glycated products, AGEs accumulate as metabolic waste and contribute to tissue senescence. Inhibiting the glycation process and removing existing glycation products may prolong lifespan, and dietary herbal supplements or physiological exercise are advantageous in reducing the AGE burden in the body.
description_zh_TW: 抑制組織中 AGE 的形成與堆積可導致壽命延長，此結論源自大量證據顯示 AGE 堆積伴隨老化與老化相關疾病。由於體內缺乏可移除糖化產物的酵素，AGEs 便作為代謝廢物堆積並促進組織衰老。抑制糖化過程並清除既有的糖化產物或可延長壽命，而飲食草本補充劑或生理性運動則有利於減輕體內的 AGE 負擔。

label: N-Formylkynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: Microbial Exposure
description: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

label: H19
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: H19 is a long non-coding RNA whose expression changes with age, and it functions to repress IGF-1 signaling. H19 associates with MBD1, a methyl-CpG-binding domain protein, to repress the expression of longevity genes including insulin-like growth factor 1, and loss of H19-dependent IGF-1 silencing may contribute to cellular senescence. Because IGF-1 signaling is a conserved regulator of the insulin/IGF-1 pathway that influences lifespan, the age-related deregulation of H19 has implications for both senescence and longevity.
description_zh_TW: H19 是一種長鏈非編碼 RNA，其表現隨年齡而變化，其功能是抑制 IGF-1 訊號傳導。 H19 與 MBD1（一種甲基 CpG 結合域蛋白）結合，抑制包括類胰島素生長因子 1 在內的長壽基因的表達，H19 依賴性 IGF-1 沉默的喪失可能導致細胞老化。由於 IGF-1 訊號傳導是影響壽命的胰島素/IGF-1 路徑的保守調節因子，因此 H19 與年齡相關的失調對老化和長壽都有影響。

label: colon cancer cell proliferation, invasion, and migration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of restrained colon cancer aggressiveness and enhanced cell death. SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. These findings indicate that SIRT3 supports the aggressive behaviour of colon cancer cells, and its inhibition may represent an anti-tumour strategy.
description_zh_TW: 在結腸癌中，SIRT3 缺乏可減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加細胞凋亡。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 的缺失位於抑制結腸癌侵襲性和增強細胞死亡的上游。SIRT3 也可作為結腸癌的標記物。這些發現表明 SIRT3 支持結腸癌細胞的侵襲性行為，其抑制可能代表一種抗腫瘤策略。

label: Cell transformation
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: Lung fibrosis via TGF-β1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT3 deficiency in the aging murine lung promotes a fibrotic response mediated by TGF-beta1 and augments mitochondrial DNA damage and apoptosis in alveolar epithelial cells. Conversely, SIRT3 overexpression can ameliorate asbestos-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Directionally, SIRT3 deficiency sits upstream of enhanced TGF-beta1-driven fibrosis, because by weakening mitochondrial antioxidant defenses it renders alveolar epithelial cells vulnerable to the damage that fuels the fibrotic program. Restoring SIRT3 could therefore protect against pulmonary fibrosis, making mitochondrial sirtuin activity an important determinant of lung resilience to environmental and aging-related fibrotic injury.
description_zh_TW: 老化小鼠肺部的SIRT3缺乏促進由TGF-beta1介導的纖維化反應，並增強肺泡上皮細胞的粒線體DNA損傷和凋亡。相反，SIRT3過表達可以改善石棉誘導的肺纖維化。方向上，SIRT3缺乏位於TGF-beta1驅動的纖維化增強的上游，因為透過削弱粒線體抗氧化防禦，它使肺泡上皮細胞容易受到推動纖維化程序的損傷。因此恢復SIRT3可能保護免受肺纖維化，使粒線體sirtuin活性成為肺部對環境和與年齡相關纖維化損傷韌性的重要決定因素。

label: Type 2 Diabetes
description: SIRT3 is consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, with deficiency correlating with insulin resistance and disturbed systemic energy homeostasis. In skeletal muscle, SIRT3 deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance and contributing to type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗和全身能量代謝失調相關。在骨骼肌中，SIRT3 缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重周邊胰島素阻抗並促進第 2 型糖尿病的病理生理學。

label: Embryoid Bodies
description: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
description_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

label: HeLa Cells
description: HeLa cells are routinely used in RNAi and reporter assays to study microRNA biogenesis. Knockdown of DGCR8 or Drosha in HeLa S3 reduced pre-miR-16 and mature miR-16 with pri-miRNA accumulation, confirming DGCR8 requirement for microRNA maturation.
description_zh_TW: HeLa 細胞常被用於 RNAi 與報導基因分析以研究 microRNA 生合成。在 HeLa S3 中敲低 DGCR8 或 Drosha 會降低 pre-miR-16 與成熟 miR-16 並累積 pri-miRNA，證實 DGCR8 為 microRNA 成熟所需。

label: Leukemia inhibitory factor
description: Leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) maintains embryonic stem cell pluripotency, and in differentiation assays it is withheld to permit lineage commitment. DGCR8-deficient ES cells failed to differentiate even without LIF, showing microRNAs are required to exit the self-renewal program.
description_zh_TW: 白血病抑制因子（LIF）維持胚胎幹細胞多能性，在分化分析中會被移除以允許譜系定向。缺乏 DGCR8 的 ES 細胞即使在無 LIF 情況下也無法分化，顯示 microRNA 為退出自我更新程式所需。

label: Retinoic Acid
description: Retinoic acid is a potent inducer of cellular differentiation applied to embryonic stem cells to drive lineage commitment. DGCR8-deficient ES cells treated with retinoic acid still failed to fully silence pluripotency markers, demonstrating microRNA loss blocks differentiation even under strong inductive pressure.
description_zh_TW: 視黃酸是強效的細胞分化誘導劑，應用於胚胎幹細胞以驅動譜系定向。以視黃酸處理的 DGCR8 缺乏 ES 細胞仍無法完全靜默多能性標記，顯示即使有強誘導壓力，microRNA 喪失仍會阻斷分化。

label: Glutathione Depletion
description: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
description_zh_TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

label: Ribosome Biogenesis
description: SIRT7 drives ribosome biogenesis by activating RNA Pol I at rDNA and suppresses p21 via H3K18 deacetylation, fueling the biosynthetic capacity tumors need; it is overexpressed in breast, thyroid, and HCC. This proliferative, biosynthetic driver role makes SIRT7 an oncogenic sirtuin.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過在 rDNA 活化 RNA Pol I 並經由 H3K18 去乙醯化抑制 p21，驅動核糖體生成，供應腫瘤所需的生物合成能力；它在乳癌、甲狀腺與 HCC 中過度表現。此增生性、生物合成驅動角色使 SIRT7 成為致癌 sirtuin。

label: colorectal, gastric, and luminal breast cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT7 takes part in the genesis of colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, and luminal breast cancer. SIRT7 is overexpressed in multiple cancer tissues, promoting the survival of cancer cells and the maintenance of a transformed state. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of tumorigenesis in these cancer types, and its overexpression supports the transformed phenotype across a broad range of tumours.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT7參與大腸直腸癌、胃癌和管腔型乳腺癌的發生。SIRT7在多種癌症組織中過表達，促進癌細胞的存活和轉化狀態的維持。方向上，SIRT7位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤發生的上游，其過表達在廣泛的腫瘤中支持轉化表型。

label: Replicative lifespan
description: Overexpression of SIRT7 extends the replicative lifespan of primary human cells by maintaining rDNA stability and reducing mitochondrial dysfunction. Directionally, SIRT7 gain sits upstream of prolonged cellular lifespan. This mirrors the pro-longevity roles of other sirtuins and supports a broadly conserved lifespan-promoting function for the family. The mechanism likely involves preservation of ribosomal DNA repeats, maintenance of heterochromatin, and support of mitochondrial gene expression through GABPβ1. SIRT7's ability to extend replicative lifespan is consistent with the theme that sirtuin activity generally counteracts cellular senescence.
description_zh_TW: 過度表達 SIRT7 透過維護 rDNA 穩定性和減少粒線體功能障礙來延長原代人類細胞的複製壽命。在方向性上，SIRT7 功能增強位於延長細胞壽命的上游。這反映了其他 sirtuin 的促長壽角色，支持該家族具有廣泛保守的壽命促進功能。其機制可能涉及核糖體 DNA 重複序列的保存、異染色質的維護以及透過 GABPβ1 對粒線體基因表達的支持。SIRT7 延長複製壽命的能力與 sirtuin 活性普遍對抗細胞衰老的主題一致。

label: rDNA transcription
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I transcription of ribosomal DNA and is required for pre-rRNA cleavage, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity; this nucleolar function supports growth and, in cancer, tumor proliferation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 對核糖體 DNA 的轉錄，並為前 rRNA 切割所需，驅動核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力；這種核仁功能支持生長，在癌症中支持腫瘤增殖。

label: RNA Polymerase I transcription
description: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I-mediated transcription of ribosomal DNA, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity in proliferating cells. It does so in part through deacetylation of histone H3K18 at rDNA loci and by stabilizing the Pol I transcriptional apparatus, ensuring sufficient ribosome output for growth. Directionally, SIRT7 acts upstream to enhance rRNA production and ribosome biogenesis. By sustaining this biosynthetic capacity, SIRT7 supports cell growth and proliferation, which underlies its roles in development and in cancer, where ribosome biogenesis is frequently upregulated.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 介導的核糖體 DNA 轉錄，驅動增殖細胞中的核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力。它部分通過去乙醯化 rDNA 基因座處的組蛋白 H3K18 以及穩定 Pol I 轉錄裝置來實現，確保足夠的核糖體產出以支持生長。在方向性上，SIRT7 在上游增強 rRNA 產生和核糖體生物合成。通過維持這種生物合成能力，SIRT7 支持細胞生長和增殖，這是其在發育和癌症中作用的基礎，在癌症中核糖體生物合成經常被上調。

label: ERK and STAT3 signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT7 affects the malignancy of glioma cells mainly by promoting glioma proliferation and invasion through the ERK and STAT3 signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ERK- and STAT3-driven glioma progression. By sustaining these proliferative and invasive signaling cascades, SIRT7 supports the aggressive growth and spread characteristic of glioma. This identifies SIRT7 as a pro-tumorigenic factor in this brain cancer and suggests that SIRT7 inhibition could suppress glioma progression. The finding adds to the emerging picture of SIRT7 as an oncogenic sirtuin in certain malignancies, where its functions diverge from the longevity-promoting roles of other family members.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7主要透過ERK和STAT3訊號通路促進膠質瘤增殖和侵襲來影響膠質瘤細胞的惡性程度。方向上，SIRT7位於ERK和STAT3驅動的膠質瘤進展的上游。透過維持這些增殖性和侵襲性訊號級聯，SIRT7支持膠質瘤特徵性的侵略性生長和擴散。這將SIRT7確定為此腦癌中的促腫瘤因子，並表明SIRT7抑制可以抑制膠質瘤進展。此發現增加了SIRT7作為某些惡性腫瘤中致癌sirtuin的新興圖景，其功能與其他家族成員的促長壽角色不同。

label: human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabilizer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 antagonizes human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabiliser and safeguards chromatin structure. As a heterochromatin stabiliser, SIRT7 counteracts human stem cell ageing. SIRT7 also regulates innate immune modulation and ensures geroprotection during stem cell ageing. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of heterochromatin maintenance and stem cell rejuvenation, protecting stem cells from age-related chromatin deterioration.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7作為異染色質穩定劑對抗人類幹細胞老化並維護染色質結構。作為異染色質穩定劑，SIRT7對抗人類幹細胞老化。SIRT7也調節先天免疫調節並在幹細胞老化期間確保老年保護。方向上，SIRT7位於異染色質維護和幹細胞回春的上游，保護幹細胞免受與年齡相關的染色質惡化。

label: glucose availability with mitochondrial biogenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 arginine methylation maintains energy balance by coordinating glucose availability with mitochondria biogenesis. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of the coupling between nutrient (glucose) status and mitochondrial mass. By linking glucose sensing to mitochondrial biogenesis, SIRT7 helps the cell match energy production to substrate availability, contributing to metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7精氨酸甲基化透過協調葡萄糖可用性與粒線體生成來維持能量平衡。方向上，SIRT7位於營養（葡萄糖）狀態與粒線體質量之間耦合的上游。透過將葡萄糖感知與粒線體生成聯繫起來，SIRT7幫助細胞使能量產生與底物可用性匹配，有助於代謝恆定。

label: GABPβ1
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates GA-binding protein beta1 (GABPbeta1), a subunit of the GABP transcription factor complex that controls expression of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes. Deacetylation facilitates GABP complex formation and transcriptional activation of these genes, supporting mitochondrial biogenesis and function. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of GABP-dependent mitochondrial gene expression. SIRT7 deficiency accordingly causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction, manifesting as lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7去乙醯化GA結合蛋白beta1（GABPbeta1），這是控制核編碼粒線體基因表達的GABP轉錄因子複合物的一個亞基。去乙醯化促進GABP複合物的形成和這些基因的轉錄活化，支持粒線體生成和功能。方向上，SIRT7位於GABP依賴性粒線體基因表達的上游。因此SIRT7缺乏會導致全身粒線體功能障礙，表現為乳酸積累和心臟異常。

label: Epigenetic regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates H3K18 on promoters (Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849) and associates with chromatin remodelers (including PAF1 complex) to regulate rDNA transcription, ribosomal biogenesis, and global gene expression; age-related SIRT7 decline perturbs these epigenetic landscapes (source review; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18（Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849），並與染色質重塑因子（包括 PAF1 複合物）結合，以調節 rDNA 轉錄、核糖體生成和整體基因表現；與年齡相關的 SIRT7 下降會擾亂這些表觀遺傳景觀（來源文獻; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008）。

label: RNA Polymerase I
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates and regulates RNA Polymerase I transcription at rDNA, controlling ribosome biogenesis (Ford et al., 2006).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化並調節 RNA 聚合酶 I 在 rDNA 上的轉錄，控制核糖體生物合成（Ford et al., 2006）。

label: H2A
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2A, contributing to its nucleolar/chromatin regulatory program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2A，有助於其核仁/染色質調控程序。

label: H2B
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2B as part of its chromatin modification repertoire.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2B，作為其染色質修飾 repertoire 的一部分。

label: Histone H3
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H3 at K18 (and H2A/H2B), an activity associated with repression of tumor-suppressor genes; SIRT7 thereby helps sustain the cancer phenotype without driving transformation. Directionally, SIRT7 enzymatically remodels chromatin to favor oncogenic transcription. This links nucleolar SIRT7 to tumor biology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的 K18（以及 H2A/H2B），此活性與腫瘤抑制基因的抑制相關；因此 SIRT7 有助於維持癌症表型而不驅動轉化。方向性上 SIRT7 以酵素方式重塑染色質以有利於致癌性轉錄。這將核仁 SIRT7 與腫瘤生物學聯繫起來。

label: histone desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 functions as a histone desuccinylase that links chromatin compaction to genome stability, deacetylating H3K18 at promoters and desuccinylating histones to maintain heterochromatic state and suppress DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 作為組蛋白去琥珀酰酶，將染色質凝縮與基因組穩定性聯繫起來，去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18 並去琥珀酰化組蛋白以維持異染色質狀態並抑制 DNA 損傷。

label: aging and lifespan of hematopoietic cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 has deacetylase activity and plays a critical role in ageing and lifespan of hematopoietic cells in humans. SIRT7 is an influence factor in healthy aging and the development of age-dependent myeloid stem-cell disorders. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of haematopoietic stem cell maintenance and healthy aging, with dysregulation linked to age-dependent blood disorders.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7具有去乙醯酶活性，在人類造血細胞的老化和壽命中發揮關鍵作用。SIRT7是健康老化和年齡依賴性骨髓幹細胞疾病發展的影響因子。方向上，SIRT7位於造血幹細胞維護和健康老化的上游，其失調與年齡依賴性血液疾病相關。

label: Nucleolus
description: SIRT7 is concentrated in the nucleolus, the site of ribosomal DNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis, where it deacetylates histone H3K18 and regulates RNA polymerase I. Its nucleolar residence positions it to control rRNA synthesis and, consequently, protein synthetic capacity and growth. SIRT7 also deacetylates extra-nucleolar targets such as GATA4 and SMAD3, linking it to cardiac and fibrotic pathways. Deficiency of SIRT7 yields extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy, revealing its importance in stress responses of the heart.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 集中在核仁中，該處是核糖體 DNA 轉錄和核糖體生物合成的場所，在此處它去乙醯化組蛋白 H3K18 並調節 RNA 聚合酶 I。其核仁定位使其能夠控制 rRNA 合成，進而控制蛋白質合成能力和細胞生長。SIRT7 還去乙醯化核仁外的靶標如 GATA4 和 SMAD3，將其與心臟和纖維化通路聯繫起來。SIRT7 缺乏會導致廣泛的心肌纖維化和心肌病，揭示其在心臟壓力反應中的重要性。

label: oncogene (upregulated in cancers)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 is described as oncogene (upregulated in cancers); it is upregulated in cancers and acts as an oncogene in several contexts (Barber 2012 PMID 22722849).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 被描述為癌基因（在癌症中上調）；它在癌症中上調，並在多種環境中作為癌基因（Barber 2012 PMID 22722849）。

label: Stress resistance
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 promotes cellular stress resistance by suppressing ER stress and reactive-ROS programs via Myc-linked silencing of ribosomal protein genes and by stabilizing DNA repair; SIRT7-depleted cells show increased apoptosis and metabolic stress (Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820; source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過抑制內質網壓力和活性氧自由基程式（經由 Myc 連結的核糖體蛋白基因沉默）以及穩定 DNA 修復，促進細胞抗壓力能力；SIRT7 缺失的細胞表現出凋亡增加和代謝壓力上升（Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820; 來源文獻）。

label: H3K18ac (histone H3 lysine 18)
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT7 promotes tumorigenesis by deacetylating lysine 18 of histone H3, thereby repressing genes with tumor-suppressor function. SIRT7 is stabilized at target promoters through interaction with the ETS-family transcription factor ELK4, and the resulting H3K18 deacetylation is necessary to maintain features such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, SIRT7 activity at H3K18 sits upstream of tumor suppressor gene repression. Loss of SIRT7 reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, making it the clearest pro-oncogenic sirtuin and positioning SIRT7 inhibition as the therapeutic direction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸促進腫瘤發生，從而抑制具有腫瘤抑制功能的基因。SIRT7 透過與 ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 的相互作用穩定於靶啟動子處，產生的 H3K18 去乙醯化對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等特徵是必要的。方向性上 SIRT7 在 H3K18 上的活性位於腫瘤抑制基因抑制的上游。SIRT7 的缺失降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，使其成為最明確的促致癌 sirtuin，並將 SIRT7 抑制定位為治療方向。

label: rRNA transcription
description: SIRT7 regulates rRNA transcription by activating RNA polymerase I and deacetylating histone H3K18 at ribosomal DNA, controlling ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of Pol I activity and ribosome production. Because excessive ribosome biogenesis fuels proliferation, this activity aligns SIRT7 with growth and, in cancer, with tumor promotion. It also ties SIRT7 to nucleolar stress responses and, through deacetylation of GABPβ1, to the transcriptional control of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, such that SIRT7 deficiency causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction with lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 通過活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 並去乙醯化核糖體 DNA 處的組蛋白 H3K18 來調節 rRNA 轉錄，控制核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 Pol I 活性和核糖體產生的上游。由於過度的核糖體生物合成促進增殖，此活性使 SIRT7 與生長一致，在癌症中與腫瘤促進一致。它也將 SIRT7 與核仁壓力反應以及通過 GABPβ1 去乙醯化對核編碼粒線體基因的轉錄控制聯繫起來，使得 SIRT7 缺乏導致伴隨乳酸堆積和心臟異常的系統性粒線體功能障礙。

label: VSMC proliferation and migration
description: SIRT7 regulates vascular smooth-muscle cell (VSMC) proliferation and migration through the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway, limiting the neointimal hyperplasia that drives vascular disease. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of VSMC quiescence. By restraining VSMC activation, SIRT7 protects against atherosclerotic and restenotic remodeling after vascular injury. It adds a vascular-stability role to SIRT7, complementing its cardiac functions, and loss of SIRT7 permits excessive VSMC growth and migration. The Wnt/β-catenin pathway is a central driver of VSMC phenotypic switching, and SIRT7's regulation of it links sirtuins to vascular remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 通過 Wnt/β-catenin 信號通路調節血管平滑肌細胞（VSMC）的增殖和遷移，限制驅動血管疾病的新生內膜增生。在方向性上，SIRT7 位於 VSMC 靜止的上游。通過限制 VSMC 活化，SIRT7 保護對抗血管損傷後的動脈粥樣硬化和再狹窄重塑。這為 SIRT7 增加了血管穩定性角色，與其心臟功能互補，SIRT7 的缺失允許過度的 VSMC 生長和遷移。Wnt/β-catenin 通路是 VSMC 表型轉換的中心驅動因子，SIRT7 對其的調節將 sirtuin 與血管重塑聯繫起來。

label: rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin 7 is required not only for rDNA transcription but also for particular pre-rRNA cleavage. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ribosomal RNA synthesis and processing in the nucleolus. By supporting both rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage, SIRT7 is essential for ribosome biogenesis, connecting SIRT7 to growth, protein synthesis, and cellular proliferation.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 7不僅是rDNA轉錄所必需的，也是特定pre-rRNA切割所必需的。方向上，SIRT7位於核仁中核糖體RNA合成和加工的上游。透過支持rDNA轉錄和pre-rRNA切割，SIRT7對核糖體生成至關重要，將SIRT7與生長、蛋白質合成和細胞增殖聯繫起來。

label: dependent on N- and C-terminal domains
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The DNA-activated deacetylase activity of SIRT7 is dependent on both the N- and C-terminal domains. The SIRT7 N-terminal domain (NTD) is made up of three helices, and according to the findings SIRT7-NTD has structural similarities to transcription factor regulators and may have a role in DNA binding. Directionally, the SIRT7 NTD sits upstream of DNA binding and enzymatic activation, connecting SIRT7 structure to its chromatin-associated functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7的DNA活化去乙醯酶活性依賴於N端和C端結構域。SIRT7 N端結構域（NTD）由三條螺旋組成，根據研究結果，SIRT7-NTD與轉錄因子調節器具有結構相似性，可能在DNA結合中具有作用。方向上，SIRT7 NTD位於DNA結合和酵素活化的上游，將SIRT7結構與其染色質相關功能聯繫起來。

label: H3K18
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histones, in particular H3K18, whose deacetylation is associated with repression of tumor suppressor genes. SIRT7 can therefore support a cancer phenotype by inhibiting expression of tumor suppressors, though it is required only to sustain, not initiate, oncogenic transformation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白，尤其是 H3K18，其去乙醯化與腫瘤抑制基因的抑制相關。因此 SIRT7 可透過抑制腫瘤抑制因子的表達來支持癌症表型，但僅用於維持而非啟動致癌轉化。

label: Glycolic acid
description: PARK7 (DJ-1) detoxifies the reactive dicarbonyl species glyoxal and methylglyoxal in a glutathione-independent manner, converting glyoxal into glycolic acid and methylglyoxal into L-lactate. This stereospecific conversion removes dicarbonyls before they can form irreversible AGE crosslinks on protein residues. Because glyoxal is a major product of glucose and lipid oxidation, PARK7-dependent conversion of glyoxal to glycolic acid is an important route for limiting dicarbonyl stress. Loss of PARK7 activity is associated with tissue-specific accumulation of novel AGEs and, in humans, is linked to early-onset Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: PARK7（DJ-1）以不依賴麩胱甘肽的方式解毒反應性二羰基物種乙二醛與甲基乙二醛，將乙二醛轉化為乙醇酸、將甲基乙二醛轉化為 L-乳酸。這種立體特異性轉化在這些二羰基物形成蛋白質殘基上不可逆的 AGE 交聯之前將其移除。由於乙二醛是葡萄糖與脂質氧化的主要產物，PARK7 依賴的乙二醛轉乙醇酸途徑是限制二羰基壓力的重要路線。PARK7 活性缺失與組織特異性新型 AGE 堆積有關，且在人類中與早發性帕金森氏症（Parkinson's disease）相關。

label: Glyoxalase System
description: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

label: Extracellular neuromelanin
source_file: _document_ - Neuromelanin, aging, and neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's disease.md
description: Extracellular neuromelanin activates Microglia, serving as a trigger that switches the target cell or process into an active state. Mechanistically, the entity engages receptors or danger signals that provoke proliferation, phagocytosis, or cytokine release. This is significant because activation of glial or immune effectors can both clear debris and, when chronic, perpetuate neuronal injury. A caveat is that activation has a protective-to-harmful transition, so the consequence depends on whether the response resolves or becomes sustained.
description_zh_TW: Extracellular neuromelanin 啟動 Microglia，作為將目標單元或進程切換到活動狀態的觸發器。從機制上講，該實體與受體或危險信號結合，引發增殖、吞噬或細胞激素釋放。這很重要，因為神經膠質或免疫效應器的活化既可以清除碎片，並且在慢性時，可以使神經元損傷永久化。需要注意的是，活化有一個保護性到有害性的轉變，因此結果取決於 response 是否解決或持續。

label: Neuronophagia
description: Neuronophagia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuronophagia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neuronophagia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuronophagia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Iba1
description: Iba1 is the standard immunohistochemical marker for microglia in the central nervous system. Its expression increases with microglial activation, and Iba1 immunostaining reveals microgliosis in neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
description_zh_TW: Iba1 是中樞神經系統微膠質細胞的標準免疫組織化學標記。其表現隨微膠質活化而增加，Iba1 免疫染色揭示神經退化與神經發炎中的微膠質增生。

label: Sas2p
description: A more recent epigenetic mechanism: Sir2p and the HAT Sas2p regulate H4K16 acetylation at the telomere-euchromatin boundary; Sir2p levels decline with age as H4K16Ac rises, and constitutive H4K16 acetylation shortens lifespan, linking subtelomeric silencing to yeast longevity. Directionally, the Sir2/Sas2 balance at telomeres determines lifespan. By maintaining H4K16 deacetylation at subtelomeric regions, Sir2 preserves the silenced state that supports longevity. This mechanism extends the sirtuin-longevity link beyond ERC suppression and highlights the importance of chromatin state in aging.
description_zh_TW: 一種更近期的表觀遺傳機制：Sir2p和HAT Sas2p調節端粒-常染色質邊界的H4K16乙醯化；隨年齡增長Sir2p水平下降而H4K16Ac升高，持續性的H4K16乙醯化縮短壽命，將亞端粒沉默與酵母長壽聯繫起來。方向上，端粒處的Sir2/Sas2平衡決定了壽命。透過維持亞端粒區域的H4K16去乙醯化，Sir2維持支持長壽的沉默狀態。此機制將sirtuin-長壽的聯繫擴展到ERC抑制之外，並突顯了染色質狀態在衰老中的重要性。

label: Sirtuins (SIRT1–7)
description: Sir2 (silent information regulator 2) is the founding member of the sirtuin family, first identified in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as a regulator of mating-type locus silencing and replicative lifespan. The seven mammalian paralogues SIRT1–SIRT7 evolved from this ancestral NAD+-dependent deacetylase, retaining the conserved catalytic core while diversifying in subcellular localization and substrate repertoire. This phylogenetic continuity means insights from yeast Sir2 historically informed mammalian sirtuin biology, although the mammalian enzymes acquired lineage-specific regulatory domains. The relationship is directional: yeast Sir2 is the evolutionary precursor, not a downstream effector, of the SIRT1–7 family.
description_zh_TW: Sir2（silent information regulator 2）是 sirtuin 家族的始祖成員，最早在釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中被發現，作為交配型基因座沉默和複製性壽命的調節因子。哺乳動物的七個旁系同源物 SIRT1–SIRT7 從這個祖先型 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶演化而來，保留了保守的催化核心，同時在次細胞定位和受質譜方面多樣化。這種系統發生學上的連續性意味著來自酵母 Sir2 的見解在歷史上促進了對哺乳動物 sirtuin 生物學的理解，儘管哺乳動物酶獲得了譜系特異性的調節結構域。這種關係是方向性的：酵母 Sir2 是 SIRT1–7 家族的演化前體，而非下游效應因子。

label: Mother cell
description: Sir2p maintains cellular polarity so that oxidized proteins, misfolded aggregates, and dysfunctional mitochondria are retained in the mother cell, allowing daughter cells to begin life undamaged; this asymmetric segregation extends daughter-cell lifespan at the mother's expense. Directionally, Sir2p promotes asymmetric segregation of damage to the mother cell. By ensuring that daughters are born free of damage, this mechanism supports the longevity of the lineage. It illustrates how sirtuins contribute to cellular rejuvenation, a concept that has influenced thinking about asymmetric cell division and aging.
description_zh_TW: Sir2p維持細胞極性，使氧化蛋白、錯誤折疊的聚集物和功能障礙的粒線體保留在母細胞中，讓子細胞在無損傷的狀態下開始生命；這種不對稱分配以母細胞為代價延長子細胞的壽命。方向上，Sir2p促進損傷向母細胞的不對稱分配。透過確保子細胞出生時無損傷，此機制支持了譜系的長壽。它說明了sirtuin如何有助於細胞回春，這一概念影響了關於不對稱細胞分裂和衰老的思考。

label: Extrachromosomal rDNA Circles (ERCs)
description: Sir2p protects yeast from toxic accumulation of self-replicating extrachromosomal rDNA circles (ERCs); deletion of the replication-fork-blocking protein Fob1p rescues the short lifespan of sir2 mutants, establishing ERC suppression as the first mechanistic explanation for Sir2's longevity effect. Directionally, Sir2p suppresses ERC accumulation to extend lifespan. By preventing the toxic buildup of these circular DNA molecules, Sir2 preserves genome stability and replicative capacity. This was the first molecular mechanism linking Sir2 to longevity and remains a foundational finding in sirtuin research.
description_zh_TW: Sir2p保護酵母免受自我複製的染色體外rDNA環（ERC）毒性積累的損害；刪除複製叉阻斷蛋白Fob1p可挽救sir2突變體的短壽命，確立ERC抑制是Sir2長壽效應的第一個機制性解釋。方向上，Sir2p抑制ERC積累以延長壽命。透過防止這些環狀DNA分子的毒性積累，Sir2維持基因組穩定性和複製能力。這是第一個將Sir2與長壽聯繫的分子機制，至今仍是sirtuin研究的基礎性發現。

label: Starvation survival
description: HLH-30 is required for survival during prolonged starvation; hlh-30 mutant animals die prematurely under nutrient-deprived conditions due to their inability to mount sufficient autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization. By activating the clearance and energy-mobilization programs, HLH-30 enables worms to withstand food absence. This essential role mirrors the dependence of mammalian cells on TFEB for stress resilience. The phenotype establishes HLH-30 as a critical effector of adaptive starvation responses.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在長期飢餓期間的存活是必需的；hlh-30 突變動物在營養剝奪條件下過早死亡，因為它們無法啟動足夠的自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員。透過活化清除和能量動員程序，HLH-30 使線蟲能夠承受食物缺失。此必要角色反映了哺乳動物細胞對 TFEB 在壓力韌性上的依賴。該表型確立了 HLH-30 作為適應性飢餓反應的關鍵效應物。

label: Longevity in C. elegans
description: HLH-30 regulates longevity in C. elegans, as its overexpression extends lifespan while loss of hlh-30 shortens it and suppresses the longevity of other mutants. By inducing autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity integrates insulin, mTOR, and dietary signals into a pro-longevity transcriptional program. The worm findings provide a conserved model for how TFEB orthologs promote healthspan in higher organisms.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中調節壽命，因為其過度表現可延長壽命，而 hlh-30 的缺失會縮短壽命並抑制其他突變體的長壽。透過誘發自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性將胰島素、mTOR 和飲食信號整合進促長壽的轉錄程序。線蟲的發現為 TFEB 同源物如何在高等生物中促進健康壽命提供了保守模型。

label: Nucleus during fasting
description: HLH-30 translocates to and accumulates in intestinal nuclei of fasted C. elegans, where it activates the lysosomal, autophagic, and lipolytic transcriptional programs. This nuclear enrichment mirrors the starvation-induced nuclear entry of mammalian TFEB/TFE3 and is essential for the organism's adaptive response to food deprivation. The translocation is opposed by insulin/IGF and CeTOR signaling that retain HLH-30 cytoplasmically when food is available. Its nuclear localization thus serves as a key determinant of fasting-induced longevity.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 轉位至禁食線蟲的腸道細胞核中並在其中累積，於此活化溶酶體、自噬性和脂解性的轉錄程序。此核富集反映了哺乳動物 TFEB/TFE3 在飢餓誘發的核進入，並對生物適應食物剝奪的反應至為必要。此轉位受到胰島素/IGF 和 CeTOR 信號的拮抗，後者在食物可得時將 HLH-30 保留於細胞質。因此其核定位作為禁食誘發長壽的關鍵決定因子。

label: Lysosomal lipase genes
description: HLH-30, the C. elegans ortholog of mammalian TFEB, induces expression of the lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) in response to fasting, promoting mobilization of stored lipids. This transcriptional activation mirrors TFEB's induction of lipolytic and autophagic programs in mammals during nutrient scarcity. The HLH-30–lipase axis provides a molecular explanation for fasting-induced lipophagy and lifespan extension in worms. It demonstrates deep conservation of the MiT/TFE nutrient-response program.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 是哺乳動物 TFEB 在線蟲中的同源物，在回應禁食時誘發溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的表現，促進儲存脂質的動員。此轉錄活化反映了哺乳動物 TFEB 在營養匱乏時對脂解和自噬程序的誘發。HLH-30–脂肪酶軸為禁食誘發的脂噬和線蟲壽命延長提供了分子解釋。它展示了 MiT/TFE 營養反應程序的高度保守性。

label: SIRT5 pockets B, C and substrate-binding site
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Co-crystallization of suramin with human SIRT5 revealed that suramin binds by occupying the nicotinamide ribose pocket (B-pocket), the nicotinamide pocket (C-pocket), and part of the substrate-binding site. This structural insight explains suramin's broad, high-affinity inhibition of multiple sirtuins and informed the design of more selective derivatives such as NF675. Directionally, suramin is the ligand and the SIRT5 catalytic cleft the receptor. The structure also illustrates general principles governing small-molecule engagement of the sirtuin NAD+/substrate channel.
description_zh_TW: Suramin 與人類 SIRT5 的共晶體結構揭示 Suramin 透過占据尼可醯胺核糖口袋（B 口袋）、尼可醯胺口袋（C 口袋）和部分受質結合位點進行結合。此結構見解解釋了 Suramin 對多種 sirtuin 的廣泛高親和力抑制作用，並為設計更具選擇性的衍生物如 NF675 提供了依據。方向性上 Suramin 是配體，SIRT5 催化溝槽是受體。此結構也闡明了小分子與 sirtuin NAD+/受質通道結合的一般原則。

label: SIRT1-selective inhibitor
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。

label: SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Suramin is a potent inhibitor of many sirtuins like SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5. The majority of known sirtuin inhibitors exclusively inhibit SIRT1 and/or SIRT2, however some also inhibit SIRT3 and SIRT5 with reduced affinity. Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines, and Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53, with both inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2.
description_zh_TW: 蘇拉明（Suramin）是多種 sirtuins 的強效抑制劑，包括 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT5。大多數已知的 sirtuin 抑制劑僅抑制 SIRT1 和/或 SIRT2，但也有部分抑制劑以較低親和力抑制 SIRT3 和 SIRT5。Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用，而 Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡，兩者均可抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。

label: non-methylated B12 alternative
description: Adenosylcobalamin is a non-methylated, non-methyl-donating form of vitamin B12, in contrast to methylcobalamin which directly supplies a methyl group to the methylation cycle via methionine synthase. Its primary biological role is as the cofactor for mitochondrial methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, which converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA for energy production. Because it bypasses direct methyl donation, it avoids contributing to the methyl load that can accumulate when COMT activity is genetically slow. It is therefore frequently recommended as a safer B12 source for slow COMT individuals who are sensitive to methylated vitamins and may react with anxiety, irritability, or insomnia.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的非甲基化、非甲基供給形式，與甲鈷胺相反，甲鈷胺透過蛋氨酸合成酶直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基。其主要生物學作用是作為線粒體甲基丙二酰輔酶A變位酶的輔因子，該酶將甲基丙二酰輔酶A轉化為琥珀酰輔酶A以產生能量。因為它繞過了直接的甲基捐贈，所以它避免了 COMT activity 基因緩慢時可能累積的甲基負荷。因此，經常建議將其作為對 methylated vitamins 敏感並可能出現焦慮、煩躁或失眠反應的緩慢 COMT 個體的更安全的 B12 來源。

label: active coenzyme form of B12
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden. This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: mitochondrial health
description: Adenosylcobalamin supports mitochondrial health by acting as the required cofactor for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, an enzyme in the mitochondrial matrix that converts methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA within the citric acid cycle. Efficient function of this pathway sustains cellular energy (ATP) production and prevents accumulation of methylmalonic acid. Because mitochondrial dysfunction is linked to numerous age-related and neurological conditions, maintaining adequate adenosylcobalamin status is important for bioenergetic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 透過充當甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 變位酶所需的輔助因子來支持 mitochondrial health，甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 變位酶是線粒體基質中的一種酶，可在檸檬酸循環中將甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 轉化為琥珀酰輔酶 A。此途徑的有效功能可維持細胞能量 (ATP) 的產生並防止甲基丙二酸的累積。由於粒線體功能障礙與許多年齡相關和神經系統疾病有關，因此維持足夠的腺苷鈷胺狀態對於生物能穩態非常重要。

label: Nitric Oxide bioavailability
description: Genistein enhances nitric oxide bioavailability by upregulating eNOS expression and scavenging superoxide that would otherwise consume NO. The combined effect improves endothelial NO signaling. The directionality is isoflavone to increased bioavailable NO. A caveat is that genistein can also bind estrogen receptors, so part of its vascular benefit may be receptor-mediated rather than purely redox-based. Clinical studies report improved flow-mediated dilation after soy isoflavone intake, consistent with enhanced NO-dependent vasorelaxation in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 透過上調 eNOS 表現並清除超氧化物來增強 nitric oxide bioavailability，否則超氧化物會消耗 NO。綜合作用可改善內皮 NO 訊號傳導。異黃酮的方向性是增加生物可利用的一氧化氮。需要注意的是，genistein 還可以結合雌激素受體，因此其部分血管益處可能是受體介導的，而不是純粹基於氧化還原的。臨床研究報告稱，攝取大豆異黃酮後血流介導的擴張得到改善，這與體內 NO 依賴性血管舒張作用的增強一致。

label: Pyridoxamine
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Pyridoxamine is a synthetic AGE inhibitor that prevents AGE accumulation by interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and acting as a carbonyl trap, similar to aminoguanidine. By scavenging carbonyl intermediates, pyridoxamine blocks the formation of advanced glycation end products and is considered a candidate for preventing glycation-mediated pathology. Unlike aminoguanidine, pyridoxamine (a vitamin B6 derivative) has a more favorable safety profile. AGE inhibitors and carbonyl-trapping agents remain an active area of research for reducing AGE burden in diabetes and aging.
description_zh_TW: Pyridoxamine 是一種 synthetic AGE inhibitor，透過與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並作為 carbonyl trap 來防止 AGE accumulation，類似於 aminoguanidine。透過 scavenging carbonyl intermediates，pyridoxamine 阻斷 advanced glycation end products 的形成，並被視為預防 glycation-mediated pathology 的 candidate。不同於 aminoguanidine，pyridoxamine（一種 vitamin B6 derivative）具有更有利的 safety profile。AGE inhibitors 與 carbonyl-trapping agents 仍是減少 diabetes 與 aging 中 AGE burden 的活躍研究領域。

label: Apoptosis in cancer cell lines
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Acute overexpression of SIRT6 in cancer cell lines of different histology induces apoptosis, supporting a tumor-suppressive role for this nuclear sirtuin. The pro-apoptotic activity appears linked to SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function rather than its deacetylase activity. Directionally, increasing SIRT6 abundance or enzymatic activity triggers cell death in tumor cells. This contrasts with SIRT1's context-dependent duality and stresses that sirtuin outputs in cancer depend on the specific isoform and its dominant catalytic modality.
description_zh_TW: 在不同組織學類型的癌細胞系中急性過量表現 SIRT6 可誘導凋亡，支持此核 sirtuin 具有腫瘤抑制功能。此促凋亡活性似乎與 SIRT6 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能而非去乙醯酶活性相關。方向性上，增加 SIRT6 的豐度或酵素活性會在腫瘤細胞中觸發細胞死亡。這與 SIRT1 因情境而異的雙重性形成對比，強調 sirtuin 在癌症中的輸出取決於特定的同工型及其主要的催化模式。

label: apoptosis in tumor cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
description_zh_TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。

label: diet-induced obesity
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 overexpression protects mice from diet-induced obesity, with increased glucose tolerance and reduced fat accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過表達保護小鼠免受飲食誘導的肥胖，具有增加的葡萄糖耐受性和減少的脂肪積累。

label: Apoptotic and autophagic cell death (MCF-7)
description: In MCF-7 breast cancer cells, sirtinol triggers both apoptotic and autophagic programmed cell death, reflecting disrupted survival homeostasis. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of dual cell-death activation. This is attributed to SIRT1/2 inhibition removing anti-apoptotic deacetylation, and it illustrates the pleiotropic anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers. The simultaneous engagement of apoptosis and autophagy suggests that sirtuin inhibition disrupts multiple survival pathways in cancer cells. This dual death response makes sirtinol an informative tool for studying how sirtuins support cancer-cell survival.
description_zh_TW: 在 MCF-7 乳腺癌細胞中，sirtinol 觸發凋亡和自噬兩種程序性細胞死亡，反映了存活恆定性的破壞。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於雙重細胞死亡活化的上游。這歸因於 SIRT1/2 抑制移除了抗凋亡去乙醯化，並闡明了 sirtuin 阻斷劑的多效性抗癌潛力。凋亡和自噬的同時啟動表明 sirtuin 抑制破壞了癌細胞中的多條存活途徑。這種雙重死亡反應使 sirtinol 成為研究 sirtuin 如何支持癌細胞存活的有資訊價值的工具。

label: Senescence-like growth arrest
description: Sirtinol induces senescence-like growth arrest in human lung cancer H1299 cells, consistent with sirtuin inhibition engaging tumor-suppressive programs. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of growth arrest. This phenotype mirrors aspects of SIRT1 loss and suggests that sirtuin blockers can blunt proliferation. The senescence-like arrest likely reflects reactivation of p53 and other tumor suppressors that sirtuins normally restrain. By demonstrating that sirtuin inhibition can induce growth arrest, sirtinol provided early evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers.
description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 在人類肺癌 H1299 細胞中誘導衰老樣生長停滯，與 sirtuin 抑制啟動腫瘤抑制程式一致。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於生長停滯的上游。此表型反映了 SIRT1 缺失的某些方面，表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可以削弱增殖。衰老樣停滯可能反映了 p53 和其他 sirtuin 通常抑制的腫瘤抑制因子的重新活化。透過證明 sirtuin 抑制可以誘導生長停滯，Sirtinol 為 sirtuin 阻斷劑的抗癌潛力提供了早期證據。

label: Breast, lung, prostate and leukemia cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Sirtinol, a hydroxynaphthaldehyde derivative discovered in a phenotypic screen, is active against multiple sirtuin isoforms and has cytotoxic activity against cancer cells of different origins, including breast, lung, prostate, and leukemia cell lines. This broad anticancer activity made sirtinol the founding member of the beta-naphthol inhibitor family and seeded structure-activity programs that produced salermide, cambinol, and splitomicin. Directionally, sirtinol-mediated inhibition of sirtuin activity sits upstream of its cytotoxic effects on malignant cells, though its full target spectrum extends beyond sirtuins.
description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 是一種在表型篩選中發現的羥基萘醛衍生物，對多種 sirtuin 同工型具有活性，並對不同來源的癌細胞具有細胞毒活性，包括乳腺癌、肺癌、前列腺癌和白血病細胞系。這種廣泛的抗癌活性使 Sirtinol 成為 β-萘酚抑制劑家族的創始成員，並啟動了產生 salermide、cambinol 和 splitomicin 的構效關係研究。方向性上 Sirtinol 介導的 sirtuin 活性抑制位於其對惡性細胞細胞毒作用的上游，儘管其完整的作用靶標範圍超越了 sirtuin。

label: cardiovascular disease in slow COMT
description: Aspirin is effective in preventing cardiovascular disease among individuals with the slow COMT (Met/Met, A/A) genotype, where its antiplatelet and anti-inflammatory actions translate into net cardiovascular protection. Slow COMT activity appears to create a metabolic milieu, involving higher catecholamine tone and distinct folate handling, in which low-dose aspirin reduces thrombotic event risk. This protective association is the inverse of the effect seen in fast COMT individuals, who may experience increased risk or no benefit. The divergence highlights a clear pharmacogenetic pattern and supports genotype-aware approaches to aspirin prophylaxis.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin 可有效預防 COMT（Met/Met，A/A）慢基因型個體的心血管疾病，其抗血小板和抗發炎作用轉化為淨心血管保護。緩慢的 COMT activity 似乎會創造一個代謝環境，涉及更高的兒茶酚胺張力和獨特的 folate 處理，其中低劑量阿斯匹靈可降低血栓事件風險。這種保護性關聯與快速 COMT 個體中觀察到的效果相反，後者可能會經歷風險增加或沒有益處。這種差異凸顯了明確的藥物遺傳學模式，並支持基因型感知的阿斯匹靈預防方法。

label: fast COMT genotype
description: Aspirin may increase cardiovascular disease risk in individuals with the fast COMT (Val/Val, G/G) genotype, reflecting a gene-drug interaction in which rapid COMT-mediated catecholamine clearance changes the vascular response to aspirin. Population studies and prospective cohorts have reported that the cardioprotective benefit of aspirin is absent or reversed in fast metabolizers, whereas slow COMT individuals derive protection. The proposed mechanisms involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that alter platelet, endothelial, and redox homeostasis. This directionality makes COMT status a candidate biomarker for personalizing aspirin therapy.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin可能會增加具有快速COMT（Val/Val，G/G）基因型個體的心血管疾病風險，反映了基因-藥物交互作用，其中快速COMT介導的兒茶酚胺清除改變了血管對阿斯匹靈的反應。人群研究和前瞻性隊列報告稱，阿斯匹靈的心臟保護作用在快速代謝者中不存在或逆轉，而慢速 COMT 個體則獲得保護。所提出的機制涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了血小板、內皮和氧化還原穩態。這種方向性使 COMT 狀態成為個人化阿斯匹靈治療的候選生物標記。

label: CVD in fast COMT
description: Aspirin may increase cardiovascular disease risk specifically in individuals carrying the fast COMT (Val/Val, G/G) genotype, a pharmacogenetic interaction identified in prospective studies. The mechanism is thought to involve genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that alter aspirin's effects on vascular homeostasis. This contrasts sharply with slow COMT individuals, in whom aspirin is protective, underscoring the importance of COMT genotyping in cardiovascular prevention strategies.
description_zh_TW: Aspirin 可能會增加心血管疾病的風險，特別是在攜帶快速 COMT（Val/Val，G/G）基因型的個體中，這是前瞻性研究中發現的一種藥物遺傳學交互作用。此機制被認為涉及兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，從而改變阿斯匹靈對血管穩態的影響。這與緩慢的 COMT 個體形成鮮明對比，阿斯匹靈對這些個體具有保護作用，並強調了 COMT 基因分型在心血管預防策略中的重要性。

label: TFEB expression
description: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: MMP-3
description: Matrix metalloproteinase-3 (MMP-3) is a SASP protease associated with extracellular matrix degradation, tissue remodeling, and, in tumor contexts, cancer cell invasion and metastasis. Its secretion reflects the matrix-remodeling arm of the secretome that supports wound healing acutely but pathological tissue breakdown chronically, and MMP-3 can activate other MMPs in a cascade, amplifying remodeling. This protease component distinguishes the SASP from a purely cytokine profile and contributes to fibrosis and basement-membrane disruption in aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 基質金屬蛋白酶-3（MMP-3）是一種與細胞外基質降解、組織重塑以及腫瘤脈絡中癌細胞侵襲和轉移相關的 SASP 蛋白酶。其分泌反映支持急性傷口癒合但慢性病理性組織崩解的基質重塑臂，且 MMP-3 可在級聯中活化其他 MMP，放大重塑。此蛋白酶組成將 SASP 與純細胞激素輪廓區分，並貢獻老化組織中的纖維化與基底膜破壞。

label: Heterochromatin Decompaction
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: METTL3/METTL14
description: The METTL3-METTL14 m6A methyltransferase complex promotes SASP factor expression by installing N6-methyladenosine marks on mRNA that facilitate enhancer-promoter looping and stabilize SASP transcripts. This epitranscriptomic layer adds post-transcriptional control to the secretome, coordinating the sustained expression of multiple SASP genes. The relationship is mechanistically plausible and supported by knockout studies showing reduced SASP, but the field is newer and less consolidated than the NF-kB/mTOR axes, so confidence is moderate.
description_zh_TW: METTL3-METTL14 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體透過在 mRNA 上安裝 N6-甲基腺苷標記，促進 SASP 因子表現，該標記促進增強子—啟動子環化並穩定 SASP 轉錄本。此表觀轉錄層次為分泌組添加轉錄後控制，協調多種 SASP 基因的持續表現。此關係在機制上合理且獲剔除研究（顯示 SASP 降低）支持，但此領域較新、較不如 NF-κB/mTOR 軸整合，故信度中等。

label: Secretory Phenotype
description: The SASP is a hypersecretory state -- a specialized secretory phenotype -- in which senescent cells upregulate and release hundreds of factors including interleukins, chemokines, growth factors, proteases, and extracellular vesicles. This secreted output contrasts with the quiescent, low-turnover secretome of non-senescent cells and is a defining non-cell-autonomous feature of the senescent state. The composition of the SASP is variable, shaped by the senescence inducer, cell type, and tissue context. Its classification as a secretory phenotype emphasizes that senescence exerts its effects largely through communication with the microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SASP 是一種高分泌狀態——一種特化的分泌表型——衰老細胞在此狀態下上調並釋放數百種因子，包括介白素、趨化因子、生長因子、蛋白酶與細胞外囊泡。此分泌輸出與非衰老細胞靜止、低更新的分泌組形成對比，是衰老狀態定義性的非細胞自主性特徵。SASP 的組成是可變的，受衰老誘發因子、細胞類型與組織脈絡塑造。將其歸類為分泌表型，強調衰老主要透過與微環境的溝通發揮作用。

label: N6-methyladenosine
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the methyltransferase complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine (m6A), the most abundant internal modification of messenger RNA in mammalian cells. Together with the adaptor protein METTL14, METTL3 methylates the N6 position of adenosine in mRNA, and the resulting m6A mark regulates RNA stability, splicing, translation, and export. Beyond its RNA-methylation role, the METTL3-METTL14 complex also facilitates senescence-associated enhancer-promoter contacts and SASP expression in oncogene-induced senescence.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是甲基轉移酶複合物的催化亞基，可沉積 N6-methyladenosine (m6A)，N6-methyladenosine (m6A) 是哺乳動物細胞中最豐富的信使 RNA 內部修飾。 METTL3 與接頭蛋白 METTL14 一起甲基化 mRNA 中腺苷的 N6 位點，產生的 m6A 標記可調節 RNA 穩定性、剪接、翻譯和輸出。除了其 RNA 甲基化作用外，METTL3-METTL14 複合物還促進衰老相關的增強子-啟動子接觸以及癌基因誘導衰老中的 SASP 表達。

label: NRTI
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, developed as antiretroviral drugs for HIV, also inhibit LINE-1 retrotransposition. NRTIs act as chain-terminating nucleoside analogs that are incorporated into nascent DNA by reverse transcriptase, halting the synthesis of the L1 cDNA copies that would otherwise be generated from L1 RNA in the cytoplasm. By blocking LINE-1 reverse transcription, NRTIs reduce the cGAS-STING-dependent inflammation and SASP that arise from retrotransposon derepression during aging, and they are being explored as anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: 核苷逆轉錄酶抑制劑是作為 HIV 抗逆轉錄病毒藥物而開發的，也能抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座。 NRTI 充當鏈終止核苷類似物，透過逆轉錄酶將其摻入新生 DNA 中，從而停止 L1 cDNA 副本的合成，否則這些副本將由細胞質中的 L1 RNA 產生。透過阻斷 LINE-1 逆轉錄，NRTI 可以減少 cGAS-STING 依賴性發炎和老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子去抑制引起的 SASP，並且它們正在被探索作為抗衰老幹預措施。

label: Acetate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetate is converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2 and is not membrane-permeable acetyl-CoA itself. Acetate supplementation increases global nuclear acetylation including H3K27ac and induces expression of pro-inflammatory genes including IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators p16 and p21. In mitochondria-depleted senescent cells, acetate increases histone acetylation and partially restores a subset of the mitochondrial-dependent SASP programme. However, acetate-induced SASP gene expression is suppressed by the STING inhibitor SN011, showing that chromatin accessibility alone cannot drive SASP transcription without innate immune activation.
description_zh_TW: 乙酸（acetate）在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA），其本身並非可通透細胞膜的乙醯輔酶A。補充乙酸可增加整體細胞核乙醯化（包括 H3K27ac），並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因的表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子 p16 與 p21。在缺乏粒線體的衰老細胞中，乙酸可增加組蛋白乙醯化，並部分恢復依賴粒線體的 SASP 程序中的一部分。然而，乙酸誘導的 SASP 基因表現會被 STING 抑制劑 SN011 所壓制，顯示若無先天免疫活化，僅靠染色質可及性無法驅動 SASP 轉錄。

label: HGF
description: The SASP is composed of hepatocyte growth factor (HGF), which is secreted by senescent fibroblasts. HGF inhibits cell competition-mediated cancer suppression mechanisms, thereby promoting cancer cell proliferation. This makes HGF a pro-tumorigenic component of the SASP.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由 hepatocyte growth factor（HGF）組成，它由衰老纖維母細胞分泌。HGF 抑制細胞競爭介導的癌症抑制機制，從而促進癌細胞增殖。這使 HGF 成為 SASP 的促腫瘤組成之一。

label: MMP-9
description: The SASP is composed of matrix metalloproteinases, including MMP-1, MMP-3, MMP-9, and MMP-12, which are associated with detrimental effects on senescent dermal fibroblasts during tissue damage. These proteases contribute to skin ageing and cooperatively facilitate cancer cell metastasis. MMP-9 in particular degrades type IV collagen in basement membranes.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由 matrix metalloproteinases 組成，包括 MMP-1、MMP-3、MMP-9 與 MMP-12，它們在組織損傷期間與衰老皮膚纖維母細胞的有害效應相關。這些蛋白酶促成皮膚老化，並協同促進癌細胞轉移。尤其是 MMP-9 會降解基底膜中的 type IV collagen。

label: CXCL10
description: The SASP is composed of the chemokine CXCL10, which is secreted by ROS-induced senescent hepatocytes. CXCL10 enhances natural killer cell activity by binding to CXCR3. This positions CXCL10 as a SASP factor that links cellular senescence to innate immune surveillance.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由趨化因子 CXCL10 組成，它由 ROS 誘導的衰老肝細胞分泌。CXCL10 透過與 CXCR3 結合增強自然殺手細胞活性。這使 CXCL10 成為將 cellular senescence 與先天免疫監視連結起來的 SASP 因子。

label: CD9
description: CD9 is a tetraspanin surface marker used to define senescent and immune cell populations. It helps identify senescent cells and is discussed as a surface marker for ligand-conjugated nanoparticle delivery targeting senescent cells within the SASP context.
description_zh_TW: CD9 是 tetraspanin 表面標記，用於定義衰老與免疫細胞族群。它有助於辨識衰老細胞，並被討論作為在 SASP 脈絡下針對衰老細胞之配體共軛奈米顆粒遞送的表面標記。

label: MLL1
description: H3K4me3 is a canonical activating mark concentrated at promoters, deposited by MLL1 (KMT2A) and other SET1-complex methyltransferases. Its dynamics with the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me3 是集中於啟動子的典型活化標記，由 MLL1（KMT2A）及其他 SET1 複合體甲基轉移酶沉積。它與抑制性 H3K27me3 的動態在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀。

label: ULK1, ATG13, FIP200, ATG101
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: ULK1 functions within a stable initiation complex containing ATG13, FIP200 (RB1CC1), and ATG101, which nucleates autophagosome formation in response to nutrient status. Directionally, the complex sits upstream of autophagy initiation. SIRT1 deacetylates and activates ULK1 within this complex, positioning sirtuins at the top of the autophagic machinery. The ULK1 complex integrates signals from AMPK and mTORC1, which either activate or inhibit it depending on energy and nutrient state. This makes the initiation complex the central decision point for whether autophagy proceeds.
description_zh_TW: ULK1 在一個包含 ATG13、FIP200（RB1CC1）和 ATG101 的穩定啟動複合物中發揮功能，該複合物在回應營養狀態時 nucleate 自噬體形成。在方向性上，該複合物位於自噬啟動的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化此複合物中的 ULK1，將 sirtuin 置於自噬機制的頂端。ULK1 複合物整合來自 AMPK 和 mTORC1 的訊號，根據能量和營養狀態啟動或抑制自噬。這使啟動複合物成為自噬是否進行的決策核心。

label: Autophagosome
description: The phagophore assembly site is the platform on which the phagophore is nucleated, elongated, and ultimately sealed into the mature autophagosome. The crescent-shaped isolation membrane formed at the PAS becomes the double-membraned autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點是吞噬泡形成、延伸並最終封閉為成熟自噬體的平台。在 PAS 形成的月牙形隔離膜成為雙膜自噬體。

label: Cancer cells to chemotherapy
description: Cambinol combination with chemotherapeutic agents dramatically sensitizes cancer cells to chemotherapy-induced apoptosis. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of enhanced chemosensitivity. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, it removes survival signals that protect tumor cells from drug-induced death, and this supports sirtuin inhibition as a chemosensitization strategy. The effect is particularly relevant in p53-wild-type tumors, where sirtuin inhibition reactivates p53-dependent apoptosis. Combination regimens of sirtuin inhibitors with conventional chemotherapy are therefore of significant clinical interest.
description_zh_TW: Cambinol 與化療藥物的組合顯著增敏癌細胞對化療誘導的凋亡。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於增強化療敏感性的上游。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，它移除保護腫瘤細胞免於藥物誘導死亡的存活訊號，支持 sirtuin 抑制作為化療增敏策略。此效應在 p53 野生型腫瘤中特別相關，因為 sirtuin 抑制可重新活化 p53 依賴性凋亡。因此 sirtuin 抑制劑與常規化療的組合方案具有重要的臨床意義。

label: Burkitt lymphoma cell lines
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines. Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53. Both Cambinol and Salermide have inhibitory effects on SIRT1 and SIRT2. Directionally, these sirtuin-inhibiting compounds sit upstream of suppressed cancer cell growth, with Cambinol showing particular potency against Burkitt lymphoma among the STIC class of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用。Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡。Cambinol 和 Salermide 均對 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 具有抑制作用。從作用方向而言，這些 sirtuin 抑制化合物位於抑制癌細胞生長的上游，其中 Cambinol 在 STIC 類 sirtuin 抑制劑中對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤表現出特別的效力。

label: Cancer cell migration and invasion
description: In hepatocellular and lung cancer cells, Cambinol impairs migration and invasion in a dose-dependent manner, consistent with sirtuin inhibition reducing metastatic behaviors. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of suppressed motility. This suggests sirtuin blockers may limit metastasis, complementing Cambinol's chemotherapy-sensitizing effects. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, Cambinol disrupts the survival and migration programs that cancer cells depend on. The anti-migratory effect adds a metastatic dimension to the anticancer profile of sirtuin inhibitors, supporting their evaluation as anti-metastatic agents.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞癌和肺癌細胞中，Cambinol 以劑量依賴方式損害遷移和侵襲，與 sirtuin 抑制減少轉移行為一致。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於抑制運動性的上游。這表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可能限制轉移，與 Cambinol 的化療增敏效應互補。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，Cambinol 破壞癌細胞依賴的存活和遷移程式。抗遷移效應為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌特徵增添了轉移維度，支持其作為抗轉移藥物的評估。

label: Cancer cell lines (MOLT4, MDA-MB-231, RKO)
description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

label: Proapoptotic genes (via H4K16ac)
description: Salermide inhibits SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of H4K16, leading to epigenetic reactivation of proapoptotic genes aberrantly repressed in cancer cells. Directionally, Salermide promotes H4K16 hyperacetylation, which drives apoptosis gene expression. This removes a chromatin-based survival brake and is a mechanistic rationale for sirtuin-inhibitor cancer therapy. By restoring H4K16ac at the promoters of pro-apoptotic genes, Salermide reverses the epigenetic silencing imposed by SIRT1. This illustrates how sirtuin inhibitors can act as epigenetic modulators to restore tumor-suppressive transcription.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 抑制 SIRT1 介導的 H4K16 去乙醯化，導致在癌細胞中異常被抑制的促凋亡基因的表觀遺傳重新活化。在方向性上，Salermide 促進 H4K16 超乙醯化，驅動凋亡基因表達。這移除了基於染色質的存活制動器，是 sirtuin 抑制劑癌症治療的機制性理由。透過在促凋亡基因啟動子上恢復 H4K16ac，Salermide 逆轉了 SIRT1 施加的表觀遺傳沉默。這說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑如何作為表觀遺傳調節因子來恢復腫瘤抑制性轉錄。

label: Colorectal cancer stem cells
description: Salermide inhibits colorectal carcinoma cancer-stem-cell self-renewal and reduces tumorigenesis, targeting the resilient stem-cell fraction. Directionally, Salermide sits upstream of stem-cell suppression. This is important because cancer stem cells drive relapse and resistance, and extending sirtuin-inhibitor effects to the tumor-initiation compartment has therapeutic significance. By suppressing self-renewal, Salermide reduces the population of cells capable of regenerating tumors. These findings suggest that sirtuin inhibitors may be effective against the most refractory cancer cell populations.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 抑制結腸直腸癌癌幹細胞的自我更新並減少腫瘤發生，靶向頑固的幹細胞群體。在方向性上，Salermide 位於抑制幹細胞的上游。這很重要，因為癌幹細胞驅動復發和抗藥性，將 sirtuin 抑制劑的效應延伸到腫瘤起始區室具有治療意義。透過抑制自我更新，Salermide 減少能夠再生腫瘤的細胞群。這些發現表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可能對最頑固的癌細胞群體有效。

label: Lipid profile (raises HDL, reduces LDL oxidation)
description: The Mediterranean Diet raises HDL while reducing LDL oxidation through its polyphenol-rich components, improving the overall lipid profile. Directionally, the diet sits upstream of favorable lipid changes. This contributes to its cardiovascular protection, and resveratrol and other polyphenols are putative SIRT1-engaging contributors. By combining healthy fats with antioxidant polyphenols, the diet improves both the quantity and quality of circulating lipoproteins. These lipid effects are part of the broader cardiovascular benefit demonstrated in clinical trials of the Mediterranean diet.
description_zh_TW: 地中海飲食透過其富含多酚的成分提高 HDL 同時減少 LDL 氧化，改善整體血脂特徵。在方向性上，飲食位於有利脂質變化的上游。這有助於其心血管保護作用，resveratrol 和其他多酚是假定的 SIRT1 介入貢獻者。透過結合健康脂肪和抗氧化多酚，飲食同時改善了循環脂蛋白的數量和品質。這些脂質效應是地中海飲食臨床試驗中展示的更廣泛心血管益處的一部分。

label: SIRT1 (via resveratrol)
description: The Mediterranean Diet's resveratrol content is proposed to activate SIRT1, linking the dietary pattern to longevity pathways. Directionally, diet-derived resveratrol sits upstream of SIRT1 activation. This is one of several polyphenol-mediated mechanisms of the diet, though human causality is inferential rather than proven. The Mediterranean Diet also provides other polyphenols and healthy fats that may act through SIRT1 and AMPK. This dietary association has motivated research into how whole-food polyphenol patterns, rather than isolated compounds, influence sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 地中海飲食中的 resveratrol 含量被提出可以活化 SIRT1，將飲食模式與長壽途徑聯繫起來。在方向性上，飲食來源的 resveratrol 位於 SIRT1 活化的上游。這是該飲食的多種多酚介導機制之一，但人體因果關係是推斷性的而非已證實的。地中海飲食還提供其他多酚和健康脂肪，可能透過 SIRT1 和 AMPK 發揮作用。此飲食關聯推動了全食物多酚模式（而非單獨化合物）如何影響 sirtuin 生物學的研究。

label: Cardiovascular Disease risk
description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: premature ageing
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Global SIRT7 depletion contributes to premature ageing, especially in the backbone, white adipose tissue, and the heart.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 的全身性缺乏促成早衰，尤其是在脊柱、白色脂肪組織和心臟中。

label: DNA repair and chromatin compaction
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 depletion decreases DNA repair and compaction of chromatin, rendering cells more susceptible to genotoxic stressors. SIRT7 is a histone desuccinylase that functionally links to chromatin compaction and genome stability. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of reduced genomic stability and increased sensitivity to DNA damage, making SIRT7 important for protecting cells against genotoxic stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭降低DNA修復和染色質壓縮，使細胞更容易受到基因毒性壓力源的影響。SIRT7是一種組蛋白去琥珀醯化酶，在功能上與染色質壓縮和基因組穩定性相關。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於基因組穩定性降低和DNA損傷敏感性增加的上游，使SIRT7對保護細胞免受基因毒性壓力至關重要。

label: p38/MAPK signaling activation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT7 depletion inhibits tumor growth by activating p38/MAPK signaling in breast cancer. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of p38/MAPK pathway activation, which suppresses tumor-cell expansion. Because SIRT7 normally restrains this growth-limiting signaling, its depletion unleashes p38/MAPK activity and curbs tumor growth. This positions SIRT7 as a tumor-promoting factor in breast cancer and identifies the p38/MAPK pathway as a downstream mediator.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7耗竭透過活化p38/MAPK訊號通路在乳腺癌中抑制腫瘤生長。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於p38/MAPK通路活化的上游，後者抑制腫瘤細胞擴增。因為SIRT7通常限制此生長限制性訊號，其耗竭釋放p38/MAPK活性並抑制腫瘤生長。這將SIRT7定位為乳腺癌中的促腫瘤因子，並將p38/MAPK通路確定為下游介導因子。

label: dopaminergic neurotransmission
description: Modafinil increases dopaminergic neurotransmission primarily by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT), thereby elevating extracellular dopamine in the prefrontal cortex and striatum. It may also affect norepinephrine and orexin systems, contributing to its wakefulness-promoting effects. By raising dopamine tone, it interacts with the COMT-set baseline that differs by genotype, with fast COMT individuals showing greater improvement. It is approved for narcolepsy and used off-label for cognitive enhancement.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 主要透過抑制多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 來增加 dopaminergic neurotransmission，從而提高前額葉皮質和紋狀體中的細胞外多巴胺。它還可能影響 norepinephrine 和食慾素系統，從而有助於其促進覺醒的作用。透過提高多巴胺張力，它與因基因型而異的 COMT 設定基線相互作用，快速的 COMT 個體表現出更大的改善。它被批准用於 narcolepsy 並用於標籤外認知增強。

label: narcolepsy
description: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting agent approved for narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea-related sleepiness, and shift-work sleep disorder, acting via dopamine transporter inhibition and orexin system modulation. It improves daytime alertness and reduces excessive sleepiness with a lower abuse liability than classical psychostimulants such as amphetamines. Its efficacy provides the clinical anchor for its off-label cognitive and nootropic uses. It is a key tool in sleep medicine and in performance-enhancement contexts.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 是一種覺醒促進劑，被批准用於治療 narcolepsy、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症相關的嗜睡和輪班工作睡眠障礙，透過多巴胺轉運蛋白抑制和食慾素系統調節發揮作用。它可以提高白天的警覺性並減少過度嗜睡，並且比安非他明等經典精神興奮劑的濫用可能性更低。其功效為其標籤外認知和 nootropic 用途提供了臨床依據。它是睡眠醫學和提高表現的關鍵工具。

label: nootropic
description: Modafinil is widely used off-label as a nootropic to enhance alertness, attention, and executive function in healthy individuals, capitalizing on its dopaminergic and wake-promoting actions. Its cognitive-enhancing effects are modest and, as with therapeutic use, modulated by COMT genotype, with fast genotypes showing greater benefit. Off-label use is common despite indications limited to narcolepsy and related sleep disorders. Its effects illustrate the intersection of pharmacology, genetics, and cognitive enhancement.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 與 nootropic 一樣被廣泛用於標籤外，以增強健康個體的警覺性和注意力，而 executive function 則利用其多巴胺能和促進清醒的作用。其認知增強作用不大，且與治療用途一樣，由 COMT genotype 調節，快速基因型顯示出更大的益處。儘管適應症僅限於 narcolepsy 和相關睡眠障礙，但超說明書使用很常見。其作用體現了藥理學、遺傳學和認知增強的交叉作用。

label: ELK1
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: SIRT7 at target gene promoters
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The ETS-family transcription factor ELK4 interacts with SIRT7 and stabilizes the deacetylase at target gene promoters, allowing SIRT7 to deacetylate histone H3 at lysine 18 and repress tumor-suppressor genes. This tethering is required to maintain cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-bound promoter occupancy precedes SIRT7-dependent H3K18 deacetylation. SIRT7 depletion accordingly reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, highlighting the ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 axis as an oncogenic regulatory circuit.
description_zh_TW: ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 SIRT7 能去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。這種錨定對於維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵是必需的。方向性上 ELK4 結合的啟動子占據先於 SIRT7 依賴的 H3K18 去乙醯化。SIRT7 的耗竭相應地降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7-H3K18 軸線作為致癌性調控迴路的重要性。

label: Fluorescent substrate artifacts
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。

label: SIRT1 KM for substrates
description: Sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) such as resveratrol lower the Km of SIRT1 for its peptide and NAD+ substrates, amplifying deacetylation efficiency. Directionally, STAC binding sits upstream of enhanced catalytic rate. This allosteric effect is the defining action of a STAC, and it underlies the metabolic and longevity benefits attributed to these molecules. By increasing substrate affinity, STACs allow SIRT1 to deacetylate targets even at low NAD+ concentrations. This mechanism distinguishes true STACs from indirect NAD+-raising compounds, and it is central to STAC pharmacology.
