label: Betaine supplementation
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine, TMG) supplementation can cause mood sensitivity, including irritability, anxiety, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it increases methyl availability that these individuals clear more slowly. The resulting elevation in SAMe and the overall methyl burden can push catecholamine metabolism and mood regulation beyond the optimal range, particularly when combined with other methyl donors. Because slow COMT already processes catecholamines and methyl groups inefficiently, the added methyl load is poorly tolerated. Dose titration, monitoring, and low starting doses are advised when using betaine in this genetically defined subgroup.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸，TMG）補充劑可能會導致緩慢的 COMT 個體情緒敏感，包括煩躁、焦慮或過度刺激，因為它增加了這些個體清除速度較慢的甲基可用性。由此產生的 SAMe 和整體甲基負擔的增加可以推動兒茶酚胺代謝和情緒調節超出最佳範圍，特別是與其他甲基供體結合時。因為緩慢的 COMT 已經低效地處理 catecholamines 和 methyl groups，所以添加的甲基負載的耐受性很差。在這個基因定義的亞群中使用甜菜鹼時，建議進行劑量滴定、監測和低起始劑量。

label: Bipolar II Disorder
description: Bipolar II Disorder is characterized by the occurrence of at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode, with hypomania representing a less severe form of mania that does not cause marked functional impairment or psychosis and does not require hospitalization. The depressive phases typically predominate in duration and disability, making depression the major source of impairment. Genetic variants including COMT and MTHFR have been explored as contributors to susceptibility through effects on catecholamine and methyl metabolism, though the associations are modest. The disorder is distinguished from Bipolar I by the absence of full manic episodes.
description_zh_TW: Bipolar II Disorder的特徵是發生至少一次輕躁症發作和至少一次重度憂鬱發作，輕躁症代表一種不太嚴重的躁狂形式，不會引起明顯的功能障礙或精神病，並且不需要住院治療。憂鬱階段通常在持續時間和殘疾方面占主導地位，這使得憂鬱症成為損害的主要來源。包括 COMT 和 MTHFR 在內的遺傳變異已被探索為透過影響兒茶酚胺和甲基代謝而導致易感性的因素，儘管這種關聯性不大。此疾病與 I 型雙極性情感疾患的差異在於不存在完全的躁症發作。

label: Body Mass Index
description: Dietary isoleucine correlates with body mass index in humans, and increased circulating isoleucine is associated with increased mortality risk. In Western diet-fed mice, increasing dietary isoleucine promotes weight gain, fat accretion, glucose intolerance, and insulin resistance. In contrast, isoleucine restriction consistently improves metabolic health across dietary contexts and age groups, extends lifespan of both Drosophila and mice, reduces frailty and increases healthspan, rejuvenates aged mice at the molecular level, induces substantial epigenetic changes, and improves Alzheimer's disease outcomes in male mice. Isoleucine is described as an exceptionally powerful modifier of the hallmarks of protein restriction.
description_zh_TW: 飲食中的異白胺酸與人類身體質量指數相關，且循環異白胺酸升高與死亡風險增加有關。在西方飲食餵養的小鼠中，增加飲食異白胺酸會促進體重增加、脂肪累積、葡萄糖不耐受與胰島素抗性。相反地，限制異白胺酸在各種飲食情境與年齡層中一致地改善代謝健康、延長果蠅與小鼠的壽命、減少衰弱並延長健康壽命、在分子層面使老年小鼠年輕化、誘導顯著的表觀遺傳變化，並改善雄性小鼠的阿茲海默症結果。異白胺酸被描述為蛋白質限制標誌特徵的異常強大修飾因子。

label: BRCA1 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Loss of BRCA1 triggers increased autophagy as a compensatory survival mechanism in breast and ovarian cancers, buffering the viability impact of defective homologous recombination. Directionally, BRCA1 deficiency sits upstream of autophagic upregulation. This metabolic rewiring can be co-opted by tumors to survive despite genome instability, and it connects genome-maintenance failure to lysosomal clearance pathways. Because autophagy supports the survival of BRCA-deficient cells, combining PARP inhibitors with autophagy inhibitors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy. The compensatory autophagy illustrates how cancer cells adapt to DNA-repair defects.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 的缺失觸發自噬增加作為乳腺和卵巢癌中的代償性存活機制，緩衝同源重組缺陷對細胞活性的影響。在方向性上，BRCA1 缺陷位於自噬上調的上游。這種代謝重編程可被腫瘤利用在基因組不穩定的情況下存活，將基因組維護失敗與溶酶體清除途徑聯繫起來。由於自噬支持 BRCA 缺陷細胞的存活，正在探索將 PARP 抑制劑與自噬抑制劑結合的治療策略。代償性自噬說明了癌細胞如何適應 DNA 修復缺陷。

Because autophagy supports the survival of BRCA-deficient cells, combining PARP inhibitors with autophagy inhibitors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy. The compensatory autophagy illustrates how cancer cells adapt to DNA-repair defects.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 的缺失觸發自噬增加作為乳腺和卵巢癌中的代償性存活機制，緩衝同源重組缺陷對細胞活性的影響。在方向性上，BRCA1 缺陷位於自噬上調的上游。這種代謝重編程可被腫瘤利用在基因組不穩定的情況下存活，將基因組維護失敗與溶酶體清除途徑聯繫起來。由於自噬支持 BRCA 缺陷細胞的存活，正在探索將 PARP 抑制劑與自噬抑制劑結合的治療策略。代償性自噬說明了癌細胞如何適應 DNA 修復缺陷。

label: BRCA1 mutation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: BRCA1-deficient tumors are exquisitely sensitive to PARP inhibitors because blocking base-excision (PARP) repair in the setting of defective homologous recombination causes catastrophic, lethal DNA damage through synthetic lethality. Directionally, BRCA1 mutation sits upstream of PARP-inhibitor vulnerability. This is a cornerstone of precision oncology, targeting the specific repair defect of the tumor. It illustrates how repair-pathway context determines therapeutic selectivity, and it has transformed the treatment of BRCA-mutated breast and ovarian cancer. Sirtuins that modulate repair pathways may influence sensitivity to such agents.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 缺陷型腫瘤對 PARP 抑制劑高度敏感，因為在同源重組缺陷的情況下阻斷鹼基切除（PARP）修復會透過合成致死導致災難性的致死 DNA 損傷。在方向性上，BRCA1 突變位於 PARP 抑制劑脆弱性的上游。這是精準腫瘤學的基石，靶向腫瘤的特定修復缺陷。它說明了修復途徑情境如何決定治療選擇性，並已改變了 BRCA 突變乳腺癌和卵巢癌的治療。調控修復途徑的 sirtuin 可能影響對此類藥物的敏感性。

label: PARP inhibitors (synthetic lethality)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: BRCA1-deficient tumors are exquisitely sensitive to PARP inhibitors because blocking base-excision (PARP) repair in the setting of defective homologous recombination causes catastrophic, lethal DNA damage through synthetic lethality. Directionally, BRCA1 mutation sits upstream of PARP-inhibitor vulnerability. This is a cornerstone of precision oncology, targeting the specific repair defect of the tumor. It illustrates how repair-pathway context determines therapeutic selectivity, and it has transformed the treatment of BRCA-mutated breast and ovarian cancer. Sirtuins that modulate repair pathways may influence sensitivity to such agents.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 缺陷型腫瘤對 PARP 抑制劑高度敏感，因為在同源重組缺陷的情況下阻斷鹼基切除（PARP）修復會透過合成致死導致災難性的致死 DNA 損傷。在方向性上，BRCA1 突變位於 PARP 抑制劑脆弱性的上游。這是精準腫瘤學的基石，靶向腫瘤的特定修復缺陷。它說明了修復途徑情境如何決定治療選擇性，並已改變了 BRCA 突變乳腺癌和卵巢癌的治療。調控修復途徑的 sirtuin 可能影響對此類藥物的敏感性。

label: Polyphenol STAC
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Butein is a chalcone polyphenol that belongs to the first generation of natural sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), reported to activate SIRT1 together with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, and myricetin. These polyphenolic activators established the concept of pharmacological SIRT1 activation and served as the basis for later, more potent synthetic STACs such as SRT1460, SRT1720, and SRT2183. Directionally, butein's identification as a polyphenol STAC initiated the activator chemistry that progressed to synthetic scaffolds, though the direct activation mechanism remains controversial due to fluorescent-substrate artifacts.
description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查爾酮多酚，屬於第一代天然 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），據報導與 resveratrol、piceatannol、quercetin 和 myricetin 一起活化 SIRT1。這些多酚類活化劑確立了藥理學 SIRT1 活化的概念，並作為後續更強效合成 STAC 如 SRT1460、SRT1720 和 SRT2183 的基礎。方向性上 Butein 作為多酚類 STAC 的鑑定啟動了從活化劑化學到合成骨架的發展，儘管由於螢光受質假象，直接活化機制仍存在爭議。

label: Glutamate dehydrogenase
description: SIRT4 is the clearest anti-glutamine sirtuin: it mono-ADP-ribosylates glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH), limiting glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate flux and restricting the anaplerotic carbon supply to the TCA cycle that glutamine-addicted cancers depend on. Loss of SIRT4 is common in HCC, gastric, CRC, bladder, and breast cancer, marking it a metabolic tumor suppressor.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 是最明確的抗麩醯胺 sirtuin：它單-ADP-核糖基化 glutamate dehydrogenase（GDH），限制麩胺酸至 alpha-ketoglutarate 的通量，並限制麩醯胺依賴癌細胞所依賴的 TCA 循環回補碳供應。SIRT4 缺失在 HCC、胃、CRC、膀胱與乳癌中常見，標記其為代謝腫瘤抑制因子。

label: E-cadherin
description: SIRT4 upregulates E-cadherin in colorectal cancer while suppressing proliferation, migration, and invasion via glutamine-metabolism inhibition. SIRT4 also increases sensitivity to 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle, cementing its tumor-suppressive role in CRC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 在大腸癌中上調 E-cadherin，同時透過抑制麩醯胺代謝抑制增生、遷移與侵犯。SIRT4 亦透過抑制細胞週期增加對 5-fluorouracil 的敏感性，鞏固其在 CRC 中的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As an outcome of cellular stresses, SIRT4 controls PTEN stability via the insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE). Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of PTEN protein abundance through IDE-mediated degradation. Because PTEN is a key tumour suppressor and negative regulator of PI3K/Akt signalling, SIRT4-dependent control of PTEN stability links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to oncogenic signalling under stress conditions.
description_zh_TW: 作為細胞壓力的結果，SIRT4透過胰島素降解酶（IDE）控制PTEN的穩定性。方向上，SIRT4透過IDE介導的降解位於PTEN蛋白豐度的上游。由於PTEN是關鍵的腫瘤抑制因子和PI3K/Akt訊號的負向調節因子，SIRT4依賴性的PTEN穩定性控制將粒線體sirtuin活性與壓力條件下的致癌訊號聯繫起來。

label: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Expression of SIRT4 is considerably downregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissues and in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Lower expression of SIRT4 promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma development. Directionally, loss of SIRT4 sits upstream of tumorigenic progression in these cancers, and its reduced expression is associated with poorer outcomes, supporting SIRT4 as a biomarker and tumor suppressor in HCC and esophageal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4的表達在肝細胞癌腫瘤組織和食道鱗狀細胞癌中顯著下調。SIRT4的較低表達促進食道鱗狀細胞癌和肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT4缺失位於這些癌症中腫瘤發生進展的上游，其降低的表達與較差的預後相關，支持SIRT4作為HCC和食道癌中的生物標誌物和腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Malonyl-CoA decarboxylase
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

label: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。

label: PDH (Pyruvate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 (as a lipoamidase) inhibits the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, modulating glucose-derived acetyl-CoA entry into the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4（作為硫辛酰胺酶）抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體，調節葡萄糖衍生的乙醯輔酶 A 進入 TCA 循環。

label: Tumour suppressor (glutamine metabolism)
description: SIRT4 acts as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting GDH and restricting glutamine-derived anaplerosis into the TCA cycle, starving cancer cells of carbon for proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine metabolism. This limits the glutamine addiction of tumors, which rely on glutamine for both energy and biosynthesis, and it is a context where SIRT4 opposes rather than promotes growth. By restraining glutamine utilization, SIRT4 reduces the metabolic support for rapid proliferation, and its loss in some cancers relieves this brake. SIRT4's tumor-suppressive role is thus tied to its regulation of mitochondrial metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 並限制穀氨醯胺衍生的回補作用進入 TCA 循環來發揮腫瘤抑制因子的作用，使癌細胞缺乏增殖所需的碳源。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制穀氨醯胺代謝的上游。這限制了腫瘤對穀氨醯胺的成癮性——腫瘤依賴穀氨醯胺同時提供能量和生物合成原料——在這個情境下 SIRT4 對抗而非促進生長。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用，SIRT4 減少了快速增殖的代謝支持，其在某些癌症中的缺失解除了此制動。SIRT4 的腫瘤抑制角色因此與其對粒線體代謝的調控相關。

label: AMPK retrograde signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) to mediate retrograde signalling. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cellular energy sensing and mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication. By modulating ATP levels and engaging AMPK-mediated retrograde signalling, SIRT4 helps the cell adapt its nuclear gene expression to mitochondrial metabolic status under conditions of energy stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4控制ATP恆定並使用AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）來介導逆行訊號。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞能量感知和粒線體到核通訊的上游。透過調節ATP水平並參與AMPK介導的逆行訊號，SIRT4幫助細胞在能量壓力條件下根據粒線體代謝狀態調整其核基因表達。

label: ATP homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMPK-mediated retrograde signaling to couple mitochondrial metabolic status to nuclear gene expression under energy stress, influencing cellular fuel choice and bioenergetic balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 控制 ATP 恆定，並利用 AMPK 介導的逆行信號將粒線體代謝狀態與能量壓力下的核基因表達耦合，影響細胞燃料選擇和生物能量平衡。

label: breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 enhances the tamoxifen sensitivity of breast cancer cells by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restored endocrine responsiveness in breast cancer. By suppressing STAT3 signaling, SIRT4 makes breast cancer cells more vulnerable to tamoxifen, in contrast to SIRT3 overexpression, which reduces tamoxifen sensitivity. This positions SIRT4 as a potential enhancer of anti-estrogen therapy efficacy in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制STAT3訊號通路增強乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於乳腺癌中內分泌反應性恢復的上游。透過抑制STAT3訊號，SIRT4使乳腺癌細胞更容易受到Tamoxifen的影響，與降低Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT3過表達形成對比。這將SIRT4定位為乳腺癌中抗雌激素療法效果的潛在增強因子。

label: SIRT1 (via glutamine metabolism)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 exerts tumor-suppressive activity in breast cancer by negatively regulating expression of SIRT1, and this suppression occurs through repression of glutamine metabolism. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced SIRT1 expression via metabolic regulation. This reveals cross-talk between mitochondrial and nuclear sirtuin proteins in cancer progression, where mitochondrial SIRT4 restrains nuclear SIRT1-dependent growth programs. By limiting glutamine utilization and, consequently, SIRT1 levels, SIRT4 curbs the metabolic and survival advantages that SIRT1 confers on tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝在乳腺癌中發揮腫瘤抑制活性，負向調節SIRT1的表達。方向上，SIRT4透過代謝調節位於SIRT1表達降低的上游。這揭示了粒線體和核sirtuin蛋白在癌症進展中的交互作用，其中粒線體SIRT4抑制核SIRT1依賴性的生長程序。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用以及隨之而來的SIRT1水平，SIRT4抑制了SIRT1賦予腫瘤細胞的代謝和存活優勢。

label: 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 increases the sensitivity of colorectal cancer cells to the chemotherapeutic drug 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest, which primes CRC cells for 5-fluorouracil-induced killing. By restraining proliferation, SIRT4 enhances the cytotoxic effect of the drug, suggesting that SIRT4 expression status could predict or improve responses to 5-fluorouracil-based therapy in colorectal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制細胞週期來增加大腸直腸癌細胞對化療藥物5-氟尿嘧啶的敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯的上游，使CRC細胞為5-氟尿嘧啶誘導的殺傷做好準備。透過抑制增殖，SIRT4增強了藥物的細胞毒作用，表明SIRT4表達狀態可能預測或改善大腸直腸癌中5-氟尿嘧啶基治療的反應。

label: NSCLC, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 is an effective tumour suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer cells, human colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restrained tumour growth across multiple cancer types, in part by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and modulating mitochondrial dynamics. Low SIRT4 expression thereby permits tumorigenic behaviour, and SIRT4 represents a prognostic and therapeutic target in these cancers.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在非小細胞肺癌細胞、人類大腸直腸癌、神經母細胞瘤和胃癌中是有效的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT4位於多種癌症類型中腫瘤生長抑制的上游，部分透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝和調節粒線體動力學。因此低SIRT4表達允許致瘤行為，SIRT4在這些癌症中代表了預後和治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class II (evolutionarily ancient)
description: SIRT4 is classified in phylogenetic Class II, which includes sirtuins from bacteria, insects, nematodes, mould, and protozoa—among the most ancient sirtuin lineages. Directionally, this is an evolutionary placement rather than a causal pathway. This antiquity implies conserved mitochondrial metabolic roles, and it situates SIRT4 early in sirtuin evolution. Because Class II sirtuins predate the divergence of major eukaryotic lineages, SIRT4's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function likely represents an ancestral enzymatic activity. Understanding SIRT4's phylogenetic position helps contextualize its metabolic-brake functions relative to the more derived deacetylases.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被分類為系統發育 II 類，包括來自細菌、昆蟲、線蟲、黴菌和原生動物的 sirtuin——是最古老的 sirtuin 譜系之一。在方向性上，這是演化定位而非因果途徑。這種古老性暗示保守的粒線體代謝角色，並將 SIRT4 置於 sirtuin 演化的早期。由於 II 類 sirtuin 先於主要真核生物譜系的分化，SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶活性。理解 SIRT4 的系統發育位置有助於將其代謝制動功能置於更衍生的去乙醯酶的背景中。

label: tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 is described as tumor suppressor (downregulated in cancers); it is a tumor suppressor downregulated in multiple cancers (Wu et al., 2022).
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被描述為腫瘤抑制因子（在癌症中下調）；它是在多種癌症中下調的腫瘤抑制因子（Wu et al., 2022）。

label: mitotic cell division regulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 plays a crucial role in mitotic cell division regulation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of proper cell cycle progression and mitotic fidelity. In addition to its roles in glutamine metabolism and tumor suppression, SIRT4 contributes to the orderly execution of mitosis, extending the functional repertoire of this mitochondrial sirtuin beyond metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在有絲分裂細胞分裂調節中發揮關鍵作用。方向上，SIRT4位於正常的細胞週期進展和有絲分裂保真度的上游。除了其在穀氨醯胺代謝和腫瘤抑制中的角色外，SIRT4還有助於有絲分裂的有序執行，將此粒線體sirtuin的功能譜擴展到代謝之外。

label: E-cadherin promotion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 suppresses epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by promoting expression of the epithelial marker E-cadherin in gastric cancer cells. This maintains an epithelial phenotype and inhibits cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of maintained epithelial phenotype and suppressed metastasis. By preventing the loss of E-cadherin that characterizes EMT, SIRT4 blocks a key step in the acquisition of invasive and migratory behavior. This supports SIRT4's role as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer, where its downregulation may allow tumors to progress toward metastatic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過促進上皮標記E-cadherin在胃癌細胞中的表達來抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT）。這維持了上皮表型並抑制癌細胞增殖、遷移和侵襲。方向上，SIRT4位於上皮表型維持和轉移抑制的上游。透過阻止EMT特徵性的E-cadherin喪失，SIRT4阻斷了獲得侵襲和遷移行為的關鍵步驟。這支持SIRT4作為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其下調可能使腫瘤向轉移性疾病進展。

label: MTPα (fatty acid oxidation)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake that conserves lipids when nutrients are abundant. The inhibition of MTPα and of PPARα signaling shifts metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward lipid storage. SIRT4's opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為在營養豐富時保存脂質的粒線體合成代謝制動器。對 MTPα 和 PPARα 訊號的抑制使代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向脂質儲存。SIRT4 對氧化代謝的對抗是拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: MTPα (mitochondrial trifunctional protein α)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake. By inhibiting MTPα, SIRT4 conserves fatty acids for storage when nutrients are abundant. This opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance that determines mitochondrial metabolic state.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為粒線體合成代謝制動器。透過抑制 MTPα，SIRT4 在營養豐富時保存脂肪酸以供儲存。這種對氧化代謝的對抗是決定粒線體代謝狀態的拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: p16 and p21
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 upregulates expression of the cell-cycle inhibitor genes p16 and p21, while suppressing CyclinB1/Cdc2 and Cdc25c, and this cell-cycle blockade induces apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction. By enforcing these checkpoints, SIRT4 functions as a tumor suppressor in liver cancer, limiting proliferation and promoting death of transformed cells. The coordinated upregulation of p16 and p21 with suppression of cell-cycle drivers reflects SIRT4's broad influence on the machinery that governs entry into mitosis. This supports interest in SIRT4 as a therapeutic target for hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4上調細胞週期抑制因子p16和p21的表達，同時抑制CyclinB1/Cdc2和Cdc25c，這種細胞週期阻斷誘導肝細胞癌細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯和凋亡誘導的上游。透過強制執行這些檢查點，SIRT4在肝癌中作為腫瘤抑制因子發揮作用，限制增殖並促進轉化細胞的死亡。p16和p21的協調上調與細胞週期驅動因子的抑制反映了SIRT4對控制有絲分裂進入機制的廣泛影響。這支持了SIRT4作為肝細胞癌治療靶點的興趣。

label: Butein, piceatannol and isoliquiritigenin
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Plant polyphenols notably butein, piceatannol, and isoliquiritigenin (ILQ) have been demonstrated to activate recombinant SIRT1, and are known as sirtuin activating compounds (STACs). Directionally, these natural polyphenols sit upstream of enhanced SIRT1 enzymatic activity. Together with resveratrol, these plant-derived compounds represent natural STACs, and synthetic STACs such as SRT1720 activate SIRT1 substantially more potently.
description_zh_TW: 植物多酚中較為突出的成分，包括紫檀芪（piceatannol）、丁香酚（butein）和異甘草素（ILQ），已被證實能夠活化重組 SIRT1，並被歸類為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs）。從作用方向而言，這些天然多酚位於增強 SIRT1 酶活性的上游。與白藜蘆醇一起，這些植物來源的化合物代表了天然 STACs，而合成 STACs 如 SRT1720 活化 SIRT1 的效力則顯著更強。

label: Ca2+ release (ER → cytoplasm)
description: Epac1 activation induces calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytoplasm, raising cytosolic Ca2+ that serves as a second messenger. Directionally, Epac1 sits upstream of cytoplasmic Ca2+ elevation. The Ca2+ surge then activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), bridging cAMP signaling to AMPK activation. This couples resveratrol's PDE4 inhibition to metabolic kinase activation, and it is the key branching point that converts a rise in cyclic AMP into a change in cellular energy sensing. Disrupting any step in this cascade attenuates resveratrol's indirect activation of SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: Epac1 活化誘導鈣離子從內質網釋放到細胞質中，提高作為第二信使的細胞質 Ca2+。在方向性上，Epac1 位於細胞質 Ca2+ 升高的上游。Ca2+ 激增然後活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），將 cAMP 信號橋接到 AMPK 活化。這將白藜蘆醇的 PDE4 抑制與代謝激酶活化偶聯起來，是將環磷酸腺苷升高轉化為細胞能量感知變化的關鍵分支點。破壞此級聯中的任何一步都會減弱白藜蘆醇的間接 SIRT1 活化。

label: Ca2+ surge (cytoplasmic)
description: The cytoplasmic calcium surge activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), which phosphorylates and activates AMPK, the central cellular energy sensor. Directionally, Ca2+ activates CaMKKβ, which in turn phosphorylates AMPK. Activated AMPK then induces NAMPT and raises NAD+, closing the loop on SIRT1 activation and promoting catabolic metabolism. This is a key branch point linking calcium flux to metabolic homeostasis, and it explains how agents that raise cytosolic calcium can indirectly boost sirtuin activity, complementing the direct actions of SIRT1 activators and integrating calcium signaling into energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣離子激增活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），後者磷酸化並活化 AMPK——細胞的中心能量感測器。在方向性上，Ca2+ 活化 CaMKKβ，CaMKKβ 再磷酸化 AMPK。活化的 AMPK 然後誘導 NAMPT 並升高 NAD+，完成 SIRT1 活化的迴路並促進分解代謝。這是將鈣離子通量與代謝穩態聯繫起來的關鍵分支點，解釋了提高細胞質鈣離子的試劑如何能間接增強 sirtuin 活性，與 SIRT1 活化因子的直接作用互補，並將鈣離子信號整合到能量代謝中。

label: Calcium Signaling
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) act as regulatory hubs for calcium signaling, lipid exchange, mitochondrial dynamics, and stress adaptation. Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis can produce either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+ (blunting ATP production) or pathological Ca2+ overload (sensitizing to permeability transition), both amplifying ROS and destabilizing membrane integrity. MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic and redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay, promoting chronic UPRER activation.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) 作為 calcium signaling、lipid exchange、mitochondrial dynamics 和 stress adaptation 的 regulatory hubs。Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis 可導致 either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+（blunting ATP production）或 pathological Ca2+ overload（sensitizing to permeability transition），兩者都 amplifying ROS 和 destabilizing membrane integrity。MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic 和 redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay，promoting chronic UPRER activation。

label: CamKIIα promoter
description: The CaMKIIalpha promoter is used in COMT-OE mouse models to drive transgenic COMT overexpression selectively in forebrain, cortical and hippocampal neurons, mimicking the brain-specific isoform distribution of endogenous COMT. This restricts the genetic manipulation to regions relevant to cognition while sparing the periphery and cerebellum, which retain normal COMT activity. The approach yields a clean model for studying prefrontal and striatal COMT effects on learning and impulse control. Cerebellar function remains intact and serves as an internal control.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE mouse models 中使用 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子選擇性地驅動轉基因 COMT 在前腦、皮質和海馬神經元中過度表達，模仿內源性 COMT 的 brain 特異性亞型分佈。這將基因操作限制在與認知相關的區域，同時保留了保留正常 COMT activity 的周邊和小腦。此方法產生了一個乾淨的模型，用於研究前額葉和紋狀體 COMT 對學習和衝動控制的影響。小腦功能保持完整併作為內部控制。

label: cAMP (elevated)
description: High intracellular cAMP activates Epac1 (Exchange Protein directly Activated by cAMP), a guanine-nucleotide-exchange factor that triggers downstream signaling independent of PKA. Directionally, cAMP sits upstream of Epac1 activation. Epac1 then stimulates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum, linking cAMP to Ca2+-dependent kinases and propagating a metabolic signal. This step is pivotal in resveratrol's indirect SIRT1-activation cascade, bridging the PDE4/cAMP arm to AMPK and NAD+ metabolism. The pathway illustrates how a polyphenol can activate sirtuins through classical second-messenger signaling rather than direct enzyme binding alone.
description_zh_TW: 高濃度的細胞內 cAMP 活化 Epac1（直接被 cAMP 活化的交換蛋白），這是一種鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子，觸發不依賴 PKA 的下游信號。在方向性上，cAMP 位於 Epac1 活化的上游。Epac1 然後刺激內質網的鈣離子釋放，將 cAMP 與 Ca2+ 依賴性激酶聯繫起來並傳播代謝信號。這一步是白藜蘆醇間接 SIRT1 活化級聯中的關鍵樞紐，將 PDE4/cAMP 臂橋接到 AMPK 和 NAD+ 代謝。此通路說明了一種多酚如何通過經典的第二信使信號而非僅靠直接酶結合來活化 sirtuin。

label: Capillary electrophoresis-based sirtuin assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Recently, non-peptide substrates for SIRT1 have been synthesized, and two capillary electrophoresis assays were developed and validated to monitor the deacetylation of these substrates and to screen sirtuin inhibitor activity, complementing earlier CE assays using N-terminally fluorescence-labeled peptides. Directionally, CE separates substrate and product by their charge/mass differences without relying on fluorophore-release effects. The non-peptide substrates broaden the assay chemistry available for studying SIRT1 and its modulators.
description_zh_TW: 最近已合成非胜肽類 SIRT1 受質，並開發和驗證了兩種毛細管電泳測定來監測這些受質的去乙醯化及篩選 sirtuin 抑制劑活性，補充了早期使用 N 端螢光標記胜肽的毛細管電泳測定。方向性上毛細管電泳透過電荷/質量差異分離受質和產物，不依賴螢光基團釋放效應。非胜肽受質擴展了研究 SIRT1 及其調節劑的可用測定化學方法。

label: Eltrombopag
description: Eltrombopag (EO), a small-molecule thrombopoietin receptor agonist, was identified as the first direct inhibitor of TFEB, disrupting TFEB-DNA interactions at CLEAR elements. By preventing TFEB from binding its target promoters, EO blocks transcriptional activation of the autophagy-lysosomal network. This tool compound has enabled dissection of TFEB-dependent versus independent autophagy and has therapeutic implications where TFEB hyperactivation is pathogenic. Its discovery established pharmacological feasibility of directly targeting the MiT/TFE family.
description_zh_TW: Eltrombopag（EO）是一種小分子 thrombopoietin 受體促效劑，被鑑定為第一個 TFEB 的直接抑制劑，破壞 TFEB 在 CLEAR 元件處的 TFEB-DNA 交互作用。透過阻止 TFEB 結合其標的啟動子，EO 阻斷自噬—溶酶體網絡的轉錄活化。此工具化合物使得剖析 TFEB 依賴與非依賴的自噬成為可能，並在 TFEB 過度活化為致病性的情況下具有治療意義。其發現確立了直接標靶 MiT/TFE 家族的藥理可行性。

label: Birt-Hogg-Dube syndrome
description: In Birt-Hogg-Dubé (BHD) syndrome, caused by Folliculin (FLCN) mutations, TFEB becomes hyperactivated and drives a renal cystic and tumor-prone phenotype. Loss of FLCN dysregulates mTOR and related signaling such that TFEB-mediated lysosomal and proliferative programs are inappropriately engaged in renal epithelial cells. This pathogenic role contrasts with TFEB's generally protective function in neurodegeneration and aging. The BHD example demonstrates that excessive or context-inappropriate TFEB activation can be deleterious.
description_zh_TW: 在由 Folliculin（FLCN）突變引起的 Birt-Hogg-Dubé（BHD）症候群中，TFEB 變得過度活化並驅動腎囊性和易長腫瘤的表型。FLCN 的缺失失調 mTOR 和相關信號，使得 TFEB 介導的溶酶體和增生程序在腎上皮細胞中不當地被啟動。此致病角色與 TFEB 在神經退化和老化中普遍保護性功能形成對比。BHD 例子證明了過度或背景不當的 TFEB 活化可能是有害的。

label: MALAT1 in renal carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
description_zh_TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。

label: Oxidation at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: Oxidation of TFEB at cysteine 212—for example by reactive oxygen species or oxidants—impairs mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at adjacent regulatory sites and thereby enhances TFEB activity. This redox-sensitive control links cellular oxidative status directly to activation of the lysosomal-autophagy program, functioning as a stress sensor. By relieving kinase repression under oxidative conditions, TFEB oxidation promotes clearance of damaged components that generate ROS. The C212 modification exemplifies how cysteine-based redox switches integrate stress signaling with degradative transcription.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的氧化——例如由活性氧物種或氧化劑引起——損害 mTORC1 介導的鄰近調節位點磷酸化，從而增強 TFEB 活性。這種對氧化還原敏感的控製將細胞氧化狀態直接連結到溶酶體—自噬程序的活化，作為一種壓力感測器。透過在氧化條件下解除激酶抑制，TFEB 氧化促進清除會產生 ROS 的受損組分。C212 修飾舉例說明了基於半胱胺酸的氧化還原方程序如何將壓力信號與降解轉錄整合。

label: PDCD4
description: Programmed cell death protein 4 (PDCD4) suppresses TFEB translation by binding eukaryotic initiation factor 4A (eIF4A) and inhibiting the RNA helicase activity required for ribosome scanning of the TFEB mRNA. This translational blockade limits TFEB protein synthesis independently of its transcriptional or degradative regulation. PDCD4 thereby acts as a brake on the autophagy-lysosomal program at the level of protein synthesis. Its own downregulation in cancer may contribute to the elevated TFEB activity observed in some malignancies.
description_zh_TW: 細胞程序性死亡蛋白 4（PDCD4）透過結合真核起始因子 4A（eIF4A）並抑制 TFEB mRNA 核糖體掃描所需的 RNA 解旋酶活性，抑制 TFEB 轉錄。此轉錄阻斷獨立於其轉錄或降解調節而限制 TFEB 蛋白合成。PDCD4 因此在蛋白質合成層次上充當自噬—溶酶體程序的制動。其在癌症中的自身下調可能促成某些惡性腫瘤中觀察到的 TFEB 活性升高。

label: S-sulfhydration at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: S-sulfhydration of TFEB at cysteine 212, catalyzed by the cystathionine gamma-lyase (CTH)-derived hydrogen sulfide (H2S) system, promotes its nuclear translocation and activation. This post-translational modification, distinct from oxidation, converts C212 into a persulfide that alters TFEB interactions and favors a transcriptionally active state. The regulation ties sulfur metabolism and H2S signaling to the autophagy-lysosomal network, with implications for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative protection. It represents a gasotransmitter-based mechanism controlling cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的 S-硫化（S-sulfhydration），由 cystathionine gamma-lyase（CTH）衍生的硫化氫（H2S）系統催化，促進其核轉運和活化。此轉譯後修飾不同於氧化，將 C212 轉化為過硫化物，改變 TFEB 交互作用並有利於轉錄活化狀態。此調節將硫代謝和 H2S 信號聯繫到自噬—溶酶體網絡，對心血管和神經退化保護具有意義。它代表了一種控制細胞清除的氣體傳遞分子（gasotransmitter）基礎機制。

label: PGC1-alpha
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB and the mitochondrial biogenesis coactivator PGC-1α form a positive feedback loop: PGC-1α modulates mitophagy by regulating TFEB expression, while TFEB induces PGC-1α transcription, reinforcing mitochondrial turnover and biogenesis. This reciprocal regulation couples lysosomal-autophagic clearance with mitochondrial network expansion under stress. The loop ensures coordinated enhancement of both degradative and biosynthetic mitochondrial programs. Its disruption impairs metabolic adaptation and is relevant to aging and myopathy.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 與粒線體生物發生共活化因子 PGC-1α 形成正向回饋環：PGC-1α 透過調節 TFEB 表現來調控粒線體自噬，而 TFEB 誘發 PGC-1α 轉錄，強化粒線體週轉與生物發生。此相互調節在壓力下將溶酶體—自噬性清除與粒線體網絡擴張耦合起來。此迴圈確保降解性和合成性粒線體程序的協調增強。其失調損害代謝適應，並與老化和肌病相關。

label: MiT/TFE family
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

label: CLEAR Element
description: TFEB binds to Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation (CLEAR) elements—a conserved 10-base-pair motif (GTCACGTGAC) present in the promoters of numerous lysosomal and autophagy genes. Through this binding, TFEB drives the coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the entire autophagy-lysosomal network. CLEAR-mediated regulation allows cells to mount a unified response that expands degradative capacity in tandem with autophagic initiation. The CLEAR network is the molecular basis for TFEB's role as a master regulator of cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 結合至協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）元件——存在於眾多溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的保守 10 個鹼基對基序（GTCACGTGAC）。透過此結合，TFEB 驅動整個自噬—溶酶體網絡的協調轉錄上調。CLEAR 介導的調節使細胞能夠啟動統一的反應，在自噬起始的同時擴展降解能力。CLEAR 網絡是 TFEB 作為細胞清除主調控因子角色的分子的基礎。

label: Autophagy-lysosomal pathway
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway, coordinating the expression of genes required for autophagosome formation, cargo recognition, lysosomal biogenesis, and substrate degradation. Its activation simultaneously boosts both the supply of autophagosomes and the degradative capacity of lysosomes, ensuring coherent flux rather than unbalanced initiation. TFEB thereby couples the two halves of autophagy—sequestration and degradation—into a single coordinated program. Dysregulation of this axis contributes to lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 是自噬—溶酶體途徑的主轉錄調控因子，協調自噬體形成、貨物辨識、溶酶體生物發生和受質降解所需基因的表現。其活化同時提升自噬體的供應和溶酶體的降解能力，確保協調的流而非不平衡的起始。TFEB 因此將自噬的兩半——隔離和降解——耦合為單一協調程序。此軸的失調促成溶酶體儲存障礙、神經退化和癌症。

label: Mitochondrial stress
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is activated in response to mitochondrial stress, a process requiring mitophagy machinery including PINK1, Parkin, Atg9A, and Atg5 to signal and enable TFEB nuclear translocation. As damaged mitochondria are selected for autophagic removal, TFEB coordinates a compensatory lysosomal and autophagic response that restores organelle quality. This coupling ensures that mitochondrial turnover is matched by degradative capacity. The axis links mitochondrial quality control to the broader autophagy-lysosomal network and to metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在回應粒線體壓力時被活化，此過程需要包括 PINK1、Parkin、Atg9A 和 Atg5 在內的粒線體自噬機械來傳遞信號並促成 TFEB 核轉位。當受損粒線體被選擇進行自噬移除時，TFEB 協調一個代償性的溶酶體和自噬反應，以恢復胞器品質。此耦合確保粒線體週轉由降解能力所匹配。該軸將粒線體品質控制連結到更廣泛的自噬—溶酶體網絡以及代謝恆定性。

label: Immune response
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB regulates innate and adaptive immune responses, becoming activated during dendritic cell maturation to enhance antigen processing and presentation via expanded lysosomal and MHC-related machinery. By boosting degradative capacity, TFEB improves the efficiency of antigen degradation and epitope loading, strengthening T cell priming. TFEB activity also influences macrophage polarization and immune cell metabolism. These roles position the autophagy-lysosomal master regulator as an important modulator of immunity.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 調節先天和適應性免疫反應，在樹突細胞成熟過程中被活化，透過擴增的溶酶體和 MHC 相關機械來增強抗原處理與呈現。透過提升降解能力，TFEB 改善了抗原降解和表位加載的效率，強化了 T 細胞啟動。TFEB 活性也影響巨噬細胞極化和免疫細胞代謝。這些角色將自噬—溶酶體主調節者定位為免疫的重要調節者。

label: Lipid catabolism
description: TFEB regulates lipid catabolism by upregulating genes involved in fatty acid import, beta-oxidation, lysosomal acid lipase (LAL)-mediated lipophagy, and the transcriptional coactivators PGC-1α and PPAR-α. Through these targets, TFEB coordinates the mobilization and oxidation of stored lipids during fasting and stress. This lipid-catabolic program complements TFEB's role in protein and organelle turnover, rendering it a comprehensive metabolic regulator. Enhanced TFEB activity improves lipid handling and protects against hepatic steatosis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過上調參與脂肪酸輸入、β 氧化、溶酶體酸性脂肪酶（LAL）介導的脂噬，以及轉錄共活化因子 PGC-1α 和 PPAR-α 的基因，來調節脂質分解代謝。透過這些標的，TFEB 在禁食和壓力期間協調儲存脂質的動員和氧化。此脂質分解代謝程序補充了 TFEB 在蛋白質和胞器週轉中的角色，使它成為全面的代謝調節者。增強的 TFEB 活性改善脂質處理並保護對抗肝臟脂肪變性。

label: K316
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB undergoes SUMOylation at lysine 316, a small ubiquitin-like modifier conjugation that attenuates its transcriptional activity. SUMOylation typically modulates protein-protein interactions and subnuclear compartmentalization, and at K316 it dampens TFEB-driven expression of lysosomal genes. This modification adds another layer to the post-translational code governing TFEB, acting in opposition to activatory marks such as deacetylation. The reversibility of SUMOylation by SENPs allows dynamic tuning of the degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 lysine 316 發生 SUMOylation，這是一種削弱其轉錄活性的小型泛素樣修飾物共軛。SUMOylation 通常調節蛋白質—蛋白質交互作用和亞核區室化，在 K316 處它抑制 TFEB 驅動的溶酶體基因表現。此修飾為控制 TFEB 的轉譯後密碼增添了另一層次，作用與去乙醯化等活化標記相反。SUMOylation 可被 SENPs 逆轉，允許對降解程序進行動態微調。

label: TNKS1
description: Tankyrase 1 (TNKS1) poly-ADP-ribosylates (PARsylates) TFEB, a modification that promotes its nuclear translocation and activation of target genes. PARsylation addsADP-ribose polymers that alter TFEB interactions and trafficking, providing a non-phosphorylation route to TFEB activation. This modification broadens the enzymatic toolkit—alongside kinases, phosphatases, acetylases, and ubiquitin ligases—that regulates the autophagy-lysosomal master switch. The TNKS1-TFEB relationship suggests potential crosstalk with Wnt/β-catenin and other PARsylation-dependent pathways.
description_zh_TW: Tankyrase 1（TNKS1）對 TFEB 進行聚 ADP-核糖基化（PARsylation），此修飾促進其核轉運和標的基因的活化。PARsylation 添加 ADP-核糖聚合物，改變 TFEB 交互作用和運輸，提供一條非磷酸化的 TFEB 活化路線。此修飾拓寬了調節自噬—溶酶體主開關的酵素工具箱——與激酶、磷酸酶、乙醯酶和泛素連接酶並列。TNKS1-TFEB 關係暗示了與 Wnt/β-catenin 和其他依賴 PARsylation 途徑的潛在串擾。

label: Celastrol
description: Celastrol activates TFEB via inhibiting mTORC1, reducing insoluble phosphorylated Tau aggregates and improving memory deficiency in Alzheimer's disease models.
description_zh_TW: Celastrol 透過抑制 mTORC1 活化 TFEB，減少不溶性磷酸化 Tau 聚集體，並改善阿茲海默症模型中的記憶缺陷。

label: Trehalose
description: Trehalose activates TFEB via inhibiting Akt, increasing clearance of proteolipid aggregates in Batten disease and reducing cardiac hypertrophy/fibrosis in chronic MI models.
description_zh_TW: Trehalose 透過抑制 Akt 活化 TFEB，增加 Batten 疾病中蛋白脂質聚集體的清除，並降低慢性 MI 模型中的心臟肥大／纖維化。

label: Rag GTPases
description: TFEB binds Rag GTPases as part of the amino acid-sensing machinery at the lysosomal surface, and this interaction is modulated by post-translational modification: oxidation of cysteine 212 inhibits TFEB's binding to Rag GTPases (PMID 31826695). The Rag GTPase complex is central to nutrient sensing, recruiting mTORC1 and its substrate machinery to the lysosome when amino acids are abundant, and TFEB's association with this complex links TFEB localization to nutrient availability. Oxidation at C212, by disrupting this binding, represents a redox-responsive mechanism that influences TFEB's cellular localization and activity, coupling oxidative stress to the regulation of the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
description_zh_TW: TFEB作為溶酶體表面氨基酸感應機制的一部分與Rag GTPases結合，並且這種相互作用受翻譯後修飾調節：半胱氨酸212的氧化抑製TFEB與Rag GTPases的結合（PMID 31826695）。Rag GTPase复合物是營養感應的核心，當氨基酸充足時將mTORC1及其底物機制招募到溶酶體，TFEB與該复合物的關聯將TFEB定位與營養可用性聯繫起來。C212處的氧化通過破壞這種結合，代表了一種氧化還原響應機制，影響TFEB的細胞定位和活性，將氧化應激與自噬-溶酶體途徑的調節聯繫起來。

label: Cytosol
description: TFEB is retained in the cytosol when it is phosphorylated at cytoplasmic-retention sites. Phosphorylation of S211 by mTORC1 or p38 MAPK, of S142 by mTORC1 or ERK2, of S122 by mTORC1, of S467 by Akt, and of S3 by MAP4K3 all promote cytoplasmic retention of TFEB, keeping the transcription factor away from its nuclear target genes. This phosphorylation-dependent cytosolic sequestration is the primary mechanism by which nutrient-rich and growth-factor-rich conditions suppress the lysosomal and autophagic transcriptional program. Dephosphorylation of these sites by calcineurin or PP2A relieves the retention and permits TFEB to translocate to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在胞質保留位點被磷酸化時被保留在細胞質中。mTORC1 或 p38 MAPK 對 S211 的磷酸化、mTORC1 或 ERK2 對 S142 的磷酸化、mTORC1 對 S122 的磷酸化、Akt 對 S467 的磷酸化，以及 MAP4K3 對 S3 的磷酸化，均促進 TFEB 的胞質保留，使轉錄因子遠離其核靶基因。這種依賴磷酸化的胞質隔離是營養豐富和生長因子豐富條件抑制溶酶體和自噬轉錄程序的主要機制。鈣調磷酸酶或 PP2A 對這些位點的去磷酸化解除保留，允許 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

label: calcineurin
description: Calcineurin dephosphorylates TFEB at S211 and S142, promoting nuclear translocation of the transcription factor (PMID 26043755). This dephosphorylation reverses the cytoplasmic-retention effect imposed by mTORC1 (S211) and ERK2/mTORC1 (S142) phosphorylation, allowing TFEB to enter the nucleus and activate lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes. Calcineurin is a calcium/calmodulin-dependent phosphatase, so this pathway couples calcium signaling to the TFEB-mediated cellular clearance program. It forms the dephosphorylation arm of TFEB regulation alongside PP2A, providing a calcium-sensitive route to activate the autophagy-lysosome pathway under stress conditions.
description_zh_TW: 鈣調磷酸酶在 S211 和 S142 上去磷酸化 TFEB，促進該轉錄因子的核轉位（PMID 26043755）。此去磷酸化逆轉 mTORC1（S211）和 ERK2/mTORC1（S142）磷酸化所施加的胞質保留效應，使 TFEB 能進入細胞核並啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因。鈣調磷酸酶是一種鈣/鈣調蛋白依賴性磷酸酶，因此此通路將鈣信號與 TFEB 介導的細胞清除程序耦合。它與 PP2A 共同構成 TFEB 調節的去磷酸化臂，在壓力條件下提供一條鈣敏感的通路來啟動自噬-溶酶體通路。

label: Autophagosome-lysosome fusion
description: TFEB is a master transcription factor for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy that plays a critical role in autophagosome-lysosome fusion and clearance of cargo. Directionally, TFEB sits upstream of autophagic-lysosomal execution. Because SIRT2 stabilizes TFEB mRNA and SIRT1 deacetylates TFEB to promote its nuclear translocation, sirtuins influence TFEB function through multiple mechanisms. This links sirtuins to the terminal degradative step of autophagy, and TFEB's transcriptional program, known as CLEAR, coordinates the lysosomal and autophagic machinery that clears damaged proteins and organelles during stress.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 是溶酶體生物合成和自噬的主控轉錄因子，在自噬溶酶體融合和清除負載物中扮演關鍵角色。在方向性上，TFEB 位於自噬溶酶體執行步驟的上游。由於 SIRT2 穩定 TFEB mRNA，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化 TFEB 以促進其核轉位，sirtuin 透過多種機制影響 TFEB 功能。這將 sirtuin 與自噬的終末降解步驟聯繫起來，而 TFEB 的轉錄程式——稱為 CLEAR——協調溶酶體和自噬機制，以在壓力期間清除受損蛋白質和細胞器。

label: TRPML1 expression
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB induces expression of TRPML1 (MCOLN1), its target gene encoding the lysosomal calcium release channel. The resulting lysosomal calcium release is required for TFEB-mediated lysosomal exocytosis and cellular clearance. In cells with loss-of-function TRPML1 mutations, TFEB fails to promote cellular clearance. This places TRPML1 as a key effector linking TFEB to lysosomal calcium signaling and exocytosis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 誘導 TRPML1（MCOLN1）的表現，這是編碼溶酶體鈣釋放通道的標的基因。由此產生的溶酶體鈣釋放是 TFEB 介導的溶酶體胞吐和細胞清除所必需。在 TRPML1 功能缺失突變的細胞中，TFEB 無法促進細胞清除。這使 TRPML1 成為將 TFEB 與溶酶體鈣訊號和胞吐連結的關鍵效應物。

label: Aneuploid cells
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB is activated in aneuploid cells as a cellular response to lysosomal stress following lysosomal accumulation of undegraded autophagic cargo. This activation occurs through an mTORC1-independent mechanism involving TFEB nuclear translocation and upregulation of its downstream targets. The response appears wired to stimulate autophagosomal rather than lysosomal biogenesis in these cells. It represents an adaptive mechanism by which aneuploid cells cope with proteotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在非整倍體細胞中被活化，作為對溶酶體累積未降解自噬貨物後之溶酶體壓力的細胞反應。此活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的機制發生，涉及 TFEB 核轉位及其下游標靶的上調。此反應似乎被設計為刺激這些細胞的自噬體而非溶酶體生物發生。它代表非整倍體細胞應對蛋白毒性的適應機制。

label: Osteoclast function
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB is required for osteoclast function in vivo, as its depletion results in decreased expression of lysosomal genes, reduced lysosome number, and defective bone matrix resorption. RANK treatment promotes TFEB phosphorylation via PKCbeta kinase, leading to TFEB nuclear translocation and induction of lysosomal biogenesis. Nuclear TFEB facilitates secretion of lysosomal hydrolases at the site of bone resorption. This establishes TFEB as essential for skeletal homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在活體中為破骨細胞功能所必需，因為其缺失導致溶酶體基因表現下降、溶酶體數量減少和骨基質吸收缺陷。RANK 處理經由 PKCbeta 激酶促進 TFEB 磷酸化，導致 TFEB 核轉位和溶酶體生物發生誘導。核 TFEB 促進溶酶體水解酶在骨吸收部位分泌。這確立了 TFEB 對骨骼恆定性的必要性。

label: Lysosomal exocytosis
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB induces lysosomal exocytosis by increasing the number of lysosomes ready to dock and fuse with the plasma membrane and by eliciting intracellular calcium release through activation of its target gene TRPML1 (MCOLN1). This process promotes cellular clearance in several lysosomal storage disease cell models, including Sanfilippo syndrome, multiple sulfatase deficiency, and Batten disease. TFEB-mediated lysosomal exocytosis plays important roles in bone remodeling and copper homeostasis. Overexpression of TFEB or TFE3 is sufficient to induce lysosome fusion with the plasma membrane.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過增加準備停靠並與質膜融合的溶酶體數量，並經由活化其標的基因 TRPML1（MCOLN1）誘發細胞內鈣釋放，來誘導溶酶體胞吐。此過程在數種溶酶體儲存疾病細胞模型中促進細胞清除，包括 Sanfilippo 症候群、多重硫酸酯酶缺乏症和 Batten 病。TFEB 介導的溶酶體胞吐在骨重塑和銅恆定性中發揮重要作用。TFEB 或 TFE3 的過度表現足以誘導溶酶體與質膜融合。

label: Cardiovascular Events
description: IL-1beta inhibition with canakinumab reduces cardiovascular events, as the CANTOS trial showed fewer recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death independent of lipid lowering. This validated inflammation (not just LDL) as a treatment target. The directionality is IL-1beta blockade to lower CVD events. A caveat is that the trial also showed increased infection risk and that not all patients benefited, indicating a selected responder population. The results of CANTOS established the inflammatory hypothesis of atherosclerosis and opened the door to targeted immunomodulation for CVD.
description_zh_TW: 卡那奴單抗抑制 IL-1beta 會降低 cardiovascular events，因為 CANTOS 試驗顯示，與降血脂無關的複發性心肌梗塞、中風和心血管死亡較少。這驗證了發炎（不僅僅是低密度脂蛋白）作為治療目標。方向性是IL-1beta封鎖以降低CVD事件。需要注意的是，該試驗還顯示感染風險增加，並且並非所有患者都受益，這表明特定的反應族群。 CANTOS的結果建立了atherosclerosis的發炎假說，為CVD的標靶免疫調節打開了大門。

label: Cardiovascular Risk
description: The L-arginine to ADMA ratio is a biomarker of cardiovascular risk because it reflects the balance between NOS substrate and the endogenous inhibitor ADMA. A low ratio predicts impaired NO bioavailability and endothelial dysfunction. The directionality is substrate-inhibitor balance to vascular risk. A caveat is that the ratio is one of several endothelial markers and is influenced by renal function and inflammation, which regulate ADMA clearance. The ratio has been proposed as a clinically accessible biomarker for monitoring NO-related vascular health in at-risk populations.
description_zh_TW: L-arginine 與 ADMA 的比率是 cardiovascular risk 的生物標記物，因為它反映了 NOS 底物和內源性抑制劑 ADMA 之間的平衡。低比率預示著 NO 生物利用度和 endothelial dysfunction 受損。方向性是血管風險的底物-抑制劑平衡。需要注意的是，該比率是幾種內皮標記物之一，並受到腎功能和發炎的影響，從而調節 ADMA 清除率。該比率已被提議作為臨床上可用的生物標記物，用於監測高風險族群中與一氧化氮相關的血管健康。

label: CD38 inhibitors (apigenin, quercetin)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: CD38 consumes NAD+; inhibiting it (apigenin, quercetin) boosts NAD+ availability, the obligate co-substrate for all sirtuins (and thus for SIRT1-SIRT7 activity).
description_zh_TW: CD38 消耗 NAD+；抑制它（芹菜素、槲皮素）可增強 NAD+ 的可用性，NAD+ 是所有 sirtuins 的必需共底物（因此影響 SIRT1-SIRT7 的活性）。

label: CeTOR
description: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
description_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

label: Charcoal Binding Assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The charcoal binding assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying 3H-labeled OAADPr released as free acetate: incubation of recombinant sirtuins with a 3H-acetylated peptide and NAD+ produces 3H-OAADPr, which binds activated charcoal, but the 3H-acetate hydrolyzed from OAADPr remains in the supernatant and is counted. This method was used to screen nicotinamide analogs and NAD+ metabolites as inhibitors of SIRT2. Directionally, the assay traces sirtuin catalytic flux through its unique OAADPr by-product rather than through fluorophore release, giving an artifact-free alternative to fluorescent assays.
description_zh_TW: 活性炭結合測定透過量化釋放為游離乙酸的 3H 標記 OAADPr 來測量 sirtuin 活性：將重組 sirtuin 與 3H-乙醯化胜肽和 NAD+ 孵育產生 3H-OAADPr，其與活化活性炭結合，而從 OAADPr 水解的 3H-乙酸留在上清液中並被計數。此方法被用於篩選尼可醯胺類似物和 NAD+ 代謝物作為 SIRT2 的抑制劑。方向性上該測定透過其獨特的 OAADPr 副產物而非螢光基團釋放來追溯 sirtuin 催化通量，提供了無假象的螢光測定替代方案。

label: Chromatin modifiers (SIRT1, SIRT6, HDAC1, PARP1)
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: Chromatin modifiers including sirtuins like SIRT1 and SIRT6, as well as HDAC1 and PARP1, normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain proper gene expression patterns that define cell identity. When DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks, occurs, these proteins are recruited to damage sites to assist in repair. This temporarily disrupts their original positions, altering local gene expression, and repeated relocalization over a lifetime contributes to the progressive loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: 包括 SIRT1 和 SIRT6 等 sirtuins 在內的染色質修飾因子，以及 HDAC1 和 PARP1，通常位於特定的基因組位點以維持定義細胞身分的正確基因表達模式。當 DNA 損傷（特別是雙股斷裂）發生時，這些蛋白質被招募到損傷位點以協助修復。這暫時破壞了它們的原始位置，改變局部基因表達，而在一生中反覆的再定位則導致表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失。

label: cisplatin nephrotoxicity
description: Silybin is the principal flavonolignan of milk thistle. It attenuates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity by preserving renal tubular integrity and mitochondrial bioenergetics, likely via SIRT3-mediated mechanisms, placing it among natural compounds engaging the mitochondrial deacetylase axis in kidney injury.
description_zh_TW: Silybin 是水飛薊的主要黃酮木脂素。它透過維護腎小管完整性和粒線體生物能學，可能透過 SIRT3 介導的機制，減輕 Cisplatin 誘導的腎毒性，將其定位為在腎損傷中參與粒線體去乙醯酶軸線的天然化合物之一。

label: cisplatin sensitivity in NSCLC
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT2 in non-small-cell lung cancer cells increases their sensitivity to cisplatin treatment, while the opposite modulation reduces responsiveness. Directionally, SIRT2 levels sit upstream of platinum chemosensitivity in NSCLC. Higher SIRT2 expression renders tumor cells more vulnerable to cisplatin-induced killing, suggesting that SIRT2 activity could be exploited to improve the efficacy of platinum-based therapy in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: 非小細胞肺癌細胞中SIRT2的上調增加了它們對順鉑治療的敏感性，而相反的調節則降低反應性。方向上，SIRT2水平位於NSCLC鉑化療敏感性的上游。較高的SIRT2表達使腫瘤細胞更容易受到順鉑誘導的殺傷，表明SIRT2活性可以被利用來提高肺癌中鉑基治療的效果。

label: cisplatin sensitivity via autophagy suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Silencing of SIRT1 enhances the cisplatin sensitivity of H1299/cisplatin non-small-cell lung cancer cells by suppressing autophagy. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of reduced autophagic survival signaling and increased susceptibility to cisplatin. Because autophagy can protect cancer cells from chemotherapy-induced damage, its suppression re-sensitizes resistant NSCLC cells to cisplatin. This identifies SIRT1 inhibition as a potential strategy to overcome platinum resistance in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: 沉默SIRT1透過抑制自噬來增強H1299/順鉑非小細胞肺癌細胞的順鉑敏感性。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於自噬性存活訊號減少和順鉑敏感性增加的上游。由於自噬可以保護癌細胞免受化療誘導的損傷，其抑制使耐藥NSCLC細胞對順鉑重新敏感。這將SIRT1抑制確定為克服肺癌鉑耐藥的潛在策略。

label: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis
community_name: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5-mediated desuccinylation of succinate dehydrogenase A (SDHA) promotes clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis. Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SDHA sits upstream of increased growth of clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumours. By activating SDHA and thereby modulating the TCA cycle, SIRT5 supports the metabolic reprogramming that drives this kidney cancer, identifying SIRT5 as a potential target in ccRCC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5介導的琥珀酸脫氫酶A（SDHA）去琥珀醯化促進透明細胞腎細胞癌的腫瘤發生。方向上，SIRT5對SDHA的去琥珀醯化位於透明細胞腎細胞癌腫瘤生長增加的上游。透過活化SDHA從而調節TCA循環，SIRT5支持驅動此腎癌的代謝重編程，將SIRT5確定為ccRCC中的潛在靶點。

label: -CH3
description: A methyl group is a covalent substituent consisting of one carbon atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms (-CH3), the smallest alkyl group and the universal currency of biological methylation. It is transferred by methyltransferases such as COMT from donors like SAMe to acceptors including DNA, proteins, phospholipids, and catechol rings. Methyl group flux is central to epigenetic regulation, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. Its availability is governed by the folate and methionine cycles, linking diet to methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: 甲基是一種共價取代基，由一個碳原子與三個氫原子鍵結 (-CH3) 組成，是最小的烷基，也是生物甲基化的通用貨幣。它透過甲基轉移酶（例如 COMT）從 SAMe 等供體轉移到包括 DNA、蛋白質、磷脂質和兒茶酚環在內的受體。甲基通量對於表觀遺傳調節、神經傳導物質失活和解毒至關重要。其可用性受 folate 和蛋氨酸循環控制，將飲食與甲基化能力聯繫起來。

label: alternative to methylfolate
description: Folinic acid is an alternative to methylfolate, particularly for slow COMT individuals, because it delivers folate cofactors without directly adding the methyl burden that methylfolate contributes to the methylation cycle. It supports nucleotide synthesis and, indirectly, methylation without acutely raising SAMe as aggressively as methyl donors do. This makes it a gentler option in methyl-sensitive genotypes, where methylfolate can provoke irritability or anxiety. It provides a route to one-carbon support that is better tolerated in this population.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 是 alternative to methylfolate，特別是對於慢速 COMT 個體，因為它提供 folate 輔因子，而不直接添加甲基葉酸對 methylation cycle 貢獻的甲基負擔。它支持核苷酸合成，並間接支持甲基化，而不會像甲基供體那樣急劇升高 SAMe。這使得它成為甲基敏感基因型的更溫和的選擇，因為甲基葉酸會引起煩躁或焦慮。它提供了一種在該人群中更容易耐受的單碳支持途徑。

label: folate
description: MTHFD1 metabolizes folate as a trifunctional enzyme catalyzing NADP-dependent methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase, cyclohydrolase, and formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase reactions in the cytosolic folate cycle. These steps produce 10-formyl-THF used in purine synthesis and contribute to the one-carbon pool that supports methylation. Disruption of MTHFD1 perturbs nucleotide synthesis and the methyl donor supply downstream of folate, indirectly affecting COMT by limiting SAMe availability. It is a central node in cytosolic one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 將 folate 代謝為三功能酶，催化細胞質 folate 循環中的 NADP 依賴性亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫酶、環化水解酶和甲醯四氫葉酸合成酶反應。這些步驟產生用於嘌呤合成的 10-甲醯基-THF，並有助於形成支持甲基化的一碳庫。 MTHFD1 的破壞會擾亂核苷酸合成和 folate 下游的 methyl donor 供應，透過限制 SAMe 的可用性來間接影響 COMT。它是細胞質一碳代謝的中心節點。

label: serotonin to melatonin
description: Methylation converts the neurotransmitter serotonin into the hormone melatonin via N-acetyltransferase- and methyltransferase (ASMT/HIOMT)-catalyzed steps in the pineal gland, with the methyl group donated by SAMe. This reaction is the final biosynthetic step producing melatonin, which regulates circadian rhythm and sleep. The process exemplifies SAMe-dependent methylation outside the catechol system and links methyl donor status to sleep-wake physiology. It highlights the broad metabolic reach of the methylation cycle.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過松果體中的 N-乙醯轉移酶和甲基轉移酶 (ASMT/HIOMT) 催化步驟將神經傳導物質血清素轉化為褪黑激素，甲基基團由 SAMe 提供。此反應是產生褪黑激素的最後生物合成步驟，褪黑激素調節晝夜節律和睡眠。此過程例證了兒茶酚系統外 SAMe 依賴性甲基化，並將 methyl donor 狀態與睡眠-覺醒生理學連結起來。它凸顯了 methylation cycle 廣泛的代謝範圍。

label: Catechols via COMT
description: Methylation neutralizes catechols via COMT by transferring a methyl group from SAMe to the catechol hydroxyls, converting reactive catecholamines and xenobiotics into stable, less active O-methylated metabolites for excretion. This detoxification limits oxidative catechol quinone formation and protects tissues from catechol-derived damage. COMT is thus the central catalyst of this neutralizing methylation, and its activity determines the efficiency of catechol clearance. The reaction consumes one SAMe per catechol, linking detoxification to methyl budget.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 透過 COMT 中和兒茶酚，將甲基從 SAMe 轉移到兒茶酚羥基，將反應性 catecholamines 和異生物質轉化為穩定的、活性較低的 O-甲基化代謝物進行排泄。這種解毒作用限制了氧化兒茶酚醌的形成，並保護組織免受兒茶酚衍生的傷害。因此，COMT 是這種中和甲基化的中心催化劑，其活性決定了兒茶酚清除的效率。該反應每種兒茶酚消耗一個 SAMe，將解毒與甲基預算聯繫起來。

label: mood side effects in slow COMT
description: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) can cause mood side effects, such as anxiety, irritability, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it is a direct methyl donor that adds to an already slowly processed methyl burden. The excess methyl groups can shift neurotransmitter and epigenetic methylation beyond the optimal range, producing emotional dysregulation. Slower COMT individuals are therefore often advised to use non-methylated B12 forms such as hydroxocobalamin or adenosylcobalamin. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin (MethylB12) 可能會在緩慢的 COMT 個體中引起情緒副作用，例如焦慮、易怒或過度刺激，因為它是直接的 methyl donor，會增加已經緩慢處理的甲基負擔。過量的 methyl groups 可以使神經傳導物質和表觀遺傳甲基化超出最佳範圍，從而產生情緒失調。因此，速度較慢的 COMT 個體通常被建議使用非甲基化 B12 形式，例如羥鈷胺或腺苷鈷胺。其作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: active B12 form
description: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

label: active folate form
description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

label: anxiety in slow COMT
description: Methylfolate can cause anxiety in slow COMT individuals for the same reason it can cause irritability: it raises methyl donor availability that slow COMT genotypes clear and utilize less efficiently, potentially over-methylating mood-relevant pathways. The effect is dose-dependent and genotype-specific, and may be compounded when combined with other methyl donors such as methylB12 or TMG. Clinicians often titrate methylfolate cautiously or choose non-methylated alternatives such as folinic acid in this group. Monitoring mood symptoms during supplementation is advised.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 可能會導致 anxiety in slow COMT 個體，原因與它可能導致煩躁的原因相同：它提高了 methyl donor 的可用性，從而減緩了 COMT 基因型的清除並降低了效率，可能導致情緒相關通路過度甲基化。此作用具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性，並且與其他甲基供體（例如甲基B12 或TMG）聯合使用時可能會加劇。臨床醫生經常謹慎滴定甲基葉酸或選擇非甲基化替代品，例如該組中的亞葉酸。建議在補充期間監測情緒症狀。

label: methylation cycle component
description: Methylfolate is a critical component of the methylation cycle, providing the methyl group that methionine synthase transfers to homocysteine to form methionine, the precursor of SAMe. Its availability therefore gates the entire downstream methyl donor supply, including that consumed by COMT for catechol O-methylation. Deficiencies or polymorphisms affecting methylfolate generation constrain COMT activity and can elevate homocysteine. It is the primary folate species linking dietary intake to methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate 是 methylation cycle 的關鍵組件，提供甲基，蛋氨酸合成酶將甲基轉移至高半胱氨酸，形成蛋氨酸（SAMe 的前體）。因此，它的可用性控制了整個下游 methyl donor 的供應，包括 COMT 用於兒茶酚 O-甲基化的消耗。影響甲基葉酸生成的缺陷或多態性會限制 COMT activity 並可能升高同型半胱氨酸。它是將飲食攝取量與甲基化能力聯繫起來的主要 folate 物種。

label: Methylfolate production
description: By channeling one-carbon units toward 5-methyl-THF via MTHFR, MTHFD1 indirectly supports the methylation cycle and methylfolate production. Because methylfolate feeds SAMe production for COMT, MTHFD1 activity influences the availability of methyl donors consumed by COMT. Inefficient MTHFD1 therefore potentially compounds slow-COMT phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: 透過將一碳單元經 MTHFR 導向 5-甲基-THF，MTHFD1 間接支援 methylation cycle 和 methylfolate 產生。由於 methylfolate 供應 COMT 所消耗的 SAMe 產生，MTHFD1 活性影響 COMT 消耗的 methyl donor 可用性。因此低效的 MTHFD1 可能加重緩慢-COMT 表型。

label: leucovorin
description: Folinic acid is also known as leucovorin, a chemically reduced and stable folate derivative that differs fundamentally from folic acid. It does not require the dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) step needed by folic acid. It is clinically established as an antidote to folic-acid antagonist toxicity such as from methotrexate.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 也稱為 leucovorin，是一種化學還原且穩定的葉酸衍生物，與葉酸有根本上的不同。它不需要葉酸所需的二氫葉酸還原酶（DHFR）步驟。它在臨床上確立為葉酸拮抗劑（如 methotrexate）毒性的解毒劑。

label: abrupt methyl load in slow COMT
description: For slow COMT individuals, high-dose methylfolate can sharply increase methyl-group availability, precipitating anxiety, irritability, or insomnia. Folinic acid avoids this abrupt methyl load by letting the body titrate methyl donation. It is therefore often preferred as a gentler alternative for supporting methylation capacity.
description_zh_TW: 對於緩慢的 COMT 個體，高劑量的 methylfolate 會急劇增加甲基群可用性，引發焦慮、煩躁或失眠。Folinic acid 透過讓人體調整甲基供給來避免這種突然的甲基負荷。因此它常被視為支持甲基化能力的較溫和替代方案而受到偏好。

label: 10-formyl-THF
description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

label: purine synthesis
description: MTHFD1 produces 10-formyl-THF, which supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation, and the methylene form feeds thymidylate synthase for DNA replication. Thus MTHFD1 links nucleotide biosynthesis with the methyl-donor economy. This dual role makes it important for cell proliferation and DNA synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 產生 10-formyl-THF，後者為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳，而亞甲基形式則為 DNA 複製提供胸苷酸合成酶。因此 MTHFD1 將核苷酸生物合成與甲基供體經濟連結起來。這種雙重角色使其對細胞增殖和 DNA 合成很重要。

label: cofactor for Methionine Synthase
description: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) functions as the prosthetic group of methionine synthase (MTR), which remethylates homocysteine to methionine using the methyl group supplied by methylfolate. The cobalt-carbon bond is labile, enabling direct transfer of the methyl group to homocysteine. This reaction simultaneously regenerates tetrahydrofolate for nucleotide synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲鈷胺）充當 methionine synthase (MTR) 的輔助基團，後者使用 methylfolate 提供的甲基將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸。鈷-碳鍵不穩定，能直接將甲基轉移至同型半胱氨酸。此反應同時再生四氫葉酸以供核苷酸合成。

label: methyl groups to Homocysteine
description: Methylfolate (5-methyl-THF) donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, using MethylB12 as cofactor, producing methionine and regenerating tetrahydrofolate. Methionine is then converted to SAMe, the universal methyl donor for COMT. Thus methylfolate sits upstream of the methyl-group pool that COMT consumes to inactivate catecholamines.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基-THF）透過 methionine synthase 將其甲基捐贈給同型半胱氨酸，使用 MethylB12 作為輔因子，產生蛋氨酸並再生四氫葉酸。蛋氨酸隨後轉化為 SAMe，即 COMT 的通用 methyl donor。因此 methylfolate 位於 COMT 滅活兒茶酚胺所消耗的甲基群池上游。

label: cleaved SIRT1
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
description_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。

label: CobB
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。

label: Cochlea
description: The cochlea is the auditory organ where cumulative oxidative damage drives age-related hearing loss. Caloric restriction reduces oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, making SIRT3 indispensable for CR-induced auditory resilience and a candidate therapeutic target in AHL.
description_zh_TW: 耳蝸是聽覺器官，累積的氧化損傷驅動年齡相關性聽力損失。熱量限制減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷，但此保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除，使 SIRT3 成為 CR 誘導聽覺韌性不可或缺的因子和 AHL 的候選治療靶標。

label: SIRT3 under caloric restriction
description: The cochlea is the auditory organ where cumulative oxidative damage drives age-related hearing loss. Caloric restriction reduces oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, making SIRT3 indispensable for CR-induced auditory resilience and a candidate therapeutic target in AHL.

label: COMT activity in humans
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: EGCG supplementation at doses up to 750 mg does not impair COMT activity in humans in controlled studies, indicating that realistic supplemental levels do not meaningfully inhibit the enzyme. This reassures that moderate EGCG intake is safe with respect to catecholamine metabolism and COMT function. Higher experimental doses, however, can inhibit COMT, so the conclusion is dose-dependent. Slow COMT individuals in particular benefit from knowing that typical EGCG supplements are unlikely to perturb catechol clearance.
description_zh_TW: 在對照研究中，EGCG supplementation 劑量高達 750 mg 時不會損害 COMT activity in humans，這表明實際的補充水平不會有意義地抑制該酶。這確保了適量的 EGCG 攝取對於兒茶酚胺代謝和 COMT 功能是安全的。然而，較高的實驗劑量可以抑制 COMT，因此結論是劑量依賴性的。慢速 COMT 個體特別受益於了解典型的 EGCG 補充劑不太可能幹擾兒茶酚清除。

label: COMT in humans
description: Dietary green tea does not significantly inhibit COMT in humans at normal consumption levels, because the catechins, notably EGCG, are present at concentrations and durations insufficient to meaningfully block the enzyme in vivo. Human studies indicate that typical green tea intake does not impair COMT activity or catechol metabolism, reassuring regular consumers. This contrasts with high-dose supplemental catechols, which can inhibit COMT and perturb catecholamine clearance. The conclusion is dose-dependent and relevant to slow COMT individuals considering concentrated extracts.
description_zh_TW: Dietary green tea 在正常消耗水準下不會顯著抑制 COMT in humans，因為兒茶素（尤其是 EGCG）的濃度和持續時間不足以在體內有意義地阻斷該酵素。人體研究表明，典型的綠茶攝取量不會損害 COMT activity 或兒茶酚代謝，這讓普通消費者放心。這與高劑量補充兒茶酚形成對比，後者可以抑制 COMT 並擾亂兒茶酚胺清除率。結論是劑量依賴性的，並且與考慮濃縮萃取物的緩慢 COMT 個體相關。

label: COVID-19 clinical outcome
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Serum SIRT3 levels are markedly lower in severe COVID-19 patients compared with those with mild or moderate disease, indicating a positive role of SIRT3 in alleviating COVID-19. Directionally, SIRT3 levels sit upstream of clinical outcome and prognosis. Because SIRT3 supports mitochondrial antioxidant defense and dampens inflammation, its reduction in severe cases may permit greater oxidative stress and inflammatory damage. SIRT3 levels therefore serve as an indicator of disease severity and associate with prognosis.
description_zh_TW: 與輕度或中度疾病患者相比，重症COVID-19患者的血清SIRT3水平顯著較低，表明SIRT3在緩解COVID-19中具有正面作用。方向上，SIRT3水平位於臨床結局和預後的上游。因為SIRT3支持粒線體抗氧化防禦並抑制發炎，其在重症中的降低可能允許更大的氧化壓力和發炎損傷。因此SIRT3水平作為疾病嚴重程度的指標，並與預後相關。

label: SIRT3 levels
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Serum SIRT3 levels are markedly lower in severe COVID-19 patients compared with those with mild or moderate disease, indicating a positive role of SIRT3 in alleviating COVID-19. Directionally, SIRT3 levels sit upstream of clinical outcome and prognosis. Because SIRT3 supports mitochondrial antioxidant defense and dampens inflammation, its reduction in severe cases may permit greater oxidative stress and inflammatory damage. SIRT3 levels therefore serve as an indicator of disease severity and associate with prognosis.

label: COVID-19 lymphocyte homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: The unbalanced p53/SIRT1 axis may impact lymphocyte homeostasis in COVID-19 patients. COVID-19 is characterized by increased p53 transcription in circulating lymphocytes and a persistently activated form of p53, possibly due to low SIRT1 levels. Directionally, low SIRT1 and elevated p53 activity sit upstream of disturbed lymphocyte homeostasis. Because SIRT1 normally deacetylates p53 and restrains its pro-apoptotic activity, its deficiency could leave lymphocytes vulnerable to p53-driven apoptosis and contribute to the lymphopenia seen in severe disease. Increased SIRT1 expression might therefore help alleviate COVID-19 pathogenesis by restoring the balance of this axis.
description_zh_TW: 失衡的p53/SIRT1軸可能影響COVID-19患者的淋巴細胞恆定。COVID-19的特徵是循環淋巴細胞中p53轉錄增加和p53持續活化形式，可能源於低SIRT1水平。方向上，低SIRT1和升高的p53活性位於淋巴細胞恆定受擾的上游。因為SIRT1通常去乙醯化p53並抑制其促凋亡活性，其缺乏可能使淋巴細胞容易受到p53驅動的凋亡，並促成重症中可見的淋巴細胞減少症。因此增加SIRT1表達可能透過恢復此軸的平衡來幫助緩解COVID-19的發病機制。

label: CRC radioresistance via β-catenin
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: FoxQ1-mediated SIRT1 upregulation augments the expression and nuclear translocation of β-catenin and benefits CRC-related intestinal pathological bacteria, thereby enhancing the radioresistance of colorectal cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 upregulation sits upstream of β-catenin-driven survival and radiation resistance in CRC. By promoting β-catenin signaling, SIRT1 helps colorectal cancer cells survive ionizing radiation, which has implications for combining SIRT1 inhibition with radiotherapy to improve treatment outcomes.
description_zh_TW: FoxQ1介導的SIRT1上調增強了β-catenin的表達和核轉位，並有利於CRC相關的腸道致病菌，從而增強大腸直腸癌細胞的放射抗性。方向上，SIRT1上調位於CRC中β-catenin驅動的存活和輻射抗性的上游。透過促進β-catenin訊號，SIRT1幫助大腸直腸癌細胞在電離輻射中存活，這對於將SIRT1抑制與放療結合以改善治療結果具有意義。

source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

label: DAF-16 (FOXO)
description: The lifespan extension produced by sir-2.1 overexpression in C. elegans is strictly dependent on the forkhead transcription factor DAF-16, the worm FOXO ortholog. DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression. Mechanistically, sir-2.1 deacetylates and cooperates with DAF-16 to drive the longevity transcriptional program. Thus the directionality is sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → lifespan, and removing DAF-16 abolishes the benefit.
description_zh_TW: sir-2.1 過量表達在 C. elegans 中產生的壽命延長嚴格依賴於叉頭轉錄因子 DAF-16，即線蟲的 FOXO 直系同源物。DAF-16 是下游效應因子，一旦 sir-2.1 將其從抑制中釋放，它便誘導壓力抗性和外源物質解毒基因。在機制上，sir-2.1 去乙醯化並與 DAF-16 協同驅動長壽轉錄程序。因此方向性為 sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → 壽命，去除 DAF-16 則消除此益處。

label: sir-2.1 lifespan extension

DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression.
