label: DAF-2
description: DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor ortholog, partially regulates MXL-3 expression such that impaired insulin signaling leads to modest repression of mxl-3 transcription. This places MXL-3 downstream of the insulin-signaling axis that broadly controls metabolism and longevity in worms. The partial effect indicates that additional nutrient and developmental inputs also govern mxl-3, consistent with its role as a multifactorial repressor. The linkage reinforces the canonical insulin→autophagy/lipid regulatory cascade.
description_zh_TW: DAF-2 是線蟲的胰島素/IGF-1 受體同源物，部分調節 MXL-3 表現，使得胰島素信號受損會導致 mxl-3 轉錄的適度抑制。這將 MXL-3 置於廣泛控制線蟲代謝和長壽的胰島素信號軸下游。此部分效應表明額外的營養和發育輸入也控制 mxl-3，與其作為多因子抑制因子的角色一致。此連結強化了典型的胰島素→自噬/脂質調節級聯。

label: MXL-3 expression
description: DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor ortholog, partially regulates MXL-3 expression such that impaired insulin signaling leads to modest repression of mxl-3 transcription. This places MXL-3 downstream of the insulin-signaling axis that broadly controls metabolism and longevity in worms. The partial effect indicates that additional nutrient and developmental inputs also govern mxl-3, consistent with its role as a multifactorial repressor. label: TFEB at S401
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: In contrast to its S211 effect, p38 MAPK phosphorylates TFEB at serine 401 in a manner that promotes nuclear translocation in specific cell types such as monocytes. This site-specific divergence illustrates that p38 can either retain or activate TFEB depending on cell context and the constellation of concurrent modifications. Such opposing outcomes highlight the combinatorial code by which multiple phosphorylations determine TFEB localization. The monocyte-specific response implicates TFEB in immune cell activation and inflammatory programs.
description_zh_TW: 相對於其 S211 效應，p38 MAPK 以促進核轉運的方式於 serine 401 磷酸化 TFEB，此作用發生在特定細胞類型如單核細胞中。這種位點特異性分歧說明 p38 可根據細胞背景和同時存在的修飾組合，保留或活化 TFEB。這種相反結果凸顯了多種磷酸化決定 TFEB 定位的組合密碼。單核細胞特異性反應將 TFEB 牽涉進免疫細胞活化和發炎程序。

label: RSK
description: RSK phosphorylates APAF-1 at Ser268, causing inhibition in prostate cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: RSK 在 Ser268 磷酸化 APAF-1，在攝護腺癌細胞中造成抑制。

label: c-ABL
description: c-ABL phosphorylates Caspase-9 at Tyr153, promoting caspase activation and DNA damage-induced apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: c-ABL 在 Tyr153 磷酸化 Caspase-9，促進 caspase 活化與 DNA 損傷誘發的凋亡。

label: ICAD
description: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. ICAD is the inhibitor of caspase-activated DNase that, upon caspase-3 cleavage, releases CAD to fragment nuclear DNA. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon ICAD rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 分裂 ICAD。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 ICAD 是 caspase 活化的 DNase 抑制劑，在 caspase-3 裂解時，釋放 CAD 以片段化核 DNA。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 ICAD 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: PKCδ
description: Caspase-3 is enhanced by PKCδ. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. PKCδ is a protein kinase C isoform that can both enhance caspase-3 activity and, in some contexts, promote apoptotic signaling. The directionality runs from PKCδ toward Caspase-3, so PKCδ is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 被 PKCδ 增強。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 PKCδ 是一種蛋白激酶 C 同工型，既可以增強 caspase-3 活性，也可以在某些情況下促進細胞凋亡訊號傳導。方向性從 PKCδ 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 PKCδ 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: PKCζ
description: Caspase-9 is inhibited by PKCζ. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. PKCzeta is an atypical protein kinase C isoform that can phosphorylate and inhibit caspase-9 to blunt apoptosis. The directionality runs from PKCζ toward Caspase-9, so PKCζ is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-9 被 PKCζ 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 PKCzeta 是一種非典型蛋白激酶 C 同工型，可磷酸化並抑制 caspase-9 以抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 PKCζ 向 Caspase-9，因此 PKCζ 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Toluidine Blue O
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Toluidine blue O (TB), the 3,7-dimethyl analog of methylene blue, is the most potent of the tested phenothiazine derivatives, with EC50s of 1.75 nM for viability, 0.11 nM for ROS reduction, and 1.54 nM for preserving mitochondrial membrane potential in the HT-22 glutamate assay. Like MB, TB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction in the complex I-III assay with NADH as electron donor, enhanced cellular oxygen consumption, and decreased lactate production, sharing MB's alternative electron-transfer-carrier function but with greater potency.
description_zh_TW: 甲苯胺藍 O（TB）是甲烯藍的 3,7-二甲基類似物，是已測試的吩噻嗪衍生物中最有效的，在 HT-22 谷氨酸測定中，其 EC50 分別為 viability 1.75 nM、ROS 減少 0.11 nM、保護線粒體膜電位 1.54 nM。與 MB 一樣，TB 在以 NADH 為電子供體的 complex I-III 測定中顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，增強了細胞氧消耗，降低了乳酸產生，共享 MB 的替代電子轉載體功能但效力更強。

label: Caspase-3 (at Ser150)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates caspase-3 at Ser150, suppressing its proteolytic activity; this inhibition is reversed by the phosphatase PP2A. Directionally, p38 sits upstream of caspase-3 inhibition. This provides a survival signal that tempers apoptosis under certain stresses, and it shows that stress kinases can directly restrain executioner caspases. By phosphorylating pro-caspase-3, p38 reduces the pool available for proteolytic activation, blunting the death response. This regulatory layer illustrates how the balance between kinases and phosphatases determines the threshold for apoptotic commitment under stress.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在 Ser150 位點磷酸化 caspase-3，抑制其蛋白水解活性；此抑制可被磷酸酶 PP2A 逆轉。在方向性上，p38 位於 caspase-3 抑制的上游。這在某些壓力下提供生存訊號以調節凋亡，並表明壓力激酶可以直接抑制效應型 caspase。透過磷酸化前 caspase-3，p38 減少可用於蛋白水解活化的池，削弱死亡反應。這一調控層說明了激酶和磷酸酶之間的平衡如何決定壓力下的凋亡承諾閾值。

label: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol
description: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol is a selective inhibitor of TAK1 (MAP3K7) used to probe the ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis that orchestrates SASP development after DNA damage. By restraining TAK1 activity it suppresses downstream p38 MAPK and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement that supports persistent SASP signaling.
description_zh_TW: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol 是 TAK1（MAP3K7）的選擇性抑制劑，用於探討 DNA 損傷後調控 SASP 發展的 ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸。透過抑制 TAK1 活性，它可壓制支撐持續 SASP 訊號的下游 p38 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與。

label: Zscan4
description: Zscan4 is a transcription factor implicated in feedforward regulatory mechanisms that potentiate the SASP during senescence. The SASP is potentiated by dual feedforward mechanisms involving Zscan4 and TAK1, which apigenin intercepts at the downstream ASAP-to-SASP transition.
description_zh_TW: Zscan4 是參與衰老期間強化 SASP 之前饋調控機制的轉錄因子。SASP 由涉及 Zscan4 與 TAK1 的雙重前饋機制強化，apigenin 在下游 ASAP→SASP 轉變處攔截之。

label: SB203580
description: SB203580 is a selective inhibitor of p38 MAPK (MAPK14), blocking its phosphorylation and activation. It was used as a pharmacological tool to verify p38 MAPK's contribution to SASP expression in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: SB203580 是 p38 MAPK（MAPK14）的選擇性抑制劑，阻斷其磷酸化與活化。它被用作藥理學工具，驗證 p38 MAPK 對衰老細胞中 SASP 表現的貢獻。

label: Deptor
description: Deptor is an endogenous inhibitor that binds both mTORC1 and mTORC2, suppressing the catalytic activity of each complex. By dampening both arms of mTOR signaling, Deptor broadly restrains anabolic growth, survival, and autophagy suppression. Its expression is itself feedback-regulated by mTORC1/mTORC2 activity, forming part of a homeostatic loop. Reduced Deptor levels in certain cancers correlate with hyperactive mTOR signaling, highlighting its tumor-suppressive potential.
description_zh_TW: Deptor 是一種內生抑制劑，結合 mTORC1 和 mTORC2 兩者，抑制各複合物的催化活性。透過阻尼 mTOR 信號的兩條臂，Deptor 廣泛地約束合成代謝生長、存活和自噬抑制。其表現本身受 mTORC1/mTORC2 活性回饋調節，構成恆定性迴圈的一部分。某些癌症中 Deptor 水平降低與過度活化的 mTOR 信號相關，凸顯了其腫瘤抑制潛力。

label: mTORC1 and mTORC2
description: Deptor is an endogenous inhibitor that binds both mTORC1 and mTORC2, suppressing the catalytic activity of each complex. By dampening both arms of mTOR signaling, Deptor broadly restrains anabolic growth, survival, and autophagy suppression. Its expression is itself feedback-regulated by mTORC1/mTORC2 activity, forming part of a homeostatic loop. Reduced Deptor levels in certain cancers correlate with hyperactive mTOR signaling, highlighting its tumor-suppressive potential.
description_zh_TW: Deptor 是一種內生抑制劑，結合 mTORC1 和 mTORC2 兩者，抑制各複合物的催化活性。透過阻尼 mTOR 信號的兩條臂，Deptor 廣泛地約束合成代謝生長、存活和自噬抑制。其表現本身受 mTORC1/mTORC2 活性回饋調節，構成恆定性迴圈的一部分。某些癌症中 Deptor 水平降低與過度活化的 mTOR 信號相關，凸顯了其腫瘤抑制潛力。

label: SIRT3 loss
description: SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress in DCM primarily through the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway. SIRT3 downregulation breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression; melatonin protects via Mst1 inhibition and SIRT3 upregulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 活化主要透過 AGO2/細胞色素 b（CYTB）訊號途徑改善粒線體呼吸能力並在 DCM 中抑制氧化壓力。SIRT3 下調打破此軸線，損害 ETC 活性並加速 DCM 進展；melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 和上調 SIRT3 發揮保護作用。

label: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera)
description: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) activates the NRF2 pathway in MS therapy by modifying KEAP1 cysteines, inducing HO-1, NQO1, and GPx to bolster antioxidant defense in glia and neurons. This is a registered disease-modifying treatment for relapsing MS. The directionality is fumarate to NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. A caveat is that dimethyl fumarate also shifts lymphocyte subsets and can cause flushing and GI effects, so NRF2 activation is one of several mechanisms. Clinical trials show reduced relapses and disability progression, though the precise contribution of NRF2 versus other fumarate actions remains debated.

label: NRF2 pathway in MS therapy
description: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) activates the NRF2 pathway in MS therapy by modifying KEAP1 cysteines, inducing HO-1, NQO1, and GPx to bolster antioxidant defense in glia and neurons. This is a registered disease-modifying treatment for relapsing MS. The directionality is fumarate to NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. A caveat is that dimethyl fumarate also shifts lymphocyte subsets and can cause flushing and GI effects, so NRF2 activation is one of several mechanisms. Clinical trials show reduced relapses and disability progression, though the precise contribution of NRF2 versus other fumarate actions remains debated.

label: drug response
description: SNPs can predict individual drug response by altering the structure or expression of drug-metabolizing enzymes, transporters, or drug targets, as exemplified by COMT Val158Met predicting aspirin and modafinil responses. Pharmacogenetic testing leverages such variants to personalize dosing and choice of therapy, improving efficacy and reducing adverse effects. The predictive power varies with the size and direction of each variant's effect and with gene-environment interactions. This approach is central to precision medicine.
description_zh_TW: SNPs 可以透過改變藥物代謝酶、轉運蛋白或藥物標靶的結構或表現來預測個別 drug response，例如 COMT Val158Met 預測阿斯匹靈和莫達非尼反應。藥物基因學測試利用這些變異來個人化劑量和治療選擇，提高療效並減少不良反應。預測能力隨每個變異效應的大小和方向以及基因-環境交互作用而變化。這種方法是精準醫學的核心。

label: Embryonic Stem Cells
description: Murine embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) are primary fibroblasts commonly used as feeder layers that secrete factors including LIF to support embryonic stem cell culture. MEF feeder contamination can confound miRNA analyses of ES cells.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠胚胎纖維母細胞（MEF）是常用的飼養層初代纖維母細胞，分泌包括 LIF 在內的因子以支持胚胎幹細胞培養。MEF 飼養層污染可能干擾 ES 細胞的 miRNA 分析。

label: endothelial cell senescence
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Downregulation of SIRT1 was found to be important in the senescence of different types of endothelial cells. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of cellular senescence in the vascular endothelium. Because SIRT1 normally promotes stress resistance and genomic stability, its decline in endothelial cells is linked to the senescent phenotype. This positions SIRT1 as a potential target for preserving endothelial function and preventing vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的下調在不同類型內皮細胞的衰老中被發現具有重要意義。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於血管內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT1通常促進壓力抗性和基因組穩定性，其在內皮細胞中的下降與衰老表型相關。這將SIRT1確定為維持內皮功能和預防血管老化的潛在靶點。

label: Endothelial nitric oxide bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 plays a pivotal role in maintaining endothelial cell function by preserving mitochondrial integrity via the SIRT3/ATG5 axis, thereby reducing ROS levels and sustaining nitric oxide bioavailability. Directionally, the axis sits upstream of maintained endothelial NO signaling. Conversely, absence of SIRT3 in EC-specific knockout models leads to exaggerated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and endothelial dysfunction, fostering a pro-inflammatory, pro-atherogenic phenotype.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 SIRT3/ATG5 軸保持粒線體完整性，從而降低 ROS 水平並維持一氧化氮生物利用度，從而在維持內皮細胞功能中發揮關鍵作用。從方向上看，該軸位於維持的內皮 NO 訊號傳導的上游。相反，EC特異性敲除模型中SIRT3的缺失會導致NLRP3發炎小體過度活化和內皮功能障礙，進而形成促發炎、促動脈粥狀硬化的表型。

label: endothelial senescence via oxidative stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Research has shown that senescence of endothelial cells is induced by oxidative stress due to SIRT6 downregulation. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of oxidative stress-driven endothelial senescence. Because SIRT6 normally supports antioxidant defences and DNA repair, its decline leaves endothelial cells vulnerable to oxidative damage and the senescent phenotype, linking SIRT6 to vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: 研究表明，由於SIRT6下調導致的氧化壓力誘導了內皮細胞的衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於氧化壓力驅動的內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT6通常支持抗氧化防禦和DNA修復，其下降使內皮細胞容易受到氧化損傷和衰老表型的影響，將SIRT6與血管老化聯繫起來。

label: Energy homeostasis and autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 and AMPK form a reciprocal regulatory loop in which each can activate the other, jointly promoting energy homeostasis and autophagic flux. Directionally, the interaction is bidirectional: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates LKB1 and PGC-1α while AMPK phosphorylates and activates SIRT1. This creates a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit, and it is a central node integrating nutrient sensing and clearance. By activating each other, SIRT1 and AMPK amplify catabolic and protective programs, including mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy. This loop is a key target for interventions that aim to restore metabolic health in aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 和 AMPK 形成雙向調控迴路，兩者可以互相活化，共同促進能量恆定性和自噬通量。在方向性上，此相互作用是雙向的：SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 LKB1 和 PGC-1α，而 AMPK 磷酸化並活化 SIRT1。這創造了一個自強化的代謝迴路，是整合營養感知和清除的核心節點。透過互相活化，SIRT1 和 AMPK 放大分解代謝和保護程式，包括粒線體生物合成和自噬。此迴路是旨在恢復衰老代謝健康的干預措施的關鍵靶標。

label: Enzyme-coupled nicotinamide assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The enzyme-coupled assay for nicotinamide detection measures sirtuin activity continuously by coupling nicotinamidase (which hydrolyzes nicotinamide to nicotinic acid and ammonia) to glutamate dehydrogenase, which converts ammonia, alpha-ketoglutarate, and NAD(P)H to glutamate and NAD(P)+, quantified spectrophotometrically at 340 nm. It was developed in 2009 and, while not used yet on the scale of large screenings, could be adapted to a high-throughput format. Directionally, a continuous enzyme-coupled readout avoids the artifacts associated with fluorescent and end-point assays.
description_zh_TW: 用於尼可醯胺偵測的酵素偶聯測定透過將尼可醯胺酶（水解尼可醯胺為尼可酸和氨）與穀氨酸脫氫酶偶聯來連續測量 sirtuin 活性，後者將氨、α-酮戊二酸和 NAD(P)H 轉化為穀氨酸和 NAD(P)+，在 340 nm 處進行分光光度法定量。它於 2009 年開發，儘管尚未大規模應用於大型篩選，但可以改編為高通量格式。方向性上連續的酵素偶聯讀取避免了與螢光和終點測定相關的假象。

label: TGFβ Superfamily
description: Activin A is a homodimer of inhibin beta-A (INHBA) subunits and a member of the TGFbeta superfamily of cytokines. Like other family members, it signals through serine/threonine kinase receptors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation. Its classification within the TGFbeta superfamily situates it among the SASP factors with paracrine arrest-inducing capacity, alongside TGF-beta1, BMP2, and GDF15. Activin A is a structurally defined ligand that is distinct from TGF-beta1 but shares functional overlap, particularly in inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in receiving cells during paracrine senescence.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 是 inhibin beta-A（INHBA）次單元的同源二聚體，且是 TGFbeta 細胞激素超家族的成員。如同其他家族成員，它經絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶受體訊號調節細胞命運、增殖與發炎。其歸類於 TGFbeta 超家族將它置於具旁分泌停滯誘發能力的 SASP 因子中，與 TGF-beta1、BMP2 與 GDF15 並列。Activin A 是結構上確立的配體，不同於 TGF-beta1 但具功能重疊，特別在旁分泌衰老中誘發受體細胞的細胞週期抑制因子。

label: ALK4
description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

label: VEGFR2
description: At higher concentrations or after proteolytic processing, VEGF-C also engages VEGFR2 on blood vascular endothelium, supporting angiogenesis in addition to its lymphatic actions. This dual receptor usage broadens its angiogenic potential within the SASP and explains how VEGF-C can drive both blood- and lymphatic-vessel formation, depending on the local processing environment. The relationship is supported by receptor-binding and processing studies, and it positions processed VEGF-C as a shared ligand across the two receptor systems with distinct downstream signaling outputs.
description_zh_TW: 在較高濃度或經蛋白水解處理後，VEGF-C 也接合血血管內皮上的 VEGFR2，除淋巴作用外也支持血管生成。此雙重受體使用拓寬其在 SASP 內的血管生成潛力，並擴展其對組織血管化的貢獻。此靈活性意味 VEGF-C 依局部濃度與蛋白水解而橋接淋巴與血血管生成，使其成為分泌組中多功能的血管重塑因子。

label: Chemokine
description: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
description_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

label: CCR6
description: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
description_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

label: Follistatin
description: Follistatin binds and neutralizes Activin A extracellularly, acting as a soluble antagonist that can block its paracrine senescence-inducing activity. This provides a natural brake on Activin A signaling and a potential therapeutic route to limit SASP-mediated arrest spread in tissue. The follistatin-Activin A axis is a classic antagonistic ligand-binding pair, and neutralization experiments confirm its functional relevance in paracrine senescence models. Because follistatin also regulates other TGFbeta-family ligands, it represents an endogenous checkpoint on the arrest-inducing arm of the senescent secretome.
description_zh_TW: Follistatin 在胞外結合並中和 Activin A，作為可阻斷其旁分泌衰老誘發活性的可溶性拮抗劑。這提供對 Activin A 訊號的自然制動，以及限制組織中 SASP 介導停滯擴散的潛在治療途徑。follistatin-Activin A 軸是經典的拮抗性配體—結合對，且中和實驗確認其在旁分泌衰老模型中的功能相關性。由於 follistatin 也調節其他 TGFbeta 家族配體，它代表衰老分泌組停滯誘發臂的內源性檢查點。

label: Lymphangiogenesis
description: Full-length VEGF-C preferentially activates VEGFR-3 and promotes lymphatic vessel sprouting, driving lymphangiogenesis. In senescence, this contributes to lymphatic remodeling and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes, shaping how immune cells access senescent tissue. The relationship is the canonical lymphangiogenic function of VEGF-C and expands the vascular consequences of the SASP beyond blood vessels. It is supported by studies of lymphatic development and tumor-associated lymphangiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 全長 VEGF-C 偏好活化 VEGFR-3 並促進淋巴管出芽，驅動淋巴生成。在衰老中，這貢獻淋巴重塑並可能影響免疫細胞遷移路徑，塑造免疫細胞如何接近衰老灶。其淋巴特異性角色補充 VEGF-A 的血血管生成，使 SASP 的血管效應具雙重性。它是連結細胞衰老到淋巴系統重塑的關鍵因子。

label: IFITM3
description: IFITM3 is enriched in exosomes released from senescent cells and mediates paracrine senescence by transmitting senescence signals to recipient cells. As an exosomal cargo, it represents a vesicle-based, rather than soluble-factor, route of spread, and its inclusion highlights that paracrine senescence is not solely cytokine-driven. Exosomes allow protected, concentrated delivery of signals to recipient cells, and they can be detected in the circulation as potential biomarkers of senescence burden. The mechanism adds a non-classical communication modality to the SASP paradigm.
description_zh_TW: IFITM3 在衰老細胞釋放的胞外囊泡中富集，並透過將衰老訊號傳遞至受體細胞介導旁分泌衰老。作為胞外體貨物，它代表一種基於囊泡而非可溶因子的擴散途徑，其納入凸顯旁分泌衰老不只由細胞激素驅動。胞外體允許受保護、濃縮的訊號遞送至受體細胞，且可在循環中作為衰老負擔的潛在生物標記被偵測。此機制為 SASP 範式增添非典型溝通方式。

label: Notch
description: Notch signaling is essential for establishing paracrine senescence and, paradoxically, weakens the secondary SASP in receiving cells. Notch integrates cues from the SASP to reinforce arrest in neighbors while modulating their secretory output, indicating that paracrine senescence is an active, regulated program rather than passive factor exposure. The distinct outcomes -- establishing arrest versus dampening the SASP -- reflect context-dependent Notch outputs in recipient cells. This dual role positions Notch as a key integrator of the spread and modulation of senescence.
description_zh_TW: Notch 訊號對建立旁分泌衰老至為必要，且矛盾地削弱受體細胞的次級 SASP。Notch 整合來自 SASP 的線索以強化鄰近細胞的停滯，同時調節其分泌輸出，顯示旁分泌衰老是一主動、受調節的程序而非被動因子暴露。此不同結果——建立停滯 vs 減弱 SASP——反映受體細胞中依脈絡而定的 Notch 輸出。此雙重角色將 Notch 定位為衰老擴散與調節的關鍵整合者。

label: Biological Process
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: VEGF Family
description: VEGF-C is a member of the VEGF family of cysteine-knot growth factors, structurally related to VEGF-A but with distinct receptor usage and lymphatic specificity. Its classification situates it among the growth-factor arm of the SASP, and in senescence it is an early-induced angiogenic and lymphangiogenic factor. The family membership underpins its receptor interactions, particularly with VEGFR-3 and, after proteolytic processing, VEGFR-2. This dual receptor capacity distinguishes its vascular functions from other family members.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的胱胺酸結（cysteine-knot）生長因子成員，結構上與 VEGF-A 相關但具不同的受體使用與淋巴特異性。其分類將其置於 SASP 的生長因子臂，在衰老中它是連結分泌組到血管與淋巴管生成的因子。其與 VEGF-A 的關係反映 SASP 生長因子的多樣性，且其在促血管生成與淋巴生成間的雙重角色使其獨特。它是分泌組中較少被認識的組成。

label: VEGFR3
description: VEGF-C signals primarily through VEGFR-3 on lymphatic endothelium, promoting lymphangiogenesis and lymphatic vessel sprouting. This receptor usage distinguishes VEGF-C from VEGF-A's preferential VEGFR2 engagement and underlies its role in lymphatic remodeling around senescent tissue. In the SASP, VEGF-C-VEGFR3 signaling contributes to lymphatic vessel formation and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes. The relationship is a canonical VEGF-C function well established in lymphatic biology.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 主要透過淋巴內皮上的 VEGFR-3 訊號，促進淋巴生成與淋巴管出芽。此受體使用區分 VEGF-C 與 VEGF-A 偏好 VEGFR2 接合，並構成其淋巴重塑角色基礎，將 SASP 連結到淋巴血管系統。在衰老中，這可影響免疫細胞遷移路徑與組織液體穩態。它是 VEGF 家族受體特異性如何塑造分泌組血管效應的例證。

label: DOT1L
description: H3K79me2 is a nucleosome-core methylation deposited by the methyltransferase DOT1L, the sole H3K79 methyltransferase. H3K79 methylation marks actively transcribed gene bodies and is elevated at SASP loci.
description_zh_TW: H3K79me2 是由甲基轉移酶 DOT1L（唯一的 H3K79 甲基轉移酶）沉積的核小體核心甲基化。H3K79 甲基化標記活躍轉錄的基因體，並在 SASP 基因座升高。

label: Eosinophil Peroxidase
description: Eosinophil peroxidase produces hypobromous acid (HOBr) by using bromide and H2O2 to generate the brominating oxidant in eosinophilic inflammation such as allergic asthma. HOBr is the eosinophil analog of neutrophil HOCl. The directionality is EPO catalysis to HOBr formation. A caveat is that HOBr is less studied than HOCl, and bromination biomarkers are less established, though it is similarly reactive toward proteins. Bromotyrosine adducts are elevated in allergic airway disease and serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage.
description_zh_TW: 在過敏性asthma等嗜酸性粒細胞發炎中，Eosinophil peroxidase透過使用溴化物和H2O2生成溴化氧化劑來產生hypobromous acid(HOBr)。 HOBr 是中性粒細胞 HOCl 的嗜酸性粒細胞類似物。方向性是 EPO 催化 HOBr 形成。需要注意的是，雖然 HOBr 對 proteins 具有類似的反應性，但與 HOCl 相比，對 HOBr 的研究較少，並且溴化生物標誌物的建立也較少。 Bromotyrosine 加合物在過敏性氣道疾病中升高，並作為嗜酸性粒細胞介導的氧化損傷的特異性標記。

label: ETS
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis. The ETS-family member ELK4 plays a central role in sirtuin biology by stabilizing SIRT7 at target gene promoters, enabling H3K18 deacetylation and repression of tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, the ETS family provides the DNA-binding and promoter-targeting mechanisms that members such as ELK4 use to recruit chromatin-modifying enzymes such as SIRT7.
description_zh_TW: ETS 是一個大型真核轉錄因子家族，共享一個保守的翼狀螺旋-轉-螺旋 DNA 結合 ETS 結構域，識別富含嘌呤的 GGAA/T 核心基序並調節增殖、分化和腫瘤發生。ETS 家族成員 ELK4 在 sirtuin 生物學中扮演核心角色，透過將 SIRT7 穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 H3K18 去乙醯化和腫瘤抑制基因的抑制成為可能。方向性上 ETS 家族提供了 DNA 結合和啟動子靶向機制，使 ELK4 等成員能招募 SIRT7 等染色質修飾酶。

source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

label: ETS1
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

label: SIRT3 via H3K27 crotonylation

label: HDAC inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: EX-527, the most potent and selective SIRT1 inhibitor identified from a large high-throughput screen, inhibits SIRT1 at nanomolar concentrations with remarkable selectivity over SIRT2 and SIRT3 and good pharmacokinetic properties. Its anticancer activity as a single agent is weak, but it cooperates with HDAC inhibitors to induce apoptosis in leukemia cells. Directionally, EX-527-mediated SIRT1 blockade combined with broad HDAC inhibition produces a synergistic lethal effect. This positions EX-527 as the standard pharmacological SIRT1 inhibitor and a component of combination anticancer strategies.
description_zh_TW: EX-527 是從大規模高通量篩選中鑑定出的最強效和最具選擇性的 SIRT1 抑制劑，在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1，對 SIRT2 和 SIRT3 具有顯著的選擇性，且具有良好的藥代動力學特性。其作為單一藥物的抗癌活性較弱，但與 HDAC 抑制劑協同誘導白血病細胞凋亡。方向性上 EX-527 介導的 SIRT1 阻斷與廣泛的 HDAC 抑制結合產生協同致死效果。這使 EX-527 成為標準的藥理學 SIRT1 抑制劑和聯合抗癌策略的組成部分。

label: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption
description: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
description_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

label: Extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy
description: SIRT7-deficient mice show extensive myocardial fibrosis, high basal apoptosis, and cardiomyopathy, reflecting SIRT7's role in maintaining cardiac homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to fibrotic cardiomyopathy. This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

label: Ferric Iron
description: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is an autosomal dominant condition caused by mutations in globin genes (alpha, beta, or gamma chains) that stabilize the ferric (Fe3+) state of heme iron. Patients with hemoglobin M disease often have lifelong cyanosis but are otherwise asymptomatic or mildly affected, because the stabilized ferric methemoglobin cannot carry oxygen yet the body compensates. This congenital cause of methemoglobinemia is distinct from the enzyme-deficiency form arising from cytochrome b5 reductase mutations, and both congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia.

label: FGF21 signaling
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Restoring SIRT3 expression via lifestyle interventions or fibroblast growth factor-21 (FGF21) signaling improves mitochondrial integrity and myocardial function in diabetes. Directionally, FGF21 sits upstream of recovered SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control. This points to metabolic reprogramming as a promising avenue for diabetic patients, coupling endocrine FGF21 biology to the mitochondrial deacetylase axis.
description_zh_TW: 透過生活方式介入或纖維母細胞生長因子 21 (FGF21) 訊號恢復 SIRT3 表現可改善糖尿病患者的粒線體完整性和心肌功能。從方向上看，FGF21 位於恢復的 SIRT3 依賴性粒線體品質控制的上游。這表明代謝重編程對於糖尿病患者來說是一條有前途的途徑，將內分泌 FGF21 生物學與粒線體去乙醯化酶軸結合起來。

label: Fisetin Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. These systems increase fisetin's dissolution rate, protect it from degradation and first-pass conjugation, and can enable sustained release and improved tissue targeting, including brain delivery. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的奈米製劑，包括聚合物奈米粒子、脂質奈米粒子、奈米乳液和奈米晶體，已被開發以克服其溶解度差和口服生物利用度低的問題。這些系統提高非瑟酮的溶解速率，保護其免受降解和首過結合，並可實現持續釋放和改善組織靶向，包括腦部遞送。綜述中總結的研究報告顯示，與游離非瑟酮懸浮液相比，奈米製劑的非瑟酮峰濃度和曲線下麵積增加數倍，並在腫瘤和神經保護模型中增強療效，但臨床數據仍然有限。

label: Nano-formulation

description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.

label: Fisetin Dissolution
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Solid dispersions of fisetin are prepared by dispersing the drug in a hydrophilic polymer matrix such as polyvinylpyrrolidone or hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, converting crystalline fisetin into an amorphous form that dissolves much faster. The review describes how fisetin solid dispersions markedly increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility relative to the free drug, leading to improved oral absorption and higher plasma concentrations in pharmacokinetic studies. Because dissolution is the limiting step in fisetin absorption, solid dispersion technology is one of the most straightforward and widely explored macro- to micro-scale strategies for improving its bioavailability.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的固體分散體通過將藥物分散在親水性聚合物基質（如聚乙烯吡咯烷酮或羥丙甲纖維素）中製備，將結晶非瑟酮轉化為溶解快得多的無定形形式。該綜述描述了非瑟酮固體分散體如何與游離藥物相比顯著增加溶出速率和表觀溶解度，從而在藥物動力學研究中改善口服吸收和更高的血漿濃度。由於溶出是非瑟酮吸收的限速步驟，固體分散體技術是改善其生物利用度的最直接和最廣泛探索的宏觀到微觀策略。

label: G→T transversions
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine causes G to T transversions because the oxidized base pairs promiscuously with adenine during replication, so a G:C pair becomes an A:T pair after a round of replication and repair. These transversions are signature mutations in many cancers. The directionality is miscoding lesion to mutagenic outcome. A caveat is that accurate repair by OGG1 before replication averts most mutations, so only unrepaired lesions are mutagenic. G to T transversions are among the most frequent mutations found in oncogenes and tumor suppressors in human cancers, underscoring the relevance of this lesion.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 會導致 G 到 T 顛換，因為複製過程中氧化鹼基與腺嘌呤混雜配對，因此 G:C 對經過一輪複製和修復後變成 A:T 對。這些顛換是許多 cancer 的特徵突變。方向性是將病變錯誤編碼為誘變結果。需要注意的是，複製前透過 OGG1 進行的精確修復可以避免大多數突變，因此只有未修復的損傷才具有突變性。 G 至 T 顛換是人類 cancer 癌基因和腫瘤抑制基因中最常見的突變之一，強調了這種病變的相關性。

label: Allopurinol
description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
description_zh_TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

label: Amifostine
description: Amifostine scavenges hydroxyl radicals as a prodrug that is dephosphorylated to the active thiol WR-1065, which protects normal tissues during radiotherapy. By quenching OH* it spares DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage. The directionality is radioprotectant to radical neutralization. A caveat is that amifostine preferentially protects some normal tissues over tumors, but it carries side effects (hypotension, nausea) that limit use. Selective uptake by normal tissues gives amifostine its cytoprotective profile during radiotherapy and chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: Amifostine 作為前藥清除 hydroxyl radicals，此前藥被去磷酸化為活性硫醇 WR-1065，可在放射治療期間保護正常組織。透過淬滅 OH*，它可以使 DNA 和 proteins 免受輻射引起的損傷。方向性對於自由基中和具有輻射防護作用。需要注意的是，amifostine 優先保護一些正常組織而不是腫瘤，但它的副作用（低血壓、噁心）限制了使用。正常組織的選擇性攝取使 amifostine 在放射治療和化療期間具有細胞保護作用。

label: Febuxostat
description: Febuxostat inhibits xanthine oxidase as a non-purine, selective inhibitor that blocks both the oxidized and reduced forms of the enzyme. Compared with allopurinol it achieves more complete suppression of urate production. The directionality is enzyme inhibition to lower urate and less XO-derived ROS. A caveat is that febuxostat carries cardiovascular black-box warnings in some populations and, like allopurinol, does not address pre-existing urate crystal deposits immediately. Febuxostat is primarily metabolized by the liver, allowing use in some renally impaired patients, although cardiovascular safety warnings limit broad adoption.
description_zh_TW: Febuxostat 作為一種非嘌呤選擇性抑制劑抑制 xanthine oxidase，可阻斷此酵素的氧化形式和還原形式。與allopurinol相比，實現了更徹底的尿酸鹽生成抑制。方向性是酵素抑制，以降低尿酸和減少 XO 衍生的 ROS。需要注意的是，febuxostat 在某些人群中帶有心血管黑盒警告，並且與 allopurinol 一樣，不能立即解決預先存在的尿酸鹽晶體沉積物。 Febuxostat 主要由肝臟代謝，允許在一些腎功能不全的患者中使用，儘管心血管安全警告限制了廣泛採用。

label: Iron accumulation in Substantia Nigra
description: Iron accumulation in the substantia nigra promotes the Fenton reaction because elevated redox-active iron there catalyzes conversion of H2O2 to hydroxyl radicals near dopaminergic neurons. The iron burden correlates with oxidative damage markers in Parkinson's disease. The directionality is iron accumulation to radical generation. A caveat is that iron accumulation may also be a downstream consequence of oxidative damage and impaired iron export, so the relationship is partly bidirectional. Iron chelation and restoration of ferritin expression are therefore investigated as strategies to protect dopaminergic neurons.
description_zh_TW: Iron 在黑質中的累積促進了 Fenton reaction，因為那裡的氧化還原活性 iron 升高會催化 dopaminergic 神經元附近的 H2O2 轉化為 hydroxyl radicals。 iron 負擔與 Parkinson's disease 中的氧化損傷標記有關。方向性是iron累積到激進生成。需要注意的是，iron 累積也可能是氧化損傷和 iron 輸出受損的下游結果，因此這種關係部分是雙向的。因此，研究了 Iron 螯合和 ferritin 表達的恢復，作為保護 dopaminergic 神經元的策略。

label: Chronic granulomatous disease
description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

label: Aconitase
description: Peroxynitrite inactivates aconitase by disrupting its [4Fe-4S] cluster, impairing the TCA-cycle enzyme and diverting citrate metabolism. This links nitrative stress to mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction. The directionality is cluster destruction to enzyme inactivation. A caveat is that aconitase is also sensitive to superoxide and other oxidants, so its inhibition is not uniquely peroxynitrite-driven. Because aconitase also acts as iron regulatory protein 1 when its cluster is lost, oxidative inactivation links metabolic and iron-regulatory responses.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過破壞 aconitase 的 [4Fe-4S] 簇、損害 TCA 循環酶並轉移檸檬酸代謝來滅活 aconitase。這將 nitrative stress 與 mitochondria1 代謝功能障礙聯繫起來。方向性是簇破壞到酵素失活。需要注意的是，aconitase 也對超氧化物和其他氧化劑敏感，因此它的抑製作用並不是 peroxynitrite 獨有的。由於 aconitase 在其簇丟失時也充當 iron 調節蛋白 1，因此氧化失活將代謝和 iron 調節反應聯繫起來。

label: Tau protein
description: Peroxynitrite nitrates tau protein at tyrosine residues, impairing tau-microtubule interaction and enhancing formation of paired helical filaments. Nitration adds to the spectrum of oxidative modifications that destabilize tau. The directionality is nitrative modification to tau dysfunction. A caveat is that tau is targeted by many oxidative and kinase modifications, so nitration is one of several converging insults. Elevated nitrotyrosine is detected on tau in neurofibrillary tangles, supporting nitration as a contributor to tau pathology in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 在 tyrosine 殘基處硝酸鹽 tau protein，損害 tau-微管相互作用並增強成對螺旋絲的形成。硝化增加了氧化修飾的範圍，從而破壞了 tau 的穩定性。方向性是tau功能障礙的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，tau 是許多氧化和激酶修飾的目標，因此硝化是幾種聚合損傷之一。在神經纖維纏結中的 tau 上檢測到升高的硝基rosine，支持硝化是體內 tau 病理學的貢獻者。

label: Tetrahydrobiopterin
description: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

label: Innate Immune Defense
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: Lipids
description: Nitrative stress nitrates unsaturated fatty acids to yield nitrated lipids such as nitrolinoleic acid and nitro-oleic acid. Unlike the destructive protein modifications, nitrated lipids act as endogenous signaling molecules that activate PPARgamma and inhibit NF-kB signaling, representing a negative feedback loop in inflammation. They also undergo Michael addition with cysteine thiols to activate the Nrf2 antioxidant program.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 硝化不飽和脂肪酸，產生 nitrated lipids，例如 nitrolinoleic acid 和 nitro-oleic acid。與破壞性的蛋白質修飾不同，nitrated lipids 作為內源性 signaling molecules，活化 PPARgamma 並抑制 NF-kB 訊號，構成發炎中的負回饋迴路。它們也會與半胱胺酸硫醇進行 Michael addition，活化 Nrf2 抗氧化程序。

label: Cytochrome c Oxidase
description: Peroxynitrite inactivates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV of the respiratory chain) through tyrosine nitration, contributing to bioenergetic failure. Among the 20-50 proteins preferentially nitrated in vivo are MnSOD, cytochrome c oxidase, aconitase, and glutamine synthetase. Tyrosine nitration typically inactivates these enzymes, causing loss of function.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過酪氨酸硝化使 cytochrome c oxidase（呼吸鏈的 Complex IV）失活，促成生物能量衰竭。在體內優先被硝化的 20-50 種蛋白質中，包括 MnSOD、cytochrome c oxidase、aconitase 與 glutamine synthetase。酪氨酸硝化通常使這些酵素失活，造成功能喪失。

label: 3-Nitrotyrosine
description: Nitrative stress produces 3-nitrotyrosine (3-NT), the most characteristic and biomedically relevant protein modification of this pathway. 3-NT forms when peroxynitrite-derived radicals (NO2 and carbonate radical) oxidize tyrosine phenolate groups and couple with NO2. Because 3-NT is a stable, unrepairable post-translational modification, it serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of tissue injury in many diseases.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 產生 3-nitrotyrosine（3-NT），這是此途徑最具特徵性且與生物醫學最相關的蛋白質修飾。當 peroxynitrite 衍生的自由基（NO2 和 carbonate radical）氧化酪氨酸酚基並與 NO2 偶聯時，會形成 3-NT。由於 3-NT 是穩定且不可修復的轉譯後修飾，它在許多疾病中既是生物標記也是組織損傷的介導者。

label: muscle protein degradation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Under catabolic conditions, nuclear FoxO drives expression of atrophy-related genes and activates specific protein degradation pathways that break down muscle proteins. Urolithin A suppresses FoxO activation, primarily by inhibiting its nuclear activity and reducing its regulation of these degradation pathways, thereby attenuating muscle protein degradation and helping to preserve muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。在分解代謝條件下，核內 FoxO 驅動萎縮相關基因的表現，並活化分解肌肉蛋白的特定蛋白降解路徑。Urolithin A 抑制 FoxO 活化，主要是透過抑制其核活性並降低其對這些降解路徑的調節，從而減緩肌肉蛋白降解並有助於保留肌肉量。

label: French Paradox
description: The French paradox describes lower cardiovascular-disease incidence in some French populations despite high-fat diets, often attributed in part to moderate wine and resveratrol consumption. Directionally, moderate wine intake sits upstream of reduced CVD in this epidemiological observation. Causality is debated, with diet and lifestyle confounders complicating the interpretation, and the wine matrix and polyphenol content may contribute. Resveratrol's vascular actions provide a plausible, but not proven, mechanism, and the concept has driven considerable research into wine polyphenols, sirtuins, and cardiovascular health.
description_zh_TW: 法國悖論描述了某些法國人群中儘管高脂飲食但心血管疾病發生率較低的現象，部分歸因於適度的葡萄酒和 resveratrol 消費。在方向性上，適度的葡萄酒攝入在此流行病學觀察中位於降低心血管疾病的上游。因果關係存在爭議，飲食和生活方式混雜因素使解釋複雜化，葡萄酒基質和多酚含量可能有所貢獻。resveratrol 的血管作用提供了一個合理的但尚未被證實的機制，此概念已推動了大量關於葡萄酒多酚、sirtuin 和心血管健康的研究。

label: Fructose
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: An additional well-studied mechanism of AGE formation is the polyol pathway, in which glucose is converted to sorbitol by the enzyme aldose reductase and then to fructose by the action of sorbitol dehydrogenase. Because fructose is a more reactive reducing sugar than glucose, its production feeds additional glycation reactions. This pathway becomes especially active under hyperglycemic conditions, linking poorly controlled diabetes with accelerated accumulation of advanced glycation end products. The polyol pathway therefore represents a non-Maillard route through which elevated glucose contributes to protein glycation and the tissue damage seen in diabetic complications.

label: Polyol Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: An additional well-studied mechanism of AGE formation is the polyol pathway, in which glucose is converted to sorbitol by the enzyme aldose reductase and then to fructose by the action of sorbitol dehydrogenase. Because fructose is a more reactive reducing sugar than glucose, its production feeds additional glycation reactions. This pathway becomes especially active under hyperglycemic conditions, linking poorly controlled diabetes with accelerated accumulation of advanced glycation end products. The polyol pathway therefore represents a non-Maillard route through which elevated glucose contributes to protein glycation and the tissue damage seen in diabetic complications.

label: GADD45 expression
description: FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 enhances expression of GADD45 and suppresses caspase-3/7 activity, promoting DNA repair over apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT1 activates FOXO4, which induces GADD45. This biases cells toward damage repair rather than death, and it is a further example of SIRT1 steering stress responses toward survival and genome maintenance. By inducing GADD45, FOXO4 supports nucleotide-excision repair and cell-cycle arrest, giving cells time to repair damage. This survival-oriented program is central to SIRT1's cytoprotective functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1對FOXO4的去乙醯化增強了GADD45的表達並抑制caspase-3/7活性，促進DNA修復而非細胞凋亡。方向上，SIRT1活化FOXO4，後者誘導GADD45。這使細胞傾向於損傷修復而非死亡，是SIRT1將壓力反應引導至存活和基因組維護的又一例證。透過誘導GADD45，FOXO4支持核苷酸切除修復和細胞週期停滯，為細胞提供修復損傷的時間。這種以存活為導向的程序是SIRT1細胞保護功能的核心。

label: gastric cancer progression via STAT3/MMP-13
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 depletion promotes gastric cancer progression through activation of the STAT3/MMP-13 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of STAT3- and MMP-13-driven tumor progression in gastric cancer. Because SIRT1 normally restrains this pathway, its depletion unleashes STAT3 activation and MMP-13 expression, accelerating GC growth and invasion. This positions SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer and identifies STAT3/MMP-13 signaling as a downstream mediator of SIRT1's protective effect.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1的耗竭透過活化STAT3/MMP-13訊號通路促進胃癌的進展。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於胃癌中STAT3和MMP-13驅動的腫瘤進展的上游。因為SIRT1通常抑制此通路，其耗竭釋放STAT3活化和MMP-13表達，加速胃癌生長和侵襲。這將SIRT1定位為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，並將STAT3/MMP-13訊號確定為SIRT1保護效果的下游介導因子。

label: TFEB at K274/K279
description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: Gender-specific tumorigenesis
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2-deficient mice develop gender-specific tumors, with females acquiring mammary tumors and males developing hepatocellular carcinoma, matching the mitotic instability produced by elevated Aurora-A/Aurora-B. Consistent with a tumor-suppressor role, human breast cancers and hepatocellular carcinomas often show reduced SIRT2 relative to normal tissue. The relationship is directional: loss of SIRT2 predisposes to these malignancies, whereas SIRT2 expression restrains them. This positions SIRT2 among the sirtuins that act as tumor suppressors in genetic mouse models.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 缺陷小鼠發展出性別特異性的腫瘤，雌性獲得多發性乳腺腫瘤，雄性則發展為肝細胞癌，這與 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 升高所產生的有絲分裂不穩定性相符。與腫瘤抑制角色一致的是，人類乳癌和肝細胞癌相較於正常組織常表現出 SIRT2 降低。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 的缺失促使這些惡性腫瘤的發生，而 SIRT2 的表現則抑制它們。這將 SIRT2 定位為在基因工程小鼠模型中具有腫瘤抑制功能的 sirtuin 之一。

label: Glioblastoma growth
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation of p21-activated kinase 1 (PAK1) at lysine 420 hinders autophagy and glioblastoma growth, establishing SIRT1 as a tumor suppressor in this context. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic inhibition of PAK1 sits upstream of suppressed glioblastoma progression. By restraining PAK1 activity, SIRT1 limits the autophagy that glioblastoma cells rely on to survive under metabolic stress. This impairs tumor growth and positions SIRT1 as a brake on an aggressive brain malignancy. The finding illustrates that the same sirtuin can exert opposite effects in different cancers, and it suggests SIRT1 activation as a therapeutic direction for glioblastoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1介導的p21活化激酶1（PAK1）第420位賴氨酸去乙醯化阻碍自噬和膠質母細胞瘤生長，確立SIRT1在此環境中作為腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT1對PAK1的酵素抑制位於膠質母細胞瘤進展抑制的上游。透過限制PAK1活性，SIRT1限制了膠質母細胞瘤細胞在代謝壓力下存活所依賴的自噬。這損害了腫瘤生長，並將SIRT1定位為對侵略性腦部惡性腫瘤的制動器。此發現說明了同一sirtuin可以在不同癌症中產生相反效果，並建議SIRT1活化作為膠質母細胞瘤的治療方向。

label: GLO1
description: GLO1 (glyoxalase I) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It catalyzes the conversion of hemithioacetals, formed spontaneously from methylglyoxal and glutathione, into S-D-lactoylglutathione. Because methylglyoxal is one of the most reactive dicarbonyl precursors of advanced glycation end products, GLO1 activity is critical for preventing dicarbonyl stress from damaging proteins. Enhancing or maintaining GLO1 function is considered a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation and for protecting against age-related pathologies in which glycation plays a role.
description_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase I）是乙二醛酶系統的速率限制酶。它催化由甲基乙二醛與麩胱甘肽（glutathione）自發形成的半硫縮醛（hemithioacetals）轉化為 S-D-lactoylglutathione。由於甲基乙二醛是晚期糖化終產物最具反應性的二羰基前驅物之一，GLO1 活性對於防止二羰基壓力損害蛋白質至關重要。增強或維持 GLO1 功能被視為減少內生性 AGE 堆積與保護對抗涉及糖化的年齡相關病理的主要標的。

label: Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion
description: Repression of UCP2 by SIRT1 preserves mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis in pancreatic β-cells, which raises the ATP/ADP ratio and closes KATP channels to trigger insulin release. Mice overexpressing SIRT1 in β-cells show enhanced glucose-stimulated insulin secretion, while SIRT1 loss elevates UCP2 and impairs the response. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated UCP2 downregulation leads to stronger insulin secretion. This links SIRT1 to improved glucose homeostasis and protection against diabetes, and it is consistent with the observation that caloric restriction, which raises SIRT1, preserves β-cell function and insulin sensitivity in aging organisms.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 UCP2 的抑制維持了胰腺 β 細胞的粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成，從而提高 ATP/ADP 比值並關閉 KATP 通道以觸發胰島素釋放。在 β 細胞中過量表達 SIRT1 的小鼠表現出增強的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，而 SIRT1 的缺失升高 UCP2 並損害此反應。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 UCP2 下調導致更強的胰島素分泌。這將 SIRT1 與改善的葡萄糖穩態和對糖尿病的保護聯繫起來，與熱量限制（提高 SIRT1）在衰老機體中保留 β 細胞功能和胰島素敏感性的觀察一致。

label: Cardiac Function
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: A strong beneficial effect of nicotinamide riboside (NR) was discovered in mouse models of heart failure, with preservation of cardiac function and limitation of cardiac remodeling, effects that were associated with maintained NAD+ levels in the heart. NR supplementation normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio and, by improving NAD+ homeostasis and activating NMRK2, can prevent the deterioration of cardiac function and adverse remodeling in a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy leading to heart failure.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠心力衰竭模型中發現菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）具有強大的有益效果，可維持心臟功能並限制心臟重塑，這些效應與心臟中維持的 NAD+ 水平相關。NR 補充能使心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，並透過改善 NAD+ 恆定與活化 NMRK2，可預防導致心力衰竭的擴張型心肌病小鼠模型中心臟功能惡化與不良重塑。

label: CD157
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD157, also called bone marrow stromal cell antigen 1 (BST1), is a glycohydrolase that participates in NAD+ precursor metabolism. It hydrolyzes nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which is then further metabolized by gut microbiota into nicotinic acid and routed through the Preiss-Handler pathway to NAD+. In addition, CD157 displays base-exchange activity against both NR and niacin riboside (NAR), interconverting amidated and deamidated precursor pathways. This dual activity means CD157 not only diverts NR toward the deamidated route but also links the two branches of NAD+ biosynthesis, providing alternative substrates that maintain intracellular NAD+ levels depending on tissue and dietary context.
description_zh_TW: CD157，又稱骨髓基質細胞抗原1（BST1），是一種參與NAD+前體代謝的糖水解酶。它將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）水解為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），隨後由腸道微生物群進一步代謝為菸鹼酸，並經由Preiss-Handler途徑進入NAD+。此外，CD157對NR與菸鹼酸核糖苷（NAR）均展現鹼基交換活性，使醯胺化與去醯胺化的前體途徑相互轉換。這種雙重活性意味著CD157不僅將NR導向去醯胺化路線，也連結NAD+生合成的兩個分支，提供替代受質，依組織與飲食背景維持細胞內NAD+水平。

label: CD38 knockdown
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD38 knockdown in mice suppressed axon degeneration, demyelination, and immune cell infiltration after facial nerve axotomy compared with wild-type mice, identifying CD38 as a candidate molecule for regulating neurodegeneration. Correspondingly, intraperitoneal injection of NR at 400 mg/kg once daily for 1 week prior to facial nerve axotomy delayed axon degeneration and demyelination and significantly increased NAD+ levels in the facial nucleus and facial nerve of wild-type mice. These findings connect the age-related rise in CD38 activity to NAD+ depletion and axonal vulnerability, and show that NAD+ precursor supplementation can mimic the protection achieved by CD38 deletion.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠中 CD38 敲低與野生型小鼠相比，抑制了面神經軸突切斷後的軸突退化、髓鞘脫失與免疫細胞浸潤，將 CD38 確認為調節神經退化的候選分子。相應地，在面神經軸突切斷前，以 400 mg/kg 的 NR 每日一次腹腔注射一週，延遲了軸突退化與髓鞘脫失，並顯著提升野生型小鼠面神經核與面神經中的 NAD+ 水平。這些發現將年齡相關的 CD38 活性上升與 NAD+ 耗竭及軸突脆弱性相連結，並顯示 NAD+ 前體補充能模擬 CD38 缺失所達成的保護作用。

label: Glucose Tolerance
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: In mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) increases NAD+ metabolism and thereby improves glucose tolerance, reduces weight gain, and exhibits neuroprotective effects against diabetic neuropathy and liver steatosis. NR also restores the significantly decreased hepatic NADP+ and NADPH levels seen in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice, both of which are important for resistance to oxidative stress. These benefits are mediated in part through activation of SIRT1, which promotes glucose-stimulated insulin secretion from pancreatic beta-cells and protects against insulin resistance in peripheral tissues.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠模型中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）可提升 NAD+ 代謝，進而改善葡萄糖耐受性、減少體重增加，並對糖尿病神經病變與肝臟脂肪變性展現神經保護作用。NR 亦能恢復糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中顯著下降的肝臟 NADP+ 與 NADPH 濃度，兩者皆對抵抗氧化壓力至關重要。這些益處部分透過活化 SIRT1 所介導，SIRT1 可促進胰島 beta 細胞的葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌，並保護周邊組織免於胰島素抗性。

label: Hepatocyte Replication
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: In the regenerating liver, nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to a faster regaining of liver weight in mice. This hepatoprotective and regenerative effect is tied to NAD+ biosynthesis, which supports the energy-producing and biosynthetic demands of liver regeneration. In addition, dietary NR supplementation restored NAD+ levels that were depressed by impaired biosynthesis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma, preventing both DNA damage and tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 在再生肝臟中，菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，使小鼠更快恢復肝臟重量。這種肝保護與再生作用與 NAD+ 生物合成有關，後者支持肝臟再生所需的能量產生與生物合成需求。此外，飲食補充 NR 恢復了因生物合成受損而下降的 NAD+ 水平，在肝細胞癌小鼠模型中同時防止了 DNA 損傷與腫瘤發生。

label: PARylation
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Increased PARylation is a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, and it could be decreased in AD mice with nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation. Increased PARylation has also been detected in several other neurodegenerative disorders that involve DNA repair defects, including Cockayne syndrome, xeroderma pigmentosum, and ataxia-telangiectasia, where PARP-mediated NAD+ depletion plays a major role in pathogenesis. Despite the underlying DNA repair deficiencies, NR dramatically improved the phenotype of each of these conditions in mouse models, prolonging survival by more than three times in ataxic mice.
description_zh_TW: PARylation（聚 ADP-核糖基化）增加是阿茲海默症的標記，且可透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充在 AD 小鼠中降低。PARylation 增加亦在數種涉及 DNA 修復缺陷的其他神經退化性疾病中被偵測到，包括 Cockayne 症候群、xeroderma pigmentosum（著色性乾皮症）與 ataxia-telangiectasia（共濟失調毛細血管擴張症），其中 PARP 介導的 NAD+ 耗竭在致病機轉中扮演主要角色。儘管存在潛在的 DNA 修復缺陷，NR 在小鼠模型中顯著改善了這些疾病的每一種表型，在共濟失調小鼠中將存活期延長超過三倍。

label: Faecalibacterium
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Long-term nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation modulates gut microbiota composition in humans, increasing the abundance of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii. In a twin study, NR at 250-1000 mg/day for 5 months raised F. prausnitzii abundance, and association analysis suggested this bacterium contributes to regulation of NAD+, inflammation, amino acid, and lipid metabolism. Faecalibacterium prausnitzii is a butyrate-producing commensal that promotes metabolic health and anti-inflammatory responses, and its decline characterizes dysbiosis in inflammatory bowel disease. NR's ability to enrich this beneficial organism supports its role in improving gut and systemic health through microbiota modulation.
description_zh_TW: 長期補充菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）調節人類腸道菌叢組成，增加 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii 的豐度。在一項雙生子研究中，每天 250-1000 mg NR 持續 5 個月提升了 F. prausnitzii 豐度，且關聯分析顯示此細菌有助於調節 NAD+、發炎、胺基酸與脂質代謝。Faecalibacterium prausnitzii 是一種產丁酸的共生菌，促進代謝健康與抗發炎反應，其減少是發炎性腸道疾病中菌叢失調的特徵。NR 富集此有益生物的能力支持其透過菌叢調節改善腸道與全身健康的角色。

label: Biomarker
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: NAAD (nicotinic acid adenine dinucleotide) is a product of NR utilization in humans and a biomarker of increased NAD+ metabolism. NR supplementation raised NAAD by 4.5-fold in blood, and healthy middle-aged adults taking 1 g/day NR for 6 weeks showed around a fivefold increase in blood NAAD. In another study, NAAD was undetectable before NR supplementation but increased by approximately 2,900% after single doses of up to 1 g NR. These findings corroborate studies in mice showing that the deamidated Preiss-Handler pathway predominates after NR intake, making NAAD a sensitive readout of the deamidated route of NAD+ precursor metabolism.
description_zh_TW: NAAD（菸鹼酸腺嘌呤二核苷酸）是 NR 在人體中利用的產物，也是 NAD+ 代謝增加的生物標記。NR 補充使血液中 NAAD 提升 4.5 倍，而每天攝取 1 g NR 達 6 週的健康中年人，其血液 NAAD 增加約五倍。在另一項研究中，NAAD 在 NR 補充前無法檢出，但在單次高達 1 g NR 劑量後增加了約 2,900%。這些發現佐證了小鼠研究中顯示 NR 攝取後去醯胺化 Preiss-Handler 路徑佔主導地位，使 NAAD 成為 NAD+ 前驅物代謝去醯胺化途徑的敏感讀值。

label: GPR109A
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) administration can elevate NAD+ levels in mammalian cells and tissues without activating GPR109A, the receptor that mediates nicotinic acid-induced flushing, which is why NR is not associated with the painful flushing side effect seen with niacin. Although nicotinic acid (NA) and nicotinamide (NAM) can enter the NAD+ salvage pathway, several preclinical studies have confirmed that both can cause painful flushing sensations at therapeutic doses or other toxic effects. NR, in contrast, was confirmed across a number of studies as well-tolerated up to 2 g of a daily dose, with no flushing or severe side effects reported.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）給藥能提升哺乳動物細胞與組織中的 NAD+ 水平，而無須活化 GPR109A（介導 nicotinic acid 誘發潮紅的受體），這就是為何 NR 與 niacin（菸鹼酸）所見的疼痛性潮紅副作用無關。儘管 nicotinic acid（NA）與 nicotinamide（NAM）能進入 NAD+ 回收路徑，數項臨床前研究已確認兩者皆可在治療劑量下造成疼痛性潮紅感或其他毒性作用。相對地，NR 在眾多研究中被確認每日劑量高達 2 g 仍耐受良好，且無潮紅或嚴重副作用的報告。

label: Lactobacillus
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These bacteria are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune support. NR also modulates gut microbiota in ways protective against high-fat diet-induced weight gain: mice fed 60% HFD with 0.4% NR for 168 days had nearly 16% less weight gain and lower fasting blood glucose, and fecal transfer from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective effect with a microbiota enriched in butyrate-producing Firmicutes. NR thus reshapes the microbiome to favor metabolically beneficial bacteria.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些細菌與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及免疫支持。NR 也以對抗高脂飲食誘發體重增加的方式調節腸道菌叢：以含 0.4% NR 的 60% HFD 餵食 168 天的小鼠，體重增加減少近 16% 且空腹血糖較低，而來自 NR 處理供體的糞便移植重現了此保護效應，其菌叢富含產丁酸的 Firmicutes。NR 因此重塑微生物組以偏好代謝有益的細菌。

label: Noise-Induced Hearing Loss
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) has been shown to prevent noise-induced hearing loss and neurite retraction from hair cells in the inner ear through a SIRT3-dependent mechanism, in which the NR-induced increase in NAD+ supports the activity of the mitochondrial deacetylase SIRT3. This illustrates the broader neuroprotective and therapeutic potential of NR, which also protects neurons from excitotoxicity-induced axonal degeneration and preserves axonal NAD+ content. SIRT3 activity is sensitive to the reduction of NAD+ content detected in multiple disorders with retinal degeneration, and NR may therefore have therapeutic applications for a variety of sensory and neurodegenerative conditions.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）已被證實透過 SIRT3 依賴性機制預防噪音誘發的聽力喪失與內耳毛細胞的 neurite retraction（神經突退縮），其中 NR 誘發的 NAD+ 提升支持了粒線體去乙醯酶 SIRT3 的活性。這說明了 NR 更廣泛的神經保護與治療潛力，其亦保護神經元免於興奮毒性誘發的軸突退化並保留軸突 NAD+ 含量。SIRT3 活性對多種伴隨視網膜退化的疾病中所偵測到的 NAD+ 含量降低相當敏感，因此 NR 可能對各種感覺與神經退化性疾病具有治療應用價值。

label: NAD+ Precursor
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is one of the most studied nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) precursors, and it is the third NAD+ precursor discovered, naturally occurring in milk and already commercially available as a nutraceutical. Alongside nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), NR feeds into NAD+ biosynthetic salvage pathways and is regarded as a favorable precursor because it lacks the serious side effects and flushing attributed to other NAD+ precursors, and because its chloride salt has been granted GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）是研究最廣泛的菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD+）前驅物之一，也是被發現的第三種 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品商業化供應。與菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）以及菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）並列，NR 進入 NAD+ 生物合成補救途徑，被視為一種理想的前驅物，因為它沒有歸因於其他 NAD+ 前驅物的嚴重副作用與潮紅反應，且其氯化物鹽已被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe）地位。

label: Milk
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is the third discovered NAD+ precursor and naturally occurs in milk, and it is already available as a nutraceutical, with its chloride salt given GRAS (generally regarded as safe) status. NAD+ intermediates such as NR are found in a wide variety of foods, including meat, eggs, dairy, certain vegetables, and whole wheat, and high availability of NR has been observed in the normal human diet. Oral supplementation with NR has been shown to increase NAD+ levels in multiple tissues along with increased sirtuin activity, improved mitochondrial function, and regenerative potential of stem cells, making NR a leading candidate among NAD+ precursors.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）是第三個被發現的 NAD+ 前驅物，天然存在於牛奶中，且已作為營養補充品可供使用，其氯化鹽被授予 GRAS（generally regarded as safe，一般認為安全）地位。諸如 NR 之類的 NAD+ 中間產物存在於多種食物中，包括肉類、蛋、乳製品、某些蔬菜與全麥，且在正常人類飲食中觀察到 NR 的高可用性。口服 NR 補充已被證實能提升多種組織中的 NAD+ 水平，同時伴隨 sirtuin 活性增加、粒線體功能改善與幹細胞的再生潛力，使 NR 成為 NAD+ 前驅物中的領先候選者。

label: Alcohol-Induced Depression
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) protects against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors in mice by altering gut microbiota composition. Dietary supplementation with NR for 10 weeks at 400 mg/kg daily reduced both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels, inhibited microglial activation, and provided protection against alcohol-induced depression-like behaviors. The effect was attributed to NR's ability to upregulate brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) through microbiota changes: brain BDNF levels correlated positively with bacteria enriched in the NR group such as Barnesiella, Alloprevotella, Prevotella, Alistipes, and Mucispirillum. Fecal microbiota transplantation from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective features in germ-free recipients, demonstrating a gut-microbiota-gut-brain axis mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）透過改變腸道菌叢組成，保護小鼠免於酒精誘發的類憂鬱行為。以每天 400 mg/kg NR 飲食補充 10 週，降低了促發炎與抗發炎細胞激素水平，抑制小膠質細胞活化，並提供對酒精誘發類憂鬱行為的保護。此效應歸因於 NR 透過菌叢改變上調腦源性神經營養因子（BDNF）的能力：腦部 BDNF 水平與 NR 組中富集的細菌如 Barnesiella、Alloprevotella、Prevotella、Alistipes 和 Mucispirillum 呈正相關。來自 NR 處理供體的糞便微生物移植在無菌受體中重現了保護特徵，證明了腸道菌叢—腸—腦軸機制。

label: Hepatic Steatosis
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces lipid accumulation and liver steatosis in mouse models, effects that are mediated through induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response and through SIRT1 activation, which promotes fatty acid oxidation and inhibits lipogenesis, protecting the liver from steatosis. NR also restores hepatic NADP+ and NADPH in prediabetic and type 2 diabetic mice and reduces cholesterol levels via SIRT1 and cholesterol-homeostasis factors. Sirtuins are downregulated in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), a hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome associated with type 2 diabetes, obesity, and insulin resistance, so raising NAD+ with NR
description_zh_TW: 煙酰胺核糖（NR）在小鼠模型中減少脂質堆積與肝臟脂肪變性，這些效應是透過誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應以及透過 SIRT1 活化所介導，後者促進脂肪酸氧化並抑制脂肪生成，保護肝臟免於脂肪變性。NR 也會在糖尿病前期與第二型糖尿病小鼠中恢復肝臟的 NADP+ 與 NADPH，並透過 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定因子降低膽固醇水平。Sirtuins 在非酒精性脂肪肝病（NAFLD）患者中表現下調，NAFLD 是與第二型糖尿病、肥胖和胰島素抵抗相關的代謝症候群的肝臟表現，因此以 NR 提升 NAD+

label: Cardiac Remodeling
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation exhibits protective effects in adverse cardiac remodeling and prevents the deterioration of cardiac function and adverse remodeling in a mouse model of dilated cardiomyopathy leading to heart failure. NR normalizes the myocardial NAD+/NADH ratio, and long-term supplementation increases nucleocytoplasmic protein acetylation by stimulating citrate and acetyl-CoA metabolism and antioxidant gene expression. NAD+ precursor supplementation also protects against adverse cardiac remodeling by activating sirtuins and maintaining Ca2+ homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充在不良心臟重塑中展現保護作用，並在導致心衰竭的擴張型心肌病小鼠模型中預防心臟功能惡化與不良重塑。NR 使心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，而長期補充透過刺激檸檬酸與 acetyl-CoA 代謝以及抗氧化基因表現，增加核質蛋白乙醯化。NAD+ 前驅物補充亦透過活化 sirtuins 與維持 Ca2+ 恆定，保護免受不良心臟重塑。

label: Arterial Stiffness
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces aortic stiffness and systolic blood pressure, both clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These NR-induced effects may occur via nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, because NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which maintains healthy vascular function and promotes endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation through endothelial nitric oxide synthase. description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低主動脈僵硬與收縮壓，兩者皆為心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些由 NR 誘發的效應可能透過核內與胞質 SIRT1 活化而產生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 可維持健康血管功能並透過 endothelial nitric oxide synthase 促進內皮依賴性血管舒張。動脈僵硬的降低與 NR 更廣泛的心血管益處一致，NR 可將心肌 NAD+/NADH 比值正常化，並在心力衰竭與擴張型心肌病模型中維持心臟功能，支持

label: Systolic Blood Pressure
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation reduces systolic blood pressure (SBP) and aortic stiffness, two clinically important risk indicators of cardiovascular function and health. These effects may occur through nuclear and cytosolic SIRT1 activation, since NAD+ is an obligate substrate for the deacetylase SIRT1, which has been implicated in the maintenance of healthy vascular function, including endothelium-dependent vascular relaxation. In mouse models, NR-induced reduction of SBP and aortic stiffness was documented alongside improved NAD+ homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）補充可降低收縮壓（SBP）與主動脈僵硬程度，這兩者是心血管功能與健康的臨床重要風險指標。這些效應可能經由核內與胞質中的 SIRT1 活化而發生，因為 NAD+ 是去乙醯酶 SIRT1 的必需受質，而 SIRT1 已被認為參與維持健康的血管功能，包括內皮依賴性血管舒張。在小鼠模型中，NR 誘發的 SBP 與主動脈僵硬程度降低，伴隨 NAD+ 恆定性的改善而被記錄下來。

label: Bovine Milk
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was first discovered in milk and, until recently, had only been measured there. Bovine milk contains the highest NR content among milk sources at 0.5-3.6 uM, while human milk is the richest source of nicotinamide mononucleotide at 2.1-9.8 uM. NR and NMN are also determined in different species of milk and beer. The niacin quantified by microbiological assay (AOAC Method 944.13) actually includes NR and NMN, because hot acid or alkaline extraction hydrolyzes these molecules into nicotinic acid, meaning NR and NMN contribute to the measured niacin content of milk and other foods.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）最早在牛奶中被發現，且直到最近都只在那裡被測得。牛乳在乳源中 NR 含量最高，達 0.5-3.6 uM，而人乳是菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。NR 和 NMN 也在不同物種的乳汁與啤酒中被測定。以微生物分析法（AOAC Method 944.13）定量出的菸鹼酸實際上包含 NR 和 NMN，因為熱酸或鹼性萃取會將這些分子水解為菸鹼酸，意味著 NR 和 NMN 貢獻了牛奶與其他食物中測得的菸鹼酸含量。

label: Macrophage Infiltration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Preclinical studies have reported that nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces macrophage infiltration in damaged muscles and attenuates plasma TNF-alpha in models of fatty liver disease. These anti-inflammatory effects contribute to the improvement of metabolism and the decrease in chronic inflammation, a hallmark of aging, that underlie the life-prolonging benefits attributed to NR supplementation. Macrophage infiltration into injured tissue promotes inflammation and fibrosis, and its reduction by NR supports the management of muscular dystrophy and age-related tissue degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 臨床前研究報導，nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）減少受損肌肉中的巨噬細胞浸潤，並在脂肪肝疾病模型中減弱血漿 TNF-alpha。這些抗發炎效果有助於代謝改善與慢性發炎（老化的標記）的降低，而後者構成了歸因於 NR 補充的延壽益處的基礎。巨噬細胞浸潤受傷組織會促進發炎與纖維化，而 NR 對其的減少支持了肌肉營養不良與年齡相關組織退化的管理。

label: Glycated proteins
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

label: Ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
