label: Matrine
description: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
description_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

label: SIRT3/OPA1 pathway
description: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.
description_zh_TW: Matrine 是來自苦參的喹諾里西啶生物鹼。它透過 SIRT3/OPA1 途徑調節粒線體膜動態對抗 Cisplatin 誘導的 AKI 發揮保護作用，並透過 SIRT3/AMPK 途徑賦予心血管益處，維護心肌細胞存活率並限制細胞死亡。

label: UUO-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis
description: The SIRT6 activator MDL-800 mitigates unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO)-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis, validating SIRT6 activation therapeutically. Directionally, MDL-800 activates SIRT6, which protects the kidney. This complements other evidence that SIRT6 restrains TGF-β/Smad3 fibrogenesis and NF-κB-mediated inflammation. It supports SIRT6 as a target for chronic kidney disease, where tubulointerstitial fibrosis determines outcome. The efficacy of a pharmacologic SIRT6 activator in a standard fibrosis model provides important proof-of-concept for SIRT6-based therapies in renal and fibrotic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 活化因子 MDL-800 減輕單側輸尿管阻塞（UUO）誘導的腎小管間質發炎和纖維化，在治療上驗證了 SIRT6 活化。在方向性上，MDL-800 活化 SIRT6，SIRT6 保護腎臟。這與 SIRT6 限制 TGF-β/Smad3 纖維化和 NF-κB 介導發炎的其他證據互補。它支持 SIRT6 作為慢性腎病的靶點，在該疾病中小管間質纖維化決定預後。藥理性 SIRT6 活化因子在標準纖維化模型中的療效為基於 SIRT6 的腎臟和纖維化疾病療法提供了重要的概念驗證。

label: Glucose
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: AGE formation begins when glucose attaches in a non-enzymatic fashion to a free amino acid on a protein, lipid, or DNA molecule, with lysine and arginine being the main targets, forming a reversible Schiff base within hours. Whether the reaction proceeds depends on glucose concentration, and it reverses if glucose levels drop. This first step is the entry point of the Maillard reaction that ultimately yields advanced glycation end products. Because glucose preferentially modifies lysine and arginine residues, these amino acids are the principal sites of protein glycation, and their modification contributes to the accumulation of AGEs in long-lived structural proteins.
description_zh_TW: AGE formation begins when glucose attaches in a non-enzymatic fashion to a free amino acid on a protein、lipid或DNA molecule，其中以lysine與arginine為main targets，在hours內形成reversible Schiff base。Whether the reaction proceeds depends on glucose concentration，若glucose levels drop則reverses。此first step是Maillard reaction的entry point，ultimately yields advanced glycation end products。由於glucose preferentially modifies lysine與arginine residues，這些amino acids是protein glycation的principal sites，其modification contributes to AGEs在long-lived structural proteins中的accumulation。

label: One-carbon compound
description: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) is a one-carbon compound formally classified as a member of the guanidines. Its compact scaffold, which can be viewed as a derivative of hydrazine, guanidine, or formamide, gives it both nucleophilic and carbonyl-reactive chemistry. One-carbon compounds serve as minimal scaffolds in drug design, and here the nitrogen-dense core endows the molecule with the enzyme-inhibitory and advanced glycation end product-blocking activities for which aminoguanidine, also known as pimagedine, is studied in diabetic complications research.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine (CH6N4, PubChem CID 2146, molecular weight 74.09 g/mol) 是一種一碳化合物，正式歸類為胍類化合物的一員。其緊湊的骨架可被視為肼、胍或甲醯胺的衍生物，賦予其親核性和羰基反應性化學特性。一碳化合物在藥物設計中充當最小骨架，此處富含氮的核心賦予該分子酶抑制和晚期糖基化終產物阻斷活性，因此 aminoguanidine（亦稱為 pimagedine）在糖尿病併發症研究中受到關注。

label: Formamide
description: Aminoguanidine can be regarded as a derivative of formamide, reflecting the one-carbon backbone that links its nitrogenous substituents. This formal relationship to formamide, a simple one-carbon amide, is used in chemistry databases to classify the compound's scaffold. Functionally the molecule behaves as a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative rather than an amide, but the formamide classification highlights the single-carbon core that makes aminoguanidine one of the smallest enzyme-inhibitory drugs, with a molecular weight of only 74.09 g/mol and zero rotatable bonds.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 可視為甲醯胺的衍生物，反映了連結其含氮取代基的單碳骨架。這種與甲醯胺（一種簡單的單碳醯胺）的形式關係，用於化學資料庫中對該化合物骨架的分類。在功能上，該分子表現為親核性肼衍生物而非醯胺，但甲醯胺分類凸顯了使 aminoguanidine 成為最小酵素抑制藥物之一的單碳核心，其分子量僅 74.09 g/mol 且無可旋轉鍵。

label: CH6N4
description: Aminoguanidine has the molecular formula CH6N4, a one-carbon core with four nitrogen atoms and six hydrogens, giving a molecular weight of 74.09 g/mol and an exact mass of 74.059246 Da. The nitrogen-dense structure is responsible for the compound's basicity and nucleophilicity, enabling its hydrazine- and guanidine-like reactivity toward carbonyls and enzyme active sites. As one of the smallest enzyme inhibitors known, this compact scaffold underlies aminoguanidine's broad, non-selective interactions with proteins and reactive carbonyl species.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine的分子式為CH6N4，具有一個含四個氮原子和六個氫原子的單碳核心，分子量為74.09 g/mol，精確質量為74.059246 Da。其富氮結構負責該化合物的鹼性與親核性，使其對羰基和酶活性位點具有肼和胍樣反應性。作為已知最小的酶抑制劑之一，此緊湊支架奠定了aminoguanidine與蛋白質及活性羰基物種的廣泛非選擇性相互作用。

label: Hydrazine
description: Aminoguanidine is a structural derivative of hydrazine, retaining the N-N bond that confers strong nucleophilicity and the ability to trap reactive carbonyl species. Hydrazine derivatives are classically used as carbonyl-trapping agents, and this chemistry is central to aminoguanidine's ability to intercept dicarbonyl intermediates that drive advanced glycation end product formation. The hydrazine-like reactivity underlies both its AGE-inhibitory pharmacology and its off-target enzyme inhibition, including monoamine oxidase inhibition, which parallels the mechanism of classic hydrazine-based MAO inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine是肼的結構衍生物，保留了賦予強親核性並能捕獲活性羰基物質的N-N鍵。肼衍生物經典地用作羰基捕獲試劑，這種化學特性是Aminoguanidine截斷驅動晚期糖化終產物（AGE）形成的二羰基中間體的關鍵。肼樣反應性構成了其AGE抑制藥理學和脫靶酶抑制（包括單胺氧化酶抑制）的基礎，其機制與經典基於肼的MAO抑制劑相似。

label: Enzyme Inhibitors
description: Aminoguanidine is classified under the MeSH pharmacological class of enzyme inhibitors, defined as compounds or agents that combine with an enzyme in such a manner as to prevent the normal substrate-enzyme combination and the catalytic reaction. Aminoguanidine fits this class through multiple activities: it inhibits monoamine oxidase, nitric oxide synthase, diamine oxidase, and aldose reductase. The enzyme-inhibitor classification captures the mechanism by which this small hydrazine derivative exerts both its therapeutic AGE-modulating effects and its broader off-target pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 被歸類於 MeSH 藥理學類別中的酵素抑制劑（enzyme inhibitors），其定義為與酵素結合以阻止正常底物-酵素結合及催化反應的化合物或試劑。Aminoguanidine 透過多種活性符合此分類：它可抑制 monoamine oxidase、nitric oxide synthase、diamine oxidase 及 aldose reductase。此酵素抑制劑分類捕捉了這類小型 hydrazine 衍生物發揮其治療性 AGE 調節效應及其更廣泛的脫靶藥理學的機制。

label: Guanidine
description: Aminoguanidine is described as a derivative of guanidine, sharing the basic guanidinium group that is protonated at physiological pH and contributes to strong hydrogen bonding and protein binding. Guanidine derivatives are common pharmacophores in enzyme inhibitors, and in aminoguanidine the guanidinium moiety combined with a hydrazine-like amino terminus generates a bifunctional molecule that can interact with enzyme active sites and dicarbonyl species. This dual functionality underpins its role as a monoamine oxidase and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor used to manage diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 被描述為胍的衍生物，共享在生理 pH 下被質子化、並有助於強氫鍵結和蛋白質結合的鹼性胍鎓基團。胍衍生物是酵素抑制劑中常見的藥效團，在 aminoguanidine 中，胍鎓部分與肼樣胺端基結合，產生一個可與酵素活性位點和二羰基物種互動的雙功能分子。這種雙重功能支撐了它作為 monoamine oxidase 和 nitric oxide synthase 抑制劑、用於管理糖尿病併發症的角色。

label: Guanidines
description: Aminoguanidine is formally a member of the guanidines, a chemical family built around the guanidinium group that is highly basic and forms strong bidentate hydrogen bonds with biological anions. Membership in this class is pharmacologically meaningful because guanidines frequently appear in drugs that interact with amine-handling enzymes and ion channels. In aminoguanidine the guanidine scaffold supplies the positively charged center that contributes to binding and enzyme inhibition relevant to its application as a diamine oxidase, monoamine oxidase, and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor in diabetic complications research.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine formally belongs to the guanidines, a chemical family built around the guanidinium group, which is highly basic and can form strong bidentate hydrogen bonds with biological anions. Membership in this class is pharmacologically meaningful because guanidines frequently appear in drugs that interact with amine-handling enzymes and ion channels. In aminoguanidine, the guanidine scaffold supplies the positively charged center that contributes to binding and enzyme inhibition relevant to its application as a diamine oxidase, monoamine oxidase, and nitric oxide synthase inhibitor in diabetic complications research.

label: Aldose reductase
description: Pimagedine (aminoguanidine) reportedly inhibits the formation of glycosylated proteins and has additional actions including inhibition of aldose reductase. Aldose reductase is the polyol-pathway enzyme that converts glucose to sorbitol and is implicated in diabetic complications, so its inhibition is itself a therapeutic goal in diabetes. This polypharmacology, combining AGE inhibition with MAO, iNOS, diamine oxidase, and aldose reductase blockade, means that aminoguanidine's benefits and side effects in diabetic models cannot be attributed to a single molecular target.
description_zh_TW: Pimagedine（aminoguanidine）據報導可抑制糖基化蛋白的形成，並具有包括抑制醛糖還原酶在內的額外作用。Aldose reductase 是將葡萄糖轉化為山梨醇的多元醇途徑酵素，與糖尿病併發症有關，因此其抑制本身即是糖尿病中的治療目標。這種多藥理學——結合 AGE 抑制與 MAO、iNOS、diamine oxidase 和 aldose reductase 阻斷——意味著 aminoguanidine 在糖尿病模型中的益處和副作用不能歸因於單一分子標靶。

label: Synvista Therapeutics
description: Pimagedine, the international nonproprietary name for aminoguanidine, was developed by Synvista Therapeutics, Inc. for the treatment of diabetic kidney disease. Synvista was the company that advanced aminoguanidine into clinical testing as an advanced glycation end product inhibitor. The development trajectory of this simple one-carbon molecule illustrates how basic carbonyl-trapping chemistry was translated into a candidate therapy for diabetic complications, although the compound ultimately did not progress beyond Phase 2 clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: Pimagedine是aminoguanidine的國際非專利名稱，由Synvista Therapeutics, Inc.開發用於治療糖尿病腎病。Synvista是將aminoguanidine作為晚期糖化終產物抑制劑推向臨床試驗的公司。這種簡樸的一碳分子的開發歷程，展示了基礎的羰基捕獲化學如何被轉化為糖尿病併發症的候選療法，但該化合物最終未能通過第二階段臨床試驗。

label: Phase 2
description: The drug development summary for aminoguanidine (pimagedine) lists a maximum clinical phase of Phase 2, meaning the compound advanced into controlled efficacy testing but did not progress to late-stage or marketed status. Clinical evaluation focused on diabetic kidney disease and other diabetic complications, where AGE inhibition was hypothesized to be renoprotective. Reaching Phase 2 established proof-of-mechanism interest in AGE inhibitors as therapeutics, even though aminoguanidine itself was not ultimately approved for clinical use.
description_zh_TW: 藥物開發摘要中，aminoguanidine（pimagedine）列出的最高臨床階段為第二階段，意指該化合物已進入控制性療效測試，但未進展至晚期或上市狀態。臨床評估著重於糖尿病腎病變及其他糖尿病併發症，其中AGE抑制被假定具有腎臟保護作用。達到第二階段確立了AGE抑制劑作為治療藥物的作用機制驗證興趣，即使aminoguanidine最終未獲批准用於臨床。

label: Alagebrium
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
description_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

label: Survival
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: A number of different studies with diabetic rats indicate that aminoguanidine-administered rats have significantly superior survival rates than untreated animals. Aminoguanidine prolongs survival in azotemic-induced diabetic rats, and it prevents age-related arterial stiffening and cardiac hypertrophy in animals. Human trials indicate aminoguanidine has very low toxicity and appears safe to use at normal dosages, with side effects limited to nausea and headache, although there is still relatively little human data and clinical trials, and broad anti-aging claims rest largely on animal and early human data rather than definitive clinical outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 多項針對糖尿病大鼠的研究表明，給予氨基胍的鼠，與未經處理的動物相比，存活率顯著優異。氨基胍延長了在氮質性糖尿病大鼠中的存活時間，並能預防在動物中出現與年齡相關的動脈僵硬和心肌肥大。人類臨床試驗表明，氨基胍毒性極低，在正常劑量下使用時似乎安全，副作用主要為噁心和頭痛，儘管人類數據和臨床試驗仍然相對有限，而且廣泛的抗衰老聲稱主要依賴動物和早期人類數據，而非明確的臨床結果。

label: Histamine Intolerance
description: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the enzyme that breaks down histamine in the gut. By blocking intestinal DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods - aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods - may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This is a major safety consideration for oral aminoguanidine use in supplement or experimental settings.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二胺氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，該酶在腸道中分解組胺。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可顯著增加對膳食組胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組胺食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這對於口服氨基胍在補充劑或實驗設定中使用來說是一個主要安全考量。

label: Diamine Oxidase
description: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the intestinal enzyme that breaks down histamine. By blocking gut DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods) may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This histamine-sensitivity risk is a major safety consideration for oral use of aminoguanidine.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二氨基酸氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，這是分解組織胺的腸道酶。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可以顯著增加對膳食組織胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組織胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組織胺的食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這種組織胺敏感的風險是口服氨基胍使用的主要安全考量。

label: Endothelial Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: Aminoguanidine selectively inhibits only the inducible form of nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) rather than the healthy endothelial form (eNOS). This selectivity is considered advantageous because it can halt the inflammatory overproduction of nitric oxide - which causes excessive vasodilation, vascular leakage, and tissue damage - without completely shutting down normal blood-pressure regulation maintained by eNOS-derived NO. This contrasts with non-selective NOS inhibition, making aminoguanidine a theoretically more targeted anti-inflammatory intervention.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍具有选择性地抑制诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）而非健康型内皮型一氧化氮合酶（eNOS）。这种选择性被认为是具有优势的，因为它能够阻止一氧化氮的过度产生（导致过度血管舒张、血管渗漏和组织损伤）而不完全关闭由eNOS衍生的正常血压调节。这与非选择性NOS抑制剂不同，使得氨基胍成为一种理论上更具针对性的抗炎干预措施。

label: Very Low Density Lipoprotein
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Studies conducted at the University of Milan over 25 years showed that aminoguanidine reduces the ability of very low density lipoprotein (VLDL), the bad form of cholesterol, to bind itself to blood vessel walls, in tests on animals. In turn, blood platelets are less likely to coagulate and form dangerous clots. Aminoguanidine's role in reducing VLDL cholesterol and its ability to stabilize glucose metabolism indicate it has a wide-reaching ability to help prevent and treat a number of aging disorders.
description_zh_TW: 米蘭大學二十五年來的研究表明，氨基胍降低非常低密度脂蛋白 (VLDL)，即壞膽固醇的形式，與血管壁結合的能力，在動物實驗中有效。 此外，血小板更不活躍，也更不容易形成危險血栓。 氨基胍在降低 VLDL 膽固醇和穩定葡萄糖代謝方面的作用，以及其穩定代謝的能力，表明它具有廣泛的抗衰老和治療多種衰老疾病的能力。

label: Albuminuria
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Trials conducted by the Alteon Corporation indicate that aminoguanidine can significantly reduce albuminuria, proteins present in urine usually as a result of kidney disease, delay the onset of end-stage renal disease, and improve the cholesterol profiles of diabetic patients. Diabetic clinical trials have also highlighted aminoguanidine's ability to prevent oxidative modification of LDL and inhibit the formation of atherosclerotic plaques. A number of studies with diabetic rats indicate that aminoguanidine-administered rats have significantly superior survival rates than untreated animals.
description_zh_TW: 由 Alteon Corporation 進行的臨床試驗顯示，氨基胍可以顯著降低尿素氮，這是通常由腎臟疾病引起的蛋白質，延遲末期腎臟疾病的發病，並改善糖尿病患者的膽固醇型態。糖尿病臨床試驗也突顯了氨基胍預防氧化修飾 LDL 以及抑制動脈粥樣性變性斑塊的功效。多項關於糖尿病大鼠的研究表明，給予氨基胍的實驗鼠與未經治療的動物相比，存活率顯著更高。

label: Melatonin in DCM
description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

label: PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis
description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

label: methylation efficiency
description: MTHFD1 mutations can impact methylation efficiency similarly to MTHFR variants by limiting the flux of folate derivatives needed to generate 5-methyl-THF and SAMe, the methyl donor for COMT. Although less studied than MTHFR, loss-of-function changes in MTHFD1 can raise homocysteine and reduce methyl donor capacity, constraining catechol O-methylation. The effect indirectly burdens COMT by limiting its SAMe supply and can compound with other one-carbon pathway variants. MTHFD1 is therefore relevant to methylation-focused genetics and personalized medicine.
description_zh_TW: 與 MTHFR variants 類似，MTHFD1 mutations 可以透過限制生成 5-甲基-THF 和 SAMe（COMT 的 methyl donor）所需的 folate 衍生物的通量來影響 methylation efficiency。儘管比 MTHFR 研究較少，但 MTHFD1 的功能喪失變化可以提高同型半胱氨酸並降低 methyl donor 的容量，從而限制兒茶酚 O-甲基化。此效應透過限制 SAMe 的供應而間接加重 COMT 的負擔，並且可以與其他單碳途徑變體複合。因此，MTHFD1 與以甲基化為中心的遺傳學和個人化醫療相關。

label: MHY2245
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: MHY2245, a new SIRT1 inhibitor, exerts antitumor activity against ovarian cancer cells by blocking the pyruvate kinase M2/mTOR pathway. Directionally, MHY2245 sits upstream of suppressed PKM2/mTOR signaling and reduced ovarian cancer cell survival. By inhibiting SIRT1 and consequently the PKM2/mTOR pathway, MHY2245 curbs tumor-cell metabolism and growth. This supports SIRT1 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in ovarian cancer, where SIRT1 inhibition of HMGB1 also suppresses metastasis and angiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: MHY2245是一種新型SIRT1抑制劑，透過阻斷丙酮酸激酶M2/mTOR通路對卵巢癌細胞發揮抗腫瘤活性。方向上，MHY2245位於PKM2/mTOR訊號抑制和卵巢癌細胞存活降低的上游。透過抑制SIRT1及隨後的PKM2/mTOR通路，MHY2245限制腫瘤細胞的代謝和生長。這支持SIRT1抑制作為卵巢癌的治療策略，其中SIRT1對HMGB1的抑制也抑制了轉移和血管新生。

label: Microfluidic mobility shift assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The microfluidic mobility shift assay separates SIRT1 substrate and product peptides by differences in electrophoretic mobility caused by charge and mass changes upon lysine deacetylation, quantitating fluorescence of both peaks. The assay effectively separates neutral-acetylated substrate peptides from deacetylated products bearing an additional positive charge. Although it could support high-throughput screening, it is more suitable for hit confirmation and mechanistic studies. Directionally, it provides a label-based yet artifact-minimized readout of SIRT1 activity distinct from fluorophore-release assays.
description_zh_TW: 微流體遷移率位移測定透過離胺酸去乙醯化引起的電荷和質量變化所導致的電泳遷移率差異來分離 SIRT1 受質和產物胜肽，量化兩個峰的螢光。該測定有效地將中性乙醯化受質胜肽與帶有額外正電荷的去乙醯化產物分開。儘管它可用於高通量篩選，但更適合用於命中確認和機制研究。方向性上它提供了一種基於標記但假象最小化的 SIRT1 活性讀取方式，與螢光基團釋放測定不同。

label: Mitochondrial Uncoupling
description: Nicotinamide nucleotide transhydrogenase (NNT) uses the proton gradient to drive NADPH production from NADP+ and NADH. By linking redox state to the proton motive force, NNT connects to mitochondrial uncoupling and the NADPH pools used by antioxidant systems.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核苷酸轉氫酶（NNT）利用質子梯度從 NADP+ 與 NADH 驅動 NADPH 生成。透過將氧化還原狀態與質子動力相連結，NNT 與粒線體解偶聯及抗氧化系統使用的 NADPH 池相關。

label: Mitosis (G2/M phase)
description: SIRT2 protein levels rise dramatically as cells enter mitosis, and the enzyme is hyperphosphorylated at the G2/M boundary, timing its activity to chromosome condensation and division. This cell-cycle coupling links SIRT2 to proper mitotic progression and genomic stability, with the enzyme regulating both tubulin dynamics and chromatin state during division. Directionally, the G2/M transition drives SIRT2 upregulation and activation, and at mitotic exit the phosphatase CDC14B dephosphorylates SIRT2 to trigger its degradation. Loss or dysregulation of this mitotic peak is associated with aneuploidy, mitotic defects, and, in some cancers, genomic instability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 蛋白水平在細胞進入有絲分裂時急劇上升，該酶在 G2/M 邊界處被超磷酸化，將其活性時間定在染色體凝縮和分裂時。這種細胞週期偶聯將 SIRT2 與正確的有絲分裂進展和基因組穩定性聯繫起來，該酶在分裂期間同時調節微管動態和染色質狀態。在方向性上，G2/M 轉變驅動 SIRT2 上調和活化，在有絲分裂退出時磷酸酶 CDC14B 去磷酸化 SIRT2 以觸發其降解。此有絲分裂高峰的缺失或失調與非整倍性、有絲分裂缺陷以及某些癌症中的基因組不穩定性相關。

label: MPC
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and its expression increases across multiple senescence models including irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative senescence. Pharmacological inhibition of MPC with UK5099 reduces TCA cycle intermediates and increases lactate levels, consistent with impaired mitochondrial pyruvate import, and suppresses SASP gene expression and secretion without affecting cell cycle arrest. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated deletion of MPC1 similarly reduces SASP factors such as IL6 and IL8, identifying pyruvate import as the entry node of the mitochondrial metabolic axis controlling the SASP.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）將糖酵解產生的丙酮酸連結至三羧酸循環，其表達在多種衰老模型中增加，包括輻射誘導、doxorubicin誘導和複製性衰老。用UK5099對MPC進行藥理學抑制可降低三羧酸循環中間體並增加乳酸水平，符合粒線體丙酮酸輸入受損的特徵，並抑制SASP基因表達和分泌，而不影響細胞週期停滯。CRISPR-Cas9介導的MPC1缺失同樣減少SASP因子如IL6和IL8，確認丙酮酸輸入是控制SASP的粒線體代謝軸的進入節點。

label: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
community_name: MPTP and kainic acid neuronal damage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Mice lacking PGC-1α are markedly more sensitive to neuronal loss induced by MPTP, a dopaminergic toxin, and kainic acid, an excitotoxin, revealing PGC-1αs role in neuronal stress resistance. Because SIRT1 activates PGC-1α by deacetylation, this sensitivity indirectly implicates the SIRT1/PGC-1α axis in neuroprotection. Directionally, PGC-1α deficiency heightens vulnerability to these insults, while its activation confers resistance. Since PGC-1α drives mitochondrial biogenesis and antioxidant gene expression, protecting neurons through this axis is a proposed strategy against Parkinsons disease and other neurodegenerative disorders.
description_zh_TW: 缺乏 PGC-1α 的小鼠對 MPTP（多巴胺能毒素）和 kainic acid（興奮性毒素）誘導的神經元損失明顯更敏感，揭示了 PGC-1α 在神經元壓力抗性中的作用。由於 SIRT1 通過去乙醯化活化 PGC-1α，這種敏感性間接將 SIRT1/PGC-1α 軸與神經保護聯繫起來。在方向性上，PGC-1α 缺乏增加了對這些損傷的脆弱性，而其活化賦予抗性。由於 PGC-1α 驅動粒線體生物合成和抗氧化基因表達，通過此軸保護神經元是針對帕金森症和其他神經退行性疾病的擬議策略。

label: mTORC1 under hypoxia
description: REDD1 (regulated in development and DNA damage responses 1) inhibits mTORC1 specifically under hypoxia by binding and releasing TSC2 from inhibitory 14-3-3 association, thereby activating the TSC GAP complex. This allows Rheb to be converted to its inactive GDP form and mTORC1 to be suppressed, conserving energy when oxygen is limiting. REDD1 thus provides a hypoxia-responsive brake that engages autophagy and limits anabolic consumption. Its induction is transcriptionally controlled by HIF-1α, integrating oxygen sensing with mTORC1 regulation.
description_zh_TW: REDD1（發育與 DNA 損傷反應中受調節者 1）在缺氧條件下特異性地抑制 mTORC1，透過結合並將 TSC2 從抑制性的 14-3-3 聯合中釋放出來，從而活化 TSC GAP 複合物。這使得 Rheb 被轉化為其失活的 GDP 形式，mTORC1 被抑制，以在氧氣受限時節省能量。因此 REDD1 提供了一個對缺氧有反應的制動，啟動自噬並限制合成代謝消耗。它的誘發受 HIF-1α 轉錄控制，將氧氣感知與 mTORC1 調節整合起來。

label: Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype
description: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

label: Myeloid Differentiation
description: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

label: Immature Myeloid Cell
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are a heterogeneous population of immature myeloid cells with potent immunosuppressive activity, expanded under pathological stress including cancer and chronic inflammation. Their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state rather than a single lineage, with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets recognized. In senescence contexts, MDSCs are recruited by SASP factors and blunt anti-tumor and anti-senescence immunity, shifting the immune balance away from clearance. They represent a key immunosuppressive cell type bridging aging, inflammation, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: MDSCs（骨髓源性抑制細胞）是一群異質、未成熟骨髓細胞，在發炎與癌症中擴張並具免疫抑制功能。其歸類為未成熟骨髓細胞將其定位於骨髓生成與免疫調節的交會點，且其在衰老中重要性上升。在衰老脈絡中，MDSC 累積貢獻免疫抑制與監視受損。其未成熟本質使其對發炎細胞激素與趨化因子高度反應，成為衰老相關免疫逃脫的關鍵角色。

label: Alveolar Macrophages
description: Alveolar macrophages are tissue-resident lung macrophages that clear particulates and are key sources of inflammatory mediators. Their persistent activation contributes to chronic low-grade lung inflammation that feeds into systemic inflammaging with age.
description_zh_TW: 肺泡巨噬細胞是肺組織駐留的巨噬細胞，負責清除微粒並是發炎介質的重要來源。其持續活化促成慢性低度肺部發炎，隨年齡增長助長全身性的發炎老化（inflammaging）。

label: Argonaute
description: Argonaute proteins are the effector subunits of small-RNA silencing pathways. In the context of immune-aging literature they are linked to microRNA regulation that influences inflammatory programs, connecting RNA-silencing machinery to chronic inflammaging states.
description_zh_TW: Argonaute 蛋白是小 RNA 靜默途徑的效應亞基。在免疫老化文獻脈絡中，它們與調控發炎程式的 microRNA 調節相關，將 RNA 靜默機制與慢性的發炎老化狀態相連結。

label: Epigenetic Aging
description: Epigenetic aging reflects the accumulation of age-related chromatin changes integrated into epigenetic clocks. Epigenetic derepression of retroelements and heterochromatin loss fuels inflammaging, linking epigenetic age acceleration to chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳老化反映累積的與年齡相關染色質變化，並整合入表觀遺傳時鐘。反轉錄轉座子的表觀去抑制與異染色質喪失助長發炎老化，將表觀遺傳年齡加速與慢性發炎相連結。

label: Herpes Zoster
description: Herpes zoster arises from reactivation of latent varicella zoster virus, and recurrent viral reactivation is a source of chronic antigenic and inflammatory stress. Vaccination reduces reactivation and is associated with lower inflammaging and slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹源於潛伏的水痘帶狀皰疹病毒再活化，而反覆的病毒再活化是慢性抗原與發炎壓力的來源。疫苗接種減少再活化，並與較低的發炎老化及較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Postherpetic Neuralgia
description: Postherpetic neuralgia is persistent neuropathic pain in the dermatome of a resolved herpes zoster rash, the most common complication of shingles. The shingles vaccine lowers the risk of herpes zoster and consequently of postherpetic neuralgia.
description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是帶狀皰疹皮疹消退後皮節區的持續神經病理性疼痛，是帶狀皰疹最常見的併發症。帶狀皰疹疫苗降低帶狀皰疹及其後神經痛的風險。

label: Health and Retirement Study
description: The Health and Retirement Study (HRS) is a longitudinal panel study of U.S. adults aged 50+ that collects health, economic, and biomarker data, enabling population-level analyses of biological aging. It was used to show shingles vaccination associates with slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 健康與退休研究（HRS）是針對 50 歲以上美國成人的縱向追蹤研究，收集健康、經濟與生物標記數據，使生物老化的族群層級分析成為可能。它被用於顯示帶狀皰疹疫苗接種與較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Transcriptomic Aging
description: Transcriptomic aging describes the progressive remodeling of the transcriptome with age, reflecting dysregulated inflammatory and stress-response pathways. Slower transcriptomic aging implies dampened expression of inflammaging-associated gene programs.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄組老化描述轉錄組隨年齡的進行性重塑，反映失調的發炎與壓力反應途徑。較慢的轉錄組老化意味著發炎老化相關基因程式的表現被削弱。

label: Varicella Zoster Virus
description: Varicella zoster virus establishes lifelong latency and can reactivate, and recurrent subclinical reactivation contributes to chronic immune activation. Vaccination reduces reactivation and is associated with lower inflammaging and slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 水痘帶狀皰疹病毒建立終身潛伏並可再活化，反覆的亞臨床再活化促成慢性免疫活化。疫苗接種減少再活化，並與較低的發炎老化及較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Myocardial infarction
description: Oxidase activity was found in the serum of patients following myocardial infarction, a finding that may be of importance in assessing the clinical and pathogenic significance of oxygen radicals in heart disease. Because stimulated neutrophils produce oxygen radicals and infiltrate the infarcted myocardium, the appearance of oxidase activity in the circulation after infarction reflects the systemic oxidative stress associated with cardiac damage. This serum marker complements the detection of a compound with the same HPLC retention time as adrenochrome in biological fluid rich in neutrophils, supporting the possibility that the adrenochrome pathway operates in vivo. Serum oxidase measurement is therefore proposed as a clinically accessible readout for the oxidant-driven conversion of adrenaline to cardiotoxic products in the setting of myocardial infarction.
description_zh_TW: 在心肌梗塞患者的血清中發現氧化酶活性，此發現對於評估氧自由基在心臟疾病中的臨床及發病意義可能具有重要性。由於受刺激的中性白血球會產生氧自由並浸潤梗塞的心肌，梗塞後血液中出現氧化酶活性反映了與心臟損傷相關的全身性氧化壓力。此血清標記物與在富含中性白血球的生物液體中，偵測到具有與adrenochrome相同HPLC保留時間之化合物的結果相互補充，支持adrenochrome代謝途徑在體內運作的可能性。因此，建議將血清氧化酶測量作為一種臨床上可取得的指標，用以反映心肌梗塞情境下，腎上腺素在氧化劑驅動下轉化為心臟毒性產物的程度。

label: Serum

This serum marker complements the detection of a compound with the same HPLC retention time as adrenochrome in biological fluid rich in neutrophils, supporting the possibility that the adrenochrome pathway operates in vivo. Serum oxidase measurement is therefore proposed as a clinically accessible readout for the oxidant-driven conversion of adrenaline to cardiotoxic products in the setting of myocardial infarction.

label: PCAF/GCN5
description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: NAD+ bioluminescence assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The NAD+ bioluminescence assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying remaining NAD+ after a deacetylation reaction, coupling NAD+ consumption to bacterial luciferase-catalyzed oxidation of decanal via a NAD+/NADH reduction step. It uses a label-free peptide substrate and is applicable to sirtuins with any peptide substrate. Directionally, NAD+ depletion tracks sirtuin catalytic turnover. Its label-free nature and high amenability to high-throughput screening make it a useful complement to fluorescent substrate-based assays, whose artifacts affect STAC measurements.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物發光測定透過量化去乙醯化反應後剩餘的 NAD+ 來測量 sirtuin 活性，將 NAD+ 消耗與細菌螢光素酶催化的癸醛氧化偶聯，透過 NAD+/NADH 還原步驟。它使用無標記的胜肽受質，適用於任何胜肽受質的 sirtuin。方向性上 NAD+ 耗竭追蹤 sirtuin 催化轉化。其無標記特性和高通量篩選的良好適應性使其成為螢光受質基測定的有用補充，後者的假象影響了 STAC 測量。

source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md

label: NAMPT targeting in AML
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6 knockdown-induced DNA repair deficiencies are potently synergistic with NAMPT targeting in acute myeloid leukemia treatment, showing promising in vivo efficacy compared with monotherapy. Directionally, SIRT6 loss-driven DNA repair defects and NAMPT inhibition cooperate to kill AML cells. This dual strategy exploits two vulnerabilities, offering a rationale for combination-based treatments that outperform single-agent therapy in acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6敲低誘導的DNA修復缺陷在急性骨髓性白血病治療中與NAMPT靶向具有強大的協同作用，與單一療法相比顯示出有前景的體內療效。方向上，SIRT6缺失驅動的DNA修復缺陷和NAMPT抑制協同殺傷AML細胞。這種雙重策略利用兩個脆弱性，為在急性骨髓性白血病中優於單一藥物治療的組合治療提供了理論基礎。

label: shSIRT6-induced DNA repair deficiency
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

label: Natalizumab (Tysabri)
description: Natalizumab (Tysabri) blocks the VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction by antagonizing alpha4 integrin, reducing T-cell trafficking across the blood-brain barrier in multiple sclerosis. This dampens CNS inflammation but leaves patients susceptible to progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. The directionality is integrin blockade to reduced leukocyte entry. A caveat is that broad alpha4 inhibition also affects gut homing, causing PML and other risks that limit use. The drug's efficacy in MS validates the VCAM-1/VLA-4 pathway as a driver of neuroinflammation, though its safety profile demands careful monitoring.
description_zh_TW: Natalizumab (Tysabri) 透過拮抗 α4 整合素來阻斷 VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction，從而減少 ros 中 multiple sclerosis 中血腦障壁的 T 細胞運輸。這可以抑制中樞神經系統炎症，但使患者容易患上進行性多灶性白質腦病變。方向性是整合素阻斷以減少白血球進入。需要注意的是，廣泛的 alpha4 抑制也會影響腸道歸巢，導致 PML 和其他限制使用的風險。該藥物對多發性硬化症的療效證實了 VCAM-1/VLA-4 路徑作為神經發炎的驅動因素，但其安全性需要仔細監測。

label: NF-κB pro-inflammatory signalling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Deacetylation of RelA/p65 by SIRT1 lowers NF-κB transactivation, thereby reducing expression of cytokines, chemokines, and adhesion molecules that propagate inflammation. This directly opposes the pro-inflammatory program and underlies many of SIRT1's protective effects in metabolic, cardiovascular, and neurodegenerative contexts. The directionality is SIRT1 deacetylation → suppressed NF-κB signaling. A caveat is that excessive NF-κB suppression could impair host defense, so the effect is beneficial within physiological ranges.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 對 RelA/p65 的去乙醯化降低 NF-κB 的轉錄活化，從而減少促進發炎的細胞因子、趨化因子和黏附分子的表達。這直接對抗促發炎程序，是 SIRT1 在代謝、心血管和神經退行性疾病背景下許多保護效應的基礎。其方向性為 SIRT1 去乙醯化 → 抑制 NF-κB 信號。需要注意的是，過度抑制 NF-κB 可能損害宿主防禦，因此其效應在生理範圍內是有益的。

label: Nicotinamide released by sirtuins
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The radiochemical assay measures sirtuin deacetylase activity using an acetylated peptide substrate and [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+, detecting the release of 14C-nicotinamide. Unreacted NAD+ is captured by a boronic acid resin, and the unbound fraction containing released nicotinamide is counted in a scintillation counter, in a format compatible with 96-well high-throughput screening. Directionally, radiolabeled nicotinamide release directly quantifies catalytic rounds. This assay confirmed the identification of indoles as sirtuin inhibitors, although radioactive waste and safety considerations limit routine screening use.
description_zh_TW: 放射化學測定使用乙醯化胜肽受質和 [carbonyl-14C]-NAD+ 測量 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性，偵測 14C-尼可醯胺的釋放。未反應的 NAD+ 被硼酸樹脂捕獲，含有釋放的尼可醯胺的非結合部分在液體閃爍計數器中計數，格式相容於 96 孔高通量篩選。方向性上放射性標記尼可醯胺的釋放直接量化催化輪次。此測定確認了吲哚類作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的鑑定，儘管放射性廢物和安全考量限制了其在常規篩選中的使用。

label: NKX2-1
description: NKX2-1 (Nk2 homeobox 1) is deacetylated by SIRT1 in hypothalamic DMH/LH neurons; deacetylated NKX2-1 activates transcription of OX2R, the orexin receptor whose increased signaling recapitulates calorie restriction and extends lifespan in BRASTO mice. Thus NKX2-1 is the direct transcriptional relay between SIRT1 and OX2R. By linking SIRT1 activity to orexin-receptor expression, NKX2-1 connects sirtuin signaling to the neural circuits controlling arousal, activity, and energy expenditure. This pathway illustrates how a single transcription factor can mediate the longevity effects of sirtuin activation in the brain.
description_zh_TW: NKX2-1（Nk2 homeobox 1）在下丘腦DMH/LH神經元中被SIRT1去乙醯化；去乙醯化的NKX2-1啟動OX2R的轉錄，OX2R是食慾素受體，其訊號增強模擬了熱量限制並在BRASTO小鼠中延長壽命。因此NKX2-1是SIRT1和OX2R之間的直接轉錄中繼。透過將SIRT1活性與食慾素受體表達聯繫起來，NKX2-1將sirtuin訊號與控制覺醒、活動和能量消耗的神經迴路連接。此通路說明了單一轉錄因子如何能介導sirtuin活化在大腦中的長壽效應。

label: Nox4-derived H2O2
description: Nox4-derived H2O2 is required for TGF-beta-induced EMT, as Nox4 knockout blocks mesenchymal marker expression and cell migration during epithelial-mesenchymal transition. The oxidant thus serves as a necessary signal rather than mere byproduct. The directionality is Nox4 H2O2 to EMT execution. A caveat is that complete EMT also needs Smad and transcription-factor reprogramming, so H2O2 is necessary but not sufficient alone. Nox4 inhibitors are being evaluated as anti-fibrotic agents, underscoring the therapeutic relevance of this redox pathway.
description_zh_TW: Nox4-derived H2O2 是 TGF-beta-induced EMT 所必需的，因為 Nox4 敲除會阻斷上皮-間質轉化過程中的間質標記表達和細胞遷移。因此，氧化劑充當必要的信號而不僅僅是副產物。方向性是Nox4 H2O2到EMT執行。需要注意的是，完整的 EMT 還需要 Smad 和轉錄因子重編程，因此 H2O2 是必要的，但單獨使用還不夠。 Nox4 抑制劑正在作為抗纖維化藥物進行評估，強調了此氧化還原途徑的治療相關性。

label: Nuclear SIRT1 (enhanced by resveratrol)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md
description: Nuclear SIRT1, enhanced by resveratrol, induces superoxide dismutase in cardiomyocytes, an antioxidant enzyme that suppresses cell death under stress. Directionally, nuclear SIRT1 sits upstream of SOD induction. This is a cardiomyoprotective output of resveratrol's SIRT1 activation, reducing oxidative damage and preserving cardiac cell viability during injury. It complements SIRT1's other cardiac actions, including SERCA2a deacetylation and PPARα activation, and it illustrates how resveratrol engages nuclear sirtuin activity to boost endogenous antioxidant defense. The SOD induction is part of the broader FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program driven by SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: 核 SIRT1 在 resveratrol 增強下誘導心肌細胞中的超氧化物歧化酶，一種在壓力下抑制細胞死亡的抗氧化酶。在方向性上，核 SIRT1 位於 SOD 誘導的上游。這是 resveratrol SIRT1 活化的心肌保護輸出，在損傷期間減少氧化損傷並維護心臟細胞活性。這與 SIRT1 的其他心臟作用互補，包括 SERCA2a 去乙醯化和 PPARα 活化，並說明 resveratrol 如何利用核 sirtuin 活性來增強內源性抗氧化防禦。SOD 誘導是 SIRT1 驅動的更廣泛 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程式的一部分。

label: ADMA
description: ADMA inhibits eNOS by competitively occupying the L-arginine binding site of all NOS isoforms, reducing NO production and promoting uncoupling. Elevated ADMA (from reduced catabolism by dimethylarginine dimethylaminohydrolase) is a marker of endothelial risk. The directionality is endogenous inhibitor to NO deficiency. A caveat is that ADMA also inhibits other NOS isoforms and its effects are modulated by L-arginine availability and methyltransferase activity. Because ADMA is primarily cleared by DDAH, oxidative inactivation of DDAH raises ADMA and further suppresses NO, a self-reinforcing cycle in endothelial disease.
description_zh_TW: ADMA 透過競爭性佔據所有 NOS 亞型的 L-arginine 結合位點、減少 NO 產生並促進解偶聯來抑制 eNOS。 ADMA 升高（由於二甲基精氨酸二甲氨基水解酶分解代謝減少）是內皮風險的標誌。方向性是NO缺乏的內源性抑制劑。需要注意的是，ADMA 也抑制其他 NOS 亞型，其作用受到 L-arginine 可用性和甲基轉移酶活性的調節。由於 ADMA 主要由 DDAH 清除，DDAH 的氧化失活會升高 ADMA 並進一步抑制 NO（內皮疾病的自我強化循環）。

label: Arginase
description: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

label: microbial macromolecules
description: Hypochlorous acid (HOCl) is a potent antimicrobial oxidant produced by myeloperoxidase in the neutrophil halogenation cycle. It damages microbial proteins, lipids, and DNA, and it is central to the oxidative burst that kills pathogens in phagosomes. When HOCl is released in excess at sites of inflammation, it also oxidizes host biomolecules, generating markers such as 3-chlorotyrosine and 3-nitrotyrosine, and modifying lipids and lipoproteins, which links MPO activity to tissue injury, atherosclerosis, and chronic inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid（HOCl）是myeloperoxidase在neutrophil halogenation cycle中產生的potent antimicrobial oxidant。它damages microbial proteins、lipids與DNA，並是kill pathogens in phagosomes的oxidative burst核心。當HOCl在inflammation部位excess released時，它亦oxidizes host biomolecules，generating markers such as 3-chlorotyrosine與3-nitrotyrosine，並modifying lipids與lipoproteins，這將MPO activity與tissue injury、atherosclerosis及chronic inflammatory disease聯繫起來。

label: 3-Chlorotyrosine
description: Hypochlorous acid chlorinates tyrosine to form 3-chlorotyrosine, a stable adduct that is a specific biomarker of myeloperoxidase activity in vivo. Its presence marks HOCl exposure in inflamed tissues. The directionality is HOCl to chlorinated protein residue. A caveat is that 3-chlorotyrosine reflects historical MPO activity and can be turned over with protein degradation, so it is an integrative rather than instantaneous marker. 3-chlorotyrosine levels rise in atherosclerotic plaques, pneumonia, and other inflammatory conditions, supporting its use as a clinical research biomarker.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 氯化 tyrosine 形成 3-chlorotyrosine，這是一種穩定的加合物，是體內 myeloperoxidase 活性的特定生物標記。它的存在標誌著發炎組織中的次氯酸暴露。方向性是 HOCl 到氯化蛋白質殘基。需要注意的是，3-chlorotyrosine 反映了歷史 MPO 活性，並且可以隨著蛋白質降解而翻轉，因此它是一個綜合標記，而不是瞬時標記。 3-chlorotyrosine 水平在 atheros 硬化斑塊、肺炎和其他發炎性疾病中升高，支持其用作臨床研究生物標記。

label: Alpha-1 Antitrypsin
description: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

label: LDL
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) and its product hypochlorous acid oxidize low-density lipoprotein (LDL) into more atherogenic forms, and they also generate dysfunctional HDL. These oxidative modifications of lipoproteins link MPO to atherosclerosis, endothelial dysfunction (via nitric oxide consumption), and plaque instability. Elevated MPO levels and activity are associated with increased oxidative stress and cardiovascular risk, making MPO both a biomarker and a mediator of cardiovascular disease and chronic inflammatory conditions.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）及其product hypochlorous acid oxidize low-density lipoprotein（LDL）into more atherogenic forms，並generate dysfunctional HDL。這些oxidative modifications of lipoproteins將MPO與atherosclerosis、endothelial dysfunction（via nitric oxide consumption）及plaque instability聯繫起來。Elevated MPO levels與activity與increased oxidative stress及cardiovascular risk相關，making MPO both a biomarker與a mediator of cardiovascular disease與chronic inflammatory conditions。

label: neutrophil azurophilic granules
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) is a heme-containing enzyme stored primarily in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils, and to a lesser extent in monocytes and macrophages. It plays a central role in the oxidative burst during innate immune responses, producing hypochlorous acid and other oxidants that kill pathogens in phagosomes. On release during inflammation, MPO can also oxidize host biomolecules and catecholamines such as epinephrine, and its products contribute to both antimicrobial defense and, in excess, to tissue damage and cardiovascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）是一種主要儲存於neutrophils azurophilic granules中、較少量存在於monocytes與macrophages的heme-containing enzyme。它在innate immune responses的oxidative burst中扮演central role，產生hypochlorous acid及其他oxidants以kill pathogens in phagosomes。在inflammation期間released時，MPO亦能oxidize host biomolecules及如epinephrine等catecholamines，其products既contribute to antimicrobial defense，在excess時也會導致tissue damage與cardiovascular pathology。

label: Soluble VCAM-1
description: Soluble VCAM-1 is a biomarker for endothelial dysfunction, being elevated in cardiovascular disease, diabetes, hypertension, and rheumatoid arthritis as a shed fragment of the adhesion molecule. Its level reflects chronic endothelial activation. The directionality is endothelial activation to soluble marker release. A caveat is that soluble VCAM-1 lacks the membrane anchor and its biological activity differs from full-length VCAM-1, so it is an index rather than a direct effector. Serum sVCAM-1 is now used in risk stratification and to monitor endothelial health in research cohorts.
description_zh_TW: Soluble VCAM-1 是 endothelial dysfunction 的生物標記物，在 cardiovascular disease、糖尿病、高血壓和類風濕性關節炎中作為黏附分子的脫落片段而升高。其水平反映了慢性內皮活化。方向性是內皮活化至可溶性標記物釋放。需要注意的是，soluble VCAM-1 缺乏膜錨，其生物活性與全長 VCAM-1 不同，因此它是一個指標而不是直接效應子。血清 sVCAM-1 現在用於風險分層和監測研究隊列中的內皮健康。

label: Hypotension
description: Massive nitric oxide release during septic shock, anaphylaxis, or post-cardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia causes excessive vasodilation and life-threateningly low blood pressure (hypotension). NO overproduction is driven largely by the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme during the inflammatory response. Therapeutic strategies target this cascade at different levels: aminoguanidine inhibits iNOS to block NO synthesis upstream, while methylene blue inhibits soluble guanylyl cyclase to block NO signaling downstream and restore blood pressure when vasopressors fail.
description_zh_TW: 在敗血症性休克、過敏反應或心肺分流術後血管麻痺期間，大量一氧化氮釋放導致過度血管舒張和危及生命的低血壓（低血壓）。NO過度產生主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）在炎症反應期間驅動。治療策略在不同層面靶向此級聯：氨基胍抑制iNOS以在上游阻斷NO合成，而亞甲藍抑制可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶以在下游阻斷NO信號並在血管加壓素失效時恢復血壓。

label: SIRT1 (resveratrol-activated)
description: Resveratrol-activated endothelial SIRT1 increases eNOS expression and deacetylates and activates it, enhancing nitric-oxide production and promoting vasodilation. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of eNOS activation in the endothelium. Improved NO bioavailability lowers vascular tone, protects against endothelial dysfunction, and reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This underlies resveratrol's cardiovascular and French-paradox associations, and SIRT1's regulation of eNOS is one of its best-established vascular mechanisms, linking sirtuin activity directly to blood-vessel health and blood-pressure control.
description_zh_TW: 被白藜蘆醇活化的內皮 SIRT1 增加 eNOS 表達並去乙醯化和活化它，增強一氧化氮產生並促進血管舒張。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於內皮中 eNOS 活化的上游。改善的 NO 生物利用度降低血管張力、保護對抗內皮功能障礙，並減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增殖。這是白藜蘆醇心血管益處和法國悖論關聯的基礎，SIRT1 對 eNOS 的調節是其最佳確立的血管機制之一，將 sirtuin 活性直接與血管健康和血壓控制聯繫起來。

label: OAADPr
description: OAADPr (2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose) binds to the cytoplasmic N-terminal domain of the TRPM2 non-selective cation channel, promoting its opening and calcium influx into the cytosol. Because OAADPr is generated directly by sirtuin deacetylase activity, TRPM2 activation acts as a sensor of cellular sirtuin flux and NAD+ utilization. The directionality is unidirectional under basal conditions: sirtuin activity produces OAADPr, which then gates TRPM2, rather than TRPM2 regulating sirtuins. This coupling provides a mechanistic link between metabolic state, redox stress, and calcium-dependent processes such as insulin secretion and apoptotic signaling.
description_zh_TW: OAADPr（2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose）結合到 TRPM2 非選擇性陽離子通道的細胞質 N 端結構域，促進其開放和鈣離子流入細胞質。由於 OAADPr 是直接由 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性產生的，TRPM2 的活化充當了細胞 sirtuin 通量和 NAD+ 利用率的感測器。在基礎條件下，這種方向性是單向的：sirtuin 活性產生 OAADPr，然後開啟 TRPM2，而非 TRPM2 調節 sirtuin。這種偶聯提供了代謝狀態、氧化還原壓力與鈣離子依賴性過程（如胰島素分泌和細胞凋亡訊號傳導）之間的機制性聯繫。

label: Oleic acid accumulation
description: PERO1 functions as a sensor of oleic acid accumulation on damaged peroxisomes, triggering autophagic removal of these defective organelles. By detecting lipid imbalance indicative of peroxisomal dysfunction, PERO1 initiates quality-control degradation that prevents the propagation of impaired organelles. This lipid-sensing mechanism links metabolic state to organelle surveillance. The pathway exemplifies how selective autophagy integrates metabolic cues to maintain peroxisome integrity.
description_zh_TW: PERO1 作為受損過氧化體上油酸累積的感測器，觸發對這些缺陷胞器的自噬性移除。透過偵測指示過氧化體功能障礙的脂質失衡，PERO1 啟動品質控制降解，防止受損胞器的傳播。此脂質感測機制將代謝狀態與胞器監控連結起來。此途徑具體體現了選擇性自噬如何整合代謝線索以維持過氧化體完整性。

label: PERO1
description: PERO1 functions as a sensor of oleic acid accumulation on damaged peroxisomes, triggering autophagic removal of these defective organelles. By detecting lipid imbalance indicative of peroxisomal dysfunction, PERO1 initiates quality-control degradation that prevents the propagation of impaired organelles. This lipid-sensing mechanism links metabolic state to organelle surveillance. The pathway exemplifies how selective autophagy integrates metabolic cues to maintain peroxisome integrity.

label: Oxidized Phospholipids
description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

label: PON1
description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.

label: p33ING1b
description: In hepatocarcinoma, p33ING1b binds SIRT1 and blocks its ability to deacetylate p53, thereby preserving p53's transcriptional activity, including repression of α-fetoprotein (AFP). This relieves SIRT1-mediated inhibition of p53 tumor suppression, restoring the p53-dependent checkpoint in liver cancer cells. Directionally, p33ING1b antagonizes SIRT1 at the p53 node. The interaction reveals a tissue-specific brake on SIRT1's pro-survival, potentially oncogenic action, and is consistent with p33ING1b's function as a tumor suppressor that cooperates with p53, highlighting how accessory proteins can redirect sirtuin activity toward anti-tumor outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 在肝癌中，p33ING1b 結合 SIRT1 並阻斷其去乙醯化 p53 的能力，從而保留 p53 的轉錄活性，包括對 α-胎兒蛋白（AFP）的抑制。這解除了 SIRT1 介導的對 p53 腫瘤抑制的抑制，恢復肝癌細胞中 p53 依賴性的檢查點。在方向性上，p33ING1b 在 p53 節點上拮抗 SIRT1。這種相互作用揭示了對 SIRT1 的促存活、潛在致癌作用的組織特異性制動，與 p33ING1b 作為與 p53 協同的腫瘤抑制因子的功能一致，突顯了輔助蛋白如何將 sirtuin 活性重新導向抗腫瘤結果。

label: p53 accumulation and cell cycle arrest
community_name: p53 accumulation and cell cycle arrest
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SIRT2 downregulation or chemical inhibition induces anticancer effects that include p53 accumulation, cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis, mirroring the tumor-suppressive functions of the enzyme. Loss of SIRT2 permits mitotic regulators such as Aurora-A/Aurora-B to accumulate, destabilizing division and forcing checkpoint engagement. The relationship is directional: reduced SIRT2 activity leads to p53 stabilization and arrest. A caveat is that SIRT2 inhibition can be counterproductive in some contexts, notably alongside microtubule inhibitors where it prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and confers resistance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 下調或化學抑制會產生抗癌效果，包括 p53 累積、細胞週期停滯和凋亡，反映了該酵素的腫瘤抑制功能。SIRT2 的缺失允許有絲分裂調節因子如 Aurora-A/Aurora-B 累積，使細胞分裂不穩定並強迫檢查點啟動。關係具有方向性：SIRT2 活性降低導致 p53 穩定化和停滯。但需要注意的是，SIRT2 抑制在某些情境下可能適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合用時，會延長慢性有絲分裂停滯並賦予抗藥性。

label: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
community_name: p53 and SIRT1 to nuclear bodies
description: Upon oncogenic stress, the PML-IV isoform recruits both p53 and SIRT1 into PML nuclear bodies, assembling a stress-responsive regulatory hub. Directionally, PML-IV sits upstream of p53/SIRT1 compartmentalization. Within these bodies, SIRT1 deacetylates p53 to shape the senescence/apoptosis decision, and it connects PML bodies to sirtuin-mediated tumor suppression. By concentrating p53 and SIRT1 at nuclear bodies, PML-IV ensures that stress responses are locally integrated. This compartmentalization is central to the tumor-suppressive functions of the PML pathway.
description_zh_TW: 在致癌壓力下，PML-IV 同型異構體將 p53 和 SIRT1 兩者招募到 PML 核體中，組裝壓力反應性調控樞紐。在方向性上，PML-IV 位於 p53/SIRT6 區室化的上游。在這些核體內，SIRT1 去乙醯化 p53 以塑造衰老/凋亡決定，並將 PML 核體與 sirtuin 介導的腫瘤抑制聯繫起來。透過在核體中濃縮 p53 和 SIRT1，PML-IV 確保壓力反應被局部整合。這種區室化對 PML 通路的腫瘤抑制功能至關重要。

label: PACAP (pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide)
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 modulates neuropeptide signaling pathways: its interaction with pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating polypeptide (PACAP) enhances neuroprotective effects by alleviating amyloid-beta toxicity. Directionally, the SIRT3-PACAP interaction sits upstream of reduced Aβ-mediated neuronal injury. This indicates that SIRT3 can bridge neurotrophic and metabolic signaling in the aging brain, extending its neuroprotective repertoire beyond mitochondrial homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 調節神經肽訊號通路：它與垂體腺苷酸環化酶激活多肽 (PACAP) 的相互作用可透過減輕澱粉樣蛋白 - β 的毒性來增強神經保護作用。從方向上看，SIRT3-PACAP 相互作用位於減少 Aβ 介導的神經元損傷的上游。這表明 SIRT3 可以在老化大腦中橋接神經營養和代謝信號傳導，將其神經保護功能擴展到粒線體穩態之外。

label: PANoptosis
description: ZBP1 (Z-DNA-binding protein 1), sensing endogenous or viral Z-nucleic acids, nucleates the PANoptosome that co-assembles RIPK1, RIPK3, caspase-8, and caspase-1 — co-executing pyroptosis, apoptosis, and necroptosis in one inflammatory program. ZBP1-driven RIPK3 recruitment also activates NLRP3 directly. Because the three arms are co-assembled, blocking any single pathway fails to prevent death, which distinguishes PANoptosis from sequentially compensating cell-death modes and explains its severity in viral and inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: ZBP1（Z-DNA 結合蛋白 1）在感應內生性或病毒性 Z-核酸後，會組裝 PANoptosome，共同召集 RIPK1、RIPK3、Caspase-8 與 Caspase-1——在同一發炎程序中同時執行焦亡、細胞凋亡與程序性壞死。ZBP1 驅動的 RIPK3 招募也會直接活化 NLRP3。由於三條路徑是共同組裝的，阻斷任何單一路徑都無法阻止死亡，這正是 PANoptosis 有別於依序補償型細胞死亡之處，也解釋了其在病毒性與發炎性疾患中的嚴重度。

label: Parkinson's and Huntington's disease
description: Selective SIRT2 inhibitors such as AGK2, AK-7, and SirReal2 are investigated in neurodegenerative disease models because blocking SIRT2 preserves α-tubulin acetylation and protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition promotes microtubule stability and neuroprotection. These agents rescue dopaminergic neurons from α-synuclein toxicity, reduce huntingtin aggregation in models of Huntington's disease, and confer protection in ischemic stroke. The approach exploits the inverse therapeutic logic of SIRT2 versus other sirtuins: while most sirtuin biology supports activation for healthspan, SIRT2 inhibition appears beneficial in specific neurodegenerative contexts.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性 SIRT2 抑制劑（如 AGK2、AK-7 和 SirReal2）正在神經退行性疾病模型中進行研究，因為阻斷 SIRT2 保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化並保護神經元免受聚集毒性。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制促進微管穩定性和神經保護。這些藥劑從 α-synuclein 毒性中拯救多巴胺能神經元，在亨丁頓症模型中減少 huntingtin 聚集，並在缺血性中風中賦予保護。此方法利用了 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的反向治療邏輯：雖然大多數 sirtuin 生物學支持活化以促進健康壽命，SIRT2 抑制在特定神經退行性疾病背景下似乎是有益的。

label: Parkinson's disease motor symptoms
description: Striatum dysfunction causes the motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease because degeneration of nigrostriatal dopamine input deprives striatal medium spiny neurons of dopaminergic tone, disrupting the basal ganglia motor loop. The resulting imbalance between the D1-mediated direct and D2-mediated indirect pathways produces bradykinesia, rigidity, and tremor. COMT inhibitors indirectly help by preserving peripheral levodopa for central conversion to dopamine. This dopaminergic model underpins the standard treatment of Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: Striatum dysfunction 會導致巴金森氏症的運動症狀，因為黑質紋狀體多巴胺輸入的退化剝奪了紋狀體中型多巴胺能神經元的多巴胺能張力，從而破壞了 basal ganglia 運動迴路。由此產生的 D1 介導的直接通路和 D2 介導的間接通路之間的不平衡會導致運動遲緩、僵硬和震顫。 COMT 抑制劑透過保留週邊左旋多巴以促進中樞轉化為多巴胺間接提供幫助。這種多巴胺能模型是帕金森氏症標準治療的基礎。

label: Tau oligomerization
description: 4-hydroxynonenal promotes tau oligomerization by forming covalent Michael adducts with tau cysteine and lysine residues, altering its conformation and seeding oligomers. As a major lipid-peroxidation aldehyde, 4-HNE thus couples membrane oxidation to protein misfolding. The directionality is aldehyde adduct to tau aggregation propensity. A caveat is that 4-HNE at low levels can also induce adaptive responses, and other aldehydes (MDA, acrolein) modify tau similarly. Elevated 4-HNE and tau adducts colocalize in Alzheimer's disease brain, linking lipid peroxidation to neurofibrillary pathology.
description_zh_TW: 4-hydroxynonenal 透過與 tau 半胱胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成共價邁克爾加合物，改變其構象並播種寡聚物來促進 tau oligomerization。作为一种主要的脂质过氧化醛，4-HNE 将膜氧化与蛋白质错误折叠结合起来。方向性是醛加合物對tau聚集的傾向。需要注意的是，低水平的 4-HNE 也可以誘導適應性反應，其他醛（MDA、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 tau。升高的 4-HNE 和 tau 加合物共定位於阿茲海默症大腦中，將 lipid peroxidation 與神經纖維病理聯繫起來。

label: Aldehyde Dehydrogenases
description: Aldehyde dehydrogenases (ALDHs), together with aldo-keto reductases, help neutralize reactive aldehydes and dicarbonyls such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal by oxidizing them into less toxic carboxylic acids. This prevents these highly reactive species from participating in glycation cascades that form advanced glycation end products. ALDH activity therefore contributes to the body's first line of enzymatic defense against dicarbonyl stress, operating alongside the glyoxalase system and PARK7. Reduced ALDH function would be expected to increase the pool of reactive dicarbonyls available to damage proteins, promoting AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 醛脫氫酶（ALDHs）與醛酮還原酶一起，透過將 3-deoxyglucosone 與甲基乙二醛等反應性醛與二羰基物氧化為較低毒性的羧酸，協助中和它們。這防止了這些高度反應性物種參與形成晚期糖化終產物的糖化級聯。因此，ALDH 活性有助於身體對抗二羰基壓力的第一道酵素防線，與乙二醛酶系統及 PARK7 並行運作。ALDH 功能降低預期會增加可用以損害蛋白質的反應性二羰基庫，促進 AGE 堆積。

label: Aldo-Keto Reductases
description: Aldo-keto reductases (AKRs) and aldehyde dehydrogenases (ALDHs) are enzyme families that assist in reducing or oxidizing reactive aldehydes and dicarbonyls, such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal, into less toxic alcohols or carboxylic acids. By converting these reactive species into less harmful products, AKRs prevent them from participating in glycation cascades that form advanced glycation end products. This enzymatic detoxification is one of the three lines of defense against AGE accumulation, operating alongside the glyoxalase system and PARK7. Impaired AKR or ALDH function would be expected to increase dicarbonyl burden and accelerate protein glycation.
description_zh_TW: 醛酮還原酶（Aldo-keto reductases, AKRs）與醛脫氫酶（aldehyde dehydrogenases, ALDHs）是協助將反應性醛與二羰基物（如 3-deoxyglucosone 與甲基乙二醛）還原或氧化為較低毒性的醇或羧酸的酵素家族。透過將這些反應性物種轉化為較無害的產物，AKR 防止它們參與形成晚期糖化終產物的糖化級聯。這種酵素解毒是對抗 AGE 堆積的三道防線之一，與乙二醛酶系統及 PARK7 並行運作。AKR 或 ALDH 功能受損預期會增加二羰基負擔並加速蛋白質糖化。

label: Electron Transport Chain
description: Silver nanoparticles are believed to disrupt the mitochondrial respiratory chain, causing oxidative stress, reduced ATP synthesis, and DNA damage. The mitochondrial electron transport chain is the major source of cellular energy, and its disruption collapses oxidative phosphorylation and elevates reactive oxygen production. This nanoparticle-specific toxicity is attributed to sustained release of silver ions and direct interaction with respiratory complexes, distinguishing it from the bulk-metal effects of larger silver particles.
description_zh_TW: 相信銀奈米粒子會干擾粒線體呼吸鏈，導致氧化應激、ATP合成減少和DNA損傷。粒線體電子傳遞鏈是細胞能量的主要來源，其干擾會使氧化磷酸化崩潰並增加活性氧產生。此奈米粒子特異性毒性歸因於銀離子的持續釋放和與呼吸複合物的直接相互作用，區別於較大銀粒子的塊狀金屬效應。

label: UV-induced photoaging
description: Singlet oxygen mediates UV-induced photoaging because UVA radiation excites endogenous photosensitizers (e.g., porphyrins, flavins) in skin, producing 1O2 that induces matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) expression. MMPs degrade collagen and elastin, producing wrinkles, laxity, and solar elastosis. The directionality is photon to radical to enzyme to matrix destruction. A caveat is that UVA also generates other ROS and activates signaling pathways independently, so singlet oxygen is one contributor among several in photoaging.
description_zh_TW: Singlet oxygen 介導 UV-induced photoaging，因為 UVA 輻射會激發皮膚中的內源性光敏劑（例如卟啉、黃素），產生 1O2，誘導基質金屬蛋白酶 (MMP) 表現。 MMP 會降解膠原蛋白和彈性蛋白，產生皺紋、鬆弛和日光性彈性組織變性。方向性是光子到自由基到酵素到基質破壞。需要注意的是，UVA 也會產生其他 ROS 並獨立活化訊號通路，因此 singlet oxygen 是 photoaging 中的幾個貢獻者之一。

label: cancer in fast COMT
description: Vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) increases cancer risk in fast COMT (Val/Val) individuals, as reported in subgroup analyses of supplementation trials where rapid COMT metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates was associated with adverse outcomes. The mechanism may involve altered handling of catecholestrogens or oxidative metabolites that differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction cautions against blanket vitamin E recommendation in fast genotypes. It underscores the importance of genotype-aware antioxidant guidance.
description_zh_TW: Vitamin E（α-生育醇）會增加快速 COMT（Val/Val）個體的癌症風險，正如補充試驗的亞組分析所報告的那樣，其中維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的快速 COMT 代謝與不良後果相關。該機制可能涉及改變兒茶酚雌激素或氧化代謝物的處理方式，這些代謝物因酶活性而異。這種基因-營養素交互作用提醒我們不要在快速基因型中全面推薦維生素 E。它強調了基因型感知抗氧化指導的重要性。

label: cancer risk in slow COMT
description: Vitamin E reduces cancer risk in slow COMT individuals, with the protective effect concentrated in Met/Met genotypes in stratified trial data, likely reflecting more favorable metabolism of vitamin E and associated catechols when COMT activity is low. This contrasts with the increased risk observed in fast COMT genotypes, demonstrating a bidirectional gene-nutrient interaction. The mechanism is thought to involve COMT-dependent handling of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and catecholestrogens. Genotype-stratified analysis is therefore essential for interpreting antioxidant trials.
description_zh_TW: Vitamin E 減少了 cancer risk in slow COMT 個體，分層試驗數據中的保護作用集中在 Met/Met 基因型上，這可能反映出當 COMT activity 較低時維生素 E 和相關兒茶酚的代謝更有利。這與快速 COMT 基因型中觀察到的風險增加形成鮮明對比，證明了基因與營養的雙向交互作用。此機制被認為涉及 COMT 依賴的維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體和兒茶酚雌激素的處理。因此，基因型分層分析對於解釋抗氧化試驗至關重要。

label: PARPs
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: As the innate immune response activates to fight infection, the activation of PARPs increases due to extensive DNA damage and IFN-induced MARylation (mono-ADP-ribosylation) of target SARS-CoV-2 proteins, and this PARP response is required for inhibition of viral replication. However, this antiviral effect is reversed by the ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3, whose activity is required for virulence. These findings indicate that key events in the innate immune response to viral infections occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through NAM and NR kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support
description_zh_TW: 當先天免疫反應活化以對抗感染時，由於廣泛的 DNA 損傷與 IFN 誘發的目標 SARS-CoV-2 蛋白 MARylation（單-ADP-核糖基化）作用，PARPs 的活化增加，而此 PARP 反應是抑制病毒複製所必需的。然而，此抗病毒效果被病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 所逆轉，其活性為毒力所必需。這些發現指出，對病毒感染的先天免疫反應中的關鍵事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 NAM 與 NR 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能以支援

label: Pentosidine
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Pentosidine is a cross-linking advanced glycation end product that accumulates in skin with age, together with argpyrimidine. It is also found to increase with age in the lamina cribrosa, lung collagen, patellar tendon, vitreous body, oocytes, intervertebral disk, and cartilage. Pentosidine is formed from the reaction of sugars with lysine and arginine residues and functions as a fluorescent AGE marker of cumulative glycation. Its age-dependent accumulation in skin and other connective tissues reflects the progressive cross-linking and stiffening of the extracellular matrix during aging.
description_zh_TW: Pentosidine 是一種 cross-linking advanced glycation end product，會隨年齡與 argpyrimidine 一起堆積於 skin 中。它也發現會隨年齡在 lamina cribrosa、lung collagen、patellar tendon、vitreous body、oocytes、intervertebral disk 與 cartilage 中增加。Pentosidine 由 sugars 與 lysine 和 arginine residues 反應形成，並作為 cumulative glycation 的 fluorescent AGE marker。其在 skin 與其他 connective tissues 中隨年齡的 accumulation 反映了 aging 過程中 extracellular matrix 的漸進 cross-linking 與 stiffening。

label: peripheral tissues
description: S-COMT (soluble COMT) predominates in peripheral tissues such as liver, kidney, and erythrocytes, where it handles the bulk of systemic catechol and catechol-drug metabolism. Unlike MB-COMT, it lacks a membrane anchor and is freely cytosolic, with lower affinity but higher capacity for catechol substrates. Its peripheral dominance means COMT genotype strongly affects systemic catechol disposition and drug responses, such as levodopa metabolism. This isoform distribution underpins the peripheral effects of COMT inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: S-COMT（可溶性 COMT）在 peripheral tissues 中占主導地位，例如肝臟、腎臟和紅血球，它處理大量的全身兒茶酚和兒茶酚藥物代謝。與 MB-COMT 不同，它缺乏膜錨並自由地存在於胞質中，對兒茶酚底物的親和力較低，但容量較高。其周邊優勢意味著 COMT genotype 強烈影響全身兒茶酚處置和藥物反應，例如左旋多巴代謝。這種異構體分佈支撐了 COMT 抑制劑的周邊作用。

label: Peroxisome membrane assembly
description: PEX1 is an ATPase essential for peroxisome membrane assembly and matrix protein import, operating as part of the peroxisomal AAA (ATPases associated with diverse cellular activities) machinery. Loss of PEX1 causes a complete lack of functional peroxisomes, as import and biogenesis cannot proceed. This essential role makes PEX1 mutations among the most common causes of peroxisome biogenesis disorders. The gene thus sits at the foundation of peroxisome formation and metabolic competence.
description_zh_TW: PEX1 是一種對過氧化體膜組裝和基質蛋白輸入至關必要的 ATPase，作為過氧化體 AAA（與多樣細胞活動相關的 ATPase）機械的一部分運作。PEX1 的缺失導致功能性過氧化體完全缺乏，因為輸入和生物發生無法進行。此必要角色使 PEX1 突變成為過氧化體生物發生障礙最常見的原因。因此該基因位居過氧化體形成和代謝能力的基礎。

label: Phagocytes
description: Phagocytes use the respiratory burst to produce high concentrations of ROS and RNS via NOX2 and inducible NOS, creating an antimicrobial environment in the phagosome and extracellular space. This oxidant surge kills engulfed pathogens but also risks collateral tissue damage. The directionality is immune activation to oxidant deployment. A caveat is that the burst is tightly compartmentalized and regulated; failure (CGD) causes infection, while excess causes inflammatory injury. The burst is also coordinated with phagosome maturation, degranulation, and acidification, ensuring oxidants act where pathogens are contained.
description_zh_TW: Phagocytes 使用 respiratory burst 透過 NOX2 和誘導型 NOS 產生高濃度的 ROS 和 RNS，在吞噬體和細胞外空間中創建抗菌環境 ironment。這種氧化激增會殺死被吞噬的病原體，但也有可能造成組織損傷。方向性是對氧化劑部署的免疫活化。需要注意的是，爆發是嚴格劃分和監管的。失敗（CGD）會導致感染，而過量則會導致發炎損傷。這種爆發也與吞噬體的成熟、脫粒和酸化相協調，確保氧化劑在病原體所在的地方發揮作用。

label: Phagocytic Lysosome Reformation
description: SLC-36.1 (a solute carrier) forms a complex with the PPK-3/PIKfyve kinase module to regulate phagocytic lysosome reformation (PLR), the process by which phagolysosomes regenerate new lysosomes after phagocytosis. By influencing PI(3,5)P2 generation and membrane dynamics, this complex ensures restoration of the lysosomal pool following immune or clearance challenges. Defects in PLR impair the ability of phagocytes to sustain repeated rounds of degradation. The pathway connects solute transport and phosphoinositide metabolism to innate immune function.
description_zh_TW: SLC-36.1（一種溶質載體）與 PPK-3/PIKfyve 激酶模組形成複合物，以調節吞噬性溶酶體重組（PLR）——即吞噬溶酶體在吞噬作用後再生新溶酶體的過程。透過影響 PI(3,5)P2 生成和膜動力學，此複合物確保在免疫或清除挑戰後溶酶體庫的恢復。PLR 的缺陷會損害吞噬細胞持續多輪降解的能力。此途徑將溶質運輸和磷酸肌醇代謝連結到先天免疫功能。

label: Phosphorylated TFEB
description: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

label: PIKfyve
description: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

label: TFEB independent of mTOR
description: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

label: PKCβ
description: Protein kinase C beta (PKCβ) phosphorylates TFEB at a cluster of C-terminal serines (461, 462, 466, 468), modifications that promote TFEB stability rather than suppressing it. Enhanced stability increases the available pool of TFEB that can be activated when nuclear entry is permitted. This contrasts with the predominantly inhibitory phosphorylations at N-terminal mTORC1 sites, illustrating that C-terminal modifications can be activatory. The PKCβ-TFEB relationship adds nuance to the site-specific regulatory code governing the transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C beta（PKCβ）在 C 端絲胺酸簇（461、462、466、468）磷酸化 TFEB，這些修飾促進 TFEB 穩定性而非抑制它。增強的穩定性增加了在核進入被許可時可被活化的 TFEB 可用庫。這與 N 端 mTORC1 位點主要為抑制性磷酸化形成對比，說明 C 端修飾可以是活化性的。PKCβ-TFEB 關係為控制該轉錄因子的位點特異性調節密碼增添了細微差別。

label: Antigen Presentation
description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
