label: Complex I and Complex IV
description: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
description_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

label: Sphingosine-1-phosphate
description: ACase overexpression raises sphingosine/S1P levels, which is classically anti-apoptotic and helps senescent cells resist apoptosis via SCAP pathways.
description_zh_TW: ACase 過度表現提高 sphingosine/S1P 水平，此在經典上為抗凋亡，並透過 SCAP 路徑幫助衰老細胞抵抗凋亡。

label: ASAH1
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, aCDase) is encoded by ASAH1. It is a lysosomal hydrolase that cleaves ceramide into sphingosine and a free fatty acid.
description_zh_TW: 酸性神經醯胺酶（ACase、aCDase）由 ASAH1 編碼。它是一種溶酶體水解酶，可將神經醯胺裂解為鞘氨醇與游離脂肪酸。

label: Carmofur
description: Carmofur has IC50 29 nM against acid ceramidase, is clinically approved in Japan, crosses the BBB, and is a repurposing candidate for senolytic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Carmofur 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 為 29 nM，已在日本獲臨床核准，可穿過血腦屏障（BBB），是去衰老（senolytic）治療的再利用候選藥物。

label: ARN14794
description: ARN14794 has IC50 ~100 nM against acid ceramidase and was specifically used in the Soriano-Castell 2026 ferroptosis study to reduce membrane PL-PUFA content.
description_zh_TW: ARN14794 對酸性神經醯胺酶的 IC50 約為 100 nM，並在 Soriano-Castell 2026 年的鐵蛋白死亡研究中被專門用於降低膜磷脂中 PL-PUFA 的含量。

label: PUFA
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase) over-expression increases the polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) content of membrane phospholipids, promoting a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile. Mechanistically, ACase-mediated ceramide breakdown releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that, via the Lands cycle, are exchanged into sn-2 PUFA-containing phospholipids (PL-PUFAs) - the substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACase knockdown in senescent cells decreased the most abundant PL-PUFA species (including PC-AA, PG-DHA, PG-DPA), thereby reducing the lipid peroxidation substrate pool and conferring ferroptosis resistance.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶 (ACase) 過表達增加了膜磷脂中的不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 含量，促進了促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態。從機制上講，ACase 介導的絲胺類分解釋放了自由飽和和一元飽和脂肪酸，透過 Lands 循環轉化為 sn-2 PUFA 含有磷脂 (PL-PUFAs) - 這是脂質過氧化反應的底物。在老化的細胞中，ACase 下調降低了最豐富的 PL-PUFA 物種（包括 PC-AA、PG-DHA、PG-DPA），從而降低了脂質過氧化反應底物池，並賦予了焦蛋白死亡的抵抗力。

label: Sphingosine
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acid ceramidase catalyzes the breakdown of ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, directly producing sphingosine in the cell. This enzymatic hydrolysis is a key branch point in sphingolipid metabolism, and in senescent cells the resulting reshaping of membrane lipid composition pushes membranes toward a pro-ferroptotic profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Because the excess sphingosine and free fatty acids generated by elevated acid ceramidase feed the lipid-peroxidation cascade, the enzyme serves as a mechanistic link between the cellular programs of senescence and ferroptosis, and its removal protects cells from ferroptotic death.
description_zh_TW: 酸陶瓷酶催化絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，直接在細胞中產生腎上腺素。這種酶促水解是腎上腺素脂質代謝中的一個關鍵分支點，在老化的細胞中，由此重塑的膜脂類組成推動膜朝向富含不飽和脂肪酸 (PUFAs) 的促進焦蛋白死亡的型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。因為過量的腎上腺素和由升高後的酸陶瓷酶產生的自由脂肪酸餵養了脂質過氧化反應的過程，因此這種酶作為細胞衰老和焦蛋白死亡兩個程序之間的機制聯繫，並且去除這種酶可以保護細胞免受焦蛋白死亡的死亡。

label: Senolytic Drug Target
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acid ceramidase is a druggable, near-term, testable senotherapeutic target for clearing senescent cells. Experimental drugs targeting acid ceramidase have already been developed for other therapeutic purposes, demonstrating that the enzyme is targetable and lighting the way toward future innovation that could extend healthspans. Because elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis, inhibitors of the enzyme could selectively eliminate senescent 'zombie' cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. The Salk team calls this a big milestone in the public health effort to support healthy aging, with the next steps being pathway completion, animal translation, and clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶是一種可藥物標靶、近期且可測試的衰老細胞治療目標，用於清除衰老細胞。針對酸甘油酯酶的實驗性藥物已經針對其他治療目的而開發，證明該酶可標靶，為未來的創新開闢了道路，可能延長壽命。由於酸甘油酯酶升高會使衰老細胞更容易受到焦慮素突變的影響，因此抑制該酶可能能夠選擇性地消除衰老「殭屍」細胞，同時保持周圍細胞健康。沙鹿團隊將這歸結為公共衛生努力支持健康老齡化的重要里程碑，接下來的步驟包括通路完成、動物翻譯和臨床試驗。

label: Senescence-Messaging Secretome
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Senescent cells - often called 'zombie' cells - are a hallmark of aging: they do not completely die but also are not quite alive, and while sometimes harmless, they release harmful factors called the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) into surrounding tissues. This secretory phenotype is pro-inflammatory and can promote the development of diseases or disorders, including cancer, and accelerates aging by driving tissue dysfunction. Because senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions including arthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, clearing them - as proposed through acid ceramidase-mediated ferroptosis sensitization - is a major strategy for extending healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞——常被稱為「殭屍」細胞——是衰老的特徵之一：它們不會完全死亡，卻也不完全活著；雖然有時無害，它們會將稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的有害因子釋放到周圍組織。這種分泌表型具促發炎性，可促進包括癌症在內的疾病或障礙發展，並透過驅動組織功能障礙而加速衰老。由於衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病，清除它們——如透過酸性神經醯胺酶介導的鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感化所提出——是延長健康壽命的主要策略。

label: Ferroptosis Susceptibility
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Vulnerable senescent cells are able to pass their ferroptosis vulnerability on to neighboring cells, helping explain why only a few senescent cells can turn into more and ultimately impact a larger tissue over time. This paracrine transmission of ferroptosis sensitivity means that a small number of senescent cells can spread susceptibility to ferroptotic death across a tissue, and it represents one mechanism by which the Salk team found ferroptosis and senescence to be connected during aging. The researchers describe the target as eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy for longer, and the finding underpins the therapeutic rationale for targeting acid ceramidase.
description_zh_TW: 脆弱的衰老細胞能將其鐵依賴性細胞死亡的脆弱性傳遞給鄰近細胞，這有助於解釋為何少數衰老細胞能轉變為更多衰老細胞，並最終隨時間影響更大的組織。這種鐵依賴性細胞死亡敏感性的旁分泌傳遞，意味著少數衰老細胞就能將對鐵依賴性細胞死亡的易感性擴散至整個組織；Salk團隊發現這是鐵依賴性細胞死亡與衰老在老化過程中相互關聯的機制之一。研究人員將目標描述為清除衰老細胞，同時讓鄰近細胞更長久地保持健康；此發現支持了以酸性神經醯胺酶為標靶的治療學理。

label: RSL3
description: RSL3 is the prototype class-II ferroptosis inducer: it directly inhibits glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), the only enzyme that can reduce lipid hydroperoxides inside membranes. GPX4 inhibition makes the cell unable to neutralize lipid peroxides regardless of GSH supply, committing it to ferroptotic death. RSL3 synergy with autophagic GPX4 degradation (Fin56, copper) and its use alongside system-xc- blockers like erastin represent the two supply-side and effector-side strategies for triggering ferroptosis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: RSL3 是第二類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型：它直接抑制麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶 4（GPX4）——唯一能在膜內還原脂質氫過氧化物的酶。GPX4 受抑制後，無論 GSH 供應如何，細胞都無法中和脂質過氧化物，注定走向鐵死亡。RSL3 與自噬介導的 GPX4 降解（Fin56、銅）之間的協同，以及與 system xc- 阻斷劑（如 erastin）的並用，代表觸發癌症鐵死亡的供給端與效應端兩大策略。

label: Sphingomyelin
description: Sphingomyelin is a phosphosphingolipid composed of ceramide linked to phosphocholine and serves as a reservoir for ceramide generation. It is a major structural lipid of the plasma membrane and myelin, and sphingomyelinases convert it back to ceramide.
description_zh_TW: 神經鞘磷脂是由 ceramide 連接磷酸膽鹼組成的磷酸鞘脂，並作為 ceramide 生成的儲庫。它是質膜與髓鞘的主要結構脂質，神經鞘磷脂酶將其轉化回 ceramide。

label: Blue-gray pigmentation of skin, eyes and mucous membranes
description: Argyria results in a blue-grayish pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes, caused by deposition of silver in body tissues after large doses of silver or its compounds are absorbed into the circulatory system. Argyria is rare, and although, so far as known, the condition does not otherwise harm a person's health, it is disfiguring and usually permanent. Mild forms of argyria are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis, which is clinically relevant because cyanosis signals hypoxemia while argyria simply reflects lifelong silver deposition.
description_zh_TW: Argyria導致皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的藍灰色色素沉著，由大劑量銀或其化合物吸收進入循環系統後在體組織中沉積引起。Argyria罕見，雖然據目前所知，該病變對健康無其他損害，但它會毀容且通常永久。輕度argyria有時被誤認為發紺，這在臨床上相關，因為發紺表示低氧血症，而argyria僅反映終身銀沉積。

label: Benzocaine
description: Benzocaine is a topical/local anesthetic that is a recognized trigger of acquired methemoglobinemia. Like other oxidizing drugs, it overwhelms the body's reducing systems, converting hemoglobin's ferrous iron to the ferric methemoglobin form. Acquired methemoglobinemia is much more common than congenital forms and can be acute and severe, especially with high-dose or combined exposures. Related local anesthetics prilocaine and lidocaine, along with antimalarials, dapsone, rasburicase and inhaled nitric oxide, are similarly implicated, and nitrite-based agents such as amyl and isobutyl nitrites and sodium nitrite are additional culprits.
description_zh_TW: Benzocaine is a topical/local anesthetic that is a recognized trigger of acquired methemoglobinemia。Like other oxidizing drugs, it overwhelms the body's reducing systems, converting hemoglobin's ferrous iron to the ferric methemoglobin form。Acquired methemoglobinemia is much more common than congenital forms and can be acute and severe, especially with high-dose or combined exposures。Related local anesthetics prilocaine and lidocaine, along with antimalarials, dapsone, rasburicase and inhaled nitric oxide, are similarly implicated, and nitrite-based agents such as amyl and isobutyl nitrites and sodium nitrite are additional culprits。

label: Cytochrome b5 reductase
description: Cytochrome b5 reductase (also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase or diaphorase) is the enzyme primarily responsible for reducing methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin. Autosomal recessive mutations causing deficiency of this enzyme produce the most common congenital form of methemoglobinemia: Type 1 affects only erythrocytes and mainly causes cyanosis, while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems. Congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are much rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia.
description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase (also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase or diaphorase) is the enzyme primarily responsible for reducing methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin。Autosomal recessive mutations causing deficiency of this enzyme produce the most common congenital form of methemoglobinemia: Type 1 affects only erythrocytes and mainly causes cyanosis, while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems。Congenital forms are present from birth or appear in infancy and are much rarer than acquired methemoglobinemia。

label: Dapsone
description: Dapsone is a medication that is a very common cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, especially with chronic use. Acquired methemoglobinemia is triggered when oxidizing agents overwhelm the body's reducing systems, and dapsone is among the most frequent offending drugs. Dapsone-related cases are often managed by dose reduction or discontinuation rather than always requiring methylene blue treatment. Other common drug triggers include topical and local anesthetics such as benzocaine, prilocaine and lidocaine, antimalarials such as chloroquine, rasburicase, and inhaled nitric oxide.
description_zh_TW: Dapsone is a medication that is a very common cause of acquired methemoglobinemia, especially with chronic use。Acquired methemoglobinemia is triggered when oxidizing agents overwhelm the body's reducing systems, and dapsone is among the most frequent offending drugs。Dapsone-related cases are often managed by dose reduction or discontinuation rather than always requiring methylene blue treatment。Other common drug triggers include topical and local anesthetics such as benzocaine, prilocaine and lidocaine, antimalarials such as chloroquine, rasburicase, and inhaled nitric oxide。

label: G6PD deficiency
description: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes. Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis. In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen.
description_zh_TW: G6PD deficiency is an inherited condition that impairs the pentose phosphate pathway and NADPH generation in erythrocytes。Because methylene blue's therapeutic effect in methemoglobinemia depends on the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, methylene blue should be avoided or used cautiously in G6PD-deficient patients, where it carries a risk of causing hemolysis。In such cases, ascorbic acid is an alternative treatment, and severe or refractory methemoglobinemia may require exchange transfusion or hyperbaric oxygen。

label: Oxygen
description: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state. In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal. When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues. This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin is the oxidized form of hemoglobin in which heme iron is in the ferric (Fe3+) state rather than the ferrous (Fe2+) state。In this form, the affected subunit cannot bind or transport oxygen, which makes methemoglobin functionally useless for oxygen delivery even though total hemoglobin levels may appear normal。When methemoglobin accumulates, it also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin, further impairing oxygen release to tissues。This creates a functional anemia, and elevated levels lead to methemoglobinemia with consequent tissue hypoxia。

label: Oxygen-dissociation curve
description: Methemoglobin, the ferric form of hemoglobin, not only fails to carry oxygen itself but also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin in the tetramer. This left shift increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen and impairs oxygen release to tissues, creating a functional anemia even when total hemoglobin levels are normal or near-normal. When methemoglobin levels rise substantially, the resulting impairment of oxygen delivery causes tissue hypoxia, and symptoms progress from cyanosis to headaches, confusion, arrhythmias, and eventually coma as the percentage of methemoglobin increases.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobin, the ferric form of hemoglobin, not only fails to carry oxygen itself but also causes a left shift in the oxygen-dissociation curve of the remaining normal hemoglobin in the tetramer。This left shift increases hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen and impairs oxygen release to tissues, creating a functional anemia even when total hemoglobin levels are normal or near-normal。When methemoglobin levels rise substantially, the resulting impairment of oxygen delivery causes tissue hypoxia, and symptoms progress from cyanosis to headaches, confusion, arrhythmias, and eventually coma as the percentage of methemoglobin increases。

label: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase
description: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase, is the primary enzyme that converts methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin by reducing ferric heme iron to the ferrous state. It keeps steady-state methemoglobin levels below 1-2% in healthy individuals despite the spontaneous oxidation of hemoglobin. Deficiency of this enzyme, due to autosomal recessive mutations, is the most common congenital cause of methemoglobinemia, with Type 1 affecting only erythrocytes and causing cyanosis while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems.
description_zh_TW: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, also called cytochrome b5 reductase or diaphorase, is the primary enzyme that converts methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin by reducing ferric heme iron to the ferrous state。It keeps steady-state methemoglobin levels below 1-2% in healthy individuals despite the spontaneous oxidation of hemoglobin。Deficiency of this enzyme, due to autosomal recessive mutations, is the most common congenital cause of methemoglobinemia, with Type 1 affecting only erythrocytes and causing cyanosis while the rarer Type 2 systemic form is more severe and involves neurological problems。

label: Oxyhemoglobin
description: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin, a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-). These radicals, along with hydrogen peroxide, can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production. Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state, and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen. This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions.
description_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin (HbO2) spontaneously autoxidizes to methemoglobin，a process that generates superoxide anion (O2-)。These radicals，along with hydrogen peroxide，can co-oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome，a well-documented reaction historically used as an assay for superoxide production。Methemoglobin is the form of hemoglobin in which the heme iron is oxidized from the ferrous (Fe2+) to the ferric (Fe3+) state，and it cannot effectively bind or transport oxygen。This autoxidation links red blood cell chemistry to catecholamine oxidation and provides a route for adrenochrome formation in blood under oxidative conditions。

label: Sodium nitrite
description: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures. Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity. Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants. Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion.
description_zh_TW: Sodium nitrite is a chemical that can trigger acquired methemoglobinemia, seen in suicide attempts, contaminated food, and industrial exposures。Nitrites and nitrates oxidize hemoglobin's heme iron to the ferric state, overwhelming the body's reducing capacity。Related nitrite and nitrate sources include amyl nitrite and isobutyl nitrite ('poppers'), aniline dyes, nitrobenzene, and well-water nitrates that cause 'blue baby syndrome' in infants。Acquired methemoglobinemia from such agents can be acute and severe, particularly with high-dose or combined exposures, and recent trends show increases in nitrite-related cases from recreational use or intentional ingestion。

label: Methemoglobin Reductase
description: Methylene blue, at low doses, serves as a cofactor that enhances the activity of the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, allowing it to reduce methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin. This mechanism is the basis for methylene blue's role as the first-line treatment for symptomatic methemoglobinemia. Because it relies on NADPH generated by the pentose phosphate pathway, methylene blue can be ineffective or dangerous in G6PD-deficient patients, where NADPH production is impaired and the drug instead risks precipitating hemolysis.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue, at low doses, serves as a cofactor that enhances the activity of the NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase pathway, allowing it to reduce methemoglobin back to functional hemoglobin。This mechanism is the basis for methylene blue's role as the first-line treatment for symptomatic methemoglobinemia。Because it relies on NADPH generated by the pentose phosphate pathway, methylene blue can be ineffective or dangerous in G6PD-deficient patients, where NADPH production is impaired and the drug instead risks precipitating hemolysis。

label: Chlorpromazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Chlorpromazine, a phenothiazine carrying an amine side chain on its 10-nitrogen, was the only compound among those tested that failed to protect HT-22 cells in the rotenone neurotoxicity model. The 10-N substitution causes a roughly 1000-fold loss of potency relative to methylene blue in glutamate, IAA, and rotenone assays, and abolishes the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt, oxygen consumption enhancement, and glycolysis suppression. In the lysate oxidation assay chlorpromazine increased DCF fluorescence with or without mitochondria and NADH, behaving as a pro-oxidant and explaining its weak neuroprotection.
description_zh_TW: 氯丙嗪（chlorpromazine）是在其10-氮上帶有胺側鏈的吩噻嗪（phenothiazine），是受測化合物中唯一無法在魚藤酮（rotenone）神經毒性模型中保護HT-22細胞的化合物。與亞甲藍（methylene blue）相比，10-N取代在麩胺酸（glutamate）、IAA與魚藤酮試驗中造成約1000倍的效力損失，並消除複合體I至細胞色素c的電子分流、耗氧量增強與糖解抑制。在裂解液氧化試驗中，氯丙嗪在有或無粒線體與NADH的情況下皆增加DCF螢光，表現出促氧化劑（pro-oxidant）行為，這解釋了其微弱的神經保護作用。

label: Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase
description: Due to the risk of hemolysis and worsening anemia, methylene blue is contraindicated in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency. The hemolysis associated with methylene blue is mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties that overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, and G6PD-deficient individuals have impaired NADPH generation that limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis. Methylene blue is also contraindicated in individuals with a known history of anaphylaxis or severe hypersensitivity to methylene blue or related thiazine dye products.
description_zh_TW: 由於溶血和貧血惡化的風險，methylene blue在葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶缺乏症患者中是禁忌的。與methylene blue相關的溶血在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，而G6PD缺乏個體的NADPH生成受損，限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，易於快速溶血。Methylene blue在已知有對methylene blue或相關噻嗪染料產品過敏或嚴重超敏反應病史的個體中也是禁忌的。

label: Mitochondrial Superoxide
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) attenuates mitochondrial superoxide production by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III, preventing electron backflow and premature electron leak to oxygen at these upstream sites. In HT-22 hippocampal neurons challenged with glutamate, MB dose-dependently suppressed the rise in mitochondrial ROS (EC50 ~20.37 nM), as measured by H2DCFDA, flow cytometry, and fluorescent microscopy. The reduced form leuco-MB can also directly scavenge superoxide and recycle back to oxidized MB, making MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過作為替代電子傳遞載體，繞過複合體 I-III，減少線粒體超氧化物的產生，防止電子回流和提前洩漏到這些上游位點的氧氣。在 HT-22 海馬神經元中挑戰穀氨酸，MB 以劑量依賴方式抑制線粒體 ROS 的上升（EC50 ~20.37 nM），通過 H2DCFDA、流式細胞術和螢光顯微鏡測量。還原型 leuco-MB 也能直接清除超氧化物並回收為氧化型 MB，使 MB 成為可再生的、線粒體特異性抗氧化劑。

label: NADH
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。

label: LeucoMB
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is reduced to its colorless leuco form, leuco-MB, upon accepting electrons from NADH via mitochondrial complex I. In this reduced state leuco-MB functions as a direct free-radical scavenger, capable of neutralizing superoxide generated by inhibition of the electron transport chain, and it then recycles back to the oxidized form of MB. This reduction-oxidation cycle makes MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant, distinct from one-use chain-breaking antioxidants. The requirement for NADH and mitochondria distinguishes MB's antioxidant action from that of simpler phenothiazine derivatives.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在通過粒線體複合物I從NADH接受電子後還原為其無色的leuco形式，leuco-MB。在這種還原狀態下，leuco-MB作為直接的自由基清除劑發揮作用，能夠中和由電子傳遞鏈抑制產生的超氧化物，然後它循環回MB的氧化形式。這種還原-氧化循環使MB成為一種可再生的、粒線體特異性的抗氧化劑，與一次性鏈斷裂抗氧化劑不同。對NADH和粒線體的要求將MB的抗氧化作用與更簡單的吩噻嗪衍生物區分開來。

label: Phenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is the first lead chemical structure of the phenothiazine class, the parent heterocyclic scaffold from which many other drugs derive. Structure-activity analysis showed that MB's distinctive neuroprotective and bioenergetic phenotype requires two structural features of the phenothiazine nucleus: a free (unsubstituted) 10-nitrogen and the position-5 sulfur of the thiazine ring. Adding an amine side chain to the 10-nitrogen (as in chlorpromazine or promethazine) produced roughly a 1000-fold loss of potency and abolished the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)是吩噻嗪類的第一個先導化學結構，是許多其他藥物衍生的母體雜環骨架。結構-活性分析表明，MB獨特的神經保護和生物能量表型需要吩噻嗪核的兩個結構特徵：游離（未取代的）10-氮和噻嗪環的5位硫。將胺側鏈添加到10-氮（如chlorpromazine或promethazine中）導致效力損失約1000倍，並廢除了複合物I到細胞色素c的電子分流。

label: Iodoacetic Acid
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) protects HT-22 cells against iodoacetic acid (IAA)-induced neurotoxicity. IAA is a toxic acetate derivative that inhibits glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate dehydrogenase and disrupts disulfide bonds, causing increased ROS and lipid peroxidation. MB increased cell viability against IAA at concentrations of 100 nM and 1 uM (though it lost protection at 10 uM), and all MB-related compounds tested were efficacious in this assay. MB's protection in the IAA model, together with the glutamate and rotenone models, demonstrates broad efficacy against mitochondrial and oxidative insults.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 可保護 HT-22 細胞免受碘乙酸 (IAA) 誘導的神經毒性。IAA 是一種有毒的醋酸鹽衍生物，可抑制甘油醛 3-磷酸脫氫酶並破壞二硫鍵，導致 ROS 和脂質過氧化增加。MB 在 100 nM 和 1 uM 濃度下可提高細胞對 IAA 的存活率（但在 10 uM 時失去保護作用），且所有測試的 MB 相關化合物在此檢測中均有效。MB 在 IAA 模型中的保護作用，加上穀氨酸和魚藤酮模型，證明其對線粒體和氧化損傷具有廣泛功效。

label: Glucose Oxidase
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) provides no protection against direct extracellular oxidative stress generated by glucose oxidase, which produces hydrogen peroxide in the culture medium. In HT-22 cells, glucose oxidase induced 80% cell death within 3 hours that was not attenuated by MB at any concentration tested, whereas the conventional antioxidant pyruvate (4 mM) provided robust protection. This distinguishes MB from classical chain-breaking antioxidants: MB acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow rather than as a direct scavenger of extracellular hydrogen peroxide.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)對葡萄糖氧化酶產生的直接細胞外氧化應激沒有提供保護作用，葡萄糖氧化酶在培養基中產生過氧化氫。在HT-22細胞中，葡萄糖氧化酶在3小時內誘導80%的細胞死亡，這在任何測試濃度下都沒有被MB減弱，而傳統抗氧化劑丙酮酸（4 mM）提供了強大的保護作用。這將MB與經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑區分開來：MB在粒線體電子流的上游起作用，而不是作為細胞外過氧化氫的直接清除劑。

label: Complex III
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional Complex III in the mitochondrial electron transport chain, rerouting electron flow to maintain ATP production when normal respiratory chain pathways are impaired. Together with its ability to bypass Complex I, this makes methylene blue a molecular shunt that sustains oxidative phosphorylation and ATP output in compromised mitochondria. This effect is demonstrated in cellular and animal studies at sub-1 mg/kg doses (roughly 1-4 mg per dose in adults). The mitochondrial longevity data are largely from cells and mice, so human translation is not guaranteed, and most mechanistic evidence remains preclinical.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue可以繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的複合物III，在正常呼吸鏈路徑受損時重新引導電子流以維持ATP產生。與其繞過複合物I的能力結合，這使得methylene blue成為一種分子分流器，在受損的粒線體中維持氧化磷酸化和ATP輸出。這種效果在細胞和動物研究中以低於1 mg/kg的劑量（成人大約每次1-4毫克）得到證實。粒線體長壽數據主要來自細胞和小鼠，因此不能保證在人體中的轉化，大多數機制證據仍處於臨床前階段。

label: Dose-dependent Toxicity
description: Methylene blue demonstrates clear dose-dependent toxicity thresholds. At single doses of 3 mg/kg or more, hypotension, wheezing, and reduced oxygenation have been reported. Cumulative doses of 7 mg/kg or more can cause significant toxicity including nausea, vomiting, precordial pain, dyspnea, tachypnea, chest tightness, tachycardia, apprehension, tremor, mydriasis, abdominal pain, dizziness, paresthesia, headache, confusion, and mild methemoglobinemia up to 7 percent, with effects lasting 2 to 12 hours. Severe overdosage with a single dose of 20 mg/kg or more has caused severe intravascular hemolysis, hyperbilirubinemia, and death, and there is no specific antidote.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue顯示出明確的劑量依賴性毒性閾值。在單劑量3 mg/kg或更高時，已報告低血壓、喘鳴和氧合減少。累積劑量7 mg/kg或更高可能引起顯著毒性，包括毒性，包括噁心、嘔吐、心前區疼痛、呼吸困難、呼吸急促、胸緊、心動過速、焦慮、震顫、瞳孔散大、腹痛、頭暈、感覺異常、頭痛、意識模糊和輕度methemoglobinemia（高達7%），效果持續2至12小時。單劑量20 mg/kg或更嚴重的過量已導致嚴重的血管內溶血、高膽紅素血癥和死亡，並且沒有特異性解毒劑。

label: Intraoperative Staining
description: Methylene blue has several well-established off-label applications, including intraoperative staining to enhance visualization of structures such as the ureters, parathyroid glands, and sentinel lymph nodes during surgery, including sentinel lymph node mapping in breast cancer and other malignancies. For intraoperative lymph node mapping, 1 to 5 mL of 1 percent methylene blue is injected peritumorally, subareolarly, or pericervically depending on tumor type and anatomical site, and the dye migrates through lymphatic channels to allow visual identification of sentinel lymph nodes to guide surgical staging and resection.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue有幾個well-established的非標籤應用，包括術中染色以增強手術期間結構的可視化，如輸尿管、甲狀旁腺和前哨淋巴結，包括乳腺癌和其他惡性腫瘤中的前哨淋巴結定位。對於術中淋巴結定位，根據腫瘤類型和解剖部位，將1至5毫升1%的methylene blue注入瘤周、乳暈下或宮頸周圍，染料通過淋巴通道遷移，以實現前哨淋巴結的視覺識別，從而指導手術分期和切除。

label: Serotonin
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue increases synaptic serotonin by inhibiting monoamine oxidase enzymes, which normally break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine. Inhibiting these enzymes means more of these neurotransmitters remain in the synapse, which is how antidepressants like phenelzine work. This mechanism provides methylene blue's mild mood-lifting and anxiolytic effects at 0.5-2 mg doses, but it is also the source of its most serious safety concern: combining methylene blue with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome - a documented case-report-level interaction requiring physician involvement.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue通過抑制單胺氧化酶酶來增加突觸血清素，這些酶通常分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素。抑制這些酶意味著更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中，這就是phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用方式。這種機制在0.5-2毫克劑量下提供methylene blue的輕度情緒提升和抗焦慮作用，但這也是其最嚴重安全問題的來源：將methylene blue與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群——這是一種已記錄的病例報告級別的相互作用，需要醫師參與。

label: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue interacts dangerously with SSRIs and other serotonergic medications. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, methylene blue raises synaptic serotonin, and combining it with SSRIs (or SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs) can increase serotonin to dangerous levels, potentially causing serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern, and the article is emphatic that anyone on an antidepressant or serotonergic drug should not self-dose with methylene blue. If a person is on such medications, physician involvement is required before any dose, and the serotonin interaction screening is cited as a key reason to pursue a supervised protocol.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue與SSRIs和其他血清素能藥物危險地相互作用。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，methylene blue提高突觸血清素，將其與SSRIs（或SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物）結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，可能導致血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，文章強調任何服用抗抑鬱藥或血清素能藥物的人都不應自行服用methylene blue。如果一個人正在服用此類藥物，在任何劑量之前都需要醫師參與，並且血清素相互作用篩查被引用為追求監督方案的關鍵原因。

label: Vasoplegic Shock
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label as adjunctive therapy for refractory vasoplegic shock, including septic and anaphylactic shock, to increase systemic vascular resistance in cases refractory to standard vasopressors, particularly in the setting of cardiac surgery such as coronary artery bypass grafting. It is commonly administered as a single intravenous bolus of 2 mg/kg over 20 to 30 minutes, with some protocols incorporating a bolus followed by continuous infusion. Evidence supporting routine preoperative or postoperative prophylactic use to reduce mortality remains limited, and this practice is not considered standard of care.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療 refractory 血管舒張性休克，包括敗血性和過敏性休克，以增加系統性血管阻力，適用於對標準血管加壓素 refractory 的病例，特別是在心臟手術如冠狀動脈繞道移植術中。通常以 2 mg/kg 劑量靜脈注射推注，持續 20 至 30 分鐘，有些方案包括推注後持續輸注。支持常規術前或術後預防性使用以降低死亡率的證據仍然有限，此實踐不被視為 standard of care。

label: Ifosfamide-induced Encephalopathy
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label for the treatment of ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, the neurotoxicity associated with ifosfamide administration. For this indication, methylene blue is typically administered intravenously at a dosage of 50 mg every 4 hours until symptom resolution. This regimen is supported by case series and institutional experience, though dosing is individualized based on clinical response, with symptom resolution often occurring within 10 minutes to 24 hours.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療異環磷醯胺誘導的腦病變，即與異環磷醯胺給藥相關的神經毒性。對於此適應症，亞甲基藍通常以 50 mg 劑量靜脈注射，每 4 小時一次，直至症狀緩解。此方案由案例系列和機構經驗支持，但劑量根據臨床反應個體化，症狀緩解通常在 10 分鐘至 24 小時內發生。

label: Antimalarial Agent
description: Methylene blue was historically used as an antimalarial agent, though it is no longer considered standard therapy due to resistance and the availability of more effective agents. Its redox properties, which enable the restoration of functional hemoglobin and enhanced oxygen delivery, are the basis of its well-established FDA-approved role in toxicologic emergencies. Beyond this, the review catalogs off-label uses including intraoperative staining, ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, refractory vasoplegic shock, neuroprotection, psychiatric disorders, cyanide poisoning adjunct, and proposed anti-inflammatory use in COVID-19 and ARDS.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue在歷史上曾用作抗瘧疾藥物，但由於耐藥性和更有效藥物的可用性，它不再被認為是標準治療。其氧化還原特性使得功能性血紅蛋白恢復和增強氧氣輸送成為可能，這是在毒理學緊急情況中其well-established的FDA批准角色的基礎。除此之外，該綜述還列出了非標籤用途，包括術中染色、ifosfamide誘導的腦病變、難治性血管痙攣性休克、神經保護、精神疾病、氰化物中毒輔助治療，以及在COVID-19和ARDS中提出的抗炎用途。

label: Neutral Red
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Neutral red (NR), a phenazine formed by substituting nitrogen for the position-5 sulfur of the phenothiazine nucleus, retained the ability to increase cellular oxygen consumption (OCR) in Seahorse assays, similar to methylene blue and toluidine blue O, and these three compounds share similar negative redox potentials. However, NR had markedly weaker neuroprotective potency than MB in the glutamate, rotenone, and IAA assays and does not function as an alternative electron-transfer carrier in mitochondria, indicating that oxygen-consumption enhancement alone does not confer neuroprotection and that electron-shunt activity is the key protective feature.
description_zh_TW: 中性紅（NR）是一種由苯噻嗪核第5位硫被氮取代形成的吩嗪，在Seahorse分析中保留了增加細胞氧消耗率（OCR）的能力，類似於亞甲藍和甲苯胺藍O，這三種化合物具有相似的負氧化還原電位。然而，在麩氨酸、rotenone和IAA分析中，NR的神經保護效力明顯弱於MB，且不作為粒線體中的替代電子轉運載體發揮作用，表明僅增強氧消耗並不能賦予神經保護作用，而電子分流活性是關鍵的保護特徵。

label: Photobiomodulation
description: Photobiomodulation, applied as daily morning sunlight or targeted red and near-infrared light therapy, directly stimulates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria, enhancing ATP production. It is listed among the light, temperature, and environmental exposures that act as mitohormetic stressors. Cold exposure similarly activates brown adipose tissue and induces uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1) leading to increased mitochondrial density, while sauna heat exposure induces heat shock proteins that repair misfolded proteins and support mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 光生物調節，作為每日早晨陽光或靶向紅光和近紅外光療法施用，直接刺激粒線體中的細胞色素c氧化酶（複合物IV），增強ATP產生。它被列為作為線粒體興奮壓力源的光、溫度和環境暴露之一。冷暴露同樣激活棕色脂肪組織並誘導解偶聯蛋白1（UCP1），導致粒線體密度增加，而桑拿熱暴露誘導熱休克蛋白，修復錯誤折疊的蛋白質並支持粒線體功能。

label: Pulse Oximetry
description: The presence of methylene blue in the bloodstream can cause pulse oximetry to significantly underestimate true oxygen saturation by interfering with the device's measurement wavelengths. During and shortly after methylene blue infusion, arterial blood gas analysis with direct measurement of oxygen saturation (SaO2) should be used instead of pulse oximetry to accurately assess oxygenation. Methylene blue is also excreted in the urine and, because of its blue coloration, may interfere with urinalysis methods relying on colorimetric indicators such as dipstick testing for leukocyte esterase, potentially resulting in false-negative or uninterpretable results.
description_zh_TW: 血液中methylene blue的存在可能導致脈搏血氧儀通過干擾設備的測量波長而顯著低估真正的氧飽和度。在methylene blue輸注期間和之後不久，應使用直接測量氧飽和度（SaO2）的動脈血氣分析而不是脈搏血氧儀來準確評估氧合。Methylene blue也會在尿液中排泄，並且由於其藍色著色，可能干擾依賴比色指標的尿液分析方法，如白細胞酯酶的試紙檢測，可能導致假陰性或無法解釋的結果。

label: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain
description: At the cellular level, methylene blue can bypass dysfunctional components of the mitochondrial electron transport chain by shuttling electrons from NADH, in the presence of Complex I, and donating them directly to cytochrome c, effectively bypassing complexes I through III. This alternative electron transfer pathway enhances mitochondrial respiration, increases oxygen consumption, reduces mitochondrial superoxide production, and mitigates oxidative stress. These mechanisms underlie the neuroprotective effects of methylene blue in conditions such as Alzheimer disease, Parkinson disease, traumatic brain injury, and ischemic stroke.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞水平，methylene blue可以通過在複合物I存在下從NADH穿梭電子，並直接將其捐贈給細胞色素c，有效地繞過複合物I至III，從而繞過粒線體電子傳遞鏈中功能障礙的組件。這種替代電子轉運路徑增強粒線體呼吸，增加氧氣消耗，減少粒線體超氧化物產生，並減輕氧化應激。這些機制是methylene blue在阿茲海默病、帕金森病、創傷性腦缺血和缺血性中風等疾病中發揮神經保護作用的基礎。

label: Serotonin Syndrome
description: Combining methylene blue with serotonergic medications can potentially trigger serotonin syndrome, the most serious safety concern associated with the compound. Because methylene blue is a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, stacking it with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs can increase serotonin to dangerous levels. This is a documented, case-report-level interaction, not a theoretical risk - if a person is on antidepressants, a physician must be involved before taking even a single milligram of methylene blue. The risk rises significantly at higher doses (above 7-10 mg) and with any concurrent serotonergic medication, making serotonin interaction screening an essential part of any protocol.
description_zh_TW: 將亞甲基藍與血清素能藥物結合可能引發血清素症候群，這是與該化合物相關的最嚴重安全問題。由於亞甲基藍是單胺氧化酶抑制劑，與 SSRI、SNRI、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物疊加可能將血清素提升至危險水平。這是 documented、case-report 級別的交互作用，而非理論風險——如果一個人正在服用抗抑鬱藥，醫師必須參與後才能服用 even a single milligram 的亞甲基藍。風險在 higher doses（7-10 mg 以上）和任何 concurrent 血清素能藥物時顯著上升，使得血清素交互作用篩查成為任何方案的 essential 部分。

label: Co-oximetry
description: During methemoglobinemia (and methylene blue infusion) pulse oximetry artifactually underestimates saturation, so arterial blood gas with co-oximetry is preferred. Co-oximetry directly resolves the methemoglobin fraction that pulse oximetry cannot distinguish.
description_zh_TW: 在變性血紅素血症（及 methylene blue 輸注）期間，脈搏血氧儀會人為地低估血氧飽和度，因此應改用動脈血氣分析與 co-oximetry。Co-oximetry 可直接解析脈搏血氧儀無法區分的變性血紅素比例。

label: Epigenetic Modifiers
description: 5-Azacytidine is classified as an epigenetic modifier, specifically a DNA methyltransferase (DNMT) inhibitor, and it is among the first epigenetic drugs used in the clinic. As a cytidine analog, it is incorporated into DNA during replication, where it covalently traps DNMT enzymes and causes passive loss of DNA methylation, reactivating silenced genes such as tumor suppressors. This mechanism underlies its use in myelodysplastic syndromes and leukemia and its application in research on gene silencing, development, and aging.
description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine被歸類為表觀遺傳修飾劑，特別是DNA甲基轉移酶（DNMT）抑制劑，是第一批應用於臨床的表觀遺傳藥物之一。作為胞苷類似物，它在複製過程中摻入 DNA，共價捕獲 DNMT 酶並導致 DNA 甲基化被動丟失，從而重新激活腫瘤抑制基因等沉默基因。這種機制是其在骨髓增生異常綜合症和白血病中的應用及其在基因沉默、發育和老化研究中的應用的基礎。

label: Gene Bodies
description: DNMT3a exhibits a preference for methylating gene bodies and intergenic regions, in contrast to DNMT3b, which preferentially targets repetitive elements and pericentromeric satellite DNA. Gene body methylation is associated with transcriptional regulation, alternative splicing, and suppression of spurious transcription initiation within genes. This differential targeting between the de novo methyltransferases helps shape the distinct compartmentalization of the methylome and influences patterns of gene expression, heterochromatin formation, and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 表現出對基因體和基因間區域甲基化的偏好，而 DNMT3b 則優先針對重複元件和著絲粒周圍衛星 DNA。基因體甲基化與基因內的轉錄調控、選擇性剪接和抑制虛假轉錄起始有關。從頭甲基轉移酶之間的這種差異靶向有助於形成甲基化組的獨特區室化，並影響 gene expression 的模式、異染色質形成和基因組穩定性。

label: Hematopoiesis
description: DNMT3a is essential for normal hematopoiesis, particularly for the differentiation and self-renewal of hematopoietic stem cells. It establishes DNA methylation patterns that restrict the expression of genes involved in stem cell maintenance and promotes commitment to the blood cell lineage. Loss or mutation of DNMT3a deregulates this epigenetic control, expanding self-renewal capacity and predisposing cells to clonal outgrowth, which underlies clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential and progression to acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a對於正常造血，特別是造血幹細胞的分化和自我更新至關重要。它建立 DNA 甲基化模式，限制參與幹細胞維持的基因表達，並促進對血球譜系的承諾。 DNMT3a的缺失或突變會解除這種表觀遺傳控制的調節，擴大自我更新能力並使細胞易於克隆生長，這是不確定潛力的克隆造血和進展為急性髓系白血病的基礎。

label: Pericentromeric Satellite Repeats
description: DNMT3b exhibits a strong preference for pericentromeric satellite repeats and other repetitive DNA, depositing methylation that is essential for constitutive heterochromatin formation and centromere function. By methylating these repetitive sequences, DNMT3b helps maintain centromere stability and prevent aberrant recombination and chromosome missegregation. Loss of this activity in ICF syndrome leads to centromeric instability, decondensation of satellite regions, and clinical features of immunodeficiency and facial anomalies.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3b 對著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列和其他重複 DNA 表現出強烈的偏好，沉積甲基化，這對於組成型異染色質形成和著絲粒功能至關重要。透過甲基化這些重複序列，DNMT3b 有助於維持著絲粒穩定性並防止異常重組和染色體錯誤分離。 ICF 症候群中這種活性的喪失會導致著絲粒不穩定、衛星區域去濃縮以及免疫缺陷和臉部異常的臨床特徵。

label: Decitabine
description: Decitabine is a nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA methyltransferases and is used as an epigenetic therapy in hematologic malignancies. After incorporation into DNA during replication, decitabine covalently traps DNMT enzymes, depleting them and causing passive loss of DNA methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates genes silenced by promoter hypermethylation, such as tumor suppressors, which underlies its clinical efficacy in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是一種核苷類似物，可抑制 DNA 甲基轉移酶，用作血液惡性腫瘤的表觀遺傳療法。在複製過程中摻入 DNA 後，地西他濱共價捕獲 DNMT 酶，耗盡它們並導致新合成鏈上 DNA 甲基化的被動喪失。這種去甲基化重新激活了因啟動子高甲基化而沉默的基因，例如腫瘤抑制基因，這是其在骨髓增生異常綜合徵和急性髓系白血病中的臨床功效的基礎。

label: Gene Silencing
description: High levels of DNA methylation in promoter regions, often concentrated in CpG islands, are strongly associated with gene silencing. Methylated promoters recruit methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins and inhibit the binding of transcription factors, converting active promoters into transcriptionally inert chromatin. This repressive mechanism is used physiologically for imprinting and for silencing transposable elements, and its aberrant targeting of tumor suppressor gene promoters is a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: 啟動子區域的高水平 DNA 甲基化（通常集中在 CpG 島）與基因沉默密切相關。甲基化啟動子招募甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白並抑制轉錄因子的結合，將活性啟動子轉化為轉錄惰性染色質。這種抑制機制在生理學上用於印記和沈默轉座元件，其對腫瘤抑制基因啟動子的異常靶向性是癌症的標誌。

label: ICF Syndrome
description: ICF syndrome (Immunodeficiency, Centromere instability, and Facial anomalies) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutations in the DNMT3B gene. Loss of DNMT3b activity leads to hypomethylation of pericentromeric satellite repeats and juxtacentromeric regions, resulting in centromeric decondensation, chromosome instability, and characteristic chromosomal abnormalities in stimulated lymphocytes. The disease manifests as combined immunodeficiency with reduced immunoglobulin levels, facial dysmorphism, and developmental delay.
description_zh_TW: ICF 症候群（免疫缺陷、著絲粒不穩定和臉部異常）是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 DNMT3B 基因突變引起。 DNMT3b 活性的喪失會導致著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列和近著絲粒區域的低甲基化，從而導致著絲粒脫縮、染色體不穩定以及受刺激的淋巴細胞中的特徵性染色體異常。此疾病表現為聯合免疫缺陷，伴隨免疫球蛋白水平降低、臉部畸形和發育遲緩。

label: SAM
description: S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) is the universal methyl donor for DNA methylation reactions. DNMT1 transfers the methyl group from SAM to the C5 position of cytosine residues on the nascent DNA strand, generating 5-methylcytosine and S-adenosylhomocysteine as products. Because SAM availability reflects one-carbon metabolism and methyl-donor supply, fluctuations in its levels can influence methylation maintenance and, consequently, gene silencing, transposable element repression, and overall epigenetic stability.
description_zh_TW: S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) 是 DNA 甲基化反應的通用 methyl donor。 DNMT1 將甲基從 SAM 轉移到新生 DNA 鏈上胞嘧啶殘基的 C5 位置，生成 5-甲基胞嘧啶和 S-adenosylhomocysteine 作為產物。由於 SAM 的可用性反映了一碳代謝和甲基供體供應，因此其水平的波動會影響甲基化維持，從而影響基因沉默、轉座元件抑制和整體表觀遺傳穩定性。

label: UHRF1
description: UHRF1 is a key accessory protein that recruits DNMT1 to sites of DNA replication. During S phase, UHRF1 recognizes hemi-methylated CpG sites through its SRA (SET- and RING-associated) domain, binding the methylated parental strand while leaving the unmodified daughter strand available for methylation. This targeting directs DNMT1 to replication foci where it restores symmetric CpG methylation on the newly synthesized strand, ensuring faithful propagation of epigenetic information across cell divisions. Loss of this targeting mechanism leads to passive demethylation and epigenetic instability.
description_zh_TW: UHRF1 是一種關鍵的輔助蛋白，它將 DNMT1 招募到 DNA 複製位點。在 S 期，UHRF1 透過其 SRA（SET 和 RING 相關）結構域識別半甲基化 CpG 位點，結合甲基化親代鏈，同時留下未修飾的子鏈可用於甲基化。這種標靶將 DNMT1 引導至複製焦點，在其中恢復新合成鏈上對稱的 CpG 甲基化，確保表觀遺傳訊息在細胞分裂中的忠實傳播。這種標靶機制的喪失會導致被動去甲基化和表觀遺傳不穩定。

label: PEX genes
description: Aberrant DNA methylation has been observed around PEX genes, ABCD1, and AMPK regulatory genes in peroxisomal disorder cells, suggesting epigenetic silencing downstream of primary genetic defects can further impair peroxisome biogenesis. DNMT inhibitors and HDAC inhibitors are being explored as potential epigenetic therapies, though causation versus correlation remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 在過氧化物體疾病細胞中，已觀察到 PEX 基因、ABCD1 及 AMPK 調控基因周圍出現異常 DNA 甲基化，顯示初級基因缺陷下游的表觀遺傳沉默可能進一步削弱過氧化物體生成。DNMT 抑制劑與 HDAC 抑制劑正被探索為潛在表觀遺傳療法，惟因果關係仍未釐清。

label: TRAF6
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: The ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis drives ASAP signaling: ATM activates TRAF6, which undergoes auto-ubiquitination and recruits TAK1 to propagate stress and inflammatory signals. TAK1 in turn activates p38 MAPK and NF-kB downstream, linking DNA damage sensing to SASP transcription. This axis is a conserved scaffold connecting genotoxic stress to senescence inflammation and operates upstream of the established SASP regulatory network. The ATM-dependent TRAF6 activation illustrates how a DNA-damage kinase directly engages innate immune signaling machinery to initiate the senescent inflammatory program.
description_zh_TW: ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸驅動 ASAP 訊號：ATM 活化 TRAF6，TRAF6 經歷自動泛素化並招募 TAK1 以傳播壓力與發炎訊號。TAK1 反過來活化 p38 MAPK 與下游 NF-κB，將 DNA 損傷感知連結到 SASP 轉錄。此軸是連接基因毒性壓力到衰老發炎的保守支架，並作用於已建立 SASP 調節網絡上游。ATM 依賴的 TRAF6 活化說明 DNA 損傷激酶如何直接參與先天免疫訊號機器以啟動衰老發炎程序。

label: Flavones
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin (4',5,7-trihydroxyflavone) is a major plant flavone belonging to the flavonoid subclass flavones within the polyphenols. It is a yellow crystalline powder with the molecular formula C15H10O5 and a molecular weight of 270.24 Da, bearing hydroxyl groups at C-5 and C-7 of the A-ring and C-4' of the B-ring. Structurally it is related to biapigenin and naturally occurs as apigenin-7-O-glucoside and acylated derivatives. Its classification as a flavone underpins its shared antioxidant and anti-inflammatory pharmacology with other plant polyphenols such as quercetin and kaempferol.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧 (4',5,7-三羟基黄酮) 是一種主要植物黃酮類，屬於黃酮類群內的一種黃酮，屬於多酚類。它是一種黃色結晶粉末，分子式為 C15H10O5，分子量為 270.24 Da，在 A 環的 C-5 和 C-7 位以及 B 環的 C-4' 位帶有羟基。結構上與 البيبيجين (biapigenin) 相關，並自然存在於阿皮ゲ寧-7-O-葡萄糖苷和酰基衍生物中。它作為一種黃酮的分類，使其與如槲皮苷 (quercetin) 和  quercetin 苷等其他植物多酚類共享的抗氧化和抗炎藥理作用相符。

label: HDAC1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin acts as a histone deacetylase inhibitor, directly targeting HDAC1 and HDAC3, which increases global histone acetylation and produces localized hyperacetylation of histone H3 on the p21/Waf1 promoter. In triple-negative breast cancer cells this drives histone H3 acetylation, decreasing cyclin A and cyclin B and increasing p21/Waf1/Cip1. Apigenin can additionally function as a dual epigenetic inhibitor that reverses both DNA methylation and trimethylation of lysine 27 on histone H3, qualifying it as an epigenetic modulator relevant to chemoprevention.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧作為組蛋白脫乙醯化酶抑制劑，直接靶向 HDAC1 和 HDAC3，從而增加全球組蛋白乙醯化程度，並在 p21/Waf1 促進子區域產生局部乙醯化程度增加，在三陰性乳癌細胞中，這會促進組蛋白 H3 的乙醯化，降低肌動素 A 和肌動素 B，並增加 p21/Waf1/Cip1。阿皮ゲ寧還可以作為雙重表觀遺傳修飾抑制劑，逆轉組蛋白 H3 上粒核苷酸 27 的 DNA 甲基化和三甲基化，使其成為與化療預防相關的表觀遺傳修飾劑。

label: Fatty Acid Synthase
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin inhibits fatty acid synthase (FASN), an enzyme that catalyzes long-chain fatty acid synthesis and is overexpressed in many cancers. Brusselmans and colleagues showed that plant flavonoids including apigenin induce apoptosis in prostate and breast carcinoma cells specifically through their ability to block fatty acid synthase activity, and this effect on lipogenesis was also observed in osteosarcoma cells where apigenin and luteolin downregulated FASN and acetyl-CoA carboxylase. By depriving cancer cells of de novo lipid synthesis, apigenin curbs cancer cell growth and survival through a metabolic route complementary to its effects on signaling kinases.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧抑制脂肪酸合成酶 (FASN)，一种催化长链脂肪酸合成的酶，并且在许多癌症中过度表达。布塞尔曼等人在研究中表明，包括阿皮ゲ寧在内的植物类黄酮类化合物诱导前列腺癌细胞和乳腺癌细胞凋亡，具体是通过阻断脂肪酸合成酶活性所致，并且这种对脂质生成的影响也被在骨肉瘤细胞中观察到，其中阿皮ゲ寧和卢特OLINA 下调了 FASN 和乙酰辅酶羧化酶。通过剥夺癌细胞的端粒脂质合成，阿皮ゲ寧通过与对信号转导激酶的影响相辅相成的代谢途径抑制癌细胞的生长和存活。

label: Parsley
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin is a major dietary flavone enriched in a range of fruits and vegetables, with parsley being the richest documented source. Dried parsley was reported to contain up to 45,035 ug/g apigenin, far exceeding dried chamomile flowers (3,000-5,000 ug/g), celery seeds (786.5 ug/g), vine spinach (622 ug/g), and Chinese celery (240.2 ug/g). It is also found in chamomile tea, red wine, and beer, and is a signature component of the Mediterranean diet, whose intake has been associated epidemiologically with lower rates of several human diseases including cancer.
description_zh_TW: 芹菜素是主要的膳食黃酮，富含於多種蔬果中，其中以歐芹（parsley）為文獻記載含量最豐富的來源。據報導，乾燥歐芹的芹菜素含量高達45,035 ug/g，遠超過乾燥洋甘菊花（3,000–5,000 ug/g）、芹菜籽（786.5 ug/g）、落葵（vine spinach，622 ug/g）與中國芹菜（240.2 ug/g）。它也存在於洋甘菊茶、紅酒與啤酒中，是地中海飲食的代表性成分；流行病學研究顯示，地中海飲食的攝取與包括癌症在內的多種人類疾病發生率較低有關。

label: Mitoxantrone
description: In a preclinical NOD-SCID xenograft model combining PC3 prostate cancer cells with senescent PSC27 stroma, co-administration of apigenin with the chemotherapy agent mitoxantrone (MIT) produced additional tumor reduction beyond MIT alone: MIT alone shrank tumors 57.8%, and the combination achieved an additional 51.1% reduction, for a total 74.9% decrease versus placebo. Apigenin reversed circulating SASP factors (amphiregulin/AREG, epiregulin/EREG) and enhanced DNA damage (γH2AX) and cleaved-caspase-3 apoptosis in tumors.
description_zh_TW: 在一個結合PC3前列腺癌細胞與衰老PSC27基質的臨床前NOD-SCID異種移植模型中，芹菜素與化療藥物米托蒽醌（mitoxantrone，MIT）合併投予，產生了超越單用MIT的額外腫瘤縮小效果：單用MIT使腫瘤縮小57.8%，合併療法再達成額外51.1%的縮小，總計較安慰劑組減少74.9%。芹菜素逆轉了循環中的SASP因子（雙調蛋白/AREG、上皮調節素/EREG），並增強腫瘤中的DNA損傷（γH2AX）與cleaved-caspase-3細胞凋亡。

label: UGT1A1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: In the intestine and liver, apigenin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 1A1 (UGT1A1), the key enzyme converting it into glucuronide and sulfate derivatives that are more readily transported in blood and excreted in bile or urine, and apigenin itself induces UGT1A1 transcription in colon cells. Combined treatment with sulforaphane synergistically increased UGT1A1 mRNA induction, although apigenin did not induce GSTA1. This phase II metabolism underlies apigenin's rapid clearance and low plasma bioavailability after oral dosing, while its slow systemic elimination may allow peripheral tissue accumulation that supports chemopreventive efficacy.
description_zh_TW: 在腸道與肝臟中，芹菜素會被UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶1A1（UGT1A1）廣泛結合，此關鍵酵素將其轉化為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸衍生物，這些衍生物更易於在血液中運輸並經由膽汁或尿液排出；而芹菜素本身也會在結腸細胞中誘導UGT1A1的轉錄。與蘿蔔硫素（sulforaphane）合併處理可協同增強UGT1A1 mRNA的誘導，不過芹菜素不會誘導GSTA1。此第二相反應代謝是芹菜素口服後快速清除與低血漿生體可用率的原因，而其緩慢的全身性排除則可能使周邊組織累積，進而支持其化學預防功效。

label: Arachidonic acid
description: Through its phospholipase A2 (PLA2) activity, PRDX6 generates arachidonic acid from membrane phospholipids; arachidonic acid is a precursor of pro-inflammatory eicosanoids and is often a driver of inflammation. This places PRDX6's aiPLA2 activity at the interface between redox homeostasis and inflammatory signaling. Apigenin suppresses this activity, and the selective PRDX6 PLA2 inhibitor MJ33 lowers canonical SASP factor expression in a concentration-dependent manner, functionally linking the PLA2-dependent arachidonic acid axis to the senescent secretory phenotype. This mechanism is independent of PRDX6's peroxidase function, which is only modestly inhibited by apigenin.
description_zh_TW: 透過其磷脂酶A2（PLA2）活性，PRDX6從膜磷脂生成花生四烯酸；花生四烯酸是促發炎類花生酸的前體，通常是發炎的驅動因素。這將PRDX6的aiPLA2活性置於氧化還原平衡和發炎訊號的交界處。芹菜素抑制此活性，選擇性PRDX6 PLA2抑制劑MJ33以濃度依賴的方式降低典型SASP因子表達，功能性地將PLA2依賴的花生四烯酸軸與衰老分泌表型聯繫起來。此機制獨立於PRDX6的過氧化物酶功能，後者僅被芹菜素輕度抑制。

label: Cancer Chemoprevention
description: Cancer chemoprevention aims to reduce cancer incidence by administering agents that prevent or reverse carcinogenesis, with dietary flavonoids such as apigenin as leading candidates. Apigenin exemplifies a multimodal chemopreventive flavone active across many human malignancies.
description_zh_TW: 癌症化學預防旨在透過給予可預防或逆轉致癌作用的藥物來降低癌症發生率，其中以 apigenin 等膳食黃酮類為主要候選。Apigenin 是橫跨多種人類惡性腫瘤的多模式化學預防黃酮典範。

label: Chrysin
description: Chrysin shares the flavone scaffold with apigenin and, when combined with apigenin, synergistically induces apoptosis and inhibits migration in breast and liver cancer cells by downregulating MMP-2 and MMP-9. Both are plant flavones with overlapping anticancer mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: Chrysin 與 apigenin 共享黃酮骨架，與 apigenin 合併使用時可透過下調 MMP-2 與 MMP-9，協同誘導乳癌與肝癌細胞凋亡並抑制其遷移。兩者皆為機制重疊的植物黃酮。

label: Matrix Metalloproteinase
description: Matrix metalloproteinases, notably MMP-2 and MMP-9, are zinc-dependent proteases that remodel the extracellular matrix and promote cancer invasion. Apigenin downregulates MMP-2 and MMP-9 expression and activity across multiple cancers, reducing migration and invasion.
description_zh_TW: 基質金屬蛋白酶（尤以 MMP-2 與 MMP-9）是重塑細胞外基質並促進癌症侵襲的鋅依賴蛋白酶。Apigenin 在多種癌症中下調 MMP-2 與 MMP-9 的表現與活性，減少遷移與侵襲。

label: NAC
description: N-acetylcysteine (NAC) is a cysteine prodrug and antioxidant that acts as a selective inhibitor of the peroxidase activity of peroxiredoxin 6 (PRDX6). NAC markedly reduced PRDX6's H2O2-clearing peroxidase activity, in contrast to apigenin which targets its iPLA2 activity.
description_zh_TW: N-乙醯半胱氨酸（NAC）是半胱氨酸前藥與抗氧化劑，作為過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）過氧化酶活性的選擇性抑制劑。NAC 顯著降低 PRDX6 清除 H2O2 的過氧化酶活性，與靶向其 iPLA2 活性的 apigenin 形成對比。

label: Phospholipase A2
description: Phospholipase A2 enzymes hydrolyze phospholipids to release arachidonic acid and lysophospholipids. Peroxiredoxin 6 uniquely carries an iPLA2 (calcium-independent PLA2) activity whose suppression underlies apigenin's senomorphic SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: 磷脂酶 A2（PLA2）水解磷脂以釋放花生四烯酸與溶血磷脂。過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）獨特地帶有 iPLA2（鈣非依賴 PLA2）活性，其抑制是 apigenin 的 senomorphic SASP 壓制基礎。

label: TXNDC5
description: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

label: Lysosomal catabolic process
description: Autophagy is a conserved lysosome-dependent catabolic process in which cytoplasmic constituents—including misfolded proteins, protein aggregates, damaged organelles, and intracellular pathogens—are sequestered into double-membrane autophagosomes and delivered to lysosomes for enzymatic degradation. The resulting macromolecular building blocks such as amino acids, fatty acids, and nucleotides are recycled to sustain metabolism and biosynthetic capacity during nutrient stress. As the cell's principal quality-control and nutrient-recycling system, autophagy is essential for maintaining proteostasis and organellar integrity across nearly all eukaryotic cells. Defects in autophagic flux are causally linked to aging, neurodegeneration, cancer, and metabolic disease, making it a central node in cellular homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 自噬是一種保守的、依賴溶酶體的分解代謝過程，其中細胞質成分——包括錯誤折疊蛋白、蛋白聚集物、受損胞器和細胞內病原體——被隔離進入雙層膜自噬體，並遞送至溶酶體進行酶解降解。所產生的巨分子建構單元如胺基酸、脂肪酸和核苷酸被回收，以在營養壓力下維持代謝和生合成能力。作為細胞主要的品質控制和營養回收系統，自噬對於在幾乎所有真核細胞中維持蛋白質穩態和胞器完整性至關重要。自噬流缺陷與老化、神經退化、癌症和代謝疾病有因果關聯，使其成為細胞穩態中的核心節點。

label: Dietary Restriction
description: Dietary restriction (DR) and its variants are among the most potent physiological activators of autophagy, engaging the pathway in most cultured cells and across many organs in vivo. By lowering circulating nutrients and insulin while raising AMP/ATP ratios, DR relieves mTORC1 inhibition and activates AMPK, thereby de-repressing the ULK1 complex and TFEB-dependent lysosomal programs. In model organisms such as C. elegans, DR induces autophagy through coordinated transcriptional changes mediated by orthologs like HLH-30/TFEB. The health- and lifespan-extending effects of DR are widely attributed in substantial part to this induction of adaptive autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 飲食限制（DR）及其變體是最強效的自噬生理活化因子之一，在大多數培養細胞和體內許多器官中啟動該途徑。透過降低循環營養素和胰島素，同時提高AMP/ATP比值，DR解除mTORC1的抑制並活化AMPK，從而解除對ULK1複合體和TFEB依賴性溶酶體程序的抑制。在如C. elegans等模式生物中，DR透過HLH-30/TFEB等同源蛋白介導的協調轉錄變化誘導自噬。DR促進健康和延長壽命的效應，在很大程度上被歸因於此適應性自噬的誘導。

label: Cancer treatment
description: During cancer treatment, autophagy plays a dual role that depends on context: it can protect tumor cells from chemotherapy- and radiation-induced damage, limiting therapeutic efficacy, yet it can also promote therapy-induced cell death when excessive or when it facilitates terminal differentiation and antigen presentation. In normal tissues, treatment-induced autophagy is generally cytoprotective and reduces toxicity, widening the therapeutic window. The opposing outcomes necessitate careful stratification of when to inhibit versus enhance autophagy in the clinic. This duality mirrors autophagy's broader role in cancer initiation versus progression.
description_zh_TW: 在癌症治療期間，自噬扮演依脈絡而定的雙重角色：它可保護腫瘤細胞免於化療和放療引起的損傷，限制治療效能，但它也可在過度或促進終末分化和抗原呈現時，促進治療誘發的細胞死亡。在正常組織中，治療誘發的自噬通常是細胞保護性的並減少毒性，拓寬治療窗口。相反的結果要求在臨床上仔細分層何時抑制 versus 增強自噬。此雙重性反映了自噬在癌症起始與進展中更廣泛的角色。

label: Insulin signaling
description: Insulin signaling inhibits autophagy by activating the PI3K-Akt axis, which in turn activates mTORC1 and promotes phosphorylation of ULK1 and TFEB that suppress autophagic initiation and lysosomal gene expression. Through this cascade, the fed-state hormone maintains an anabolic, autophagy-off condition in peripheral tissues. The relief of insulin signaling during fasting or caloric restriction is therefore prerequisite for autophagic induction. This relationship is a primary reason why nutrient excess and insulin resistance are associated with impaired autophagy and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: 胰島素信號透過活化 PI3K-Akt 軸來抑制自噬，後者接著活化 mTORC1 並促進 ULK1 和 TFEB 的磷酸化，從而抑制自噬起始和溶酶體基因表現。透過此級聯，進食狀態的荷爾蒙在周邊組織維持合成代謝、自噬關閉的條件。在禁食或熱量限制期間胰島素信號的解除，因此是誘發自噬的先決條件。此關係是營養過剩和胰島素抗性與自噬受損和代謝疾病相關的主要原因。

label: Ketogenic Diet
description: Ketogenic diets, characterized by high fat and very low carbohydrate intake, activate autophagy by lowering insulin and glucose while elevating ketone bodies and AMPK activity. The metabolic shift toward fatty-acid oxidation and mild energy stress mimics aspects of caloric restriction, engaging the autophagic machinery. This activation contributes to the reported healing and neuroprotective effects of ketogenic regimens in epilepsy, neurodegeneration, and metabolic disease. The diet thus provides a non-fasting nutritional strategy to recruit autophagic clearance.
description_zh_TW: 生酮飲食以高脂肪、極低碳水化合物攝取為特徵，透過降低胰島素和葡萄糖、同時升高酮體和 AMPK 活性來活化自噬。朝脂肪酸氧化和輕度能量壓力的代謝轉移模擬了熱量限制的某些層面，運用了自噬機械。此活化促成生酮飲食在癲癇、神經退化和代謝疾病中報告的修復和神經保護效應。因此此飲食提供了一種非禁食的營養策略，以招募自噬性清除。

label: Macroautophagy
description: Macroautophagy (commonly termed autophagy) is the best-characterized form, in which a de novo formed double-membrane structure called the phagophore expands to engulf cytoplasmic cargo and seals into an autophagosome. The autophagosome then fuses with a lysosome, forming an autolysosome where luminal contents are degraded by acidic hydrolases. This bulk and selective degradative route is orchestrated by the conserved ATG machinery, including the ULK1 initiation complex and the PI3K III/Beclin 1 nucleation complex. Macroautophagy is the dominant pathway induced by starvation, stress, and many pharmacological interventions and is the primary focus of most therapeutic autophagy modulation.
description_zh_TW: 巨自噬（通常稱為自噬）是特徵最清楚的形式，其中一種稱為吞噬泡、從頭形成的雙層膜結構擴展以吞噬細胞質貨物並封閉成自噬體。自噬體隨後與溶酶體融合，形成自噬溶酶體，其腔內容物被酸性水解酶降解。此種大規模且選擇性的降解途徑由保守的ATG機制協調，包括ULK1起始複合體和PI3K III/Beclin 1成核複合體。巨自噬是由飢餓、壓力和許多藥理介入所誘導的主要途徑，也是大多數治療性自噬調控的主要焦點。

label: Microautophagy
description: Microautophagy involves the direct engulfment of cytoplasmic cargo by the lysosomal (or vacuolar) membrane through invagination, tubulation, or protrusion of the limiting membrane, without the requirement for a distinct autophagosome intermediate. The entrapped material is then internalized into the lysosomal lumen for degradation, a process that is particularly prominent in yeast vacuoles and in mammalian late endosomes/multivesicular bodies. Compared with macroautophagy, microautophagy operates with less selectivity and is regulated by distinct machineries, though it similarly contributes to organelle and protein turnover. It plays roles in lipid droplet turnover, membrane protein degradation, and quality control under both basal and stress conditions.
description_zh_TW: 微自噬涉及溶酶體（或液泡）膜透過界膜的內陷、成管或突起直接吞噬細胞質貨物，不需要獨立的自噬體中間體。被困住的物質隨後被內化進入溶酶體腔進行降解，此過程在酵母液泡和哺乳動物晚期內體／多泡體中特別顯著。與巨自噬相比，微自噬的選擇性較低，並由不同的機制調控，儘管它同樣有助於胞器和蛋白質的更新。它在脂滴更新、膜蛋白降解以及基礎和壓力條件下的品質控制中發揮作用。

label: B Cell responses
source_file: _document_ - The autophagy enhancer spermidine reverses arterial aging.md
description: Spermidine supplementation rejuvenates age-impaired B cell responses by inducing autophagy in memory T and B lymphocytes, restoring their functional competence. The polyamine's ability to clear damaged organelles and enhance proteostasis in these cells counteracts the decline in vaccine responsiveness seen with immune aging. By supporting lymphoid cell fitness, spermidine addresses a key component of immunosenescence through an autophagy-dependent mechanism. These effects complement its broader rejuvenation of adaptive immunity.
description_zh_TW: 補充spermidine透過在記憶性T和B淋巴細胞中誘導自噬，恢復因年齡受損的B細胞反應，使其功能能力復原。此多胺清除受損胞器和增強這些細胞中蛋白質穩態的能力，抵消了免疫老化所見的疫苗反應性下降。透過支持淋巴樣細胞健康，spermidine透過依賴自噬的機制解決免疫老化的關鍵組成部分。這些效應補充了其對適應性免疫更廣泛的恢復作用。

label: PI3K III complex
description: The class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K III) complex, centered on Vps34 and including Beclin 1, Atg14, Vps15, and Ambra-1, generates phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) at membranes to drive autophagosome nucleation. PI3P recruits effector proteins carrying PI3P-binding domains that organize the expanding phagophore and tether downstream ATG conjugation systems. Beclin 1 is a tumor suppressor whose activity is modulated by interacting partners and by anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins that restrain autophagy under fed conditions. This nucleation complex functions immediately downstream of the ULK1 initiator and is a critical control node for the magnitude of autophagic responses.
description_zh_TW: 第三類磷脂醯肌醇3-激酶（PI3K III）複合體以Vps34為核心，並包含Beclin 1、Atg14、Vps15和Ambra-1，在膜上生成磷脂醯肌醇3-磷酸（PI3P）以驅動自噬體成核。PI3P招募帶有PI3P結合域的效應蛋白，這些蛋白組織擴展中的吞噬泡並繫留下游的ATG共軛系統。Beclin 1是一種腫瘤抑制因子，其活性受交互作用夥伴以及抗凋亡Bcl-2家族蛋白的調節，後者在進食狀態下抑制自噬。此成核複合體作用於ULK1起始者緊接的下游，是自噬反應強度的關鍵控制節點。

label: Yoshinori Ohsumi
description: Yoshinori Ohsumi was awarded the 2016 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his pioneering work using yeast genetics to identify the core autophagy-related (ATG) genes that govern the process. Through systematic mutagenesis screens, he uncovered the molecular machinery responsible for autophagosome formation, including the ubiquitin-like conjugation systems that build the phagophore membrane. His discoveries established autophagy as a genetically tractable and evolutionarily conserved degradation pathway, providing the conceptual framework for all subsequent mammalian autophagy research. The recognition underscored the fundamental importance of autophagy in cellular homeostasis, development, and human disease.
description_zh_TW: 大隅良典（Yoshinori Ohsumi）因開創性地利用酵母遺傳學鑑定出主導此過程的核心自噬相關（ATG）基因，而獲頒2016年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。透過系統性的突變篩選，他揭示了負責自噬體形成的分子機制，包括建構吞噬泡膜的泛素樣共軛系統。他的發現確立了自噬作為一種可遺傳操作且演化上保守的降解途徑，為後續所有哺乳動物自噬研究提供了概念框架。此項榮譽凸顯了自噬在細胞穩態、發育和人類疾病中的根本重要性。

label: eIF5A
description: Spermidine serves as the essential aminobutyl donor for the post-translational hypusination of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A (eIF5A), a modification catalyzed by deoxyhypusine synthase and deoxyhypusine hydroxylase. Hypusinated eIF5A is required for efficient translation of a subset of mRNAs with polyproline tracts, including that encoding the master autophagy regulator TFEB. By facilitating TFEB protein synthesis, spermidine upregulates the entire autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This hypusination-dependent axis is a distinctive mechanistic link between polyamine metabolism and autophagic control.
description_zh_TW: Spermidine作為真核轉譯起始因子5A（eIF5A）轉譯後hypusination所必需的胺基丁基供體，此修飾由deoxyhypusine synthase和deoxyhypusine hydroxylase催化。經hypusination的eIF5A是高效轉譯含多脯胺酸序列的一類mRNA所必需的，包括編碼自噬主調控因子TFEB者。透過促進TFEB蛋白合成，spermidine上調整個自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序。此依賴hypusination的軸線是多胺代謝與自噬控制之間一個獨特的機制連結。

label: Hydroxychloroquine
description: HCQ blocks cytoprotective autophagy in cancer cells and is combined with chemotherapy in clinical trials. Results have been modest and inconsistent across cancer types.
description_zh_TW: HCQ 阻斷癌細胞中的細胞保護性自噬，並在臨床試驗中與化療合併使用。其結果在不同癌種間溫和且不一致。

label: Four distinct class III PI3K complexes
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Beclin1 scaffolds four class III PI3K complexes (I/Atg14L, II/UVRAG, III/UVRAG+Rubicon, IV/Bif-1) that regulate autophagy at initiation, nucleation, and maturation stages. Directionally, Beclin1 sits upstream of autophagosome machinery assembly. SIRT1 deacetylates Beclin1 to enhance Vps34 activity, making Beclin1 a hub integrating sirtuin signals into autophagy. The distinct complexes direct autophagosome nucleation, membrane expansion, and fusion with lysosomes, and their composition determines whether autophagy proceeds or is restrained. Beclin1's central scaffolding role makes it a critical control point for autophagic flux.
description_zh_TW: Beclin1 支架四個 III 型 PI3K 複合物（I/Atg14L、II/UVRAG、III/UVRAG+Rubicon、IV/Bif-1），在自噬的啟動、成核和成熟階段進行調控。在方向性上，Beclin1 位於自噬體機器組裝的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化 Beclin1 以增強 Vps34 活性，使 Beclin1 成為將 sirtuin 訊號整合到自噬中的樞紐。不同的複合物指導自噬體的成核、膜擴張和與溶酶體的融合，其組成決定了自噬是進行還是被抑制。Beclin1 的核心支架作用使其成為自噬通量的關鍵控制點。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum
description: The Peroxisome Biogenesis Network (PBN), a dynamic pool of pre-peroxisomal precursors residing in the cytosol, receives lipids and membrane material from the endoplasmic reticulum through direct ER-PBN contact sites. Pre-peroxisomal vesicles bud from the ER membrane and mature by importing peroxisomal proteins and lipids.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network（PBN，位於細胞質的前過氧化物體前驅池）透過直接的 ER-PBN 接觸位点，自內質網獲得脂質與膜物質。前過氧化物體囊泡自內質網膜出芽，並藉由輸入過氧化物體蛋白與脂質而成熟。

label: Ambroxol
description: Ambroxol and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Ambroxol and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Ambroxol 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Ambroxol 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Ventral Tegmental Area
description: Ventral Tegmental Area is spared in Parkinson's Disease, contrasting with the pronounced loss of other dopaminergic populations. Mechanistically, relative sparing reflects differences in pigment load, connectivity, and vulnerability factors between nuclei. This is significant because the differential involvement helps define the anatomical selectivity of the disease. A caveat is that 'spared' is relative; these neurons may show milder or later changes rather than complete immunity.
description_zh_TW: Ventral Tegmental Area 在 Parkinson's Disease 中倖免於難，與其他 dopaminergic 族群的明顯損失形成鮮明對比。從機制上講，相對保留反映了細胞核之間色素負載、連接性和脆弱性因素的差異。這很重要，因為不同的受累情況有助於確定疾病的解剖選擇性。需要注意的是，「倖免」是相對的。這些神經元可能會表現出較輕微或較晚的變化，而不是完全免疫。

label: 900 mg per day
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: A sub-chronic 90-day toxicity study in rats established that repeated oral administration of synthetic NMN at doses up to 1500 mg/kg/day appears safe and did not promote toxic effects on body weight, food and water consumption, feed conversion efficiency, or biochemical and blood parameters, although higher doses increased kidney, liver, and adrenal gland weights and elevated hepatic enzymes such as alkaline phosphatase, alanine aminotransferase, and aspartate aminotransferase. Based on these findings, the established upper intake level of NMN for a 60 kg individual was set at 900 mg per day. Human studies at 100-500 mg single doses and 250-300 mg/day over weeks to months reported no adverse effects.
description_zh_TW: 一項大鼠亞慢性 90 天毒性研究確立，重複口服高達 1500 mg/kg/天的合成 NMN 似乎安全，且未對體重、食物與水分攝取、飼料轉換效率或生化與血液參數產生毒性效應，儘管較高劑量增加了腎臟、肝臟與腎上腺重量，並提升了鹼性磷酸酶、丙胺酸轉胺酶與天門冬胺酸轉胺酶等肝酶。基於這些發現，60 kg 個體的 NMN 既定上限攝取量設定為每天 900 mg。人體研究中，100-500 mg 單次劑量以及 250-300 mg/天持續數週至數月均未報告不良反應。

label: Combined Metabolic Activators
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Combined metabolic activators (CMAs), consisting of NR (1 g), l-carnitine tartrate (3.73 g), N-acetylcysteine (2.55 g), and serine (12.35 g), improved COVID-19 outcomes in clinical trials. Patients taking the mixture orally for 14 days had significantly faster complete recovery times than placebo (6.6 vs 9.3 days in a phase 2 study and 5.7 vs 9.2 days in a phase 3 study). CMAs were found to reinforce the immune response and regulate amino acid and lipid metabolism, and patients showed improvements in plasma levels of inflammation and antioxidant metabolism-related biomarkers including alanine aminotransferase, lactate dehydrogenase, creatinine, glucose, and proteins. NR within the mixture contributes NAD+ restoration supporting antiviral PARP function.
description_zh_TW: 合併代謝活化劑（CMAs）由 NR（1 g）、酒石酸左旋肉鹼（3.73 g）、N-乙醯半胱胺酸（2.55 g）和絲胺酸（12.35 g）組成，在臨床試驗中改善了 COVID-19 結果。口服此混合物 14 天的患者，其完全康復時間顯著快於安慰劑組（第二期研究為 6.6 對 9.3 天，第三期研究為 5.7 對 9.2 天）。CMAs 被發現能強化免疫反應並調節胺基酸與脂質代謝，且患者的發炎與抗氧化代謝相關生物標記血漿水平有所改善，包括丙胺酸轉胺酶、乳酸脫氫酶、肌酸酐、葡萄糖與蛋白質。混合物中的 NR 有助於 NAD+ 恢復，支持抗病毒 PARP 功能。

label: Melanoidins
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Melanoidins are the final Maillard reaction products formed in food science, found in bread crust, bakery products, and coffee. Ames and colleagues found that melanoidins increased the number of anaerobes, clostridia, and bifidobacteria in cultures of human fecal bacteria, and Borrelli and colleagues found that bread crust melanoidins can promote growth of some bifidobacterial strains, indicating a possible prebiotic effect. These findings show that not all Maillard products are detrimental, and that some dietary glycation products may support gut bacteria considered health-beneficial, in contrast to the pro-inflammatory effects of other AGEs.
description_zh_TW: 黑精（Melanoidins）是食品科學中形成的最終梅納反應產物，存在於麵包外皮、烘焙產品與咖啡中。Ames 及其同事發現，黑精增加了人類糞便細菌培養中厭氧菌、梭菌與雙歧桿菌的數量，而 Borrelli 及其同事發現麵包外皮黑精能促進某些雙歧桿菌菌株的生長，顯示可能的益生元效應。這些發現顯示並非所有梅納產物都有害，且某些飲食糖化產物可能支持被視為有益健康的腸道細菌，與其他 AGE 的促發炎效應形成對比。

label: Acute Pancreatitis
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) derived from the gut microbiota ameliorates acute pancreatitis injury. In acute pancreatitis mouse models, NMN increased NAD+ levels and activated the SIRT3-PRDX5 pathway, mitigating pancreatic mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage, and inflammation in a partially SIRT3-dependent manner. Acute pancreatitis is exacerbated by gut microbiota dysbiosis, and normobiotic fecal microbiota transplantation induced higher serum NMN levels, enhancing NAD+ biosynthesis in the pancreas. This makes NMN an important mediator of the protective effects of fecal microbiota transplantation and highlights the role of gut microbiota-produced NAD+ precursors in pathological outcomes of the host.
description_zh_TW: 源自腸道菌叢的菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善急性胰臟炎損傷。在急性胰臟炎小鼠模型中，NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平並活化 SIRT3-PRDX5 路徑，以部分依賴 SIRT3 的方式減輕胰臟粒線體功能障礙、氧化損傷與發炎。急性胰臟炎會因腸道菌叢失調而惡化，而正常菌叢糞便微生物移植誘導了較高的血清 NMN 水平，增強胰臟中的 NAD+ 生合成。這使 NMN 成為糞便微生物移植保護效應的重要介導者，並凸顯腸道菌叢產生的 NAD+ 前驅物在宿主病理結果中的作用。

label: Aerobic Capacity
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) enhances aerobic capacity, as demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind study in amateur runners. NMN also improves mitochondrial function and energy metabolism: long-term administration in drinking water at 100 or 300 mg/kg/day for 12 months increased mitochondrial respiratory ability in skeletal muscle and reversed age-associated gene expression changes in a tissue-specific manner in aged mice. These mitochondrial and aerobic benefits are attributed to NMN raising NAD+ levels, which activates sirtuins and supports oxidative metabolism, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption, positioning NMN as a performance- and healthspan-enhancing NAD+ precursor.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）增強有氧能力，此點已在一項針對業餘跑者的隨機雙盲研究中獲證實。NMN 也改善粒線體功能與能量代謝：在飲用水中以 100 或 300 mg/kg/天長期給藥 12 個月，增加了骨骼肌的粒線體呼吸能力，並以組織特異性方式逆轉老化小鼠中與年齡相關的基因表現變化。這些粒線體與有氧益處歸因於 NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平，進而活化去乙醯酶並支持氧化代謝、能量消耗與氧氣消耗，使 NMN 成為增進表現與健康壽命的 NAD+ 前驅物。

label: Intestinal Barrier
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) improves intestinal barrier function, which is important for preventing translocation of harmful bacteria and toxins from the gut into the bloodstream.
