In colitis models, NMN increased the expression of tight-junction proteins and improved mucus secretion, attenuating intestinal mucosal permeability. Long-term NMN treatment also increased the number of goblet cells, mucus thickness, and tight junction protein expression, maintaining the integrity of the intestinal epithelium. NMN and NR share this gut-protective property alongside selective stimulation of beneficial bacteria, and NAD+-precursor-activated sirtuins also protect intestinal endothelial cells against oxidative injury, collectively reinforcing the gut barrier.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）改善腸道屏障功能，這對於防止有害細菌與毒素從腸道移位至血流中相當重要。在結腸炎模型中，NMN 增加緊密連接蛋白的表現並改善黏液分泌，減輕腸黏膜通透性。長期 NMN 處理也增加杯狀細胞數量、黏液厚度與緊密連接蛋白表現，維持腸上皮的完整性。NMN 和 NR 共享此腸道保護特性，加上對有益細菌的選擇性刺激，且 NAD+ 前驅物活化的去乙醯酶也保護腸道內皮細胞免受氧化損傷，共同強化腸道屏障。

label: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is an effective intervention against the pathophysiology of type 2 diabetes in both diet-induced and age-induced mouse models. Intraperitoneal administration at 500 mg/kg body weight per day for 11 days substantially ameliorated impaired glucose tolerance and enhanced hepatic insulin sensitivity, with the reversal of gene expression changes related to oxidative stress, inflammatory response, and circadian rhythm partly resulting from SIRT1 activation. NMN also restored glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in aged beta-cell-specific SIRT1-overexpressing (BESTO) mice and aged wild-type mice, and in postmenopausal women with prediabetes, 250 mg/day for 10 weeks increased NAD+ in PBMCs and improved insulin signaling and sensitivity in skeletal muscle.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）是針對第2型糖尿病病理生理學的有效介入手段，適用於飲食誘發與年齡誘發的小鼠模型。以500 mg/kg體重每日腹腔注射、持續11天，可顯著改善受損的葡萄糖耐受性並增強肝臟胰島素敏感性；其對氧化壓力、發炎反應與晝夜節律相關基因表現變化的逆轉，部分源自SIRT1的活化。NMN亦能恢復老年β細胞專一性SIRT1過度表現（BESTO）小鼠與老年野生型小鼠，以及患有糖尿病前期的停經後婦女之葡萄糖刺激胰島素分泌；在後者中，每日250 mg、持續10週可提升PBMC中的NAD+，並改善骨骼肌的胰島素訊號傳遞與敏感性。

label: Edamame
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) is found in a range of foods including edamame beans, avocado, broccoli, cucumber, cabbage, and tomato, according to the first evidence published by Mills et al. (2016). Among the investigated sources, the highest NMN content was found in edamame at 0.47-1.88 mg/100 g and avocado at 0.36-1.60 mg/100 g, with smaller amounts in seafood and raw meats (0.06-0.42 mg/100 g). Milk also contains NMN, with human milk the richest source at 2.1-9.8 uM. These natural occurrences support the idea that a normal diet can contribute to NAD+ precursor intake, though optimal sources remain to be established.
description_zh_TW: 根據 Mills 等人（2016）發表的首批證據，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）存在於一系列食物中，包括毛豆、酪梨、花椰菜、小黃瓜、高麗菜和番茄。在受調查的來源中，NMN 含量最高的是毛豆（0.47-1.88 mg/100 g）和酪梨（0.36-1.60 mg/100 g），海鮮與生肉中含量較少（0.06-0.42 mg/100 g）。牛奶也含有 NMN，其中人乳是最豐富的來源，達 2.1-9.8 uM。這些天然存在支持正常飲食可貢獻 NAD+ 前驅物攝取的概念，儘管最佳來源仍有待確立。

label: Gut Dysbiosis
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) reverses gut dysbiosis and protects the intestinal tract. In an experimental mouse model of colitis induced by dextran sodium sulfate, NMN given by gavage at 1 mg/g body weight increased microbial abundance and diversity, improved mucus secretion and tight-junction protein expression, and attenuated intestinal mucosal permeability, protecting against inflammatory bowel disease. Long-term NMN treatment modulated gut microbiota diversity and composition, increasing butyric acid-producing bacteria such as Ruminococcaceae UCG-014 and Prevotellaceae NK3B31 as well as Akkermansia muciniphila, while decreasing harmful bacteria like Bilophila and Oscillibacter. NMN thereby restores intestinal homeostasis and barrier integrity through microbiota remodeling.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）逆轉腸道失調並保護腸道。在硫酸葡聚醣誘發的實驗性小鼠結腸炎模型中，以 1 mg/g 體重灌胃給予 NMN 增加了微生物豐度與多樣性，改善黏液分泌與緊密連接蛋白表現，並減輕腸黏膜通透性，防護發炎性腸道疾病。長期 NMN 處理調節腸道菌叢多樣性與組成，增加產丁酸細菌如 Ruminococcaceae UCG-014 和 Prevotellaceae NK3B31 以及 Akkermansia muciniphila，同時減少 Bilophila 和 Oscillibacter 等有害細菌。NMN 因此透過菌叢重塑恢復腸道恆定與屏障完整性。

label: SLC12A8
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SLC12A8 is a transporter encoded by the gene SLC12A8 that has been proposed to mediate cellular uptake of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), in addition to the CD73-mediated dephosphorylation route in which NMN is converted extracellularly to nicotinamide riboside for uptake. The expression of a gut transporter reinforces that NMN could be made bioavailable through oral delivery, and the presence of such a transporter in the intestine supports the idea that dietary NMN can enter the circulation. These uptake mechanisms complement each other and explain how orally administered NMN is rapidly absorbed from the intestine into the bloodstream and converted to NAD+ in tissues.
description_zh_TW: SLC12A8 是由基因 SLC12A8 編碼的轉運蛋白，被認為除了 CD73 介導的去磷酸化途徑（NMN 在細胞外轉化為菸鹼醯胺核糖以供吸收）之外，還介導菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）的細胞攝取。腸道轉運蛋白的表現強化了 NMN 可透過口服遞送達成生物可利用性的觀點，而此類轉運蛋白在腸道中的存在支持膳食性 NMN 能進入循環的構想。這些攝取機制互補，並解釋了口服給予的 NMN 如何從腸道快速吸收進入血流並在組織中轉化為 NAD+。

label: Intestinal Stem Cell
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), an NAD+ precursor, restores NAD+ in intestinal stem cells and reverses mtDNA-mutation-driven dysfunction via UPRmt, linking the NAD+ fuel line to stem-cell resilience.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）作為 NAD+ 前體，可恢復腸道幹細胞的 NAD+，並經 UPRmt 逆轉 mtDNA 突變驅動的功能障礙，將 NAD+ 燃料線與幹細胞韌性連結。

label: Adiponectin
description: Administration of adiponectin to obese, high-fat-fed mice improves insulin sensitivity and lowers blood glucose, reflecting its role as an insulin-sensitizing adipokine. It acts through the AdipoR1/2 receptors to activate AMPK and PPAR-α pathways that enhance fatty-acid oxidation and glucose uptake. Directionally, adiponectin sits upstream of improved insulin action in peripheral tissues. Because SIRT1 raises adiponectin via the FOXO1–C/EBPα axis, this forms part of SIRT1's anti-diabetic circuitry, and declining adiponectin with obesity contributes to the insulin resistance that sirtuin-activating interventions aim to reverse.
description_zh_TW: 向肥胖的高脂飲食小鼠施用脂聯素可改善胰島素敏感性並降低血糖，反映其作為胰島素增敏脂肪因子的作用。它通過 AdipoR1/2 受體活化 AMPK 和 PPAR-α 通路，增強脂肪酸氧化和葡萄糖攝取。在方向性上，脂聯素位於周圍組織改善胰島素作用的上游。由於 SIRT1 通過 FOXO1–C/EBPα 軸提高脂聯素，這構成 SIRT1 抗糖尿病電路的一部分，肥胖伴隨的脂聯素下降導致胰島素抵抗，sirtuin 活化干預旨在逆轉這一過程。

label: Vascular Dementia
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Accumulation of advanced glycation end products in aging persons is associated not only with diabetes complications but also with chronic diseases including vascular dementia. Bar and colleagues demonstrated differential increases of AGE products in Alzheimer's dementia and vascular dementia compared with controls. Because vascular dementia is driven by cerebrovascular dysfunction and impaired perfusion, the ability of AGEs to stiffen vessels, drive endothelial dysfunction, and promote inflammation offers a plausible mechanistic link. These findings place glycation among the modifiable biochemical processes associated with cognitive decline in the elderly.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products在aging persons中的accumulation不僅與diabetes complications有關，也與包括vascular dementia在內的chronic diseases相關。Bar及其colleagues demonstrated differential increases of AGE products in Alzheimer's dementia與vascular dementia compared with controls。由於vascular dementia是由cerebrovascular dysfunction與impaired perfusion所driven，AGEs使vessels stiffen、drive endothelial dysfunction並promote inflammation的能力，提供了一個plausible mechanistic link。這些findings place glycation among the modifiable biochemical processes associated with cognitive decline in the elderly。

label: Maillard Reaction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) are a heterogeneous, complex group of compounds formed mainly via the Maillard reaction, in which a reducing sugar reacts non-enzymatically with amino groups in proteins, lipids, or DNA. The Maillard reaction has long been exploited by the food industry for the color and taste it imparts, but its products have gained attention in biomedicine because AGEs are associated with chronic diseases of aging such as diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease, and Alzheimer's disease. AGEs form in three phases, and the final brownish, often fluorescent products are very stable and accumulate in tissues, where they interfere with protein function.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products（AGEs）是一群heterogeneous、complex的compounds，主要經由Maillard reaction形成，其中a reducing sugar與proteins、lipids或DNA中的amino groups進行non-enzymatic reaction。Maillard reaction長期以來被food industry利用以imparts color與taste，但其products在biomedicine中受到attention，因為AGEs與diabetes mellitus、cardiovascular disease及Alzheimer's disease等aging chronic diseases相關。AGEs form in three phases，最終的brownish、often fluorescent products非常stable並accumulate in tissues，干擾protein function。

label: ECM
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。

label: Elastin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix and cross-link elastic fibers as well as collagen. This cross-linking of extracellular proteins reduces the elasticity of connective tissues such as blood vessels, skin, and tendons, affecting especially vascular function. Glycated modifications alter the balance between ECM synthesis and degradation, accelerating skin aging and increasing skin stiffness. AGE-elastin cross-linking is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs injure tissues, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM）內，並使 elastic fibers 與 collagen 交聯。這種 extracellular proteins 的交聯降低了 blood vessels、skin 與 tendons 等結締組織的彈性，尤其影響 vascular function。Glycated modifications 改變 ECM synthesis 與 degradation 之間的平衡，加速 skin aging 並增加皮膚僵硬。AGE-elastin cross-linking 是 AGEs 傷害組織的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated inflammatory signaling。

label: glycated serum albumin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。

label: Matrix Metalloproteinases
description: In the extracellular matrix, matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) such as MMP-1 and MMP-2 are involved in remodeling collagen and elastin that have been stiffened by glycation. Because AGE crosslinks make these long-lived structural proteins resistant to normal turnover, MMP-mediated remodeling helps manage matrix that has accumulated glycation damage, though MMP activity can become dysregulated under high-AGE conditions. MMPs thereby act as a degradative countermeasure to AGE-induced matrix stiffening, balancing crosslink formation and matrix turnover in vascular and connective tissue, although excessive or dysregulated MMP activity contributes to matrix destruction.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞外基質中，基質金屬蛋白酶（MMPs），如 MMP-1 與 MMP-2，參與重塑因糖化而變僵硬的膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白。由於 AGE 交聯使這些長壽結構蛋白對正常更新產生抗性，MMP 介導的重塑有助於處理已累積糖化損傷的基質，儘管在高 AGE 條件下 MMP 活性可能失調。因此，MMPs 作為對抗 AGE 誘發基質僵硬的降解性對策，在血管與結締組織中平衡交聯形成與基質更新，儘管過度或失調的 MMP 活性會導致基質破壞。

label: AGER1
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Several enzymes, including glyoxalase I, glyoxalase II, and carbonyl reductase, together with the receptor AGER1, have been shown to be part of a detoxification and counterregulation system against the prooxidant effects of glycation. AGER1 helps oppose the pro-inflammatory actions of advanced glycation end products, functioning as an endogenous check on AGE-mediated signaling. With aging and in some pathological conditions, there is an imbalance in this steady state, due to increased endogenous production or increased exogenous intake combined with lower renal AGE clearance, leading to the AGE accumulation observed in older populations.
description_zh_TW: 數種酵素，包括 glyoxalase I、glyoxalase II 與 carbonyl reductase，以及受體 AGER1，已被證實是對抗糖化促氧化效應之解毒與反向調節系統的一部分。AGER1 有助於對抗晚期糖化終產物的促發炎作用，作為 AGE 介導訊號的內生性制衡。隨著老化與在某些病理狀況下，此恆定狀態出現失衡，起因於內生性產生增加或外源性攝取增加，加上腎臟 AGE 清除率下降，導致在老年族群中觀察到的 AGE 堆積。

label: HemF-like
description: Through functional metagenomics, researchers identified soil bacteria enzymes capable of utilizing synthetic glucosepane as a nutrient source, including the biocatalysts HemF-like (coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like), BluB-like (5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like), and QueE-like (7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase-like). Remarkably, the human homolog of HemF, alongside homologous bacterial proteins found in the human microbiome, was shown to catalyze the cleavage of glucosepane in vitro, releasing citrulline as a byproduct. These glucosepane-cleaving enzymes represent a promising frontier for therapeutic interventions against age-related vascular stiffness and diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 透過功能性元基因體學，研究人員鑑定出能夠以合成 glucosepane 作為營養來源的土壤細菌酶，包括生物催化劑 HemF-like（coproporphyrinogen III oxidase-like）、BluB-like（5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole synthase-like）與 QueE-like（7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase-like）。值得注意的是，HemF 的人類同源蛋白，連同在人類微生物群中發現的同源細菌蛋白，被證實能在體外催化 glucosepane 的裂解，釋出瓜胺酸作為副產物。這些可裂解 glucosepane 的酶代表了對抗年齡相關血管僵硬與糖尿病併發症療法介入的極具前景的前沿。

label: Glomerular Filtration Rate
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Vlassara and colleagues studied 325 healthy participants and 66 participants with kidney disease and found that serum CML and methylglyoxal were higher in the older participants, and that serum CML correlated negatively with estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) and positively with age. Because declining kidney function reduces AGE clearance, the inverse relationship between CML and eGFR indicates that the kidney is central to regulating circulating AGE levels. This correlation supports the view that age-related decline in renal function contributes to the progressive accumulation of advanced glycation end products in the elderly.
description_zh_TW: Vlassara 及其同事研究 325 名健康參與者與 66 名腎臟病患者，發現年長參與者的血清 CML 與甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）較高，且血清 CML 與估計腎小球過濾率（eGFR）呈負相關、與年齡呈正相關。由於腎功能下降會減少 AGE 清除，CML 與 eGFR 之間的反向關係顯示腎臟是調節循環 AGE 濃度的核心。此相關性支持年齡相關腎功能下降促成老年族群晚期糖化終產物漸進堆積的觀點。

label: TFEB at S467
description: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
description_zh_TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

label: Chronic SASP
description: Chronic SASP, through IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, promotes cancer stem-cell traits and expands the CSC pool in neighbouring epithelial and tumour cells, enhancing tumour initiation and relapse potential. By driving stemness and survival, the persistent secretome fosters malignant progression and therapy resistance. The relationship is a key mechanism by which senescence can become tumor-promoting and is supported by cancer-stemness and senescence co-culture studies. It motivates the one-two punch strategy of senescence induction followed by senolytic clearance.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 IL-6 與 IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3 促進癌症幹細胞特性，並擴張鄰近上皮與腫瘤細胞中的 CSC 池，增強腫瘤起始與復發潛力。透過驅動幹性與存活，持續分泌組助長惡性進展並削弱治療。此促進將衰老與治療誘發衰老連結到腫瘤幹性，說明 SASP 在慢性脈絡中的雙重、促腫瘤面。它是年齡相關癌症的關鍵機制。

label: Nanog
description: Cancer Stem Cells relates to Nanog through the relation express. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Nanog is a core pluripotency transcription factor re-expressed in cancer stem cells to sustain self-renewal. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 透過關係表達與 Nanog 相關。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 Nanog 是一個核心多能性轉錄因子，在 Cancer Stem Cells 中重新表達以維持自我更新。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Temozolomide
description: MGMT expression confers temozolomide resistance in a subset of GBM.
description_zh_TW: MGMT 表達在部分 GBM 中賦予 temozolomide 抗藥性。

label: ATR
source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md
description: Stalled or collapsed replication forks generate single-stranded DNA gaps that engage the ATR-CHK1 cascade, activating a checkpoint that senses replication stress. In oncogene-induced senescence, ATR signaling contributes to arrest and senescence establishment by stabilizing p53 and enforcing cell-cycle exit. The relationship is a canonical DNA-damage-checkpoint response and links oncogene-driven hyper-replication to cell-cycle enforcement. ATR is considered the primary sensor of replication stress.
description_zh_TW: 停滯或崩塌的複製叉產生單股 DNA 缺口，接合 ATR-CHK1 級聯，活化感知複製壓力的檢查點。在致癌基因誘發衰老中，ATR 訊號貢獻停滯與衰老建立，與 ATM 並行運作。此活化將複製壓力直接耦合到細胞週期退出，確保過度複製的細胞進入持久停滯。它是 OIS 中 DDR 驅動生長停止的核心組成。

label: Deoxycytidine kinase
description: Gemcitabine requires intracellular phosphorylation by deoxycytidine kinase (dCK) to generate its active diphosphate and triphosphate metabolites. Reduced dCK activity is a documented mechanism of resistance to the drug.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 需要由 deoxycytidine kinase（dCK）進行細胞內磷酸化，才能產生有活性的二磷酸和三磷酸代謝物。dCK 活性降低是已記錄的藥物抗藥性機制。

label: Polycythemia Vera
description: Hydroxyurea is a first-line therapy for managing erythrocytosis in polycythemia vera. By inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase in erythroid progenitors it reduces total red blood cell mass and prevents thrombotic complications.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 是控制真性紅血球增多症紅血球增多症的一線治療。透過抑制紅血球前驅細胞中的 ribonucleotide reductase，它減少總紅血球質量並預防血栓併發症。

label: Sickle Cell Disease
description: Hydroxyurea is used to improve the clinical course of sickle cell disease by raising HbF levels. It reduces the frequency of vaso-occlusive crises and is a standard disease-modifying therapy.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 藉由提高 HbF 水平改善鐮刀型細胞疾病的臨床病程。它可減少血管阻塞性危象的發生頻率，是標準的疾病調整治療。

label: Fetal Hemoglobin
description: Hydroxyurea stimulates production of fetal hemoglobin (HbF) in red blood cells of sickle cell disease patients. Increased HbF interferes with polymerization of hemoglobin S, reducing vaso-occlusive crises.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 刺激鐮刀型細胞疾病患者的紅血球產生胎兒血紅蛋白（HbF）。HbF 增加會干擾血紅蛋白 S 的聚合，減少血管阻塞性危象。

label: DNA Polymerase
description: The triphosphate form dFdCTP competes with the natural substrate dCTP for incorporation into nascent DNA strands by DNA polymerase during S phase. Following incorporation, the polymerase adds one or two further nucleotides before elongation is blocked (masked chain termination).
description_zh_TW: 三磷酸形式 dFdCTP 在 S 期與天然受質 dCTP 競爭被 DNA polymerase 嵌入新生 DNA 股。嵌入後，聚合酶會再添加一至兩個核苷酸，之後延長受阻（隱蔽式鏈終止）。

label: DNA Replication
description: dNTPs are consumed stoichiometrically by DNA polymerases during DNA replication and repair, and their supply is rate-limiting. Balanced dNTP pools are essential for high-fidelity replication; both depletion and imbalance drive replication stress, mutagenesis, and genomic instability.
description_zh_TW: dNTP 在 DNA 複製與修復期間被 DNA 聚合酶以化學計量方式消耗，其供應具有速率限制。平衡的 dNTP 池對高保真複製至關重要；耗竭與失衡皆會驅動複製壓力、突變與基因體不穩定性。

label: Caspase-11
description: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

label: Immune Complex
description: Inflammasomes are cytosolic supramolecular complexes of the innate immune system that assemble in response to pathogens or sterile danger signals to activate inflammatory caspases. They are not antibodies (immune complexes) but rather multiprotein scaffolds; the original classification here as an immune complex is loose, though inflammasomes are innate immune signaling platforms. They serve as a key intersection between senescence, DAMPs, and inflammation. Their activation links cellular damage to IL-1 family cytokine release.
description_zh_TW: 發炎體是先天免疫系統的胞質超分子複合體，組裝以回應病原體或無菌危險訊號，活化發炎性 caspase。它們不是抗體（免疫複合體）而是多重蛋白支架；此處歸類為免疫複合體鬆散，儘管發炎體是先天免疫訊號平台。它們作為衰老、DAMP 與發炎間的關鍵交會點。其活化將細胞損傷連結到 IL-1 家族細胞激素釋放。

label: LPS
description: The hexa-acylated lipid A of LPS binds directly to the CARD domain of caspase-4/5/11, inducing their dimerization and activation, the defining trigger of the noncanonical inflammasome. While classically microbial, this mechanism can be engaged in senescence-associated inflammatory contexts. The relationship is the canonical activation mode of the pathway and links Gram-negative sensing to caspase activation. Because the caspases themselves are the sensors, no upstream receptor is required for this pathway.
description_zh_TW: LPS 的六醯化 lipid A 直接結合 caspase-4/5/11 的 CARD 域，誘發其雙聚化與活化，是非典型發炎體的定義性觸發因子。雖典型為微生物性，此機制可在衰老相關發炎脈絡中被啟動。此關係將微生物產物感知連結到內源性發炎，且若胞質 LPS 或 LPS 樣配體在衰老中出現，可能貢獻非典型發炎體活化。它是該途徑的確立啟動機制。

label: HERV
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Human endogenous retroviruses activate the cGAS-STING pathway when their expression is derepressed during aging and senescence. Age-related loss of DNA methylation and heterochromatin permits HERV transcription, and the resulting HERV RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA that is sensed by cGAS, triggering STING-dependent upregulation of type I interferons and SASP factors. HERV-driven innate immune signaling contributes to inflammaging and the paracrine spread of senescence. Suppressing HERV expression or reverse transcription therefore reduces this senescence-driving inflammatory signal.
description_zh_TW: 當人類內源性逆轉錄病毒的表達在老化和老化過程中被抑制時，它們會活化 cGAS-STING 路徑。與年齡相關的 DNA 甲基化和異染色質缺失允許 HERV 轉錄，並且所得的 HERV RNA 被逆轉錄為 cGAS 感知的 cDNA，觸發 I 型乾擾素和 SASP 因子的 STING 依賴性上調。 HERV 驅動的先天免疫訊號傳導有助於發炎和老化的旁分泌擴散。因此，抑制 HERV 表達或逆轉錄可以減少這種老化驅動的發炎訊號。

label: Senolytic Drugs
description: Senolytic drugs are agents designed to selectively eliminate senescent cells, the damaged cells that accumulate with age and drive age-related pathology through their pro-inflammatory secretome. Because senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis, senolytics typically target the anti-apoptotic pathways that keep them alive, such as the BCL-2 family members, enabling their clearance while sparing proliferating healthy cells. Clearing senescent cells in animal models delays the onset of age-related diseases, and several senolytics are now being tested in human clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: 老化藥物是一種旨在選擇性消除衰老細胞的藥物，衰老細胞是隨著年齡的增長而積累的受損細胞，並通過促炎分泌組驅動與年齡相關的病理。由於衰老細胞對細胞凋亡具有抵抗力，因此 senolytics 通常針對使它們保持活力的抗細胞凋亡途徑（例如 BCL-2 家族成員），從而在不傷害增殖的健康細胞的同時清除它們。在動物模型中清除衰老細胞可以延緩與年齡相關的疾病的發生，並且有幾種衰老藥物目前正在人體臨床試驗中進行測試。

label: Type I Interferon
description: Cytosolic mitochondrial DNA and cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (from senescence or TDP-43-driven mitochondrial rupture) engage cGAS-STING to drive type-I interferon signaling — the innate-immune axis that, in the wiki graph, organizes the entire tau/TDP-43/C9orf72/FTD disease community.
description_zh_TW: 胞質粒線體 DNA 與胞質染色質片段（來自衰老或 TDP-43 驅動的粒線體破裂）會啟動 cGAS-STING 以驅動第一型干擾素訊息——在 wiki 圖中，此先天免疫軸組織整個 tau/TDP-43/C9orf72/FTD 疾病群落。

label: CD206
description: CD206 (mannose receptor MRC1) is a canonical surface marker of alternatively activated (M2) macrophages. Its expression is induced by IL-4 and IL-13 and suppressed by inflammatory stimuli, making CD206 a defining M2 polarization marker.
description_zh_TW: CD206（甘露糖受體 MRC1）是交替活化（M2）巨噬細胞的典型表面標記。其表現由 IL-4 與 IL-13 誘導，並受發炎刺激抑制，使 CD206 成為 M2 極化的定義性標記。

label: Checkpoint Inhibitor
description: Checkpoint inhibitors disrupt inhibitory checkpoint receptors that tumors and senescent cells use to silence cytotoxic lymphocytes. Because senescent cells exploit PD-L1/PD-1 and HLA-E/NKG2A to avoid clearance, checkpoint-modulating combinations are being explored with senolytics.
description_zh_TW: 檢查點抑制劑破壞腫瘤與衰老細胞用以靜默細胞毒性淋巴球的抑制性檢查點受體。由於衰老細胞利用 PD-L1/PD-1 與 HLA-E/NKG2A 逃避清除，檢查點調節組合正與 senolytic 一起被探索。

label: 7-Ketocholesterol
description: 7-ketocholesterol induces apoptosis through ROS-dependent mitochondrial permeabilization and activation of caspase-3, contributing to death of macrophage foam cells in plaques. As a major oxysterol in oxidized LDL, it is implicated in plaque necrosis. The directionality is oxysterol to programmed cell death. A caveat is that 7-ketocholesterol effects are concentration-dependent and can also trigger inflammatory and autophagic responses before death. Plasma and lesion 7-KC levels correlate with plaque vulnerability, and its toxicity to vascular cells is a recognized contributor to plaque necrosis.
description_zh_TW: 7-ketocholesterol透過ROS依賴性mitochondria1透化和caspase-3的活化誘導apoptosis，導致斑塊中巨噬細胞泡沫細胞死亡。作為 oxidized LDL 中的主要氧甾醇，它與噬菌斑 necrosis 有關。方向性是氧甾醇到程序性細胞死亡。需要注意的是，7-ketocholesterol 的作用具有濃度依賴性，也可能在死亡前引發發炎和自噬反應。血漿和病變 7-KC 水平與斑塊脆弱性相關，其對血管細胞的毒性是斑塊 necQrosis 的公認貢獻者。

label: PAK2
description: PAK2 directly binds and phosphorylates Caspase-7 at Ser30, Thr173, and Ser239, neutralizing its effector function and promoting survival in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: PAK2 直接結合並在 Ser30、Thr173 與 Ser239 磷酸化 Caspase-7，中和其效應器功能並在乳癌中促進存活。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of p53
description: By deacetylating p53, SIRT1 lowers p53's transcriptional activation of BH3-only proteins and other apoptotic effectors, suppressing programmed cell death after oxidative or genotoxic stress. This creates a survival bias that helps cells tolerate damage but can also protect incipient cancer cells from elimination. The directionality is that SIRT1 activity on p53 is upstream of reduced apoptosis. A caveat is that chronic suppression of p53-dependent apoptosis is a double-edged sword: protective in normal tissue but potentially tumor-promoting.
description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 p53，SIRT1 降低 p53 對 BH3-only 蛋白和其他凋亡效應因子的轉錄活化，在氧化或基因毒性壓力後抑制程序性細胞死亡。這創造了一種存活偏向，幫助細胞耐受損傷，但也可能保護早期癌細胞免於被清除。其方向性為 SIRT1 對 p53 的活性在減少凋亡的上游。需要注意的是，長期抑制 p53 依賴性凋亡是一把雙刃劍：在正常組織中具有保護作用，但可能促進腫瘤。

label: Cytoplasmic SIRT1
source_file: _document_ - Caspase-mediated changes in Sir2alpha during apoptosis.md
description: Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is pro-apoptotic (caspase-dependent, deacetylase-independent), flipping SIRT1 from a survival factor into a death promoter once it is cleaved and relocalized. In vivo, cells with cytoplasmic Sir2alpha were overwhelmingly dying, with over 130 of 150 such cells having pyknotic nuclei.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質 SIRT1 是促凋亡的（依賴 caspase、不依賴去乙醯化），一旦被裂解和重新定位，便將 SIRT1 從存活因子翻轉為死亡促進者。在體內，具有細胞質 Sir2α 的細胞絕大多數正在死亡，150 個此類細胞中超過 130 個具有固縮核。

label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Auranofin (Ridaura) was FDA-approved in 1985 for adult rheumatoid arthritis as a second-line gold DMARD after NSAID failure, at an oral dose of 6 mg/day. Its mechanism in RA is incompletely understood but involves suppression of phagocytosis and inflammatory mediator release.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin（Ridaura）於 1985 年獲 FDA 核准用於成人類風濕性關節炎，作為 NSAID 治療失敗後的二線金製劑 DMARD，口服劑量為每日 6 mg。其在 RA 中的機制尚未完全明瞭，但涉及抑制吞噬作用與發炎介質釋放。

label: Damaged peroxisomes
description: Selective autophagy targets damaged peroxisomes for degradation through a process termed pexophagy, in which ubiquitin tagging of peroxisomal proteins and recruitment of ESCRT (endosomal sorting complex required for transport) machinery mark the organelle for autophagic engulfment. This cargo-specific pathway contrasts with bulk autophagy by requiring receptor proteins that bridge the peroxisome to the autophagosomal membrane. Pexophagy protects cells from the oxidative and metabolic damage caused by defective peroxisomes. Its failure leads to accumulation of aberrant organelles and disease.
description_zh_TW: 選擇性自噬透過稱為 pexophagy 的過程，標靶受損過氧化體進行降解，其中過氧化體蛋白的泛素標記和 ESCRT（運輸所需內體分選複合物）機制的招募，將該胞器標定為自噬吞噬。此貨物特異性途徑不同於整體自噬之處，在於它需要受體蛋白將過氧化體橋接到自噬體膜。Pexophagy 保護細胞免於缺陷過氧化體造成的氧化和代謝損傷。其失敗導致異常胞器與疾病的累積。

label: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB
description: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB shifts signaling to necroptosis, as loss of NF-kappaB-dependent survival genes leaves RIPK1 free to engage RIPK3 and MLKL in lytic, pro-inflammatory cell death. This explains toxicity when NF-kappaB is inhibited in TNF-exposed cells. The directionality is NF-kappaB blockade to necroptotic switch. A caveat is that caspase-8 can still divert cells to apoptosis, so the outcome depends on the full death-receptor complex composition. Necroptosis is highly inflammatory because lysed cells release damage-associated molecular patterns, amplifying tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: TNF-alpha with blocked NF-kappaB 將訊號傳導轉移至 necroptosis，因為 NF-kappaB 依賴性存活基因的缺失使 RIPK1 可以自由地與 RIPK3 和 MLKL 結合，參與裂解性促發炎細胞死亡。这解释了 TNF 暴露细胞中 NF-κB 受到抑制时的毒性。方向性是 NF-kappaB 阻断坏死性凋亡开关。需要注意的是，caspase-8 仍然可以將細胞轉移到 apoptosis，因此結果取決於完整的死亡受體複合物組成。 Necroptosis 具有高度發炎性，因為裂解的細胞會釋放與損傷相關的分子模式，從而放大組織損傷。

label: Cardiolipin
description: Cardiolipin stimulates DRP1 GTPase activity for fission AND is required for OPA1-mediated fusion — it has dual pro-fusion and pro-fission roles depending on context.
description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 刺激 DRP1 的 GTPase 活性以進行使分裂，同時也是 OPA1 介導融合所必需的——依情境不同，它具有促融合與促分裂的雙重角色。

label: Huntingtin
description: Mutant huntingtin (mHTT) uncouples fission from degradation while disrupting autophagic flux. Broad-spectrum autophagy activators like rapamycin may be insufficient if downstream transport remains blocked.
description_zh_TW: 突變 huntingtin（mHTT）使分裂與降解脫鉤，同時破壞自噬流。若下游運輸仍受阻，則 rapamycin 等廣譜自噬活化劑可能不足。

label: BNIP3
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: BNIP3 (BCL-2/adenovirus E1B interacting protein 3) is an outer mitochondrial membrane mitophagy receptor that interacts directly with LC3 to promote engulfment of damaged mitochondria, functioning independently of Parkin. NIX/BNIP3-mediated mitophagy is induced through hypoxia and stabilization of HIF-1alpha. BNIP3 also interacts with OPA1 to induce mitochondrial fragmentation and with FUNDC1 under the control of OPA1 and DRP1, and its protein levels are upregulated at early premalignant stages of several human solid cancers but frequently decrease when tumors become invasive.
description_zh_TW: BNIP3（BCL-2/adenovirus E1B interacting protein 3，BCL-2/腺病毒E1B相互作用蛋白3）是粒線體外膜上的粒線體自噬（mitophagy）受體，直接與LC3相互作用以促進受損粒線體的吞噬，其功能不依賴Parkin。NIX/BNIP3介導的粒線體自噬可透過缺氧與HIF-1alpha的穩定化而被誘導。BNIP3也與OPA1相互作用以誘導粒線體斷裂，並在OPA1與DRP1的調控下與FUNDC1相互作用；其蛋白質水平在多種人類實體癌的早期癌前階段上調，但當腫瘤變得具侵襲性時往往下降。

label: HRI
description: DELE1, previously identified as a poorly characterized mitochondrial protein from a yeast two-hybrid screen, was converged upon by two independent CRISPR-based screens as the mediator of mitochondrial stress signaling to the ISR. Under mitochondrial stress, the cleaved cytosolic fragment DELE1-S directly binds and activates the heme-regulated kinase HRI. Importantly, HRI activation by DELE1 was shown to be heme-independent, ruling out the classical heme-depletion mechanism. HRI activation in turn leads to eIF2alpha phosphorylation and downstream ATF4 induction, linking mitochondrial dysfunction to the integrated stress response.
description_zh_TW: DELE1 先前在酵母雙雜交篩選中被鑑定為一個特性不明的粒線體蛋白，而兩個獨立的 CRISPR 篩選共同指向它作為粒線體壓力訊號傳遞至 ISR 的媒介。在粒線體壓力下，被切割的細胞質片段 DELE1-S 直接結合並活化血基質調控激酶 HRI。重要的是，DELE1 對 HRI 的活化被證實與血基質無關，排除了經典的血基質耗竭機制。HRI 活化接著導致 eIF2alpha 磷酸化與下游 ATF4 誘導，將粒線體功能障礙與整合性壓力反應連結起來。

label: Mitochondrial Fission Sites
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
description_zh_TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。

label: FIS1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: FIS1 is a tail-anchored outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for DRP1, helping to recruit the fission machinery to mitochondria. In yeast, the FIS1 ortholog Fis1p is the main membrane anchor for the Dnm1p fission GTPase, whereas in mammalian cells FIS1 plays a more accessory role alongside MFF, MID49, and MID51, and may also mediate non-DRP1 functions such as recruiting proteasomal and autophagic machinery to mitochondria. Overexpression of FIS1 fragments mitochondria, whereas FIS1 knockdown produces elongated networks, confirming its pro-fission role, although its relative importance varies between cell types and conditions.
description_zh_TW: FIS1是一種錨定於粒線體外膜的蛋白質（tail-anchored protein），作為DRP1的受體，協助將分裂機製招募至粒線體。在酵母菌中，FIS1的直系同源物Fis1p是分裂GTP酶Dnm1p的主要膜錨點；而在哺乳類細胞中，FIS1則與MFF、MID49及MID51一同扮演較輔助性的角色，也可能中介非DRP1的功能，例如將蛋白酶體與自噬機製招募至粒線體。FIS1過度表現會使粒線體碎裂，而FIS1基因敲低則產生延長狀的網絡，證實其促分裂作用，儘管其相對重要性會因細胞類型與條件而異。

label: FUNDC1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: FUNDC1 (FUN14 domain containing 1) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that serves as a mitophagy receptor for hypoxia-induced mitophagy, interacting directly with LC3 after dephosphorylation by phosphoglycerate mutase 5. ULK1 interacts with FUNDC1 and phosphorylates it at serine 17, enhancing FUNDC1 binding to LC3, and FUNDC1 interacts with OPA1 and DRP1 in a manner regulated by serine 13 phosphorylation during hypoxia or membrane potential loss. DRP1 can interact with overexpressed FUNDC1 to facilitate mitochondrial fragmentation and Parkin-mediated mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: FUNDC1（FUN14 domain containing 1）是一種粒線體外膜蛋白，作為缺氧誘發粒線體自噬的受體，在經磷酸甘油酸變位酶5（phosphoglycerate mutase 5）去磷酸化後直接與LC3交互作用。ULK1與FUNDC1交互作用並在絲胺酸17（serine 17）處使其磷酸化，增強FUNDC1與LC3的結合；而在缺氧或膜電位喪失期間，FUNDC1與OPA1及DRP1的交互作用則受絲胺酸13磷酸化調節。DRP1可與過度表現的FUNDC1交互作用，以促進粒線體碎裂與Parkin介導的粒線體自噬。

label: Fasting
description: Intermittent fasting and time-restricted feeding compress the eating window to 8-10 hours to allow a 14-16 hour daily fasting period, described as the simplest and most effective way to activate AMPK and mitophagy. Constant snacking and chronic overeating abolish the fasting-induced AMPK signal necessary for mitophagy. Fasting-induced mitochondrial recycling is a core mitohormetic mechanism, and stopping food intake at least 3-4 hours before sleep is highlighted as a key variable that instantly improves overnight HRV by allowing the body to focus entirely on cellular repair during sleep.
description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食與限時進食將進食窗口壓縮至8–10小時，以達到每天14–16小時的禁食期，被描述為活化AMPK與粒線體自噬最簡單且最有效的方法。持續零嘴進食與慢性暴食會消除禁食誘發、粒線體自噬所需的AMPK訊號。禁食誘導的粒線體回收是核心的粒線體毒物興奮機制，而至少在睡前3–4小時停止進食被強調為關鍵變因，可讓身體在睡眠期間完全專注於細胞修復，立即改善夜間HRV。

label: Mdivi-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mdivi-1 (mitochondrial division inhibitor 1), a quinazolinone derivative that specifically inhibits DRP1, attenuates cardiac dysfunction in diverse mouse cardiomyopathy models, likely by promoting mitochondrial elongation or reducing autophagy. It also attenuates neuronal cell death through mitochondrial elongation and inhibition of complex I activity and ROS generation in neurodegenerative disease models including Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease. However, treatment of myocardial infarction in pigs with Mdivi-1 did not reduce infarct size or preserve cardiac function, and Mdivi-1 has off-target effects such as cleaving L-OPA1 and altering OXPHOS complex protein expression.
description_zh_TW: Mdivi-1（粒線體分裂抑制劑 1）是一種喹唑啉酮衍生物，可特異性抑制 DRP1，在多種小鼠心肌病模型中減輕心臟功能障礙，可能透過促進粒線體延長或減少自噬。它在帕金森氏症與阿茲海默症等神經退化性疾病模型中，也透過粒線體延長以及抑制複合體 I 活性與 ROS 生成來減輕神經元細胞死亡。然而，以 Mdivi-1 治療豬的心肌梗塞並未減少梗塞面積或保存心臟功能，且 Mdivi-1 具有脫靶效應，例如切割 L-OPA1 與改變 OXPHOS 複合體蛋白質表現。

label: Mitochondrial Quality Control
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control. Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units; through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components; and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated. The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population. Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics, the balance of fusion and fission, is a central component of mitochondrial quality control。Through fission, damaged portions of the network are segregated into smaller units；through fusion, functional mitochondria exchange and dilute damaged components；and through the interplay of these processes, mitochondria destined for mitophagy are identified and eliminated。The degradation of damaged mitochondria by mitophagy, and the biogenesis of new mitochondria through PGC-1alpha-driven pathways, complete a quality-control cycle that maintains a healthy mitochondrial population。Disruption of any step, as in Parkinson's disease with PINK1 and Parkin mutations, leads to accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria and cellular damage。

label: Mitochondrial DNA Mutations
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial fusion dilutes mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) mutations by mixing the contents of healthy and damaged mitochondria, thereby enabling functional complementation between individual mitochondrial genomes. By exchanging mitochondrial DNA, proteins, lipids, and metabolites across a connected network, fusion allows a damaged genome to be complemented by the products of an intact genome. This content mixing is a principal functional rationale for the existence of the mitochondrial network and is experimentally demonstrated by the finding that fusion between a wild-type and a mutant mitochondrion restores oxidative phosphorylation function in heteroplasmic cells. Loss of fusion therefore accelerates the phenotypic manifestation of mtDNA mutations.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合透過混合健康和受損粒線體的內容物，稀釋粒線體 DNA（mtDNA）突變，從而實現個別粒線體基因體之間的功能互補。透過在互連網路中交換粒線體 DNA、蛋白質、脂質和代謝物，融合使得受損的基因體可由完整基因體的產物進行互補。這種內容混合是粒線體網路存在的主要功能原理，並透過實驗發現異質性細胞中野生型與突變粒線體的融合可恢復氧化磷酸化功能而得到證實。因此，融合的喪失會加速 mtDNA 突變的表型表現。

label: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
description_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。

label: Dominant Optic Atrophy
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。

label: Very Long Chain Fatty Acids
description: Peroxisomes are the primary site where very long chain fatty acids are shortened into shorter-chain products such as acetyl-CoA that can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation. Impaired peroxisomal beta-oxidation causes toxic VLCFA accumulation, the hallmark of Zellweger syndrome and adrenoleukodystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Peroxisome 是極長鏈脂肪酸進行縮短代謝的主要場所，產物如 acetyl-CoA 可進入粒線體完成氧化。過氧化物體 beta-oxidation 功能受損會導致有毒的 VLCFA 累積，這是 Zellweger syndrome 與 adrenoleukodystrophy 的標誌性特徵。

label: VDAC
description: Parkin ubiquitinates the voltage-dependent anion channel VDAC on the mitochondrial outer membrane — a modification with dual cell-fate meaning: monoubiquitination of VDAC halts apoptosis, while polyubiquitination feeds PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. Parkin also ubiquitinates MFN1 and mitochondrial Rho GTPases, and regulates Drp1 activity and degradation. VDAC is therefore the point of intersection where the same E3 ligase executing mitophagy also restrains apoptotic permeabilization.
description_zh_TW: Parkin 會對粒線體外膜的電壓依賴性陰離子通道 VDAC 進行泛素化——此修飾具有雙重的細胞命運意義：VDAC 的單泛素化可阻止細胞凋亡，而多泛素化則驅動 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。Parkin 也會泛素化 MFN1 與粒線體 Rho GTPase，並調控 Drp1 的活性與降解。因此 VDAC 正是同一個 E3 連接酶在執行粒線體自噬之外、同時抑制凋亡通透化的交會點。

label: c-FLIP
description: c-FLIP heterodimerizes with caspase-8 and, in its long isoform (c-FLIPL), preserves just enough caspase-8 catalytic activity to cleave and inactivate RIPK1 and RIPK3 — the necrosome substrates — thereby suppressing necroptosis while blunting apoptosis. When caspase-8/c-FLIP activity drops below that threshold (z-VAD-FMK, viral c-FLIP mimetics, high RIPK3 expression), TNF signaling flips to necroptosis. The short isoform c-FLIPS blocks caspase-8 more completely while enhancing complex II assembly, promoting necroptosis instead.
description_zh_TW: c-FLIP 會與 caspase-8 形成異源二聚體；其長型（c-FLIPL）保留剛好足夠的 caspase-8 催化活性去切割並使 RIPK1 與 RIPK3——即 necrosome 的受質——失活，從而在減弱細胞凋亡的同時抑制程序性壞死。當 caspase-8/c-FLIP 活性低於此門檻（z-VAD-FMK、病毒型 c-FLIP 擬似劑、高 RIPK3 表達）時，TNF 訊號便翻轉為程序性壞死。短型 c-FLIPS 對 caspase-8 的阻斷更完全，且會促進 complex II 組裝，反而促進程序性壞死。

label: Neuronal survival
description: Mitophagy acts as a double-edged sword in neuronal survival. Insufficient clearance allows damaged mitochondria to accumulate, triggering inflammation and cell death, while excessive mitophagy depletes healthy mitochondria, causing bioenergetic failure. This bidirectional regulation means that both impairment and overactivation of mitophagy can precipitate neuronal damage. Striking the precise balance between removing dysfunctional and preserving healthy mitochondria is the central challenge for therapeutics.
description_zh_TW: Mitophagy 在神經元存活中扮演雙刃劍。清除不足使受損粒線體累積，觸發發炎和細胞死亡，而過度的 mitophagy 耗盡健康粒線體，造成生物能量衰竭。此雙向調節意味著 mitophagy 的受損和過度活化都可能引發神經元損傷。在移除功能失常與保留健康粒線體之間取得精確平衡是治療的核心挑戰。

label: USP30
description: USP30 is a mitochondrial deubiquitinase that opposes Parkin-mediated mitophagy by removing ubiquitin chains from outer mitochondrial membrane proteins. Its inhibition or loss enhances mitophagy, reduces alpha-synuclein pathology, and protects dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson's disease models. USP30 therefore acts as a negative regulator of mitophagy and a promising therapeutic target. Selective USP30 inhibitors such as MTX115325 have validated this approach in vivo.
description_zh_TW: USP30 是一種粒線體去泛素酶，透過移除粒線體外膜蛋白上的泛素鏈，拮抗 Parkin 介導的 mitophagy。其抑制或缺失增強 mitophagy、減少 alpha-synuclein 病理，並在帕金森氏症模型中保護多巴胺神經元。因此 USP30 作為 mitophagy 的負向調節者和有前景的治療標靶。MTX115325 等選擇性 USP30 抑制劑已在活體中驗證此方法。

label: LRRK2
description: LRRK2 directly phosphorylates DRP1 to drive excess mitochondrial fission; since impaired mitophagy (PINK1/Parkin) is a PD mechanism, LRRK2-driven fission couples mitochondrial dynamics to Parkinson's pathology.
description_zh_TW: LRRK2 直接磷酸化 DRP1 以驅動過度的粒線體分裂；由於受損的 mitophagy（PINK1/Parkin）是帕金森氏症機制，LRRK2 驅動的分裂把粒線體動態學與帕金森氏症病理耦合。

label: Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia
description: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is a chronic lung disease of premature infants in which dysregulated mitochondrial fission and fusion contribute to lung cell injury. Impaired mitochondrial dynamics and mitophagy are implicated in the arrested alveolar and vascular development of BPD.
description_zh_TW: 支氣管肺發育不良（BPD）是早產兒的慢性肺病，其中失調的粒線體分裂與融合造成肺細胞損傷。粒線體動態與 mitophagy 受損與 BPD 中肺泡與血管發育停滯有關。

label: Cellular Homeostasis
description: Mitochondrial dynamics refers to the continuous processes of fusion and fission that regulate mitochondrial morphology, number, and function. These processes maintain cellular homeostasis by exchanging components, diluting damage, and enabling mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體動態指調控粒線體形態、數量與功能的持續融合與分裂過程。這些過程透過交換成分、稀釋損傷與促成 mitophagy 來維持細胞恆定。

label: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
description: Pulmonary arterial hypertension involves excessive mitochondrial fission mediated by DRP1, contributing to pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation and vascular remodeling. DRP1-mediated fission has been implicated in PAH pathogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 肺動脈高壓涉及由 DRP1 介導的過度粒線體分裂，促成肺動脈平滑肌細胞增殖與血管重塑。DRP1 介導的分裂被認為與 PAH 致病機轉有關。

label: Redox-Active Metals
description: Amyloid-beta binds redox-active metals (Cu2+ and Fe3+), forming complexes that generate superoxide and H2O2 via Fenton-like chemistry at the metal site. This positions Abeta as a localized source of ROS in the Alzheimer brain. The directionality is metal binding to radical generation. A caveat is that metal-free Abeta aggregation also drives pathology, so redox activity is one of several toxic functions. Abeta is proposed to act as a redox-active metal chaperone, and metal chelators have been tested as candidate therapies to limit this pro-oxidant activity.
description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白與 redox-active metals（Cu2+ 和 Fe3+）結合，形成複合物，透過金屬位點上的類芬頓化學反應生成超氧化物和 H2O2。這使得 Abeta 成為阿茲海默症大腦中 ROS 的局部來源。方向性是金属与自由基生成的结合。需要注意的是，不含金屬的 Abeta 聚集也會引發病理學，因此氧化還原活性是多種毒性功能之一。 Abeta 被提议充当氧化还原活性金属伴侣，金属螯合剂已作为限制这种促氧化活性的候选疗法进行了测试。

label: Mitochondrial Complex IV
description: Amyloid-beta impairs mitochondrial Complex IV (cytochrome c oxidase) after accumulating in mitochondria, depressing respiration and increasing electron leak. This links protein misfolding to bioenergetic failure and ROS. The directionality is Abeta mitochondrial localization to respiratory inhibition. A caveat is that Complex IV inhibition can be both a cause and consequence of oxidative damage in a feed-forward loop. The resulting energetic deficit may precede overt neurodegeneration and contributes to synaptic failure in Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: β 澱粉樣蛋白在 mitochondria 中累積後會損害 mitochondrial Complex IV（細胞色素 C 氧化酶），抑制呼吸並增加電子洩漏。這將蛋白質錯誤折疊與生物能量衰竭和 ROS 聯繫起來。方向性是Abeta mitochondria1定位於呼吸抑制。需要注意的是，複合物 IV 抑制既可能是前饋迴路中氧化損傷的原因，也可能是其結果。由此產生的能量缺乏可能先於明顯的 neurodegeneration 發生，並導致阿茲海默症的突觸衰竭。

label: Circulation
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。

label: Plasma AGEs
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Uribarri and colleagues estimated dietary AGE intake from three-day food records in 90 healthy subjects using a database of the AGE content of foods and found a significant correlation between ingested AGEs and plasma levels; a subgroup exposed to dietary restriction of AGEs showed decreased plasma levels as well. Similar results were reported in patients with diabetes and renal failure. These findings support the view that the intake of dietary AGEs is an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and that reducing dietary AGE intake lowers circulating AGE concentrations even in healthy individuals.
description_zh_TW: Uribarri 及其同事利用食物 AGE 含量資料庫，從 90 名健康受試者的三日飲食記錄估計飲食 AGE 攝取量，發現攝入 AGE 與血漿濃度之間有顯著相關；一組接受飲食 AGE 限制的亞組也顯示血漿濃度下降。糖尿病與腎衰竭患者中也報告了類似結果。這些發現支持飲食 AGE 攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且減少飲食 AGE 攝取可降低循環 AGE 濃度，即使在健康個體中亦然。

label: TLR4
description: Extracellular disulfide-HMGB1 signals through TLR4 on antigen-presenting cells to drive inflammatory and antitumor immune responses.
description_zh_TW: 細胞外二硫鍵-HMGB1 通過抗原呈遞細胞上的 TLR4 發出信號，驅動炎症和抗腫瘤免疫反應。

label: Damage-associated molecular pattern
description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: Immunogenic cell death
description: HMGB1 release is a hallmark DAMP of immunogenic cell death, necessary for anticancer immune priming.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 釋放是免疫原性細胞死亡的標誌性 DAMP，對抗癌免疫 priming 必不可少。

label: Lecanemab
description: Lecanemab (Leqembi) is an FDA-approved anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease with confirmed amyloid; it clears parenchymal Aβ protofibrils and slows cognitive decline by roughly 25–35% while carrying ARIA (edema/microhemorrhage) risk.
description_zh_TW: Lecanemab（Leqembi）是獲 FDA 核准的抗類澱粉單株抗體，用於經確證類澱粉的早期症狀性阿茲海默症；它清除實質 Aβ 原纖維並減緩認知衰退約 25–35%，但帶有 ARIA（水腫／微出血）風險。

label: CD86
description: CD86 (B7-2) is a co-stimulatory ligand on antigen-presenting cells that is rapidly upregulated upon activation and modulates the inflammatory milieu. Its expression serves as a marker of activated immune cells in inflammatory and senescent contexts.
description_zh_TW: CD86（B7-2）是抗原呈現細胞上的共刺激配體，活化後迅速上調並調控發炎環境。其表現作為發炎與衰老情境中活化免疫細胞的標記。

label: hs-CRP
description: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) is a high-sensitivity assay for C-reactive protein, an acute-phase reactant whose circulating concentration rises with systemic inflammation. It is the preferred marker for low-grade, chronic inflammation in monitoring protocols.
description_zh_TW: 高敏感 C 反應蛋白（hs-CRP）是 C 反應蛋白的高敏感檢測，C 反應蛋白是循環濃度隨全身發炎升高的急性期反應物。它是監測方案中低度慢性發炎的首選標記。

label: Beclin 1
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: Clustered DNA Damage
description: Ionizing radiation causes clustered DNA damage, defined as two or more lesions within one or two helical turns, a signature pattern that overwhelms repair and drives lethal or mutagenic breaks. This clustering distinguishes radiation from many chemical genotoxins. The directionality is radiation to locally concentrated lesions. A caveat is that clustering severity depends on radiation quality (LET) and oxygen enhancement, so not all exposures produce identical patterns. Clustered lesions are a hallmark of high-LET radiation and are repaired inefficiently, increasing the probability of mutation and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 導致 clustered DNA damage，定義為一兩個螺旋圈內的兩個或多個病變，這是一種壓倒修復並導致致命或誘變斷裂的特徵模式。这种聚类将辐射与许多化学基因毒素区分开来。方向性是局部集中病灶的輻射。需要注意的是，聚集的严重程度取决于辐射质量 (LET) 和氧气增强，因此并非所有暴露都会产生相同的模式。聚集性病变是高 LET 辐射的一个标志，修复效率低下，增加了突变和细胞死亡的可能性。

label: Werner Syndrome
description: Werner syndrome is a progeroid disorder caused by mutations in the WRN gene, which encodes a protein with both helicase and exonuclease activities essential for DNA repair and genome stability. The WRN protein functions in pathways including homologous recombination, base excision repair, and resolution of replication stress, and its loss leads to accelerated genomic instability and premature aging. Werner syndrome patients prematurely develop age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, diabetes, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: Werner 症候群是一種由 WRN 基因突變引起的早衰症，該基因編碼的蛋白質具有解旋酶和核酸外切酶活性，對於 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性至關重要。 WRN 蛋白在同源重組、鹼基切除修復和複製壓力解決等途徑中發揮作用，其缺失會導致基因組不穩定加速和過早老化。沃納症候群患者過早地患有與年齡相關的疾病，如動脈粥狀硬化、糖尿病和癌症。

label: γ-H2A.X
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: gamma-H2A.X, the phosphorylated form of the histone variant H2A.X at serine 139, serves as a beacon that recruits DNA repair proteins to sites of double-strand DNA breaks. Phosphorylation of H2A.X spreads over large chromatin domains around the break, providing a platform for the assembly of DNA repair complexes and the amplification of damage signaling. Beyond its role in repair, gamma-H2A.X induces p53 expression and activates senescence signaling, and it accumulates with aging as a result of persistent DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: γ-H2A.X 是組蛋白變體 H2A.X 在絲氨酸 139 的磷酸化形式，可作為將 DNA 修復蛋白招募到雙股 DNA 斷裂位點的信標。 H2A.X 的磷酸化遍布斷裂周圍的大染色質結構域，為 DNA 修復複合物的組裝和損傷訊號的放大提供了平台。除了修復作用之外，gamma-H2A.X 還誘導 p53 表達並激活衰老信號傳導，並且由於持續的 DNA 損傷，它會隨著衰老而累積。

label: Homologous recombination repair
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: BRCA1 is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks by the MRN complex, promotes end resection, and facilitates RAD51 loading via PALB2 and BRCA2 to execute homologous recombination repair. Directionally, BRCA1 sits upstream of high-fidelity double-strand-break repair. Loss of BRCA1 cripples homologous recombination, increasing mutation and cancer risk, particularly in breast and ovarian tissue. Sirtuins such as SIRT2 support BRCA1 localization to damage sites, linking sirtuin activity to genome stability. The BRCA1 pathway is also the basis for synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors in BRCA-deficient cancers.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 被 MRN 複合物招募到 DNA 雙鏈斷裂處，促進末端切除，並透過 PALB2 和 BRCA2 協助 RAD51 裝載以執行同源重組修復。在方向性上，BRCA1 位於高保真雙鏈斷裂修復的上游。BRCA1 的缺失損害同源重組，增加突變和癌症風險，特別是在乳腺和卵巢組織中。如 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 支持 BRCA1 定位到損傷位點，將 sirtuin 活性與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。BRCA1 途徑也是 BRCA 缺陷癌症中與 PARP 抑制劑合成致死的基礎。

label: CHK2
description: Activated ATM phosphorylates the checkpoint kinase CHK2, which propagates the DNA-damage checkpoint signal. This cascade initiates cell-cycle arrest and coordinates the damage response. CHK2 is thus a direct downstream substrate of ATM.
description_zh_TW: 激活的 ATM 磷酸化檢查點激酶 CHK2，進而傳播 DNA 損傷檢查點訊號。此級聯啟動細胞週期停滯並協調損傷反應。因此 CHK2 是 ATM 的直接下游受質。

label: p27
description: The CDK inhibitor p27 is co-induced with p21 to enforce cell cycle arrest. p27 inhibits G1 cyclin-CDK complexes, maintaining cells in a non-proliferative state. Together with p21 it represents a key effector of growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27 與 p21 共同被誘導以強制實施細胞週期停滯。p27 抑制 G1 cyclin–CDK 複合體，使細胞維持在非增殖狀態。它與 p21 共同構成生長停滯的關鍵效應因子。

label: SIRT1 as CR mediator
description: David Sinclair identified SIRT1 as a mediator of caloric-restriction benefits and, in a landmark 2003 study, discovered resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound (STAC). Directionally, the discovery establishes SIRT1/STAC centrality to longevity research. This launched the modern sirtuin field, and it connects basic yeast findings to mammalian therapeutics. By showing that resveratrol extends yeast lifespan through Sir2, Sinclair bridged the caloric-restriction and sirtuin fields. This work catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development and made SIRT1 a central target in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: David Sinclair 鑑定 SIRT1 為限制熱量益處的介導因子，並在 2003 年的里程碑研究中發現 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）。在方向性上，此發現確立了 SIRT1/STAC 在長壽研究中的核心地位。這啟動了現代 sirtuin 領域，並將基礎酵母發現與哺乳動物治療學聯繫起來。透過展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，Sinclair 架起了限制熱量和 sirtuin 領域之間的橋樑。此工作催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，使 SIRT1 成為老年科學的核心靶標。

label: Resveratrol as STAC
description: In 2003, Sinclair showed resveratrol extends yeast lifespan via Sir2 and later demonstrated parallel effects in higher organisms, discovering it as the first STAC. Directionally, the discovery sits upstream of the STAC concept. This catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development, and it remains a seminal finding in geroscience. By identifying a natural compound that activates sirtuins, Sinclair provided the prototype for pharmacologically engaging longevity pathways. The STAC concept has since driven the search for more potent and specific sirtuin activators for therapeutic use.
description_zh_TW: 2003 年，Sinclair 展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，後來在高等生物中展示了類似效應，將其發現為第一個 STAC。在方向性上，此發現位於 STAC 概念的上游。這催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，至今仍是老年科學的開創性發現。透過鑑定一種活化 sirtuin 的天然化合物，Sinclair 為藥理學地介入長壽途徑提供了原型。STAC 概念自那以後推動了尋找更強效和更具選擇性的 sirtuin 活化劑用於治療。

label: RCM-driven epigenetic aging
description: Induction of double-strand breaks in the ICE Mouse, followed by repair, produces accelerated epigenetic aging and physiological decline without mutagenesis, supporting the RCM hypothesis. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of epigenetic aging. This argues that aging can arise from information loss rather than just genetic damage, and it is a cornerstone experiment for the Information Theory of Aging. Because the phenotype occurs without mutations, it is attributed to loss of epigenetic information during repair. These results reframe aging as a software problem and motivate NAD+/sirtuin-based interventions.
description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中雙鏈斷裂的誘導及隨後的修復產生加速的表觀遺傳衰老和生理退化，不伴隨突變，支持 RCM 假說。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於表觀遺傳衰老的上游。這主張衰老可以源於資訊喪失而非僅僅基因損傷，是衰老資訊理論的基礎實驗。由於表型在沒有突變的情況下發生，被歸因於修復期間表觀遺傳資訊的喪失。這些結果將衰老重新定義為軟體問題，並推動基於 NAD+/sirtuin 的干預措施。

label: RCM (Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers)
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
description_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。

label: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
description: Sinclair co-founded Sirtris Pharmaceuticals (later acquired by GlaxoSmithKline) to develop STACs such as SRT1720 and SRT2104 as therapeutics. Directionally, the academic discovery was translated into a company. This drove clinical translation of sirtuin activators, and it illustrates the bench-to-bedside path of sirtuin research. By commercializing STACs, Sirtris aimed to develop drugs that reproduce the metabolic benefits of caloric restriction. Although clinical outcomes were mixed, the company's formation validated sirtuins as a druggable target class and stimulated industrial interest in longevity biology.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 共同創辦了 Sirtris Pharmaceuticals（後被葛蘭素史克收購）以開發 SRT1720 和 SRT2104 等 STAC 作為治療藥物。在方向性上，學術發現被轉化為一家公司。這推動了 sirtuin 活化劑的臨床轉化，並說明了 sirtuin 研究從實驗室到床邊的路徑。透過商業化 STAC，Sirtris 旨在開發再現限制熱量代謝益處的藥物。儘管臨床結果不一，該公司的成立驗證了 sirtuin 作為可藥靶標類別的地位，並刺激了工業界對長壽生物學的興趣。

label: I-PpoI endonuclease
description: The ICE (Induced Changes in Epigenetics) Mouse uses inducible I-PpoI expression to introduce targeted double-strand breaks that are repaired without introducing mutations. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of controlled double-strand-break formation. This lets researchers trigger DNA damage alone, isolating epigenetic from mutational effects, and it is the experimental engine of the RCM model. By using sequence-specific breaks that are repaired faithfully, the ICE Mouse creates pure DNA-repair events. This design is central to testing whether DNA damage drives aging through epigenetic information loss.
description_zh_TW: ICE（表觀遺傳誘導變化）小鼠使用誘導型 I-PpoI 表達引入靶向的雙鏈斷裂，這些斷裂在不引入突變的情況下被修復。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於受控雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。這讓研究人員僅觸發 DNA 損傷，將表觀遺傳與突變效應分離，是 RCM 模型的實驗引擎。透過使用被忠實修復的序列特異性斷裂，ICE 小鼠創造純粹的 DNA 修復事件。此設計對於測試 DNA 損傷是否透過表觀遺傳資訊喪失驅動衰老至關重要。

label: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

label: ICE Mouse model
description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: Chromatin Modifiers
description: Chromatin modifiers are the central class of proteins in the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis. They are recruited away from their native loci to DNA repair sites, and repeated relocalization with imperfect resetting erodes the epigenetic landscape and drives aging.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子是染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說中的核心蛋白類別。它們被招募離開原生基因座至 DNA 修復位點，反覆易位與不完美的重置會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀並驅動衰老。

label: Double-Strand Break
description: Double-strand breaks are the principal trigger for the recruitment of chromatin modifiers away from their native genomic loci to damage sites. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated cycles of DSB-induced relocalization are proposed to erode the epigenetic landscape over time.
description_zh_TW: 雙股斷裂是染色質修飾因子被招募離開原生基因座至損傷位點的主要觸發因素。在 RCM 假說中，反覆的 DSB 誘導易位被認為會隨時間侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀。

label: Mutations
description: In the Information Theory of Aging, mutations represent irreversible 'hardware' damage distinct from the 'software' (epigenetic) information loss the theory emphasizes as the primary driver of aging. The RCM hypothesis and ICE mouse model induce double-strand breaks without mutations to isolate epigenetic consequences.
description_zh_TW: 在老化資訊理論中，突變代表不可逆的「硬體」損傷，有別於理論強調為老化主要驅動者的「軟體」（表觀遺傳）資訊喪失。RCM 假說與 ICE 小鼠模型在無突變下誘導雙股斷裂，以隔離表觀遺傳後果。

label: Epigenetic Landscape
description: The epigenetic landscape denotes the ensemble of chromatin states that establish cellular identity. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated recruitment of chromatin modifiers to DNA repair sites causes gradual erosion of this landscape, leading to loss of cellular identity and aging phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳景觀指建立細胞身分的染色質狀態總和。在 RCM 假說中，染色質修飾因子被反覆招募至 DNA 修復位點會造成此景觀的逐漸侵蝕，導致細胞身分喪失與衰老表現型。

label: antioxidant enzyme expression
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Moderate physical exercise induces the expression of antioxidant enzymes, leading to the reduction of oxidative stress. Exercise effectively inhibits ROS generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes, and because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is attributed mainly to exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Physical exercise also decreases oxidative stress in rodent models and is reported to improve systemic antioxidant activity in humans. These antioxidant effects link exercise to reduced AGE accumulation and healthier aging.
description_zh_TW: 適度的身體運動會誘導抗氧化酵素的表現，進而降低氧化壓力。運動能有效抑制 ROS 的生成並提升抗氧化酵素的活性，而由於蛋白質糖化反應是由 ROS 驅動並加速的，規律運動對 AGE 形成的抑制主要歸因於運動相關的抗氧化活性。身體運動也能降低囓齒類動物模式中的氧化壓力，且據報導能改善人類的全身性抗氧化活性。這些抗氧化效應將運動與減少的 AGE 堆積及更健康的老化連結起來。

label: Appetite
description: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
description_zh_TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

label: Athletes
description: Athletes in heavy training display elevated resting metabolic rates compared with untrained individuals, largely because their higher fat free mass increases the metabolic load of lean tissues. Speakman notes that RMR measured in endurance athletes can be elevated by about 5-10 percent beyond the prediction for their body composition alone, an effect attributed to increased protein turnover, elevated sympathetic tone, and continued recovery processes in muscle. However, the review stresses that the majority of the difference in total daily energy expenditure between athletes and non-athletes arises from the energy cost of training itself, not from chronic elevation of RMR.
description_zh_TW: 進行高強度訓練的運動員與未訓練者相比表現出更高的靜息代謝率，主要是因為他們較高的去脂體重增加了瘦組織的代謝負擔。Speakman指出，在耐力運動員中測量的RMR可能比僅根據其身體成分預測的值高出約5-10%，這一效應歸因於蛋白質周轉增加、交感神經張力升高和肌肉中持續的恢復過程。然而，該綜述強調，運動員和非運動員之間每日總能量消耗的大部分差異來自訓練本身的能量成本，而不是來自RMR的長期升高。

label: Daily Energy Expenditure
description: Physical activity and exercise are the components of daily energy expenditure that are most amenable to voluntary modification, in contrast to resting metabolic rate and thermic effect of food which are largely fixed by body size and composition. Speakman reviews doubly labelled water studies of total daily energy expenditure in adults to argue that although activity levels vary widely between individuals, the day-to-day variability of total daily energy expenditure is surprisingly small, around 2-3 percent. This suggests energy intake is tightly matched to expenditure over the long term, and that exercise-induced elevations in expenditure are generally not fully compensated by reductions elsewhere in the daily energy budget.
description_zh_TW: 體力活動和運動是每日能量支出中最容易自願修改的成分，而靜息代謝率和食物熱效應 largely 由身體大小和成分固定。Speakman回顧了成人每日總能量支出的雙標記水研究，認為儘管活動水平因人而異，但每日總能量支出的每日變異性驚人地小，約2-3%。這表明能量攝入在長期內與支出緊密匹配，且運動引起的支出增加通常不會完全被日常能量預算中其他地方的減少所補償。

label: Thyroid Hormones
description: Resting metabolic rate is modulated by thyroid hormones, which set the metabolic tone of the body by regulating mitochondrial oxygen consumption and cellular sodium-potassium ATPase activity in most tissues. Speakman reviews that both hypothyroid and hyperthyroid states shift RMR substantially, and that within the normal range thyroid status contributes to inter-individual variability in resting metabolic rate. However, training-induced changes in RMR are generally not mediated by changes in thyroid hormone levels, and short-term exercise does not consistently alter circulating thyroid hormone concentrations, indicating that the post-exercise RMR elevation is driven by other factors.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率受甲狀腺激素調節，甲狀腺激素通過調節大多數組織中的線粒體氧氣消耗和細胞鈉-鉀ATP酶活性來設定身體的代謝基調。Speakman回顧指出，甲狀腺功能減退和甲狀腺功能亢進狀態都會顯著改變RMR，並且在正常範圍內，甲狀腺狀態有助於靜息代謝率的個體間變異性。然而，訓練引起的RMR變化通常不是由甲狀腺激素水平的變化介導的，短期運動不會一致地改變循環甲狀腺激素濃度，表明運動後RMR升高是由其他因素驅動的。

label: Doubly Labelled Water
description: The doubly labelled water (DLW) technique is the gold-standard method for measuring total daily energy expenditure and the physical activity component of the energy budget in free-living humans. Subjects drink water labeled with the stable isotopes deuterium and oxygen-18; carbon dioxide production is calculated from the differential loss rates of the two isotopes, and energy expenditure is derived using standard equations. In the studies reviewed by Speakman, DLW has been used to quantify total daily energy expenditure (TEE) over 7-14 day periods, showing that within-individual day-to-day variability of TEE is small even when physical activity varies.
description_zh_TW: 雙標記水（DLW）技術是測量自由生活人類每日總能量支出和能量預算中體力活動成分的黃金標準方法。受試者飲用含有穩定同位素氘和氧-18標記的水；二氧化碳產生量根據兩種同位素的差異損失率計算，能量支出使用標準方程式得出。在Speakman回顧的研究中，DLW被用於量化7-14天期間的每日總能量支出（TEE），顯示即使體力活動變化，個體內每日TEE變異性也很小。

label: Sedentary Behaviour
description: Total physical activity during the day can be limited by sedentary behaviour, and in some doubly labelled water studies the elevated energy expenditure from a structured exercise session was partly offset by a reduction in non-exercise physical activity elsewhere in the day. Speakman notes that the extent of this compensation varies between individuals, so the net effect of a training program on total daily energy expenditure is the sum of the exercise cost, the excess post-exercise oxygen consumption, and any changes in spontaneous activity and appetite. This interaction helps explain why measured increases in total daily energy expenditure with training are often smaller than the energy cost of the training sessions themselves.
description_zh_TW: 白天的總體力活動可能因久坐行為而受限，在一些雙標記水研究中，結構化運動課程增加的能量消耗部分被一天中其他時間非運動體力活動的減少所抵消。Speakman指出這種補償程度因人而異，因此訓練課程對每日總能量支出的淨效應是運動成本、運動後過量氧消耗以及自發活動和食慾變化的總和。這種相互作用有助於解釋為什麼訓練期間測量的每日總能量支出增加通常小於訓練課程本身的能量成本。

label: UCP3
description: Uncoupling protein 3 (UCP3) is expressed primarily in skeletal muscle and is a candidate mediator of the proton leak that contributes to resting metabolic rate and exercise-related energy expenditure. Speakman cites evidence that UCP3 mRNA is elevated after exercise and that its expression, together with UCP2, may account for a fraction of the exercise-induced rise in metabolic rate. The functional importance of UCP3 in mediating proton leak remains debated, because knockout studies in mice do not show gross changes in resting metabolic rate, but its induction by training and by lipids keeps it a focus for understanding inter-individual differences in energy expenditure.
description_zh_TW: 解偶聯蛋白 3（UCP3）主要在骨骼肌中表達，是貢獻於靜息代謝率和運動相關能量消耗的質子洩漏的候選介導因子。Speakman 引用了 UCP3 mRNA 在運動後升高的證據，以及其表達與 UCP2 一起可能解釋運動誘導代謝率上升的一部分。UCP3 在介導質子洩漏中的功能重要性仍有爭議，因為小鼠基因敲除研究未顯示靜息代謝率的顯著變化，但其被訓練和脂質誘導的特性使其成為理解個體間能量消耗差異的焦點。

label: Fat Free Mass
description: Across and within individuals, resting metabolic rate (RMR) is most strongly predicted by fat free mass (FFM), which typically accounts for roughly 60-80 percent of the variance in RMR. Larger organs such as liver, brain, heart, and kidneys are metabolically expensive, so differences in lean mass drive most of the between-individual variation in RMR. Within a single individual, day-to-day variability of RMR is small, and the residual variability not explained by FFM includes fat mass, age, thyroid status, and ambient temperature. Because lean tissue is the primary metabolic driver, changes in muscle mass through training can modestly raise RMR.
description_zh_TW: 在個體之間和內部，靜息代謝率（RMR）最強烈地由去脂體重（FFM）預測，FFM通常佔RMR變異的大約60-80%。較大的器官如肝臟、大腦、心臟和腎臟在代謝上成本高昂，因此瘦體重的差異驅動了個體之間RMR的大部分變化。在單個個體內部，RMR的日常變異性很小，FFM未解釋的殘餘變異性包括脂肪質量、年齡、甲狀腺狀態和環境溫度。由於瘦組織是主要的代謝驅動因素，通過訓練改變肌肉質量可以適度提高RMR。

label: BDNF and NAD+ levels
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Exercise raises both BDNF and NAD+ levels, and SIRT1 may mediate exercise-induced BDNF upregulation in the hippocampus. Directionally, exercise sits upstream of BDNF and NAD+ elevation. Higher NAD+ fuels SIRT1, which then supports BDNF, and this provides a mechanistic bridge between physical activity, sirtuins, and brain health. By raising NAD+, exercise engages the sirtuin pathway that promotes BDNF expression and mitochondrial function. This axis is central to the well-established cognitive benefits of exercise and to the geroscience concept of exercise as medicine.
description_zh_TW: 運動同時提高 BDNF 和 NAD+ 水平，SIRT1 可能中介運動誘導的海馬 BDNF 上調。在方向性上，運動位於 BDNF 和 NAD+ 提升的上游。較高的 NAD+ 為 SIRT1 提供燃料，後者隨後支持 BDNF，這提供了身體活動、sirtuin 和大腦健康之間的機制橋樑。透過提高 NAD+，運動啟動促進 BDNF 表達和粒線體功能的 sirtuin 途徑。此軸線是運動公認的認知益處和老年科學中運動即藥物概念的核心。

label: NAD+ Depletion
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAD+ depletion was observed during the aging process in multiple animals, including humans, and is considered the major risk factor for Alzheimer's disease (AD).
