Neurodegenerative disorders such as AD are associated with DNA damage and oxidative stress, which accumulate with age and lead to impaired mitochondrial function, while excitotoxicity-driven axonal degeneration causes strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. When administered in AD mouse models, nicotinamide riboside (NR) displays beneficial effects on both oxidative stress and DNA repair by increasing NAD+ levels, and it improves pTau, amyloid-beta, neurogenesis, neuroinflammation, hippocampal synaptic plasticity, and cognition.
description_zh_TW: 在多種動物（包括人類）的老化過程中觀察到 NAD+ 耗竭，且被視為阿茲海默症（AD）的主要風險因子。諸如 AD 之類的神經退化性疾病與 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力相關，這些隨年齡累積並導致粒線體功能受損，而興奮毒性驅動的軸突退化則在神經元中造成強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。在 AD 小鼠模型中給予 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）時，NR 透過提升 NAD+ 水平對氧化壓力與 DNA 修復均展現有益效果，並改善 pTau、amyloid-beta（類澱粉乙型）、神經生成、神經發炎、海馬突觸可塑性與認知功能。

label: IGFBP3
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: A second group cloned humanin using a yeast two-hybrid screen as a partner of IGFBP3, and demonstrated that humanin binds to IGFBP3 with high affinity and specificity. IGFBP3 regulates IGF bioactivity and also induces apoptosis and inhibits cell growth independently of IGFs, and humanin protects against IGFBP3-induced apoptosis. Humanin does not interfere with IGF-I/IGFBP-3 binding but appears to bind to the heparin-binding domain of IGFBP-3, and a single amino acid substitution of alanine for phenylalanine at position 6 (F6AHN) abrogates IGFBP-3 binding.
description_zh_TW: 第二個團隊以酵母雙雜交篩選將 humanin 選殖為 IGFBP3 的結合夥伴，並證明 humanin 以高親和力與特異性結合 IGFBP3。IGFBP3 調節 IGF 的生物活性，也獨立於 IGF 誘導凋亡並抑制細胞生長；而 humanin 可保護細胞免受 IGFBP3 誘導的凋亡。Humanin 不干擾 IGF-I/IGFBP-3 的結合，但似乎結合 IGFBP-3 的肝素結合域；第 6 位置苯丙胺酸取代為丙胺酸的單一胺基酸置換（F6AHN）會消除 IGFBP-3 的結合。

label: FPRL1
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: FPRL1, a seven-transmembrane G-protein-coupled receptor, was the first humanin receptor to be described. Humanin acts as an agonist for FPRL1 by inducing Ca2+ mobilization and rapid activation of ERK1/2 signaling, a commonly induced downstream pathway of G-protein-coupled receptors. In neuroblasts, both the 42-aa form of beta-amyloid peptide and humanin activate FPRL1, but only Abeta42 is cytotoxic, and this cytotoxicity is reversed by humanin, suggesting that the neuroprotective effects of humanin might be accomplished by competitively binding to FPRL1, which may contribute to its cytoprotective aspects.
description_zh_TW: FPRL1 是七次跨膜 G 蛋白偶聯受體，為第一個被描述的 humanin 受體。Humanin 作為 FPRL1 的促效劑，誘導 Ca2+ 動員及 ERK1/2 訊號的快速活化，此為 G 蛋白偶聯受體常見誘發的下游路徑。在神經母細胞中，42 個胺基酸形式的 β-類澱粉胜肽與 humanin 都會活化 FPRL1，但只有 Aβ42 具細胞毒性，且此毒性可被 humanin 逆轉，顯示 humanin 的神經保護作用可能是透過競爭性結合 FPRL1 達成，這可能構成其細胞保護特性的一部分。

label: Pancreatic Beta Cells
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin improves glucose tolerance and delays the onset of diabetes in NOD mice, a model of type 1 diabetes involving progressive accumulation of lymphocytes within the pancreatic islets of Langerhans. In NOD mouse pancreata, humanin treatment dramatically suppressed inflammation and lymphocyte infiltration. Furthermore, humanin decreases serum starvation- and cytokine-induced apoptosis in the pancreatic beta-cell line NIT-1, protecting against the IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and IFN-gamma released by T cells and activated macrophages, in an ERK- and STAT3-dependent manner, suggesting it may be a therapeutic target for type 1 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 改善 NOD 小鼠的葡萄糖耐受性並延遲糖尿病的發生；NOD 小鼠是第 1 型糖尿病模型，其特徵為淋巴球在胰臟蘭氏小島內逐漸累積。在 NOD 小鼠胰臟中，humanin 治療顯著抑制發炎與淋巴球浸潤。此外，humanin 降低胰臟 beta 細胞株 NIT-1 中血清剝奪與細胞激素誘導的細胞凋亡，以 ERK 與 STAT3 依賴的方式保護細胞免受 T 細胞與活化巨噬細胞釋放的 IL-1beta、TNF-alpha 與 IFN-gamma 傷害，顯示它可能是第 1 型糖尿病的治療標靶。

label: MOTS-c
description: MOTS-c is a 16 amino acid peptide encoded by the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene, and is one of eight mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs) described to date along with humanin and small humanin-like peptides 1-6 (SHLPs 1-6). It is an exercise-induced factor that increases insulin sensitivity and visceral fat accumulation, with circulating levels rising acutely with exercise. The peptide has also been observed to translocate to the nucleus during energetic stress, suggesting both cell-autonomous and non-cell-autonomous functions.
description_zh_TW: MOTS-c是由粒線體12S rRNA基因編碼的16胺基酸肽，是迄今描述的八種粒線體衍生肽（MDPs）之一，與humanin和小型humanin類似肽1-6（SHLPs 1-6）並列。它是一種運動誘導因子，可增加胰島素敏感性和內臟脂肪堆積，其循環水平在運動後急性升高。該肽還被觀察到在能量應激時易位至細胞核，提示其具有細胞自主和非細胞自主功能。

label: Distal Tissues
description: Mitokines are soluble factors released by stressed mitochondria that communicate mitochondrial stress status to distal tissues, enabling cell-non-autonomous regulation of stress responses and lifespan. In C. elegans, knockdown of the cytochrome c oxidase component cco-1 in the brain activates the UPRmt response in the intestine and extends lifespan, implying that stressed mitochondria in the nervous system release signals that modulate stress defenses elsewhere in the soma. This allows mitochondria in one tissue to act as sensors of overall metabolic status for the entire organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體因子是由受壓粒線體釋放的可溶性因子，將粒線體壓力狀態傳遞給遠端組織，實現壓力反應和壽命的細胞非自主性調節。在 C. elegans 中，腦中細胞色素 c 氧化酶成分 cco-1 的敲低會在腸道活化 UPRmt 反應並延長壽命，暗示神經系統中受壓粒線體釋放的訊號在其他體細胞部位調節壓力防禦。這使得一個組織中的粒線體能夠作為整個生物體整體代謝狀態的感測器。

label: Cells
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: The humanin peptide sequence has been proposed to contain a pseudo-signal peptide, and when transfected into neuronal cells humanin is detected in the culture medium, indicating a secretory capacity that is blocked by inhibition of ER-golgi transport processes. Humanin is secreted from cells and found in circulation (plasma) as well as bound to cellular membranes, and its actions are thought to be mediated by specific receptors. This endocrine mode of action distinguishes humanin from other stress-induced mitochondrial retrograde signals, which are cell-autonomous, and supports its role as a non-autonomous signaling factor.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 胜肽序列被提出含有一個偽訊息胜肽，當轉染進入神經元細胞後，humanin 可在培養基中偵測到，顯示其具有分泌能力，而此能力會被 ER-高基氏體運輸過程的抑制所阻斷。Humanin 從細胞分泌並存在於循環（血漿）中，也結合於細胞膜上，其作用被認為是由特定受體所媒介。這種內分泌作用模式使 humanin 有別於其他由壓力誘導、細胞自主性的粒線體逆向訊號，並支持其作為非自主性訊號因子的角色。

label: MAP2
description: MAP2 (microtubule-associated protein 2) is a high-molecular-weight protein abundant in neuronal dendrites that binds and stabilizes microtubules. MAP2 immunostaining is widely used as a dendritic marker to assess neuronal integrity and preservation.
description_zh_TW: MAP2（微管相關蛋白 2）是豐富存在於神經元樹突的高分子量蛋白，結合並穩定微管。MAP2 免疫染色被廣泛用作樹突標記，以評估神經元完整性與保存。

label: Inter-organ signaling
description: Mitokines are soluble factors secreted by cells undergoing mitochondrial stress that trigger stress responses in distal tissues or organs. They represent a form of cell non-autonomous, inter-organ signaling that extends longevity effects across the organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體動素（mitokines）是承受粒線體壓力的細胞分泌的可溶性因子，可在遠端組織或器官觸發壓力反應。它們代表一種細胞非自主、器官間訊號形式，將長壽效應擴展至整個生物體。

label: Synaptophysin
description: Neurons are the principal signaling cells of the nervous system, and synaptophysin is a synaptic-vesicle protein used as an immunohistochemical marker of synapses and neuronal connectivity. Synaptophysin marks presynaptic terminals within neurons.
description_zh_TW: 神經元是神經系統的主要訊號細胞，而 synaptophysin 是突觸囊泡蛋白，用作突觸與神經元連接性的免疫組織化學標記。Synaptophysin 標記神經元內的突觸前末端。

label: Anti-androgen
description: Enzalutamide is a nonsteroidal anti-androgen used in endocrine therapy of prostate cancer.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 是一種非甾體抗雄激素，用於前列腺癌的內分泌治療。

label: IL-22
description: Interleukin 22, an IL-10 gene family member produced by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets, signals through the IL-22 receptor on the surface of thymic epithelial cells and promotes the proliferation and survival of thymocytes. Dudakov et al. showed that IL-22 administration to wild-type mice after total body irradiation significantly increases thymic cellularity, including both developing thymocytes and TEC subsets, and that immune recovery in irradiated IL-22-deficient mice is impaired.
description_zh_TW: 介白素 22（Interleukin 22）是 IL-10 基因家族成員，由 T 輔助 17 細胞與先天淋巴樣細胞亞群產生，透過胸腺上皮細胞表面的 IL-22 受體傳遞訊號，促進胸腺細胞的增生與存活。Dudakov 等人顯示，在全身照射後對野生型小鼠施用 IL-22 可顯著增加胸腺細胞數量，包括發育中的胸腺細胞與 TEC 亞群，而 IL-22 缺陷小鼠在照射後的免疫恢復則受損。

label: Keratinocyte Growth Factor
description: Keratinocyte growth factor (KGF, FGF7) signaling through FGFR2IIIb is critical for fetal thymus organogenesis and linked to proliferation and differentiation of fetal and postnatal thymic epithelial cells. KGF administration is well-documented to increase thymus size, TEC differentiation, and thymocyte production in aged animals. Min and colleagues showed that a single course of KGF treatment increases thymic cellularity in aged mice, maintained for two months, with restoration of cortical and medullary compartments, increased naive CD4 T cell output, and increased humoral responses to a T-dependent antigen.
description_zh_TW: 角質細胞生長因子（KGF，FGF7）透過 FGFR2IIIb 的訊息傳導對胎兒胸腺器官發生至關重要，並與胎兒及出生後胸腺上皮細胞的增生與分化有關。有充分文獻記載 KGF 施用可增加年老動物的胸腺大小、TEC 分化與胸腺細胞生成。Min 及其同事顯示，單一療程的 KGF 治療可增加老年小鼠的胸腺細胞數量，並維持兩個月，同時恢復皮質與髓質區室、增加初始 CD4 T 細胞輸出，並增加對 T 依賴性抗原的體液免疫反應。

label: LHRH
description: Luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (LHRH) analogues achieve pharmacological sex steroid ablation and are a clinically tolerable alternative to surgical castration. Agents such as Lupron (leuprolide) act on the pituitary gland, desensitizing LHRH receptors and thereby decreasing luteinizing hormone and follicle-stimulating hormone, leading to reduced estrogen and testosterone production. Human studies with LHRH analogues have resulted in increased thymic weight and reversal of age-related thymic structural defects.
description_zh_TW: 黃體生成激素釋放激素（LHRH）類似物可達成藥理性性類固醇消融，是外科去勢的臨床上可耐受之替代方案。諸如 Lupron（leuprolide）等藥物作用於腦下垂體，使 LHRH 受體去敏感化，從而減少黃體生成激素與濾泡刺激激素，導致雌激素與睪固酮生成減少。使用 LHRH 類似物的人類研究已導致胸腺重量增加及年齡相關胸腺結構缺陷的逆轉。

label: sjTREC
description: Single joint T cell receptor excision circle (sjTREC) analysis is a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis. Using sjTREC, researchers reported a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan, and a significant decrease of sjTREC per milligram of mouse thymus tissue with increasing age in BALB/c mice (6-90 weeks), demonstrating gradual decrease in thymopoiesis with age similar to humans. The sjTREC assay was also used to show that ghrelin administration to aged mice increases the number of recent thymic emigrants exported to the periphery. It is thus a quantitative readout of thymic output used across species.
description_zh_TW: 單關節T細胞受體刪除環（sjTREC）分析是活性胸腺生成的分子標誌物。使用sjTREC，研究人員報告了在80年人類壽命中循環初始T細胞穩步下降三個數量級，以及在BALB/c小鼠（6-90週）中隨著年齡增長，每毫克小鼠胸腺組織的sjTREC顯著減少，證明了與人類相似的隨著年齡增長胸腺生成逐漸減少。sjTREC測定也被用於證明ghrelin給藥老年小鼠增加了最近輸出到外周的胸腺遷出細胞的數量。因此，它是跨物種使用的胸腺輸出的定量讀數。

label: CDK5
description: CDK5 phosphorylates NOXA at Ser13, causing inactivation in metabolically regulated T-cell leukemia cells.
description_zh_TW: CDK5 在 Ser13 磷酸化 NOXA，在代謝調節的 T 細胞白血病細胞中造成不活化。

label: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Tenovins (tenovin-1 and tenovin-6) are sirtuin inhibitors that block SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation of p53, leading to p53 hyperacetylation and activation. Their strong anticancer activity is associated with this p53 activation, which reinstates tumor-suppressive transcription in cancer cells. Directionally, tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation and tumor suppression, a property shared with HDAC inhibitors and other p53-releasing strategies. Tenovins illustrate the direct link between sirtuin inhibition, p53 acetylation state, and cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin（tenovin-1 和 tenovin-6）是 sirtuin 抑制劑，阻斷 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的 p53 去乙醯化，導致 p53 超乙醯化和活化。其強效抗癌活性與此 p53 活化相關，在癌細胞中恢復腫瘤抑制性轉錄。方向性上 tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化和腫瘤抑制的上游，此特性與 HDAC 抑制劑和其他 p53 釋放策略共享。Tenovin 展示了 sirtuin 抑制、p53 乙醯化狀態和癌症治療之間的直接聯繫。

label: HIC1 transcription
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: p53 directly activates transcription of HIC1, a tumor suppressor that in turn represses the SIRT1 promoter, forming a negative feedback loop that restrains SIRT1 abundance. This loop ensures that p53 activity is not indefinitely suppressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation, because sustained p53 signaling drives HIC1 to limit SIRT1 expression. Directionally, p53 is the transcription factor and HIC1 the induced target gene, with SIRT1 sitting downstream of both. The biological significance is genome protection: by inducing HIC1, p53 prevents SIRT1 from over-deacetylating and silencing p53 itself, preserving the capacity for apoptosis and senescence in response to damage.
description_zh_TW: p53 直接活化 HIC1 的轉錄，HIC1 是一種腫瘤抑制因子，反過來抑制 SIRT1 啟動子，形成一個負回饋迴路以限制 SIRT1 的表達量。這個迴路確保 p53 活性不會被 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化無限期抑制，因為持續的 p53 信號驅動 HIC1 來限制 SIRT1 表達。在方向性上，p53 是轉錄因子，HIC1 是被誘導的靶基因，而 SIRT1 位於兩者的下游。其生物學意義在於基因組保護：通過誘導 HIC1，p53 防止 SIRT1 過度去乙醯化和沉默 p53 本身，維持對損傷的凋亡和衰老反應能力。

label: CDKN1A
description: CPEC-induced stability of p53 drives expression of CDKN1A, the gene encoding the p21(WAF1/CIP1) cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor. p21 induction enforces G1/S arrest in cells subjected to cyclopentenyl cytosine pyrimidine starvation.
description_zh_TW: CPEC 誘導的 p53 穩定化會驅動 CDKN1A（編碼 p21(WAF1/CIP1) 週期蛋白依賴性激酶抑制劑的基因）表現。p21 的誘導在遭受 cyclopentenyl cytosine 嘧啶缺乏的細胞中執行 G1/S 停滯。

label: CTP Synthetase
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine (CPEC) is a synthetic cyclopentenyl-derived cytidine analog whose active triphosphate metabolite (CPEC-TP) acts as a potent, mechanism-based inhibitor of CTP Synthetase. By blocking the ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, it collapses intracellular pyrimidine pools, especially CTP and dCTP, in rapidly dividing cells and pyrimidine-dependent viruses.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine（CPEC）是一種合成的環戊烯基胞苷類似物，其活性三磷酸代謝物（CPEC-TP）是 CTP Synthetase 的強效機制型抑制劑。透過阻斷 UTP 依賴 ATP 轉化為 CTP，它使快速分裂細胞和依賴嘧啶的病毒細胞內嘧啶池（尤其 CTP 和 dCTP）崩潰。

label: Deoxycholic Acid
description: Obesity alters the gut microbiota, leading to increased production of deoxycholic acid, a secondary bile acid metabolite. DCA induces cellular senescence and SASP factor production in hepatic stellate cells, promoting HCC development. Deoxycholic acid is therefore a gut-derived driver of obesity-associated HCC.
description_zh_TW: 肥胖會改變腸道微生物群，導致次級膽酸代謝物脫氧膽酸的產生增加。DCA 誘導肝星狀細胞中的細胞衰老與 SASP 因子產生，促進 HCC 發展。因此脫氧膽酸是肥胖相關 HCC 的腸道來源驅動因子。

label: Hepatic Stellate Cells
description: Senescent hepatic stellate cells produce SASP factors that drive obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. HSC senescence, induced by deoxycholic acid from altered gut microbiota, creates a pro-inflammatory microenvironment. Hepatic stellate cells are therefore central to obesity-associated HCC.
description_zh_TW: 衰老的肝星狀細胞產生驅動肥胖相關肝細胞癌的 SASP 因子。由改變的腸道微生物群產生的脫氧膽酸誘導 HSC 衰老，創造促發炎微環境。因此肝星狀細胞對肥胖相關 HCC 至關重要。

label: Antimetabolite
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine is a type of Antimetabolite: this synthetic cytidine nucleoside analog acts as a metabolic antagonist that depletes pyrimidine nucleotides, chiefly by inhibiting CTP synthetase, which underlies its candidate use in cancer chemotherapy and antiviral research.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於 Antimetabolite（抗代謝物）的一種：此合成胞苷核苷類似物扮演代謝拮抗劑，主要透過抑制 CTP synthetase 耗竭嘧啶核苷酸，這是其在癌症化療與抗病毒研究中作為候選藥物的基礎。

label: Biological Age
description: An epigenetic clock is a statistical estimator of biological age built from DNA methylation measurements at a defined set of CpG sites across the genome. Trained on large cohorts, these clocks compute an epigenetic age that correlates with chronological age but can also deviate from it, reflecting accelerated or decelerated biological aging. Clock acceleration is associated with disease and mortality risk, making epigenetic clocks valuable biomarkers for aging research and for evaluating anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的統計估計器，是根據基因組中一組定義的 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化測量而建構的。這些時鐘經過對大群體的訓練，計算出與實際年齡相關的表觀遺傳年齡，但也可能偏離實際年齡，反映生物老化的加速或減慢。時鐘加速與疾病和死亡風險有關，這使得表觀遺傳時鐘成為老化研究和評估抗衰老幹預措施的寶貴生物標記。

label: DNAmGrimAge
description: DNAmGrimAge is a second-generation epigenetic clock trained to predict morbidity, mortality, and physiological decline rather than simply chronological age. It incorporates DNA methylation surrogates for plasma proteins and smoking exposure, producing a DNAm-based age estimate that is a robust predictor of lifespan and healthspan. As a stronger predictor of time-to-death than first-generation clocks such as the Horvath and Hannum clocks, GrimAge is widely used as an endpoint in aging and rejuvenation studies.
description_zh_TW: DNAmGrimAge 是第二代表觀遺傳時鐘，經過訓練可以預測發病率、死亡率和生理衰退，而不僅僅是實際年齡。它結合了血漿蛋白和吸煙暴露的 DNA 甲基化替代物，產生基於 DNAm 的年齡估計，這是壽命和健康壽命的強大預測因子。作為比第一代時鐘（例如 Horvath 和 Hannum 時鐘）更強大的死亡時間預測器，GrimAge 被廣泛用作衰老和復興研究的終點。

label: Histone Modification
description: Histone modification is a core epigenetic mechanism operating through covalent marks on the N-terminal tails of histone proteins, including acetylation, methylation, phosphorylation, ubiquitination, and SUMOylation. These modifications alter chromatin structure and recruit reader proteins that modulate gene expression; acetylation neutralizes lysine charge to open chromatin, whereas methylation at H3K9 or H3K27 typically condenses it into repressive heterochromatin. The marks are written, erased, and read by families of enzymes such as acetyltransferases, deacetylases, and methyltransferases, and their dynamic balance shapes gene expression and becomes progressively dysregulated with age.
description_zh_TW: Histone 修飾是一種核心表觀遺傳機制，透過組蛋白 N 端尾部的共價標記進行操作，包括乙醯化、甲基化、磷酸化、泛素化和 SUMO 化。這些修飾改變染色質結構並招募調節 gene expression 的讀取蛋白；乙醯化會中和賴氨酸電荷以打開染色質，而 H3K9 或 H3K27 的甲基化通常會將其凝結成抑制性異染色質。這些標記由乙醯轉移酶、去乙醯酶和甲基轉移酶等酵素家族書寫、擦除和讀取，它們的動態平衡塑造了 gene expression，並隨著年齡的增長而逐漸失調。

label: Non-Coding RNA
description: Non-coding RNAs, including microRNAs, piRNAs, and long non-coding RNAs, function as an epigenetic mechanism that regulates gene expression at both the transcriptional and post-transcriptional levels. MicroRNAs guide the RNA-induced silencing complex to target mRNAs to promote degradation or translational repression, piRNAs help silence transposable elements in the germline, and long non-coding RNAs can recruit chromatin-modifying complexes to specific genomic loci. Their expression is dynamically regulated across the lifespan, and age-related declines in microRNA levels and in RNA-processing enzymes such as Dicer contribute to the aging epigenome.
description_zh_TW: 非編碼 RNA，包括 microRNA、piRNA 和長非編碼 RNA，作為表觀遺傳機制在轉錄和轉錄後層級調節 gene expression。 MicroRNA 引導 R​​NA 誘導的沉默複合物靶向 mRNA，以促進降解或翻譯抑制，piRNA 幫助沉默種系中的轉座元件，長非編碼 RNA 可以將染色質修飾複合物招募到特定基因組位點。它們的表達在整個生命週期中受到動態調節，並且與年齡相關的 microRNA 水平和 RNA 加工酶（例如 Dicer）的下降導致了表觀基因組的衰老。

label: Polycomb Group Proteins
description: Polycomb group proteins are a primary target of epigenetic drift, as genes marked by Polycomb repressive complexes are especially vulnerable to age-associated methylation changes. The H3K27me3 mark deposited by Polycomb complexes and associated CpG methylation tend to be gained during aging, altering the expression of developmental and differentiation genes. This drift at Polycomb targets contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity that characterizes aging. Preventing such drift at Polycomb targets is a goal of epigenetic rejuvenation approaches.
description_zh_TW: Polycomb 族蛋白是表觀遺傳漂變的主要目標，因為 Polycomb 抑制複合物標記的基因特別容易受到與年齡相關的甲基化變化的影響。 Polycomb 複合物沉積的 H3K27me3 標記和相關的 CpG 甲基化往往在老化過程中獲得，從而改變發育和分化基因的表達。 Polycomb 標靶的這種漂移導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失，而這正是衰老的特徵。防止多梳目標的這種漂移是表觀遺傳復興方法的目標。

label: Global Hypomethylation
description: The best-characterized signature of epigenetic drift is global hypomethylation of repetitive elements and gene bodies coupled with site-specific hypermethylation of gene promoters. This age-related divergence of methylation patterns erodes the stability of the epigenome and contributes to the loss of cellular identity and transcriptional fidelity. Because drift accumulates with time and is modified by environment, lifestyle, and interventions such as caloric restriction, it underlies both biological aging and the age-associated increase in disease risk.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳漂變的最佳特徵是重複元件和基因體的整體低甲基化以及基因啟動子的位點特異性高甲基化。這種與年齡相關的甲基化模式的差異會侵蝕表觀基因組的穩定性，並導致細胞身份和轉錄保真度的喪失。由於漂移會隨著時間的推移而累積，並會受到環境、生活方式和熱量限制等乾預措施的改變，因此它是生物老化和與年齡相關的疾病風險增加的基礎。

label: DSB repair and RCM
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: DSB repair and RCM may advance epigenetic clocks by affecting DNA methylation machinery (e.g., TET enzymes and DNMTs). Because the response to DNA damage follows conserved mechanisms, aging becomes somewhat predictable despite random damage, leading to consistent epigenetic drift. Directionally, DNA damage repair and the consequent relocalization of chromatin modifiers sit upstream of clock-measured epigenetic age acceleration, linking RCM to quantitative measures of biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 雙股斷裂（DSB）修復和 RCM 可能透過影響 DNA 甲基化機制（例如 TET 酶和 DNMTs）來推進表觀遺傳時鐘。由於 DNA 損傷反應遵循保守的機制，衰老因此具有一定的可預測性，儘管損傷是隨機的，導致一致的表觀遺傳漂移。從作用方向而言，DNA 損傷修復及隨後的染色質修飾因子再定位位於時鐘測量的表觀遺傳年齡加速的上游，將 RCM 與生物衰老的量化測量聯繫起來。

label: epigenetic information
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: Partial reprogramming (e.g., via Yamanaka factors) can reset epigenetic information, supporting the idea that aging is reversible at the information level. This connection to cellular reprogramming complements the RCM hypothesis, which frames aging as an epigenetic software problem rather than purely hardware (mutation) damage. Because epigenetic changes can potentially be reset, unlike permanent mutations, reprogramming-based approaches offer a route to restoring youthful gene expression patterns.
description_zh_TW: 部分重編程（例如透過 Yamanaka 因子）可以重置表觀遺傳資訊，支持了衰老在資訊層面可逆的觀點。這種與細胞重編程的關聯補充了 RCM 假說，該假說將衰老定位為表觀遺傳軟體問題，而非單純的硬體（突變）損傷。由於表觀遺傳變化不像永久性突變那樣無法逆轉，基於重編程的方法提供了恢復年輕基因表達模式的途徑。

label: Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer
description: Reprogramming ranges from complete nuclear reprogramming via somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT), where an oocyte erases somatic identity to restore totipotency, to factor-driven pluripotent reprogramming and partial reprogramming. SCNT remains the gold standard for developmental reprogramming studies.
description_zh_TW: Reprogramming 的範圍從透過體細胞核轉移（SCNT）的完全核重編程（卵母細胞抹除體細胞身分以恢復全能性），到因子驅動的多能性重編程和部分重編程。SCNT 仍是發育重編程研究的黃金標準。

label: CDK6
source_file: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md
description: p16INK4a also inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 6 (CDK6), similarly preventing cyclin D-CDK6-mediated Rb phosphorylation and stabilizing the arrested state. This broad inhibition of both CDK4 and CDK6 ensures a robust G1 blockade, and the dual targeting makes p16 a potent, non-redundant cell-cycle inhibitor. Its action underpins the irreversibility of established senescence, complementing the p53/p21 arm. p16 is consequently a key mediator of permanent growth arrest and a widely used senescence marker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 也抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 6（CDK6），類似地防止 cyclin D-CDK6 介導的 Rb 磷酸化並穩定停滯狀態。此對 CDK4 與 CDK6 的廣泛抑制確保強健的 G1 封鎖，且雙重標靶使 p16 成為強效、非冗餘的細胞週期抑制因子。其動作支撐已確立衰老的不可逆性，補充 p53/p21 臂。p16 因此是永久生長停滯與廣泛使用的衰老標記的關鍵介導者。

label: Early SASP
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: p21 supports an early secretory phenotype -- including factors such as CXCL14 and IGFBP3 -- that places stressed cells under immunosurveillance prior to full senescence. This early p21-associated secretome differs from the later NF-kB-dominated SASP, and it may help communicate cellular stress and recruit immune clearance. The relationship suggests p21 contributes to both arrest and the initial communicative state of stressed cells. It is more nuanced than simple arrest enforcement, giving moderate confidence.
description_zh_TW: p21 支持早期分泌表型——包括如 CXCL14 與 IGFBP3 等因子——使受壓細胞在完全衰老前處於免疫監視下。此早期 p21 相關分泌組不同於後期 NF-κB 主導的 SASP，且可能有助溝通細胞壓力並招募免疫清除。此關係顯示 p21 同時貢獻停滯與受壓細胞的初始溝通狀態。它比簡單的停滯執行更細微，信度中等。

label: S Phase
description: G1 is the principal interphase gap before DNA synthesis. Once the cell passes the restriction point late in G1, it becomes irreversibly committed to replicating its genome in S phase.
description_zh_TW: G1 是 DNA 合成前的主要分裂間期。一旦細胞通過 G1 後期的限制點，就不可逆地決定在 S 期複製其基因組。

label: Cyclin-Dependent Kinase
description: Progression through G1 is driven by cyclin-dependent kinase complexes, principally cyclin D-CDK4/6 and cyclin E-CDK2. Mitogenic signals activate these complexes, which phosphorylate the RB1 tumor suppressor to release E2F and induce S-phase genes.
description_zh_TW: 通過 G1 期的進程由週期蛋白依賴性激酶複合體驅動，主要是 cyclin D-CDK4/6 和 cyclin E-CDK2。促有絲分裂訊號活化這些複合體，磷酸化 RB1 腫瘤抑制因子以釋放 E2F 並誘導 S 期基因。

label: Restriction Point
description: The restriction point (R point) is the commitment point late in G1 after which CDK activity becomes self-sustaining and largely independent of external growth cues. Passage through it commits the cell to a complete round of division.
description_zh_TW: 限制點（R 點）是 G1 後期的承諾點，通過後 CDK 活性變成自我維持，並在很大程度上不依賴外部生長訊號。通過它使細胞承諾完成一整輪分裂。

label: Oncogene Activation
description: Activated oncogenes such as RAS, BRAF, and MYC drive hyperproliferation and replication stress, which in turn elicit oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) as an intrinsic tumor-suppressive failsafe. The unscheduled S-phase entry generates DNA replication stress and DNA damage that stabilize p53 and derepress the CDKN2A/p16INK4a locus, locking cells in arrest. OIS is observed in benign lesions such as melanocytic nevi and is a major barrier to tumor progression. The paradox is that OIS cells secrete a SASP that, while recruiting immune clearance, can also promote tumorigenesis in neighboring cells.
description_zh_TW: 活化的致癌基因如 RAS、BRAF 與 MYC 驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，進而引發致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS），作為一種內在的腫瘤抑制失效安全機制。非預期的 S 期進入產生 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷，穩定 p53 並去抑制 CDKN2A/p16INK4a 位點，將細胞鎖定於停滯。OIS 見於如黑色素細胞痣等良性病灶，是腫瘤進展的主要屏障。其矛盾之處在於，OIS 細胞分泌 SASP，雖能招募免疫清除，也可能促進鄰近細胞的腫瘤發生。

label: HIRA/ASF1a
description: SAHF are assembled by the HIRA-ASF1a histone chaperone complex, which deposits macroH2A and core histones to establish H3K9me3-marked heterochromatin at the foci. This chaperone-driven deposition is required for the formation of the DAPI-dense nuclear bodies that characterize senescent cells, and it is coordinated with hypophosphorylated Rb. The process links histone dynamics directly to senescence-specific chromatin reorganization. HIRA/ASF1a thus provide the assembly machinery for the repressive structures that lock in the arrested state.
description_zh_TW: SAHF 由 HIRA-ASF1a 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體組裝，該複合體沉積 macroH2A 與核心組蛋白以在焦點建立 H3K9me3 標記的異染色質。此伴護蛋白驅動的沉積對形成定義衰老細胞的 DAPI 緻密核體為必要，且與低磷酸化 Rb 協調。此過程將組蛋白動態直接連結到衰老特異性染色質重組。HIRA/ASF1a 因此提供將停滯狀態鎖入的抑制性結構的組裝機器。

label: p16/Rb Pathway
description: The p16INK4a/Rb pathway enforces the long-term, irreversible phase of senescence independently of p53. p16 inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, keeping Rb hypophosphorylated and bound to E2F, thereby preventing expression of S-phase genes; this locks in a durable growth arrest. Unlike the p53/p21 arm, which can be transient, p16/Rb-mediated arrest is typically sustained for the life of the cell and is the stronger correlate of in vivo senescent burden with age. Its engagement is a key determinant of why senescence is considered irreversible rather than a quiescent state.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a/Rb 路徑獨立於 p53 地執行衰老的長期、不可逆階段。p16 抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，使 Rb 維持低磷酸化並結合 E2F，從而阻止 S 期基因表現；這將持久的生長停滯鎖定。與可能短暫的 p53/p21 臂不同，p16/Rb 介導的停滯通常維持細胞終生，且是體內衰老負擔隨年齡更強的相關因子。其啟動是衰老被視為不可逆而非靜止狀態的關鍵決定因素。

label: p53/p21 Pathway
description: The p53/p21 axis is a primary enforcement mechanism of senescence, especially in damage- and stress-induced forms. DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 inhibits cyclin E/A-CDK2, preventing phosphorylation of Rb and blocking S-phase entry. This pathway provides a rapid, p53-dose-dependent G1/S arrest that can be engaged acutely after genotoxic insult. A caveat is that the p53 pathway is frequently disabled in cancer, and p53 also restrains the SASP, so its loss reshapes rather than simply abolishes senescence.
description_zh_TW: p53/p21 軸是衰老的主要執行機制，尤其在損傷與壓力誘發的形式中。DNA 損傷穩定 p53，後者轉錄誘導 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 抑制 cyclin E/A-CDK2，阻止 Rb 磷酸化並阻斷 S 期進入。此路徑提供快速、依賴 p53 劑量的 G1/S 停滯，可在基因毒性傷害後立即啟動。需注意，p53 路徑在癌症中常被失能，且 p53 也會抑制 SASP，因此其缺失是重塑而非單純廢除衰老。

label: Sodium Butyrate
description: Sodium butyrate (HDAC inhibitor) induces senescence-like state via p21 upregulation, which can be both p53-dependent and independent.
description_zh_TW: Sodium butyrate（HDAC 抑制劑）透過 p21 上調誘發類衰老狀態，可為 p53 依賴或非依賴。

label: Executioner Caspase
description: Executioner caspases are the terminal proteases of the apoptotic cascade that dismantle the cell. In aging, senescent-cell resistance to executioner-caspase killing via SCAPs is a barrier to senescent-cell clearance, linking executioner-caspase biology to senescence persistence.
description_zh_TW: 執行型 caspase 是分解細胞的細胞凋亡級聯末端蛋白酶。在衰老中，衰老細胞經由 SCAPs 對執行型 caspase 殺傷的抵抗是衰老細胞清除的障礙，將執行型 caspase 生物學與衰老持續相連結。

label: HPLC
description: A compound with the same retention time as adrenochrome on HPLC was detected in a biological fluid rich in neutrophils, providing chromatographic evidence that the adrenochrome pathway can operate in vivo. High-performance liquid chromatography is the analytical technique used to separate and identify adrenochrome on the basis of its characteristic retention behavior, and this detection in a neutrophil-rich fluid is among the strongest indications that the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome occurs in biological contexts. Despite such observations, the authors note that adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids by an established method, highlighting both the technical challenge of measuring this short-lived, unstable molecule and the ongoing controversy about its clinical significance in stress-induced heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在一富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中，偵測到一個與腎上腺素紅在 HPLC 上具有相同滯留時間的化合物，提供了腎上腺素紅途徑可在體內運作的色譜學證據。高效液相色譜法是根據其特徵性滯留行為來分離並鑑定腎上腺素紅的分析技術，而在此富含中性粒細胞的液體中偵測到該物質，是腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺素紅發生於生物學情境中最有力的指標之一。儘管有此類觀察結果，作者指出腎上腺素紅從未以既 established 方法在生物液體中被偵測到，突顯了測量此種短壽命、不穩定分子的技術挑戰，以及其在壓力誘發心臟疾病中臨床意義的持續爭議。

label: Neuromelanin formation
description: Adrenochrome and related aminochromes serve as intermediates in the synthesis of neuromelanin, the dark pigment that accumulates in catecholaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra and locus coeruleus. When catecholamines such as dopamine, norepinephrine, and adrenaline are oxidized, they generate reactive quinones and aminochromes that polymerize into melanin-like pigments. In the brain, this process is tied to iron- and metal-catalyzed autoxidation, and the oxidative metabolism of catecholamines into quinone compounds contributes to the age-dependent buildup of neuromelanin. Adrenochrome-like structures are thus chemically upstream of neuromelanin formation, with neuromelanin granules accumulating progressively from birth to middle-to-late adulthood.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 及相關的 aminochromes 是 neuromelanin 合成的中間產物，neuromelanin 是一種深色色素，會堆積在 substantia nigra 與 locus coeruleus 的兒茶酚胺能神經元中。當 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 adrenaline 等兒茶酚胺被氧化時，會產生具反應性的 quinones 與 aminochromes，並聚合成類黑色素色素。在大腦中，此過程與鐵及金屬催化的自氧化有關，而兒茶酚胺氧化代謝成 quinone 化合物，促成了 neuromelanin 隨年齡增長的堆積。因此，adrenochrome-like 結構在化學上位於 neuromelanin 形成上游，neuromelanin 顆粒從出生到中晚年持續漸進堆積。

description: Adrenochrome has a computed XLogP3-AA partition coefficient of -1.3, indicating that the molecule is substantially more hydrophilic than lipophilic. The negative logP value arises from the polar indoline-5,6-dione core with its two carbonyl oxygens, one hydroxyl group, and four hydrogen bond acceptors, giving adrenochrome limited ability to partition into lipid membranes. This water solubility is consistent with its behavior as a blood- and tissue-dissolved oxidation product of the hydrophilic catecholamine epinephrine rather than a membrane-accumulating species. The polarity also shapes its toxicology: adrenochrome remains in aqueous compartments such as serum and cytosol where it can encounter proteins, DNA, and small-molecule nucleophiles. The low partition coefficient is relevant to questions about whether and where the compound can form and persist in biological fluids.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的計算 XLogP3-AA 分配係數為 -1.3，表明該分子明顯更具親水性而非親脂性。負 logP 值源於極性 indoline-5,6-dione 核心，其兩個羰基氧、一個羥基和四個氫鍵受體，使 adrenochrome 分配到脂質膜的能力有限。這種水溶性與其作為親水性兒茶酚胺腎上腺素的血液和組織溶解氧化產物的行為一致，而非膜累積物種。極性也塑造了其毒理學：adrenochrome 保留在血清和細胞質等水性區室中，在那裡它可以遇到蛋白質、DNA 和小分子親核試劑。低分配係數與該化合物是否以及在何處可以在生物液體中形成和持續存在的問題相關。

label: 179.17 g/mol
description: Adrenochrome has a molecular weight of 179.17 g/mol, computed by PubChem for the formula C9H9NO3. This relatively low molecular mass places adrenochrome among small bioactive molecules that can diffuse through tissues and interact with intracellular targets. The mass is consistent with the monoisotopic value of 179.0582 Da and reflects the compact indoline-5,6-dione scaffold assembled from the oxidation and cyclization of epinephrine. As a small, polar electrophile, adrenochrome's mass underlies its ability to cross cell membranes, reach nuclear DNA, and form covalent adducts with proteins, contributing to its documented toxicity. Knowledge of its molecular weight is also essential for analytical detection by HPLC and mass spectrometry, methods that have been used to search for adrenochrome in biological fluids.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的分子量為 179.17 g/mol，由 PubChem 根據分子式 C9H9NO3 計算得出。這種相對較低的分子質量使 adrenochrome 屬於可以擴散穿過組織並與細胞內靶標相互作用的小型生物活性分子。該質量與單一同位素值 179.0582 Da 一致，反映了由腎上腺素氧化和環化組裝而成的緊密 indoline-5,6-dione 骨架。作為小型、極性親電試劑，adrenochrome 的質量是其穿越細胞膜、到達核 DNA 並與蛋白質形成共價加合物的基礎，導致其已記錄的毒性。了解其分子量對於通過 HPLC 和質譜進行分析檢測也至關重要，這些方法已被用於在生物液體中搜索 adrenochrome。

label: Coronary artery constriction
description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, and one of its documented cardiovascular effects is constriction of the coronary arteries. Along with cell necrosis and arrhythmias, coronary artery constriction links adrenochrome to impaired blood supply to the heart muscle and thereby to the pathology of stress-induced heart disease. The vasoconstrictive action of this adrenaline oxidation product is consistent with the broader biology of catecholamine oxidation, where reactive quinone species exert direct effects on vascular smooth muscle. These findings are significant in the context of the adrenochrome pathway because oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome, potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 已知 Adrenochrome 具有心臟毒性，其已記錄的心血管作用之一是冠狀動脈收縮。除了細胞壞死和心律不整外，冠狀動脈收縮將 Adrenochrome 與心肌血液供應受損連結起來，進而與壓力性心臟疾病的病理相關。這種 adrenaline 氧化產物的血管收縮作用與 catecholamine 氧化的更廣泛生物學一致，其中活性醌類物種對血管平滑肌產生直接作用。這些發現在 Adrenochrome 途徑的背景下具有重要意義，因為浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性白血球產生的氧自由基可驅動 adrenaline 氧化為 Adrenochrome， potentially converting an elevated catecholamine state into a vasoconstrictive, cardiotoxic insult during infarction and inflammation.

label: Arrhythmias
description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing arrhythmias among its effects on the heart. The capacity of this oxidation product of adrenaline to disturb cardiac electrical activity, together with its induction of cell necrosis and coronary artery constriction, has made it a candidate mediator of stress-induced heart disease. Arrhythmias are proposed to arise because adrenochrome, as a reactive quinone, modifies cardiac proteins and disrupts the ionic and signaling machinery of cardiomyocytes. These effects are relevant to the hypothesis that when stimulated neutrophils produce oxygen radicals that oxidize adrenaline through the adrenochrome pathway, the resulting cardiotoxic products could contribute to the electrical instability observed after myocardial infarction, although the in vivo significance remains controversial because adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome已被證實具有心臟毒性，其對心臟的影響包括心律不齊。這種腎上腺素氧化產物干擾心臟電活動的能力，加上其誘發細胞壞死和冠狀動脈收縮的作用，使其成為壓力性心臟病的候選介導因子。心律不齊的產生被認為是因為adrenochrome作為一種活性醌類，修飾心臟蛋白並破壞心肌細胞的離子與訊號傳導機制。這些效應與以下假說相關：當受刺激的中性白血球產生氧自由基，透過adrenochrome pathway氧化腎上腺素時，所產生的心臟毒性產物可能促成心肌梗塞後觀察到的電不穩定性，但其體內意義仍具爭議性，因為adrenochrome從未在生物液體中被偵測到。

label: Cell necrosis
description: Adrenochrome has been shown to be cardiotoxic, causing cell necrosis as one of its principal effects on cardiac tissue. Alongside arrhythmias and coronary artery constriction, the induction of cell necrosis demonstrates that adrenochrome is not merely an inert pigment but a cytologically damaging oxidation product of adrenaline. The necrotic cell death it triggers is consistent with its behavior as a reactive electrophilic quinone that forms covalent adducts with proteins and DNA, disrupting cellular function. These toxic effects provide the rationale for investigating the adrenochrome pathway in stress-induced heart disease, where oxygen radicals produced by stimulated neutrophils infiltrating the myocardium can drive adrenaline oxidation, potentially converting an excess of the catecholamine into a locally necrotizing species in the heart.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome已知具有心臟毒性，導致細胞壞死為其對心臟組織的主要效應之一。除心律不齊和冠狀動脈收縮外，細胞壞死的誘導表明adrenochrome不僅僅是一種惰性色素，而是腎上腺素的細胞毒性氧化產物。其觸發的壞死性細胞死亡與其作為活性親電醌的行為一致，該醌可與蛋白質和DNA形成共價加合物，擾亂細胞功能。這些毒性效應提供了研究adrenochrome途徑在壓力誘發之心臟疾病中的依據，其中浸潤心肌的活化嗜中性球所產生的氧自由基可驅動腎上腺素氧化， potentially將過量的兒茶酚胺轉化為心臟局部壞死性物種。

label: C9H9NO3
description: Adrenochrome has the molecular formula C9H9NO3, corresponding to nine carbon atoms, nine hydrogen atoms, one nitrogen atom, and three oxygen atoms, with a computed molecular weight of 179.17 g/mol and a monoisotopic mass of 179.0582 Da. The three oxygen atoms reflect the two carbonyl groups of the quinone ring (the 5,6-dione) and a single hydroxyl group at the 3-position of the indoline ring. The single nitrogen atom is the methylated amine that becomes part of the five-membered ring after epinephrine cyclizes. With one hydrogen bond donor and four hydrogen bond acceptors and no rotatable bonds, the formula describes a rigid, compact, oxygen-rich heterocycle whose composition is consistent across PubChem identifiers CID 5898, ChEMBL1314174, and CHEBI:166544. These structural parameters explain adrenochrome's high polarity and reactivity as an electrophilic quinone.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的分子式為 C9H9NO3，對應九個碳原子、九個氫原子、一個氮原子和三個氧原子，計算分子量為 179.17 g/mol，單一同位素質量為 179.0582 Da。三個氧原子反映了醌環（5,6-二酮）的兩個羰基和吲哚啉環 3 位的一個羥基。單個氮原子是甲基化胺，在腎上腺素環化後成為五元環的一部分。具有一個氫鍵供體和四個氫鍵受體且無可旋轉鍵，該分子式描述了一個剛性、緊密、富氧的雜環，其組成在 PubChem 標識符 CID 5898、ChEMBL1314174 和 CHEBI:166544 中一致。這些結構參數解釋了 adrenochrome 作為親電醌的高極性和反應性。

label: oxidation product of epinephrine
description: Adrenochrome is a chemical compound formed by the oxidation of epinephrine (adrenaline), a catecholamine stress hormone. In humans it arises as a minor oxidative metabolite or byproduct rather than through a dedicated biosynthetic pathway. Oxidation converts the catechol ring of adrenaline to an o-quinone followed by internal cyclization to an indoline-5,6-dione structure. This process occurs in vivo, driven by reactive oxygen species such as superoxide anion and hydrogen peroxide, and in vitro. Because the reaction competes with the primary COMT and MAO degradation routes, adrenochrome formation becomes more prominent under oxidative stress, inflammation, and conditions where adrenaline levels are high, and it is considered a marker of failed homeostasis rather than a normal abundant product.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是由兒茶酚胺壓力荷爾蒙 epinephrine（adrenaline）氧化形成的化學化合物。在人體中，它是作為次要的氧化代謝物或副產物出現，而非透過專一的生物合成途徑。氧化將腎上腺素的兒茶酚環轉化為 o-quinone，隨後內部環化形成 indoline-5,6-dione 結構。此過程在體內由超氧陰離子與過氧化氫等活性氧物種驅動，亦發生於體外。由於此反應與主要的 COMT 與 MAO 降解途徑競爭，adrenochrome 形成在氧化壓力、發炎以及腎上腺素濃度高的情況下更為顯著，且被視為恆定失調的標記，而非正常的豐富產物。

label: Indoles
description: Adrenochrome is a cyclic amino ketone pigment classified as a member of indoles. It bears the core indoline-5,6-dione scaffold, a fused bicyclic ring system derived from the cyclized catecholamine backbone. This indole classification reflects adrenochrome's origin as an oxidation product of the catecholamine epinephrine, whose benzene ring and amine side chain fold into a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring during intramolecular cyclization. As an indole quinone, adrenochrome sits at the intersection of catecholamine and pigment biochemistry, connecting the chemistry of adrenaline to downstream reactive electrophiles. Its indole structure underlies both its characteristic pink color and its tendency to undergo further reactions, including polymerization into melanins. This classification is central to understanding adrenochrome's behavior as an electron-deficient quinone that forms adducts with cellular nucleophiles.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是一種環狀胺基酮色素，被歸類為吲哚類成員。它具有核心的 indoline-5,6-dione 骨架，這是一個源自環化兒茶酚胺骨架的融合雙環系統。這種吲哚分類反映了 Adrenochrome 作為兒茶酚胺腎上腺素的氧化產物的起源，其苯環和胺側鏈在分子內環化過程中摺疊成含氮的五元環。作為吲哚醌，Adrenochrome 位於兒茶酚胺和色素生物化學的交匯處，將腎上腺素的化學與下游反應性親電試劑聯繫起來。其吲哚結構是其特徵性粉紅色和傾向於進一步反應（包括聚合成黑色素）的基礎。這種分類對於理解 Adrenochrome 作為電子缺陷醌與細胞親核試劑形成加合物的行為至關重要。

label: Electrophile
description: Adrenochrome is a highly reactive electrophile, an electron-poor species that seeks electrons from other molecules. As a quinone, its electron-deficient carbonyl system readily bonds with nucleophilic sites on proteins, DNA, and other cellular structures, forming covalent adducts, and this reactivity is why the molecule is considered toxic to cells. The electrophilic character also drives adrenochrome's self-reactivity: it rapidly polymerizes into melanin pigments rather than persisting in solution. This electron-poor nature is the mechanistic basis for adrenochrome's reported cardiotoxic effects, including cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction, because covalent modification of cellular macromolecules disrupts their function. Electrophilicity therefore unifies adrenochrome's instability, its adduct-forming toxicity, and its position as the central reactive intermediate of the adrenaline oxidation pathway.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺素紅是一種高活性的親電體，一種電子缺乏的物質，會從其他分子中尋求電子。作為一種醌類，其電子缺乏的羰基系統容易與蛋白質、DNA 及其他細胞結構上的親核位點結合，形成共價加合物，而這種反應活性正是該分子被認為對細胞具有毒性的原因。其親電特性也驅動了腎上腺素紅的自我反應性：它會迅速聚合形成黑色素顏料，而非在溶液中持續存在。這種電子缺乏的特性是腎上腺素紅所報告的心臟毒性效應的機制基礎，包括細胞壞死、心律不整和冠狀動脈收縮，因為對細胞大分子的共價修飾會破壞其功能。因此，親電性將腎上腺素紅的不穩定性、其形成加合物的毒性，以及其作為腎上腺素氧化途徑中核心反應中間體的地位統一起來。

label: Pigment
description: Adrenochrome is a pigment obtained by the oxidation of epinephrine, exhibiting a characteristic pink-to-red color in aqueous solution that has been recognized since its first description in 1856. The pink color results from the conjugated indoline-5,6-dione chromophore that forms when the catecholamine ring is oxidized and cyclized. As a pigment, adrenochrome is an intermediate in the melanin pathway, because its further polymerization produces dark brown and black melanin pigments; the visible reddening of adrenaline solutions left exposed to air is the classic demonstration of this chemistry. Beyond its color, the pigment identity connects adrenochrome to histochemical and forensic contexts, where oxidation products of catecholamines are used as stains, and to pathology, where it represents an oxidative transformation of adrenaline linked to cellular damage.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 是一種通過腎上腺素氧化獲得的色素，在水溶液中呈現特徵性的粉紅至紅色，自 1856 年首次描述以來已被認識。粉紅色源於共軛的 indoline-5,6-dione 發色團，該發色團在兒茶酚胺環氧化和環化時形成。作為色素，adrenochrome 是黑色素途徑中的中間體，因為其進一步聚合產生深棕色和黑色黑色素；暴露於空氣中的腎上腺素溶液可見的變紅是這種化學反應的經典演示。除了顏色之外，色素身份將 adrenochrome 與組織化學和法醫學背景聯繫起來，在那裡兒茶酚胺的氧化產物用作染色劑，並與病理學聯繫起來，在那裡它代表與細胞損傷相關的腎上腺素氧化轉化。

label: Minutes to hours
description: Adrenochrome is a very unstable molecule in aqueous solution, with a half-life ranging from minutes to hours depending on temperature, pH, and the presence of nucleophiles. The instability arises because adrenochrome is a highly reactive electrophilic quinone that rapidly undergoes further reactions, principally polymerization into melanins and covalent adduct formation with proteins and DNA. This transience is a central reason why adrenochrome has proven difficult to detect in biological fluids despite decades of interest in its possible role in disease: it does not persist long enough to accumulate. The short half-life also frames the clinical controversy around the compound, since any effect it exerts must occur quickly after formation, and its fleeting nature makes measurement of the relevant intermediate states technically challenging.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在水溶液中是一種極不穩定的分子，其半衰期依溫度、pH 值及親核試體的存在與否，從數分鐘到數小時不等。此不穩定性源於 adrenochrome 是一種高反應性的親電醌，會迅速進行進一步反應，主要是聚合成 melanins 以及與蛋白質和 DNA 形成共價加合物。這種短暫性正是儘管數十年來對其在疾病中的潛在角色感興趣，adrenochrome 仍難以在生物液體中檢測出的核心原因：它存在時間不足以累積。短半衰期也構成了該化合物周圍的臨床爭議，因為其任何效應都必須在形成後迅速發生，而其轉瞬即逝的特性使得相關中間狀態的測量在技術上具挑戰性。

label: Acute oral toxicity
description: Adrenochrome is classified under the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) with hazard statement H302, meaning it is harmful if swallowed, with acute oral toxicity category 4 (Acute Tox. 4, 100% of notifications). The signal word is Warning with an irritant pictogram. This regulatory classification reflects experimental evidence that ingestion of adrenochrome can produce adverse effects, complementing mechanistic studies showing that adrenochrome, as an electrophilic quinone, readily forms covalent adducts with proteins and DNA and is cardiotoxic, capable of causing cell necrosis, arrhythmias, and coronary artery constriction. The GHS designation provides a formal toxicological endpoint that supports the view of adrenochrome as a biologically reactive molecule rather than an inert pigment, though its clinical significance in human disease remains debated.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 根據全球統一分類系統 (GHS) 被分類，具有危險性說明 H302，意味著吞食有害，具有急性口服毒性類別 4（急性毒性 4，100% 通知）。信號詞為警告，帶有刺激性象形圖。這種監管分類反映了攝入 adrenochrome 可能產生不良反應的實驗證據，補充了機制研究，表明 adrenochrome 作為親電醌易於與蛋白質和 DNA 形成共價加合物，並具有心臟毒性，可導致細胞壞死、心律失常和冠狀動脈收縮。GHS 指定提供了一個正式的毒理學終點，支持將 adrenochrome 視為生物反應性分子而非惰性色素的觀點，儘管其在人類疾病中的臨床意義仍有爭議。

label: Aqueous solutions at physiological pH
description: Adrenochrome is highly unstable in aqueous solutions at physiological pH, rapidly polymerizing into neuromelanin-like compounds. This chemical instability is a critical translational challenge because it makes formulating adrenochrome or its derivatives to achieve a controlled, targeted therapeutic window in vivo extremely difficult. The rapid polymerization also means that observed biological effects of adrenochrome preparations may be confounded by the presence of its polymeric breakdown products, complicating both mechanistic studies and any proposed use as a senotherapeutic agent.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在生理 pH 的水溶液中高度不穩定，會快速聚合形成類似 neuromelanin 的化合物。這種化學不穩定性是一個關鍵的轉譯挑戰，因為它使得製劑 adrenochrome 或其衍生物以在體內實現受控、靶向的治療窗口極其困難。快速聚合也意味著 adrenochrome 製劑觀察到的生物效應可能因其聚合分解產物的存在而混淆，使機制研究和任何擬議作為 senotherapeutic agent 的用途變得複雜。

label: Melanins
description: Adrenochrome is inherently very unstable and, as a highly reactive electrophile, rapidly undergoes further reactions once formed. Chief among these is polymerization: adrenochrome molecules condense together to produce melanins, the black and brown pigments responsible for the darkening of oxidized adrenaline solutions and related to the pigment chemistry of skin and hair. This polymerization is part of why adrenochrome has only a fleeting existence in aqueous solution, with a half-life ranging from minutes to hours depending on temperature, pH, and the presence of nucleophiles. The melanin-forming instability also means that adrenochrome sits on the oxidative pathway connecting catecholamines to the pigment melanin, linking adrenaline oxidation to pigmentation biochemistry and to the tissue discoloration seen in oxidized catecholamine environments.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 本質上非常不穩定，作為高活性親電體，一旦形成便迅速進行進一步反應。其中最主要的是聚合反應：Adrenochrome 分子相互凝縮產生 melanin（黑色素），這是導致氧化 adrenaline 溶液變黑變棕的色素，與皮膚和毛髮的色素化學相關。這種聚合反應是 adrenochrome 在水溶液中僅能短暫存在的原因之一，其半衰期依溫度、pH 值及親核試體的存在與否，從數分鐘到數小時不等。形成 melanin 的不穩定性也意味著 adrenochrome 位於連接 catecholamine 與色素 melanin 的氧化途徑上，將 adrenaline 的氧化與色素生成生物化學，以及在氧化 catecholamine 環境中所見的組織變色連結起來。

label: Hydrazines
description: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid structure and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines, e.g., aminoguanidine, semicarbazide, phenylhydrazine, o-nitrophenylhydrazine, p-nitrophenylhydrazine, and 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. These hydrazine derivatives serve both for the stabilization of adrenochrome and for the preparation of useful medicines such as hemostatics. The stabilization treatment is generally conducted for 30 minutes to 3 hours at a temperature of 0 to 15 degrees C.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與肼類（如胺基胍、氨基硫脲、苯肼、鄰硝基苯肼、對硝基苯肼和2,4-二硝基苯肼）的常規衍生化來穩定。這些肼衍生物既用於穩定腎上腺紅，也用於製備如止血劑等實用藥物。穩定化處理通常在0至15°C下進行30分鐘至3小時。

label: Guanylhydrazone
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM), historically known as S-Adchnon or adrenochrome guanylhydrazone, is formed by reacting adrenochrome, an oxidation product of epinephrine containing an indoline-5,6-dione core, with aminoguanidine, a nucleophilic hydrazine derivative. The reaction forms a stable guanylhydrazone linkage at one of the carbonyl groups of the dione structure. AMM therefore combines a redox-active indoline core with an established anti-glycation agent, providing a dual-action glyco-oxidative modulator designed to simultaneously target oxidative stress and protein crosslinking by advanced glycation end products.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM），歷史上稱為 S-Adchnon 或 adrenochrome guanylhydrazone，是由含 indoline-5,6-dione 核心的腎上腺素氧化產物 adrenochrome，與親核性肼衍生物 aminoguanidine 反應形成。該反應在二酮結構的其中一個羰基上形成穩定的 guanylhydrazone 連結。因此，AMM 將具氧化還原活性的 indoline 核心與既有的抗糖化劑結合，提供一種雙重作用的糖氧化調節劑，旨在同時標靶氧化壓力與晚期糖化終產物所引發的蛋白質交聯。

label: Michael addition
description: Aminochromes are strong electrophiles capable of reacting with nucleophilic sulfhydryl (cysteine) groups on cellular proteins via Michael addition. This covalent modification is the proposed senomorphic mechanism: by alkylating critical cysteine residues on regulators such as IKK and the p65 subunit of NF-κB, adrenochrome could permanently inhibit NF-κB signaling and blunt transcription of SASP factors like IL-6 and IL-8. The same thiol-reactivity underlies aminochrome toxicity through adduct formation with proteins such as alpha-synuclein.
description_zh_TW: 氨基色素是強親電體，能通過麥克爾加成與細胞蛋白質上的親核硫氫基（半胱氨酸）反應。這種共價修飾是假定的衰老模仿機制：通過烷基化調節因子如IKK和NF-κB的p65亞基上的關鍵半胱氨酸殘基，腎上腺素色素可能永久抑制NF-κB信號並削弱IL-6和IL-8等SASP因子的轉錄。相同的硫醇反應性奠定了氨基色素通過與α-突觸核蛋白等蛋白質形成加合物的毒性。

label: IKK complex
description: Aminochromes such as adrenochrome can covalently modify the IKK complex (IkappaB kinase), a key upstream activator of NF-kappaB, via Michael addition to critical cysteine residues. IKK relies on cysteine residues for its activation, so alkylation would impair its kinase function and prevent phosphorylation-dependent activation of NF-kappaB. By disabling this upstream regulator, low concentrations of adrenochrome are hypothesized to suppress NF-kappaB-driven SASP transcription, shifting the senescent cell into a less inflammatory, senomorphic state rather than killing it outright.
description_zh_TW: 氨基色素如腎上腺素色素可通過麥克爾加成共價修飾IKK複合物（IκB激酶），NF-κB的關鍵上游激活因子，針對關鍵半胱氨酸殘基。IKK依賴半胱氨酸殘基進行激活，因此烷基化會損害其激酶功能並阻止NF-κB的磷酸化依賴性激活。通過禁用此上游調節因子，假定低濃度的腎上腺素色素抑制NF-κB驅動的SASP轉錄，將衰老細胞轉變為較少炎症的衰老模仿狀態，而非直接殺死。

label: Biological fluids
description: Despite decades of interest in the adrenochrome pathway, adrenochrome has never been detected in biological fluids, and no established method for its formation in vivo has been demonstrated; this is the central reason the clinical significance of the compound remains controversial. The difficulty of detection is consistent with the molecule's chemical properties, including its instability and short half-life in aqueous solution, its rapid polymerization into melanins, and its reactivity with proteins and DNA, all of which would prevent accumulation. The strongest evidence for in vivo formation is indirect, such as the detection of a compound with the same HPLC retention time as adrenochrome in a biological fluid rich in neutrophils and the presence of oxidase activity in serum after myocardial infarction. Its apparent absence from biological fluids, however, has fueled skepticism about whether the pathway is truly significant in human disease.
description_zh_TW: 儘管數十年來對 adrenochrome 途徑感興趣，adrenochrome 從未在生物液體中被檢測到，也尚未建立證明其在體內形成的既成方法；這是該化合物臨床意義仍具爭議性的核心原因。檢測的困難與該分子的化學性質一致，包括其在水溶液中的不穩定性與短半衰期、迅速聚合成 melanins，以及對蛋白質和 DNA 的反應性，這些都會阻止其累積。體內形成最強的證據是間接的，例如在富含中性粒細胞的生物液體中檢測到與 adrenochrome 具有相同 HPLC 滯留時間的化合物，以及心肌梗塞後血清中出現氧化酶活性。然而，它明顯不存在於生物液體中，助長了對該途徑是否在人類疾病中真正重要的懷疑。

label: 495 nm wavelength
description: During the oxidation of adrenaline, the reaction mixture is tinged with purplish red due to the production of adrenochrome, and its color becomes deeper with increasing adrenochrome content. The reaction is continued until the absorbance at a wavelength of 495 nm, measured by sampling the reaction mixture at an appropriate time, reaches a maximum, at which point further oxidation of the product is minimized and adrenochrome is obtained in maximum yield. The reaction time required for maximum yield varies from 30 to 45 minutes depending on the temperature of the reaction mixture and the level of catalyst employed.
description_zh_TW: 在腎上腺素氧化過程中，反應混合物因腎上腺紅的生成而呈紫紅色，且隨腎上腺紅含量增加而顏色加深。反應持續進行，直到於適當時間取樣反應混合物所測得的495 nm波長吸光度達到最大值，此時產物的進一步氧化降至最低，並以最大產率獲得腎上腺紅。達到最大產率所需的反應時間為30至45分鐘不等，取決於反應混合物的溫度和所用催化劑的量。

label: Prodrug
description: For adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine to act as an active AGE inhibitor despite its hydrazine group being locked in a hydrazone bond, it must either retain sufficient nucleophilicity through its remaining guanidine nitrogens, act as a prodrug that undergoes controlled in vivo hydrolysis to slowly release free aminoguanidine, or work via alternative pathways such as chelating transition metals that catalyze glycoxidation. The prodrug hypothesis is plausible because the conjugate is stable for clinical use yet could hydrolyze to release aminoguanidine over time. Whether the bound aminoguanidine retains dicarbonyl-scavenging activity remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 儘管 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 的肼基被鎖定在腙鍵中，要作為活性 AGE 抑制劑，它必須透過剩餘的胍氮保留足夠的親核性、作為前藥在體內經受控水解以緩慢釋出游離 aminoguanidine，或經由螯合催化糖氧化的過渡金屬等替代途徑作用。前藥假說是合理的，因為該共軛物在臨床上穩定可用，但隨時間可能水解釋出 aminoguanidine。被結合的 aminoguanidine 是否保留二羰基清除活性仍懸而未決。

label: Metabolic waste
description: In the chemistry of catecholamine handling, the main route is a clean enzymatic process in which MAO and COMT specifically target adrenaline, process it, and prepare it for excretion, keeping blood pressure and heart rate controlled. The adrenochrome pathway, by contrast, is a side pathway that essentially produces metabolic waste: adrenochrome is a chemical mishap formed when the body's antioxidant defenses are failing and epinephrine oxidizes on its own. Adrenochrome is therefore not a purposeful catabolite but an incidental oxidation product whose formation is considered undesirable because of the molecule's electrophilic reactivity toward proteins and DNA. Viewing adrenochrome as metabolic waste frames it as a failure marker of homeostasis whose accumulation is linked to oxidative stress, rather than a regulated product of normal catecholamine metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 在兒茶酚胺處理的化學中，主要途徑是一個乾淨的酵素過程，其中 MAO 和 COMT 專一地標靶 adrenaline，處理它並為排泄做準備，從而控制血壓和心率。相對地，adrenochrome 途徑是一條側路，本質上產生代謝廢物：adrenochrome 是當身體抗氧化防禦失效、epinephrine 自行氧化時所形成的化學意外。因此，adrenochrome 並非有目的的分解代謝物，而是一種偶發的氧化產物，其形成被視為不可取，因為該分子對蛋白質和 DNA 具有親電反應性。將 adrenochrome 視為代謝廢物，使其成為恆定性失敗的標記，其累積與氧化壓力相關，而非正常兒茶酚胺代謝的受調節產物。

label: Reference standard
description: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control. Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use. Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air, manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products, and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control。Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use。Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air，manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products，and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies。

label: Impurity marker
description: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies. HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability, since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments. Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe, and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome serves as a key impurity marker in epinephrine quality control and forced degradation studies。HPLC methods monitor it alongside adrenochrome to ensure formulation stability，since leuco-adrenochrome is an intermediate in the oxidative degradation of epinephrine to adrenochrome and ultimately to melanin-like brown pigments。Tracking these oxidation products allows manufacturers to detect degradation before the drug becomes unsafe，and discolored epinephrine solutions (colorless to pink to brown) are a visible sign of impurity accumulation that signals the solution should not be used clinically。

label: NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase
description: NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase performs the one-electron reduction of aminochrome ortho-quinones such as adrenochrome, generating highly unstable semiquinone radicals. These radicals rapidly transfer their electron to molecular oxygen, producing superoxide anion and regenerating the parent quinone in a redox cycle. This enzyme-initiated reduction is the entry point for aminochrome-driven oxidative stress that is hypothesized to selectively push already-ROS-elevated senescent cells into apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: NADPH-細胞色素P450還原酶執行氨基色素鄰醌如腎上腺素色素的單電子還原，產生高度不穩定的半醌自由基。這些自由基迅速將其電子轉移到分子氧，產生超氧陰離子並在氧化還原循環中再生母體醌。此酶啟動的還原是氨基色素驅動的氧化應激的入口點，假定選擇性地將已ROS升高的衰老細胞推入凋亡。

label: Rheumatoid synovial fluid
description: Researchers have detected adrenochrome-like compounds in neutrophil-rich fluids such as synovial fluid from rheumatoid arthritis patients, where neutrophil activation and ROS release are prominent. This suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine oxidation in inflammatory or stress-related conditions, and one study proposed it as a potential catabolic route for adrenaline in inflammatory diseases. Adrenochrome detected in such fluids reflects local oxidation of catecholamines at sites of inflammation, consistent with the observation that cell-free medium from activated neutrophils retains adrenaline-oxidizing ability.
description_zh_TW: Researchers已在neutrophil-rich fluids中，例如rheumatoid arthritis患者的synovial fluid，detected adrenochrome-like compounds，此處neutrophil activation與ROS release顯著。這suggests a role for neutrophil-mediated catecholamine oxidation in inflammatory或stress-related conditions，且有一項study proposed它可能是inflammatory diseases中adrenaline的potential catabolic route。在此類fluids中detected的adrenochrome reflects inflammation部位catecholamines的local oxidation，consistent with the observation that activated neutrophils的cell-free medium retains adrenaline-oxidizing ability。

label: Semicarbazide
description: Semicarbazide reacts with adrenochrome to form adrenochrome monosemicarbazone (carbazochrome), a hemostatic agent. In the patented process, semicarbazide hydrochloride is added to the adrenochrome solution at below 10 degrees C in the presence of a potassium acetate buffer, with the stabilization carried out at pH 5 to 7. The reaction yields about 40.0 g of crude powder that is purified by dissolving in dilute sodium hydroxide, active carbon treatment, and precipitation at pH 5.5, and the purified product shows an ultraviolet absorption maximum at 354 nm and characteristic infrared absorptions matching those of an authentic sample.
description_zh_TW: 氨基硫脲與腎上腺紅反應形成腎上腺紅單縮氨脲（carbazochrome），一種止血劑。在該專利方法中，於低於10°C下、在醋酸鉀緩衝液存在下將鹽酸氨基硫脲加入腎上腺紅溶液中，穩定化在pH 5至7下進行。反應產生約40.0 g粗粉末，經溶於稀氫氧化鈉、活性碳處理及在pH 5.5下沉澱純化，純化後的產物呈現354 nm的紫外線吸收極大值，以及與標準品相符的特徵紅外線吸收。

label: 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione
description: The IUPAC name of adrenochrome is 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione, which encodes the complete structure of the molecule: an indole (indoline) bicyclic core, a hydroxyl group at the 3-position, an N-methyl group on the ring nitrogen, and two ketone carbonyls at the 5- and 6-positions of the benzo ring. The 5,6-dione motif makes adrenochrome a quinone, while the 3-hydroxyl and N-methyl groups are the vestiges of the epinephrine side chain after oxidative cyclization. Alternative names such as indoline-5,6-dione refer to the same compound. The name captures the duality of adrenochrome: a rigid indole ring system that is simultaneously an electron-deficient quinone, explaining both its stability within the indole class and its electrophilic reactivity toward biological nucleophiles.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的 IUPAC 名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydroindole-5,6-dione，它編碼了分子的完整結構：一個吲哚（吲哚啉）雙環核心，3 位的一個羥基，環氮上的 N-甲基，以及苯環 5 和 6 位的兩個酮羰基。5,6-二酮基序使 adrenochrome 成為醌，而 3-羥基和 N-甲基是氧化環化後腎上腺素側鏈的殘留物。替代名稱如 indoline-5,6-dione 指的是同一種化合物。該名稱捕捉了 adrenochrome 的雙重性：一個剛性的吲哚環系統，同時是電子缺陷醌，解釋了其在吲哚類中的穩定性及其對生物親核試劑的親電反應性。

label: indoline-5,6-dione
description: Adrenochrome is chemically an indoline-5,6-dione, formally 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione. The molecule features a fused bicyclic system in which a six-membered benzene ring (oxidized to a quinone at positions 5 and 6) is fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring bearing a hydroxy substituent and an N-methyl group. This structure arises when oxidized epinephrine undergoes intramolecular cyclization, in which the side-chain nitrogen attacks the electrophilic o-quinone ring (a Michael addition), closing the second ring. The quinone moiety and its o-quinone character account for much of adrenochrome's reactivity, including its ability to undergo redox cycling and one-electron reduction to the semiquinone radical.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在化學上是 indoline-5,6-dione，正式名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione。該分子具有融合雙環系統，其中一個六元苯環（於第 5 與第 6 位氧化為醌）與一個帶有羥基取代基與 N-甲基的五元含氮環融合。此結構源於氧化後的 epinephrine 發生分子內環化，其中側鏈氮攻擊親電性的 o-quinone 環（一種 Michael 加成），閉合第二個環。醌部分及其 o-quinone 特性解釋了 adrenochrome 大部分的反應性，包括其進行氧化還原循環與單電子還原為半醌自由基的能力。

label: Cardiotoxicity
description: Adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, is linked to potential cardiotoxic effects when catecholamine levels are high or under oxidative stress. Oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome has been observed in isolated rat cardiomyocytes, and one hypothesis proposes that adrenochrome or its metabolites such as adrenolutin contribute to stress-induced heart problems. In inflammatory cardiac conditions such as myocardial infarction, where neutrophils infiltrate and release ROS, local conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome could be relevant, though the cardiotoxic contribution of adrenochrome specifically remains incompletely established.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome, the oxidation product of epinephrine, is linked to potential cardiotoxic effects when catecholamine levels are high or under oxidative stress。Oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome has been observed in isolated rat cardiomyocytes, and one hypothesis proposes that adrenochrome or its metabolites such as adrenolutin contribute to stress-induced heart problems。In inflammatory cardiac conditions such as myocardial infarction, where neutrophils infiltrate and release ROS, local conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome could be relevant, though the cardiotoxic contribution of adrenochrome specifically remains incompletely established。

label: Diaphorase
description: Adrenochrome is reduced back to epinephrine in whole blood by erythrocytic diaphorase and ascorbic acid, keeping steady-state adrenochrome levels in the nanomolar range under physiological conditions. This enzymatic reduction constrains adrenochrome's half-life to on the order of minutes in vivo. It represents an endogenous sink that limits aminochrome accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 在全血中，Adrenochrome 會由紅血球 diaphorase 與 ascorbic acid 還原回 epinephrine，使生理條件下的 adrenochrome 穩態水平維持在奈莫耳範圍。這種酶促還原將 adrenochrome 的體內半衰期限制在數分鐘數量級。它代表限制 aminochrome 累積的內源性匯。

label: Tyrosinase-related protein-2
description: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

label: Honeybee venom
description: Honeybee venom has demonstrated antitumoral effects in melanoma and other cancers, with higher cytotoxic potency in cancer cells. Both honeybee venom and its component melittin are studied for their anticancer activity. This positions honeybee venom as a candidate anticancer natural product.
description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 在黑色素瘤和其他癌症中顯示出抗腫瘤效應，且對癌細胞的細胞毒性效力更高。蜂毒及其成分 Melittin 均被研究其抗癌活性。這使蜂毒成為具潛力的抗癌天然產物。

label: MITF
description: MITF amplification drives proliferation in melanoma, and MITF-M, an isoform enriched in melanoma, correlates strongly with expression of lysosomal genes containing CLEAR elements. MITF is a lineage-defining transcription factor for melanocytes. It contributes to the proliferative and lysosomal program of melanoma cells.
description_zh_TW: MITF 擴增驅動黑色素瘤中的增殖，而富含於黑色素瘤的 MITF-M 異構體與含有 CLEAR 元件的溶酶體基因表現密切相關。MITF 是黑色素細胞的譜系定義轉錄因子。它促成黑色素瘤細胞的增殖與溶酶體程式。

label: FTSJ1
description: Metastatic colonization by melanoma depends on FTSJ1 and the Um34 modification of tRNA[Ser]Sec, which supports translation of antioxidant selenoproteins. FTSJ1-deficient cells are oxidatively stressed and show reduced metastatic colonization. FTSJ1/Um34 is therefore necessary and sufficient for melanoma metastasis in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 黑色素瘤的轉移性定殖依賴 FTSJ1 以及 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 修飾，後者支持抗氧化硒蛋白的轉譯。FTSJ1 缺陷細胞會受到氧化壓力，並表現出轉移性定殖減少。因此 FTSJ1/Um34 在體內對黑色素瘤轉移是必要且充分的。

label: PRAS40
description: PRAS40 is an mTORC1-associated protein that acts as a negative regulator by competing for substrate binding and limiting mTORC1 kinase activity, particularly when the complex is in a low-activity state. Growth-factor signaling through Akt phosphorylates PRAS40, releasing its inhibition and permitting mTORC1 activation. Thus PRAS40 provides a built-in brake that is relieved by anabolic signals. Its dynamic association fine-tunes mTORC1 output in response to the cellular environment.
description_zh_TW: PRAS40 是一種與 mTORC1 相關的蛋白質，作為負向調節者，透過競爭受質結合並限制 mTORC1 激酶活性——尤其是在複合物處於低活性狀態時。透過 Akt 的生長因子信號磷酸化 PRAS40，釋放其抑制並允許 mTORC1 活化。因此 PRAS40 提供了一個由合成代謝信號解除的內建制動。其動態聯合依據細胞環境精細調諧 mTORC1 輸出。

label: Rheb
description: Rheb (Ras homolog enriched in brain) is a small GTPase that directly binds and activates mTORC1 when in its GTP-bound state, provided mTORC1 is localized at the lysosomal surface. Rheb's activity is held in check by the TSC1/TSC2 GAP complex, making it the immediate effector that relays growth and nutrient signals to mTORC1. GTP-Rheb relieves the autoinhibitory conformation of mTORC1, enabling substrate phosphorylation. As the proximal activator, Rheb sits at the convergence point of multiple upstream inhibitory pathways.
description_zh_TW: Rheb（腦部富集的 Ras 同源物）是一種小 GTPase，在其 GTP 結合態時直接結合並活化 mTORC1，前提是 mTORC1 定位於溶酶體表面。Rheb 的活性受 TSC1/TSC2 GAP 複合物控制，使其成為將生長和營養信號傳遞至 mTORC1 的立即效應物。GTP-Rheb 解除 mTORC1 的自抑構象，使其能磷酸化受質。作為近端活化劑，Rheb 位於多條上游抑制途徑的匯聚點。

label: TSC1/TSC2
description: The TSC1-TSC2 tumor-suppressor complex acts as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for the small G protein Rheb, converting active GTP-bound Rheb to its inactive GDP-bound form. Because only GTP-Rheb directly activates mTORC1, TSC1/TSC2 functions as a critical upstream brake on mTORC1 in response to energy, oxygen, and growth-factor signals. Loss-of-function mutations in TSC1 or TSC2 cause tuberous sclerosis complex, characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation, hamartoma formation, and autophagy suppression. The complex is therefore a major gatekeeper of mTORC1 and cellular growth.
description_zh_TW: TSC1-TSC2 腫瘤抑制複合物作為小 G 蛋白 Rheb 的 GTP 酶活化蛋白（GAP），將活化的 GTP 結合態 Rheb 轉化為其失活的 GDP 結合態。由於只有 GTP-Rheb 直接活化 mTORC1，TSC1/TSC2 在回應能量、氧氣和生長因子信號時，作為 mTORC1 關鍵的上游制動。TSC1 或 TSC2 的功能缺失突變導致結節性硬化症複合體，其特徵為 mTORC1 組成型活化、錯構瘤形成和自噬抑制。因此該複合物是 mTORC1 與細胞生長的主要守門者。

label: mTOR, Raptor, mLST8, PRAS40, Deptor
description: mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) is composed of five core subunits: the catalytic kinase mTOR, the scaffold Raptor (which binds substrates and Rag GTPases), mLST8 (stabilizing the kinase domain), the inhibitory subunit PRAS40, and the negative regulator Deptor. This stoichiometric assembly defines mTORC1's substrate specificity and its sensitivity to upstream inputs such as amino acids and insulin. Raptor is essential for recruitment of mTORC1 to lysosomes and for phosphorylation of canonical substrates like S6K1 and 4E-BP1. The composition distinguishes mTORC1 from mTORC2, which shares mTOR, mLST8, and Deptor but includes Rictor instead of Raptor.
description_zh_TW: mTOR 複合物 1（mTORC1）由五個核心次單元組成：催化激酶 mTOR、支架蛋白 Raptor（結合受質和 Rag GTPases）、mLST8（穩定激酶結構域）、抑制性次單元 PRAS40，以及負向調節者 Deptor。此化學計量組裝決定了 mTORC1 的受質專一性及其對胺基酸和胰島素等上游輸入的敏感性。Raptor 對於將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體以及磷酸化 S6K1 和 4E-BP1 等典型受質至關重要。此組成將 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 區分開來，後者共享 mTOR、mLST8 和 Deptor，但包含 Rictor 而非 Raptor。

label: Lysosomal surface
description: mTORC1 is recruited to the lysosomal surface, where it encounters its activator Rheb and receives upstream amino-acid and growth-factor inputs necessary for full activation. This spatial recruitment, mediated by Rag GTPases and the Ragulator scaffold, converts the lysosome into the signaling platform for mTORC1. Only when docked at the lysosome can mTORC1 efficiently phosphorylate its substrates, including TFEB and ULK1. Thus lysosomal localization is essential for mTORC1 function and for its inhibition of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 被招募至溶酶體表面，在此它遇到其活化劑 Rheb，並接收上游胺基酸和生長因子輸入以達到完全活化。這種由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 支架介導的空間招募，將溶酶體轉化為 mTORC1 的信號平台。唯有停靠於溶酶體時，mTORC1 才能有效磷酸化其受質，包括 TFEB 和 ULK1。因此溶酶體定位對 mTORC1 功能及其對自噬的抑制至為關鍵。

label: TFE3 at S321
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFE3 at serine 321, an analog of the TFEB S211 site, thereby promoting cytosolic retention and inhibiting TFE3's transcriptional activity under nutrient-replete conditions. This parallel modification ensures that both MiT/TFE family master regulators are coordinately repressed by mTORC1. Upon starvation or mTORC1 inhibition, dephosphorylation permits TFE3 nuclear entry and activation of lysosomal genes. The conserved regulatory logic highlights the unified control of the degradative program.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 321 磷酸化 TFE3，此位點是 TFEB S211 位點的類似物，從而在營養充足條件下促進細胞質保留並抑制 TFE3 的轉錄活性。此平行修飾確保 MiT/TFE 家族的兩個主調節者都被 mTORC1 協調抑制。在飢餓或 mTORC1 抑制時，去磷酸化允許 TFE3 核進入和溶酶體基因的活化。保守的調節邏輯凸顯了對降解程序的統一控制。

label: TFEB at Ser142/Ser211
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at both serine 142 and serine 211, two residues whose combined modification enforces 14-3-3 binding and robust cytosolic retention of the transcription factor. These sites act synergistically to prevent TFEB nuclear entry and thus block activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program under nutrient-replete conditions. Dephosphorylation of both marks is required for full TFEB activation during starvation. The dual-site control exemplifies the redundancy mTORC1 employs to firmly suppress degradative transcription.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 142 和 serine 211 兩處磷酸化 TFEB，這兩個殘基的聯合修飾強制了 14-3-3 結合以及該轉錄因子穩健的細胞質保留。這些位點協同作用以防止 TFEB 核進入，從而在營養充足條件下阻斷自噬—溶酶體程序的活化。飢餓期間必須將這兩個標記都去磷酸化，TFEB 才能完全活化。雙位點控制具體體現了 mTORC1 用以牢牢抑制降解轉錄的冗餘機制。

label: TFEB at S122
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 122, an additional N-terminal regulatory site that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor under nutrient-rich conditions. Alongside S142 and S211, S122 forms part of the multi-site phosphorylation code through which mTORC1 enforces TFEB exclusion from the nucleus. Dephosphorylation of these sites by phosphatases such as PP2A is required for nuclear translocation. The multiplicity of mTORC1 sites provides tunable, robust control of lysosomal gene transcription.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 122 磷酸化 TFEB，這是營養豐裕條件下促進該轉錄因子細胞質保留的額外 N 端調節位點。與 S142 和 S211 並列，S122 構成 mTORC1 用以將 TFEB 排除於核外之多位點磷酸化密碼的一部分。這些位點經 PP2A 等磷酸酶去磷酸化，是核轉運所必需的。mTORC1 多重位點的設計提供了對溶酶體基因轉錄可調、穩健的控制。

label: TFEB at S138
description: mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, a residue also modified by GSK3β, and this phosphorylation promotes nuclear export of TFEB, complementing the cytosolic retention imposed at other sites. The accumulation of phosphates across the N-terminal regulatory region collectively suppresses TFEB transcriptional activity. Relief of S138 phosphorylation facilitates nuclear accumulation and activation of the autophagy-lysosomal program. This site therefore participates in the coordinated mTORC1 restraint of cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 在 serine 138 磷酸化 TFEB，此殘基亦受 GSK3β 修飾，此磷酸化促進 TFEB 的核輸出，補足其他位點施加的細胞質保留。N 端調節區磷酸根的增加共同抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。S138 磷酸化的解除有利於自噬—溶酶體程序的核累積與活化。因此此位點參與了 mTORC1 對細胞清除的協調性約束。

label: Protein synthesis
description: mTORC1 promotes cap-dependent protein synthesis by phosphorylating the eukaryotic initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 (4E-BP1), releasing eIF4E to initiate translation, and by phosphorylating S6 kinase 1 (S6K1), which enhances ribosome biogenesis and translational capacity. These outputs prioritize anabolic processes when nutrients and growth factors are plentiful. The stimulation of protein synthesis is a major consumer of cellular energy and amino acids, balanced against the catabolic program of autophagy. Dysregulated mTORC1-driven translation contributes to hypertrophy and malignancy.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化真核起始因子 4E 結合蛋白 1（4E-BP1）促進帽依賴性蛋白質合成，釋放 eIF4E 以起始轉譯，並透過磷酸化 S6 激酶 1（S6K1）增強核醣體生物發生和轉譯能力。這些輸出在營養和生長因子充裕時優先安排合成代謝過程。蛋白質合成的刺激是細胞能量和胺基酸的主要消耗者，需與自噬的分解代謝程序取得平衡。失調的 mTORC1 驅動轉譯促成肥大和惡性腫瘤。

label: Lipid synthesis
description: mTORC1 promotes lipid and cholesterol synthesis by activating the sterol regulatory element-binding proteins (SREBP1) and peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), transcription factors that drive expression of lipogenic and adipogenic enzymes. This anabolic output supports membrane biogenesis and energy storage during growth. The lipid-synthetic program is coordinated with mTORC1's stimulation of protein and nucleotide synthesis to build cellular mass. Its dysregulation contributes to hepatic steatosis and metabolic syndrome.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過活化固醇調節元件結合蛋白（SREBP1）和過氧化物酶體增殖物活化受體 gamma（PPARγ）——驅動脂肪生成和成脂酵素表現的轉錄因子——來促進脂質和膽固醇合成。此合成代謝輸出在生長期間支持膜生物發生和能量儲存。脂質合成程序與 mTORC1 對蛋白質和核苷酸合成的刺激協調，以建構細胞質量。其失調促成肝臟脂肪變性和代謝症候群。

label: TSC1
description: Loss of TSC1 or TSC2 removes the GAP that restrains Rheb, causing constitutive mTORC1 hyperactivation that drives benign hamartomas (Tuberous Sclerosis, renal angiomyolipoma, epilepsy, autism). Here benign growth is itself the disease, contrasting with the protective OIS-type benign lesion.
description_zh_TW: TSC1 或 TSC2 缺失移除抑制 Rheb 的 GAP，造成組成性 mTORC1 過度活化，驅動良性錯構瘤（結節性硬化症、腎血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇、自閉症）。此處良性生長本身就是疾病，與保護性 OIS 型良性病灶形成對比。

label: Ribosomal Protein S6
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Phosphorylated ribosomal protein S6 (phospho-S6) is used as a surrogate marker of mTORC1 activation, having been applied to resected brain tissue specimens and experimental models for mTOR pathway hyperactivation in TSC and other mTORopathies. However, phospho-S6 has not proven a consistent clinical biomarker, making it difficult to determine how the extent of mTOR inhibition, rapamycin blood levels, and seizure reduction correlate. In many aging studies, surrogate biomarkers of mTORC1 inhibition are underreported or inconsistently applied, making it hard to confirm outcomes truly reflect effective mTOR inhibition - a key gap in the rapamycin longevity literature.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化核糖體蛋白S6（phospho-S6）用作mTORC1激活的替代標誌物，已應用於切除的腦組織樣本和TSC及其他mTOR病中mTOR通路過度激活的實驗模型。然而，phospho-S6尚未被證明是一致的臨床生物標誌物，因此難以確定mTOR抑製程度、rapamycin血藥水平和癲癇減少之間的相關性。在許多老化研究中，mTORC1抑製的替代生物標誌物報告不足或應用不一致，難以確認結果是否真正反映有效的mTOR抑製——這是rapamycin長壽文獻中的一個關鍵空白。

label: ULK1 (at Ser757)
description: Under nutrient-rich conditions, mTORC1 phosphorylates ULK1 at Ser757, disrupting its interaction with AMPK and suppressing autophagy. Directionally, mTORC1 sits upstream of ULK1 inhibition. This couples nutrient abundance to autophagic restraint, and it is the basis for rapamycin's autophagy-promoting effects. Sirtuin and AMPK activation opposes mTORC1 to relicense ULK1, connecting sirtuin biology to the nutrient-sensing control of autophagy. The AMPK-mTORC1-ULK1 network is a central regulatory circuit that determines autophagic flux in response to energy and growth signals.
description_zh_TW: 在營養豐富條件下，mTORC1 在 Ser757 位點磷酸化 ULK1，破壞其與 AMPK 的相互作用並抑制自噬。在方向性上，mTORC1 位於 ULK1 抑制的上游。這將營養豐富與自噬抑制偶聯，也是 rapamycin 促自噬效應的基礎。Sirtuin 和 AMPK 活化反對 mTORC1 以重新啟用 ULK1，將 sirtuin 生物學與自噬的營養感知控制聯繫起來。AMPK-mTORC1-UNK1 網絡是決定自噬通量的核心調控迴路，回應能量和生長訊號。

label: Histone
description: A nucleosome, the fundamental repeating unit of chromatin, is composed of a histone octamer around which DNA is wrapped. The octamer contains two copies each of the core histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, and approximately 147 base pairs of DNA wind around this protein core in a left-handed superhelix. Nucleosomes package the genome into chromatin, and their positioning and modification regulate access to DNA for transcription, replication, and repair. Linker histone H1 associates with the DNA between nucleosomes and helps fold the fiber into higher-order structures.
description_zh_TW: 核小體是染色質的基本重複單位，由 DNA 包覆的組蛋白八聚體組成。此八聚體包含核心組蛋白 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各兩個拷貝，約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 以左手超螺旋纏繞在該蛋白質核心周圍。核小體將基因組包裝成染色質，它們的定位和修飾調節 DNA 的轉錄、複製和修復。連接組蛋白 H1 與核小體之間的 DNA 結合，幫助將纖維折疊成更高階的結構。

label: HDAC
