description: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
description_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

label: Euchromatin
description: Histone acetylation promotes the formation of euchromatin, the open, transcriptionally permissive form of chromatin. Acetylation neutralizes the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, reducing their affinity for the negatively charged DNA backbone and loosening the nucleosome structure. This relaxed conformation allows transcription factors and RNA polymerase to access regulatory sequences, and acetylated lysines also serve as docking sites for bromodomain-containing reader proteins that further stimulate transcription.
description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化促進常染色質的形成，常染色質是開放的、轉錄允許的染色質形式。乙醯化會中和組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的正電荷，降低其與帶負電荷的 DNA 主鏈的親和力，並鬆開核小體結構。這種鬆弛的構象允許轉錄因子和 RNA 聚合酶存取調控序列，乙醯化離胺酸也可作為含溴結構域讀取蛋白的對接位點，進一步刺激轉錄。

label: Sodium Valproate
description: Sodium valproate is an anticonvulsant and mood-stabilizing drug that also acts as a histone deacetylase inhibitor at therapeutic concentrations. By inhibiting class I HDACs, valproate increases histone acetylation and alters the expression of many genes, which contributes to its clinical effects and underlies its use as an experimental epigenetic modulator. Valproate is also used in research to enhance reprogramming, promote differentiation, and study the role of acetylation in gene regulation and aging.
description_zh_TW: 丙戊酸鈉是一種抗驚厥藥和情緒穩定藥，在治療濃度下也可用作組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑。透過抑制 I 類 HDAC，丙戊酸增加組蛋白乙醯化並改變許多基因的表達，這有助於其臨床效果並奠定其作為實驗性表觀遺傳調節劑的基礎。丙戊酸也用於增強重編程、促進分化以及研究乙醯化在基因調控和老化中的作用的研究。

label: Trichostatin A
description: Trichostatin A is a potent, broadly acting histone deacetylase inhibitor used extensively in epigenetics and senescence research. By blocking HDAC enzymes, trichostatin A increases histone acetylation, opening chromatin and reactivating genes silenced by deacetylation across the genome. In senescence studies it serves as a tool compound to probe how the balance between histone acetyltransferase and deacetylase activities influences the senescence phenotype, SASP regulation, and chromatin state. It is one of the most widely used tool compounds for manipulating the acetylome experimentally.
description_zh_TW: Trichostatin A 是一種有效、廣泛作用的組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑，廣泛用於表觀遺傳學和老化研究。透過阻斷 HDAC 酶，曲古抑菌素 A 增加組蛋白乙醯化，打開染色質並重新活化整個基因組中因去乙醯化而沉默的基因。在老化研究中，它作為工具化合物來探討組蛋白乙醯轉移酶和去乙醯化酶活性之間的平衡如何影響老化表型、SASP 調節和染色質狀態。它是用於實驗操縱乙醯基組的最廣泛使用的工具化合物之一。

label: ACLY
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: ACLY (ATP-citrate lyase) catalyzes the downstream conversion of mitochondria-derived citrate exported to the cytosol into acetyl-CoA, the principal substrate for cytosolic acetyl-CoA production and histone acetylation. ACLY expression is increased across multiple senescence models, and its silencing reduces both H3K27ac levels and SASP gene expression in irradiation-induced and replicative senescence. Conversely, citrate supplementation increases histone acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory gene expression in proliferating cells, confirming that increasing citrate availability is sufficient to drive the acetylation-dependent inflammatory programme.
description_zh_TW: ACLY（ATP-西妥環酶）催化由線粒體釋放至細胞質的檸檬酸下游轉化為乙酰-CoA，這是細胞質內乙酰-CoA的主要底物，以及組蛋白乙酰化。ACLY的表達在多個衰老模型中均增加，並且抑制其會降低H3K27ac的水平和輻射誘導和代數衰老引起的SASP基因表達。相反，檸檬酸補充會增加組蛋白乙酰化並誘導增生細胞中的促炎基因表達，這證實增加檸檬酸的供應足夠驅動乙酰化依賴的炎症程序。

label: Lipofuscin
description: Lipofuscin and Aging are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Lipofuscin and Aging may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Lipofuscin 和 Aging 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Lipofuscin 和 Aging 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Autophagic flux
description: Autophagic flux—the complete rate of cargo delivery to and degradation within lysosomes—declines progressively with age in many tissues. This decline stems from impaired initiation, reduced lysosomal proteolytic capacity, and accumulated lipofuscin that compromises lysosomal function, producing a state of proteostatic insufficiency. The resulting accumulation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates contributes centrally to the aging phenotype and to age-related diseases such as neurodegeneration and sarcopenia. Restoration of autophagic flux is therefore a major hypothesized mechanism through which longevity interventions exert their benefits.
description_zh_TW: 自噬流——即貨物遞送至溶酶體及在溶酶體內降解的完整速率——在許多組織中隨年齡漸進下降。此下降源於起始受損、溶酶體蛋白水解能力降低，以及累積的脂褐質損害溶酶體功能，產生蛋白質穩態不足的狀態。由此導致的受損胞器和蛋白聚集物累積，對老化表型和神經退化、肌肉減少症等與年齡相關疾病有核心貢獻。因此，恢復自噬流是長壽介入發揮其益處的一個主要假設機制。

label: Intestinal nuclei during fasting
description: During fasting, MXL-3::GFP signal disappears from intestinal nuclei within about two hours, indicating that the repressor exits the nucleus and ceases to suppress its target genes. This delocalization is a rapid, nutrient-responsive event that permits de-repression of lysosomal lipase and autophagy genes. The nuclear export of MXL-3 complements the concurrent nuclear accumulation of HLH-30, creating a switch from storage to mobilization. The observation provides direct in vivo evidence for dynamic regulation of the lipid-degradation program.
description_zh_TW: 在禁食期間，MXL-3::GFP 訊號在大約兩小時內從腸道細胞核消失，表明該抑制因子離開細胞核並停止抑制其標的基因。此去定位是一個快速的、對營養有反應的事件，它允許溶酶體脂肪酶和自噬基因的解除抑制。MXL-3 的核輸出補充了同時發生的 HLH-30 核累積，創造出從儲存到動員的開關。此觀察為脂質降解程序的動態調節提供了直接的活體證據。

label: Lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1,2,3,5)
description: In C. elegans, the MAX-like transcription factor MXL-3 represses transcription of lysosomal lipase genes (lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3, lipl-5) when food is abundant, limiting lipid mobilization. This repression maintains lipid storage under fed conditions and is relieved during fasting, allowing lipolysis. MXL-3 thus acts as a nutritional gatekeeper of lysosomal lipid catabolism, analogous to MYC's repression of lysosomal programs in mammals. Its activity positions lipid degradation within the broader nutrient-responsive regulatory network.
description_zh_TW: 在線蟲 C. elegans 中，MAX 樣轉錄因子 MXL-3 在食物充裕時抑制溶酶體脂肪酶基因（lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3、lipl-5）的轉錄，限制脂質動員。此抑制在進食條件下維持脂質儲存，並在禁食期間解除，允許脂解作用。因此 MXL-3 作為溶酶體脂質分解代謝的營養閘門，類似於 MYC 在哺乳動物中對溶酶體程序的抑制。其活性將脂質降解定位於更廣泛的營養反應性調節網絡中。

label: MAX
description: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

label: Senescent Cell Accumulation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial dysfunction in cellular senescence a bridge to neurodegenerative disease.md
description: Aging causes senescent-cell accumulation as telomere shortening, cumulative DNA damage, and stem-cell stress increase senescent-cell formation, while declining immune clearance reduces their removal. The burden rises across multiple tissues, often described as exponential with age, and is a cardinal hallmark linking cellular senescence to organismal aging. The causal direction is reinforced by experiments showing that clearing these cells alleviates age-related dysfunction. Senescent-cell accumulation is therefore both a marker and a driver of the aging process.
description_zh_TW: 老化造成衰老細胞累積，因端粒縮短、累積 DNA 損傷與幹細胞壓力增加衰老細胞形成，而下降的免疫清除減少其移除。此負擔在多種組織上升，常被描述為隨年齡指數增加，且是連結細胞衰老與個體老化的關鍵特徵。因果方向被清除這些細胞可緩解年齡相關功能障礙的實驗強化。衰老細胞累積因此既是老化過程的標記也是驅動者。

label: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression
description: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression extends lifespan, as demonstrated by MCAT (mitochondrial catalase transgenic) mice showing roughly 20 percent increased median lifespan and delayed age-related pathology. By concentrating catalase in the mitochondrial matrix, H2O2 from Complex I or III leak is removed before it propagates damage. The directionality is targeted detoxification promoting longevity. A caveat is that lifespan extension is modest and tissue-specific, and overexpression does not abolish all aging phenotypes, indicating multiple parallel aging mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial catalase overexpression延長了壽命，正如MCAT（mitochondria1catalase轉基因）小鼠所證明的那樣，其顯示中位壽命延長了約20％並延遲了與年齡相關的病理。透過將catalase濃縮在mitochondria1基質中，來自複合物I或III洩漏的H 2 O 2 在其傳播損害之前被除去。方向性是針對性排毒延年益壽。需要注意的是，壽命延長是適度的且具有組織特異性，且過度表現並不能消除所有 aging 表型，表明存在多個並行的 aging 機制。

label: Nucleosome Remodeling
description: Nucleosome remodeling capacity decreases with age, accompanied by the loss of core histones and nucleosome occupancy. In aging yeast, nucleosome occupancy decreases by up to 50 percent and half the core histone proteins are lost, and similar chromatin decompaction occurs in worms and human cells. Reduced histone abundance and nucleosome loss decompact chromatin, increasing DNA accessibility and transcriptional noise while contributing to genomic instability in aging cells. These findings support the view that chromatin decompaction is a fundamental driver of age-related dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Nucleosome 重塑能力隨著年齡的增長而降低，伴隨著核心組蛋白和核小體佔據的損失。在老化的酵母菌中，核小體佔有率下降高達 50%，一半的核心組蛋白流失，蠕蟲和人類細胞中也會發生類似的染色質解壓縮。組蛋白豐度的減少和核小體的流失會使染色質解壓縮，增加 DNA 的可及性和轉錄噪音，同時導致老化細胞的基因組不穩定。這些發現支持這樣的觀點：染色質解壓縮是與年齡相關的功能障礙的根本驅動因素。

label: Declining SIRT3 and rising SIRT4
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Aging is associated with declining SIRT3 activity and rising SIRT4, which narrows the hormetic window and increases vulnerability to mitochondrial stressors. Directionally, aging sits upstream of the altered ratio. This shift favors oxidant stress and metabolic inflexibility, and restoring the ratio, for example via caloric restriction or NAD+ precursors, is a proposed anti-aging strategy. By reducing the protective SIRT3/SIRT4 balance, aging impairs mitochondrial quality control and stress adaptation. This association links mitochondrial sirtuin biology to the functional decline of aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: 衰老與 SIRT3 活性下降和 SIRT4 上升相關，這縮窄了激效窗口並增加對粒線體壓力源的脆弱性。在方向性上，衰老位於改變比率的上游。這種變化有利於氧化壓力和代謝不靈活性，恢復比率（例如透過限制熱量或 NAD+ 前驅物）是一種擬議的抗衰老策略。透過降低保護性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡，衰老損害粒線體品質控制和壓力適應。此關聯將粒線體 sirtuin 生物學與衰老組織的功能退化聯繫起來。

label: Endostatin
description: Endostatin is a 20 kDa collagen XVIII-derived fragment that acts as a potent endogenous inhibitor of angiogenesis, restraining tumor growth and metastasis. Its regulation and matrix-derived abundance change with tissue remodeling in aging.
description_zh_TW: Endostatin 是 20 kDa 的 XVIII 型膠原蛋白衍生片段，是抑制血管生成、約束腫瘤生長與轉移的強效內源性抑制劑。其調控與基質衍生豐度隨衰老的組織重塑而改變。

label: Gram-Negative Bacteria
description: Gram-negative bacteria release LPS that triggers NF-kB and inflammation, increasing mitochondrial ROS and oxidative stress. This links infection to the aging-associated inflammatory load (inflammaging), and gut gram-negative overgrowth contributes to metabolic endotoxemia.
description_zh_TW: 革蘭氏陰性菌釋放 LPS 觸發 NF-κB 與發炎，增加粒線體 ROS 與氧化壓力。這將感染與衰老相關的發炎負荷（inflammaging）相連結，而腸道革蘭氏陰性菌過度生長促成代謝性內毒素血症。

label: SIRT3 for osteoprotection
description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

label: SIRT1 (via Hes1 deacetylation)
description: SIRT1 directly regulates BDNF transcription by deacetylating and repressing Hes1, a transcriptional repressor of BDNF, thereby relieving inhibition and promoting neuronal survival. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylates Hes1, which induces BDNF. This links sirtuin activity to neurotrophic support, and it is a mechanism for SIRT1's neuroprotective and cognitive benefits. By removing the Hes1 brake on the BDNF promoter, SIRT1 increases BDNF expression in the brain. This regulation is engaged by caloric restriction and exercise, both of which elevate BDNF through SIRT1-dependent pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並抑制 Hes1——一種 BDNF 的轉錄抑制因子——直接調控 BDNF 轉錄，從而解除抑制並促進神經元存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 去乙醯化 Hes1，後者誘導 BDNF。這將 sirtuin 活性與神經營養支持聯繫起來，是 SIRT1 神經保護和認知益處的機制。透過移除 Hes1 對 BDNF 啟動子的制動，SIRT1 增加大腦中的 BDNF 表達。此調控在限制熱量和運動中被啟動，兩者都透過 SIRT1 依賴性途徑提高 BDNF。

label: TrkB
description: BDNF signals primarily through the receptor tyrosine kinase TrkB, triggering phosphorylation cascades including MAPK/ERK, PI3K-Akt, and PLCgamma. These pathways converge on transcription factors such as CREB, strengthening excitatory synapses, facilitating long-term potentiation, and supporting adult hippocampal neurogenesis.
description_zh_TW: BDNF 主要透過受體酪胺酸激酶 TrkB 傳遞信號，觸發包括 MAPK/ERK、PI3K–Akt 和 PLCγ 的磷酸化級聯。這些途徑匯聚於 CREB 等轉錄因子，強化興奮性突觸、促進長期增強，並支持成體海馬神經新生。

label: FNDC5
description: Irisin is cleaved from the membrane protein FNDC5 during exercise. In the hippocampus, FNDC5-derived irisin stimulates BDNF and downstream mediators of hippocampal function including Npas4, c-Fos, and Arc, forming the irisin-BDNF axis that mediates exercise benefits on cognition.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 在運動期間從膜蛋白 FNDC5 上被剪切產生。在海馬體中，源自 FNDC5 的 irisin 刺激 BDNF 以及 Npas4、c-Fos 和 Arc 等海馬功能下游介導因子，形成介導運動對認知益處的 irisin–BDNF 軸。

label: Cell Migration
description: Integrin-dependent adhesion turnover at focal adhesions drives cell migration during development, wound healing and immune trafficking. Each integrin heterodimer has defined ligand specificity that directs migration in distinct tissues.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 依賴的黏著斑黏附更新在發育、傷口癒合和免疫運輸期間驅動細胞遷移。每個 integrin 異二聚體具有明確的配體特異性，指導不同組織中的遷移。

label: Satellite Cells
description: Integrins anchor muscle satellite cells to the extracellular matrix, coupling them to the basement membrane for regenerative responses. Integrin-linked signaling maintains the stem-cell niche and senses tissue stiffness.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 將肌肉衛星細胞錨定在細胞外基質上，使其與基底膜耦合以進行再生反應。Integrin 連結的訊號維持幹細胞巢並感測組織硬度。

label: Extracellular Matrix
description: Integrins are heterodimeric transmembrane receptors that mediate cell-ECM adhesion by binding matrix ligands such as fibronectin (alpha5beta1), vitronectin (alphavbeta3) and collagens. Ligand engagement induces conformational extension, clustering, and recruitment of focal adhesion machinery.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 是異二聚體跨膜受體，透過結合纖連蛋白（alpha5beta1）、玻連蛋白（alphavbeta3）和膠原蛋白等基質配體，介導細胞-ECM 黏附。配體接合誘導構形伸展、聚集和黏著斑機器的招募。

label: FAK Signaling
description: Outside-in integrin signaling recruits focal adhesion kinase (FAK), paxillin, talin and kindlin, which organize actin stress fibers and activate RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT pathways. This pathway transduction governs cell migration, proliferation, and survival.
description_zh_TW: 由外而內的 integrin 訊號招募黏著斑激酶（FAK）、paxillin、talin 和 kindlin，組織肌動蛋白應力纖維並活化 RAS-MAPK 和 PI3K-AKT 途徑。這種途徑傳導調控細胞遷移、增殖和存活。

label: Beta-hydroxybutyrate
description: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

label: Akkermansia
description: Akkermansia is a genus of gut bacteria, notably A. muciniphila, associated with gut health, metabolic homeostasis, and longevity. Its presence supports metabolic balance and is linked to improved glucose and lipid handling.
description_zh_TW: Akkermansia 是腸道細菌的一個屬，尤以 A. muciniphila 與腸道健康、代謝恆定及長壽相關。其存在有助於代謝平衡，並與改善葡萄糖與脂質處理有關。

label: benzene ring with two hydroxyl groups
description: Catechols contain a benzene ring bearing two adjacent (ortho) hydroxyl groups, a structural motif that is both chemically reactive and the specific recognition site for COMT. This vicinal diol is methylated at the meta position by COMT using SAMe, yielding O-methylated metabolites that are less reactive and more readily excreted. The presence of this group defines whether a molecule, endogenous or xenobiotic, is a COMT substrate or, at high concentrations, a competitive inhibitor. The motif also renders catechols prone to oxidation, linking them to reactive quinone chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 含有一個帶有兩個相鄰（鄰位）羥基的苯環，這是一種具有化學反應性的結構基序，也是 COMT 的特異性識別位點。這種鄰位二醇被 COMT 使用 SAMe 在間位甲基化，產生反應性較低且更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。該基團的存在決定了分子（內源性或外源性）是 COMT 底物還是高濃度的競爭性抑制劑。該基序也使兒茶酚易於氧化，將它們與反應性醌化學聯繫起來。

label: Estrogen metabolites
description: Estrogen metabolites, such as 2-hydroxyestrone and 4-hydroxyestrone, are catechols because they retain a catechol ring formed during hydroxylation, making them substrates for COMT. COMT O-methylates these metabolites into less genotoxic methoxyestrogens, a protective detoxification step that reduces exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones. Slow COMT can therefore slow the clearance of catecholestrogens, with implications for hormone-related cancer risk. This connection links COMT genotype to estrogen metabolism and cancer susceptibility hypotheses.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen metabolites，如 2-羥基雌酮和 4-羥基雌酮，是兒茶酚，因為它們保留了羥基化過程中形成的兒茶酚環，使其成為 COMT 的底物。 COMT 將這些代謝物 O-甲基化成遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素，這是一種保護性解毒步驟，可減少活性兒茶酚醌的暴露。因此，緩慢的 COMT 可以減緩兒茶酚雌激素的清除，進而影響荷爾蒙相關的癌症風險。這種關聯將 COMT genotype 與雌激素代謝和癌症易感性假設聯繫起來。

label: Pro-oxidants
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Flavonoids can act as pro-oxidants at high concentrations because, in the presence of transition metals, they undergo autoxidation that generates semiquinone radicals and subsequently superoxide and H2O2. This biphasic behavior underlies their hormetic profile. The directionality is high-dose flavonoid to radical generation. A caveat is that pro-oxidant effects are favored by metal abundance and high dose, whereas low doses are generally antioxidant. This pro-oxidant behavior is implicated in their anticancer effects, where selective ROS generation can drive apoptosis in malignant cells.
description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 在高濃度下可以充當 pro-oxidants，因為在過渡金屬存在的情況下，它們會發生 autoxidation，生成半醌自由基，隨後生成超氧化物和 H2O2。这种双相行为是其毒物兴奋效应的基础。方向性是大剂量黄酮类物质向自由基生成。需要注意的是，金属丰度和高剂量有利于促氧化作用，而低剂量通常具有抗氧化作用。这种促氧化行为与它们的抗 cancer 作用有关，其中选择性 ROS 生成可以在恶性细胞中驱动 apoptosis。

label: dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT
description: Oleacein is a dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT: its phenolic structure is O-methylated by COMT as a substrate while simultaneously competing for the active site and for SAMe as an inhibitor, reducing clearance of other catechols. This bifunctional interaction means oleacein both feeds and partially blocks the COMT pathway, with the net effect depending on dose and on the individual's COMT genotype. It is a notable example of dietary polyphenols modulating catechol metabolism. Its olive oil source links diet to COMT-related biochemistry.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是 dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT：其酚類結構被 COMT 作為底物 O-甲基化，同時競爭活性位點和 SAMe 作為抑制劑，減少其他兒茶酚的清除。這種雙功能交互作用意味著油酸素既供給又部分阻斷 COMT 途徑，淨效應取決於劑量和個體的 COMT genotype。這是膳食多酚調節兒茶酚代謝的一個顯著例子。其橄欖油來源將飲食與 COMT 相關的生物化學聯繫起來。

label: extra virgin olive oil
description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

label: COMT at high levels
description: Rutin can inhibit COMT at high supplemental levels because, as a quercetin glycoside containing a catechol moiety, it competes for the enzyme's active site and for SAMe when present in sufficient concentration. At typical dietary intake inhibition is negligible, but concentrated extracts may affect catechol clearance and metabolism. Its catechol nature determines this dose-dependent interaction, which is most relevant in slow COMT individuals. After deglycosylation, its quercetin aglycone mediates the interaction.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 可以在高補充水平下抑制 COMT，因為作為含有兒茶酚部分的槲皮素糖苷，當存在足夠濃度時，它會競爭酶的活性位點和 SAMe。在典型的飲食攝取量下，抑製作用可以忽略不計，但濃縮萃取物可能會影響兒茶酚的清除和代謝。其茶酚性質決定了這種劑量依賴性相互作用，這在緩慢的 COMT 個體中最為相關。去糖基化後，其槲皮素苷元介導相互作用。

label: glycoside of quercetin
description: Rutin is a glycoside of quercetin, formed by rutinose, a disaccharide, attached to the quercetin aglycone, which modifies its solubility, absorption, and bioavailability in the gut. After deglycosylation, the quercetin backbone, a catechol flavonoid, is metabolized partly by COMT, linking rutin intake to COMT-dependent disposition. This structural relationship explains rutin's COMT-interacting potential once converted to quercetin. Found in buckwheat, apples, and citrus, it is a common dietary flavonoid glycoside.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 是 glycoside of quercetin，由芸香糖（一种二糖）形成，附着在槲皮素苷元上，改变其在肠道中的溶解度、吸收和生物利用度。去糖基化后，槲皮素骨架（catechol flavonoid）部分被 COMT 代谢，将芦丁摄入与 COMT 依赖性处置联系起来。這種結構關係解釋了蘆丁在轉化為槲皮素後具有 COMT 相互作用潛力。它存在於蕎麥、蘋果和柑橘中，是一種常見的膳食黃酮苷。

label: quercetin-3-rutinoside
description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

label: SAMe when methylated
description: Rutin, via its quercetin aglycone, is O-methylated by COMT, a reaction that consumes SAMe and methyl groups. At high supplemental doses it can competitively inhibit COMT, slowing methylation of endogenous catechols. This places rutin in the same COMT-modulating class as luteolin and oleacein.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 透過其槲皮素苷元被 COMT O-甲基化，此反應消耗 SAMe 和 methyl groups。在高補充劑量下，它可競爭性抑制 COMT，減緩內源性兒茶酚的甲基化。這使 rutin 與 luteolin 和 oleacein 屬於同一 COMT 調節類別。

label: TFEB at Ser142
description: CDK4/6 phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142, driving CRM1-dependent nuclear export and cytoplasmic sequestration during cell-cycle progression. This modification aligns TFEB repression with the biosynthetic demands of dividing cells, when autophagy is downregulated. Pharmacologic CDK4/6 inhibitors relieve this constraint, permitting TFEB nuclear accumulation and enhancing lysosome biogenesis and autophagic flux. The axis thereby couples cell-cycle machinery to the metabolic state of the cell.
description_zh_TW: CDK4/6 在 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，驅動 CRM1 依賴的核輸出以及在細胞週期進展期間的細胞質隔離。此修飾將 TFEB 抑制與分裂細胞的生物合成需求對齊，此時自噬被下調。藥理 CDK4/6 抑制劑解除此約束，允許 TFEB 核累積並增強溶酶體生物發生與自噬流。該軸因而將細胞週期機制與細胞的代謝狀態耦合。

label: Degradation center and signaling hub
description: The lysosome is the cell's terminal degradation center, containing acidic hydrolases that break down proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, and carbohydrates delivered by endocytosis, phagocytosis, and autophagy. Beyond catabolism, lysosomes serve as signaling hubs that integrate nutrient and growth-factor inputs, most notably by hosting the activation of mTORC1 at their surface. This duality—as both waste-disposal organelle and metabolic command post—places lysosomes at the center of cellular homeostasis, development, and aging. Lysosomal dysfunction underlies a broad spectrum of storage and degenerative diseases.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體是細胞的終端降解中心，含有酸性水解酶，可分解經由胞吞作用、吞噬作用和自噬遞送的蛋白質、脂質、核酸和碳水化合物。除了分解代謝，溶酶體還作為整合營養和生長因子輸入的信號樞紐，最顯著者是在其表面主導 mTORC1 的活化。這種雙重性——既是廢物處理胞器也是代謝指揮站——使溶酶體位居細胞恆定性、發育與老化的中心。溶酶體功能失調是廣泛的儲存性和退化性疾病的基礎。

label: mTORC1 activation
description: The lysosome serves as the physical platform for mTORC1 activation, hosting the recruitment of mTORC1 via Rag GTPases and Ragulator and its encounter with the activator Rheb at the lysosomal surface. Amino-acid sensing, growth-factor inputs, and calcium signals all converge at this organelle to determine mTORC1 activity. By colocalizing mTORC1 with its upstream regulators, the lysosome functionally couples nutrient detection to the control of autophagy and anabolism. This spatial organization is essential for the rapid, reversible regulation of the pathway.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體作為 mTORC1 活化的物理平台，主導 mTORC1 經由 Rag GTPases 和 Ragulator 的招募，以及其與溶酶體表面活化劑 Rheb 的相遇。胺基酸感知、生長因子輸入和鈣信號都在此胞器匯聚以決定 mTORC1 活性。透過將 mTORC1 與其上游調節者共定位，溶酶體在功能上將營養偵測耦合到自噬和合成代謝的控制。此空間組織對途徑快速、可逆的調節至為必要。

label: Intracellular and extracellular signals
description: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway integrates a wide array of intracellular and extracellular cues—including growth factors, insulin, amino acids, oxygen, and energy status—to coordinate cell growth, metabolism, proliferation, and survival. Through its two complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2, it translates these inputs into decisions about biosynthesis versus catabolism, notably by inhibiting autophagy when resources are abundant. This central integrator role makes mTOR a nodal control point for physiology and a target for cancer, aging, and metabolic disease. Its dysregulation is implicated in nearly every major chronic disease.
description_zh_TW: 雷帕黴素機械性標靶（mTOR）途徑整合了廣泛的細胞內與細胞外線索——包括生長因子、胰島素、胺基酸、氧氣和能量狀態——以協調細胞生長、代謝、增殖與存活。透過其兩個複合物 mTORC1 和 mTORC2，它將這些輸入轉化為關於生物合成與分解代謝的決策，特別是在資源充裕時抑制自噬。這種核心整合者角色使 mTOR 成為生理學的節點控制點，以及癌症、老化和代謝疾病的標靶。其失調與幾乎每一種主要慢性疾病都有關聯。

label: Hyperfunction Theory of Aging
description: The hyperfunction theory of aging holds that aging is the quasi-programmed continuation of developmental growth signaling; mTOR is the engine of aging and Rapamycin extends lifespan by suppressing mTOR. This frames the key distinction that arrested growth (OIS) is protective while ongoing, unopposed growth signaling is pathogenic.
description_zh_TW: 老化的功能亢進理論主張，老化是發育生長訊號的準程式化延續；mTOR 是老化的引擎，而 Rapamycin 透過抑制 mTOR 延長壽命。這框定了關鍵區分：停滯的生長（OIS）具保護性，而持續、無對抗的生長訊號具致病性。

label: Atrogin-1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Atrogin-1 and MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) are pivotal molecules involved in muscle protein synthesis and degradation, functioning as muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligases that drive protein breakdown during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing atrophy signaling, attenuating protein degradation, and preserving muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: Atrogin-1 與 MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1 and 2) 是參與肌肉蛋白合成與降解的關鍵分子，作為肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，在萎縮期間驅動蛋白分解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而降低萎縮訊號、減緩蛋白降解，並保留肌肉量。

label: muscle fatigue
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Existing evidence suggests that urolithin A may have a positive role in improving endurance and delaying muscle fatigue, both of which are intricately linked to mitochondrial function. By enhancing mitochondrial activity and ATP synthesis, urolithin A provides sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise, and its anti-inflammatory properties alleviate tissue damage and muscle soreness caused by inflammation. Most studies have been conducted in vitro or on animals, so more human studies are needed to validate these effects.
description_zh_TW: 現有證據顯示 urolithin A 可能在改善耐力與延遲肌肉疲勞方面具有正面作用，兩者皆與粒線體功能密切相關。透過增強粒線體活性與 ATP 合成，urolithin A 在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持，且其抗發炎特性可減輕由發炎引起的組織損傷與肌肉痠痛。大多數研究為體外或動物實驗，因此需要更多人體研究來驗證這些效應。

label: MuRF1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase that, together with Atrogin-1, marks muscle proteins for ubiquitin-proteasome degradation during atrophy. Studies have shown that urolithin A can regulate muscle protein synthesis and degradation by inhibiting the activity of mTORC1 and the expression of Atrogin-1/MuRF1, thereby reducing muscle protein degradation and supporting the maintenance of muscle mass under catabolic conditions. Suppressing this E3 ligase reduces ubiquitination of muscle proteins and complements urolithin A's anabolic effects on protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: MuRF1 (muscle-specific RING finger protein 1) 是一種肌肉特異性 E3 泛素連接酶，與 Atrogin-1 共同在萎縮期間標記肌肉蛋白以供泛素-蛋白酶體降解。研究顯示 urolithin A 可透過抑制 mTORC1 的活性與 Atrogin-1/MuRF1 的表現，來調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解，從而減少肌肉蛋白降解，並在分解代謝條件下支持肌肉量的維持。抑制此 E3 連接酶可減少肌肉蛋白的泛素化，並補足 urolithin A 對蛋白質合成的合成代謝效應。

label: Pomegranate
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Pomegranate is cited as one of the primary and richest dietary sources of urolithin A. Pomegranate peel and seeds contain abundant polyphenolic compounds, including ellagitannins that are metabolized by the gut microbiota into urolithin A. Consequently, consuming pomegranate supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A, and pomegranate consumption is a standard dietary route to increase systemic urolithin A exposure alongside other sources such as walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry.
description_zh_TW: 石榴被引述為 urolithin A 的主要且最豐富的膳食來源之一。石榴皮與籽含有豐富的多酚類化合物，包括被腸道菌叢代謝為 urolithin A 的 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）。因此，食用石榴提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成，且食用石榴是增加全身性 urolithin A 暴露的標準膳食途徑，與核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓等其他來源並列。

label: TLR3/TRIF signaling
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling, reducing inflammation and enhancing antioxidant defense. TLR3/TRIF is an upstream innate immune signaling route whose inactivation dampens downstream NF-κB activation and the production of inflammatory mediators. This mechanism contributes to urolithin A's anti-inflammatory activity in settings such as poly(I:C)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and supports its role in muscle recovery and protection from inflammation-induced damage.
description_zh_TW: 文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸，從而減少發炎並增強抗氧化防禦。TLR3/TRIF 是一條上游先天免疫訊號路線，其失活會抑制下游 NF-κB 活化與發炎介質的產生。此機制有助於 urolithin A 在如 poly(I:C) 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞等情境中的抗發炎活性，並支持其在肌肉恢復與免受發炎誘發損傷中的角色。

label: Urolithins
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A (UA) is a naturally occurring compound classified within the urolithins, a family of gut-microbiota-derived metabolites that form when dietary polyphenols are processed in the gastrointestinal tract. The review describes urolithins as compounds present in pomegranates and certain other fruits and nuts such as strawberries, walnut kernels, and peanuts, with ellagitannins serving as their precursors. As a member of this family, Urolithin A has attracted considerable research attention due to its pharmacological effects, encompassing anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging properties, and it is a primary focus of research into muscle health and performance.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A（UA）是一種天然存在的化合物，歸類於 urolithins（尿石素）家族，這是一類當膳食多酚在胃腸道中被處理時所形成的腸道菌叢衍生代謝物。該綜述將 urolithins 描述為存在於石榴與某些其他水果和堅果（如草莓、核桃仁與花生）中的化合物，以 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）作為其前驅物。作為此家族的一員，Urolithin A 因其藥理作用（涵蓋抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗衰老特性）而吸引了相當多的研究關注，且它是肌肉健康與表現研究的主要焦點。

label: ATP synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can promote the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, thereby improving the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells. ATP is the primary energy molecule for muscle cells and is crucial for muscle contraction and exercise performance. By promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism, urolithin A increases the energy supply to muscle cells, improving endurance, strength, and recovery, and providing sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，從而改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率。ATP 是肌肉細胞的主要能量分子，對肌肉收縮與運動表現至關重要。透過促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝，urolithin A 增加對肌肉細胞的能量供應，改善耐力、力量與恢復，並在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持。

label: CDK
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can regulate the cell cycle by inhibiting the activity of cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) and reducing the expression of cell cycle proteins such as cyclin D1, leading to cell cycle arrest in the G1 phase. It also increases the levels of cell cycle inhibitory proteins such as p21 and p27. This cell-cycle control, achieved through modulation of CDK activity and cyclin expression, contributes to urolithin A's reported antiproliferative activity and to its effects on cell cycle-related protein kinase complexes.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可透過抑制 cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) 的活性並降低如 cyclin D1 等細胞週期蛋白的表現，來調節細胞週期，導致 G1 期細胞週期停滯。它亦提升如 p21 與 p27 等細胞週期抑制蛋白的水平。此透過調控 CDK 活性與 cyclin 表現而達成的細胞週期控制，有助於 urolithin A 被報導的抗增殖活性，以及其對細胞週期相關蛋白激酶複合體的效應。

label: Bax/Bcl-2 ratio
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A induces apoptosis by increasing the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, which results in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. Modulation of the pro-apoptotic to anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family ratio is a classical intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis trigger. It represents one of the several mechanisms through which urolithin A promotes programmed cell death, in addition to its activation of JNK and p38 MAPK signaling.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值誘導凋亡，此比值升高導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。調節促凋亡與抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族比值，是經典的內在（粒線體）凋亡觸發因子。這代表了 urolithin A 促進程序性細胞死亡的數種機制之一，此外還包括其對 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 訊號的活化。

label: Ellagitannins
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A is a natural metabolite derived from ellagitannins, polyphenolic precursors found in pomegranate, walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry. During digestion, microbial enzymes in the colon convert ellagitannins through stepwise enzymatic and metabolic reactions to yield urolithin A. Because ellagitannin intake is a precondition for urolithin A formation, dietary consumption of ellagitannin-rich foods supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A and increasing its systemic availability.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是一種源自 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）的天然代謝物，後者為存在於石榴、核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓中的多酚類前驅物。在消化期間，結腸中的微生物酵素透過逐步的酵素與代謝反應將 ellagitannins 轉化以產生 urolithin A。由於 ellagitannin 攝取是 urolithin A 形成的先決條件，飲食攝取富含 ellagitannin 的食物提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成並增加其全身性可用性。

label: Muscle Hypertrophy
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A may have a positive impact on muscle hypertrophy and maintenance of muscle mass through multiple pathways, including promotion of muscle cell repair and growth, enhancement of mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, and regulation of protein synthesis and degradation processes. It can increase the cross-sectional area of muscle fibers, muscle protein content, and muscle strength, thus promoting muscle hypertrophy. Current research is still limited and mostly conducted in vitro or in animal experiments, so human studies are needed.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑對肌肉肥大與肌肉量維持產生正面影響，包括促進肌肉細胞修復與生長、增強粒線體功能與能量代謝，以及調節蛋白質合成與降解過程。它可增加肌纖維橫截面積、肌肉蛋白含量與肌肉力量，從而促進肌肉肥大。目前研究仍有限且多為體外或動物實驗，因此需要人體研究。

label: TLR3
description: TLR3 is an endosomal toll-like receptor that recognizes double-stranded RNA and signals exclusively through the TRIF adaptor. Urolithin A, a gut-microbiome metabolite with anti-inflammatory activity, is studied for modulation of TLR signaling including the TLR3 pathway.
description_zh_TW: TLR3 是辨識雙股 RNA 並僅透過 TRIF 銜接蛋白訊號的內體 toll 樣受體。Urolithin A 是具有抗發炎活性的腸道微生物代謝物，被研究對包括 TLR3 途徑在內之 TLR 訊號的調控。

label: TRIF
description: TRIF is a cytoplasmic adaptor central to toll-like receptor signaling, serving as the exclusive adaptor for TLR3. Urolithin A, with its anti-inflammatory activity, is studied for modulation of the TRIF-dependent TLR signaling branch.
description_zh_TW: TRIF 是 toll 樣受體訊號中心的細胞質銜接蛋白，是 TLR3 的專屬銜接蛋白。Urolithin A 具有抗發炎活性，被研究對 TRIF 依賴 TLR 訊號分支的調控。

label: Muscle Atrophy
description: Muscle atrophy is the progressive loss of skeletal muscle mass that arises when protein degradation outpaces synthesis. Urolithin A, a mitophagy-inducing metabolite, is studied for its capacity to preserve muscle by supporting mitochondrial health and function.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉萎縮是蛋白質降解超過合成時發生的骨骼肌質量進行性喪失。Urolithin A 是誘導 mitophagy 的代謝物，被研究其透過支持粒線體健康與功能來保存肌肉的能力。

label: Low-level oxidative stress
description: Low-level oxidative stress activates mitohormesis, a beneficial adaptive response in which transient ROS upregulate DNA repair, antioxidant defenses, and autophagy to improve resilience. This explains the paradoxical benefits of mild mitochondrial stress. The directionality is mild oxidant to adaptive reprogramming. A caveat is that the benefit is strictly dose-dependent; higher oxidative stress overwhelms the response and becomes damaging, the classic hormetic inverted-U. Exercise, caloric restriction, and some phytochemicals harness mitohormesis to improve metabolic and neurological health.
description_zh_TW: Low-level oxidative stress 活化 mitohormesis，這是一種有益的適應性反應，其中短暫的 ROS 上調 DNA 修復、抗氧化防禦和自噬，以提高恢復能力。這解釋了輕度 mitochondria1 壓力的矛盾好處。方向性是適應性重編程的溫和氧化劑。需要注意的是，其益處嚴格依賴劑量。更高的 oxidative stress 壓倒了反應並成為 damaging，經典的毒效劑倒 U 型。運動、熱量限制和一些植物化學物質利用 mitohormesis 來改善代謝和神經系統健康。

label: NLRP3 inflammasome assembly
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: ROS trigger NLRP3 inflammasome assembly by promoting the conformational changes and ASC speck formation needed for caspase-1 activation. Mitochondrial ROS and oxidized mitochondrial DNA are particularly implicated as upstream signals. The directionality is oxidant to inflammasome activation. A caveat is that NLRP3 is also activated by non-ROS stimuli (ATP, nigericin, crystals), so ROS is a common but not exclusive trigger. ROS derived from both NOX enzymes and mitochondria converge on NLRP3, linking metabolic and inflammatory stress to IL-1beta production.
description_zh_TW: ROS 透過促進 caspase-1 活化所需的構象變化和 ASC 斑點形成來觸發 NLRP3 inflammasome assembly。 Mitochondrial ROS 和氧化的 mitochondrial DNA 作為上游訊號尤其受到牽連。方向性是發炎小體活化的氧化劑。需要注意的是，NLRP3 也會被非 ROS 刺激（ATP、尼日利亞黴素、晶體）激活，因此 ROS 是一種常見但非排他性的觸發器。源自 NOX 酶的 ROS 和 mitochondria 匯聚於 NLRP3，將代謝和發炎壓力與 IL-1beta 的產生連結起來。

label: Integrated Stress Response
description: A major advance in mitohormesis research was the discovery that diverse mitochondrial stressors activate the ISR. The pathway is initiated when mitochondrial stress activates the OMA1 protease, which cleaves DELE1 to generate a cytosolic fragment (DELE1-S) that binds and activates HRI, one of the four eIF2alpha kinases. HRI then phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, reducing global protein synthesis while allowing preferential translation of ATF4. This mitochondrial-ISR connection establishes a defined signaling axis by which mild mitochondrial dysfunction produces a protective transcriptional and metabolic response characteristic of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應研究的一個重大進展是發現多種粒線體壓力源會活化整合壓力反應（ISR）。該途徑在粒線體壓力活化 OMA1 蛋白酶時啟動，OMA1 切割 DELE1 產生細胞質片段（DELE1-S），後者結合並活化 HRI（四個 eIF2alpha 激酶之一）。HRI 隨後磷酸化翻譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，減少整體蛋白質合成，同時允許 ATF4 的優先翻譯。這種粒線體-ISR 連結建立了一個明確的訊號軸，透過該軸，輕度粒線體功能障礙產生具有粒線體促效應特徵的保護性轉錄和代謝反應。

label: MTHFD2
description: Analysis of mice expressing a mutant mitochondrial helicase Twinkle, which develop progressive respiratory chain dysfunction and COX-deficient fibers in skeletal muscle, revealed coordinated induction of metabolic genes including MTHFD2, a mitochondrial one-carbon enzyme highly expressed during development and in tumors but normally low in adult tissues. This induction depended on a conserved amino acid response element (AARE) in the proximal promoter that binds C/EBP and ATF family transcription factors. MTHFD2 induction links mitochondrial dysfunction to serine-driven one-carbon and folate metabolism supporting purine and thymidine synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 對表達突變粒線體解旋酶 Twinkle 的小鼠的分析（這些小鼠會發展出進行性呼吸鏈功能障礙和骨骼肌中 COX 缺陷的纖維）顯示，包括 MTHFD2 在內的代謝基因被協調誘導，MTHFD2 是一種粒線體一碳酶，在發育和腫瘤中高表達，但在成人組織中通常低表達。這種誘導依賴於啟動子近端中保守的胺基酸反應元件（AARE），AARE 結合 C/EBP 和 ATF 家族轉錄因子。MTHFD2 誘導將粒線體功能障礙與絲氨酸驅動的一碳和葉酸代謝相連結，支持嘌呤和胸苷的合成。

label: Pathogen Infection
description: Bacteria secrete a wide array of diffusible proteinaceous toxins to fend off competing bacterial species, and a survey of over 500 bacterial species suggests a significant fraction secrete factors that influence host mitochondrial function. In organisms such as C. elegans, this mitochondrial dysfunction is sensed at least in part by the UPRmt, which activates a stress-induced pathway necessary for host defense. Widely used antibiotics like tetracyclines impose a low level of mitochondrial stress on eukaryotic cells, suggesting that hormetic mitochondrial stress responses can be employed for therapeutic benefit in pathogen challenge.
description_zh_TW: 細菌分泌各種各樣的可擴散蛋白質毒素來抵禦競爭的細菌物種，對超過 500 種細菌物種的調查表明，很大一部分分泌影響宿主粒線體功能的因子。在 C. elegans 等生物體中，這種粒線體功能障礙至少部分由 UPRmt 感知，UPRmt 活化宿主防禦所必需的壓力誘導途徑。廣泛使用的抗生素如四環素類對真核細胞施加低水平的粒線體壓力，表明促效應粒線體壓力反應可用於病原體挑戰中的治療益處。

label: Mitochondrial protein import
description: The emerging theme from many studies is that protein import or processing is used as a readout of mitochondrial health and a signal to induce a hormetic response. Nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins enter through the TOM complex aided by cytosolic chaperones including HSP70 and HSP90, and impaired import can trigger quality control pathways such as mitoTAD, mitoCPR, and mitoRQC that extract, ubiquitinate, and degrade stalled precursor proteins via the proteasome, in a process coordinated by transcription factors HSF1, RPN4, and PDR3 in yeast. In mammals, defects in mitochondrial protein import can produce both protein and metabolic disruption, for instance non-imported citrate synthase functioning in the cytosol.
description_zh_TW: 許多研究的新興主題是，蛋白質輸入或加工被用作粒線體健康的讀數和誘導促效應反應的訊號。核編碼的粒線體蛋白透過 TOM 複合體進入，輔以包括 HSP70 和 HSP90 在內的細胞質分子伴護，受損的輸入可觸發品質控制途徑如 mitoTAD、mitoCPR 和 mitoRQC，這些途徑提取、泛素化並透過蛋白酶體降解停滯的前體蛋白，此過程在酵母中由轉錄因子 HSF1、RPN4 和 PDR3 協調。在哺乳動物中，粒線體蛋白輸入的缺陷可同時產生蛋白質和代謝紊亂，例如未輸入的檸檬酸合酶在細胞質中發揮功能。

label: EREG
description: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

label: Heat Shock Proteins
description: Heat shock proteins are a conserved family of molecular chaperones induced by proteotoxic, thermal, oxidative, and exercise stress. Their expression is coordinated transcriptionally by heat shock factor HSF1, which binds heat-shock elements to drive HSP induction.
description_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白是保守的分子伴護蛋白家族，由蛋白毒性、熱、氧化與運動壓力誘導。其表現由熱休克因子 HSF1 在轉錄層面協調，HSF1 結合熱休克元件驅動 HSP 誘導。

label: WNT16B
description: WNT16B is a Wnt family ligand induced and secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP, where it promotes paracrine therapy resistance in adjacent cancer cells. Apigenin treatment reduces WNT16B expression dose-dependently.
description_zh_TW: WNT16B 是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分誘導並分泌的 Wnt 家族配體，在相鄰癌細胞中促進旁分泌治療抗藥性。Apigenin 治療以劑量依賴方式降低 WNT16B 表現。

label: miR-24
description: XIAP is downregulated by miR-24. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-24 is a microRNA that targets several anti-apoptotic and cell-cycle mRNAs, including XIAP, to lower the death threshold. The directionality runs from miR-24 toward XIAP, so miR-24 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: XIAP 被 miR-24 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-24 是一種 microRNA，可針對多種抗凋亡和細胞週期 mRNA（包括 XIAP），以降低死亡閾值。方向性從 miR-24 向 XIAP，因此 miR-24 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: miR-7
description: XIAP is downregulated by miR-7. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-7 is a microRNA with tumor-suppressive roles that downregulates survival proteins such as XIAP and EGFR signaling. The directionality runs from miR-7 toward XIAP, so miR-7 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: XIAP 被 miR-7 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-7 是一種具有腫瘤抑製作用的 microRNA，可下調 XIAP 和 EGFR 訊號等存活蛋白。方向性從 miR-7 朝向 XIAP，因此 miR-7 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: 5-FU
description: 5-FU (fluorouracil) is the infusional fluoropyrimidine backbone of rectal cancer chemoradiation, delivered as a radiosensitizer in neoadjuvant chemoradiation. It is standard for locally advanced rectal cancer. 5-FU is therefore central to the nCRT regimen.
description_zh_TW: 5-FU（氟尿嘧啶）是直腸癌化放療的輸注型氟嘧啶主幹，在新輔助化放療中作為放射增敏劑給藥。它是局部晚期直腸癌的標準治療。因此 5-FU 對 nCRT 方案至關重要。

label: Capecitabine
description: Capecitabine is an oral fluoropyrimidine prodrug used as a radiosensitizer in neoadjuvant chemoradiation for rectal cancer. It is an alternative to infusional 5-FU in the nCRT regimen. Capecitabine is therefore central to rectal cancer chemoradiation.
description_zh_TW: Capecitabine 是口服氟嘧啶前驅藥，用作直腸癌新輔助化放療中的放射增敏劑。它是 nCRT 方案中輸注 5-FU 的替代品。因此 Capecitabine 對直腸癌化放療至關重要。

label: SMAD4
description: Deletion of SMAD4 (and neighboring DCC) on chromosome 18q disrupts TGF-beta signaling, enabling escape from growth-inhibitory signals in late adenomas. SMAD4 loss is a step in the Vogelstein model of colon cancer. It contributes to progression toward invasive carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: 18q 上 SMAD4（及相鄰的 DCC）的刪除會擾亂 TGF-β 訊號傳導，使晚期腺瘤得以逃脫生長抑制訊號。SMAD4 缺失是結腸癌 Vogelstein 模型中的一個步驟。它促成向侵襲性癌的進展。

label: Wnt Signaling
description: Colon Cancer is driven by Wnt Signaling. Constitutive Wnt/β-catenin signaling—initiated by APC loss—is the initiating driver in the majority of sporadic colon cancers, leading to dysplastic aberrant crypt foci and progression along the adenoma-carcinoma sequence.
description_zh_TW: 大腸癌（Colon Cancer）由 Wnt 訊息傳遞（Wnt Signaling）所驅動。由 APC 缺失所啟動的持續 Wnt/β-catenin 訊息傳遞是多數散發性大腸癌的起始驅動因子，導致發育不良的異常隱窩病灶，並沿腺瘤-癌序列進展。

label: anti-inflammatory effects
description: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。

label: homocysteine to methionine
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

label: two forms
description: COMT exists in two major isoforms produced by alternative translation initiation: a soluble form (S-COMT) found predominantly in peripheral tissues such as liver, kidney, and erythrocytes, and a membrane-bound form (MB-COMT) anchored to the Golgi that predominates in the brain. MB-COMT has higher affinity for catechol substrates and is the principal neuronal isoform. This tissue-specific distribution explains why central and peripheral catechol metabolism are differentially affected by COMT genotype and inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: COMT 存在於由替代翻譯起始產生的兩種主要異構體中：主要存在於 peripheral tissues（如肝、腎和紅血球）中的可溶形式 (S-COMT)，以及錨定在高爾基體上的膜結合形式 (MB-COMT)，主要存在於 brain 中。 MB-COMT 對兒茶酚底物具有較高的親和力，是主要的神經元亞型。這種組織特異性分佈解釋了為什麼 COMT genotype 和抑制劑對中樞和周邊兒茶酚代謝的影響不同。

label: COMT variants
description: COMT genetic variants may influence susceptibility to Bipolar II Disorder, based on the enzyme's role in catecholamine regulation and interactions with folate-cycle genes such as MTHFR and MTHFD1. Association studies report modest, inconsistent effects, suggesting at most a small contribution to risk relative to the complex genetic architecture of the disorder. Catecholaminergic dysregulation is plausibly relevant to mood cycling and hypomania, but COMT is not a major determinant of the bipolar phenotype. It is typically studied jointly with methylation-pathway genes in mood disorder genetics.
description_zh_TW: 基於此酵素在兒茶酚胺調節中的作用以及與 folate 循環基因（例如 MTHFR 和 MTHFD1）的相互作用，COMT 遺傳變異可能會影響 Bipolar II Disorder 的易感性。關聯研究報告了適度且不一致的影響，顯示相對於該疾病的複雜遺傳結構，至多對風險的貢獻很小。兒茶酚胺能失調似乎與情緒循環和輕躁症有關，但 COMT 並不是雙極性情感疾患表型的主要決定因素。它通常與情緒障礙遺傳學中的甲基化途徑基因進行聯合研究。

label: Epinephrine levels
description: COMT inhibition increases epinephrine (adrenaline) levels because O-methylation to metanephrine is blocked, prolonging epinephrine signaling and allowing accumulation of the parent catecholamine. Clinically, COMT inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone used as adjuncts to levodopa in Parkinson's disease raise circulating catecholamines, which is therapeutically useful for motor symptoms but can cause adrenergic side effects. The directionality is straightforward: less enzymatic inactivation yields higher epinephrine. This relationship also connects COMT blockade to downstream oxidative products such as adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制會增加腎上腺素（腎上腺素）水平，因為 O-甲基化為變腎上腺素被阻斷，從而延長腎上腺素信號傳導並允許母體兒茶酚胺積累。臨床上，COMT 抑制劑（例如恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋）用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，可提高循環 catecholamines，這對運動症狀有治療作用，但可能引起腎上腺素能副作用。方向性很簡單：較少的酵素失活會產生較高的腎上腺素。這種關係也將 COMT 阻斷與下游氧化產物（例如腎上腺素紅）聯繫起來。

label: impulsivity
description: COMT overexpression increases impulsivity in mice, measured as more premature responses in operant tasks, reflecting altered prefrontal and striatal catechol signaling that governs response inhibition. The phenotype aligns with the idea that excessive dopamine clearance perturbs the balance of impulsive and compulsive behaviors, and mirrors traits associated with fast human COMT genotypes. Effect sizes in animal models are moderate and task-dependent, but the causal manipulation strengthens the interpretation. The behavioral change is consistent with reduced dopamine-mediated inhibitory control.
description_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現會增加小鼠的 impulsivity，測量為操作任務中更多的過早反應，反映了控制反應抑制的前額葉和紋狀體兒茶酚訊號的改變。該表型與過多的多巴胺清除擾亂衝動和強迫行為的平衡的觀點相一致，並反映了與快速人類 COMT 基因型相關的特徵。動物模型中的效應大小適中且依賴任務，但因果操作加強了解釋。行為變化與多巴胺介導的抑制控制的減少一致。

label: striatal dopamine release
description: COMT overexpression increases striatal dopamine release capacity, observed in COMT-OE mice as enhanced phasic dopamine signaling in the striatum. The mechanism is thought to involve homeostatic upregulation of dopamine synthesis and release in response to chronically low extracellular dopamine tone produced by excess clearance. This contrasts with the cognitive deficits also seen in these mice, illustrating region-specific effects of COMT activity on striatal versus prefrontal dopamine systems. The finding helps dissociate the motor and cognitive consequences of COMT excess.
description_zh_TW: COMT 過度表現增加了 striatal dopamine release 的能力，在 COMT-OE 小鼠中觀察到，紋狀體中的階段性多巴胺訊號傳導增強。該機制被認為涉及多巴胺合成和釋放的穩態上調，以響應因過度清除而產生的長期較低的細胞外多巴胺張力。這與這些小鼠中也觀察到的認知缺陷形成鮮明對比，說明 COMT activity 對紋狀體多巴胺系統與前額葉多巴胺系統的區域特異性影響。這項發現有助於區分 COMT 過量對運動和認知的影響。

label: methyl groups from SAMe
description: COMT requires methyl groups derived from S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe), the universal methyl donor generated by the methionine cycle, to methylate catechol substrates. Each catalytic turnover consumes one SAMe molecule, coupling COMT flux tightly to the cellular methyl budget and to folate- and B12-dependent remethylation that regenerates methionine and SAMe. This dependence means COMT activity is sensitive to overall methyl donor availability, including diet, supplementation, and genetic variants affecting one-carbon metabolism. It also explains why excess methyl donors can be poorly tolerated when COMT activity is already slow.
description_zh_TW: COMT 需要源自 S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe) 的 methyl groups（由蛋胺酸循環產生的通用 methyl donor）來甲基化兒茶酚底物。每次催化轉換消耗一個 SAMe 分子，將 COMT 通量與細胞甲基預算以及 folate 和 B12 依賴性再甲基化緊密耦合，從而再生蛋氨酸和 SAMe。這種依賴性意味著 COMT activity 對 methyl donor 的整體可用性敏感，包括飲食、補充劑和影響一碳代謝的遺傳變異。這也解釋了為什麼當 COMT activity 已經很慢時，過量的甲基供體的耐受性很差。

label: increased striatal dopamine release
description: COMT-OE (overexpression) mice display increased striatal dopamine release, a homeostatic adaptation to constitutively elevated COMT activity that lowers baseline extracellular dopamine. This enhanced release capacity manifests as greater phasic dopamine responses in the striatum, likely reflecting compensatory upregulation of dopamine synthesis and releasable pools. The finding helps dissociate the motor and striatal effects from the cognitive and prefrontal consequences of COMT excess. It illustrates how the brain compensates for chronically altered catecholamine clearance.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE（過度表達）小鼠表現出 increased striatal dopamine release，這是對持續升高的 COMT activity 的穩態適應，可降低基線細胞外多巴胺。這種增強的釋放能力表現為紋狀體中更大的階段性多巴胺反應，可能反映了多巴胺合成和可釋放池的補償性上調。這項發現有助於將運動和紋狀體的影響與 COMT 過量的認知和前額葉後果分開。它說明了 brain 如何補償長期改變的兒茶酚胺清除率。

label: increased compulsive behavior
description: COMT-OE mice show increased compulsive behavior, reflected in more perseverative responses, indicating that excess COMT activity shifts the impulsive-compulsive balance toward perseveration. This suggests COMT tone influences the tuning of habit and repetitive-behavior circuits, particularly in the striatum and prefrontal cortex. The observation extends the behavioral phenotyping of COMT overexpression beyond cognition and impulsivity. It is relevant to disorders characterized by compulsivity and rigid behavioral patterns.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased compulsive behavior，反映在更堅持不懈的反應中，顯示過量的 COMT activity 會使衝動-強迫平衡轉向堅持。這表明 COMT 音調影響習慣和重複行為迴路的調節，特別是在紋狀體和前額葉皮質。此觀察結果將 COMT 過度表現的行為表型擴展到認知和 impulsivity 之外。它與以強迫性和僵化行為模式為特徵的疾病有關。

label: increased impulsive behavior
description: COMT-OE mice show increased impulsive behavior, quantified as more premature responses in timed operant tasks, consistent with catecholaminergic perturbation of inhibitory control circuits in prefrontal and striatal regions. This mirrors impulsivity-related traits linked to fast COMT in humans, such as risk-taking and rapid decision-making under time pressure. The phenotype is reversible by manipulations that restore dopamine signaling, supporting causality rather than confounded effects. It extends the COMT-OE behavioral profile beyond cognition into impulse control.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 increased impulsive behavior，量化為定時操作任務中更多的過早反應，與前額葉和紋狀體區域抑制控制迴路的兒茶酚胺能擾動一致。這反映了與快速 COMT in humans 相關的 impulsivity 相關特徵，例如在時間壓力下承擔風險和快速決策。透過恢復多巴胺訊號傳導的操作，表型是可逆的，支持因果關係而不是混雜效應。它將 COMT-OE 行為特徵從認知擴展到衝動控制。

label: specific cognitive deficits
description: COMT-OE mice show specific cognitive deficits, particularly in stimulus-response learning and working memory, attributable to excess catecholamine clearance that reduces dopamine availability in prefrontal and striatal circuits. These deficits model the cognitive endophenotype associated with fast human COMT genotypes, providing a causal link between enzyme activity and cognition. The specificity, rather than global impairment, supports a circuit-level rather than generalized effect of COMT overexpression. Such models are central to translating COMT genetics into mechanistic understanding.
description_zh_TW: COMT-OE 小鼠表現出 specific cognitive deficits，特別是 stimulus-response learning 和工作記憶，這是由於兒茶酚胺清除過多，減少了前額葉和紋狀體迴路中多巴胺的可用性。這些缺陷模擬了與快速人類 COMT 基因型相關的認知內表型，提供了酶活性和認知之間的因果關係。 COMT 過度表現的特異性（而不是全局損傷）支持電路水平而非普遍效應。這些模型對於將 COMT 遺傳學轉化為機械理解至關重要。

label: Entacapone
description: Entacapone is a peripherally acting COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease to block the O-methylation of levodopa, prolonging its plasma half-life and brain availability. By inhibiting COMT, it raises levodopa and catecholamine levels, improving motor fluctuations and reducing off time. Unlike tolcapone, entacapone has minimal central nervous system penetration, which reduces the risk of hepatotoxicity. It exemplifies the therapeutic use of peripheral COMT blockade in dopaminergic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Entacapone 是一種外周作用的 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，阻斷左旋多巴的 O-甲基化，延長其血漿半衰期和 brain 的可用性。透過抑制 COMT，它可以提高左旋多巴和兒茶酚胺水平，改善運動波動並減少休息時間。與託卡朋不同，恩他卡朋具有最小的中樞神經系統滲透性，從而降低了肝毒性的風險。它例證了外周 COMT 阻斷在多巴胺能治療中的治療用途。

label: Green tea
description: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially the catechin epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), which constitutes a major fraction of its antioxidant and bioactive content. EGCG is subsequently metabolized by COMT, linking green tea consumption to COMT-dependent pharmacokinetics, with slow genotypes clearing it more slowly. The high EGCG content is the basis for many of green tea's studied health effects, including antioxidant, metabolic, and neuroprotective actions. At dietary intake levels it does not significantly inhibit COMT in humans.
description_zh_TW: Green tea 富含多酚，尤其是兒茶素表沒食子兒茶素沒食子酸酯 (EGCG)，它構成了其抗氧化劑和生物活性成分的主要部分。 EGCG 隨後被 COMT 代謝，將綠茶攝取與 COMT 依賴性藥物動力學聯繫起來，而慢基因型清除它的速度更慢。 EGCG 的高含量是綠茶許多健康功效研究的基礎，包括抗氧化、代謝和神經保護作用。在飲食攝取量下，它不會顯著抑制 COMT in humans。

label: flavanone
description: Hesperidin is classified as a flavanone, a subclass of flavonoids characterized by a saturated C-ring and the absence of the catechol motif, distinguishing it from catechol flavonoids such as quercetin or luteolin. This structural class determines its metabolic fate and its lack of interaction with COMT, since it cannot serve as a substrate or inhibitor of the enzyme. Its glycosidic form is abundant in citrus peels and juices, where it contributes to antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity. The absence of vicinal hydroxyl groups is the key to its COMT neutrality.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 被歸類為 flavanone，是類黃酮的亞類，其特徵是具有飽和的 C 環且不存在兒茶酚基序，從而將其與槲皮素或木犀草素等兒茶酚類黃酮區分開來。這種結構類別決定了它的代謝命運以及它與 COMT 相互作用的缺乏，因為它不能充當酶的底物或抑制劑。它的糖苷形式在柑橘皮和果汁中含量豐富，有助於抗氧化和抗炎活性。鄰位羥基的缺失是其 COMT 中性的關鍵。

label: brain
description: MB-COMT (membrane-bound COMT) predominates in the brain, where its membrane-anchored localization near catechol release sites allows efficient perisynaptic O-methylation of dopamine and norepinephrine. This makes MB-COMT the major determinant of central COMT activity and of the genotype-dependent cognitive effects associated with Val158Met. Peripheral tissues instead rely more on the soluble S-COMT isoform, which has lower substrate affinity. This regional isoform distribution explains why COMT genotype affects brain and periphery differently.
description_zh_TW: MB-COMT（膜結合型 COMT）在 brain 中占主導地位，其在兒茶酚釋放位點附近的膜錨定定位允許多巴胺和 norepinephrine 進行有效的突觸周圍 O-甲基化。這使得 MB-COMT 成為中樞 COMT activity 以及與 Val158Met 相關的基因型依賴性認知效應的主要決定因素。相反，週邊組織更依賴可溶性 S-COMT 亞型，其底物親和力較低。這種區域亞型分佈解釋了為什麼 COMT genotype 對 brain 和周邊細胞的影響不同。

label: MTHFR variants
description: MTHFR genetic variants may influence susceptibility to Bipolar II Disorder through their effects on methyl donor availability and catecholamine-related epigenetic regulation, though associations are modest and inconsistent. Altered folate metabolism could perturb monoamine signaling relevant to mood cycling and hypomania, complementing COMT's role in catecholamine clearance. COMT and MTHFR are often studied jointly as candidate genes in bipolar genetics, reflecting shared effects on the methylation cycle. The combined contribution is small relative to the disorder's overall genetic architecture.
description_zh_TW: MTHFR 遺傳變異可能透過影響 methyl donor 的可用性和兒茶酚胺相關的表觀遺傳調控來影響對 Bipolar II Disorder 的易感性，儘管相關性有限且不一致。 folate 代謝的改變可能會擾亂與情緒週期和輕躁症相關的單胺訊號傳導，補充 COMT 在兒茶酚胺清除中的作用。 COMT 和 MTHFR 經常作為雙相遺傳學中的候選基因聯合研究，反映了對 methylation cycle 的共同影響。相對於該疾病的整體遺傳結構，綜合貢獻很小。

label: cofactor for COMT
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Magnesium is a required cofactor for COMT, with the enzyme's catalytic activity depending on divalent cations, magnesium prominently, to coordinate SAMe and the catechol substrate during methyl transfer. Magnesium deficiency can reduce COMT efficiency and impair catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetically slow COMT variants. Ensuring magnesium adequacy is a common recommendation for supporting healthy COMT activity in personalized protocols. It is a nutritional lever that directly affects enzyme catalysis.
description_zh_TW: Magnesium 是必需的 cofactor for COMT，該酶的催化活性取決於二價陽離子（主要是鎂），以在甲基轉移過程中協調 SAMe 和兒茶酚底物。 Magnesium 缺乏會降低 COMT 效率並損害兒茶酚胺清除率，加劇了遺傳性緩慢的 COMT variants 的影響。確保鎂充足是在個人化方案中支援健康 COMT activity 的常見建議。它是直接影響酵素催化作用的營養槓桿。

label: Opicapone
description: Opicapone is a third-generation, peripherally restricted COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease, with a long duration of action allowing once-daily dosing. By blocking COMT-mediated O-methylation of levodopa, it prolongs levodopa availability and reduces motor fluctuations and off time, improving motor symptom control. Its minimal brain penetration lowers the hepatotoxicity risk seen with tolcapone, and it is generally well tolerated. It represents the evolution of COMT inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in dopaminergic therapy.
description_zh_TW: Opicapone 是第三代外周限制性 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，作用持續時間長，允許每日一次給藥。透過阻斷 COMT 介導的左旋多巴 O-甲基化，它可以延長左旋多巴的有效性並減少運動波動和停頓時間，從而改善運動症狀控制。其最小的 brain 滲透降低了託卡朋的肝毒性風險，並且通常具有良好的耐受性。它代表了 COMT 抑製作為多巴胺能治療策略的演變。

label: COMT inhibitor supplements
description: Slow COMT individuals are sensitive to COMT inhibitor supplements, such as high-dose catechol flavonoids, because further reducing an already low COMT activity can excessively elevate catecholamines, risking adrenergic and mood side effects. Unlike fast individuals, they have little spare clearance capacity to absorb additional enzyme inhibition. This argues for caution with concentrated catechols such as quercetin, luteolin, and EGCG in slow genotypes. The sensitivity is dose-dependent and genotype-specific.
description_zh_TW: 慢COMT個體對COMT inhibitor supplements敏感，例如高劑量兒茶酚黃酮類化合物，因為進一步減少已經存在的low COMT activity可能會過度升高catecholamines，從而存在腎上腺素能和情緒副作用的風險。與快速個體不同，它們幾乎沒有多餘的清除能力來吸收額外的酵素抑制。這表明在慢基因型中應謹慎使用濃縮兒茶酚，例如槲皮素、木犀草素和 EGCG。敏感性具有劑量依賴性和基因型特異性。

label: methylated vitamins
description: Slow COMT individuals are sensitive to methylated vitamins such as methylcobalamin and methylfolate because their reduced enzyme activity already leaves them with elevated catecholamine tone and a higher methyl burden, so additional methyl donors can push methylation beyond the optimal range and provoke mood effects. This sensitivity is the rationale for preferring non-methylated B12 forms and folinic acid in this group. The effect is dose- and genotype-dependent, with slow individuals reacting at lower doses. It is a core consideration in personalized supplementation.
description_zh_TW: 緩慢的 COMT 個體對 methylated vitamins（例如甲鈷胺和甲基葉酸）敏感，因為它們降低的酶活性已經使它們的兒茶酚胺張力升高和甲基負擔更高，因此額外的甲基供體可以將甲基化推到最佳範圍之外並引發情緒影響。這種敏感性是首選非甲基化 B12 形式和亞葉酸的基本原理。這種效應是劑量和基因型依賴性的，個體在較低劑量下反應較慢。這是個人化補充的核心考量。

label: EGCG more slowly
description: Slow COMT individuals metabolize EGCG more slowly because their reduced COMT activity delays O-methylation and excretion of this catechin, prolonging its plasma and tissue exposure. This altered pharmacokinetics can enhance both beneficial antioxidant effects and any inhibitory competition with endogenous catechols at the enzyme. Genotype thus modulates the dose-response of EGCG supplementation, with slow individuals potentially experiencing greater exposure. It is a clear example of COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 個體代謝 EGCG more slowly 較慢，因為 COMT activity 的減少會延遲兒茶素的 O-甲基化和排泄，延長其血漿和組織暴露時間。這種改變的藥物動力學可以增強有益的抗氧化作用以及與內源性兒茶酚在酵素上的任何抑制性競爭。因此，基因型調節 EGCG supplementation 的劑量反應，緩慢的個體可能會經歷更大的暴露。這是 COMT 依賴的多酚配置的明顯例子。

label: estrogen metabolite clearance
description: Slow COMT slows the clearance of certain estrogen metabolites, specifically catecholestrogens such as 2- and 4-hydroxyestrogens, because COMT O-methylation is the key detoxification step converting them to less genotoxic methoxyestrogens. Impaired clearance may increase exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones, a hypothesized risk factor for hormone-sensitive cancers. This links COMT genotype to estrogen-related disease susceptibility and to interactions with compounds like vitamin E. It is among the most clinically relevant consequences of slow COMT.
description_zh_TW: 緩慢的 COMT 會減慢某些雌激素代謝物的清除，特別是兒茶酚雌激素，如 2- 和 4- 羥基雌激素，因為 COMT O-甲基化是將它們轉化為遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素的關鍵解毒步驟。清除受損可能會增加活性兒茶酚雌激素醌的暴露，這是激素敏感癌症的假設危險因子。這將 COMT genotype 與雌激素相關疾病的易感性以及與維生素 E 等化合物的相互作用聯繫起來。這是緩慢的 COMT 與臨床最相關的後果之一。

label: COMT Val allele
description: The COMT Val allele is associated with increased schizophrenia risk in some populations, particularly through its effect on prefrontal dopamine signaling and possibly gene-environment interactions. Meta-analyses support a modest but significant association, which is stronger in certain ethnic groups and clinical subgroups, reflecting heterogeneity in genetic background. The biological rationale is that excessive dopamine catabolism in fast COMT may disrupt prefrontal networks implicated in the disorder, consistent with the dopamine hypothesis. The effect is small relative to the overall genetic architecture of schizophrenia.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val allele 與某些人群中精神分裂症風險增加有關，特別是透過其對前額多巴胺訊號傳導以及可能的基因-環境交互作用的影響。薈萃分析支持一種適度但顯著的關聯，這種關聯在某些種族群體和臨床亞組中更為強烈，反映了遺傳背景的異質性。生物學原理是，快速 COMT 中過多的多巴胺分解代謝可能會破壞與疾病有關的前額葉網絡，這與多巴胺假說一致。相對於精神分裂症的整體遺傳結構，這種影響很小。

label: chromosome 22q11.21
description: The COMT gene is located on chromosome 22 at band q11.21, a locus also associated with the 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, which presents with cardiac, craniofacial, and psychiatric features. Its genomic position places it within a region subject to copy-number variation that can affect COMT dosage and enzyme levels, with hemizygosity influencing catecholamine metabolism in deletion carriers. The well-characterized Val158Met polymorphism (rs4680) at this locus is among the most studied functional variants in neuropsychiatry and pharmacogenetics. The locus therefore links structural chromosomal variation to catecholamine physiology.
description_zh_TW: COMT 基因位於 22 號染色體 q11.21 條帶上，該位點也與 22q11.2 缺失症候群相關，該症候群表現為心臟、顱顏和精神特徵。它的基因組位置將其置於一個受拷貝數變異影響的區域內，該變異可以影響 COMT 劑量和酶水平，其半合性影響缺失載體中的兒茶酚胺代謝。該位點的充分錶徵的 Val158Met 多態性 (rs4680) 是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學中研究最多的功能變異之一。因此，該基因座將結構染色體變異與兒茶酚胺生理學連結起來。

label: memory consolidation
description: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

label: spatial navigation
description: The hippocampus is involved in spatial navigation, functioning as a core component of the brain's allocentric mapping system via place cells and grid-cell inputs that encode location, direction, and trajectory. Dopamine and norepinephrine, modulated by hippocampal COMT, influence the precision of spatial memory and navigation. Damage to the hippocampus produces profound deficits in navigation and episodic memory, as seen in lesions and neurodegenerative disease. Its role in forming cognitive maps is among its best-established functions.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體參與 spatial navigation，透過編碼位置、方向和軌跡的位置細胞和網格細胞輸入，作為 brain 異中心映射系統的核心組件發揮作用。 Dopamine和norepinephrine受海馬COMT調製，影響空間記憶和導航的精確度。海馬體的損傷會導致導航和情景記憶的嚴重缺陷，如在病變和神經退化性疾病中所見。它在形成認知地圖方面的作用是其最完善的功能之一。

label: Tolcapone
description: Tolcapone is a potent COMT inhibitor used as an adjunct to levodopa in Parkinson's disease, blocking peripheral and central O-methylation of levodopa to extend its half-life and brain penetration. Its central activity improves motor fluctuations but carries a risk of rare, sometimes fatal hepatotoxicity, requiring liver enzyme monitoring. It exemplifies the therapeutic use of COMT blockade in dopaminergic therapy. Its central penetration distinguishes it from peripherally restricted inhibitors such as entacapone and opicapone.
description_zh_TW: Tolcapone 是一種有效的 COMT 抑制劑，用作帕金森氏症左旋多巴的輔助藥物，阻斷左旋多巴的周邊和中樞 O-甲基化，以延長其半衰期和 brain 滲透。其中樞活性可改善運動波動，但有罕見甚至致命的肝毒性風險，需要監測肝臟酵素。它例證了 COMT 阻斷劑在多巴胺能治療的治療用途。其中樞滲透使其有別於恩他卡朋和阿匹卡朋等周邊限制性抑制劑。

label: Antioxidant
description: Melatonin is described as a critical, mitochondria-targeted antioxidant whose endogenous production is maximized by ensuring complete darkness during sleep. Circadian alignment and sleep hygiene are presented as high-impact behaviors supporting the mitohormesis protocol, since deep sleep is when cellular repair and neural recovery occur. The document ties melatonin production to sleep quality, which in turn determines overnight HRV and recovery capacity, completing the loop between circadian biology, antioxidant defenses, and mitochondrial adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 褪黑激素被描述為一種關鍵的、以粒線體為標靶的抗氧化劑，其內源性生成可藉由確保睡眠期間完全黑暗而最大化。晝夜節律對齊與睡眠衛生被呈現為支持粒線體毒物興奮效應（mitohormesis）方案的高影響力行為，因為深度睡眠是細胞修復與神經恢復發生的時刻。該文件將褪黑激素生成與睡眠品質連結，而睡眠品質又決定整夜 HRV 與恢復能力，在晝夜節律生物學、抗氧化防禦與粒線體適應之間完成迴路。

label: Methionine
description: Methionine is the precursor of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe), the universal methyl donor used in methylation reactions throughout the body, including DNA and histone methylation. Dietary methionine deprivation may therefore impact physiology through changes in histone methylation resulting from decreased availability of methyl donors, providing a direct mechanistic link between dietary amino acid intake and the epigenome. Cells can preserve heterochromatic stability through upregulation of H3K9 methylation in the liver in response to methionine restriction. This methyl-donor pathway is a core mechanism by which methionine restriction recapitulates the benefits of protein restriction on metabolic health, frailty, and lifespan.
description_zh_TW: Methionine是S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe)的前體，SAMe是全身甲基化反應中使用的通用甲基供體，包括DNA和組蛋白甲基化。因此，飲食中methionine缺乏可能通過甲基供體可用性減少導致的組蛋白甲基化變化來影響生理功能，提供飲食氨基酸攝入與表觀基因組之間的直接機制聯繫。細胞可以通過在肝臟中上調H3K9甲基化來應對methionine限制，從而保持異染色質穩定性。這種甲基供體路徑是methionine限制重現蛋白質限制對代謝健康、虛弱和壽命益處的核心機制。

label: COMT at supplement doses
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Although animal and cell studies show EGCG to be an inhibitor of COMT, studies in humans give a different result. A study involving people with both fast and slow COMT variants showed that 750 mg of supplemental EGCG did not impair COMT activity. Research does show that people with slow COMT break down EGCG more slowly than people with fast COMT.
description_zh_TW: 雖然動物和細胞研究顯示 EGCG 是 COMT 的抑制劑，但人體研究給出不同的結果。一項涉及快速和緩慢 COMT 變異個體的研究顯示，750 毫克的補充 EGCG 不會損害 COMT activity。研究確實顯示緩慢 COMT 個體分解 EGCG 的速度比快速 COMT 個體慢。

label: Magnesium as cofactor
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Reactions using COMT include magnesium as a cofactor, so it is important to get plenty of magnesium in the diet or through a mineral supplement to support COMT function. Magnesium stabilizes the SAMe-substrate complex for efficient methyl transfer. This makes magnesium a practical nutritional lever for maintaining healthy COMT activity.
description_zh_TW: 使用 COMT 的反應包含鎂作為輔因子，因此在飲食中攝取足量鎂或透過礦物質補充劑來支持 COMT 功能很重要。鎂穩定 SAMe-受質複合物以實現有效的甲基轉移。這使鎂成為維持健康 COMT activity 的實用營養槓桿。

label: A53T
description: Alpha-synuclein and A53T are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Alpha-synuclein and A53T may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Glial cells
description: Glial cells and Neuroinflammation are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Glial cells and Neuroinflammation may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Glial cells 和 Neuroinflammation 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Glial cells 和 Neuroinflammation 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Pale Bodies
description: Pale Bodies and Lewy Bodies are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Pale Bodies and Lewy Bodies may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Pale Bodies 和 Lewy Bodies 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Pale Bodies 和 Lewy Bodies 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Lysosomal Dysfunction
