source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is a central mediator of healthspan and longevity: its activity declines with age as NAD+ falls, and genetic/pharmacologic (resveratrol, NAD+ precursors) activation extends lifespan in model organisms; SIRT1-dependent deacetylation of p53, FOXOs, and NF-κB underpins these effects (Giblin et al., 2014, Sirtuins: Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan; Satoh et al., 2013 brain-specific SIRT1-overexpression lifespan extension, PMID 24011076).
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是健康跨度和長壽的核心中介因子：隨著 NAD+ 下降，其活性隨年齡增長而降低，而基因/藥物（白藜蘆醇、NAD+ 前體）活化可在模式生物中延長壽命；SIRT1 依賴性的 p53、FOXOs 和 NF-κB 去乙醯化構成了這些效應的基礎（Giblin et al., 2014, Sirtuins: Guardians of Mammalian Healthspan; Satoh et al., 2013 大腦特異性 SIRT1 過表達延長壽命，PMID 24011076）。

label: stress responses
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is a central stress-response integrator that deacetylates p53, FOXO, NF-kB, and HIF to bias cells toward repair and survival, activates Nrf2 and antioxidant enzymes, and relocalizes to DNA-damage sites to support repair; these actions underpin SIRT1's stress resistance and longevity functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是一個核心的壓力反應整合因子，它去乙醯化 p53、FOXO、NF-kB 和 HIF，使細胞偏向修復和存活方向；活化 Nrf2 和抗氧化酶；並再定位至 DNA 損傷位點以支持修復；這些作用構成了 SIRT1 抗壓能力和長壽功能的基礎。

label: WRN
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates the Werner syndrome helicase WRN, linking SIRT1 to DNA repair and genomic stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 Werner 氏症候群解旋酶 WRN，將 SIRT1 與 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: H3K56
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K56 (Yang et al., 2009), a mark also touched by SIRT1; the node analysis flagged the missing direct SIRT6→H3K56 edge as a curation gap to fill in the next triples pass.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H3K56（Yang et al., 2009），此標記亦受 SIRT1 作用；節點分析將缺失的 SIRT6→H3K56 直接邊標記為應補回的策展缺口。

label: ChREBP
description: SIRT6 deacetylates ChREBP (alongside SREBP-1c) to maintain hepatic lipid homeostasis and oppose fatty liver disease. Loss of SIRT6 elevates fibrosis and oxidative stress in NASH mice in part through loss of ChREBP/SREBP-1c control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 ChREBP（與 SREBP-1c 並行）以維持肝臟脂質恆定並對抗脂肪肝。在 NASH 小鼠中 SIRT6 缺失會部分因失去 ChREBP/SREBP-1c 控制而加重纖維化與氧化壓力。

label: Ubiquinone
description: FSP1 catalyzes the reduction of oxidized ubiquinone (CoQ10) to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2) at the expense of NAD(P)H, regenerating the membrane-embedded radical-trapping antioxidant pool that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains during lipid peroxidation. This is mechanistically distinct from GPX4, which consumes Glutathione to repair pre-formed phospholipid hydroperoxides.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 利用 NAD(P)H 將氧化的泛醌（CoQ10）還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），重新生成膜內的自由基捕獲抗氧化劑池，終止脂質過氧化過程中的磷脂過氧自由基鏈。這在機制上不同於 GPX4——後者消耗 Glutathione 來修復已形成的磷脂氫過氧化物。

label: Statins
description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition by statins diverts mevalonate flux away from CoQ10, collapsing the ubiquinone pool; with no substrate to reduce, FSP1 cannot regenerate ubiquinol even with abundant NAD(P)H — so statins (like FIN56) sensitize to ferroptosis independently of GPX4 status.
description_zh_TW: Statins 對 HMG-CoA 還原酶的抑制使 mevalonate 流量偏離 CoQ10，使 ubiquinone 池崩潰；沒有受質可還原時，即使 NAD(P)H 充足 FSP1 也無法再生成 ubiquinol——因此 statins（如 FIN56）以不依賴 GPX4 狀態的方式使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

label: GDH (Glutamate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates GDH, promoting amino-acid-derived anaplerosis and gluconeogenesis (contrast SIRT4, which ADP-ribosylates and inhibits GDH).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化並活化 GDH（穀氨酸脫氫酶），促進氨基酸衍生的回補反應和糖質新生（與 SIRT4 形成對比，後者透過 ADP-核糖基化抑制 GDH）。

label: gene expression
description: Methyl-group transfers are among the most pervasive regulatory reactions in biology. DNA and histone methylation regulates gene expression without changing the DNA sequence, a process known as epigenetics. Methylation also governs chromatin state, signal transduction, xenobiotic clearance, and neurotransmitter metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Methyl groups 的轉移是生物學中最普遍的調節反應之一。DNA 和組蛋白甲基化在不改變 DNA 序列的情況下調節 gene expression，這個過程稱為表觀遺傳學。甲基化也調控染色質狀態、訊號傳導、異生物質清除和神經傳導物質代謝。

label: TH17
description: IL-6, IL-1beta, and TGFbeta together drive naive T-cell differentiation toward the TH17 lineage, linking the SASP to adaptive immune reprogramming. TH17 cells recruited to senescent niches can amplify inflammation and promote autoimmunity-like responses. The relationship connects the secretome to a distinct effector T-cell subset with pro-inflammatory roles and is a well-established cytokine combination in TH17 biology. This illustrates how the SASP shapes not only innate but also adaptive immune responses.
description_zh_TW: IL-6、IL-1beta 與 TGFbeta 共同驅動初始 T 細胞朝 TH17 譜系分化，將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫重編程。被招募至衰老巢的 TH17 細胞可放大發炎並促進類自體免疫反應。此關係將分泌組連結到特定 T 細胞子集偏移，擴展 SASP 超越先天活化的免疫學後果。它是衰老與自體免疫樣發炎間的橋樑。

label: Glucocorticoids
description: The SASP is suppressed by glucocorticoids, which block the pro-inflammatory SASP by impairing IL-1alpha-mediated NF-kB activity. This senomorphic action modulates senescence-associated properties without cytotoxicity. Glucocorticoids thus represent a class of senomorphic therapy targeting the inflammatory arm of the SASP.
description_zh_TW: SASP 會被 glucocorticoids 抑制，它們透過損害 IL-1alpha 介導的 NF-kB 活性來阻斷促發炎性 SASP。這種 senomorphic 作用在不具細胞毒性的情況下調節衰老相關特性。因此 glucocorticoids 代表一類針對 SASP 發炎臂的 senomorphic 療法。

label: Cataract
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Cross-linking may be responsible for many of the problems of old age, including senile cataract, thickening of the arteries, some cancers and damage to the immune system. A damaged immune system leads to increased susceptibility to infection, and some cancers may arise from the effects of glucose on DNA, which can react with glucose to produce damaged DNA that causes abnormal cells to be produced. Aminoguanidine's ability to prevent cross-linking may help alleviate or prevent senile cataract as well as arterial thickening, kidney failure, thinning bones, osteoarthritis and skin wrinkles.
description_zh_TW: 交聯作用可能是老年許多問題的成因，包括老年性白內障、動脈增厚、某些癌症與免疫系統損傷。受損的免疫系統會導致對感染的易感性增加，而某些癌症可能源於葡萄糖對 DNA 的影響——DNA 可與葡萄糖反應而產生受損的 DNA，進而導致異常細胞的生成。胺基胍防止交聯的能力，可能有助於緩解或預防老年性白內障，以及動脈增厚、腎衰竭、骨質變薄、骨關節炎與皮膚皺紋。

label: Hannum Clock
description: The Hannum clock is a blood-based epigenetic age estimator whose blood-specific training makes it sensitive to immunosenescence and inflammatory states. Its age-acceleration correlates with aging and epigenetic alterations in the immune compartment.
description_zh_TW: Hannum 時鐘是基於血液的表觀遺傳年齡估算器，其血液特異訓練使其對免疫衰老與發炎狀態敏感。其年齡加速與免疫區室的衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: Aminoguanidine (Pimagedine) is primarily known as a selective inhibitor of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), the enzyme responsible for producing high levels of nitric oxide during inflammation. By blocking iNOS, aminoguanidine prevents the overproduction of nitric oxide from the start of the inflammatory cascade, acting upstream of NO signaling. Because it selectively targets the inducible form rather than the healthy endothelial form (eNOS), it is considered a way to halt the inflammatory cascade without completely shutting down normal blood pressure regulation.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Pimagedine) 主要已知作為 inducible 硝酸 synthase (iNOS) 的選擇性抑制劑，該酶負責在發炎期間產生高濃度的硝酸鹽。通過阻斷 iNOS，氨基胍丁可以從發炎遞濫的開始處阻止硝酸鹽的過度產生，在 NO 訊號之前起作用。因為它選擇性地針對 inducible 形式而非健康內皮細胞形式 (eNOS)，因此被認為是停止發炎遞濫的方法，而無需完全關閉正常的血壓調節。

label: high COMT activity
description: Studies in COMT-overexpressing (COMT-OE) mice show that elevated COMT activity accelerates dopamine clearance and leads to slower acquisition of stimulus-response tasks. Proposed mechanisms include reduced dopamine availability at MSN synapses and poorer top-down control over response selection. This manifests as increased impulsivity or perseveration.
description_zh_TW: 對 COMT 過度表現（COMT-OE）小鼠的研究顯示，升高的 COMT activity 加速多巴胺清除並導致 stimulus-response 任務習得較慢。提出的機制包括 MSN 突觸的多巴胺可用性降低，以及對反應選擇的由上而下控制較差。這表現為衝動性或持續性增加。

label: p16INK4A
description: p16INK4a (CDKN2A) accumulation with age drives senescence and opposes SIRT1-dependent replicative programs; SIRT1 represses p16INK4a expression via promoter deacetylation and via the Akt/p70S6K1 axis, and p16INK4a upregulation is a hallmark of aging-related SIRT1 decline (Li & Tollefsbol, 2011, PLoS One 6:e17421, PMID 21390332).
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a（CDKN2A）隨年齡的積累驅動衰老並對抗 SIRT1 依賴性的複製程序；SIRT1 透過啟動子去乙醯化和 Akt/p70S6K1 軸抑制 p16INK4a 表達，而 p16INK4a 的上調是衰老相關 SIRT1 下降的標誌（Li & Tollefsbol, 2011, PLoS One 6:e17421, PMID 21390332）。

label: Transposable Elements
description: DNA methylation helps repress potentially harmful repetitive elements and retrotransposons within the genome. Methylation at the promoters and internal sequences of transposable elements such as LINE-1 and Alu elements maintains them in a transcriptionally silent state, preventing their mobilization and the genomic instability they would otherwise cause. Age-related loss of this methylation derepresses these elements, allowing their transcription and reverse transcription, which in turn triggers innate immune signaling and inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化有助於抑制基因組內潛在有害的重複元件和逆轉錄轉座子。 Methylation 位於轉座元件（例如 LINE-1 和 Alu 元件）的啟動子和內部序列上，使它們保持轉錄沉默狀態，防止它們的動員和否則會導致的基因組不穩定。與年齡相關的甲基化缺失會抑制這些元件，從而允許它們轉錄和逆轉錄，進而觸發先天免疫訊號傳導和發炎。

label: Clonal Hematopoiesis
description: DNMT3a-mutant clones are frequently detectable in preleukemic states, linking age-associated clonal hematopoiesis to overt acute myeloid leukemia. These clones can persist in the bone marrow years before diagnosis and survive chemotherapy, seeding relapse. Clonal hematopoiesis is thus a precursor state for AML.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 突變克隆常在前白血病狀態中可被偵測到，將年齡相關的克隆性造血與明顯的急性骨髓性白血病連結起來。這些克隆可在診斷前數年持續存在於骨髓中，並在化療後存活，播下復發的種子。因此克隆性造血是 AML 的前驅狀態。

label: Arterial aging
description: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。

label: Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin
description: Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 和 Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuromelanin 和 Pathogenic Threshold of Neuromelanin 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Blood
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is very unstable in the blood, which makes it difficult to measure and detect, and this instability is partially due to degradation of NR to nicotinamide (NAM), compromising its ability to reach peripheral tissues after oral administration. Despite this instability, the development of reliable methods for collection, processing, and measurement has enabled determination of the pharmacokinetic profile of orally administered NR, and the apparent oral bioavailability of a 1000 mg dose of NR is highly variable among individuals. The reduced form of NR, NRH, appears more stable than NR and does not undergo direct degradation in plasma.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）在血液中非常不穩定，使其難以測量與偵測，且此不穩定性部分源於 NR 降解為 nicotinamide（NAM，菸鹼醯胺），損害了其口服給藥後到達周邊組織的能力。儘管此不穩定性，可靠收集、處理與測量方法的發展已使得口服 NR 的藥物動力學特徵得以確定，且 1000 mg 劑量 NR 的表觀口服生體可用率在人與人之間差異極大。NR 的還原型 NRH 似乎比 NR 更穩定，且不會在血漿中發生直接降解。

label: Universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator
description: NMN is a direct NAD+ precursor that, once converted to NAD+, serves as a universal indirect pan-sirtuin activator by supplying the obligate co-substrate for all seven sirtuins. Directionally, NMN is converted to NAD+, which activates sirtuins. It raises NAD+ levels that decline with age, restoring sirtuin function systemically, and NMN repletion in mice reverses mitochondrial dysfunction and features of cellular senescence. NMN, together with NR, is a leading nutraceutical strategy to counteract age-related sirtuin attenuation, and its efficacy is enhanced when combined with agents that prevent NAD+ consumption, such as CD38 inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: NMN 是一種直接的 NAD+ 前體，一旦轉化為 NAD+，便通過為所有七種 sirtuin 提供必需的共同受質而充當通用的間接泛 sirtuin 活化因子。在方向性上，NMN 被轉化為 NAD+，NAD+ 活化 sirtuin。它提高隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 水平，恢復全身的 sirtuin 功能，小鼠中的 NMN 補充逆轉粒線體功能障礙和細胞衰老的特徵。NMN 與 NR 一起是對抗與年齡相關的 sirtuin 衰減的主要營養保健品策略，當與防止 NAD+ 消耗的藥劑（如 CD38 抑制劑）結合時，其功效增強。

label: diabetic complications
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。

label: P-gp
description: Multidrug Resistance is mediated by P-gp. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) is an ATP-binding-cassette efflux pump that expels cytotoxic drugs from cells and is a major mediator of multidrug resistance. The directionality runs from P-gp toward Multidrug Resistance, so P-gp is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance是由P-gp介導的。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 P-糖蛋白（ABCB1）是一種ATP結合盒外排泵，可將細胞毒性藥物從細胞中排出，是Multidrug Resistance的主要介質。方向性從 P-gp 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 P-gp 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: DNA Damage Response
description: Replication stress produced by gemcitabine activates the DNA damage response through ATR and ATM pathway kinases. This leads to cell cycle arrest and can resolve into either apoptosis or stress-induced premature senescence depending on stress severity.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 產生的複製壓力透過 ATR 和 ATM 途徑激酶活化 DNA 損傷反應。這導致細胞週期停滯，並可依壓力嚴重程度演化為凋亡或壓力誘導的早發性衰老。

label: Common Pathway
description: Apoptosis converges at Common Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 收斂於 Common Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: MFF
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: MFF (mitochondrial fission factor) is an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor protein that recruits DRP1 to the mitochondria to initiate fission. Its role is relatively simple: MFF overexpression enhances mitochondrial fragmentation, whereas low MFF expression inhibits DRP1 anchoring to the mitochondria and results in elongated mitochondria. MFF physically interacts with the MID proteins within a DRP1 complex, and MFF appears uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission, whereas FIS1 is involved in asymmetrical fission. MFF is upregulated in heart failure and pulmonary diseases where excessive fission predominates.
description_zh_TW: MFF（線粒體分裂因子）是一種外線粒體膜接頭蛋白，可招募 DRP1 到線粒體以啟動分裂。其作用相對簡單：MFF 過表達增強線粒體 fragment，而低 MFF 表達抑制 DRP1 錨定到線粒體，導致線粒體 elongated。MFF 與 DRP1 複合體中的 MID 蛋白 physically interacts，且 MFF 似乎 uniquely related to symmetrical mitochondrial fission，而 FIS1 參與 asymmetrical fission。MFF 在 heart failure 和 pulmonary diseases 中 upregulated，其中 excessive fission predominates。

label: Doxorubicin
description: Doxorubicin is a widely used anthracycline chemotherapeutic that induces therapy-induced senescence in cancer cells and normal fibroblasts. As a DNA-damaging agent, doxorubicin intercalates into DNA, poisons topoisomerase II, and generates reactive oxygen species, producing DNA damage that activates the p53-p21 axis and triggers permanent cell cycle arrest. The resulting senescent cells exhibit the SASP and persistent DNA damage signaling, which can contribute to both the therapeutic response and long-term side effects such as cardiac toxicity.
description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin 是一種廣泛使用的蒽環類化療藥物，可誘導癌細胞和正常纖維母細胞因治療而老化。作為 DNA 損傷劑，阿黴素會嵌入 DNA，毒害拓樸異構酶 II，並產生活性氧，產生 DNA 損傷，活化 p53-p21 軸並觸發永久性細胞週期停滯。由此產生的衰老細胞表現出 SASP 和持續的 DNA 損傷信號傳導，這可能有助於治療反應和長期副作用，例如心臟毒性。

label: Bleomycin
description: Bleomycin is a glycopeptide antibiotic that causes DNA double-strand breaks and is a standard tool for generating therapy-induced senescence (TIS) in vitro. Sub-lethal bleomycin treatment produces a canonical senescence phenotype with elevated SA-beta-gal and DNA-damage-response foci.
description_zh_TW: Bleomycin 是一種糖肽抗生素，會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，是體外誘發治療誘導性衰老（TIS）的標準工具。次致死劑量的 bleomycin 處理會產生典型的衰老表現型，包括升高的 SA-β-gal 與 DNA 損傷反應焦點。

label: Glycemic Control
description: Regular physical exercise has beneficial effects on glycemic control, and because AGE formation is accelerated by hyperglycemia, improved glycemic control attenuates the formation and accumulation of AGEs in tissues. Exercise benefits diabetic patients by improving glycemic control, and physical activity reduces AGE accumulation in diabetic patients and during aging. The higher energy demands of exercise may also reduce the pool of reactive intermediates available for glycation. Together with its antioxidant effects, glycemic control is a major mechanism by which exercise reduces AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動對血糖控制具有有益的效果，而由於高血糖會加速 AGE 的形成，改善血糖控制可減緩組織中 AGEs 的形成與堆積。運動透過改善血糖控制使糖尿病患者受益，且身體活動可減少糖尿病患者體內及老化過程中的 AGE 堆積。運動較高的能量需求也可能減少可用於糖化的反應性中間產物的庫存。結合其抗氧化作用，血糖控制是運動減輕 AGE 負擔的主要機制。

label: Total Daily Energy Expenditure
description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: T Lymphocyte
description: Thymopoiesis is the process by which T cell development, maturation and induction of self-tolerance occur in the thymic epithelial space. Lymphoid progenitors enter the thymus at the cortico-medullary junction, migrate to the outer cortex for early development and TCR gene rearrangement and positive selection, then return to the medulla for negative selection before export to the periphery. Reduction of functional thymopoiesis with aging results in loss of TCR gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺生成是 T 細胞發育、成熟和自身耐受誘導在胸腺上皮空間中發生的過程。淋巴祖細胞在皮髓交界處進入胸腺，遷移至外皮質進行早期發育和 TCR 基因重排及陽性選擇，然後返回髓質進行陰性選擇，最後輸出至外周。隨著年齡增長，功能性胸腺生成的減弱導致 TCR 基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。

label: miR-34a
description: The 3'UTR of the SIRT1 transcript contains a miR-34a-responsive element; active miR-34a represses SIRT1 translation. Directionally, miR-34a sits upstream to lower SIRT1 protein. Because SIRT1 deacetylates and inhibits p53, this repression is part of a negative feedback loop that helps explain the drop in SIRT1 observed during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 轉錄本的 3'UTR 包含一個 miR-34a 響應元件；活性 miR-34a 抑制 SIRT1 的翻譯。方向性上 miR-34a 位於上游以降低 SIRT1 蛋白水平。由於 SIRT1 去乙醯化並抑制 p53，這種抑制是負回饋迴路的一部分，有助於解釋在衰老過程中觀察到的 SIRT1 下降。

label: Lamin B1
description: Lamin B1 is lost in senescence as LMNB1 expression declines, detaching lamina-associated domains from the nuclear periphery and reorganizing chromatin architecture. This structural remodeling contributes to altered gene expression and the spatial redistribution of heterochromatin, including the formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci. Lamin B1 loss is a relatively conserved marker of senescence across species and cell types, and it correlates with persistent DNA damage and genomic instability in arrested cells. The decline is driven by both transcriptional repression and proteolytic degradation and precedes full establishment of the senescent phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Lamin B1 隨 LMNB1 表現下降而在衰老中喪失，使核膜相關區域從核周邊脫離並重組染色質架構。此結構重塑貢獻改變的基因表現與異染色質的空間重新分布，包括衰老相關異染色質焦點的形成。Lamin B1 喪失是跨物種與細胞類型相對保守的衰老標記，並與停滯細胞中持續 DNA 損傷與基因組不穩定相關。此下降由轉錄抑制與蛋白水解降解驅動，並先於衰老表型的完全建立。

label: Telomere Attrition
description: Telomere attrition is sex-dimorphic: females shorten telomeres more slowly (~26 bp/yr) than males (~43 bp/yr) (Gardner et al., Exp Gerontol 2014). Because females accumulate senescent cells less rapidly early in life, sex-stratified attrition rates gate the onset of replicative senescence and shape the sex differences documented across Senescence, SASP, and Senolytics.
description_zh_TW: 端粒磨耗具性別雙型性：女性（每年約 26 bp）比男性（每年約 43 bp）磨耗較慢（Gardner 等，Exp Gerontol 2014）。由於女性早期累積衰老細胞較慢，性別分層的磨耗率決定了複製性衰老的起始，並塑造 Senescence、SASP 與 Senolytics 中所記載的性別差異。

label: Redox Cycling
description: Adrenochrome is not merely a passive end-product of adrenaline oxidation; it actively participates in redox cycling that amplifies oxidative stress. It accepts one electron from reducing agents or enzymes to form the adrenochrome semiquinone radical, which then donates its unpaired electron to molecular oxygen, regenerating adrenochrome and producing superoxide anion. Because newly generated superoxide can oxidize more adrenaline to adrenochrome, the cycle repeats without net consumption of adrenochrome, which acts catalytically. This cycling also consumes oxygen and produces hydrogen peroxide, and it has been directly demonstrated in submitochondrial particles using ESR spectroscopy and pulse radiolysis, explaining part of adrenochrome's cardiotoxic and neurodegenerative potential.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 不僅是 adrenaline 氧化的被動終產物；它主動參與放大氧化壓力的氧化還原循環。它從還原劑或酶接受一個電子形成 adrenochrome 半醌自由基，隨後將其未配對電子捐給分子氧，再生 adrenochrome 並產生超氧陰離子。由於新生成的超氧陰離子可氧化更多 adrenaline 為 adrenochrome，此循環在無 adrenochrome 淨消耗下重複，發揮催化作用。此循環也消耗氧氣並產生過氧化氫，且已在亞粒線體顆粒中透過 ESR 光譜與脈衝輻解直接證實，解釋了 adrenochrome 部分的心臟毒性與神經退化潛力。

label: Adrenolutin
description: Adrenochrome is unstable and undergoes further conversion to adrenolutin, particularly under alkaline conditions, as well as to semiquinone radicals and melanin-like polymers. These downstream transformations occur both in vitro and in vivo and contribute to the difficulty of detecting adrenochrome directly at significant levels in healthy tissues. Adrenolutin and other adrenochrome-derived products are among the oxidized metabolites implicated in oxidative stress and pigment accumulation, and adrenochrome can also participate in redox cycling to generate superoxide before or alongside these conversions.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 不穩定，會進一步轉化為 adrenolutin，尤其在鹼性條件下，也會轉化為 semiquinone radicals 與 melanin-like polymers。這些 downstream transformations 在體外與體內都會發生，並導致難以在健康組織中直接偵測到顯著水平的 adrenochrome。Adrenolutin 與其他 adrenochrome-derived products 是涉及 oxidative stress 與色素堆積的 oxidized metabolites 之一，且 adrenochrome 也可在這些轉化之前或同時參與 redox cycling 以產生 superoxide。

label: Cutaneous Melanoma
description: Cutaneous Melanoma and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Cutaneous Melanoma and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Cutaneous Melanoma 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Cutaneous Melanoma 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Tyrosinase-related protein-1
description: Oculocutaneous Albinism type 3 (OCA3), also called rufous or red albinism, is due to mutations in TYRP1 (9p23) encoding Tyrosinase-related protein-1. This melanosomal enzyme is involved in eumelanin synthesis. It is most common in individuals of African or Puerto Rican descent.
description_zh_TW: Oculocutaneous Albinism 第 3 型（OCA3），也稱為紅褐色或紅色白化症，由編碼 Tyrosinase-related protein-1 的 TYRP1（9p23）突變引起。這種 melanosomal 酶參與 eumelanin 合成。它在非洲或波多黎各裔人群中最常見。

label: ACSS2
description: ACSS2 (acetyl-CoA synthetase 2) is a nuclear-cytosolic enzyme that ligates acetate to coenzyme A to form acetyl-CoA, providing a mitochondrial-independent route of acetyl-CoA production that supports histone acetylation and gene expression.
description_zh_TW: ACSS2（acetyl-CoA synthetase 2）是一種核-胞質酵素，將乙酸（acetate）與輔酶 A 連接形成 acetyl-CoA，提供一條不依賴粒線體的 acetyl-CoA 生成路徑，以支持組蛋白乙醯化與基因表現。

label: CREB
description: CREB is a transcription factor critical for BDNF expression. SIRT1-dependent signaling converges on CREB to drive BDNF production and support neurogenesis and memory.
description_zh_TW: CREB 是 BDNF 表現的關鍵轉錄因子。SIRT1 依賴性訊號匯聚於 CREB 以驅動 BDNF 產生，並支持神經新生與記憶。

label: muscle protein synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Accumulating evidence suggests that urolithin A may promote muscle protein synthesis and muscle growth through various pathways. It can increase the rate of protein synthesis within muscle cells while inhibiting protein degradation processes, allowing muscle cells to more effectively synthesize new proteins and maintain muscle mass. This anabolic action, combined with enhanced mitochondrial function and energy metabolism, supports muscle hypertrophy, the maintenance of muscle mass, and improved recovery after exercise.
description_zh_TW: 累積證據顯示 urolithin A 可能透過多種路徑促進肌肉蛋白合成與肌肉生長。它可提升肌肉細胞內蛋白質合成速率，同時抑制蛋白降解過程，使肌肉細胞能更有效地合成新蛋白並維持肌肉量。此合成代謝作用，結合增強的粒線體功能與能量代謝，支持肌肉肥大、肌肉量的維持，以及運動後更佳的恢復。

label: FOLFOX
description: FOLFOX (5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin) is the standard adjuvant chemotherapy regimen for stage III and high-risk stage II colon cancer, and a backbone for metastatic disease. FOLFOX and FOLFIRI are interchangeable as first-line chemotherapy in metastatic colon cancer. It is a cornerstone of colon cancer treatment.
description_zh_TW: FOLFOX（5-氟尿嘧啶、亞葉酸、奧沙利鉑）是第三期與高風險第二期結腸癌的標準輔助化療方案，也是轉移性疾病的主幹。FOLFOX 和 FOLFIRI 在轉移性結腸癌中可互換作為一線化療。它是結腸癌治療的基石。

label: TBK1
description: IKKepsilon is closely related to TBK1, its closest paralog, with which it shares overlapping substrates in the type I interferon response including IRF3 and IRF7. Both kinases contribute to innate antiviral immunity and oncogenic signaling. Their overlapping functions make them jointly attractive therapeutic targets.
description_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 與其最接近的旁系同源基因 TBK1 密切相關，兩者在第一型干擾素反應中共享重疊的受質，包括 IRF3 和 IRF7。兩種激酶都參與先天抗病毒免疫與致癌性訊號傳導。其重疊功能使它們共同成為具吸引力的治療靶點。

label: Cytokines
description: Cytokines are small secreted signaling proteins that mediate communication between immune and resident cells. In the CNS, microglia and infiltrating lymphocytes release cytokines that coordinate neuroinflammation, a process implicated in Parkinson's disease progression.
description_zh_TW: 細胞激素是介導免疫細胞與駐留細胞溝通的小型分泌性訊號蛋白。在中樞神經系統中，微膠質細胞與浸潤淋巴球釋放細胞激素以協調神經發炎，此過程與帕金森氏症的進展有關。

label: executive function
description: The prefrontal cortex controls executive function, encompassing planning, decision-making, inhibition, and cognitive flexibility, through its extensive reciprocal connections with posterior cortex, striatum, and thalamus. Its operations depend critically on an optimal, COMT-genotype-sensitive level of dopamine, with both excess and deficiency degrading performance. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that governs these high-level functions. Dysregulation of prefrontal dopamine is implicated in numerous psychiatric and cognitive disorders.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過與後皮質、紋狀體和丘腦的廣泛相互連結來控制 executive function，包括計畫、決策、抑制和認知靈活性。其運作關鍵取決於 COMT 基因型敏感的最佳多巴胺水平，過量和缺乏都會降低表現。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了控制這些高階功能的多巴胺基調。前額葉多巴胺的失調與許多精神和認知障礙有關。

label: mTOR Inhibitor
description: Suppressed mTOR relieves inhibition of autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis via TFEB, promoting cellular cleanup. mTOR inhibition is thus a canonical inducer of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 抑制的 mTOR 解除對自噬與溶酶體生合成的抑制（經由 TFEB），促進細胞清理。因此 mTOR 抑制是自噬的典型誘導者。

label: Integrins
description: FAK is activated by Integrins. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Integrins are transmembrane receptors that connect the extracellular matrix to the cytoskeleton and intracellular survival kinases. The directionality runs from Integrins toward FAK, so Integrins is the active agent and FAK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: FAK 由 Integrins 活化。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。 Integrins 是將細胞外基質連接到細胞骨架和細胞內生存激酶的跨膜受體。方向性從 Integrins 朝向 FAK，因此 Integrins 是主動主體，FAK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Complex II
description: Complex II is embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane and is the only enzyme that participates in both the TCA cycle and the electron transport chain. It links carbon metabolism to mitochondrial redox signaling and oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Complex II 嵌入粒線體內膜，是唯一同時參與 TCA 循環與電子傳遞鏈的酶。它將碳代謝與粒線體氧化還原訊號及氧化壓力相連結。

label: trastuzumab
description: Cancer is treated by trastuzumab. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against HER2 that inhibits signaling and recruits immune effector mechanisms in HER2-positive breast cancer. The directionality runs from trastuzumab toward Cancer, so trastuzumab is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 trastuzumab 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。曲妥珠單抗是一種針對 HER2 的單株抗體，可抑制訊號傳導並在 HER2 陽性 Breast Cancer 中招募免疫效應機制。方向性從 trastuzumab 向 Cancer，因此 trastuzumab 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: NKG2A
description: NKG2A is an inhibitory receptor expressed as a heterodimer with CD94 that recognizes HLA-E on target cells. It operates in parallel with PD-1 as a checkpoint axis that tumors and senescent cells exploit to blunt cytotoxic responses.
description_zh_TW: NKG2A 是與 CD94 形成異源二聚體表現的抑制性受體，辨識目標細胞的 HLA-E。它與 PD-1 並行運作，作為腫瘤與衰老細胞用以削弱細胞毒性反應的檢查點軸。

label: Glutathione S-Transferase
description: Urolithin A, a gut-microbiome metabolite of ellagitannins, is associated with antioxidant responses that involve phase II enzymes including glutathione S-transferases. GST activity contributes to the detoxification and redox-buffering program engaged by such polyphenol metabolites.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是鞣花單寧的腸道微生物代謝物，與涉及包括穀胱甘肽 S-轉移酶在內之第二相酶的抗氧化反應相關。GST 活性有助於此類多酚代謝物啟動的解毒與氧化還原緩衝程式。

label: ASF1a
description: ASF1a is an upstream histone H3–H4 chaperone that hands off dimers to the HIRA complex for replication-independent deposition. Together with HIRA and UBN1 it is a core member of the chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是上游的組蛋白 H3–H4 伴護蛋白，將二聚體交給 HIRA 複合體進行非複製依賴的沉積。它與 HIRA 及 UBN1 同為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需的伴護蛋白複合體核心成員。

label: UBN1
description: UBN1 is an essential, dedicated subunit of the HIRA histone chaperone complex, with an N-terminal domain that binds HIRA. Together with HIRA and ASF1a, it mediates replication-independent deposition of H3.3.
description_zh_TW: UBN1 是 HIRA 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體的必需專屬亞基，其 N 端結構域結合 HIRA。它與 HIRA 及 ASF1a 一起介導 H3.3 的非複製依賴沉積。

label: Preiss-Handler Pathway
description: The Preiss-Handler pathway is the de novo biosynthesis route to NAD+, converting tryptophan or niacin into NAD+ through a sequence culminating in the ATP-dependent condensation of quinolinate with phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate. It provides the essential redox and signaling cofactor NAD+.
description_zh_TW: Preiss-Handler 途徑是到 NAD+ 的從頭生合成途徑，將色胺酸或菸鹼酸經由以喹啉酸與磷酸核糖焦磷酸之 ATP 依賴縮合告終的序列轉化為 NAD+。它提供必需的氧化還原與訊號輔因子 NAD+。

label: H3K4me1
description: H3K4me1 is the canonical enhancer mark, and active enhancers are defined by the combination of H3K4me1 with H3K27ac. In senescence, super-enhancers are enriched in both H3K4me1 and H3K27ac to drive SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me1 是典型的增強子標記，活性增強子由 H3K4me1 與 H3K27ac 的組合定義。在衰老中，超級增強子同時富集 H3K4me1 與 H3K27ac 以驅動 SASP 表現。

label: H4K5ac
description: H4K5ac is often co-acetylated with other marks and is enriched together with H3K27ac at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Both acetyl marks contribute to the open enhancer landscape driving SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: H4K5ac 常與其他標記共同乙醯化，並與 H3K27ac 一起富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。兩種乙醯標記皆促成驅動 SASP 表現的開放增強子景觀。

label: Hexokinase 2
description: Fenbendazole down-regulates/inhibits HK2, collapsing glycolytic flux and de-repressing apoptosis at the mitochondrial level by detaching HK2 from VDAC.
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 下調／抑制 HK2，瓦解糖解通量，並經由將 HK2 從 VDAC 脫離，在粒線體層級去抑制凋亡。

label: GLUT1
description: Fenbendazole reduces surface expression of GLUT1, the primary glucose transporter overexpressed in cancer cells, directly impairing glucose uptake and starving tumors.
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 降低 GLUT1 的表面表現——GLUT1 是在癌細胞中過度表現的主要葡萄糖轉運蛋白——直接損害葡萄糖攝取並使腫瘤挨餓。

label: Microtubule
description: Fenbendazole binds the colchicine site of β-tubulin, preventing polymerization into microtubules. This causes mitotic spindle disruption, G2/M arrest, and mitotic catastrophe.
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 結合 β-tubulin 的 colchicine 位點，阻止聚合為微管。這造成有絲分裂紡錘體破壞、G2/M 停滯與有絲分裂災難。

label: SHP1
description: Caspase-8 is restored by SHP1. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. SHP1 is a protein tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and reactivates caspase-8, restoring death-receptor-induced apoptosis. The directionality runs from SHP1 toward Caspase-8, so SHP1 is the active agent and Caspase-8 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-8 由 SHP1 恢復。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。 SHP1 是一種蛋白質酪胺酸磷酸酶，可去磷酸化並重新活化 caspase-8，恢復死亡受體誘導的細胞凋亡。方向性從 SHP1 朝向 Caspase-8，因此 SHP1 是主動主體，Caspase-8 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Dopaminochrome
description: Dopamine, like epinephrine, undergoes oxidation to an aminochrome: dopamine is converted through an o-quinone intermediate to dopaminochrome, the dopamine analog of adrenochrome. These aminochromes are unstable reactive intermediates that can polymerize into melanins, including neuromelanin in dopaminergic neurons. This oxidation pathway is relevant to the brain, where oxidative metabolism of catecholamines into quinone-like compounds contributes to the age-dependent buildup of neuromelanin pigments in the substantia nigra. The reactivity of dopaminochrome and related aminochromes underlies their potential neurotoxicity and their sequestration by neuromelanin.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 與 epinephrine 類似，會氧化成 aminochrome：dopamine 經由 o-quinone 中間產物轉化為 dopaminochrome，即 adrenochrome 的 dopamine 類似物。這些 aminochromes 是不穩定的反應性中間產物，可聚合成 melanins，包括多巴胺能神經元中的 neuromelanin。此氧化途徑與大腦相關，其中兒茶酚胺氧化代謝成類 quinone 化合物，促成了 substantia nigra 中 neuromelanin 色素隨年齡的堆積。Dopaminochrome 及相關 aminochromes 的反應性，是其潛在神經毒性以及被 neuromelanin 隔離的基礎。

label: Kinase Inhibitor
description: Because kinases sit inside densely wired signaling networks, kinase inhibition can produce non-monotonic (hormetic) dose responses rather than clean sigmoidal curves. The network-topology basis of an incoherent bivalent motif explains these inverted-U effects.
description_zh_TW: 由於激酶位於密集連接的訊號網路內，激酶抑制可產生非單調（毒物興奮）劑量反應，而非乾淨的 S 型曲線。不一致雙價模體的網路拓撲基礎解釋這些倒 U 型效應。

label: IC50
description: IC50 is defined for a monotonic sigmoidal dose-response curve as its inflection point, and is inapplicable to non-monotonic (hormetic) biphasic curves. In a hormetic curve the slope changes sign, so there is no single inflection point and IC50 is ill-defined.
description_zh_TW: IC50 是針對單調 S 型劑量-反應曲線定義為其反曲點，不適用於非單調（毒物興奮）雙相曲線。在毒物興奮曲線中斜率改變符號，因此沒有單一反曲點，IC50 無法明確定義。

label: Cholangiocarcinoma
description: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignancy of the bile-duct epithelium (adenocarcinoma).
description_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 是膽管上皮的惡性腫瘤（腺癌）。

label: ERK2
description: ERK2 phosphorylates TFEB at serine 142, producing cytoplasmic retention and nuclear export of the transcription factor (PMID 21617040, 29992949). Phosphorylation at this site, shared with mTORC1 and CDK4/CDK6, keeps TFEB out of the nucleus and thereby represses its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes. This places TFEB under the control of mitogen/extracellular-signal-regulated kinase (ERK) signaling in addition to nutrient sensing, integrating growth factor cues into the control of lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. Dephosphorylation of S142 by calcineurin reverses this effect and promotes TFEB translocation to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: ERK2 在絲氨酸 142 上磷酸化 TFEB，導致該轉錄因子的胞質保留和核輸出（PMID 21617040、29992949）。此位點的磷酸化與 mTORC1 和 CDK4/CDK6 共享，使 TFEB 保持在細胞核外，從而抑制其溶酶體和自噬基因的轉錄程序。這使 TFEB 除了營養感知外，還受到絲裂原/細胞外信號調節激酶（ERK）信號通路的控制，將生長因子線索整合到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的調節中。鈣調磷酸酶對 S142 的去磷酸化逆轉此效應，促進 TFEB 轉位至細胞核。

label: Cognitive Decline
description: Cognitive decline is the age-associated reduction in memory, processing speed, and executive function, linked to chronic inflammation and inflammaging. Persisting low-grade inflammation is implicated in cognitive decline and shares risk with frailty and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 認知衰退是與年齡相關的記憶、處理速度與執行功能下降，與慢性發炎及發炎老化相關。持續的低度發炎與認知衰退有關，並與衰弱及心血管疾病共享風險。

label: BRD4
description: BRD4 co-binds H3K27ac at SASP super-enhancers alongside AP-1, facilitating the senescence-associated secretory phenotype program.
description_zh_TW: BRD4 與 AP-1 一起，在 SASP 超級增強子處共結合 H3K27ac，促進衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）程序。

label: BMAL1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: NAMPT, the rate-limiting NAD+ salvage enzyme, is regulated by the CLOCK:BMAL1 circadian complex, coupling NAD+ biosynthesis and thus sirtuin activity to the daily rhythm. Directionally, the CLOCK/BMAL1 loop drives rhythmic NAMPT and NAD+ levels. This explains the circadian gating of sirtuin-dependent processes and links clock disruption to altered sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是限速的 NAD+ 補救酵素，受 CLOCK:BMAL1 昼夜節律複合物調節，將 NAD+ 生合成從而將 sirtuin 活性與每日節律偶聯。方向性上 CLOCK/BMAL1 迴路驅動節律性的 NAMPT 和 NAD+ 水平。這解釋了 sirtuin 依賴過程的晝夜節律調控，並將時鐘紊亂與 sirtuin 活性改變聯繫起來。

label: Males
description: SIRT6 overexpression extends median lifespan of male mice by 14.5% and 9.9% with no significant effect in females (Kanfi et al., Nature 2012); the male-specific benefit tracks reduced serum IGF-1 and IIS. In the inbred C57BL/6JOlaHsd background (Roichman et al., Nat Commun 2021) it extends lifespan in both sexes, but the effect remains strongest in males (~27% vs ~15%), gated by baseline IGF-1.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表現使雄性小鼠中位壽命延長 14.5% 與 9.9%，對雌性無顯著效果（Kanfi 等，Nature 2012）；雄性特異獲益追蹤於血清 IGF-1 與 IIS 的降低。在近交 C57BL/6JOlaHsd 背景（Roichman 等，Nat Commun 2021）中於兩性皆延長壽命，但效應仍以雄性最強（約 27% 對 15%），受基礎 IGF-1 所調控。

label: IL-8
description: Interleukin-8 (IL-8) is one of the best-known cytokines of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), along with IL-6. Secreted by senescent cells, IL-8 reshapes local tissue microenvironments and exerts paracrine effects on neighboring cells. In this study, recombinant IL-8 (combined with IL-6 at a 1:2 ratio) induced acid ceramidase expression in proliferative cells, reproduced by senescent-cell co-culture, resulting in elevated lipid peroxidation and sensitization of bystander cells to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 介白素-8（IL-8）與 IL-6 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。IL-8 由衰老細胞分泌，重塑局部組織微環境並對鄰近細胞發揮旁分泌效應。在本研究中，重組 IL-8（以 1:2 比例與 IL-6 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現，此現象可由衰老細胞共培養重現，導致脂質過氧化升高並使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

label: UPRmt
description: ATFS-1 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor in C. elegans that serves as the primary regulator of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt). Under mitochondrial stress it translocates to the nucleus to drive the protective UPRmt gene program.
description_zh_TW: ATFS-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）中鹼性螺旋-環-螺旋轉錄因子，是粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的主要調控者。在粒線體壓力下它轉位至細胞核以驅動保護性的 UPRmt 基因程式。

label: Reactive Nitrogen Species
description: Nitrative stress is caused by reactive nitrogen species when RNS production exceeds the capacity of detoxifying and repair systems to neutralize them. The condition reflects an imbalance between nitrating oxidants and endogenous defenses. The directionality is RNS excess to nitrative damage. A caveat is that transient, localized RNS signaling is physiological, so pathology depends on chronic overload or miscompartmentalization. The transition from beneficial to pathological RNS activity hinges on concentration, duration, and the tissue's antioxidant and repair capacity.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 是由 reactive nitrogen species 當 RNS 產生超過解毒和修復系統中和它們的能力時引起的。這種情況反映了硝化氧化劑和內源性防禦之間的不平衡。方向性是RNS過量對硝化損傷的影響。需要注意的是，短暫的、局部的 RNS 訊號傳導是生理性的，因此病理學取決於慢性超負荷或錯室化。 RNS 活性從有益到病理的轉變取決於濃度、持續時間以及組織的抗氧化和修復能力。

label: SUV39H1
description: SIRT1 deacetylates and cooperates with the H3K9 methyltransferase Suv39h1 to enforce heterochromatin and silencing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並與 H3K9 甲基轉移酶 Suv39h1 協同作用，以強化異染色質和基因沉默。

label: TSC
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: In tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC), where mTOR pathway hyperactivation is a hallmark due to variants in TSC1 or TSC2, rapamycin prevents seizures, reduces mortality, and rescues neuropathology including glial proliferation and disrupted cortical architecture in mouse models. In the EXIST-3 phase III trial, adjunctive everolimus significantly reduced seizure frequency in treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC, with about 40% of high-dose patients achieving at least 50% seizure reduction versus 15% placebo, leading to regulatory approval.
description_zh_TW: 在結節性硬化症（TSC）中，由於TSC1或TSC2變異，mTOR通路過度激活是一個標誌，rapamycin在小鼠模型中預防癲癇、降低死亡率並挽救神經病理學，包括膠質增生和皮質結構破壞。在EXIST-3 III期試驗中，輔助everolimus顯著降低了TSC引起的治療抵抗性癲癇的發作頻率，約40%的高劑量患者達到至少50%的癲癇減少，而安慰劑組為15%，從而獲得監管批准。

label: Macrophage Polarization
description: SIRT6 regulates macrophage polarization to alleviate sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome through both autophagy-dependent and autophagy-independent mechanisms. This positions SIRT6 as a modulator of the M1/M2 inflammatory balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過自噬依賴與非依賴機制調控巨噬細胞極化，以減輕敗血症誘導的急性呼吸窘迫症候群。這使 SIRT6 成為 M1/M2 發炎平衡的調控者。

label: HSP27
description: HSP27 is commonly upregulated in tumors and serves as a prognostic and therapeutic-resistance marker.
description_zh_TW: HSP27 在腫瘤中常被上調，並作為預後和治療抵抗的標誌物。

label: Biphasic Dose-Response Curve
description: IC50 is defined for a monotonic sigmoidal dose-response curve as its inflection point, and is inapplicable to non-monotonic (hormetic) biphasic curves. In a hormetic curve the slope changes sign, so there is no single inflection point and IC50 is ill-defined.
description_zh_TW: IC50 是針對單調 S 型劑量-反應曲線定義為其反曲點，不適用於非單調（毒物興奮）雙相曲線。在毒物興奮曲線中斜率改變符號，因此沒有單一反曲點，IC50 無法明確定義。

label: H3K56ac
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 deacetylates H3K56ac, contributing to mitotic chromatin organization and genome stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 H3K56ac，有助於有絲分裂染色質組織和基因組穩定性。

label: carbohydrate metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT2 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating G6PD (pentose phosphate pathway) and phosphoglycerate mutase (glycolysis) to influence NADPH production and glucose flux, and deacetylates PEPCK to support gluconeogenesis; these actions link SIRT2 to redox balance and metabolic control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 G6PD（磷酸戊糖途徑）和磷酸甘油酸變位酶（糖酵解）來調節碳水化合物代謝，影響 NADPH 產生和葡萄糖通量；並去乙醯化 PEPCK 以支持糖質新生；這些作用將 SIRT2 與氧化還原平衡和代謝控制聯繫起來。

label: Tenovin-6
description: Tenovin-6 inhibits SIRT2 with an IC50 of 10 μM, making SIRT2 its more potent sirtuin target compared with SIRT1. Directionally, Tenovin-6 blocks SIRT2 catalysis. By inhibiting SIRT2 deacetylation, it can protect neurons and reactivate p53, and it also inhibits SIRT3 with an IC50 of 67 μM, so its effects span multiple sirtuins. It is a chemical probe distinguishing SIRT2 from other sirtuins, and its p53-reactivation activity underlies its anticancer phenotype. The moderate potency and limited selectivity require careful interpretation of Tenovin-6 studies.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin-6 以 IC50 10 μM 抑制 SIRT2，使其成為相較於 SIRT1 更強效的 sirtuin 靶標。在方向性上，Tenovin-6 阻斷 SIRT2 催化作用。透過抑制 SIRT2 去乙醯化，它可以保護神經元並重新活化 p53，同時也以 IC50 67 μM 抑制 SIRT3，因此其效應跨越多個 sirtuin。它是區分 SIRT2 與其他 sirtuin 的化學探針，其 p53 重新活化活性構成了其抗癌表型的基礎。中等效力和有限的選擇性需要謹慎詮釋 Tenovin-6 的研究。

label: Histone H4
description: Under stress the nuclear fraction of SIRT3 deacetylates H4K16 and H3K9, regulating expression of genes involved in mitochondrial biogenesis and metabolism. Directionally, SIRT3 acts enzymatically on chromatin in the nucleus. This reveals a nuclear, chromatin-level face of the otherwise mitochondrial sirtuin, complementing its metabolic roles.
description_zh_TW: 在壓力下，SIRT3 的細胞核部分去乙醯化 H4K16 和 H3K9，調節參與粒線體生成和代謝的基因表現。方向性上 SIRT3 在細胞核中以酵素方式作用於染色質。這揭示了 otherwise 為粒線體 sirtuin 的 SIRT3 的核、染色質層面，補充了其代謝功能。

label: Liver Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT3 is protective in liver ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout of Takeda G protein-coupled receptor 5 suppresses SIRT3, driving proinflammatory macrophages and exacerbated injury. The protective SIRT1/SIRT3 axis is a targetable balance for organ protection.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 對肝臟缺血再灌注損傷具有保護作用：敲除 Takeda G 蛋白偶聯受體 5 會抑制 SIRT3，驅動促發炎巨噬細胞並加重損傷。保護性的 SIRT1/SIRT3 軸是器官保護的可靶向平衡。

label: Stroke
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is neuroprotective in rodent models of stroke, reducing infarct volume and preserving neurological function. MB enhances cellular oxygen consumption in vivo and provides protection against hypoxia-induced injury, including in primary hepatocyte cultures. Its mechanism is distinct from conventional antioxidants: by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III and by upregulating complex IV activity and expression, MB sustains mitochondrial bioenergetics in ischemic tissue where electron transport is compromised.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在中風的囓齒類模型中具有神經保護作用，減少梗塞體積並保留神經功能。MB在體內增強細胞氧氣消耗，並提供對缺氧誘導損傷的保護，包括在原代肝細胞培養中。其機制與傳統抗氧化劑不同：通過作為繞過複合物I-III的替代電子轉運載體，並通過上調複合物IV活性和表達，MB在電子傳輸受損的缺血組織中維持粒線體生物能量學。

label: Superoxide dismutase
description: Superoxide dismutase (SOD), along with catalase and azide, inhibits the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome in experiments with stimulated neutrophils, confirming that reactive oxygen species are responsible for the conversion. SOD specifically scavenges superoxide radicals generated by the neutrophil NADPH oxidase system, and because these radicals drive much of the adrenaline oxidation (over 80% at low micromolar concentrations), removing them blocks adrenochrome formation. This enzyme-based inhibition is key experimental evidence for the ROS-dependent mechanism of neutrophil-mediated adrenochrome production.
description_zh_TW: Superoxide dismutase（SOD）與catalase及azide一同，在stimulated neutrophils的experiments中inhibits adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome，confirming that reactive oxygen species are responsible for the conversion。SOD specifically scavenges由neutrophil NADPH oxidase system生成的superoxide radicals，而由於這些radicals驅動了大部分的adrenaline oxidation（在低micromolar concentrations下超過80%），removing them blocks adrenochrome formation。此enzyme-based inhibition是neutrophil-mediated adrenochrome production的ROS-dependent mechanism的key experimental evidence。

label: Age-Related Diseases
description: Anti-aging drugs extend healthspan and are most effective before overt diseases cause organ damage and loss of function, so rapamycin is most effective when administered at the pre-disease or even pre-pre-disease stages of age-related diseases. It delays the onset of age-related diseases, which are manifestations of aging, and although rapamycin may reverse some manifestations of aging, it is more effective at slowing aging than reversing it. Rapalogs may slow atherosclerosis, preventing myocardial infarction, but are unlikely to help reverse an infarction, and rapamycin may be useful for osteoporosis though not for a broken hip after an osteoporotic fracture.
description_zh_TW: 抗衰老藥物延長健康壽命，並在明顯疾病導致器官損傷和功能喪失之前最有效，因此rapamycin在年齡相關疾病的疾病前期甚至疾病前期前期階段給藥時最有效。它延遲年齡相關疾病的發病，這些疾病是老化的表現，雖然rapamycin可能逆轉一些老化的表現，但它在減緩老化方面比逆轉更有效。rapalogs可能減緩動脈粥樣硬化，預防心肌梗塞，但不太可能幫助逆轉梗塞，rapamycin可能對骨質疏鬆症有用，但對骨質疏鬆性骨折後的髖部骨折無效。

label: Caspase-6
description: Caspase-6 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-6 is an executioner caspase particularly important for cleavage of nuclear lamins and the structural collapse of the nucleus. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-6, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-6 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-6 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-6 是一種劊子手半胱天冬酶，對於核纖層蛋白的裂解和細胞核的結構崩潰特別重要。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-6，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-6 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: SMAD2
description: SIRT6 inactivates TGF-beta1/Smad2 signaling to prevent myofibroblast differentiation, inhibits TGF-beta-induced cellular senescence, and blocks EMT during IPF through TGF-beta1/Smad3. SIRT6 is thus a master suppressor of the fibrotic cascade in lung fibrosis, whereas SIRT7 decline has a profibrotic effect via Smad3 changes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 使 TGF-beta1/Smad2 訊號失效以阻止肌纖維母細胞分化，抑制 TGF-beta 誘發的細胞衰老，並在 IPF 中透過 TGF-beta1/Smad3 阻斷 EMT。SIRT6 因此是肺纖維化中纖維化級聯的主抑制因子，而 SIRT7 下降透過 Smad3 變化具有促纖維化效應。

label: Cysteine
description: During pheomelanogenesis the amino acid Cysteine adds to dopaquinone, forming cysteinyldopas that cyclize and oxidize into benzothiazine intermediates. Sulfur incorporation during pigment polymerization depends on cysteine and glutathione present in dopamine neurons. Cysteine thus acts as the sulfur donor that enables benzothiazine formation.
description_zh_TW: 在 pheomelanogenesis 過程中，胺基酸 Cysteine 與 dopaquinone 結合，形成 cysteinyldopas，後者環化並氧化成 benzothiazine 中間體。色素聚合過程中硫的摻入取決於多巴胺神經元中存在的 cysteine 和 glutathione。因此 Cysteine 充當使 benzothiazine 形成成為可能的硫供體。

label: p21
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Induction of the CDK inhibitor p21 enforces cell cycle arrest, often through a p53-dependent pathway. p21 blocks cyclin-CDK activity, halting progression at defined checkpoints. Induction of p21 is a core mechanism linking stress signaling to cell cycle arrest.
description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p21 的誘導會強制實施細胞週期停滯，通常透過 p53 依賴途徑。p21 會阻斷 cyclin–CDK 活性，使進程停滯在特定檢查點。p21 的誘導是將壓力訊號與細胞週期停滯連結的核心機制。

label: Vascular Calcification
description: SIRT3 counteracts vascular calcification via mitochondrial function preservation and oxidative stress mitigation, deacetylating proteins in the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway to promote mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification. AMPK/SIRT3 axis activation attenuated mineralization through mitochondrial functional restoration, and sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to impede VC progression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過維護粒線體功能和減輕氧化壓力來對抗血管鈣化，去乙醯化 PGC-1alpha/TFAM 途徑中的蛋白以促進粒線體生成同時減輕血管平滑肌細胞鈣化。AMPK/SIRT3 軸線活化透過粒線體功能恢復減輕礦化，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 可用性以阻礙 VC 進展。

label: lipogenesis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT3 inhibits lipogenesis (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制脂肪生成（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。

label: H3K9
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 is the principal H3K9 deacetylase (Vaquero et al., 2007). The vault graph lacked a direct SIRT1→H3K9 edge, routing it through 19 three-hop paths; this triple fills that curation gap, consistent with the source review's substrate catalogue.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是主要的 H3K9 去乙醯酶（Vaquero et al., 2007）。vault 圖譜原本缺少直接的 SIRT1→H3K9 邊，需經 19 條三跳路徑繞行；此三元組填補該策展缺口，與來源回顧的受質目錄一致。

label: IL-1β
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) decreases secretion of the pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta in human immune cells. In healthy volunteers, 24-hour NR administration reduced IL-1beta secretion in monocytes by over 50% (from approximately 22,000 to 10,000 pg/mL) and in macrophages by around 20% (from above 300 to less than 250 pg/mL). This effect is mediated by SIRT3-dependent blunting of NLRP3 inflammasome activation and enhanced mitochondrial quality control. By reducing IL-1beta and TNF-alpha production, NR demonstrates systemic anti-inflammatory activity consistent with its NAD+-boosting and sirtuin-activating mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）降低人類免疫細胞中促發炎細胞激素 IL-1beta 的分泌。在健康志願者中，24 小時 NR 給藥使單核細胞中 IL-1beta 分泌減少超過 50%（從約 22,000 降至 10,000 pg/mL），巨噬細胞中減少約 20%（從 300 以上降至 250 以下 pg/mL）。此效應由 SIRT3 依賴性的 NLRP3 發炎體活化減弱以及增強的粒線體品質控制所介導。透過減少 IL-1beta 和 TNF-alpha 的產生，NR 展現出與其提升 NAD+ 及活化去乙醯酶機制一致的全身性抗發炎活性。

label: fatty-acid metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 promotes fatty-acid metabolism by deacetylating and activating PGC-1alpha and PPARalpha to drive fatty-acid oxidation, represses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c, and mobilizes fat from white adipose tissue by repressing PPAR-gamma and aP2. This supports metabolic flexibility and the lean phenotype of caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1alpha 和 PPARalpha 來促進脂肪酸氧化，透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成，並透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 和 aP2 從白色脂肪組織中動員脂肪。這支持了代謝靈活性和熱量限制的精瘦表型。

label: Gasdermin D
description: Apoptotic caspases-3 and -7 cleave active gasdermin D (GSDMD) at the non-canonical aspartate-88 site, inactivating its pore-forming N-terminal fragment and thereby suppressing pyroptosis. Because these apoptotic caspases activate more slowly than caspase-1, this acts as a delayed negative-feedback brake: the inflammasome initiates pyroptosis, and the slower apoptotic arm damps it to prevent excessive inflammation. The nature of the death ultimately produced depends on which gasdermin substrate is available — GSDMD (inhibited by caspase-3/-7) versus GSDME (activated by caspase-3).
description_zh_TW: 凋亡性的 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 會在非典型天門冬胺酸-88 位點切割活化的 gasdermin D（GSDMD），使其成孔的 N 端片段失活，從而抑制焦亡。由於這些凋亡 caspases 的活化比 Caspase-1 慢，這形成延遲的負回饋剎車：發炎體啟動焦亡，而較慢的凋亡臂則抑制過度發炎。最終產生的死亡型態取決於可用的 gasdermin 受質——GSDMD（被 Caspase-3/-7 抑制）或 GSDME（被 Caspase-3 活化）。

label: TGF-β
description: Beyond SIRT1, SMURF2's canonical function is negative regulation of TGF-β/BMP signaling: as a HECT-domain E3 ligase it ubiquitinates SMAD proteins and SMAD7-bound receptor complexes, shaping the strength and duration of the pathway. This dual identity — SMAD regulator and SIRT1 E3 — makes SMURF2 a node where developmental signaling and sirtuin-controlled stress metabolism intersect.
description_zh_TW: 除了 SIRT1 之外，SMURF2 的典型功能是對 TGF-β/BMP 訊號的負向調節：作為 HECT 結構域的 E3 連接酶，它會泛素化 SMAD 蛋白及與 SMAD7 結合的受體複合體，從而塑造路徑的強度與持續時間。這種雙重身份——SMAD 調節者與 SIRT1 的 E3——使 SMURF2 成為發育訊號與 sirtuin 控制的壓力代謝相互交會的節點。

label: Chemotherapy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Leukemia is treated with cytotoxic chemotherapy and, in selected cases, targeted agents; ivermectin's activity remains preclinical.
description_zh_TW: Leukemia 接受細胞毒性化療，在某些情況下使用標靶藥物；伊維菌素的活性仍處於臨牀前階段。

label: Antioxidant Properties
description: Rutin scavenges free radicals, inhibits lipid peroxidation, and strengthens capillaries by supporting collagen cross-linking. It modulates oxidative stress and exhibits anti-inflammatory and mild antiplatelet effects. These actions contribute to cardiovascular protection and its use for vascular integrity.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 清除自由基、抑制脂質過氧化，並透過支持膠原蛋白交聯來強化微血管。它調節 oxidative stress，並表現出抗發炎和輕度抗血小板作用。這些作用有助於心血管保護及其用於血管完整性的用途。

label: Glutamine metabolism
description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamine metabolism by suppressing GDH-dependent anaplerosis, acting as a tumor suppressor in colorectal and other cancers that depend on glutamine; this restrains the glutamine addiction of proliferating cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 依賴性的回補反應來抑制穀胺酸代謝，在依賴穀胺酸的結直腸癌和其他癌症中作為腫瘤抑制因子；這抑制了增殖細胞對穀胺酸的成癮性。

label: p62
description: p62 delivers polyubiquitinated substrates to the autophagosome via its LIR motif and UBA domain, and is itself degraded by autophagy, making it a biomarker of autophagic flux. This couples p62 to lysosomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: p62 經由其 LIR 模體與 UBA 結構域將泛素化受質遞送至自噬體，並本身被自噬降解，使其成為自噬流的生物標記。這將 p62 與溶酶體降解相耦合。

label: Angiogenesis
description: The tumor microenvironment supports angiogenesis through proangiogenic factors such as VEGF secreted by tumor and stromal cells. SASP from senescent cells in the TME also drives tumor vascularization. Angiogenesis is thereby promoted by the tumor microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤微環境透過腫瘤與基質細胞分泌的 VEGF 等促血管生成因子支持血管新生。TME 中衰老細胞的 SASP 也驅動腫瘤血管形成。因此血管新生受到腫瘤微環境的促進。

label: Hallmarks of Cancer
description: Tumorigenesis proceeds through the acquisition of genetic and epigenetic alterations that confer the Hallmarks of Cancer. These enabling biological capabilities include sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The Hallmarks of Cancer framework describes the capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤發生透過獲得賦予癌症標誌的遺傳與表觀遺傳改變而進行。這些賦能生物學能力包括持續增生、逃避死亡與轉移。癌症標誌架構描述了腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的能力。

label: Glycine
description: Glycine is the third residue of the gamma-glutamyl-cysteinyl-glycine tripeptide and becomes rate-limiting for glutathione synthesis under metabolic stress, aging, and methylglyoxal overload.
description_zh_TW: 甘胺酸是 γ-麩胺醯-半胱胺醯-甘胺酸三肽的第三個殘基，在代謝壓力、老化與甲基乙二醛過載下成為穀胱甘肽合成的限速因子。

label: GATA4
description: SIRT7 ameliorates stress-induced cardiac hypertrophy by deacetylating the transcription factor GATA4. This protective action contrasts with SIRT7's pro-fibrotic role in cardiac fibrosis, where enhanced expression promotes fibrosis via Smad2/ERK signaling. The same nucleolar sirtuin therefore has divergent, context-dependent cardiovascular effects.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過去乙醯化轉錄因子 GATA4 改善壓力誘發的心臟肥大。此保護作用與 SIRT7 在心臟纖維化中的促纖維化角色形成對比，後者中增強的表現透過 Smad2/ERK 訊號促進纖維化。同一核仁 sirtuin 因此具有分歧、情境依賴的心血管效應。

label: Bcl-w
description: Bad binds Bcl-w. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-w is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member overexpressed in several carcinomas and hematologic malignancies where it blunts chemotherapy-induced death. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-w rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-w。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-w 是一種抗凋亡 Bcl-2 family 成員，在多種癌症和血液惡性腫瘤中過度表達，可減少化療引起的死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-w 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Cytoplasm
source_file: _document_ - A Biotin Switch-Based Proteomics Approach Identifies 14-3-3zeta as a Target of Sirt1 in the Metabolic Regulation of Caspase-2.md
description: In breast tumor cell lines SIRT1 is found predominantly in the cytoplasm — very little nuclear signal — in contrast to the nuclear distribution seen in normal breast tissue. Cytoplasmic SIRT1 is the form that regulates the 14-3-3ζ-caspase-2 module, and cytoplasmic SIRT1 is also the form generated by caspase cleavage during apoptosis, where it behaves pro-apoptotically in a deacetylase-independent manner. Subcellular localization therefore flips SIRT1's functional valence: nuclear anti-apoptotic, cytoplasmic context-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 在乳腺癌細胞株中，SIRT1 主要分布於細胞質——核內訊號極少——與正常乳腺組織的細胞核分布形成對比。細胞質型 SIRT1 正是調控 14-3-3ζ-Caspase-2 模組的形式，也是細胞凋亡期間被 caspase 切割後產生的形式，此時它以不依賴去乙醯活性的方式促進凋亡。次細胞定位因此翻轉了 SIRT1 的功能極性：細胞核內抗凋亡，細胞質內則視情境而定。

label: Stem Cells
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Restoring NAD+ with nicotinamide riboside (NR) reactivated mitochondrial metabolism, upregulated prohibitin proteins, and induced UPRmt, delaying stem cell senescence and extending lifespan in aged contexts. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence and diminished regenerative capacity, and NR treatment reverses this by restoring mitochondrial function. NR is a key NAD+ repletion strategy alongside NMN that restores sirtuin activity, enhances the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, and improves mitochondrial membrane potential, thereby supporting regeneration and resilience in aged stem cell c...
description_zh_TW: 使用煙醯胺核糖苷（NR）恢復NAD+重新激活粒線體代謝，上調prohibitin蛋白，並誘導UPRmt，延緩幹細胞衰老並延長老年環境中的壽命。在老年肌肉幹細胞、神經幹細胞和黑素細胞幹細胞中，NAD+耗竭導致衰老、靜止喪失和再生能力降低，NR治療透過恢復粒線體功能逆轉這一過程。NR是與NMN並列的關鍵NAD+補充策略，可恢復sirtuin活性，增強粒線體未折疊蛋白反應，並改善粒線體膜電位，從而支持老年幹細胞 compartment 的再生和恢復力。

label: Nucleus
description: TFEB translocates to the nucleus in response to dephosphorylation of its cytoplasmic-retention sites. Dephosphorylation of S211 and S142 by calcineurin, and of S122 and S109/S114 by PP2A, promotes nuclear translocation, while phosphorylation of S401 by p38 MAPK also drives the transcription factor into the nucleus. Acetylation at K91/K103/K430 and PARsylation by TNKS1 likewise promote nuclear translocation, and O-GlcNAc glucosylation of S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 promotes nuclear entry while S138 glucosylation blocks nuclear export. Once in the nucleus, TFEB activates transcription of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes, making nuclear localization the key regulatory decision point.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 通過其胞質保留位點的去磷酸化響應而轉位至細胞核。鈣調磷酸酶對 S211 和 S142 的去磷酸化，以及 PP2A 對 S122 和 S109/S114 的去磷酸化，促進核轉位；p38 MAPK 對 S401 的磷酸化也驅動轉錄因子進入細胞核。K91/K103/K430 的乙醯化以及 TNKS1 的 PARylation 同樣促進核轉位，S195/S196/S203/T201/T208 的 O-GlcNAc 糖基化促進核輸入，而 S138 的糖基化則阻斷核輸出。一旦進入細胞核，TFEB 啟動溶酶體生物發生和自噬基因的轉錄，使核定位成為關鍵的調節決定點。

label: Reverse Electron Transport
description: Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) oxidizes succinate and reduces ubiquinone; its product ubiquinol is the fuel that drives reverse electron transport when the membrane is highly polarized. Succinate accumulation during ischemia makes Complex II a key upstream driver of RET-derived ROS.
description_zh_TW: Complex II（琥珀酸脫氫酶）氧化琥珀酸並還原泛醌；其產物泛醇是膜高度極化時驅動反向電子傳遞（RET）的燃料。缺血期間的琥珀酸累積使 Complex II 成為 RET 來源 ROS 的關鍵上游驅動者。

label: CD8 T cells
description: Low-dose mTORC1 inhibition by rapamycin increases CD8+ memory T-cell counts and dendritic cell activity, improving immune responses to infection and vaccination. This low-dose immunostimulatory effect contrasts with the immunosuppression seen at higher doses.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 會增加 CD8+ 記憶 T 細胞數量與樹突細胞活性，改善對感染與疫苗的免疫反應。此低劑量免疫刺激作用與高劑量時的免疫抑制形成對比。

label: Thioredoxin-2
description: Mitochondrial thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) donates electrons to reduce the oxidized (disulfide) form of peroxiredoxin 3 (Prx3), restoring its peroxide-scavenging activity. Trx2 is itself recycled to the reduced form by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD2) using NADPH. Because Prx3 consumes the H2O2 generated by MnSOD, the Trx2/Prx3 arm is the water-evolving half of the mitochondrial peroxide-relay and a direct functional partner of MnSOD in the matrix.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 thioredoxin-2（Trx2）捐贈電子以還原 peroxiredoxin 3（Prx3）的氧化態（雙硫）形式，恢復其過氧化物清除活性。Trx2 本身再由粒線體 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD2）以 NADPH 回收為還原形式。由於 Prx3 消耗 MnSOD 所產生的 H2O2，Trx2/Prx3 分支是粒線體過氧化物接力中產生水的半段，也是 MnSOD 在基質中的直接功能夥伴。

label: Immune Aging
description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

label: EGFR
description: Cancer is driven by EGFR. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Cancer, so EGFR is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由EGFR 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從 EGFR 朝向 Cancer，因此 EGFR 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: GSK3
description: GSK3beta phosphorylates TFEB at serine 138, promoting lysosomal localization and nuclear export (PMID 27617930, 29992949), and at S134 promoting lysosomal localization. Phosphorylation of TFEB by GSK3beta modulates its subcellular distribution, controlling access of the transcription factor to its nuclear targets. The S138 site is particularly notable because it is also subject to O-GlcNAc glucosylation that blocks TFEB nuclear export, illustrating cross-talk between phosphorylation and glycosylation at the same residue. GSK3beta regulation of TFEB links glycogen synthase kinase signaling to the control of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: GSK3beta 在絲氨酸 138 上磷酸化 TFEB，促進溶酶體定位和核輸出（PMID 27617930、29992949），並在 S134 上磷酸化 TFEB 促進溶酶體定位。GSK3beta 對 TFEB 的磷酸化調節其亞細胞分布，控制轉錄因子對其核靶標的可及性。S138 位點特別值得注意，因為它也受到 O-GlcNAc 糖基化的調節，該糖基化阻斷 TFEB 的核輸出，說明同一殘基上磷酸化和糖基化之間的交談。GSK3beta 對 TFEB 的調節將糖原合酶激酶信號與溶酶體生物發生和自噬的控制聯繫起來。

label: Teratoma
description: Teratoma formation is the gold-standard assay of pluripotency, validating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC) and embryonic stem cells (ESC) for rejuvenation medicine. This is an instrumental, research-level benefit of a benign tumor rather than an organismal longevity benefit.
description_zh_TW: 畸胎瘤形成是分化多能性的黃金標準檢定，驗證誘導性多能幹細胞（iPSC）與胚胎幹細胞（ESC）用於回春醫學。這是良性腫瘤的器械性、研究層級益處，而非生物體層級的長壽益處。

label: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Monoamine oxidase inhibitors block the intracellular mitochondrial enzyme that oxidatively deaminates dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine. Because MAO-mediated deamination is one of the dominant routes of catecholamine breakdown, inhibition raises catecholamine concentrations and can produce cardiovascular and autonomic effects such as higher blood pressure and heart rate. In combination with COMT inhibition, MAO inhibition strongly reduces overall catecholamine degradation, and the resulting excess epinephrine has more opportunity to undergo autoxidation or radical-mediated conversion to adrenochrome. Such combinations are used in Parkinson's disease under medical supervision but carry risks of hypertensive crisis with non-selective or high-dose use.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase 抑制劑阻斷氧化脫胺多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的細胞內粒線體酶。由於 MAO 介導的脫胺是兒茶酚胺分解的主要途徑之一，抑制會升高兒茶酚胺濃度，並可產生如血壓升高與心率加快等心血管與自主神經效應。與 COMT 抑制併用時，MAO 抑制強烈減少整體兒茶酚胺降解，所導致的過量 epinephrine 有更多機會經歷自氧化或自由基介導轉化為 adrenochrome。此類組合在醫療監督下用於帕金森氏症，但在非選擇性或高劑量使用時帶有高血壓危機的風險。

label: Multidrug Resistance
description: Elevated HSP27 correlates with resistance to chemotherapy (e.g., docetaxel) in prostate and other cancers.
description_zh_TW: HSP27 升高與前列腺癌及其他癌症對化療（如 docetaxel）的抗性相關。

label: Sulfiredoxin
description: Sulfiredoxin (Srx/SRXN1) is the ATP-dependent enzyme that rescues hyperoxidized (sulfinylated) peroxiredoxin back to the active state, directly Nrf2-induced as feed-forward. Together with glutaredoxin it constitutes the reversible-repair machinery that turns moderate ROS into hormetic adaptation (memory) rather than irreversible collapse.
description_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin（Srx/SRXN1）是 ATP 依賴性酵素，可將過度氧化（亞磺醯化）的過氧化還原酶救回活性態，本身受 Nrf2 誘導而具前饋作用。它與 glutaredoxin 共同構成可逆修復機械，使中等量 ROS 轉為荷爾蒙適應（記憶）而非不可逆崩潰。

label: RRM2B
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2B (p53R2) provides a p53-inducible small (beta-prime) subunit that partners with RRM1 to provision dNTPs for DNA repair and mitochondrial DNA synthesis. RRM2B mutations cause mitochondrial DNA depletion syndromes.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2B（p53R2）提供受 p53 誘導的（beta-prime）小次單元，與 RRM1 配對以供應 DNA 修復與粒線體 DNA 合成所需的 dNTP。RRM2B 突變會導致粒線體 DNA 耗竭症候群。

label: Hypoxia
description: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues. Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin. Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia is a condition in which elevated levels of methemoglobin reduce oxygen delivery to tissues。Because methemoglobin cannot transport oxygen and left-shifts the oxygen-dissociation curve of remaining hemoglobin, affected patients develop a functional anemia and tissue hypoxia even with normal total hemoglobin。Symptom thresholds scale with methemoglobin percentage: levels of 30-50% cause dizziness, confusion, tachycardia and tachypnea, 50-70% cause coma, seizures, arrhythmias and acidosis, and levels above 70% are life-threatening with a high risk of death if untreated。

label: PIDD
description: PIDD activates Caspase-2. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: PIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: JNK
description: ASK1 phosphorylates and activates the dual-specificity MAP2Ks MKK4 and MKK7, which in turn activate JNK. ASK1 sits upstream of the JNK cascade and links diverse cellular stressors to JNK-dependent transcription. This makes ASK1 a central conduit for stress-induced JNK signaling that governs inflammation, apoptosis, and cell survival.
description_zh_TW: ASK1 磷酸化並激活雙特異性 MAP2K（MKK4 和 MKK7），後者進而激活 JNK。ASK1 位於 JNK 級聯上游，將各種細胞壓力與 JNK 依賴性轉錄連結起來。這使 ASK1 成為壓力誘導之 JNK 訊號傳導的核心通道，調控發炎、細胞凋亡與細胞存活。

label: Bik
description: Bik activates Bak. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The relationship is directional, with Bik acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Bik 激活 Bak。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bik 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CDK2
source_file: _document_ - Senolytic Treatment With Fisetin Reverses Age‐Related Endothelial Dysfunction Partially Mediated by SASP Factor CXCL12.md
description: SIRT1 promotes T-ALL progression by deacetylating CDK2, which drives p27 phosphorylation and degradation, and SIRT1 knockdown sensitizes AML to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. SIRT2 activation by NAMPT reduces proliferation and induces apoptosis in AML blasts via the Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin axis, showing opposing leukemic roles for the two sirtuins.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 CDK2 促進 T-ALL 進展，後者驅動 p27 磷酸化與降解，且 SIRT1 敲低使 AML 對酪胺酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。SIRT2 經由 NAMPT 活化透過 Akt/GSK-3beta/beta-catenin 軸減少增生並誘發 AML 母細胞凋亡，顯示兩個 sirtuin 相反的白血病角色。

label: Vitamin C
description: Gomez-Cabrera et al. (2008, PMID 18175748) showed oral vitamin C decreases muscle mitochondrial biogenesis and hampers training-induced endurance adaptations. This is among the cleanest human studies showing antioxidant interference with a hormetic stressor (exercise), blunting the necessary acute ROS signal.
description_zh_TW: Gomez-Cabrera 等人（2008，PMID 18175748）顯示口服維生素 C 降低肌肉粒線體生成並妨礙訓練誘發的耐力適應。這是最乾淨的人體研究之一，顯示抗氧化劑干擾促效應壓力源（運動），減弱必要的急性 ROS 訊號。

label: Platelet aggregation
description: Platelet aggregation is the process whereby activated platelets bind to one another through fibrinogen bridging the integrin receptor, forming the terminal common pathway of primary hemostasis. Activated platelets aggregate to form thrombi and support coagulation.
