description_zh_TW: 血小板凝集是活化的血小板透過纖維蛋白原橋接整合素受體而彼此結合的過程，是初級止血的終末共同途徑。活化的血小板凝集成血栓並支持凝血。

label: Wound Healing
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Dietary advanced glycation end products are exogenous glycotoxins absorbed from food that trigger organ dysfunction and tissue aging. In genetically diabetic mice, adverse effects of dietary glycotoxins on wound healing have been demonstrated, and dietary AGEs also accelerate endothelial dysfunction and arterial aging with prolonged exposure. Because AGEs promote inflammation via RAGE and cross-link extracellular matrix proteins, dietary glycotoxins burden the body in addition to endogenous glycation. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE levels and may protect against AGE-related tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Dietary advanced glycation end products 是從食物吸收的 exogenous glycotoxins，會引發 organ dysfunction 與 tissue aging。在 genetically diabetic mice 中，已證實 dietary glycotoxins 對 wound healing 有 adverse effects，且長期暴露下 dietary AGEs 也會加速 endothelial dysfunction 與 arterial aging。由於 AGEs 透過 RAGE 促進 inflammation 並使 extracellular matrix proteins 交聯，dietary glycotoxins 在 endogenous glycation 之外還會加重身體負擔。限制 dietary AGEs 可降低 circulating AGE levels，並可能保護免受 AGE-related tissue damage。

label: Polyphenols
description: Polyphenols are metabolized by the gut microbiome, with the majority of dietary polyphenols reaching the colon intact for bacterial transformation into absorbable metabolites. Microbial catabolism both activates and inactivates these compounds, shaping their systemic bioavailability. The directionality is host diet to microbial biotransformation. A caveat is that the resulting metabolites, not the parent compounds, often mediate the in vivo antioxidant and signaling effects. Inter-individual differences in microbial polyphenol metabolism explain much of the variability in the health effects of these compounds.
description_zh_TW: Polyphenols 由 gut microbiome 代謝，大部分飲食 polyphenols 完整地到達結腸，被細菌轉化為可吸收的代謝物。微生物分解代謝既可以活化也可以使這些化合物失活，從而影響它們的全身生物利用度。方向性是宿主飲食對微生物生物轉化的影響。需要注意的是，產生的代謝物，而不是母體化合物，通常介導體體內抗氧化和訊號傳導作用。微生物多酚代謝的個體間差異解釋了這些化合物對健康影響的大部分差異。

label: PI3K/Akt
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: PI3K/AKT signaling regulates Sirt3 in various contexts, generally opposing SIRT3-mediated catabolic/mitochondrial programs (e.g., PI3K/AKT modulates Sirt3 in activated microglia); Table 3 lists PI3K/AKT among negative regulators of the SIRT3 pathway (PMID 37930585).
description_zh_TW: PI3K/AKT 信號在多種環境中調節 Sirt3，通常拮抗 SIRT3 介導的分解代謝/粒線體程序（例如 PI3K/AKT 在活化的小膠質細胞中調節 Sirt3）；表 3 將 PI3K/AKT 列為 SIRT3 通路的負向調節因子（PMID 37930585）。

label: Proteins
description: Protein carbonylation is an irreversible modification of proteins introduced by metal-catalyzed oxidation or by adduction of lipid-peroxidation products to susceptible residues. It marks severe, often non-repairable oxidative damage and is used as a biomarker. The directionality is oxidative insult to stable carbonyl formation. A caveat is that carbonylation can also arise from glycation and other non-ROS processes, so it is not exclusively an oxidative-stress marker. Carbonyls can be measured in plasma, tissues, and cell lysates, and their accumulation is a hallmark of aging and age-related disease.
description_zh_TW: Protein carbonylation 是 proteins 的不可逆修飾，透過金屬催化氧化或透過脂質過氧化產物與敏感殘基的加合引入。它標誌著嚴重的、通常不可修復的氧化損傷，並被用作生物標記。方向性是對穩定羰基形成的氧化損傷。需要注意的是，羰基化也可能由糖化和其他非 ROS 過程引起，因此它不僅僅是氧化壓力標記。可以在血漿、組織和細胞裂解物中測量羰基，它們的累積是 aging 和年齡相關疾病的標誌。

label: Bmf
description: Bmf activates Bak. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The relationship is directional, with Bmf acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Bmf 活化 Bak。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bmf 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Chondrocytes
description: In osteoarthritis, SIRT3 preserves mitochondrial integrity by deacetylating cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4 isoform 2, and its deletion correlates with OA exacerbation in animal and human models. SIRT3 promotes mitophagy via the PINK1/Parkin axis, maintains mitochondrial health by regulating FOXO3a hyperacetylation, inhibits chondrocyte apoptosis through PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, facilitates mitochondrial fusion for mtDNA complementation, and enhances cartilage resilience.
description_zh_TW: 在骨關節炎中，SIRT3 透過去乙醯化細胞色素 c 氧化酶亞基 4 異型 2 維護粒線體完整性，其缺失與動物和人類模型中的 OA 加劇相關。SIRT3 透過 PINK1/Parkin 軸線促進粒線體自噬，透過調節 FOXO3a 超乙醯化維護粒線體健康，透過 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 訊號抑制軟骨細胞凋亡，促進粒線體融合以進行 mtDNA 補償，並增強軟骨韌性。

label: Sirtuin-Caspase Crosstalk
description: AGK2 liberates caspase-2/3-dependent apoptosis in nucleated cells, engaging sirtuin-caspase crosstalk. In platelets it instead triggers caspase-independent calpain-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在有核細胞中釋放依賴 caspase-2/3 的細胞凋亡，啟動 sirtuin-caspase 交互作用；而在血小板中則改為觸發不依賴 caspase 的 calpain 介導細胞死亡。

label: o-quinone
description: Adrenochrome is very unstable due to its ortho-quinoid (o-quinone) structure, and is therefore usually stabilized by conventional derivatization with hydrazines such as aminoguanidine and semicarbazide to form hemostatic medicines. This instability also means that during the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline, the produced adrenochrome may be further oxidized and decompose to black by-products, so the reaction is monitored by sampling and measuring the absorbance at 495 nm, which is stopped at the point of maximum yield.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅因其鄰醌式（o-quinone）結構而極不穩定，因此通常透過與胺基胍和氨基硫脲等肼類的常規衍生化來穩定，以形成止血藥物。此不穩定性也意味著在腎上腺素的過硫酸鹽氧化過程中，生成的腎上腺紅可能進一步氧化並分解為黑色副產物，因此反應透過取樣並測量495 nm的吸光度來監控，並在產率最大時停止。

label: Malondialdehyde
description: Lipid peroxidation produces malondialdehyde (MDA), a three-carbon dialdehyde arising from cyclization and fragmentation of peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acids such as arachidonic acid. MDA is reactive and forms adducts with proteins and DNA, contributing to downstream toxicity. The directionality is membrane damage yielding a diffusible, immunogenic byproduct. A caveat is that MDA is one of many aldehyde products, so its measurement captures only part of the peroxidation burden. MDA forms under both physiological and pathological conditions and is the most commonly measured TBARS-based endpoint in redox research.
description_zh_TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 malondialdehyde (MDA)，一種三碳二醛，由過氧化 polyunsaturated fatty acids（例如花生四烯酸）環化和裂解產生。 MDA 具有反應性，可與 proteins 和 DNA 形成加合物，導致下游毒性。方向性是膜損傷，產生可擴散的免疫原性副產物。需要注意的是，MDA 是眾多醛類產品之一，因此其測量僅捕獲部分過氧化負擔。 MDA 在生理和病理條件下形成，是氧化還原研究中最常測量的基於 TBARS 的終點。

label: Ribonucleotide Reductase
description: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is the only enzyme that catalyzes the de novo conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates (NDPs) into deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs), the immediate precursors of the dNTPs required for DNA replication and repair. It is the rate-limiting, allosterically regulated committed step of de novo dNTP synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）是唯一能催化核醣核苷二磷酸（NDP）de novo 轉化為去氧核醣核苷二磷酸（dNDP）的酵素，dNDP 是 DNA 複製與修復所需 dNTP 的直接前驅物。它是 de novo dNTP 合成中受別構調控、速率限制的承諾步驟。

label: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins
description: Apoptosis is inhibited by Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The directionality runs from Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins toward Apoptosis, so Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 被 Apoptosis 抑制。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。方向性從Apoptosis向Apoptosis延伸，因此Apoptosis是活性劑，Apoptosis是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Innate Immune System
description: Mitochondria act as platforms for orchestrating innate immune responses to external threats. The MAVS protein, an outer mitochondrial membrane adaptor, binds retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) that sense viral RNA, self-propagates in a prion-like fashion, and recruits TRAF2, TRAF6, and RIPK1 to activate antiviral signaling. Additionally, mitochondrial ROS prime the NLRP3 inflammasome, whose activation leads to caspase-1 activation and proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta, linking mitochondrial stress to the inflammatory response.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 作為 orchestrate innate immune responses to external threats 的平台。MAVS 蛋白是一種外線粒體膜 adaptor，結合 retinoic-acid-inducible gene I-like receptors (RLRs) 感測 viral RNA，以 prion-like fashion 自我增殖，並招募 TRAF2、TRAF6 和 RIPK1 激活 antiviral signaling。此外，mitochondrial ROS priming NLRP3 inflammasome，其 activation 導致 caspase-1 activation 和 proteolytic cleavage of pro-interleukin-1beta，將 mitochondrial stress 與 inflammatory response 連結。

label: Intrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Intrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Intrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Intrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Intrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Monoamine oxidase
description: Methylene blue is a potent inhibitor of monoamine oxidase, specifically MAO-A. This MAO-A inhibition means that combining methylene blue with serotonergic medications - such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), or certain pain relievers - can cause a life-threatening accumulation of serotonin (serotonin syndrome). This drug-interaction risk is a critical safety consideration when methylene blue is used clinically, particularly in the perioperative or critical-care setting.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue是單胺氧化酶的強效抑制劑，特別是MAO-A。這種MAO-A抑制意味著將methylene blue與血清素能藥物——如選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRIs）、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑（SNRIs）或某些止痛藥——結合使用可能導致危及生命的血清素積累（血清素症候群）。當methylene blue在臨床上使用時，這種藥物相互作用風險是關鍵的安全考慮因素，特別是在圍手术期或重症護理環境中。

label: Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition
description: HGF-MET signaling produces the invasive growth program including branching morphogenesis, migration, and epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition-like scattering of epithelial cells. MET recapitulates this program through GRB2/SOS, PI3K-AKT, STAT3 and SRC-family kinase signaling.
description_zh_TW: HGF-MET 訊號產生侵入性生長程式，包括分支形態發生、遷移和上皮細胞的類上皮-間質轉化散射。MET 透過 GRB2/SOS、PI3K-AKT、STAT3 和 SRC 家族激酶訊號重現此程式。

label: SAMe
description: The methylation cycle transfers methyl groups for DNA methylation and neurotransmitter synthesis, with central metabolites including SAMe and folate. The cycle is regulated by enzymes such as MTHFR, and dysregulation is linked to cardiovascular disease, neurodegeneration, and aging.
description_zh_TW: 甲基化循環為 DNA 甲基化與神經傳導物質合成轉移甲基，中心代謝物包括 SAMe 與葉酸。循環由 MTHFR 等酶調控，其失調與心血管疾病、神經退化及衰老相關。

label: Kaempferol
description: Kaempferol, a flavonol (3,5,7,4'-tetrahydroxyflavone) and sister compound to quercetin/apigenin, directly activates SIRT1 as a natural polyphenol STAC via K-type allosteric Km lowering, and is frequently co-studied for anti-aging and cancer-risk reduction.
description_zh_TW: Kaempferol 是一種黄酮醇（3,5,7,4'-四羥基黄酮），是 quercetin/apigenin 的姊妹化合物，作為天然多酚類 STAC 透過 K 型別構降低 Km 直接活化 SIRT1，常與抗老化和降低癌症風險的研究並提。

label: Synaptic Vesicles
description: Dopamine is located in Synaptic Vesicles, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Synaptic Vesicles 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

label: Chronic Kidney Disease
description: SIRT6 is markedly downregulated in chronic kidney disease and vascular calcification patients, and it suppresses osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells via runt-related transcription factor 2. MSC exosomes inhibit high-phosphate aortic calcification through SIRT6-HMGB1 deacetylation, and proximal tubule-specific SIRT6 knockout aggravates UUO fibrosis. SIRT6 thereby protects the kidney and vasculature in CKD.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在慢性腎病與血管鈣化患者中明顯下調，且它透過 runt-related transcription factor 2 抑制血管平滑肌細胞的成骨轉分化。MSC 外泌體透過 SIRT6-HMGB1 去乙醯化抑制高磷酸血 aortic 鈣化，且近曲小管專一性 SIRT6 基因敲除加劇 UUO 纖維化。SIRT6 因此保護 CKD 中的腎臟與血管。

label: Human Growth Hormone
description: Human growth hormone (HGH) is widely used for rejuvenation and longevity, yet it actually accelerates aging and shortens lifespan. Growth hormone is a pro-aging hormone because it indirectly activates mTOR, and the hype around growth hormone is based on a single publication that misinterpreted its acute effects. Unlike HGH, the anti-aging effects of rapamycin are not based on a single paper or a wild guess but on the work of thousands of scientists studying mTOR and its inhibitors in diverse organisms from yeast to humans.
description_zh_TW: 人類生長激素（HGH）被廣泛用於回春與長壽，但它實際上會加速衰老並縮短壽命。生長激素是促衰老激素，因為它會間接活化 mTOR；而生長激素的炒作源於單一出版物誤解了其急性效應。與 HGH 不同，雷帕黴素的抗衰老效果並非基於單一論文或隨意猜測，而是基於數千名科學家從酵母菌到人類等各種生物中研究 mTOR 及其抑制劑的成果。

label: Fibrosis
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD) and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. DMD is characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration, and decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression are also observed in this condition. By improving muscular strength, rejuvenating senescent muscle stem cells, and reducing levels of inflammation and fibrosis, NR could be effective in managing the progression of muscular dystrophy and degeneration. These findings support the use of NR for the human condition of DMD.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）被發現能改善 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。DMD 的特徵為 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化，且在此疾病中亦觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低。透過改善肌肉力量、使衰老的肌肉幹細胞年輕化，以及降低發炎與纖維化程度，NR 可能有效管理肌肉營養不良與退化的進程。這些發現支持將 NR 用於人類 DMD 病症。

label: NADPH
description: FSP1's NAD(P)H-dependent ubiquinone oxidoreductase activity draws reducing equivalents from NAD(P)H to regenerate ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), the lipophilic radical trap that halts lipid peroxidation. NAD(P)H is therefore the obligate electron donor for the GPX4-independent FSP1 axis.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 依賴 NAD(P)H 的泛醌氧化還原酶活性，從 NAD(P)H 取得還原當量以重新生成泛醇（CoQ10H2）——這個脂溶性自由基陷阱能中止脂質過氧化。因此 NAD(P)H 是 FSP1 這條不依賴 GPX4 的路徑所必需的電子供體。

label: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In an oncogenic mouse model, supplementation with NMN (500 mg/kg body weight daily for 13 days) significantly increased the secretory phenotype associated with pro-inflammatory senescence, promoting pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma progression. This raises the hypothesis that dietary supplements that increase NAD+ may be tumorigenic in vivo under stress conditions such as premalignant senescent lesions induced by activated oncogenes. The finding highlights the complex, context-dependent interplay between NAD+ metabolism and cancer biology, cautioning that NAD+ precursor supplementation could accelerate tumorigenesis in certain premalignant settings even as it confers health benefits in normal aging and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: 在致癌小鼠模型中，補充 NMN（每天 500 mg/kg 體重，持續 13 天）顯著增加了與促發炎性衰老相關的分泌型態，促進胰管腺癌的進展。這提出了這樣的假說：在活化致癌基因誘發的癌前衰老病變等壓力條件下，提升 NAD+ 的膳食補充劑可能在體內具有致癌性。此發現凸顯了 NAD+ 代謝與癌症生物學之間複雜且依賴情境的相互作用，並警示儘管 NAD+ 前驅物補充在正常老化與代謝疾病中帶來健康益處，但在某些癌前情境中可能加速腫瘤發生。

label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
description: Enhanced SIRT6 activity abrogates the neurotoxicity of ALS-linked mutant SOD1 astrocytes, making SIRT6 a therapeutic target in ALS. SIRT1 is increased in SOD1-G93A mice and SIRT3 is increased in ALS spinal cord, with functional implications still unclear, while SIRT6 upregulation also alleviates inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis after spinal cord injury.
description_zh_TW: 增強的 SIRT6 活性消除 ALS 連結突變 SOD1 星狀細胞的神經毒性，使 SIRT6 成為 ALS 的治療標的。SIRT1 在 SOD1-G93A 小鼠中增加，SIRT3 在 ALS 脊髓中增加，功能意義仍不明，而 SIRT6 上調亦減輕脊髓損傷後的發炎、氧化壓力與凋亡。

label: Androgen Receptor
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: Bid
description: Bid is a BH3-only direct activator: in the absence of anti-apoptotic restraint it can directly bind and trigger BAX (and BAK), bypassing the need for sensitizer displacement. In the extrinsic pathway, caspase-8 cleavage of Bid (tBid) routes death-receptor signals into the intrinsic mitochondrial arm in type II cells, and in ischemia-reperfusion injury models caspase-1 cleavage of Bid likewise converts pyroptotic signaling into mitochondrial apoptosis when gasdermin pores are unavailable.
description_zh_TW: Bid 是 BH3-only 的直接活化因子：在缺乏抗凋亡抑制時，它可直接結合並觸發 BAX（與 BAK），無需敏化因子的置換。在外在路徑中，caspase-8 對 Bid 的切割（tBid）使死亡受體訊號在 type II 細胞中轉入內在粒線體臂；而在缺血再灌注損傷模型中，Caspase-1 對 Bid 的切割同樣可在 gasdermin 孔道缺席時，將焦亡訊號轉為粒線體凋亡。

label: Streptomyces avermectinius
description: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
description_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

label: Kitasato Institute
description: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
description_zh_TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。

label: Benzothiazine
description: Benzothiazine rings have been identified within the heterogeneous core of Neuromelanin, reflecting its mixed eumelanic and pheomelanic chemistry. Solid-state NMR and X-ray spectroscopy reveal sulfur-containing benzothiazine-like moieties alongside indolic 5,6-indolequinone-derived units. The benzothiazine content may influence neuromelanin's paramagnetic and metal-binding properties.
description_zh_TW: 在 Neuromelanin 的異質核心中已鑑定出 benzothiazine 環，反映了其混合的 eumelanic 和 pheomelanic 化學特性。固態 NMR 和 X 射線光譜揭示了含硫的 benzothiazine 樣基團，以及源自 5,6-indolequinone 的吲哚類單元。benzothiazine 含量可能影響 neuromelanin 的順磁性和金屬結合特性。

label: addiction
description: Stimulus-response learning underlies both adaptive expertise and maladaptive habits, including addiction and compulsive behaviors. Its COMT dependence links genetic dopamine regulation to individual differences in habit formation. Understanding S-R mechanisms informs therapeutic approaches to compulsive and addictive disorders.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 既構成適應性專長，也構成適應不良習慣，包括成癮和強迫行為。其對 COMT 的依賴將遺傳性多巴胺調節與習慣形成的個體差異連結起來。了解 S-R 機制有助於治療強迫性和成癮性疾病的介入方法。

label: Clofarabine
description: Clofarabine received FDA accelerated approval in December 2004 for pediatric patients (ages 1-21) with relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia after at least two prior regimens. It was the first new drug approved for pediatric leukemia in over a decade.
description_zh_TW: Clofarabine 於 2004 年 12 月獲得 FDA 加速核准，用於至少接受過兩種先前療程後復發或難治型急性淋巴性白血病的兒童患者（1-21 歲）。它是十多年來第一個獲核准用於兒童白血病的藥物。

label: Acute Stress-Associated Phenotype
description: Apigenin blocks the transition of the ASAP toward the SASP by disrupting ATM-HSPA8 and HSPA8-p38 MAPK crosstalk, preventing maturation of the secretome. As a flavonoid it also binds PRDX6 to inhibit its iPLA2 activity, further gatekeeping the transition between acute stress response and chronic secretion. This early intervention contrasts with agents that only suppress the established SASP, positioning apigenin as a candidate preventive senomorphic that acts at the ASAP stage. The mechanism highlights HSPA8 and PRDX6 as druggable nodes in senescence initiation.
description_zh_TW: Apigenin 透過破壞 ATM-HSPA8 與 HSPA8-p38 MAPK 交互作用阻斷 ASAP 朝向 SASP 的轉變，防止分泌組成熟。作為類黃酮它也結合 PRDX6 抑制其 iPLA2 活性，進一步守門急性壓力反應與慢性分泌間的轉變。此早期介入不同於僅抑制已建立 SASP 的藥劑，將 apigenin 定位為作用於 ASAP 階段的候選預防性 senomorphic。此機制凸顯 HSPA8 與 PRDX6 作為衰老起始中可藥物化的節點。

label: PINK1
description: In healthy mitochondria, PINK1 (PTEN-induced putative kinase 1) is continuously imported into the inner membrane, cleaved and degraded by PARL and mitochondrial processing peptidases. When mitochondrial membrane potential becomes abnormal or import is impaired, PINK1 stabilizes and accumulates on the outer mitochondrial membrane, where its kinase domain phosphorylates outer membrane proteins and recruits and activates the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin (PRKN). PINK1 phosphorylation of MFN2 acts as a Parkin receptor that facilitates Parkin recruitment, and activated Parkin polyubiquitinates outer membrane proteins, marking damaged mitochondria for autophagic degradation.
description_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，PINK1（PTEN-induced putative kinase 1）持續被輸入內膜，並被PARL和粒線體加工肽酶切割和降解。當粒線體膜電位異常或輸入受損時，PINK1會穩定並累積在外膜上，其激酶結構域在此磷酸化外膜蛋白質並招募和活化E3泛素連接酶Parkin（PRKN）。PINK1對MFN2的磷酸化作為Parkin受體，促進Parkin招募，活化的Parkin將外膜蛋白質多聚泛素化，標記受損粒線體以進行自噬降解。

label: Natural Killer Cells
description: SASP chemokines including CCL2, CCL5, CXCL1, and CXCL10 act as find-me signals that recruit NK cells to sites of senescence, where they then kill the arrested cells. This recruitment converts the SASP into an immune-clearance stimulus, and the engagement is enhanced by type-I interferons from cGAS-STING. Declining NK function with age weakens this recruitment and clearance, contributing to senescent-cell accumulation. Enhancing NK recruitment and activation is therefore a strategy to restore senescence surveillance.
description_zh_TW: SASP 趨化因子包括 CCL2、CCL5、CXCL1 與 CXCL10 作為 find-me 訊號，招募 NK 細胞至衰老部位，隨後殺死停滯細胞。此招募將 SASP 轉化為免疫清除刺激，且此參與被 cGAS-STING 的第一型干擾素增強。隨年齡下降的 NK 功能減弱此招募與清除，貢獻衰老細胞累積。因此增強 NK 招募與活化是恢復衰老監視的策略。

label: Apoptosome
description: Apoptosome is composed of Apaf-1. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Apaf-1 is the scaffolding adaptor of the apoptosome, containing CARD, NB-ARC, and WD40 domains that bind cytochrome c and recruit procaspase-9. The directionality runs from Apaf-1 toward Apoptosome, so Apaf-1 is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosome由Apaf-1組成。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Apaf-1 是凋亡體的支架接頭，包含結合 Cytochrome c 並募集 procaspase-9 的 CARD、NB-ARC 和 WD40 結構域。方向性從 Apaf-1 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 Apaf-1 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Lipid Metabolism
description: SIRT2 prevents hepatic steatosis by deacetylating HNF4alpha, a master regulator of hepatic lipid genes, and suppresses adipocyte differentiation via FoxO1 deacetylation that restrains PPAR-gamma; reduced SIRT2 in obese adipose progenitors is linked to visceral fat expansion.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝臟脂質基因的主調控因子 HNF4α 來預防肝脂肪變性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化抑制脂肪細胞分化（FoxO1 去乙醯化可抑制 PPAR-γ）；肥胖脂肪前體細胞中 SIRT2 的減少與內臟脂肪擴增相關。

label: Obesity
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT3 suppresses obesity by activating macroautophagy through the AMPK-ULK1 pathway to produce smaller lipid droplets, and by inducing the perilipin-1-Hsc71-LAMP2 complex to drive chaperone-mediated autophagy. These mitochondrial-autophagy actions promote lipid catabolism and energy expenditure, opposing adipose accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 AMPK-ULK1 路徑活化巨自噬以產生較小的脂滴，並誘發 perilipin-1-Hsc71-LAMP2 複合體以驅動伴侶介導的自噬，從而抑制肥胖。這些粒線體—自噬作用促進脂質分解與能量消耗，對抗脂肪堆積。

label: Hormetic Window
description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 acetylation ratio is the mechanistic dial that sets the hormetic window for MnSOD-dependent redox tone ('SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window', conf 0.95): locked-off drives cancer/hypertension, locked-on drives cardiomyopathy — restored cycling is protective.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 乙醯化比率是決定 MnSOD 依賴氧化還原張力荷爾蒙窗口的機制旋鈕（「SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window」，conf 0.95）：鎖定關閉驅動癌症／高血壓，鎖定開啟驅動心肌病變——恢復循環則具保護作用。

label: Fatty acid oxidation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: SIRT4 inhibits fatty-acid oxidation at the mitochondria by suppressing malonyl-CoA decarboxylase (MCD) ADP-ribosylase activity and restraining oxidative fuel use, an adaptive suppression that rises under calorie restriction; during aging its dysregulation perturbs metabolic fuel selection (source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制丙二醯輔酶 A 脫羧酶（MCD）ADP-核糖基酶活性並抑制氧化燃料使用來抑制粒線體中的脂肪酸氧化，這種適應性抑制在熱量限制下升高；在衰老過程中，其失調干擾代謝燃料選擇（文獻綜述）。

label: Carbazochrome
description: Carbazochrome is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone ('is_derivative_of', conf 0.95), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to make a relatively chemically inactive derivative — resolving the Round-2 amplifier-conflict ticket as an evidence-based null for carbazochrome redox-cycling at Complex I.
description_zh_TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（「is_derivative_of」，conf 0.95），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成的一種相對化學惰性衍生物——把第二輪放大器衝突票裁定為 carbazochrome 在 Complex I 氧化還原循環的以證據為基礎的空結果。

label: SCAPs
description: SCAPs (senescence-cell anti-apoptotic pathways) are the ensemble of pro-survival mechanisms that allow senescent cells to persist despite SASP and DNA damage. Senolytic therapies kill senescent cells by targeting these anti-apoptotic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SCAPs（衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑）是讓衰老細胞儘管有 SASP 與 DNA 損傷仍能存續的促存活機制總和。Senolytic 療法透過靶向這些抗凋亡途徑殺死衰老細胞。

label: Enhancer-Promoter Looping
description: In cellular senescence, large-scale rewiring of the enhancer-promoter network is a primary mechanism by which the epigenetic landscape activates SASP genes. EP loops place senescence-activated enhancers in contact with SASP promoters to induce their secretion.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞衰老中，增強子-啟動子網路的大規模重組是表觀遺傳景觀活化 SASP 基因的主要機制。EP 環化使衰老活化的增強子與 SASP 啟動子接觸以誘導其分泌。

label: Hemolysis
description: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions. Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated. These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome and related pathway intermediates can promote methemoglobin formation, hemolysis at high concentrations, and lipid peroxidation in erythrocyte membranes under oxidative conditions。Adrenochrome-induced hemolysis (rupture of red blood cells) has been observed in experimental settings, and older research from the 1960s-1970s examined whether erythrocytes from some patients were more susceptible to adrenochrome-induced lysis, though results were mixed and not strongly replicated。These effects position adrenochrome as a potential reactant that can damage red blood cells rather than a molecule normally stored or produced inside healthy erythrocytes。

label: Redox Homeostasis
description: The oxidation state of the CxxC motif is a direct readout of cellular redox status: its cysteines switch client proteins between reduced (active) and oxidized (inactive or chaperone-like) states. Over-oxidation of the nucleophilic cysteine disables antioxidant enzymes and contributes to oxidative-stress-linked pathology.
description_zh_TW: CxxC 基序的氧化狀態是細胞氧化還原狀態的直接讀數：其半胱氨酸使客戶蛋白在還原（活化）與氧化（不活化或類伴侶）狀態之間切換。親核半胱氨酸的過度氧化會使抗氧化酵素失能，並促成與氧化壓力相關的病理。

label: Mitochondrial Complex I
description: SIRT3, as a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase, activates mitochondrial Complex I of the electron-transport chain, improving respiratory efficiency. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of Complex I activation. This boosts oxidative phosphorylation and reduces proximal electron leak, and it is a direct mechanism for SIRT3's bioenergetic benefits. By deacetylating Complex I subunits, SIRT3 enhances electron flux and ATP production while limiting superoxide generation. This regulation is central to SIRT3's support of cellular energy metabolism and its protection against oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 作為粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶活化電子傳遞鏈的粒線體 Complex I，改善呼吸效率。在方向性上，SIRT3 位於 Complex I 活化的上游。這增強氧化磷酸化並減少近端電子洩漏，是 SIRT3 生物能益處的直接機制。透過去乙醯化 Complex I 亞基，SIRT3 增強電子通量和 ATP 產生，同時限制超氧陰離子生成。此調控對 SIRT3 支持細胞能量代謝和對抗氧化壓力的保護至關重要。

label: GW5074
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074 is an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor; like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220, it was repurposed as a sirtuin inhibitor after screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 based on the shared adenosine-binding site between sirtuins and kinases. GW5074 shows SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory activity in the low micromolar range. Directionally, its identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, highlighting the need for selectivity optimization in dual kinase/sirtuin inhibitor design.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 是一種最初作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物；與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 類似，它在基於 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享腺嘌呤結合位點的原理篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性後被重新定位為 sirtuin 抑制劑。GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制活性。方向性上其作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了在雙重激酶/sirtuin 抑制劑設計中選擇性優化的必要性。

label: Ro31-8220
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Ro31-8220 is a bisindolylmaleimide compound originally developed as a protein kinase C inhibitor; its adenosine-binding scaffold allowed it to be repurposed as an inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. It belongs to the kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins, sharing this property with the indolinone GW5074. Directionally, Ro31-8220's identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold underlies its cross-reactivity with sirtuins through the shared adenosine-binding site. Because it retains potent kinase activity, cellular effects cannot be attributed solely to sirtuin inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Ro31-8220 是一種最初作為蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑開發的雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺化合物；其腺嘌呤結合骨架使其被重新定位為低微摩爾範圍內的 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 抑制劑。它屬於透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 活性而鑑定的激酶抑制劑骨架，與吲哚啉酮 GW5074 共享此特性。方向性上 Ro31-8220 作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份奠定了其透過共享腺嘌呤結合位點對 sirtuin 的交叉反應性。由於其保留強效激酶活性，細胞效應不能僅歸因於 sirtuin 抑制。

label: SRT1460
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT1460 is a potent, chemically diverse second-generation sirtuin-activating compound reported alongside SRT1720 and SRT2183 as more effective activators than the polyphenolic STACs. Most compounds of this class were also reported to have anticancer activity. A major caveat is that the mechanism of SRT1460 action remains unclear: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and the metabolic effects may reflect indirect actions (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK axis) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 enhances SIRT1 activity in assay systems, but interpretation of in vivo effects requires caution.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種強效的、化學結構多樣的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起被報導為比多酚類 STAC 更有效的活化劑。此類化合物大多據報導具有抗癌活性。主要的注意事項是 SRT1460 的作用機制仍不清楚：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，且代謝效果可能反映間接作用（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 軸線）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 在試驗系統中增強 SIRT1 活性，但對體內效果的詮釋需要謹慎。

label: SRT2183
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT2183 is a potent second-generation sirtuin-activating compound identified with SRT1720 and SRT1460 as chemically diverse, more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation was frequently demonstrable only with fluorescently tagged substrates, and metabolic effects may be indirect (cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 activation. Directionally, SRT2183 stimulates SIRT1 deacetylase activity in biochemical assays. These caveats frame the ongoing debate about the physiological relevance of STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
description_zh_TW: SRT2183 是一種強效的第二代 sirtuin 活化化合物，與 SRT1720 和 SRT1460 一起被鑑定為化學結構多樣、比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能在螢光標記的受質下驗證，且代謝益處可能反映間接作用（cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 活化。方向性上 SRT2183 在生化試驗中刺激 SIRT1 去乙醯酶活性。這些注意事項構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化生理相關性的持續爭論。

label: Atg14L
description: Atg14L promotes the fusion of mature autophagosomes with the lysosome by binding the tethering factor Syntaxin 17, completing autophagic flux. This positions Atg14L not only in initiation but also in the lysosomal degradation step of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Atg14L 透過結合繫鏈因子 Syntaxin 17 促進成熟自噬體與溶酶體的融合，完成自噬流。這使 Atg14L 不僅參與起始，也參與自噬的溶酶體降解步驟。

label: UVRAG
description: Rubicon and UVRAG reciprocally regulate the Vps34 complex: Rubicon restrains Vps34 lipid kinase activity and endosomal maturation, while UVRAG promotes them. They compete within overlapping complexes to modulate autophagy and endocytic trafficking.
description_zh_TW: Rubicon 與 UVRAG 對 Vps34 複合體進行相互調控：Rubicon 抑制 Vps34 脂質激酶活性與內體成熟，UVRAG 則促進之。它們在重疊複合體中競爭以調控自噬與內吞運輸。

label: SMURF2
description: SMURF2, a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase, ubiquitinates SIRT1 and promotes its proteasomal degradation, suppressing proliferation and tumorigenesis in colorectal cancer (Yu et al., Oncogene 2020). Unlike TRIM28/KAP1 — whose SIRT1 degradation is ATM-dependent and DNA-damage-conditioned — SMURF2-mediated SIRT1 turnover was characterized outside DNA damage settings, making it a constitutive metabolic regulator of SIRT1 abundance rather than a DDR-specific one.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 是一種 HECT 結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，會泛素化 SIRT1 並促進其蛋白酶體降解，從而抑制大腸直腸癌的增殖與腫瘤生成（Yu 等人，Oncogene 2020）。有別於 TRIM28/KAP1——其對 SIRT1 的降解依賴 ATM 且限於 DNA 損傷情境——SMURF2 介導的 SIRT1 代謝是在非 DNA 損傷條件下被闡明的，因此它是 SIRT1 豐度的組成性代謝調節者，而非 DDR 專一性的調節者。

label: MPP+
description: Monoamine oxidase B is biochemically converted into MPP+ through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Monoamine oxidase B acts as the substrate and MPP+ as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 MPP+。從機制上講，Monoamine oxidase B 作為底物，MPP+ 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Smoking
description: Adrenochrome formation is promoted by smoking, which increases systemic oxidative stress and catecholamine levels. The resulting shift of more epinephrine toward the adrenochrome pathway elevates aminochrome generation. This links cigarette smoking to oxidative catecholamine metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 的形成會因 smoking 而受到促進，smoking 會增加全身性氧化壓力與兒茶酚胺水平。由此使更多 epinephrine 轉向 adrenochrome 途徑，提高了 aminochrome 的生成。這將吸菸與氧化性兒茶酚胺代謝連結起來。

label: COX-2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: RAGE upregulates COX-2 as part of its NF-kB target gene program upon ligand engagement. This, together with iNOS upregulation, amplifies oxidative stress and catecholamine oxidation. RAGE-mediated COX-2 induction is thus a feed-forward component of glycation- and oxidative-stress-driven inflammation.
description_zh_TW: RAGE 在配體結合時，作為其 NF-kB 標靶基因程序的一部分上調 COX-2。這與 iNOS 上調一起，放大了氧化壓力與兒茶酚胺氧化。因此 RAGE 介導的 COX-2 誘導是糖化與氧化壓力驅動發炎的正向迴圈組成。

label: ERK
description: Bik is degraded by ERK. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. The directionality runs from ERK toward Bik, so ERK is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Bik 被 ERK 降級。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。方向性從 ERK 朝向 Bik，因此 ERK 是主動主體，Bik 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: BET inhibitors
description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CDKN2B
description: CDKN2B encodes p15INK4b, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that blocks CDK4/6 and thereby enforces G1 arrest. As a tumor-suppressor locus often co-regulated with CDKN2A at chromosome 9p21, its product is a core effector of growth inhibition in response to TGFbeta signaling. In senescence, CDKN2B induction is a key event in paracrine and TGFbeta-driven arrest, acting downstream of SMAD3/SMAD4. The encoding relationship is a fundamental gene-to-protein fact with direct relevance to cell-cycle control.
description_zh_TW: CDKN2B 編碼 p15INK4b，一種阻斷 CDK4/6 從而強制 G1 停滯的細胞週期依賴激酶抑制因子。作為常與 CDKN2A 在染色體 9p21 共調節的腫瘤抑制基因座，其產物是對 TGFbeta 訊號生長抑制的核心效應器。在衰老中，CDKN2B 誘發是旁分泌與 TGFbeta 驅動停滯的關鍵事件，作用於 SMAD3/SMAD4 下游。此編碼關係是對細胞週期控制直接相關的基本基因—蛋白事實。

label: Sodium Potassium ATPase
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: The silver ion inhibits Na+,K+-ATPase (sodium-potassium ATPase) activity, disrupting intracellular ion concentrations. Sodium-potassium ATPase maintains the electrochemical gradients essential for nerve conduction, muscle contraction, and nutrient transport, so its inhibition by silver perturbs cellular ion homeostasis and can produce systemic effects. Alongside glutathione peroxidase inhibition, this action is one of the two defined biochemical toxicities of silver ions described in toxicological summaries.
description_zh_TW: 銀離子抑制Na+,K+-ATPase（鈉鉀ATP酶）活性，干擾細胞內離子濃度。鈉鉀ATP酶維持神經傳導、肌肉收縮和營養物質運輸所必需的電化學梯度，因此其被銀抑制會擾亂細胞離子恆穩並可能產生系統效應。除了穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶抑制外，此作用是毒理學摘要中描述的銀離子兩種已定義生化毒性之一。

label: Hemoglobin
description: Hemoglobin, which is abundant in erythrocytes, can catalyze the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome in blood. This is more of a chemical reaction occurring in the presence of oxygen or radicals than active production by red blood cells themselves, and it involves hemoglobin-catalyzed peroxidation/oxidation processes. As a result, adrenochrome can form in blood as a reactant or byproduct, but red blood cells do not actively produce it, since erythrocytes lack the organelles and major oxidative enzymes found in neutrophils or adrenal cells.
description_zh_TW: Hemoglobin在erythrocytes中含量豐富，能在血液中催化epinephrine氧化為adrenochrome。這更像是在氧氣或自由基存在下發生的化學反應，而非red blood cells本身主動生成的產物，且涉及hemoglobin所催化的peroxidation/oxidation過程。因此，adrenochrome可在血液中作為反應物或副產物形成，但red blood cells並不主動生成它，因為erythrocytes缺乏neutrophils或adrenal cells所具有的胞器與主要氧化酶。

label: Prostate Cancer
description: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

label: NLRP3
description: MLKL pore formation at the plasma membrane triggers potassium efflux, which is a canonical activator of the NLRP3 inflammasome — establishing the RIPK3/MLKL/NLRP3 route by which necroptosis feeds pyroptosis. ASC oligomerization is reduced in MLKL-deficient cells, and RIPK3 can activate NLRP3 even without MLKL. This makes lytic necroptotic rupture a upstream driver of inflammatory interleukin maturation rather than a parallel endpoint.
description_zh_TW: MLKL 在細胞膜形成的孔道會引發鉀離子外流——這是 NLRP3 發炎體的典型活化訊號——從而建立 RIPK3/MLKL/NLRP3 路徑，使程序性壞死餵養焦亡。在 MLKL 缺陷細胞中 ASC 聚集減少，而 RIPK3 即使沒有 MLKL 也能活化 NLRP3。這表示裂解性的程序性壞死破裂是發炎性介白素成熟的下游驅動者，而非平行終點。

label: TNF-alpha
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: SIRT1 suppresses TNF-α production/ signaling downstream of NF-κB deacetylation, blunting inflammation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 NF-κB 去乙醯化的下游抑制 TNF-α 的產生/信號傳導，減輕發炎反應。

label: Gut Microbiome
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Obesity-altered gut microbiota produce deoxycholic acid, driving the senescence-SASP-HCC axis in obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. Targeting the gut-liver axis to reduce DCA production may prevent HSC senescence and SASP-driven HCC. The gut microbiome is therefore linked to HCC pathogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 肥胖改變的腸道微生物群產生脫氧膽酸，驅動肥胖相關肝細胞癌中的衰老–SASP–HCC 軸。靶向腸肝軸以減少 DCA 產生，可預防 HSC 衰老與 SASP 驅動的 HCC。因此腸道微生物群與 HCC 的發病機制相關。

label: alpha-Tubulin
description: SIRT1 deacetylates α-tubulin (alongside SIRT2), contributing to cytoskeletal/microtubule regulation and cytoplasmic deacetylase activity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 α-tubulin（與 SIRT2 協同），有助於細胞骨架/微管調控和細胞質去乙醯酶活性。

label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Reducing glucose from 2% to 0.5% in yeast medium extends replicative lifespan by roughly 30%, an effect mediated through elevated NAD+ availability and Sir2 activation. The mechanism hinges on CR lowering the nicotinamide/NAD+ ratio, thereby disinhibiting Sir2 and reinforcing silencing at repetitive rDNA and subtelomeric regions. This intervention is directional: the dietary manipulation is the cause and the lifespan gain the consequence. The finding seeded the broader hypothesis that sirtuin activation underlies longevity benefits of restricted feeding across species.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母培養基中將葡萄糖從 2% 降至 0.5% 可延長複製性壽命約 30%，這種效應是通過升高的 NAD+ 可用性和 Sir2 活化介導的。其機制核心在於 CR 降低菸鹼醯胺/NAD+ 比值，從而解除對 Sir2 的抑制，並加強在重複 rDNA 和亞端粒區域的沉默。這種干預是方向性的：飲食操控是原因，壽命延長是後果。該發現催生了一個更廣泛的假說，即 sirtuin 活化是跨物種限制性餵食帶來壽命益處的基礎。

label: SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio
description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 acetylation ratio is the mechanistic dial that sets the hormetic window for MnSOD-dependent redox tone ('SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window', conf 0.95): locked-off drives cancer/hypertension, locked-on drives cardiomyopathy — restored cycling is protective.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 乙醯化比率是決定 MnSOD 依賴氧化還原張力荷爾蒙窗口的機制旋鈕（「SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio --determines--> Hormetic Window」，conf 0.95）：鎖定關閉驅動癌症／高血壓，鎖定開啟驅動心肌病變——恢復循環則具保護作用。

label: Melanocytes
description: Melanocytes synthesize Eumelanin, the black and brown protective melanin, within melanosomes via the pathway of Melanogenesis. Eumelanin acts as a broad-band radical scavenger and UV absorber. This dark pigment is exported to neighboring keratinocytes for photoprotection.
description_zh_TW: Melanocytes 透過 Melanogenesis 途徑在 melanosomes 內合成 Eumelanin，即黑色和棕色的保護性黑色素。Eumelanin 充當寬頻自由基清除劑和 UV 吸收劑。這種深色色素被輸出到鄰近的 keratinocytes 以提供光保護。

label: Colorectal Cancer
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Ubiquitination-mediated SIRT1 degradation by SMURF2 suppresses colorectal cancer cell proliferation and tumorigenesis. This places SMURF2 on the tumor-suppressive side of the SIRT1-in-cancer debate: since SIRT1 supports survival of transformed epithelial cells, an E3 ligase that lowers SIRT1 abundance acts as a brake on tumor growth. It complements the DNA-damage arm (TRIM28) and the p53-axis arm (MDM2), giving three context-specific E3 ligases that control SIRT1 stability.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 對 SIRT1 的泛素化降解會抑制大腸直腸癌細胞的增殖與腫瘤生成。這使 SMURF2 站在「SIRT1 與癌症」辯論中腫瘤抑制的一方：由於 SIRT1 支持轉化上皮細胞的存活，能降低 SIRT1 豐度的 E3 連接酶便成為腫瘤生長的煞車。它與 DNA 損傷臂（TRIM28）及 p53 軸線臂（MDM2）互補，共同構成三個依情境控制 SIRT1 穩定性的 E3 連接酶。

label: NF-kB signaling
description: SIRT1 suppresses NF-kB (p65) signaling through deacetylation, dampening inflammatory gene expression. This anti-inflammatory action is central to SIRT1's protective role in metabolism, cardiovascular disease, and aging, though it also contributes to its tumor-suppressive arm.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化抑制 NF-kB（p65）信號，抑制發炎基因表達。此抗發炎作用是 SIRT1 在代謝、心血管疾病和衰老中保護作用的核心，同時也構成其腫瘤抑制臂。

label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
description: Alpha-lipoic acid improves endothelial dysfunction, as confirmed in meta-analyses showing improved flow-mediated dilation and markers of oxidative stress in diabetic and metabolic patients. By restoring GSH and reducing NF-kappaB, it ameliorates NO bioavailability. The directionality is antioxidant supplementation to vascular benefit. A caveat is that trial results are heterogeneous and benefits are most consistent in established endothelial dysfunction rather than primary prevention. Lipoic acid also chelates redox-active metals, which may reduce the metal-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals in the vascular wall.
description_zh_TW: 統合分析證實，Alpha-lipoic acid 改善了 endothelial dysfunction，顯示糖尿病和代謝患者中血流介導的擴張和 oxidative stress 標記得到改善。透過恢復 GSH 和減少 NF-κB，它可以改善 NO 的生物利用度。方向性是補充抗氧化劑對血管有益。需要注意的是，試驗結果有差異，在已建立的 endothelial dysfunction 而非一級預防中，效果最一致。硫辛酸也螯合 redox-active metals，這可能會減少血管壁中金屬催化的 hydroxyl radicals 的生成。

label: Quiescence
description: G1 is the principal point of entry into quiescence (G0), a reversible arrest state occupied by differentiated tissues and stem cells. Cells can re-enter G1 from G0 in response to injury or mitogenic stimulation, and G1 length modulates stem cell self-renewal versus differentiation.
description_zh_TW: G1 是進入靜止期（G0）的主要入口點，靜止期是被分化組織和幹細胞佔據的可逆停滯狀態。細胞可因損傷或促有絲分裂刺激而從 G0 重新進入 G1，且 G1 長度調節幹細胞的自我更新與分化之間的平衡。

label: Thioredoxin reductase
description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: Complex I
description: Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) is the first enzyme of the electron transport chain, and its inhibition is a central mechanism of mitochondrial dysfunction. Loss of complex I elevates oxidative stress and depletes ATP, linking it to Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: Complex I（NADH：泛醌氧化還原酶）是電子傳遞鏈的第一個酶，其抑制是粒線體功能障礙的核心機制。Complex I 喪失會升高氧化壓力並耗竭 ATP，與帕金森氏症相連結。

label: IRAK1
description: IRAK1 is a serine/threonine kinase downstream of IL-1R and TLR receptors that propagates MyD88-dependent signaling to NF-kB and MAPKs. Apigenin suppresses the SASP partly by inhibiting IL-1alpha signaling via IRAK1, IRAK4, p38 MAPK, and NF-kB.
description_zh_TW: IRAK1 是 IL-1R 與 TLR 受體下游的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，傳播 MyD88 依賴訊號至 NF-κB 與 MAPK。Apigenin 部分透過經 IRAK1、IRAK4、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB 抑制 IL-1α 訊號來壓制 SASP。

label: Muscle Wasting
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reversed the progressive wasting syndrome in skeletal muscle in mice lacking Nampt while restoring endurance in as little as 1 week of treatment. Decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression were also observed in Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD), a condition histologically and transcriptionally similar to progressive wasting syndrome and characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration. NR was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of DMD and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. These findings support NR as an effective approach to managing muscular dystrophy and degeneration.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）逆轉了缺乏 Nampt 小鼠骨骼肌中的漸進性消耗症候群，同時在僅 1 週的治療內恢復耐力。在 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）中也觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低，此疾病在組織學與轉錄組學上類似於漸進性消耗症候群，並以 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化為特徵。NR 被發現能改善 DMD 的 mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。這些發現支持 NR 作為管理肌肉營養不良與退化的有效方法。

label: ovarian cancer
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: BRCA1/2 defects and homologous-recombination deficiency characterize the high-grade serous subtype of ovarian cancer. BRCA status is used to determine PARP-inhibitor eligibility. BRCA alterations are therefore central to ovarian cancer biology and targeted therapy.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1/2 缺陷與同源重組缺陷是高惡性度漿液性卵巢癌亞型的特徵。BRCA 狀態用於決定 PARP 抑制劑的適用資格。因此 BRCA 改變對卵巢癌生物學與靶向治療至關重要。

label: BH3 mimetics
description: Apoptosis is restored by BH3 mimetics. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward Apoptosis, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 BH3 mimetics 恢復。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從 BH3 mimetics 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Cardiomyocytes
description: SIRT3 strengthens mitochondrial function by deacetylating key metabolic enzymes such as SOD2 and IDH2, optimizing TCA cycle efficiency and preserving cardiomyocyte viability under stress, particularly in hypertensive heart failure models. SIRT3 protects cardiomyocytes by modulating ROS levels, oxidative phosphorylation, and Ku70 expression, and suppresses pathological hypertrophy and apoptotic signaling via mitochondrial quality control through PINK1-mediated autophagic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化關鍵代謝酵素如 SOD2 和 IDH2 增強粒線體功能，優化 TCA 循環效率並在壓力下維護心肌細胞存活率，特別是在高血壓心臟衰竭模型中。SIRT3 透過調節活性氧水平、氧化磷酸化和 Ku70 表現保護心肌細胞，並透過 PINK1 介導的自噬途徑進行粒線體品質控制，抑制病理性肥厚和凋亡訊號。

label: RAS
description: Downstream of MET autophosphorylation, the multi-substrate docking site recruits GRB2/SOS, activating RAS-MAPK signaling. This contributes to proliferation and the invasive growth phenotype of MET-driven cells.
description_zh_TW: 在 MET 自磷酸化的下游，多受質停靠位點招募 GRB2/SOS，活化 RAS-MAPK 訊號。這有助於 MET 驅動細胞的增殖和侵入性生長表型。

label: RB1
description: RB1 decline in senescence derepresses LINE-1 retrotransposition, contributing to retrotransposon activation and the cytosolic cDNA that fuels cGAS-STING and the SASP. Rb normally helps maintain repression of repetitive elements, and its altered state in senescence loosens this control, linking cell-cycle regulatory proteins to transposon control. This connection integrates the cell-cycle machinery with innate immune signaling in the senescence program. It is a newer, moderate-confidence mechanism in the senescence chromatin-immune axis.
description_zh_TW: 衰老中 RB1 下降去抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座，貢獻餵養 cGAS-STING 與 SASP 的胞質 cDNA 與逆轉錄元件活化。Rb 正常協助維持重複元件的抑制，其在衰老中改變的狀態鬆動此控制，將細胞週期調節蛋白連結到轉座子控制。此連結將細胞週期機器整合到衰老程序中的先天免疫訊號。它是衰老染色質—免疫軸中較新、中等信度的機制。

label: PGAM5
description: The mitochondrial phosphatase PGAM5 stabilizes PINK1 on damaged mitochondrial membranes and can attach to LC3, supporting PINK1/Parkin mitophagy. It simultaneously serves the necroptosis machinery by anchoring the necrosome and activating Drp1-driven fission. Which role dominates depends on damage severity: mild stress favors the PGAM5-PINK1 mitophagy arm (cell preservation), while severe RIPK3 activation shifts PGAM5-Drp1 toward necroptotic rupture.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體磷酸酶 PGAM5 會將 PINK1 穩定在受損的粒線體膜上並可結合 LC3，支持 PINK1/Parkin 介導的粒線體自噬。同時它也服務於程序性壞死機器：錨定 necrosome 並活化 Drp1 驅動的分裂。何種角色占上風取決於損傷程度：輕度壓力偏向 PGAM5-PINK1 的粒線體自噬臂（細胞保存），而強烈的 RIPK3 活化則使 PGAM5-Drp1 轉向程序性壞死破裂。

label: Warburg Effect
description: SIRT6 is the clearest anti-Warburg sirtuin: it corepresses HIF-1α and suppresses transcription of glycolytic enzymes (glucose transporters, Hexokinase 2), and its loss permits Warburg-like aerobic glycolysis. Restoration suppresses glycolysis in HCC/glioma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 是最明確的抗 Warburg sirtuin：它協同抑制 HIF-1α 並抑制糖酵解酶（葡萄糖轉運體、Hexokinase 2）的轉錄，其缺失會容許 Warburg 樣的有氧糖酵解。恢復 SIRT6 可抑制 HCC/神經膠質瘤中的糖酵解。

label: Mitochondrial Membrane Potential
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Signals that provide an assessment of mitochondrial health have expanded beyond ROS, calcium, and metabolites to include mitochondrial membrane potential, protease activity, and protein import. For example, FCCP reduces mitochondrial membrane potential as one of the diverse strategies used to invoke mitochondrial stress and ATF4 activation. This broadens the sensing repertoire for mitochondrial dysfunction, indicating that mitohormesis is triggered not by a single signal but by a panel of readouts reflecting organelle integrity, metabolic state, and protein homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 提供粒線體健康評估的訊號已擴展到 ROS、鈣和代謝物之外，包括粒線體膜電位、蛋白酶活性和蛋白質輸入。例如，FCCP 降低粒線體膜電位，作為用於引發粒線體壓力和 ATF4 活化的多樣策略之一。這擴展了粒線體功能障礙的感知範圍，表明粒線體促效應並非由單一訊號觸發，而是由反映胞器完整性、代謝狀態和蛋白質體恆定性的一系列讀數觸發。

label: Survivin
description: In a mouse liver cancer model, increased SIRT6 expression reduces survivin expression by deacetylating H3K9Ac at the survivin promoter, and this induces apoptosis during cancer initiation. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of survivin suppression and prevention of tumor initiation. By silencing survivin, an anti-apoptotic factor, SIRT6 removes a key block to programmed cell death in early tumor cells. This allows damaged or transformed cells to undergo apoptosis rather than expand into tumors. The finding links SIRT6's epigenetic control of a critical survival gene to its tumor-suppressive activity in the liver.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠肝癌模型中，增加的SIRT6表達透過去乙醯化存活素啟動子上的H3K9Ac來減少存活素表達，這在癌症起始期間誘導凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於存活素抑制和腫瘤起始預防的上游。透過沉默存活素（一種抗凋亡因子），SIRT6移除了早期腫瘤細胞中程式性細胞死亡的關鍵阻礙。這使得受損或轉化細胞能夠經歷凋亡而非擴展為腫瘤。此發現將SIRT6對關鍵存活基因的表觀遺傳控制與其在肝臟中的腫瘤抑制活性聯繫起來。

label: Metallic silver
description: Metallic silver is oxidized and may deposit in the tissues, causing argyria, a permanent blue-gray pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Argyria results when large doses of silver are absorbed into the circulatory system and deposited in body tissues; although disfiguring and usually permanent, the condition does not otherwise harm health, and mild forms are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis. The pigmentation reflects reduced elemental silver and silver sulfide granules lodged in the tissues.
description_zh_TW: 金屬銀被氧化並可能沉積在組織中，導致argyria，一種皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的永久性藍灰色色素沉著。當大劑量銀吸收進入循環系統並沉積在體組織中時，會導致argyria；雖然毀容且通常永久，但該病變對健康無其他損害，輕度形式有時被誤認為發紺。色素沉著反映了還原的元素銀和硫化銀顆粒滯留在組織中。

label: Tumor-Suppressor Loss-Induced Senescence
description: Tumor-suppressor loss-induced senescence (TLS) is a cellular senescence program triggered when cells lose function of one or more tumor suppressor genes in the absence of full malignant transformation. The cells withdraw from the cycle into a stable, senescence-associated arrest.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制因子缺失誘導的衰老（TLS）是一種細胞衰老程式，在未發生完全惡性轉化的情況下，細胞失去一個或多個腫瘤抑制基因功能時被觸發。細胞退出細胞週期，進入穩定的衰老相關停滯狀態。

label: Tryptophan
description: Tryptophan (Trp) is the dietary precursor for de novo NAD+ biosynthesis, which proceeds through an eight-step pathway that passes through quinolinic acid before generating NAD+. This de novo route complements the salvage pathways, which recycle nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinic acid (NA), nicotinamide riboside (NR), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) back into NAD+ in two or three steps. Dietary tryptophan, or less than 20 mg of niacin daily, is sufficient to meet baseline NAD+ synthesis requirements, although greater rates of NAD+ synthesis through precursor supplementation are required to achieve therapeutic effects.
description_zh_TW: 色氨酸（Trp）是從頭合成 NAD+ 的飲食前驅物，此途徑經過八個步驟，在生成 NAD+ 之前會通過喹啉酸。這條從頭合成路徑補充了補救途徑，後者將菸鹼醯胺（NAM）、菸鹼酸（NA）、菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）與菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）在兩到三個步驟內回收為 NAD+。飲食中的色氨酸，或每日少於 20 毫克的菸鹼酸，即足以滿足基礎 NAD+ 合成需求，然而要達到治療效果，則需透過前驅物補充來提高 NAD+ 合成速率。

label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell
description: Acute myeloid leukemia arises through the sequential acquisition of mutations in hematopoietic stem cells, the cell of origin where DNMT3A mutations arise and persist as preleukemic clones. This origin in stem cells underlies the clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts. Targeting the mutant clone rather than only the blast population is a key therapeutic rationale.
description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病透過造血幹細胞中突變的依序獲得而發生，造血幹細胞是 DNMT3A 突變產生並以白血病前克隆持續存在的起源細胞。這種起源於幹細胞的性質是不成熟骨髓母細胞克隆擴張的基礎。靶向突變克隆而非僅針對母細胞族群是關鍵的治療依據。

label: Depression
description: Depression has complex neurobiological underpinnings including monoamine dysregulation, inflammation, and oxidative stress. Elevated inflammatory cytokines impair neurotransmitter metabolism, linking neuroinflammation to the pathophysiology of major depressive disorder.
description_zh_TW: 憂鬱症的神經生物學基礎複雜，包括單胺失調、發炎與氧化壓力。升高的發炎細胞激素會損害神經傳導物質代謝，將神經發炎與重度憂鬱症的病理生理相連結。

label: Oxidative Phosphorylation
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) supports oxidative phosphorylation by maintaining the reduced, active state of respiratory chain components and matrix enzymes, supporting complex activity and membrane potential under stress. Its redox defects impair respiration and elevate mitochondrial ROS.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 透過維持呼吸鏈組成與基質酵素的還原且活化狀態來支持氧化磷酸化，在壓力下維持複合物活性與膜電位。其氧化還原缺陷會損害呼吸作用並提高粒線體 ROS。

label: Proteasome
description: DNA damage drives SIRT1 loss post-transcriptionally through the ubiquitin-proteasome system, not autophagy-lysosomes and not mRNA downregulation. Cycloheximide chase showed a shortened SIRT1 half-life under etoposide; qRT-PCR showed unchanged SIRT1 mRNA; and only the proteasome inhibitor MG132 — not bafilomycin A1 or chloroquine — restored SIRT1 levels while its K48-polyubiquitination rose. This establishes UPS-dependent turnover as the mechanism of SIRT1 downregulation in the DDR.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷透過泛素-蛋白酶體系統（而非自噬-溶酶體、也非 mRNA 下調）以轉錄後方式造成 SIRT1 減少。cycloheximide chase 顯示 etoposide 下 SIRT1 半衰期縮短；qRT-PCR 顯示 SIRT1 mRNA 不變；且只有蛋白酶體抑制劑 MG132——而非 bafilomycin A1 或 chloroquine——能恢復 SIRT1 水平，同時其 K48 多泛素化上升。這確立了依賴 UPS 的代謝是 DDR 中 SIRT1 下調的機制。

label: Oculocutaneous Albinism
description: All forms of Oculocutaneous Albinism result from defects in melanosome biogenesis, tyrosinase function, or downstream melanin synthesis enzymes, disrupting Melanogenesis. This leads to variable degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. OCA is a group of autosomal recessive disorders affecting melanin biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: 所有形式的 Oculocutaneous Albinism 都由 melanosome 生物發生、tyrosinase 功能或下游黑色素合成酶的缺陷引起，從而破壞 Melanogenesis。這導致皮膚、頭髮和眼睛不同程度的色素減退。OCA 是一組影響黑色素生物合成的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病。

label: Caspase
description: Caspases are a conserved family of cysteine-aspartate proteases that function as central regulators of apoptosis and inflammation. Initiator caspases sense death signals while executioner caspases dismantle the cell, placing caspases at the heart of the apoptotic program.
description_zh_TW: Caspase 是保守的半胱氨酸-天門冬氨酸蛋白酶家族，是細胞凋亡與發炎的核心調控者。起始型 caspase 感知死亡訊號，執行型 caspase 則分解細胞，使 caspase 位居細胞凋亡程式的核心。

label: Immune System
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: In clinical settings, rapamycin's immunosuppressive mechanisms increase infection risk and impair wound healing, especially in otherwise healthy individuals without clinical manifestations that outweigh the risk of side effects. Some early clinical studies suggest short-term rapamycin or rapalogs may improve aspects of immune function in older adults, but these relied on serologic responses to influenza vaccination, a marker with limited predictive value for broader immunocompetence. Broader measures including T cell repertoire diversity, innate immune activity, and real-world infection resistance remain underexplored.
description_zh_TW: 在臨床環境中，rapamycin的免疫抑製機制增加感染風險並損害傷口癒合，特別是在其他方面健康、沒有臨床表現的個體中，其風險超過副作用的風險。一些早期臨床研究表明，短期rapamycin或rapalogs可能改善老年人免疫功能的某些方面，但這些研究依賴於對流感疫苗接種的血清學反應，這對更廣泛的免疫能力的預測價值有限。更廣泛的措施，包括T細胞庫多樣性、先天免疫活性和現實世界的感染抵抗力，仍然研究不足。

label: AIF
description: AIF is a type of Apoptosis. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The directionality runs from Apoptosis toward AIF, so Apoptosis is the active agent and AIF the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: AIF 是 Apoptosis 的一種。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。方向性從 Apoptosis 向 AIF，因此 Apoptosis 是活性劑，AIF 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: MC1R
description: MC1R regulates the melanogenic pathway by switching Melanocytes from pheomelanin to eumelanin synthesis. Upon binding alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, MC1R signals via Gs to stimulate adenylyl cyclase and cAMP, activating the eumelanogenic program in Melanogenesis. Loss-of-function variants reduce signaling and shift synthesis toward Pheomelanin.
description_zh_TW: MC1R 透過將 Melanocytes 從 pheomelanin 合成切換為 eumelanin 合成來調節黑色素生成途徑。在結合 alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone 後，MC1R 透過 Gs 發出信號以刺激 adenylyl cyclase 和 cAMP，啟動 Melanogenesis 中的 eumelanogenic 程序。功能缺失變異會降低信號傳導並使合成轉向 Pheomelanin。

label: Triapine
description: Triapine (3-AP) is an investigational alpha-N-heterocyclic thiosemicarbazone iron chelator that inhibits ribonucleotide reductase by chelating the iron of the RRM2/RRM2B small subunits. This strips the tyrosyl-radical cofactor, inactivating RNR and collapsing de novo dNTP synthesis.
description_zh_TW: Triapine（3-AP）是研究性的 alpha-N-雜環硫代半卡巴腙鐵螯合劑，透過螯合 RRM2/RRM2B 小次單元的鐵來抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶。這剝離酪胺醯自由基輔因子，使 RNR 失活並使 de novo dNTP 合成崩潰。

label: Acute Kidney Injury
description: SIRT3 is a pivotal coordinator of renal bioenergetics maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis, enhancing antioxidant defenses, and modulating ECM dynamics; its expression is reduced across nephropathies and negatively correlated with histological injury severity. SIRT3 overexpression alleviates AKI and CKD progression in multiple preclinical models, via Nrf2 pathway upregulation, NF-kappaB suppression through IkappaBalpha stabilization, and inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是腎臟生物能學的關鍵協調者，維護粒線體恆定、增強抗氧化防禦並調節 ECM 動態；其表現在腎病變中降低，且與組織學損傷嚴重程度呈負相關。SIRT3 的過量表現在多個臨床前模型中緩解 AKI 和 CKD 進展，透過 Nrf2 途徑上調、NF-kappaB 抑制（經由 IkappaBalpha 穩定化）和 NLRP3 炎症小體活化的抑制。

label: Caspases
description: Multiple caspases redundantly cleave SIRT1 at the C-terminal DEPDVP(704-709) motif under severe DNA damage. Only pan-caspase inhibitors (Q-VD-OPh, Boc-D-FMK, z-VAD) blocked cleavage, while individual knockdown of CASP1-9 failed — the cleavage is distributed across the cascade. The D707A point mutant resists cleavage and the ΔC703 truncation mimics the cleaved fragment. Caspase-mediated SIRT1 cleavage places it in the DDR-cleavage set alongside PARP, DNA-PKcs, and ATM itself — dismantling the repair machinery commits the cell to death.
description_zh_TW: 在嚴重 DNA 損傷下，多種 caspases 會以冗餘方式在 SIRT1 的 C 端 DEPDVP(704-709) 基序進行切割。只有廣效 caspase 抑制劑（Q-VD-OPh、Boc-D-FMK、z-VAD）能阻斷切割，個別沉默 CASP1-9 皆無效——切割分布在整個級聯中。D707A 點突變可抵抗切割，ΔC703 截斷則模擬被切割的片段。caspase 對 SIRT1 的切割使其與 PARP、DNA-PKcs 及 ATM 本身同列於 DDR 切割組——拆解修復機器等同讓細胞走向死亡。

label: Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT1 protects against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury: knockout increases infarct size while overexpression upregulates FoxO1 and MnSOD and downregulates caspase-3 and Bax. Signaling upstream of SIRT1 includes miR-132 inhibition leading to PGC-1alpha/Nrf2, and lncRNA Oip5-as1 acting through the SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1alpha axis. SIRT1 is thus an endogenous cardioprotective factor against reperfusion damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在心肌缺血—再灌流損傷中受保護：基因敲除增加梗塞面積，而過度表現上調 FoxO1 與 MnSOD 並下調 caspase-3 與 Bax。SIRT1 上游的訊號包括 miR-132 抑制導致 PGC-1alpha/Nrf2，以及 lncRNA Oip5-as1 經由 SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1alpha 軸作用。SIRT1 因此是對抗再灌流損傷的內源性心臟保護因子。

label: Wnt
description: β-catenin (Wnt pathway) transcriptionally represses the SIRT2 promoter, and SIRT2 reciprocally deacetylates β-catenin to destabilize it, so Wnt signaling opposes SIRT2 pathway activity and vice versa in intestinal and cancer cell contexts (BBA Mol Cell Res 2021).
description_zh_TW: β-catenin（Wnt 通路）轉錄抑制 SIRT2 啟動子，而 SIRT2 相互去乙醯化 β-catenin 以不穩定化它，因此 Wnt 信號在腸道和癌細胞環境中拮抗 SIRT2 通路活性，反之亦然（BBA Mol Cell Res 2021）。

label: Sympathetic nerve endings
description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

label: KDM4
description: H3K36me3 is a gene-body trimethyl mark deposited co-transcriptionally by SETD2 and removed by KDM4 (JMJD2) JmjC demethylases. Its dynamics regulate transcribed gene bodies including SASP loci.
description_zh_TW: H3K36me3 是由 SETD2 共轉錄沉積、由 KDM4（JMJD2）JmjC 去甲基酶移除的基因體三甲基標記。其動態調控包括 SASP 基因座在內的轉錄基因體。

label: Tyrosinase
description: TRP-2/DCT is a type I membrane glycoprotein of the melanosome, closely related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1. It requires copper at its active site and is regulated transcriptionally by MITF and post-translationally within melanosomes. The enzyme is part of the shared tyrosinase-family melanogenic toolkit.
description_zh_TW: TRP-2/DCT 是 melanosome 的 I 型膜醣蛋白，與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 密切相關。它的活性位點需要 copper，並在轉錄上受 MITF 調控，且在 melanosomes 內受到轉譯後調控。該酶是共享的 tyrosinase 家族黑色素生成工具包的一部分。

label: APE1
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) reduces the redox-sensitive protein APE1/Ref-1, maintaining its critical cysteine residues in the reduced state. Reduced Ref-1 in turn activates redox-sensitive transcription factors such as AP-1 and NF-kappaB, coupling the thioredoxin system to transcriptional decisions.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 會還原氧化還原敏感的蛋白質 APE1/Ref-1，使其關鍵的半胱氨酸殘基維持在還原態。被還原的 Ref-1 進而活化 AP-1 和 NF-kappaB 等氧化還原敏感的轉錄因子，將硫氧還蛋白系統與轉錄決策連結起來。

label: Horvath Clock
description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Cortisol
description: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) released from the anterior pituitary under hypothalamic CRH stimulation binds the adrenal cortex to drive cortisol synthesis and release, forming the effector arm of the HPA-axis stress response. Chronic ACTH–cortisol activation suppresses heart-rate variability and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 促腎上腺皮質激素（ACTH）在下視丘 CRH 刺激下由腦下垂體前葉釋放，作用於腎上腺皮質以驅動 cortisol 的合成與釋放，構成 HPA 軸壓力反應的效應臂。慢性的 ACTH–cortisol 活化會抑制心率變異度並損害粒線體生合成。

label: SOD1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: Tofersen (Qalsody) is an intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide against SOD1 mRNA, approved April 2023 on biomarker grounds (plasma NfL −55%) for SOD1-ALS and now tested presymptomatically in the ATLAS trial — the first precision neurodegenerative therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tofersen（Qalsody）是針對 SOD1 mRNA 的鞘內反義寡核苷酸，2023 年 4 月依生物標記（血漿 NfL −55%）獲准用於 SOD1-ALS，現於 ATLAS 試驗中做症狀前測試——是第一個精準神經退化療法。

label: Kynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: NF675
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。

label: H3K4me3
description: H3K4me3 and the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence, co-localizing in 'mesas' while H3K27me3 is depleted from 'canyons'. These bivalent states define transcriptional poise.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me3 與抑制性 H3K27me3 在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀，在「mesas」中共定位，而 H3K27me3 在「canyons」中被耗竭。這些雙價狀態定義轉錄準備狀態。

label: Phagophore Assembly Site
description: The phagophore assembly site is the platform on which the phagophore is nucleated, elongated, and ultimately sealed into the mature autophagosome. The crescent-shaped isolation membrane formed at the PAS becomes the double-membraned autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點是吞噬泡形成、延伸並最終封閉為成熟自噬體的平台。在 PAS 形成的月牙形隔離膜成為雙膜自噬體。

label: ETS transcription factor
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: GLO2
description: GLO2 (glyoxalase II) is the second enzyme of the glyoxalase system. It converts S-D-lactoylglutathione into D-lactate, regenerating glutathione in the process. Because glutathione is both the cofactor for GLO1 and a major cellular antioxidant, GLO2 activity sustains the capacity of the glyoxalase system to detoxify methylglyoxal and other dicarbonyls. The conversion of reactive dicarbonyl intermediates into lactate thereby prevents them from forming irreversible AGE crosslinks on proteins, making GLO2 an integral component of the body's defense against glycation stress.
description_zh_TW: GLO2（glyoxalase II）是乙二醛酶系統的第二個酵素。它將 S-D-lactoylglutathione 轉化為 D-乳酸（D-lactate），過程中再生麩胱甘肽。由於麩胱甘肽既是 GLO1 的輔酶也是主要的細胞抗氧化劑，GLO2 活性維持了乙二醛酶系統解毒甲基乙二醛與其他二羰基物的能力。將反應性二羰基中間產物轉化為乳酸，從而防止它們在蛋白質上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯，使 GLO2 成為身體對抗糖化壓力防禦中不可或缺的組成部分。

label: DNA Ligase IV
description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

label: LIR Motif
description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

label: GSK3β
description: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
description_zh_TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

label: TGF-beta1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: TGF-β1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, ACTA2, and TIMP1, driving collagen deposition and tissue scarring in multiple organs. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of fibrogenesis. This makes TGF-β1 a central target in fibrosis therapeutics, and sirtuins that inhibit SMAD3 signaling, such as SIRT6 and SIRT7, are antifibrotic. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic organ injury, understanding the TGF-β1/SMAD3 axis is central to developing treatments for heart, lung, kidney, and liver fibrosis. Sirtuin activation is emerging as one such strategy.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 活化 SMAD3 依賴性的促纖維化基因轉錄，包括 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 和 TIMP1，驅動多個器官的膠原沉積和組織疤痕形成。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於纖維化生成的上游。這使 TGF-β1 成為纖維化治療的核心靶標，而抑制 SMAD3 訊號的 sirtuin（如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7）具有抗纖維化作用。由於纖維化是慢性器官損傷的共同最終通路，理解 TGF-β1/SMAD3 軸線對開發心臟、肺、腎臟和肝臟纖維化的治療至關重要。Sirtuin 活化正成為此類策略之一。

label: Persulfates
description: Ammonium persulfate is one of the suitable persulfate oxidizing agents for converting adrenaline into adrenochrome, together with potassium persulfate and sodium persulfate. Sodium and ammonium persulfates are preferred over potassium persulfate for their good solubility in water. In the examples, ammonium persulfate (about 0.42 mole) is used with a sodium hydrogencarbonate buffer and a bismuth salt catalyst at 0 to 5 degrees C to produce adrenochrome in maximum yield within about 30 to 45 minutes.
