By blocking NOS, aminoguanidine can reduce nitric oxide production, which together with its pro-oxidant activities prevented its clinical use. This NOS inhibition is one of the adverse effects that emerged during evaluation of aminoguanidine as a therapeutic agent. Despite these limitations, aminoguanidine remains a key research compound that established the concept of AGE inhibition for preventing diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 作為首個 AGE inhibitor，其 safety concern 與抑制 nitric oxide synthase（NOS）有關。透過 blocking NOS，aminoguanidine 可減少 nitric oxide production，這與其 pro-oxidant activities 一起阻止了其 clinical use。此 NOS inhibition 是在評估 aminoguanidine 作為 therapeutic agent 期間出現的 adverse effects 之一。儘管有這些 limitations，aminoguanidine 仍是確立 AGE inhibition 以預防 diabetic complications 概念的關鍵 research compound。

label: Neurodegeneration
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Aging of the nervous system combined with decreased mitophagy is a hallmark of neurodegeneration, and mitophagy dysregulation is a predominant factor contributing to various neurodegenerative disorders including Alzheimer's disease, Huntington's disease, ALS and mixed dementia. The mitophagy pathway is affected at multiple stages, from cargo recognition to lysosomal fusion. Inducing mitophagy can produce pathological and cognitive outcomes in AD, yet suppressing mitophagy restored mitochondrial density in synapses in some models; in ALS, mitophagy may be neuroprotective initially but prolonged elevation can aggravate neuronal damage, illustrating its context-dependent role.
description_zh_TW: 神經系統老化加上線粒體自噬減少是神經退化的標誌，而線粒體自噬失調是導致多種神經退化性疾病的主要因素，包括阿茲海默症、亨廷頓症、肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症（ALS）和混合型失智症。線粒體自噬通路從貨物識別到溶酶體融合的多個階段均受影響。誘發線粒體自噬可在阿茲海默症中產生病理和認知結果，但在某些模型中抑制線粒體自噬可恢復突觸中的線粒體密度；在ALS中，線粒體自噬最初可能具有神經保護作用，但持續升高可能加重神經元損傷，說明其作用具有情境依賴性。

label: Mesenchymal-to-Epithelial Transition
description: Reprogramming proceeds through defined phases, including a mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET) in which somatic fibroblasts adopt an epithelial morphology early in the process. The MET is driven by factors such as Oct4 and Klf4, which suppress mesenchymal genes and reinforce epithelial ones, and it is required because fibroblasts are mesenchymal while iPSCs are epithelial. This transition is a necessary early event that reorganizes cell adhesion and signaling before the full pluripotency program is established.
description_zh_TW: 重編程透過確定的階段進行，包括間質到上皮的轉變（MET），其中體細胞成纖維細胞在此過程的早期採用上皮形態。 MET 是由 Oct4 和 Klf4 等因子驅動的，這些因子抑制間質基因並增強上皮基因，這是必需的，因為成纖維細胞是間質的，而 iPSC 是上皮細胞。這種轉變是一個必要的早期事件，在建立完整的多能性程序之前重組細胞黏附和信號傳導。

label: Dendritic cells
description: Low-dose mTORC1 inhibition by rapamycin improves immune responses by increasing dendritic cell activity and CD8+ memory T-cell counts. This potentiation is dose-dependent and immunostimulatory at low dose while immunosuppressive at high dose.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 可透過增加樹突細胞活性與 CD8+ 記憶 T 細胞數量來改善免疫反應。此增強作用具劑量依賴性，低劑量免疫刺激、高劑量免疫抑制。

label: Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Food is an important source of exogenous advanced glycation end products, since significant AGE generation occurs when sugars are cooked with proteins via the Maillard reaction. In a mouse model, feeding an AGE-rich diet for 16 weeks promoted a 53% increase in serum AGE levels. In renal failure patients, an AGE-rich diet produced a 29% increase in blood CML, while a low-AGE diet produced a 34% reduction. These findings suggest that a diet restricting AGEs is an effective way to reduce the AGE burden in the human body.
description_zh_TW: Food 是 exogenous advanced glycation end products 的重要來源，因為當 sugars 與 proteins 經由 Maillard reaction 一起 cooked 時，會產生顯著的 AGE。在 mouse model 中，餵食 AGE-rich diet 16 週使血清 AGE levels 增加 53%。在 renal failure patients 中，AGE-rich diet 使血液 CML 增加 29%，而 low-AGE diet 則使其降低 34%。這些 findings 顯示，限制 AGEs 的 diet 是降低人體 AGE burden 的有效方法。

label: Silver nanoparticles
description: Silver nanoparticles are believed to cause DNA damage in addition to disrupting mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis. The oxidative stress generated by silver ions can oxidize DNA bases and produce strand breaks, while direct interactions between silver and nucleic acids add to the genotoxic burden. DNA damage is therefore a key toxicological endpoint for silver nanoparticle exposure, informing both regulatory safety assessment of nanoparticle-containing products and the design of antimicrobial nanomaterials that maximize efficacy against pathogens while minimizing harm to host tissues.
description_zh_TW: 相信銀奈米粒子除了干擾粒線體呼吸和ATP合成外，還會導致DNA損傷。銀離子產生的氧化應激可氧化DNA鹼基並產生鏈斷裂，而銀與核酸的直接相互作用增加了基因毒性負擔。因此，DNA損傷是銀奈米粒子暴露的關鍵毒理學終點，為含奈米粒子產品的監管安全評估和設計最大化對病原體功效同時最小化對宿主組織危害的抗菌奈米材料提供信息。

label: Tumor suppressor
description: ATM functions as a tumor suppressor; its loss drives genomic instability and predisposes to lymphoid malignancies and solid tumors. Loss-of-function mutations cause ataxia-telangiectasia, a syndrome of neurodegeneration, immunodeficiency, and cancer predisposition. ATM inhibitors are explored clinically as radiosensitizers and via synthetic lethality.
description_zh_TW: ATM 具有腫瘤抑制功能；其缺失會驅動基因體不穩定，並易導致淋巴惡性腫瘤與實體腫瘤。功能缺失突變會造成毛細血管擴張性運動失調症，這是一種以神經退化、免疫缺陷與癌症易感性為特徵的症候群。ATM 抑制劑在臨床上被探索作為放射增敏劑並利用合成致死機制。

label: Cytoplasmic Chromatin Fragments
description: DNA-SCARS may serve as precursors to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCF) that trigger inflammation via cGAS-STING. CCF derived from DNA-SCARS are enriched in heterochromatin marks and activate the cGAS-STING-NF-kB axis.
description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 可能作為細胞質染色質片段（CCF）的前驅物，經由 cGAS-STING 觸發發炎。源自 DNA-SCARS 的 CCF 富含異染色質標記，並活化 cGAS-STING-NF-κB 軸。

label: SLC25A1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
description_zh_TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

label: Ionizing Radiation
description: Ionizing radiation causes DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM at the site of damage, converting it to an active monomer. This makes ionizing radiation a primary exogenous trigger for ATM activation. Activated ATM then coordinates cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 游離輻射會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，在損傷處招募並使 ATM 自體磷酸化，將其轉化為活化的單體。這使游離輻射成為 ATM 激活的主要外源性觸發因子。激活的 ATM 隨後協調細胞週期停滯、修復與細胞凋亡。

label: HDAC4
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: HDAC4 possesses SUMO E3 ligase activity and sumoylates MEF2D at Lys424, locking it into an inactive, transcription-repressing state. Directionally, HDAC4 sits upstream of MEF2D inactivation. This regulates muscle-gene expression independently of sirtuins, and it is included as a parallel chromatin regulatory mechanism contextualizing SIRT1's muscle actions. By sumoylating MEF2D, HDAC4 represses its transcriptional activity and the muscle genes it controls. This regulation is distinct from the acetylation-deacetylation balance that sirtuins influence, illustrating the diversity of muscle-gene control.
description_zh_TW: HDAC4 具有 SUMO E3 連接酶活性，在 Lys424 位點 SUMO 化 MEF2D，將其鎖定在不活化的轉錄抑制狀態。在方向性上，HDAC4 位於 MEF2D 失活的上游。這獨立於 sirtuin 調控肌肉基因表達，被納入作為將 SIRT1 肌肉作用置於背景中的平行染色質調控機制。透過 SUMO 化 MEF2D，HDAC4 抑制其轉錄活性和它所控制的肌肉基因。此調控不同於 sirtuin 影響的乙醯化-去乙醯化平衡，說明了肌肉基因控制的多樣性。

label: IKKepsilon
description: IKKepsilon is closely related to TBK1, its closest paralog, with which it shares overlapping substrates in the type I interferon response including IRF3 and IRF7. Both kinases contribute to innate antiviral immunity and oncogenic signaling. Their overlapping functions make them jointly attractive therapeutic targets.
description_zh_TW: IKKepsilon 與其最接近的旁系同源基因 TBK1 密切相關，兩者在第一型干擾素反應中共享重疊的受質，包括 IRF3 和 IRF7。兩種激酶都參與先天抗病毒免疫與致癌性訊號傳導。其重疊功能使它們共同成為具吸引力的治療靶點。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products formation
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: Norepinephrine
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) clears approximately 80-90 percent of released norepinephrine by high-affinity reuptake into the presynaptic varicosity at sympathetic nerve endings. The recaptured norepinephrine is either repackaged into vesicles or metabolized. NET-mediated reuptake is the dominant mechanism for terminating sympathetic neurotransmission.
description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter（NET）透過高親和力再攝取，清除交感神經末梢突觸前膨體中約 80-90% 已釋放的 norepinephrine。被再攝取的 norepinephrine 會被重新包裝入囊泡或被代謝。NET 介導的再攝取是終止交感神經傳遞的主要機制。

label: PKC
description: PKC is a family of serine/threonine kinases that regulates autophagy, cell survival, differentiation, and immune responses. Through its control of survival pathways and Bcl-2-family regulation, PKC signaling modulates cell fate decisions relevant to apoptosis and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: PKC 是調控自噬、細胞存活、分化與免疫反應的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶家族。透過對存活途徑與 Bcl-2 家族調控的控制，PKC 訊號調節與細胞凋亡及自噬相關的細胞命運決定。

label: DNA Methyltransferase
description: Decitabine is a nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA methyltransferases and is used as an epigenetic therapy in hematologic malignancies. After incorporation into DNA during replication, decitabine covalently traps DNMT enzymes, depleting them and causing passive loss of DNA methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates genes silenced by promoter hypermethylation, such as tumor suppressors, which underlies its clinical efficacy in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是一種核苷類似物，可抑制 DNA 甲基轉移酶，用作血液惡性腫瘤的表觀遺傳療法。在複製過程中摻入 DNA 後，地西他濱共價捕獲 DNMT 酶，耗盡它們並導致新合成鏈上 DNA 甲基化的被動喪失。這種去甲基化重新激活了因啟動子高甲基化而沉默的基因，例如腫瘤抑制基因，這是其在骨髓增生異常綜合徵和急性髓系白血病中的臨床功效的基礎。

label: Genomic Instability
description: SIRT1 works as an anti-apoptotic, genome-protecting protein in the DNA damage response: it is recruited to break sites by ATM, deacetylates ATM itself (stimulating autophosphorylation and stabilization), and deacetylates DDR factors such as TIP60, NBS1, XPA, and XPC. The 2022 stability study shows that TRIM28-mediated degradation plus caspase cleavage of SIRT1 enhance DNA-damage-induced cell death while helping maintain genome stability — i.e., removing SIRT1 is part of the cell-fate decision between repair and death.
description_zh_TW: 在 DNA 損傷反應中，SIRT1 是抗凋亡且保護基因體的蛋白：它會被 ATM 召募到斷裂位置、去乙醯化 ATM 本身（促進其自體磷酸化與穩定），並去乙醯化 TIP60、NBS1、XPA、XPC 等 DDR 因子。2022 年的穩定性研究顯示，TRIM28 介導的降解加上 caspase 對 SIRT1 的切割會加劇 DNA 損傷誘導的細胞死亡，同時有助於維持基因體穩定——也就是說，移除 SIRT1 本身就是修復與死亡之間細胞命運決策的一部分。

label: HMGB2
description: When chromatin-bound, HMGB2 actively shields SASP gene loci from the spread of repressive heterochromatin. Its depletion in senescence coincides with elevated expression of SASP genes in replicative senescence.
description_zh_TW: 當結合於染色質時，HMGB2 主動保護 SASP 基因座免受抑制性異染色質擴散。它在衰老中的耗竭與複製性衰老中 SASP 基因表現升高同時發生。

label: BRCA1
description: ATM phosphorylates BRCA1 to coordinate DNA repair and maintain genome integrity after double-strand breaks. This connects ATM activation to homologous-recombination repair. BRCA1 is thus a downstream ATM substrate in the damage-response network.
description_zh_TW: ATM 磷酸化 BRCA1，以在雙股斷裂後協調 DNA 修復並維持基因體完整性。這將 ATM 激活與同源重組修復連結起來。因此 BRCA1 是損傷反應網路中 ATM 的下游受質。

label: NAD+ Salvage Pathway
description: NAD+ is efficiently regenerated through the salvage pathway, which recycles nicotinamide produced as a byproduct of sirtuin reactions and other NAD+-consuming enzymes. The pathway converts nicotinamide back to NMN via NAMPT and then to NAD+ via NMN adenylyltransferases (NMNATs). Directionally, the salvage pathway sits upstream of the NAD+ pool that sirtuins depend on as obligate co-substrate. Because recycling is far more economical than de novo synthesis, the salvage pathway is the dominant route of NAD+ maintenance in most tissues. This is why NAMPT and the salvage pathway are central to strategies that restore NAD+ and re-engage sirtuin activity during aging.
description_zh_TW: NAD+透過補救合成途徑高效再生，該途徑回收作為sirtuin反應和其他NAD+消耗酶副產品產生的菸鹼醯胺。此途徑透過NAMPT將菸鹼醯胺轉回NMN，再透過NMN腺苷醯轉移酶（NMNAT）轉化為NAD+。方向上，補救合成途徑位於sirtuin所依賴的NAD+池的上游。由於回收遠比從頭合成經濟，補救合成途徑是大多數組織中NAD+維持的主要途徑。這就是為什麼NAMPT和補救合成途徑成為恢復老化過程中NAD+並重新啟動sirtuin活性策略的核心。

label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease is characterized by persistent airway inflammation and poorly reversible airflow limitation driven by neutrophilic and macrophage inflammation. Oxidant-antioxidant imbalance in the lungs fuels this chronic inflammatory state. The directionality is inflammatory airway disease to oxidative burden. A caveat is that COPD heterogeneity means not all patients show the same oxidant signature, and smoking-independent forms exist. This inflammation is sustained by an oxidant-antioxidant imbalance that inactivates antiproteases and perpetuates tissue destruction.
description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease 的特徵是持續的 airway inflammation 和由中性粒細胞和巨噬細胞發炎驅動的可逆性差的氣流受限。肺部的氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡加劇了這種慢性發炎狀態。方向性是發炎性氣道疾病對氧化負擔的影響。需要注意的是，COPD 異質性意味著並非所有患者都表現出相同的氧化劑特徵，並且存在 smoking 獨立形式。這種發炎是由氧化劑-抗氧化劑失衡所維持的，這種失衡會使抗蛋白酶失去活性並使組織破壞永久化。

label: Mebendazole
description: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) = 0.421 — shared Tubulin, Microtubule, Benzimidazole, Glycolysis, Apoptosis — marking the benzimidazoles as a bonded twin-pair whose mechanism claims should be presumed portable until dissociated; Ivermectin is mechanistically distinct (Jaccard 0.178, shared sets mostly indications).
description_zh_TW: Jaccard(Fenbendazole, Mebendazole) ＝ 0.421——共享 Tubulin、Microtubule、Benzimidazole、Glycolysis、Apoptosis——把苯並咪唑類標記為鍵合雙胞胎對，機制主張應推定可互通直到被區分；Ivermectin 機制上截然不同（Jaccard 0.178，共享集合多為適應症）。

label: Energy Expenditure
description: Protein restriction increases energy expenditure, in part through FGF21-mediated mechanisms. FGF21 promotes energy expenditure through UCP1-dependent thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, with PR stimulating WAT beiging via FGF21 action in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and PR similarly increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue via an FGF21-dependent mechanism. The increased energy expenditure drives increased food intake with PR by shifting brain signaling toward protein appetite. These effects occur despite, and in part explain, the paradox that PR improves metabolic health while increasing food intake, and they are most pronounced in males but also present in females and effective even when initiated late in life.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制增加能量消耗，部分透過FGF21介導的機制。FGF21透過UCP1依賴的白色脂肪組織產熱米色化促進能量消耗，PR透過交感神經訊號在腦中透過FGF21作用刺激WAT米色化，PR同樣透過FGF21依賴的機制增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。增加的能量消耗透過將腦訊號轉向蛋白質食慾來驅動PR期間的食物攝入增加。這些效應發生在儘管PR改善代謝健康同時增加食物攝入的悖論中，並部分解釋了這一悖論，它們在雄性中最明顯，但在雌性中也存在，即使在生命晚期開始也有效。

label: Dihydromyricetin
description: DHM activates AMPK, which synergistically raises NAD+ via NAMPT upregulation and thereby further potentiates SIRT3 activity. Directionally, DHM activates AMPK, which increases NAD+ to boost SIRT3. This dual SIRT3/AMPK engagement amplifies mitochondrial and metabolic defenses, protecting the liver and other tissues from metabolic and oxidative injury. It mirrors the indirect resveratrol cascade, suggesting convergent circuitry among polyphenols, and it illustrates how natural compounds often activate multiple, reinforcing pathways rather than a single target—an important consideration for interpreting their biological effects.
description_zh_TW: DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 協同性地通過 NAMPT 上調提高 NAD+，進而進一步增強 SIRT3 活性。在方向性上，DHM 活化 AMPK，AMPK 增加 NAD+ 以提升 SIRT3。這種 SIRT3/AMPK 的雙重參與放大粒線體和代謝防禦，保護肝臟和其他組織免受代謝和氧化損傷。它反映了白藜蘆醇的間接級聯反應，提示多酚之間的趨同電路，並說明天然化合物通常活化多個強化的通路而非單一靶點——這是解釋其生物學效應時的重要考量。

label: Telomere
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at telomeric regions in response to DNA damage and stabilizes the WRN helicase at telomeres, tightening telomere structure and preventing dysfunction during replication. Directionally, SIRT6 maintains telomere integrity. Loss of SIRT6 causes H3K9 hyperacetylation and chromatin relaxation at telomeres, tying it to genomic stability in ageing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在 DNA 損傷反應中去乙醯化端粒區域的 H3K9，並在端粒處穩定 WRN 解旋酶，緊密化端粒結構並防止複製過程中的功能障礙。方向性上 SIRT6 維護端粒完整性。SIRT6 的缺失導致端粒處 H3K9 超乙醯化和染色質鬆弛，將其與老化的基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: CML
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: CML (N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine) has been reported as one of the most abundant advanced glycation end products in vivo and was one of the first AGEs to be characterized in foods, particularly milk and milk products. Because of its abundance and relative ease of measurement, CML is chosen in most studies as a marker of AGEs in both foods and in vivo. It is a glycoxidation product of lysine residues and accumulates in long-lived proteins. CML is the basis of a food database of approximately 500 items and is widely used as a biomarker linking dietary and circulating AGE burden to health outcomes.
description_zh_TW: CML（N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine）被報導為體內最豐富的晚期糖化終產物之一，也是最早在食物中（特別是牛奶與乳製品）被表徵的 AGE 之一。由於其豐富性與相對容易測量，CML 在大多數研究中被選作食物與體內 AGE 的標記。它是賴氨酸殘基的糖氧化產物，並堆積於長壽命蛋白中。CML 是約 500 項食品資料庫的基礎，並被廣泛用作連結飲食與循環 AGE 負擔和健康結果的生物標記。

label: PARP1
description: SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylates PARP1 at Lys521 in response to oxidative stress (Mao 2011 PMID 21680843), increasing PARP1 activity and facilitating DNA repair via both non-homologous end joining and homologous recombination. This expands SIRT6's enzymatic repertoire beyond deacetylation and connects it to base-excision repair and DNA-damage signaling. It also links SIRT6 to NAD+ consumption, since activated PARP1 is a major NAD+ consumer that competes with sirtuins for the co-substrate.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6在氧化壓力下在Lys521位點單-ADP-核糖基化PARP1（Mao 2011 PMID 21680843），增加PARP1活性並透過非同源末端連接和同源重組促進DNA修復。這擴展了SIRT6超越去乙醯化的酵素功能譜，並將其與鹼基切除修復和DNA損傷訊號聯繫起來。它也將SIRT6與NAD+消耗聯繫起來，因為活化的PARP1是主要的NAD+消耗者，與sirtuin競爭共同底物。

label: VEGF
description: VEGF drives Angiogenesis. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with VEGF acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 驅動 Angiogenesis。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，VEGF 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Peroxiredoxin
description: Cytosolic thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) donates electrons to regenerate oxidized peroxiredoxins (Prx1/2 and the family generally) after they reduce hydrogen peroxide, sustaining cytosolic peroxide clearance. Trx1 is itself recycled by thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD1) using NADPH. This is the cytosolic mirror of the mitochondrial Trx2/Prx3 arm and involves the same peroxiredoxin family that consumes SOD-generated H2O2, tying Trx1 into the SOD-peroxide-thioredoxin relay in the cytoplasm.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質 thioredoxin-1（Trx1）捐贈電子以再生氧化態的 peroxiredoxins（一般指 Prx1/2 及該家族），使它們在還原過氧化氫後恢復活性，從而維持細胞質的過氧化物清除。Trx1 本身再由 thioredoxin reductase（TXNRD1）以 NADPH 回收。這是粒線體 Trx2/Prx3 分支的細胞質鏡像，涉及同一消耗 SOD 所產生 H2O2 的 peroxiredoxin 家族，因此將 Trx1 納入細胞質中的 SOD-過氧化物-thioredoxin 接力。

label: HSPA8
description: TXNDC5 is an ER-localized thioredoxin-family chaperone that synergizes with HSPA8 (HSC70) to exacerbate the inflammatory phenotype of synovial fibroblasts via NF-kB signaling. Because HSPA8 is the bridge node apigenin disrupts, TXNDC5-HSPA8 cooperativity is relevant to SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: TXNDC5 是 ER 定位的硫氧還蛋白家族伴護蛋白，與 HSPA8（HSC70）協同，經由 NF-κB 訊號加劇滑膜纖維母細胞的發炎表現型。由於 HSPA8 是 apigenin 破壞的橋接節點，TXNDC5-HSPA8 協同與 SASP 壓制相關。

label: Insulin Secretion
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT1 supports glucose-stimulated insulin secretion by transcriptionally repressing UCP2 in pancreatic beta-cells, preserving mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis; beta-cell SIRT1 overexpression enhances, while SIRT1 loss impairs, the insulin response, linking SIRT1 to beta-cell function and diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過轉錄抑制胰腺 β 細胞中的 UCP2 來支持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌，維持粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成；β 細胞 SIRT1 過表達可增強胰島素反應，而 SIRT1 缺失則損害胰島素反應，將 SIRT1 與 β 細胞功能和糖尿病聯繫起來。

label: Renal Cell Carcinoma
description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common malignant kidney tumor, usually clear-cell subtype.
description_zh_TW: 腎細胞癌 (RCC) 是最常見的惡性腎臟腫瘤，通常為透明細胞亞型。

label: DNA Replication Stress
description: dNTP depletion leads to replication fork stalling and collapse, activating ATR/ATM checkpoints and triggering DNA replication stress, senescence, or apoptosis. This dNTP-catastrophe axis is how agents such as hydroxyurea impose cell-cycle arrest.
description_zh_TW: dNTP 耗竭會導致複製叉停滯與崩潰，活化 ATR/ATM 檢查點並觸發 DNA 複製壓力、衰老或細胞凋亡。此 dNTP 災難軸正是 Hydroxyurea 等藥物造成細胞週期停滯的機制。

label: Enzalutamide
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: BRCA
description: BRCA1/2 defects and homologous-recombination deficiency characterize the high-grade serous subtype of ovarian cancer. BRCA status is used to determine PARP-inhibitor eligibility. BRCA alterations are therefore central to ovarian cancer biology and targeted therapy.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1/2 缺陷與同源重組缺陷是高惡性度漿液性卵巢癌亞型的特徵。BRCA 狀態用於決定 PARP 抑制劑的適用資格。因此 BRCA 改變對卵巢癌生物學與靶向治療至關重要。

label: Lewy Bodies
description: Alpha-synuclein is a major protein component that accumulates and aggregates within Lewy bodies, the pathological hallmark inclusions of Parkinson's disease. Its aggregation is central to the selective vulnerability of dopaminergic neurons.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 是累積並聚集於路易小體（Lewy bodies）內的主要蛋白質成分，路易小體是帕金森氏症的病理標誌包涵體。其聚集是多巴胺神經元選擇性脆弱性的核心。

label: Caspase-1
description: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin inflammasomes recruit pro-Caspase-1 via ASC for proximity-induced dimerization and activation — the scaffolded platform that determines pyroptotic versus inflammatory outcomes; Caspase-1 then cleaves pro-IL-1beta and IL-18 to their active cytokines.
description_zh_TW: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin 發炎體經 ASC 招募 pro-Caspase-1，進行鄰近誘導二聚化與活化——這是決定細胞焦亡或發炎結果的平台支架；Caspase-1 隨後把 pro-IL-1beta 與 IL-18 切割成熟為活性細胞激素。

label: COVID-19
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Serum SIRT3 levels are associated with clinical outcome and prognosis in COVID-19, being markedly lower in severe patients. This positions serum SIRT3 as a potential prognostic biomarker that reflects mitochondrial health and antioxidant reserve during systemic viral inflammation, analogous to its diagnostic value in lung cancer.
description_zh_TW: 血清 SIRT3 水平與 COVID-19 的臨床結果和預後相關，在重症患者中明顯較低。這將血清 SIRT3 定位為潛在預後生物標記，反映全身性病毒性發炎期間的粒線體健康與抗氧化儲備，類似其在肺癌中的診斷價值。

label: Hyperglycemia
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 is also consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, where its deficiency correlates with insulin resistance, and in skeletal muscle its deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: 慢性高血糖抑制海馬體中的 SIRT3 表現，透過粒線體 Ca2+ 超載和神經元凋亡導致認知缺陷。SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中也持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗相關，在骨骼肌中其缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重第 2 型糖尿病的周邊胰島素阻抗。

label: Lysosomal biogenesis
description: TFE3 is, together with TFEB, a master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, binding CLEAR elements to induce expression of lysosomal and autophagic genes. Its activation occurs via mTORC1 inhibition, calcineurin signaling, and ER-stress-dependent PERK activation, providing partially distinct triggers from TFEB. TFE3 overexpression similarly expands lysosomal capacity and promotes autophagic flux. The overlapping master-regulator roles of TFE3 and TFEB ensure robustness in the control of cellular degradation.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 與 TFEB 一同是溶酶體生物發生的主調節者，結合 CLEAR 元件以誘發溶酶體和自噬基因的表現。其活化透過 mTORC1 抑制、calcineurin 信號和內質網壓力依賴的 PERK 活化發生，提供了與 TFEB 部分不同的觸發因子。TFE3 過度表現同樣擴展溶酶體能力並促進自噬流。TFE3 和 TFEB 重疊的主調節者角色確保了對細胞降解控制的穩健性。

label: Sox2
description: Through PAK1-STAT3, ivermectin downregulates Sox2 (with Oct4 and Nanog), suppressing the transcription factors rejuvenation requires turned on. This is mechanistically opposing to Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation, though exogenous OSKM delivery may partially bypass the suppression.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 經由 PAK1-STAT3 下調 Sox2（與 Oct4 和 Nanog 一起），抑制回春所需的轉錄因子開啟。這在機制上對抗 Yamanaka 因子回春，儘管外源 OSKM 遞送可能部分繞過此抑制。

label: PD-L1
description: First-line therapy for extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer combines platinum-based chemotherapy with a PD-L1 inhibitor such as atezolizumab or durvalumab. PD-L1 blockade confers a modest but significant survival benefit in ES-SCLC. PD-L1 is therefore a relevant immune-checkpoint target in SCLC.
description_zh_TW: 廣泛期 Small-cell lung cancer 的一線治療將鉑類化療與 atezolizumab 或 durvalumab 等 PD-L1 抑制劑結合。PD-L1 阻斷在 ES-SCLC 中提供適度但顯著的存活益處。因此 PD-L1 是 SCLC 中的相關免疫檢查點靶點。

label: Cyanosis
description: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'. Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron. Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages.
description_zh_TW: Methemoglobinemia produces cyanosis, a bluish-gray discoloration of the skin, lips, mucous membranes, and nail beds, typically once methemoglobin reaches 10-20% of total hemoglobin, at which point blood also appears 'chocolate brown'。Cyanosis in methemoglobinemia is notable because it does not improve with supplemental oxygen, since the problem is not oxygenation of hemoglobin but the oxidation state of its heme iron。Higher levels add headache, anxiety, dyspnea on exertion and fatigue (20-30%), progressing to more severe central nervous and cardiovascular symptoms at higher percentages。

label: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: SIRT2 prevents NAFLD by deacetylating hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha, but is deleterious in hepatic fibrosis through the SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc axis. SIRT4 upregulation inhibits high-fat-diet-induced lipid accumulation, inflammation, and fibrogenesis via the SIRT4/Smad4 axis, though SIRT4 is harmful in NAFLD by destabilizing mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝細胞核因子 4 alpha 防止 NAFLD，但在肝纖維化中透過 SIRT2/ERK/c-Myc 軸是有害的。SIRT4 上調透過 SIRT4/Smad4 軸抑制高脂飲食誘發的脂質堆積、發炎與纖維生成，儘管 SIRT4 在 NAFLD 中因不穩定粒線體三功能蛋白質 alpha 而有害。

label: Ischemic stroke
description: SIRT3 is a prosurvival factor protective in ischemic stroke through HIF-1alpha/VEGF signaling in astrocytes, and it is downregulated in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury where enhancing SIRT3 with Wnt/beta-catenin is proposed as a therapeutic target. This extends SIRT3's mitochondrial protective axis to the neurovascular unit.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在缺血性腦中風中是透過星形細胞中 HIF-1alpha/VEGF 訊號的促存活保護因子，且其在腦缺血—再灌流損傷中下調，其中提議以 Wnt/beta-catenin 增強 SIRT3 作為治療標的。這將 SIRT3 的粒線體保護軸延伸至神經血管單元。

label: N-Acetylcysteine
description: In C. elegans, glucose restriction normally raises mitochondrial respiration and ROS, inducing catalase and extending lifespan; NAC pre-treatment completely abolished both the ROS rise and the longevity benefit. NAC is the strongest direct evidence that scavenging the ROS signal blocks mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，葡萄糖限制通常升高粒線體呼吸與 ROS，誘發 catalase 並延長壽命；NAC 預處理完全廢除 ROS 升高與長壽益處。NAC 是最強的直接證據，顯示清除 ROS 訊號會阻斷粒線體促效應。

label: Immune Checkpoint
description: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Ubiquitin-Proteasome System
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The ubiquitin-proteasome system stands as one of the main pathways responsible for the degradation of intracellular proteins, including muscle proteins. Studies have found that urolithin A can attenuate the degradation of muscle proteins by inhibiting the activity of the ubiquitin-proteasome system, possibly by influencing the activity of specific ubiquitin ligases or proteasomes. This inhibition contributes to urolithin A's muscle-sparing and anti-atrophic effects, helping to preserve muscle mass during catabolic states.
description_zh_TW: 泛素-蛋白酶體系統（ubiquitin-proteasome system）是負責細胞內蛋白（包括肌肉蛋白）降解的主要路徑之一。研究發現 urolithin A 可透過抑制泛素-蛋白酶體系統的活性來減緩肌肉蛋白的降解，可能是透過影響特定泛素連接酶或蛋白酶體的活性。此抑制作用有助於 urolithin A 的肌肉保留與抗萎縮效應，在分解代謝狀態下幫助保留肌肉量。

label: Singlet Oxygen
description: Singlet oxygen causes DNA damage by reacting with guanine at the C8 position to produce 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine and related mutagenic lesions. Its reactivity is highly selective for guanine among the bases, making 8-oxodG the signature oxidative DNA adduct. The directionality is photochemical or oxidative modification of nucleobases. A caveat is that, like other oxidative lesions, these are normally repaired by OGG1-mediated base-excision repair, so persistence indicates failed repair rather than mere exposure.
description_zh_TW: Singlet oxygen 透過與 C8 位的鳥嘌呤反應產生 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 和相關的誘變損傷，從而引起 DNA damage。其反應活性對鹼基中的鳥嘌呤具有高度選擇性，使 8-oxodG 成為標誌性氧化 DNA 加成物。方向性是核鹼基的光化學或氧化修飾。需要注意的是，與其他氧化損傷一樣，這些損傷通常是透過 OGG1 介導的鹼基切除修復來修復的，因此持續存在表明修復失敗而不僅僅是暴露。

label: Auranofin
description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Senescent cells are linked to many age-related conditions, including osteoarthritis, poor wound healing, and neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, according to senior author Pam Maher. The harmful factors senescent cells release (the SASP) promote tissue dysfunction and disease development in surrounding tissue. Because senescence and ferroptosis are both independently linked to age-related dysfunction, the discovery that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis offers a two-birds-with-one-stone strategy: eliminating senescent cells while keeping neighboring cells healthy. Clearing senescent cells is considered a promising therapeutic approach for a multitude of age-related diseases and disorders.
description_zh_TW: 根據資深作者Pam Maher，衰老細胞與許多年齡相關疾病有關，包括骨關節炎、傷口癒合不良，以及阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症等神經退化性疾病。衰老細胞釋放的有害因子（SASP）會促進周圍組織的功能障礙與疾病發展。由於衰老與鐵依賴性細胞死亡均獨立地與年齡相關功能障礙有關，酸性神經醯胺酶升高使衰老細胞更易發生鐵依賴性細胞死亡的發現，提供了一石二鳥的策略：在清除衰老細胞的同時，保持鄰近細胞健康。清除衰老細胞被認為是治療多種年齡相關疾病與障礙的具前景療法。

label: FOXO3a
description: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a in multiple cell types, including neurons and fibroblasts, shifting its target-gene program toward stress resistance and away from apoptosis. Deacetylated FOXO3a induces antioxidant enzymes such as MnSOD and catalase, promotes autophagy and mitophagy through BNIP3, and reduces death-gene expression, biasing cells toward repair and survival. Directionally, SIRT1 modifies FOXO3a, and the altered transcription follows downstream. This stress-resistant switch is central to SIRT1-mediated protection in aging and neurodegeneration, and it links sirtuin activity to redox homeostasis and cellular quality control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在多種細胞類型（包括神經元和纖維母細胞）中去乙醯化 FOXO3a，將其靶基因程序轉向壓力抗性並遠離凋亡。去乙醯化的 FOXO3a 誘導抗氧化酶（如 MnSOD 和 catalase），通過 BNIP3 促進自噬和粒線體自噬，並降低死亡基因表達，使細胞偏向修復和存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 修飾 FOXO3a，隨後的轉錄改變發生在下游。這種壓力抗性開關是 SIRT1 介導的在衰老和神經退行性疾病中保護的核心，將 sirtuin 活性與氧化還原穩態和細胞品質控制聯繫起來。

label: Immunosenescence
description: The Hannum clock is a blood-based epigenetic age estimator whose blood-specific training makes it sensitive to immunosenescence and inflammatory states. Its age-acceleration correlates with aging and epigenetic alterations in the immune compartment.
description_zh_TW: Hannum 時鐘是基於血液的表觀遺傳年齡估算器，其血液特異訓練使其對免疫衰老與發炎狀態敏感。其年齡加速與免疫區室的衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: ASK1
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。

label: DJ-1
description: DJ-1 is a glutathione-independent glyoxalase that stereospecifically detoxifies methylglyoxal into L-lactate, bypassing the glutathione requirement of the canonical glyoxalase system.
description_zh_TW: DJ-1 是一種不依賴麩胱甘肽的乙二醛酶，立體專一性地將甲基乙二醛解毒為 L-lactate，繞過典型乙二醛酶系統對麩胱甘肽的需求。

label: Cross-linking
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Alagebrium is an AGE breaker developed to destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links, following the first AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide, which was unstable in vitro and clinically unsuccessful. Alagebrium could reverse AGE accumulation in vivo, and AGE breakers of this class restored large artery properties in experimental diabetes. However, clinical studies on these compounds were terminated, and none of the known AGE breakers are currently in clinical use. AGE breakers represent a complementary therapeutic strategy to AGE inhibitors, targeting existing cross-links rather than preventing new AGE formation.
description_zh_TW: Alagebrium 是一種 AGE breaker，開發用於 destroy preformed AGE-derived protein cross-links，繼首個 AGE breaker N-phenacylthiazolium bromide 之後，後者在體外 unstable 且 clinically unsuccessful。Alagebrium 能在體內 reverse AGE accumulation，且此類 AGE breakers 在 experimental diabetes 中 restored large artery properties。然而，針對這些 compounds 的 clinical studies 已 terminated，且目前已知的所有 AGE breakers 均無 clinical use。AGE breakers 代表了與 AGE inhibitors 互補的 therapeutic strategy，針對 existing cross-links 而非 preventing new AGE formation。

label: Leukemia
description: Leukemia is a clonal hematologic malignancy arising from abnormal hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells.
description_zh_TW: Leukemia 是一種由異常造血幹/祖細胞引起的克隆性血液惡性腫瘤。

label: DNA
description: DNA encodes the genetic framework that determines pigment-cell fate and the enzymes of catecholamine synthesis and neuromelanin production. Genetic variants influence how dopaminergic neurons synthesize and handle pigment, linking DNA to neuromelanin and Parkinson's susceptibility.
description_zh_TW: DNA 編碼決定色素細胞命運及兒茶酚胺合成與 neuromelanin 生成酶的遺傳框架。基因變異影響多巴胺神經元如何合成與處理色素，將 DNA 與 neuromelanin 及帕金森氏症易感性相連結。

label: CDK4/6
description: Cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6), central drivers of G1 cell-cycle progression, phosphorylate TFEB at serine 142 and promote its nuclear export through a CRM1-dependent mechanism. This action sequesters TFEB in the cytoplasm during phases of active proliferation, when degradative programs are downregulated. Conversely, pharmacological CDK4/6 inhibition permits TFEB nuclear retention and enhances lysosome biogenesis and autophagy. The CDK4/6-TFEB link couples cell-cycle state to the metabolic and degradative status of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 細胞週期蛋白依賴型激酶 4 和 6（CDK4/6）是 G1 細胞週期進展的核心驅動者，於 serine 142 磷酸化 TFEB，並透過 CRM1 依賴機制促進其核輸出。此作用在降解程序下調的主動增殖階段，將 TFEB 隔離於細胞質中。相反地，藥理 CDK4/6 抑制允許 TFEB 核保留並增強溶酶體生物發生和自噬。CDK4/6-TFEB 連結將細胞週期狀態耦合到細胞的代謝和降解狀態。

label: ABCA1
description: ABCA1 prevents atherosclerosis by driving cholesterol efflux from macrophages, which limits foam-cell formation and arterial lipid accumulation. Loss of this reverse-transport step tips the vessel wall toward retention of cholesterol. The directionality is efflux to reduced plaque initiation. A caveat is that ABCA1 is one of several anti-atherogenic mechanisms (e.g., ABCG1, SR-BI), so its deficiency increases but does not solely determine risk. ABCA1 expression is induced by LXR agonists, which are being explored as therapies that harness reverse cholesterol transport to retard plaque formation.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 透過驅動 cholesterol 從巨噬細胞流出來阻止 atherosclerosis，從而限制泡沫細胞的形成和動脈脂質累積。失去這個反向運輸步驟會使血管壁傾向於保留 cholesterol。方向性是流出以減少斑塊的形成。需要注意的是，ABCA1 是多種抗動脈粥狀硬化機制（例如 ABCG1、SR-BI）之一，因此其缺陷會增加，但並不僅僅決定風險。 ABCA1 表達由 LXR 激動劑誘導，目前正在探索如何利用 reverse cholesterol transport 來延緩斑塊形成的療法。

label: SAMD
description: SAMD (senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction) is a specific form of mitochondrial dysfunction that is a hallmark of senescent cells, encompassing reduced oxidative phosphorylation, altered mitochondrial dynamics, and elevated ROS production. It is distinct from generalized mitochondrial disease in being a programmed, senescence-associated feature that both results from and feeds back into the arrested state. SAMD drives the SASP through ROS and mtDNA release, coupling metabolic derangement to inflammation. Its classification as mitochondrial dysfunction situates it within the metabolic hallmarks of aging.
description_zh_TW: SAMD（senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction，衰老相關粒線體功能障礙）是粒線體功能障礙的一種特定形式，是衰老細胞的特徵，涵蓋氧化磷酸化降低、粒線體動態改變與 ROS 產生升高。它不同於一般性粒線體疾病之處，在於其為一種程序性、衰老相關的特徵，既由停滯狀態產生又回饋至停滯狀態。SAMD 透過 ROS 與 mtDNA 釋放驅動 SASP，將代謝失調耦合到發炎。其歸類為粒線體功能障礙，使其定位於老化的代謝特徵之中。

label: Macrophages
description: CD206 (mannose receptor MRC1) is a canonical surface marker of alternatively activated (M2) macrophages. Its expression is induced by IL-4 and IL-13 and suppressed by inflammatory stimuli, making CD206 a defining M2 polarization marker.
description_zh_TW: CD206（甘露糖受體 MRC1）是交替活化（M2）巨噬細胞的典型表面標記。其表現由 IL-4 與 IL-13 誘導，並受發炎刺激抑制，使 CD206 成為 M2 極化的定義性標記。

label: Caspase-7
description: Alongside caspase-3, the executioner caspase-7 is a downstream target of the SIRT1-FOXO4 survival axis. FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 shifts FOXO output away from apoptosis (caspase-3/7 activation) toward stress resistance and repair gene expression. RNAi silencing of SIRT1 in p53-wildtype colorectal cancer cells produced caspase-3 and caspase-7 cleavage products and massive apoptosis, rescued by FOXO4 co-silencing — establishing caspase-7 as a co-executioner of the SIRT1-regulated death pathway.
description_zh_TW: 與 Caspase-3 並列，執行者半胱天冬酶-7 是 SIRT1-FOXO4 存活軸的下游目標。SIRT1 對 FOXO4 的去乙醯化會將 FOXO 的輸出由細胞凋亡（Caspase-3/7 活化）轉向壓力抗性與修復基因表達。在 p53 母源型大腸直腸癌細胞中以 RNAi 沉默 SIRT1 會產生 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-7 的切割片段並引發大量凋亡，而共同沉默 FOXO4 可 rescue——確立 Caspase-7 為 SIRT1 調控死亡路徑的共同執行者。

label: GCN5
description: SIRT6 deacetylates the acetyltransferase GCN5, one of its direct non-histone substrates, altering the chromatin acetylation balance at metabolic and growth promoters and complementing SIRT6's histone deacetylation at H3K9/H3K56. In hepatocytes, SIRT6 also engages GCN5 to acetylate and inhibit PGC-1alpha and thereby restrain gluconeogenesis, so the same enzyme-substrate pair can be tuned in different directions depending on cellular context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6去乙醯化乙醯轉移酶GCN5，這是其直接的非組蛋白底物之一，改變了代謝和生長啟動子上的染色質乙醯化平衡，並補充了SIRT6在H3K9/H3K56上的組蛋白去乙醯化。在肝細胞中，SIRT6也與GCN5相互作用以乙醯化並抑制PGC-1alpha，從而抑制糖質新生，因此相同的酶-底物對可以根據細胞環境以不同方向調節。

label: Glutaredoxin
description: Glutaredoxins use electrons from reduced glutathione (GSH) instead of thioredoxin reductase, passing them through a dithiol or monothiol mechanism to reduce protein disulfides and reverse protein S-glutathionylation. This makes glutaredoxin the GSH-coupled half of the cellular disulfide-reducing system.
description_zh_TW: Glutaredoxin 使用來自還原態麩胱甘肽（GSH）的電子而非硫氧還蛋白還原酶，透過雙硫醇或單硫醇機制還原蛋白質雙硫鍵並逆轉蛋白質的 S-麩胱甘肽化。這使 Glutaredoxin 成為細胞雙硫還原系統中與 GSH 偶聯的一半。

label: Cardiovascular Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy. In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1. Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy。In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1。Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury。

label: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus
source_file: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus.md
description: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: FGF21
description: FGF21 is the primary endocrine mediator of protein restriction's metabolic benefits. PR robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats, and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of PR's effects - increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure, and extended lifespan. Other geroprotective diets including calorie restriction, methionine restriction, BCAA restriction, and isoleucine restriction also induce FGF21. Mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30% (males) and ~40% (females) lifespan extension, while Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR. FGF21 also suppresses senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue and reduces hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in obese models.
description_zh_TW: FGF21是蛋白質限制代謝益處的主要內分泌介質。PR在小鼠、大鼠和人類中強力提升FGF21，FGF21是PR許多效應所必需的——增加食物攝入、減少體重、增加能量消耗和延長壽命。其他抗老化飲食包括熱量限制、甲硫氨酸限制、BCAA限制和異亮氨酸限制也誘導FGF21。過表達Fgf21的小鼠顯示約30%（雄性）和約40%（雌性）的壽命延長，而Fgf21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長。FGF21也抑制白色脂肪組織的衰老和發炎，並減少肥胖模型中的肝臟脂肪變性和纖維化。

label: MYC
description: The SIRT7-Myc axis is bidirectional: SIRT7 assembles with Myc at ribosomal protein (RP) gene promoters to silence gene expression and relieve ER stress, while Myc-driven proliferation opposes SIRT7-dependent growth-quiescence programs in some contexts; Table 3 lists Myc among negative regulators of SIRT7 (Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7-Myc 軸線是雙向的：SIRT7 與 Myc 在核糖體蛋白（RP）基因啟動子處組裝以沉默基因表現並緩解內質網壓力，而 Myc 驅動的增殖在某些情境下對抗 SIRT7 依賴的生長靜止程序；表 3 將 Myc 列為 SIRT7 的負向調節因子（Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820）。

label: Metabolic Reprogramming
description: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Sarcopenia
description: In the Women's Health and Aging Study I, serum carboxymethyl-lysine (CML), the soluble receptor for advanced glycation end products (sRAGE), endogenous secretory RAGE (esRAGE), and grip strength were measured in 559 moderately to severely disabled women aged 65 and older. Women with higher concentrations of CML had less grip strength than women with lower CML concentrations, leading the authors to conclude that women with higher AGEs have more muscle weakness. These findings support a role for AGE accumulation in age-related muscle weakness and sarcopenia, although the studies are not conclusive of a causal relationship.
description_zh_TW: 在女性健康與老化研究 I（Women's Health and Aging Study I）中，於 559 名 65 歲及以上、中度至重度失能的女性中測量了血清羧甲基賴氨酸（CML）、晚期糖化終產物之可溶性受體（sRAGE）、內源性分泌型 RAGE（esRAGE）與握力。CML 濃度較高的女性比 CML 濃度較低的女性握力較差，使作者得出結論：AGE 較高的女性有較多的肌肉無力。這些發現支持 AGE 堆積在年齡相關肌肉無力與肌少症中的角色，儘管這些研究尚無法確立因果關係。

label: NRH
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NRH, the reduced form of nicotinamide riboside, is bioavailable in mice and increases NAD+ in both cultured cells (5-10-fold above the baseline) and in mice, in a more potent and faster manner than NR, and it is detectable in circulation after oral intake or intraperitoneal injection. A NMRK-independent pathway for the NRH-induced NAD+ increase has been demonstrated, consistent with the recent discovery of a novel biosynthetic route of NAD+ from NRH through the NMNH intermediate, where adenosine kinase (ADK) acts as an NRH kinase. The presence of endogenous NRH in the liver of mouse models was confirmed, establishing NRH as a valid natural precursor of NAD+.
description_zh_TW: NRH（nicotinamide riboside 的還原型）在小鼠中具有生物可用率，並以比 NR 更強效且更快速的方式提升培養細胞（高於基線 5-10 倍）與小鼠中的 NAD+，且在口服攝取或腹腔注射後可在循環中偵測到。NRH 誘發的 NAD+ 增加之 NMRK 非依賴性路徑已被證實，這與近期發現的從 NRH 經由 NMNH 中間產物生成 NAD+ 的新穎生物合成路徑一致，其中 adenosine kinase（ADK，腺苷激酶）作為 NRH 激酶。小鼠模型肝臟中內源性 NRH 的存在已獲確認，確立了 NRH 作為 NAD+ 的有效天然前驅物。

label: NLRP3 inflammasome
description: SIRT2 modulates activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome through deacetylation of alpha-tubulin, an effect that has been implicated in vascular inflammation and in the endothelial dysfunction that accompanies insulin resistance. Directionally, SIRT2's tubulin deacetylation sits upstream of altered NLRP3 inflammasome activity. The net outcome is context-dependent, reflecting the complex roles of both SIRT2 and NLRP3 in different tissues and inflammatory milieus. Because NLRP3-driven inflammation underpins aspects of atherosclerosis and metabolic disease, defining when SIRT2 dampens versus promotes the inflammasome is important for predicting the cardiovascular effects of SIRT2-modulating drugs.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2透過α-tubulin去乙醯化調節NLRP3發炎小體的活化，此作用已被認為與血管發炎和伴隨胰島素阻抗的內皮功能障礙有關。方向上，SIRT2的tubulin去乙醯化位於NLRP3發炎小體活性改變的上游。最終結果取決於環境，反映了SIRT2和NLRP3在不同組織和發炎環境中的複雜作用。由於NLRP3驅動的發炎是動脈粥樣硬化和代謝疾病的基礎，確定SIRT2何時抑制或促進發炎小體對於預測SIRT2調節藥物的心血管效應非常重要。

label: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation
description: Failing lysosomes cannot clear α-synuclein oligomers, so aggregates accumulate into Lewy bodies — the hallmark of Parkinson's disease dopaminergic neurons. Lysosomal failure co-acts with Complex I defects, and dying neurons then release neuromelanin and aggregates as DAMPs that prime microglia. Because the lysosome is the terminal station of autophagy and mitophagy, its dysfunction converts otherwise-manageable protein load into lethal aggregation, and lipofuscin accumulation further buffers lysosomal pH upward.
description_zh_TW: 失能的溶酶體無法清除 α-synuclein 寡聚體，使聚集物累積成路易氏體——帕金森氏症多巴胺神經元的標誌。溶酶體失能與 Complex I 缺陷協同作用，垂死神經元隨後釋出神經黑色素與聚集物作為 DAMP 致敏小膠細胞。由於溶酶體是自噬與粒線體自噬的終點站，其失能會使原本可處理的蛋白負荷轉為致命聚集，而脂褐素的累積更進一步推高溶酶體的 pH。

label: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is the most abundant oxidative lesion in DNA, with roughly 10^3 to 10^6 lesions per cell per day arising from normal metabolism and extrinsic insults. Its prevalence reflects both high formation rate and efficient but imperfect repair. The directionality is oxidation of guanine to the dominant adduct. A caveat is that the steady-state level integrates formation and repair, so it is an indirect rather than instantaneous measure of ROS flux. The steady-state 8-oxodG level is influenced by both the rate of oxidation and the efficiency of OGG1-mediated repair, so it reflects the balance between insult and defense.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 DNA 中最豐富的氧化損傷，每個細胞每天約有 10^3 至 10^6 個損傷，這些損傷是由正常代謝和外在損傷引起的。它的流行反映了高形成率和有效但不完善的修復。方向性是鳥嘌呤氧化成主要加合物。需要注意的是，穩態水平整合了形成和修復，因此它是 ROS 通量的間接而非瞬時測量。穩態8-oxodG水平受到氧化速率和OGG1介導的修復效率的影響，因此它反映了損傷和防禦之間的平衡。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: ATF4
description: GCN2 is an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase activated by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs, as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, which suppresses global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key transcription factor that activates stress response and autophagy genes. This selective translation of ATF4 is a central feature of the integrated stress response engaged during protein restriction. Genetic evidence confirms GCN2's importance: Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, and GCN2 overexpression extends lifespan in both organisms.
description_zh_TW: GCN2是一種演化上保守、對壓力有反應的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，由胺基酸限制透過未帶電荷的tRNA活化，也可由核醣體停滯與碰撞活化。活化的GCN2使eIF2alpha磷酸化，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性地促進ATF4的轉譯；ATF4是活化壓力反應與自噬基因的關鍵轉錄因子。ATF4的選擇性轉譯是蛋白質限制期間所啟動的整合性壓力反應（integrated stress response）的核心特徵。遺傳證據確認了GCN2的重要性：缺乏Gcn2的果蠅在胺基酸受限時會死亡，酵母菌中刪除Gcn2會阻斷飲食限制的壽命延長，而GCN2過度表現則在兩種生物體中均延長壽命。

label: Asthma
description: SIRT2 enhances allergic asthmatic inflammation: pharmacologic ablation attenuates the phenotype while genetic overexpression exaggerates it, and SIRT2 aggravates asthma through Th2 responses and macrophage polarization. Unlike the protective SIRT1 and SIRT3 in asthma, SIRT2 is harmful, exemplifying the counter-regulatory relationship between SIRT2 and the protective sirtuins in allergic airway disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 增強過敏性氣喘發炎：藥理去除減弱表型，而基因過度表現誇大之，且 SIRT2 透過 Th2 反應與巨噬細胞極化加劇氣喘。不同於氣喘中保護性的 SIRT1 與 SIRT3，SIRT2 是有害的，體現了過敏性氣道疾病中 SIRT2 與保護性 sirtuin 之間的相反調節關係。

label: miR-217
description: miR-217 is a senescence-associated microRNA whose canonical validated target is SIRT1. It binds the SIRT1 3'-UTR and suppresses translation, reducing NAD+-dependent deacetylase activity (Menghini et al., Circulation 2009; PMID 19188522).
description_zh_TW: miR-217 是一種與衰老相關的微 RNA，其經實驗驗證的經典靶標是 SIRT1。它結合 SIRT1 的 3'-UTR 並抑制轉譯，降低 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯化酶活性（Menghini 等人，Circulation 2009；PMID 19188522）。

label: Bladder Cancer
description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

label: c-Myc
description: SIRT6 inhibits the transcriptional activities of c-MYC, resulting in repression of the glycolytic metabolic reprogramming that supports tumor growth. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of c-MYC inhibition and tumor suppression. This complements SIRT6's repression of HIF-1alpha, giving SIRT6 a dual brake on the two major oncogenic drivers of glycolysis. By restricting the metabolic switch to aerobic glycolysis, SIRT6 limits the biosynthetic and energetic advantages that cancer cells depend on. This positions SIRT6 as a central regulator of the metabolic reprogramming that underlies many cancers and as a rational target for therapeutic activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6抑制c-MYC的轉錄活性，導致支持腫瘤生長的糖解代謝重編程被抑制。方向上，SIRT6位於c-MYC抑制和腫瘤抑制的上游。這補充了SIRT6對HIF-1alpha的抑制，賦予SIRT6對兩個主要糖解致癌驅動因子的雙重制動。透過限制向有氧糖解的代謝轉換，SIRT6限制了癌細胞依賴的生物合成和能量優勢。這將SIRT6定位為支撐許多癌症的代謝重編程的核心調節因子，以及治療活化的合理靶點。

label: Lysosome biogenesis
description: MYC antagonizes TFEB and TFE3 transcriptional activities at lysosomal gene promoters, thereby repressing lysosome biogenesis in proliferating cells. Through direct competition for CLEAR elements and broader chromatin effects, MYC suppresses the degradative capacity that would otherwise constrain growth. This repression aligns cellular resources toward biosynthesis rather than turnover during oncogenic drive. The MYC-lysosome antagonism is a key axis by which cancer cells reshape their degradative landscape.
description_zh_TW: MYC 在溶酶體基因啟動子處拮抗 TFEB 和 TFE3 的轉錄活性，從而在增殖細胞中抑制溶酶體生物發生。透過對 CLEAR 元件的直接競爭以及更廣泛的染色質效應，MYC 抑制了本會限制生長的降解能力。此抑制將細胞資源在致癌驅動下導向生物合成而非更新。MYC-溶酶體拮抗作用是癌細胞重塑其降解景觀的關鍵軸。

label: L-DOPA
description: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: macroH2A
description: macroH2A accumulates in senescent cells and contributes to the proper timing of SASP expression. Its repressive chromatin functions balance SASP output during senescence.
description_zh_TW: macroH2A 在衰老細胞中累積，並促成 SASP 表現的適當時序。其抑制性染色質功能在衰老期間平衡 SASP 輸出。

label: Alpha-synuclein
description: Alpha-synuclein is a major protein component that accumulates and aggregates within Lewy bodies, the pathological hallmark inclusions of Parkinson's disease. Its aggregation is central to the selective vulnerability of dopaminergic neurons.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 是累積並聚集於路易小體（Lewy bodies）內的主要蛋白質成分，路易小體是帕金森氏症的病理標誌包涵體。其聚集是多巴胺神經元選擇性脆弱性的核心。

label: MPTP
description: Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Oct4
description: Ivermectin inhibits expression of Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 in cancer stem cells via the PAK1-STAT3 axis. Because Oct4 and Sox2 are core Yamanaka factors, this lowers reprogramming capacity and opposes partial reprogramming, while being therapeutically desirable against CSCs.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 經由 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制癌幹細胞中 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 的表現。由於 Oct4 與 Sox2 是核心 Yamanaka 因子，這降低重編程能力並對抗部分重編程，同時在治療上對抗 CSC 是理想的。

label: Females
description: This is the most fundamental sex difference in the vault's cell-death biology: under stress, cells of female (XX) origin preferentially undergo caspase-dependent apoptosis (controlled, non-inflammatory), while male (XY) cells preferentially die by PARP-1/AIF-dependent necrosis (uncontrolled, proinflammatory). The divergence is cell-autonomous, persisting in hormone-free media and prepubertal animals, with major implications for stroke, MI, neurodegeneration and cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: 這是資料庫細胞死亡生物學中最根本的性別差異：在壓力下，女性（XX）來源的細胞優先進行依賴 caspases 的凋亡（受控、非發炎），而男性（XY）細胞則偏好 PARP-1/AIF 依賴的壞死（不受控、促發炎）。此差異具細胞自主性，在無荷爾蒙培養基與青春期前動物中皆持續存在，對中風、心肌梗塞、神經退化與癌症治療具重大意義。

label: Proteostasis
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: The mTORC1 pathway controls mRNA translation, and its overactivity increases the rate of protein synthesis at the expense of protein quality. Inhibition of mTORC1 by rapamycin reduces translation, improves its accuracy, and promotes longer life by reducing genetic code reading errors and the accumulation of abnormal proteins, a mechanism confirmed in Drosophila and C. elegans models. Rapamycin also inhibits cap-dependent translation of mRNA, supporting alternative stress-resistant translation that increases production of stress-response and mitochondrial-protection proteins such as HSP70 and TFAM, and by activating ATF4 and producing hydrogen sulfide it increases resistance to oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1途徑控制mRNA翻譯，其過度活化以蛋白質質量為代價增加蛋白質合成速率。Rapamycin對mTORC1的抑制減少翻譯，提高其準確性，並透過減少遺傳密碼讀取錯誤和異常蛋白質的累積來促進更長壽命，這一機制在黑腹果蠅和秀丽隱桿線蟲模型中得到證實。Rapamycin還抑制mRNA的帽依賴性翻譯，支持替代性抗壓力翻譯，增加壓力反應和粒線體保護蛋白如HSP70和TFAM的產生，並透過活化ATF4和產生硫化氫來增加對氧化壓力的抵抗力。

label: p21 CIP1
description: DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 binds and inhibits cyclin-CDK complexes, notably CDK2, enforcing a G1/S arrest. This p53-to-p21 axis is a primary, rapid enforcement mechanism of senescence and quiescence, and the induction is dose-dependent and reversible in the short term but locks the arrest when sustained. It exemplifies tumor-suppressive cell-cycle control and is a core target of the DNA damage response. p21 also supports an early secretory phenotype during stress.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷穩定 p53，p53 轉錄誘發 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 結合並抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體，特別是 CDK2，強制 G1/S 停滯。此 p53-to-p21 軸是衰老與靜止的主要、快速執行機制，且此誘發在短期內依劑量且可逆，但在持續時鎖定停滯。它例示腫瘤抑制性細胞週期控制，是 DNA 損傷反應的核心標靶。p21 也在壓力期間支持早期分泌表型。

label: EMT
description: Within the tubular epithelium, SIRT3 suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transformation (EMT) through activation of FOXO3a, which directly induces mitochondrial SOD2 and peroxisomal catalase expression. This coordinated antioxidant enzyme induction mitigates intracellular oxidative stress, preventing ECM component deposition associated with early fibrotic lesions, and SIRT3 also disrupts the NF-kappaB/TGF-beta1/Smad axis that drives fibrogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 在腎小管上皮中，SIRT3 透過活化 FOXO3a 抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT），FOXO3a 直接誘導粒線體 SOD2 和過氧化物酶體 catalase 的表達。這種協調的抗氧化酵素誘導減輕細胞內氧化壓力，防止與早期纖維化病灶相關的 ECM 成分沉積；SIRT3 還中斷驅動纖維化的 NF-kappaB/TGF-beta1/Smad 軸線。

label: Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reduces fat accumulation in the liver through a mechanism that involves induction of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt), which is elicited by NAD+ repletion and reverses fatty liver disease in mice. Through this pathway, as well as through activation of SIRT1 and factors associated with cholesterol homeostasis, NR can reduce cholesterol levels and improve liver health. In regenerating liver, NR reduces lipid accumulation, promotes hepatocyte replication, and increases hepatic ATP content, leading to faster recovery of liver weight.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）透過涉及誘導粒線體未摺疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的機制減少肝臟中的脂肪堆積，此反應由 NAD+ 補充所引發，並在小鼠中逆轉脂肪肝疾病。透過此路徑，以及透過活化 SIRT1 與膽固醇恆定相關的因子，NR 能降低膽固醇水平並改善肝臟健康。在再生肝臟中，NR 減少脂質堆積、促進肝細胞複製，並增加肝臟 ATP 含量，導致肝臟重量更快恢復。

label: Senolytic
description: Senolytics are a class of drugs or natural compounds that selectively target senescent cells, inducing their apoptosis and clearing them from tissues; cellular senescence is therefore the object of senolytic activity. By killing senescent cells, senolytics suppress the SASP they secrete and extend healthspan and lifespan in aged mice when initiated late in life. The Senolytic-Senescence relationship is the defining mechanism of senolytic pharmacology (contrast with senomorphics, which suppress the senescent phenotype without killing the cells).
description_zh_TW: Senolytics 是一類藥物或天然化合物，可選擇性地靶向衰老細胞，誘導其凋亡並將其從組織中清除；因此細胞衰老是 senolytic 作用的對象。透過殺死衰老細胞，senolytics 抑制它們所分泌的 SASP，並在晚年小鼠中延遲啟用時延長健康壽命與壽命。Senolytic-衰老之間的關係正是 senolytic 藥理學的定義機制（與 senomorphics 相對，後者在不殺死細胞的情況下抑制衰老表型）。

label: Ghrelin
description: The metabolic hormone ghrelin, a major regulator of food intake, also exerts immunomodulatory and thymopoietic effects. Ghrelin binds immune cell subsets via ghrelin-specific receptors and localizes to lipid rafts of activated T cells. Dixit et al. reported that ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice, and in aged thymus both ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease in correlation with functional thymic involution and elevated inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 代謝激素ghrelin（飢餓素）是食物攝取的主要調節者，也具有免疫調節與胸腺生成（thymopoietic）效應。Ghrelin透過ghrelin特異性受體與免疫細胞亞群結合，並定位於活化T細胞的脂筏。Dixit等人報告ghrelin可減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應，而在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平均下降，與功能性胸腺退化及發炎升高相關。

label: Parkin
description: In healthy mitochondria, PINK1 (PTEN-induced putative kinase 1) is continuously imported into the inner membrane, cleaved and degraded by PARL and mitochondrial processing peptidases. When mitochondrial membrane potential becomes abnormal or import is impaired, PINK1 stabilizes and accumulates on the outer mitochondrial membrane, where its kinase domain phosphorylates outer membrane proteins and recruits and activates the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin (PRKN). PINK1 phosphorylation of MFN2 acts as a Parkin receptor that facilitates Parkin recruitment, and activated Parkin polyubiquitinates outer membrane proteins, marking damaged mitochondria for autophagic degradation.
description_zh_TW: 在健康的粒線體中，PINK1（PTEN-induced putative kinase 1）持續被輸入內膜，並被PARL和粒線體加工肽酶切割和降解。當粒線體膜電位異常或輸入受損時，PINK1會穩定並累積在外膜上，其激酶結構域在此磷酸化外膜蛋白質並招募和活化E3泛素連接酶Parkin（PRKN）。PINK1對MFN2的磷酸化作為Parkin受體，促進Parkin招募，活化的Parkin將外膜蛋白質多聚泛素化，標記受損粒線體以進行自噬降解。

label: SAHF
description: SADS is distinct from SAHF in both substrate and direction: SADS decompacts constitutive pericentromeric heterochromatin, whereas SAHF compact facultative heterochromatin at E2F loci. The two processes can coexist in the same senescent nucleus, reflecting parallel, opposite chromatin rearrangements with different regulators and functional consequences. Recognizing the distinction is important because SADS connects to LINE-1 activation and innate immune signaling, while SAHF reinforce proliferative arrest. Together they illustrate the complexity of senescent chromatin remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SADS 在受質與方向上皆不同於 SAHF：SADS 去緻密化組成性著絲粒周異染色質，而 SAHF 在 E2F 基因座緻密化兼性異染色質。兩過程可在同一衰老細胞核共存，反映具不同調節者與功能後果的平行、相反染色質重排。辨識此區別很重要，因 SADS 連結到 LINE-1 活化與先天免疫訊號，而 SAHF 強化增殖停滯。它們共同說明衰老染色質重塑的複雜性。

label: Glioblastoma
description: Ivermectin carries the typed edge 'inhibits → Glioblastoma' (conf 0.8) together with lower-confidence inhibitory edges to Cholangiocarcinoma (0.7) and Renal Cell Carcinoma (0.7); all are multiplicity-1 claims on enormous Adamic–Adar headroom (Ivermectin→Cancer 9.68) — precise intervention statements and curation blind spots at once.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 帶「inhibits → Glioblastoma」類型邊（conf 0.8），另有對 Cholangiocarcinoma（0.7）與 Renal Cell Carcinoma（0.7）的低信度抑制邊；這些都是巨大 Adamic–Adar 空間（Ivermectin→Cancer 9.68）上的 multiplicity-1 主張——既是精準介入陳述也是策展盲點。

label: Acetyl-CoA
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: Adrenochrome Pathway
description: RAGE signaling intersects with the adrenochrome pathway through multiple mechanisms: adrenochrome-induced oxidative stress promotes AGE formation via glycolysis-derived dicarbonyls, activating the AGE-RAGE inflammatory axis. RAGE activation upregulates NF-kB targets including COX-2 and iNOS, amplifying catecholamine oxidation. RAGE-mediated inhibition of autophagy may also impair clearance of aminochrome-damaged mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: RAGE 訊號透過多種機制與 adrenochrome pathway 相交：adrenochrome 誘導的氧化壓力經由糖酵解衍生的 dicarbonyls 促進 AGE 形成，啟動 AGE-RAGE 發炎軸。RAGE 活化上調包括 COX-2 與 iNOS 在內的 NF-kB 標靶，放大兒茶酚胺氧化。RAGE 介導的 autophagy 抑制也可能損害受 aminochrome 損傷粒線體的清除。

label: Methylation Cycle
description: Creatine synthesis consumes an estimated 40% of the body's daily methyl-group flux, making it the single largest sink in the methylation cycle. Endogenous creatine synthesis competes with other SAM-dependent reactions, and supplementing creatine spares methyl groups for other pathways.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸合成消耗身體每日甲基通量約 40%，是甲基化循環中最大的單一消耗端。內源性肌酸合成與其他 SAM 依賴反應競爭，而補充肌酸可為其他途徑節省甲基。

label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
description: Acute myeloid leukemia is the most common acute leukemia in adults and belongs to the broader disease category of leukemia. It is characterized by clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts that fail to differentiate. AML is a distinct subtype within the leukemia family.
description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病是成人中最常見的急性白血病，屬於更廣泛的白血病疾病類別。其特徵是不成熟骨髓母細胞的克隆擴張且未能分化。AML 是白血病家族中的一個獨特亞型。

label: Inflammasome
description: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin inflammasomes recruit pro-Caspase-1 via ASC for proximity-induced dimerization and activation — the scaffolded platform that determines pyroptotic versus inflammatory outcomes; Caspase-1 then cleaves pro-IL-1beta and IL-18 to their active cytokines.
description_zh_TW: NLRP3/NLRP1/NLRC4/AIM2/pyrin 發炎體經 ASC 招募 pro-Caspase-1，進行鄰近誘導二聚化與活化——這是決定細胞焦亡或發炎結果的平台支架；Caspase-1 隨後把 pro-IL-1beta 與 IL-18 切割成熟為活性細胞激素。

label: Reprogramming
description: Transient OSKM expression erases cell identity and yields induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). iPSCs enable patient-specific disease modeling, drug discovery, and regenerative applications, including the first iPSC clinical trial for macular degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 短暫的 OSKM 表現會抹除細胞身分並產生誘導多能幹細胞（iPSC）。iPSC 促成患者特異性的疾病建模、藥物發現和再生應用，包括第一個黃斑部退化 iPSC 臨床試驗。

label: IKK
description: Activated IKK phosphorylates the inhibitor IkappaBalpha at Ser32/Ser36, triggering K48-linked ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of IkappaBalpha. This liberates the p50/RelA NF-kB dimer for nuclear translocation. Phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha is the canonical step through which IKK controls NF-kB signaling.
description_zh_TW: 激活的 IKK 在 Ser32/Ser36 磷酸化抑制因子 IkappaBalpha，觸發 K48 連接的泛素化與 IkappaBalpha 的蛋白酶體降解。這使 p50/RelA NF-kB 二聚體得以釋放並轉位至細胞核。磷酸化 IkappaBalpha 是 IKK 控制 NF-kB 訊號傳導的經典步驟。

label: Antioxidants
description: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
description_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

label: Genistein
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein is an isoflavone flavonoid reported to possess anti-glycation properties. Together with other flavonoids such as kaempferol, quercitrin, and quercetin, genistein inhibits the glycation process in vitro. The anti-glycation activities of these polyphenols are similar to or even stronger than aminoguanidine, and they act in part through trapping reactive carbonyl species and antioxidant capacity. Herbal products and dietary plants containing these flavonoids are therefore considered promising, relatively safe agents for preventing glycation and AGE accumulation during aging.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 是一種異黃酮類黃酮，據報導具有抗糖化特性。與其他黃酮類如 kaempferol、quercitrin 與 quercetin 一起，Genistein 在體外抑制糖化過程。這些多酚的抗糖化活性與 aminoguanidine 相似甚至更強，且部分透過捕捉活性羰基物種與抗氧化能力來作用。因此，含有這些黃酮類的草藥產品與食用植物被視為在老化過程中預防糖化與 AGE 堆積的具潛力且相對安全的物質。

label: Dopachrome tautomerase
description: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

label: Immune Evasion
description: Immune evasion is a hallmark of cancer whereby cells subvert immune surveillance through checkpoint molecules and an immunosuppressive milieu. The tumor microenvironment is a constellation of elements that can exclude or tolerize cytotoxic lymphocytes, reinforcing evasion.
description_zh_TW: 免疫逃逸是癌症的特徵，細胞透過檢查點分子與免疫抑制環境規避免疫監視。腫瘤微環境是能排除或耐受化細胞毒性淋巴球的元素集合，強化逃逸。

label: GlyNAC
description: GlyNAC (glycine + N-acetylcysteine) increases glutathione and reduces oxidative stress (round-3 remediation, degree-10 node including 'increases → Glutathione' and 'activates → NRF2'), pulling the redox-buffer arm of the protocol into the glutathione synthesis subgraph.
description_zh_TW: GlyNAC（甘氨酸＋N-乙醯半胱氨酸）提高 glutathione 並降低氧化壓力（第三輪修復，degree-10 節點，含「increases → Glutathione」與「activates → NRF2」），把協定的氧化還原緩衝臂拉入 glutathione 生合成子圖。

label: AP-1
description: AP-1 and NF-κB are co-regulators of inflammatory SASP genes. They share transcriptional targets including IL-6, IL-8, and TNFα.
description_zh_TW: AP-1 與 NF-κB 是發炎型 SASP 基因的共調節因子。它們共享包括 IL-6、IL-8 與 TNFα 在內的轉錄標的。

label: Senomorphic Therapy
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is suppressed by Senomorphic Therapy. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senomorphics suppress the SASP without killing senescent cells, dampening chronic inflammation and paracrine tumor promotion. The directionality runs from Senomorphic Therapy toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senomorphic Therapy is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 被 Senomorphic Therapy 抑制。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它可以抑制衰老細胞而不殺死衰老細胞，從而抑制慢性發炎和旁分泌腫瘤的發生。方向性從 Senomorphic Therapy 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senomorphic Therapy 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Healthspan
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Aged (19-month-old) C57BL/6 mice gavaged with CTPI2 (50 mg/kg three times weekly for 3 months) exhibited more lustrous fur, reduced alopecia and greying, and delayed onset of frailty as measured by a 31-parameter frailty index. Functional assessment revealed enhanced neuromuscular performance: improved coordination and balance (tightrope test), increased strength (hanging and grip strength tests) and preservation of muscle integrity. CTPI2 reduced SASP gene expression in skeletal muscle, liver and heart without altering p16 or p21, indicating that suppressing the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis improves healthspan through SASP modulation rather than senescent cell clearance.
description_zh_TW: 以 CTPI2（50 mg/kg，每週三次，持續 3 個月）管餵的老年（19 個月大）C57BL/6 小鼠，表現出更有光澤的毛皮、脫毛與毛髮灰白減少，且以 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，衰弱症的發生獲得延緩。功能評估顯示神經肌肉表現增強：協調性與平衡感改善（走鋼索測試）、肌力增加（懸掛與握力測試），並保留肌肉完整性。CTPI2 在不改變 p16 或 p21 的情況下，降低了骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中的 SASP 基因表現，顯示抑制粒線體檸檬酸—乙醯輔酶 A 軸，是透過調節 SASP 而非清除衰老細胞來改善健康壽命。

label: H3K9me3
description: H3K9me3 globally decreases with aging, reflecting the progressive loss of constitutive heterochromatin. Reduced H3K9me3 is observed in aging flies, in progeria patient fibroblasts, and in aged mouse and human tissues, and it is accompanied by reduced HP1 and heterochromatin decompaction. This decline in the repressive mark permits derepression of transposable elements and aberrant gene expression, contributing to genomic instability and inflammation during aging. Restoring H3K9me3 levels is investigated as a means to stabilize the aging genome.
description_zh_TW: H3K9me3 隨著年齡的增長而整體下降，反映了組成型異染色質的逐漸喪失。在衰老果蠅、早衰症患者成纖維細胞以及衰老小鼠和人體組織中觀察到 H3K9me3 減少，並且伴隨著 HP1 減少和異染色質解壓縮。抑制標記的下降允許轉座元件和異常 gene expression 的去抑制，從而導致老化過程中基因組不穩定和發炎。研究恢復 H3K9me3 水平作為穩定老化基因組的一種方法。

label: Mitochondrial DNA
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP.
