Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。

label: Blood-Brain Barrier
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol's small, aromatic, lipophilic structure allows it to cross the blood-brain barrier, enabling its CNS actions. This property underpins its neuroprotective, anxiolytic, and sleep-promoting effects and allows it to inhibit CNS tumor growth.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 的小型芳香親脂結構使其能穿越血腦屏障，實現其中樞神經系統作用。此特性支撐其神經保護、抗焦慮和促進睡眠的作用，並使其能抑制中樞神經系統腫瘤生長。

label: Collagen
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Collagen is the main structural protein of the extracellular matrix, and during aging it undergoes glycation leading to advanced glycation end-product cross-links. These cross-links stiffen tissues such as blood vessels and skin, contributing to age-related loss of elasticity.
description_zh_TW: 膠原蛋白是細胞外基質的主要結構蛋白，衰老期間會發生糖化，形成晚期糖化終產物交聯。這些交聯使血管與皮膚等組織變硬，造成與年齡相關的彈性喪失。

label: c-Met
description: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
description_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

label: Tumorigenicity
description: Tumorigenicity is the capacity of a cell, population of cells, or agent to form a tumor when introduced into a suitable host, reflecting uncontrolled proliferation, evasion of senescence and apoptosis, invasion, and failure of differentiation control. It is a quantitative attribute central to cancer biology.
description_zh_TW: 致瘤性是指細胞、細胞群或藥劑在進入合適宿主後形成腫瘤的能力，反映不受控制的增殖、逃避免疫衰老和凋亡、侵襲以及分化控制失敗。它是癌症生物學核心的定量屬性。

label: Histone Acetyltransferase
description: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
description_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

label: Oncogene-Induced Senescence
description: Oncogenic BRAF (V600E), RAS, or MYC drive a hyperproliferative burst that causes DNA replication stress and a DNA damage response, permanently arresting the cell via p53/p21 and p16/Rb. OIS is therefore induced by oncogenic signaling yet confronts it with a tumor-suppressive barrier in benign lesions.
description_zh_TW: 致癌性 BRAF（V600E）、RAS 或 MYC 驅動高增生爆發，造成 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷反應，經由 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 永久性停滯細胞。OIS 因此由致癌訊號誘發，卻在良性病灶中以腫瘤抑制屏障對抗之。

label: poorer Cognitive Performance
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: In healthy subjects, the Val158 allele has been found to associate with poorer cognitive performance, specifically on tasks involving executive function. Transgenic COMT-overexpressing mice, equivalent to the relative increase in activity of the human Val158 allele, exhibit cognitive deficits in stimulus-response learning and working memory. This functionally validates the model of increased COMT activity.
description_zh_TW: 在健康受試者中，已發現 Val158 等位基因與較差的認知表現相關，尤其是在涉及 executive function 的任務上。與人類 Val158 等位基因活性相對增加等效的轉基因 COMT 過度表現小鼠，在 stimulus-response learning 和工作記憶上表現出認知缺陷。這在功能上驗證了 COMT activity 增加的模型。

label: COMT activity
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: The COMT Val158 allele increases the thermostability of the enzyme, thereby increasing its level of activity compared to the 158 Met allele. This higher activity increases dopamine turnover in cortical synapses. A common polymorphism resulting in increased COMT activity has been associated with poorer cognitive performance and increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val158 等位基因增加酶的熱穩定性，從而相對於 158 Met 等位基因提高其活性水平。這種較高的活性增加皮質突觸的多巴胺代謝。導致 COMT activity 增加的常見多態性已與較差的認知表現和精神疾病易感性增加相關。

label: PARK7
description: PARK7 mutations (L166P, M26I) cause early-onset autosomal recessive Parkinson's disease. DJ-1-deficient neurons show fragmented mitochondria, Complex I impairment, and accelerated α-synuclein aggregation.
description_zh_TW: PARK7 突變（L166P、M26I）造成早發性體染色體隱性遺傳帕金森氏症。DJ-1 缺失的神經元呈現粒線體碎片化、Complex I 功能受損與 α-synuclein 聚集加速。

label: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor
description: Kynurenine and its derivatives activate the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), promoting regulatory T cell (Treg) differentiation and suppressing effector T/NK cells. This metabolite-driven AhR signaling is the second major mechanism of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression alongside local tryptophan depletion, and together they create an immunosuppressive microenvironment in tissues such as tumors, placenta and inflamed sites. The context-dependent nature of this pathway is notable: it is protective via tolerance induction in autoimmunity but potentially detrimental when overactive in metabolic inflammation, where elevated KP activity links to insulin resistance and chronic low-grade inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸及其衍生物活化芳香烴受體（AhR），促進調節性 T 細胞（Treg）分化並抑制效應 T/NK 細胞。此代謝物驅動的 AhR 訊息傳導是 IDO1 媒介免疫抑制的第二個主要機制，與局部色胺酸耗竭並行，兩者共同在腫瘤、胎盤與發炎部位等組織中創造免疫抑制微環境。此路徑的情境依賴性值得注意：它在自體免疫中經由耐受誘導具有保護作用，但在代謝性發炎中過度活化則可能有害，此時升高的 KP 活性與胰島素抗性及慢性低度發炎相關。

label: Non-homologous End Joining
description: NHEJ directly ligates DNA double-strand breaks without a homologous template; DNA ligase IV performs the terminal sealing with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 enhances NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation, supporting genome stability and mtDNA repair.
description_zh_TW: NHEJ 在沒有同源模板的情況下直接連接 DNA 雙股斷裂；DNA ligase IV 與 XRCC4/XLF 一起執行最終封口。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化增強 NHEJ 效率，支持基因組穩定性和 mtDNA 修復。

label: LC3
description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

label: OMA1
description: The proteolytic processing of OPA1 is mediated by several mitochondrial proteases, including the metalloendopeptidase OMA1, the ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease YME1L1, the rhomboid protease PARL, paraplegin and the mAAA protease complex. Under stress conditions such as mitochondrial depolarization, the S1 site of OPA1 is cleaved by YME1L1 or OMA1 to produce the short form S-OPA1, which lacks a membrane anchor but can modulate fusion by complexing with membrane-bound L-OPA1. DRP1-mediated zinc influx into the matrix causes membrane depolarization, resulting in OMA1 activation and OPA1 inactivation to enable clearance of damaged mitochondrial fragments by mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: OPA1的蛋白水解加工由幾種粒線體蛋白酶介導，包括金屬內肽酶OMA1、ATP依賴性鋅金屬蛋白酶YME1L1、菱形蛋白酶PARL、paraplegin和mAAA蛋白酶複合物。在粒線體去極化等壓力條件下，OPA1的S1位點被YME1L1或OMA1裂解以產生短形式S-OPA1，該形式缺乏膜錨定但可通過與膜結合的L-OPA1形成複合物來調節融合。DRP1介導的鋅流入基質導致膜去極化，引起OMA1激活和OPA1失活，從而通過線粒體自噬清除受損的粒線體片段。

label: Schizophrenia
description: Prefrontal dopamine dysregulation is central to schizophrenia, manifesting as hypofrontality and working-memory deficits. Because COMT activity is the dominant determinant of PFC dopamine, COMT genotype contributes to this dysfunction. This makes the prefrontal cortex a key site in schizophrenia pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉多巴胺失調是精神分裂症的核心，表現為前額葉功能低下和工作記憶缺陷。由於 COMT activity 是 PFC 多巴胺的主要決定因素，COMT genotype 促成這種功能障礙。這使前額葉皮質成為精神分裂症病理生理學的關鍵部位。

label: NMRK2
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

label: H3K27me3
description: H3K4me3 and the repressive H3K27me3 reshape the promoter landscape in senescence, co-localizing in 'mesas' while H3K27me3 is depleted from 'canyons'. These bivalent states define transcriptional poise.
description_zh_TW: H3K4me3 與抑制性 H3K27me3 在衰老中重塑啟動子景觀，在「mesas」中共定位，而 H3K27me3 在「canyons」中被耗竭。這些雙價狀態定義轉錄準備狀態。

label: Microglia
description: Iba1 is the standard immunohistochemical marker for microglia in the central nervous system. Its expression increases with microglial activation, and Iba1 immunostaining reveals microgliosis in neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation.
description_zh_TW: Iba1 是中樞神經系統微膠質細胞的標準免疫組織化學標記。其表現隨微膠質活化而增加，Iba1 免疫染色揭示神經退化與神經發炎中的微膠質增生。

label: METTL3
description: METTL3, the catalytic subunit of the m6A methyltransferase complex, methylates TFEB mRNA at N6-methyladenosine residues, a mark that targets the transcript for destabilization and degradation. By reducing TFEB mRNA stability, METTL3 negatively regulates TFEB protein abundance and consequently the autophagy-lysosomal program. This epitranscriptomic control links RNA methylation to degradative pathway output. The finding situates TFEB within the expanding regulatory influence of m6A modification on stress-response genes.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體的催化次單元，於 N6-甲基腺苷殘基甲基化 TFEB mRNA，此標記將轉錄本標定為不穩定和降解。透過降低 TFEB mRNA 穩定性，METTL3 負向調節 TFEB 蛋白豐度，進而影響自噬—溶酶體程序。此表觀轉錄組控制將 RNA 甲基化連結到降解途徑的輸出。此發現將 TFEB 置於 m6A 修飾對壓力反應基因日益擴大的調節影響中。

label: Fucoidan
description: SIRT6-activating fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged wild-type mice, confirming in vivo geroprotection. Directionally, fucoidan sits upstream of improved survival and function. This mirrors the longevity association of centenarian SIRT6 variants and positions fucoidan as a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention. The benefit in naturally aged mice suggests that SIRT6 activation can counteract age-related decline even when initiated late in life. Fucoidan's dual activation of SIRT6 protein and ADP-ribosyltransferase activity is thought to mediate its healthspan effects.
description_zh_TW: 活化 SIRT6 的 fucoidan 延長老年野生型小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，確認了體內抗衰老保護。在方向性上，fucoidan 位於改善存活和功能的上游。這反映了百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體的長壽關聯，將 fucoidan 定位為天然的 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。在自然衰老小鼠中的益處表明，即使在生命後期才開始 SIRT6 活化也能對抗年齡相關退化。Fucoidan 對 SIRT6 蛋白和 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性的雙重活化被認為是其健康壽命效應的介導機制。

label: CD36 Receptor
description: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

label: TAK1
description: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol is a selective inhibitor of TAK1 (MAP3K7) used to probe the ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis that orchestrates SASP development after DNA damage. By restraining TAK1 activity it suppresses downstream p38 MAPK and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement that supports persistent SASP signaling.
description_zh_TW: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol 是 TAK1（MAP3K7）的選擇性抑制劑，用於探討 DNA 損傷後調控 SASP 發展的 ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸。透過抑制 TAK1 活性，它可壓制支撐持續 SASP 訊號的下游 p38 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與。

label: Dietary AGEs
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: It was estimated using an AGE-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay that approximately 10% of ingested immunoreactive advanced glycation end products are transported into the circulation, two-thirds of which remain in the body and are incorporated covalently into tissues, while only one-third is excreted via the kidneys. Dietary intake is therefore an important contributor to the body's AGE pool, and studies in healthy subjects, diabetic patients, and renal failure patients have found significant correlations between ingested AGEs and plasma AGE levels. Restricting dietary AGEs reduces circulating AGE concentrations, supporting the view that diet modulates systemic glycation burden.
description_zh_TW: 使用 AGE 專一的酵素連結免疫吸附分析法（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay）估計，約 10% 攝入的免疫反應性晚期糖化終產物被運輸進入循環，其中三分之二留在體內並共價地併入組織，僅三分之一經由腎臟排泄。因此，飲食攝取是身體 AGE 庫的重要貢獻者，且在健康受試者、糖尿病患者與腎衰竭患者中的研究發現攝入 AGE 與血漿 AGE 濃度之間有顯著相關。限制飲食中的 AGE 可降低循環 AGE 濃度，支持飲食會調節全身性糖化負擔的觀點。

label: Neuron
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: MAP2 (microtubule-associated protein 2) is a high-molecular-weight protein abundant in neuronal dendrites that binds and stabilizes microtubules. MAP2 immunostaining is widely used as a dendritic marker to assess neuronal integrity and preservation.
description_zh_TW: MAP2（微管相關蛋白 2）是豐富存在於神經元樹突的高分子量蛋白，結合並穩定微管。MAP2 免疫染色被廣泛用作樹突標記，以評估神經元完整性與保存。

label: Mitokines
description: Mitokines are soluble factors secreted by cells undergoing mitochondrial stress that trigger stress responses in distal tissues or organs. They represent a form of cell non-autonomous, inter-organ signaling that extends longevity effects across the organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體動素（mitokines）是承受粒線體壓力的細胞分泌的可溶性因子，可在遠端組織或器官觸發壓力反應。它們代表一種細胞非自主、器官間訊號形式，將長壽效應擴展至整個生物體。

label: Hippocampus
description: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

label: EGCG
description: Although animal and cell studies show EGCG to be an inhibitor of COMT, studies in humans give a different result. A study involving people with both fast and slow COMT variants showed that 750 mg of supplemental EGCG did not impair COMT activity. Research does show that people with slow COMT break down EGCG more slowly than people with fast COMT.
description_zh_TW: 雖然動物和細胞研究顯示 EGCG 是 COMT 的抑制劑，但人體研究給出不同的結果。一項涉及快速和緩慢 COMT 變異個體的研究顯示，750 毫克的補充 EGCG 不會損害 COMT activity。研究確實顯示緩慢 COMT 個體分解 EGCG 的速度比快速 COMT 個體慢。

label: Cerebellum
description: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
description_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

label: Cigarette Smoke
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Exposure to cigarette-smoke extract disrupts the SIRT1–RelA/p65 complex, diminishing deacetylation of RelA and leaving NF-κB in a more active, pro-inflammatory state. The consequence is heightened expression of inflammatory mediators in airway and other cells exposed to smoke. The directionality is that the environmental insult (smoke) reduces a protective protein–protein interaction, increasing inflammation. This provides a mechanistic link between smoking, impaired sirtuin function, and chronic inflammatory lung disease.
description_zh_TW: 暴露於香菸煙霧提取物會破壞 SIRT1–RelA/p65 複合體，削弱 RelA 的去乙醯化，使 NF-κB 處於更活躍的促發炎狀態。後果是在氣道和其他暴露於煙霧的細胞中發炎介質的表達增高。其方向性為：環境損害（煙霧）降低了一個保護性的蛋白-蛋白相互作用，增加發炎。這提供了吸煙、sirtuin 功能受損和慢性發炎性肺病之間的機制性聯繫。

label: Methylation
description: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

label: Glutamate-gated Cl- channels
description: Avermectins are allosteric potentiators/agonists of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls); Cl- influx hyperpolarizes and paralyzes parasites.
description_zh_TW: 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯離子通道 (GluCls) 的變構增強劑/激動劑； Cl-流入使寄生蟲超極化並麻痺。

label: Klf4
description: Klf4 promotes the mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition that is required for cellular reprogramming to pluripotency. Together with Oct4 and Sox2, Klf4 represses EMT-inducing transcription factors such as Snail and Slug and suppresses TGF-beta signaling, allowing the re-expression of epithelial genes such as E-cadherin, EpCAM, and occludin. This MET-promoting activity is essential for converting fibroblasts into induced pluripotent stem cells, and Klf4's epithelializing function underlies its requirement among the Yamanaka factors.
description_zh_TW: Klf4 促進細胞重編程為多能性所需的間質到上皮的轉變。 Klf4 與 Oct4 和 Sox2 一起抑制 EMT 誘導轉錄因子（如 Snail 和 Slug），並抑制 TGF-β 訊號傳導，讓上皮基因（如 E-鈣黏蛋白、EpCAM 和 occludin）重新表達。這種 MET 促進活性對於將纖維母細胞轉化為誘導多能幹細胞至關重要，而 Klf4 的上皮化功能是其在山中因子中的要求的基礎。

label: PPARγ
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A modulates the activity of peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ), a crucial transcription factor involved in adipocyte differentiation, glucose metabolism, and cholesterol metabolism. Studies indicate that urolithin A can increase the expression of PPARγ and the transcription of its downstream target genes, thereby promoting fatty acid oxidation, improving insulin sensitivity, and reducing cholesterol synthesis and absorption. These metabolic regulatory effects position PPARγ signaling as a mediator of urolithin A's influence on energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 調節 peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) 的活性，這是參與脂肪細胞分化、葡萄糖代謝與膽固醇代謝的重要轉錄因子。研究指出 urolithin A 可提升 PPARγ 的表現及其下游標的基因轉錄，從而促進脂肪酸氧化、改善胰島素敏感性，並降低膽固醇合成與吸收。這些代謝調節效應使 PPARγ 訊號成為 urolithin A 影響能量代謝的中介者。

label: Neutrophils
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Neutrophils are white blood cells that generate large quantities of reactive oxygen species, primarily superoxide anion and hydroxyl radicals, during the respiratory burst that accompanies infection and inflammation. This burst is the basis of their microbicidal activity but also mediates non-specific oxidation reactions, including the conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome both intracellularly and extracellularly. Neutrophil-derived oxidants also include hydrogen peroxide and products of myeloperoxidase. In the lungs and other tissues flooded by neutrophils during conditions such as pneumonia, ARDS, COPD exacerbations, and acute lung injury, this ROS production makes epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation a prominent local reaction.
description_zh_TW: 中性球是在感染與發炎伴隨的呼吸爆發期間產生大量活性氧物種（主要為超氧陰離子與羥基自由基）的白血球。此爆發是其殺微生物活性的基礎，但也介導非特異性氧化反應，包括在細胞內與細胞外將 epinephrine 轉化為 adrenochrome。中性球衍生的氧化劑也包括過氧化氫與 myeloperoxidase 的產物。在肺炎、ARDS、COPD 急性惡化與急性肺損傷等情況下被中性球淹沒的肺部與其他組織中，此 ROS 產生使 epinephrine 至 adrenochrome 的氧化成為顯著的局部反應。

label: Bak
description: Bcl-2 family includes Bak. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bcl-2 family 包括 Bak。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: TNFα
description: SIRT6 promotes secretion of the pro-inflammatory cytokine TNF-alpha via deacylation of a target, distinct from its anti-inflammatory chromatin roles; this illustrates that SIRT6 can both stimulate and suppress inflammatory outputs depending on substrate and context. Directionally, SIRT6 promotes TNF-alpha secretion through a specific substrate. This context-dependence is a defining feature of SIRT6 biology, and it cautions against simple interpretations of SIRT6 as purely anti-inflammatory. By understanding when SIRT6 promotes versus suppresses inflammation, researchers can better predict the effects of SIRT6-targeted therapies.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過去醯基化一個目標分子促進促發炎細胞因子TNF-alpha的分泌，這與其抗發炎的染色質作用不同；這說明SIRT6可以根據底物和環境刺激或抑制發炎輸出。方向上，SIRT6透過特定底物促進TNF-alpha分泌。這種環境依賴性是SIRT6生物學的一個定義性特徵，它提醒不要將SIRT6簡單地詮釋為純粹的抗發炎因子。透過了解SIRT6何時促進或抑制發炎，研究人員可以更好地預測SIRT6靶向療法的效果。

label: CCL20
description: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
description_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

label: Necroptosis
description: c-FLIP heterodimerizes with caspase-8 and, in its long isoform (c-FLIPL), preserves just enough caspase-8 catalytic activity to cleave and inactivate RIPK1 and RIPK3 — the necrosome substrates — thereby suppressing necroptosis while blunting apoptosis. When caspase-8/c-FLIP activity drops below that threshold (z-VAD-FMK, viral c-FLIP mimetics, high RIPK3 expression), TNF signaling flips to necroptosis. The short isoform c-FLIPS blocks caspase-8 more completely while enhancing complex II assembly, promoting necroptosis instead.
description_zh_TW: c-FLIP 會與 caspase-8 形成異源二聚體；其長型（c-FLIPL）保留剛好足夠的 caspase-8 催化活性去切割並使 RIPK1 與 RIPK3——即 necrosome 的受質——失活，從而在減弱細胞凋亡的同時抑制程序性壞死。當 caspase-8/c-FLIP 活性低於此門檻（z-VAD-FMK、病毒型 c-FLIP 擬似劑、高 RIPK3 表達）時，TNF 訊號便翻轉為程序性壞死。短型 c-FLIPS 對 caspase-8 的阻斷更完全，且會促進 complex II 組裝，反而促進程序性壞死。

label: COPD
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: SIRT3 is critical in maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis and counteracting oxidative stress in COPD, where the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 pathway is pivotal for mitochondrial biogenesis and redox equilibrium. SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates alveolar destruction, increases airway inflammation, and accelerates pulmonary function decline; miR-494-3p targeting of SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells accelerates senescence contributing to COPD pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 COPD 中對維護粒線體恆定和對抗氧化壓力至關重要，其中 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 途徑對於粒線體生成和氧化還原平衡至關重要。SIRT3 缺乏加劇肺泡破壞、增加氣道發炎並加速肺功能衰退；miR-494-3p 在小氣道上皮細胞中靶向 SIRT3 加速衰老，促進 COPD 病理生理學。

label: Paclitaxel
description: In breast tumor cell lines where SIRT1 is primarily cytoplasmic, SIRT1 inhibition causes rapid caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta dissociation and markedly enhances paclitaxel sensitivity. This is therapeutically relevant during mitotic arrest when transcription is not ongoing.
description_zh_TW: 在 SIRT1 主要位於細胞質的乳腺腫瘤細胞系中，抑制 SIRT1 會導致快速的 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 解離，並顯著增強對太平洋紫杉醇（paclitaxel）的敏感性。這在有絲分裂停滯、轉錄不進行時具有治療相關性。

label: FL118
description: FL118 is a second-generation camptothecin analog that traps the covalent TOP1-DNA cleavage complex, preventing religation of single-strand breaks. Collision of the trapped complex with replicating DNA polymerases converts these breaks into lethal double-strand breaks.
description_zh_TW: FL118 是第二代喜樹鹼類似物，會捕獲共價的 TOP1-DNA 切割複合體，阻止單股斷裂的重新連結。被捕獲複合體與複製中的 DNA 聚合酶碰撞，會將這些斷裂轉化為致命的雙股斷裂。

label: PARP
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide (NAM), the amide form of vitamin B3 and a product released from NAD+-consuming reactions, inhibits PARP activity while being effective at increasing NAD+ levels in tissues. At high doses, NAM is metabolized by nicotinamide N-methyltransferase into N1-methylnicotinamide for urinary elimination, which can progressively lower the cellular methyl pool, potentially reducing DNA and protein methylation and altering gene expression and protein activity. This dual role as both NAD+ precursor and PARP/sirtuin inhibitor distinguishes NAM from NMN and NR, which elevate NAD+ without this inhibitory action, and may explain differences in their metabolic outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺（NAM）是維生素 B3 的醯胺形式，也是 NAD+ 消耗反應釋放的產物，它在有效提升組織 NAD+ 水平的同時抑制 PARP 活性。在高劑量下，NAM 被菸鹼醯胺 N-甲基轉移酶代謝為 N1-甲基菸鹼醯胺以經尿液排出，這可能逐步降低細胞甲基池，潛在減少 DNA 與蛋白質甲基化並改變基因表現與蛋白質活性。這種同時作為 NAD+ 前驅物與 PARP/去乙醯酶抑制劑的雙重角色，使 NAM 有別於 NMN 和 NR——後者提升 NAD+ 而不具此抑制作用，並可能解釋其代謝結果的差異。

label: Pyroptosis
description: Gasdermin E (GSDME, formerly DFNA5) is cleaved by executioner caspase-3, releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain. In GSDME-high cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 converts the death program from quiet apoptosis into lytic, inflammatory pyroptosis; in GSDME-low settings GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3. PINK1-mediated mitophagy suppresses caspase-3/GSDME-dependent pyroptosis in postoperative cognitive dysfunction, tying mitophagy competence to which death modality prevails.
description_zh_TW: Gasdermin E（GSDME，舊稱 DFNA5）會被執行者 Caspase-3 切割，釋出其成孔的 N 端片段。在 GSDME 高表達的細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 會將死亡程序由安靜的細胞凋亡轉為裂解性、發炎性的焦亡；在 GSDME 低表達時，GSDME 反而位於 Caspase-3 的上游。PINK1 介導的粒線體自噬會抑制術後認知功能障礙中 Caspase-3/GSDME 依賴的焦亡，將粒線體自噬能力與何種死亡模式勝出連結起來。

label: Catecholamines
description: Neurotransmitters are endogenous chemical messengers that relay signals between neurons, and the catecholamines dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine are paramount in neuromelanin research. Their oxidative metabolism generates the aminochromes that polymerize into neuromelanin.
description_zh_TW: 神經傳導物質是神經元間傳遞訊號的內源性化學信使，而兒茶酚胺（dopamine、norepinephrine、epinephrine）在 neuromelanin 研究中至關重要。其氧化代謝產生聚合為 neuromelanin 的 aminochrome。

label: Working Memory
description: The prefrontal cortex controls working memory by maintaining and manipulating information online through sustained firing of pyramidal networks, a process tightly gated by dopamine D1 receptor signaling. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that determines working memory capacity, making this region exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Genotype-dependent COMT activity is therefore a major modulator of this function. The region is the primary substrate of working memory in humans.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過錐體網路的持續放電來在線上維護和操作訊息，從而控制工作記憶，這個過程受到多巴胺 D1 receptor 訊號的嚴格控制。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了決定工作記憶容量的多巴胺基調，使該區域對 COMT genotype 極為敏感。因此，基因型依賴性 COMT activity 是此功能的主要調節劑。此區域是人類工作記憶的主要基質。

label: MLKL
description: RIPK3 phosphorylates MLKL on its activation loop (human Thr357/Ser358), exposing the N-terminal four-helix bundle that executes necroptosis. This phosphorylation is the final licensure step of the necrosome cascade: without it MLKL stays monomeric and inert. Phosphorylated MLKL then oligomerizes and traffics to the plasma membrane, where its four-helix bundles form cation channels. MLKL is a pseudokinase — it binds ATP but does not hydrolyze it — so its function is structural membrane disruption rather than signaling.
description_zh_TW: RIPK3 會將 MLKL 的活化環（人類 Thr357/Ser358）磷酸化，暴露出執行程序性壞死的 N 端四螺旋束。此磷酸化是 necrosome 級聯的最終許可步驟：缺少它時 MLKL 保持單體且不活化。磷酸化的 MLKL 隨後寡聚化並轉位至細胞膜，其四螺旋束在此形成陽離子通道。MLKL 是一種偽激酶——會結合 ATP 但不水解——因此其功能是結構性的膜破壞而非訊號傳遞。

label: Dicarbonyls
description: Aminoguanidine is an AGE inhibitor that acts as a carbonyl trap, interacting with highly reactive carbonyl species and preventing them from reacting with proteins. These reactive carbonyls include dicarbonyls such as methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which are key intermediates in AGE formation. By trapping these dicarbonyl species, aminoguanidine blocks AGE accumulation and the downstream glycation damage. This mechanism is shared with other AGE inhibitors such as pyridoxamine, and underpins aminoguanidine's ability to prevent diabetic complications in animal models.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是一種 AGE inhibitor，作為 carbonyl trap，與 highly reactive carbonyl species 交互作用並防止其與蛋白質反應。這些 reactive carbonyls 包括 methylglyoxal、glyoxal 與 3-deoxyglucosone 等 dicarbonyls，它們是 AGE formation 的關鍵 intermediates。透過 trapping 這些 dicarbonyl species，aminoguanidine 阻斷 AGE accumulation 與 downstream glycation damage。此 mechanism 與 pyridoxamine 等其他 AGE inhibitors 共享，並構成 aminoguanidine 在 animal models 中預防 diabetic complications 能力的基礎。

label: ACSL4
description: ACSL4 is a canonical positive regulator of ferroptosis. By charging long-chain PUFAs (e.g., arachidonic acid) to their acyl-CoA thioesters for re-esterification into membrane phospholipids (Lands cycle), ACSL4 enriches the sn-2 position of phosphatidylethanolamines with oxidizable PUFAs — the direct substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACSL4 overexpression raises ferroptosis sensitivity; knockdown protects against RSL3/GPX4 inhibition.
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 是鐵死亡的典型正向調節因子。它將長鏈 PUFA（如花生四烯酸）活化為其醯基-CoA 硫酯，重新酯化進膜磷脂（Lands cycle），使磷脂醯乙醇胺的 sn-2 位置富含可氧化的 PUFA——也就是脂質過氧化的直接受質。ACSL4 過表現會提高鐵死亡敏感性；敲低則能抵抗 RSL3/GPX4 抑制。

label: Xanthine Oxidase
description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
description_zh_TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

label: Diabetic nephropathy
description: SIRT1 is protective in diabetic kidney disease by deacetylating p53 and activating FoxO3a and Nrf2, and resveratrol promotes resistance to diabetic renal fibrosis via Nrf2. These antioxidant and anti-apoptotic actions defend podocytes and the renal tubulointerstitium against hyperglycemic damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病腎臟疾病中具保護性，透過去乙醯化 p53 並活化 FoxO3a 與 Nrf2，且 resveratrol 透過 Nrf2 促進對糖尿病腎纖維化的抗性。這些抗氧化與抗凋亡作用防禦足細胞與腎小管間質免於高血糖損傷。

label: William C. Campbell
description: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

label: Chemoresistance
description: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

label: Cardiac Hypertrophy
description: SIRT1 has dose-dependent effects on cardiac hypertrophy: low (2.5-fold) or moderate (7.5-fold) overexpression attenuates hypertrophy, whereas high (12.5-fold) overexpression increases it. Directionally, SIRT1 expression level determines whether the outcome is protective or detrimental. This biphasic behavior explains conflicting reports in the literature on SIRT1's cardiac effects, which differ depending on the degree of overexpression studied. The finding underscores that more SIRT1 is not always better, and that therapeutic approaches must consider dosing windows.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1對心臟肥大具有劑量依賴性的效果：低（2.5倍）或中等（7.5倍）過表達可減輕肥大，而高（12.5倍）過表達則加重肥大。方向上，SIRT1表達水平決定了結果是保護性還是有害。這種雙相行為解釋了文獻中關於SIRT1心臟效果的矛盾報導，這些報導因研究的過表達程度不同而異。此發現強調更多的SIRT1並非總是更好，治療方法必須考慮劑量窗口。

label: Silver(I) Oxide
description: Silver(I) oxide is acutely toxic in animal studies, with a reported LD50 of 1027 mg/kg by the oral route in mice and 2820 mg/kg orally in rats; intraperitoneal LD50 values are 37 mg/kg in mice and 70 mg/kg in rats. The much lower intraperitoneal threshold reflects efficient absorption of silver ions directly into the circulation, whereas oral silver is less bioavailable. These data establish silver oxide as a moderate acute hazard requiring careful handling in laboratory, industrial, and battery-manufacturing settings.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)在動物研究中具有急性毒性，報導的小鼠口服LD50為1027 mg/kg，大鼠口服為2820 mg/kg；腹腔注射LD50值小鼠為37 mg/kg，大鼠為70 mg/kg。低得多的腹腔注射閾值反映了銀離子直接吸收進入循環的效率，而口服銀的生物利用度較低。這些數據將氧化銀確立為中等急性危害，需要在實驗室、工業和電池製造環境中謹慎處理。

label: ROS
description: SIRT3 inhibits ROS (e.g., p53, ROS, lipogenesis) by deacetylating upstream regulators, protecting against damage and tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過去乙醯化上游調節因子抑制 ROS（例如 p53、ROS、脂肪生成），保護免受損傷和腫瘤發生。

label: PhenoAge
description: DunedinPACE is a rate-based epigenetic estimator of the pace of aging, complementary to the level-based PhenoAge clock. Where PhenoAge estimates biological-age level, DunedinPACE estimates rate, so the two together describe both position and trajectory of aging.
description_zh_TW: DunedinPACE 是基於速率的表觀遺傳老化速度估算器，與基於水平的 PhenoAge 時鐘互補。PhenoAge 估算生物年齡水平，DunedinPACE 則估算速率，兩者共同描述老化的位置與軌跡。

label: Amadori products
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Amadori products are the stable early products of the non-enzymatic reaction between reducing sugars and protein amino groups. They undergo a variety of irreversible dehydration, oxidation, polymerization, and rearrangement reactions that lead over the course of days to weeks to the formation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). AGEs are toxic glycated adducts that accumulate in tissues during aging and in diabetic, renal, and inflammatory pathology. Because there are no enzymes in the human body to remove glycated products, the accumulation of these metabolic waste products is thought to promote organ and tissue senescence.
description_zh_TW: Amadori products 是 reducing sugars 與蛋白質 amino groups 之間非酵素反應的穩定早期產物。它們經歷多種不可逆的 dehydration、oxidation、polymerization 與 rearrangement 反應，在數天至數週的過程中導致 advanced glycation end products（AGEs）的形成。AGEs 是有毒的 glycated adducts，會在 aging 以及 diabetic、renal 與 inflammatory pathology 期間堆積於組織中。由於人體內沒有酵素可移除 glycated products，這些 metabolic waste products 的堆積被認為會促進器官與組織的 senescence。

label: melittin
description: Melittin, a component of honeybee venom, has demonstrated antitumoral effects in melanoma by inhibiting the MAPK signaling pathway. It shows higher cytotoxic potency in cancer cells than in normal cells. Melittin is therefore studied as a natural-product agent against melanoma.
description_zh_TW: Melittin 是蜂毒的一種成分，透過抑制 MAPK 訊號傳導途徑，在黑色素瘤中顯示出抗腫瘤效應。它對癌細胞的細胞毒性效力高於正常細胞。因此 Melittin 被研究作為對抗黑色素瘤的天然產物製劑。

label: HIRA
description: ASF1a is an upstream histone H3–H4 chaperone that hands off dimers to the HIRA complex for replication-independent deposition. Together with HIRA and UBN1 it is a core member of the chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是上游的組蛋白 H3–H4 伴護蛋白，將二聚體交給 HIRA 複合體進行非複製依賴的沉積。它與 HIRA 及 UBN1 同為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需的伴護蛋白複合體核心成員。

label: H3K27ac
description: ChIP-seq analysis of histone H3 acetylation at lysine 27 (H3K27ac) showed that loci gaining acetylation during senescence are markedly reduced following mitochondrial clearance, and these regions are enriched for inflammatory and interleukin signalling pathways central to the SASP. A 51-gene SASP signature induced during senescence is suppressed upon mitochondrial removal, with genes such as IL6 and CCL2 showing coordinated decreases in chromatin acetylation and mRNA expression. Multiple nodes of the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis converge to control H3K27ac at SASP loci, selectively modulating inflammatory gene expression without affecting the senescence-associated cell cycle arrest.
description_zh_TW: 對組蛋白H3在賴氨酸27處的乙酰化（H3K27ac）的ChIP-seq分析表明，在衰老過程中獲得乙酰化的位點在線粒體清除後顯著減少，並且這些區域富含與SASP核心相關的炎症和白細胞介素信號通路。在衰老過程中誘導的51個基因的SASP特徵在線粒體移除後被抑制，IL6和CCL2等基因顯示出染色質乙酰化和mRNA表達的協調減少。線粒體枸櫞酸-乙酰輔酶A軸的多個節點匯聚以控制SASP位點的H3K27ac，選擇性地調節炎症基因表達而不影響衰老相關的細胞週期停滯。

label: Cytochrome c
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SIRT5 deacetylates cytochrome c, the mitochondrial intermembrane protein central to oxidative metabolism and apoptosis initiation. SIRT5 overexpression ameliorates cytochrome c leakage into the cytoplasm and the resulting caspase-3 activation, alleviating apoptosis. Together with SIRT4's restraint of procaspase processing, this places the mitochondrial sirtuins directly on the cytochrome c/apoptosome entry point of the caspase cascade rather than only on transcriptional or redox arms.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 會去乙醯化 cytochrome c——這個位於粒線體膜間腔、對氧化代謝與細胞凋亡起始至關重要的蛋白。SIRT5 的過表達能改善 cytochrome c 洩漏至細胞質及其後續的 Caspase-3 活化，從而減輕細胞凋亡。與 SIRT4 對 pro-caspase 加工的抑制並列，這使粒線體 sirtuins 不只作用於轉錄或氧化還原臂，而是直接作用於 caspase 級聯的 cytochrome c/凋亡體入口。

label: Epigenetics
description: Epigenetic dysregulation underlies cancer through silencing of tumor suppressors and global hypomethylation. Promoter hypermethylation silences genes that restrain proliferation, while global loss of methylation destabilizes the genome and activates transposable elements, and aberrant histone modifications reinforce these changes. These epigenetic alterations cooperate with genetic mutations to drive tumorigenesis and provide therapeutic targets for epigenetic drugs such as DNA methyltransferase inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳失調透過腫瘤抑制因子的沉默和整體低甲基化而成為癌症的基礎。啟動子高甲基化會沉默抑制增殖的基因，而甲基化的整體喪失會破壞基因組的穩定性並激活轉座元件，而異常的組蛋白修飾會強化這些變化。這些表觀遺傳學改變與基因突變共同驅動腫瘤發生，並為 DNA 甲基轉移酶抑制劑等表觀遺傳藥物提供治療標靶。

label: miR-543
description: DNA Methylation governs the expression of miR-543 through the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 cluster on chromosome 14q32 that hosts the microRNA; parent-of-origin methylation controls the locus, making miR-543 both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome and linking epigenetic drift to the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: DNA Methylation 透過位於染色體 14q32 上、帶有親源印記的 DLK1-DIO3 基因叢調控 miR-543 的表現；該基因座由親源甲基化控制，使 miR-543 既是表觀基因組的效應分子也是感應分子，並將表觀遺傳漂變與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸相連。

label: Leuco-adrenochrome
description: Leuco-adrenochrome, the reduced leuco-form of the aminochrome system, is further oxidized to form adrenochrome, a distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound whose color arises from its extended conjugated system. Adrenochrome is the classic oxidation product of epinephrine studied since the 19th century. Because leuco-adrenochrome is highly unstable in the presence of oxygen and acts as a ready electron donor, this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily, which is why leuco-adrenochrome is difficult to isolate outside controlled laboratory environments and why pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations is a recognized stability problem.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome，aminochrome system 的 reduced leuco-form，is further oxidized to form adrenochrome，一種 distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound，其 color arises from its extended conjugated system。Adrenochrome 是 classic oxidation product of epinephrine，自 19th century 以來被研究。由於 leuco-adrenochrome 在 oxygen presence 下 highly unstable 且 acts as a ready electron donor，this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily，這就是為什麼 leuco-adrenochrome 在 controlled laboratory environments 外 difficult to isolate，以及 pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations 是 recognized stability problem。

label: Rectal Cancer
description: Rectal cancer is often grouped with colon cancer as colorectal cancer, but is managed distinctly due to pelvic anatomical constraints and differing treatment paradigms. Rectal cancer exhibits a higher propensity for locoregional recurrence while colon cancer more often recurs distantly. They are neighboring entities along the colorectal continuum with distinct biology.
description_zh_TW: 直腸癌常與結腸癌合稱為結直腸癌，但因骨盆解剖限制與不同的治療模式而治療方式不同。直腸癌具有較高的局部區域復發傾向，而結腸癌較常在遠端復發。它們是結直腸連續體上相鄰但生物學不同的實體。

label: ATP
description: Sympathetic nerve endings co-release ATP as a cotransmitter alongside norepinephrine, particularly at higher stimulation frequencies. Along with neuropeptide Y, ATP augments and prolongs the vasoconstrictor response. The contribution of ATP to sympathetic signaling depends on firing frequency and the target organ.
description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 與 norepinephrine 一起共同釋放 ATP 作為共遞質，尤其是在較高的刺激頻率下。與 neuropeptide Y 一起，ATP 增強並延長血管收縮反應。ATP 對交感神經訊號的貢獻取決於放電頻率與靶器官。

label: Splitomicin
description: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

label: PPARα
description: SIRT4 represses signaling by the nuclear receptor PPARalpha and destabilizes the mitochondrial trifunctional protein alpha (MTPalpha) subunit in hepatocytes. Together these actions shift liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid oxidation and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty-acid utilization, positioning it as a metabolic brake that opposes the fatty-acid-catabolic programs promoted by SIRT3 and SIRT5. In nutrient-replete conditions this restrains wasteful fat burning, but under energetic stress it can limit the capacity to oxidize fatty acids, and this SIRT3/SIRT4 balance governs mitochondrial fuel choice.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4抑制核受體PPARalpha的訊號並在肝細胞中使粒線體三功能蛋白α（MTPalpha）亞基不穩定。這些作用共同將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸氧化轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸利用抑制的上游，將其定位為與SIRT3和SIRT5促進的脂肪酸分解程序相對抗的代謝制動器。在營養充足條件下，這限制了浪費性的脂肪燃燒，但在能量壓力下，它可能限制氧化脂肪酸的能力，這種SIRT3/SIRT4平衡控制粒線體燃料選擇。

label: PI3K
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Urolithin A regulates protein synthesis and growth of muscle cells by inhibiting specific regulatory factors within the mTOR signaling pathway, such as PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase) and AKT (protein kinase B). The literature demonstrates that urolithin A inhibits mTOR by first inhibiting PI3K and then AKT. Downregulation of PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling underlies several of urolithin A's reported anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and pro-autophagic effects, and it supports muscle growth while maintaining muscle quality.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過抑制 mTOR 訊息傳遞路徑中的特定調節因子（如 PI3K (phosphoinositide 3-kinase) 與 AKT (protein kinase B)）來調節肌肉細胞的蛋白質合成與生長。文獻顯示 urolithin A 先抑制 PI3K 再抑制 AKT，從而抑制 mTOR。PI3K-AKT-mTOR 訊號的下調，是 urolithin A 被報導的數項抗發炎、代謝與促自噬效應的基礎，並在維持肌肉品質的同時支持肌肉生長。

label: DNMT3a
description: Recurrent mutations in the DNA methyltransferase DNMT3a occur in approximately 20% of acute myeloid leukemia cases, with the R882H hotspot most frequent. These mutations reduce methyltransferase activity and disrupt DNA methylation at regulatory regions controlling stem cell behavior. This epigenetic dysregulation cooperates with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基轉移酶 DNMT3a 的反覆突變發生在約 20% 的急性骨髓性白血病病例中，其中 R882H 熱點最常見。這些突變降低甲基轉移酶活性，並擾亂控制幹細胞行為的調控區域之 DNA 甲基化。這種表觀遺傳失調與其他突變合作驅動白血病發生。

label: LINE-1
description: SADS connects to retrotransposon and LINE-1 activation, as satellite-repeat derepression in senescence permits mobilization of normally silenced repetitive elements. Derepressed LINE-1 generates cytoplasmic cDNA that fuels cGAS-STING signaling and the SASP, linking constitutive heterochromatin relaxation to innate immune activation. This connection positions SADS within the broader chromatin-immune axis of senescence, where loss of heterochromatin integrity amplifies inflammation. It is a newer, moderate-confidence mechanism in the senescence field.
description_zh_TW: SADS 連結到逆轉錄轉座子與 LINE-1 活化，因衰老中的衛星重複去抑制允許 normally 靜默的重複元件移動。去抑制的 LINE-1 產生胞質 cDNA 助長 cGAS-STING 訊號與 SASP，將組成性異染色質鬆弛連結到先天免疫活化。此連結將 SADS 定位於衰老更廣的染色質—免疫軸中，其中異染色質完整性喪失放大發炎。它是該領域較新、中等信度的機制。

label: ICE Mouse
description: Double-strand-break induction in the ICE Mouse shifts the epigenetic (DNA-methylation) clock, consistent with chromatin modifiers such as SIRT1 relocalizing away from native sites during repair. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of clock acceleration. This provides a quantitative readout of epigenetic drift, and it links the RCM model to measurable aging biomarkers. By demonstrating that DNA damage alone can advance the epigenetic clock, the ICE Mouse connects the loss of epigenetic information to the rate of aging. This finding supports the use of DNA-methylation clocks as indicators of biological age.
description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中的雙鏈斷裂誘導改變了表觀遺傳（DNA 甲基化）時鐘，與染色質修飾因子如 SIRT1 在修復期間從原始位點重新定位一致。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於時鐘加速的上游。這提供了表觀遺傳漂變的量化讀數，並將 RCM 模型與可測量的衰老生物標誌物聯繫起來。透過證明僅 DNA 損傷就能推進表觀遺傳時鐘，ICE 小鼠將表觀遺傳資訊的喪失與衰老速率聯繫起來。此發現支持使用 DNA 甲基化時鐘作為生物年齡的指標。

label: SMAD3
description: SIRT7 directly deacetylates SMAD3, reducing its transcriptional activity and pro-fibrotic output downstream of TGF-β1. Directionally, SIRT7 enzymatically inhibits SMAD3. This reveals an antifibrotic, deacetylation-based action of SIRT7 that can oppose TGF-β1 signaling, adding nuance to SIRT7's otherwise sometimes profibrotic cardiac role. The same sirtuin can therefore both promote and suppress fibrosis depending on the signaling context and its state of phosphorylation. By directly modifying SMAD3, SIRT7 provides a molecular brake on TGF-β-driven matrix production in specific settings.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 直接去乙醯化 SMAD3，降低其轉錄活性和 TGF-β1 下游的促纖維化輸出。在方向性上，SIRT7 以酶性方式抑制 SMAD3。這揭示了 SIRT7 的一種基於去乙醯化的抗纖維化作用，可以對抗 TGF-β1 訊號，為 SIRT7 在其他方面有時具促纖維化作用的心臟角色增添了細微差別。因此同一 sirtuin 可以根據訊號情境和磷酸化狀態既促進又抑制纖維化。透過直接修飾 SMAD3，SIRT7 在特定情況下為 TGF-β 驅動的基質產生提供分子制動器。

label: Chromatin
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Chromatin is composed of nucleosomes, the repeating structural units that package the genome within the nucleus. Each nucleosome consists of a histone octamer, with two copies each of H2A, H2B, H3, and H4, wrapped by approximately 147 base pairs of DNA. Nucleosomes are arranged along the DNA in a beads-on-a-string fashion and further compact into higher-order fibers, with their positioning and modification determining whether underlying DNA is accessible for transcription, replication, and repair.
description_zh_TW: Chromatin 由核小體組成，核小體是將基因組包裝在細胞核內的重複結構單元。每個核小體由一個組蛋白八聚體組成，其中 H2A、H2B、H3 和 H4 各有兩個拷貝，由大約 147 個鹼基對的 DNA 包裹。核小體以串珠的方式沿著 DNA 排列，並進一步壓縮成高級纖維，其定位和修飾決定了底層 DNA 是否可用於轉錄、複製和修復。

label: GPX4
description: FSP1 and GPX4 guard the same outcome — suppression of lethal lipid peroxidation — through independent chemistries and cofactor requirements. GPX4 is GSH/selenium-dependent and repairs existing phospholipid hydroperoxides; FSP1 is GSH-independent and maintains a preventive radical trap. Loss of either axis alone is survivable if the other is intact, so combined inhibition (e.g., iFSP1 + a GPX4 inhibitor) is strongly synergistic. || GPX4 and FSP1 both suppress lethal lipid peroxidation but via independent chemistries: GPX4 is GSH/selenium-dependent and repairs existing phospholipid hydroperoxides, whereas FSP1 is GSH-independent and maintains a preventive ubiquinol radical trap. Loss of either axis alone is tolerable if the other is intact, so combined inhibition is strongly synergistic.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 與 GPX4 守護同一結果——抑制致死的脂質過氧化——但透過各自獨立的化學機制與輔因子需求。GPX4 依賴 GSH/硒並修復既有的磷脂氫過氧化物；FSP1 不依賴 GSH 並維持預防性的自由基陷阱。只要另一軸完整，單獨喪失任一軸都可存活，因此同時抑制兩者（例如 iFSP1 加上 GPX4 抑制劑）具有強烈協同效應。 || GPX4 與 FSP1 都抑制致死的脂質過氧化，但機制各自獨立：GPX4 依賴 GSH/硒並修復既有的磷脂氫過氧化物，而 FSP1 不依賴 GSH 並維持預防性的泛醇自由基陷阱。只要另一軸完整，單獨喪失任一軸都可耐受，因此同時抑制兩者具有強烈協同效應。

label: Intermittent Fasting
description: Fasting-driven energy deficit activates AMPK, which in turn activates TFEB → lysosomal biogenesis → autophagy and mitochondrial quality control — the hormetic engine linking fasting, mitohormesis and caloric restriction to longevity (2026 Frontiers in Nutrition framing of intermittent fasting as a hormetic signal).
description_zh_TW: 禁食造成的能量赤字活化 AMPK，AMPK 再活化 TFEB → 溶酶體新生 → 自噬與粒線體品質控管——這是連結禁食、mitohormesis 與熱量限制到延壽的荷爾蒙引擎（2026 Frontiers in Nutrition 將間歇性禁食框架為荷爾蒙訊號）。

label: Incoherent Bivalent Motif
description: The saturated enzymatic regime describes an interaction operating near its maximal velocity where the reaction rate is insensitive to substrate changes. When the backward link of an incoherent bivalent motif is deeply saturated, the fraction of parameter sets producing hormesis rises sharply.
description_zh_TW: 飽和酶學機制描述接近最大速度運作、反應速率對受質變化不敏感的交互作用。當不一致雙價模體的逆向連結深度飽和時，產生毒物興奮的參數組比例急遽上升。

label: Nigrostriatal System
description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: ATM
description: ATM phosphorylates TRIM28/KAP1 at Ser824 in response to DNA double-strand breaks (and also during mitosis), a modification that relaxes chromatin and licenses the DDR functions of KAP1. In the SIRT1-stability axis, ATM activity restrains SIRT1 destruction: the ATM inhibitor KU-55933 lowered pATM(Ser1981) and pKAP1(Ser824), accelerated SIRT1 cleavage and degradation, and increased cell death — effects that were absent in TRIM28-knockout cells, establishing the ATM-TRIM28-SIRT1 signaling axis.
description_zh_TW: ATM 會在 DNA 雙股斷裂時（有絲分裂期間亦然）將 TRIM28/KAP1 的 Ser824 磷酸化，此修飾可鬆弛染色質並賦予 KAP1 在 DNA 損傷反應中的功能。在 SIRT1 穩定性軸線中，ATM 活性會抑制 SIRT1 的破壞：ATM 抑制劑 KU-55933 降低了 pATM(Ser1981) 與 pKAP1(Ser824)，加速 SIRT1 的切割與降解並增加細胞死亡——這些效應在 TRIM28 基因敲除細胞中消失，確立了 ATM-TRIM28-SIRT1 訊號軸。

label: DNMT3b
description: DNMT3a forms functional complexes with its paralog DNMT3b and with the accessory protein DNMT3L to deposit methylation at targeted loci. The two de novo methyltransferases share sequence homology but exhibit distinct genomic targeting preferences, with DNMT3b favoring repetitive elements while DNMT3a acts more broadly across gene bodies and intergenic regions. Their cooperative activity is critical during early embryogenesis for establishing the genome-wide methylation patterns that are subsequently maintained by DNMT1, and both are essential for normal development.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3a 與其旁系同源物 DNMT3b 和輔助蛋白 DNMT3L 形成功能複合物，在目標位點沉積甲基化。這兩種從頭甲基轉移酶具有序列同源性，但表現出不同的基因組靶向偏好，其中 DNMT3b 有利於重複元件，而 DNMT3a 在基因體和基因間區域中發揮更廣泛的作用。它們的合作活動在早期胚胎髮生過程中對於建立隨後由 DNMT1 維持的全基因組甲基化模式至關重要，並且兩者對於正常發育都是必需的。

label: Tau
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: SIRT1 reduces O-GlcNAcylation of tau via CREB in Alzheimer's disease, and SIRT3 plays a role in tau acetylation as a potential therapy target. SIRT2 affects tau phosphorylation and autophagic flux, and nuclear SIRT2 is hyperactivated in AD where FoxO1 recruits it to Fzd1/Fzd7 promoters to reduce H4K16ac.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在阿茲海默症中透過 CREB 減少 tau 的 O-GlcNAcylation，且 SIRT3 在 tau 乙醯化中扮演角色，作為潛在治療標的。SIRT2 影響 tau 磷酸化與自噬流，核 SIRT2 在 AD 中過度活化，其中 FoxO1 將其招募至 Fzd1/Fzd7 啟動子以降低 H4K16ac。

label: Noncanonical Inflammasome
description: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

label: Super-enhancer
description: Many SASP-associated genes are linked to super-enhancer-like regions that are particularly sensitive to changes in histone acetylation, and such loci probably require sustained acetyl-CoA availability to maintain high transcriptional output, rendering them especially vulnerable to interventions that limit acetyl-CoA supply. SLC25A1 inhibition reduces chromatin accessibility at these SASP loci both in vitro and in vivo, selectively suppressing inflammatory gene expression. This positions mitochondrial metabolism as an upstream determinant of chromatin accessibility in senescent cells, aligning with previous reports linking citrate metabolism to SASP regulation.
description_zh_TW: 許多與SASP相關的基因與超增強子樣區域相關，這些區域對組蛋白乙酰化變化特別敏感，並且這些位點可能需要持續的乙酰輔酶A可用性來維持高轉錄輸出，使其特別容易受到限制乙酰輔酶A供應的干預措施的影響。SLC25A1抑製在體外和體內都減少了這些SASP位點的染色質可及性，選擇性地抑制炎症基因表達。這將線粒體代謝定位為衰老細胞中染色質可及性的上游決定因素，與先前將枸櫞酸代謝與SASP調節相關聯的報告一致。

label: IL-1α
description: DOT1L modulates the SASP through epigenetic regulation of IL-1alpha: DOT1L controls IL-1alpha expression, a key upstream cytokine of the SASP. Depletion or inhibition of DOT1L reduces SASP while sparing the growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: DOT1L 透過對 IL-1α 的表觀遺傳調控來調節 SASP：DOT1L 控制 IL-1α 的表現，IL-1α 是 SASP 的關鍵上游細胞激素。DOT1L 的耗竭或抑制會減少 SASP，同時保留生長停滯。

label: Insulin Sensitivity
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: SIRT1 has a dual role in diabetes mellitus: overexpression improves insulin sensitivity while hepatic SIRT1 knockdown prevents fasting hyperglycemia by increasing hepatic insulin responsiveness. SIRT1 therefore both enhances systemic insulin action and constrains hepatic glucose output. This context-dependence is characteristic of SIRT1's master-regulator role in metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在糖尿病 mellitus 中具有雙重角色：過度表現改善胰島素敏感性，而肝 SIRT1 敲低透過增加肝臟胰島素反應性防止空腹高血糖。SIRT1 因此既增強全身性胰島素作用，又限制肝臟葡萄糖輸出。此情境依賴性是其作為代謝疾病主控調節因子的特徵。

label: Frailty
description: CTPI2, a third-generation SLC25A1 inhibitor, delays the onset of frailty in aged mice as measured by a validated 31-parameter frailty index, alongside improvements in fur condition, coordination, balance and grip strength. In aged tissues, CTPI2 suppresses SASP-associated inflammatory gene expression across skeletal muscle, liver and heart while leaving p16 and p21 unchanged, and circulating inflammatory cytokines are reduced, indicating a systemic attenuation of inflammatory burden. These benefits arise without broad metabolic reprogramming: body weight, composition, metabolic rate, respiratory exchange ratio, activity and lipid metabolic pathways are largely unaffected.
description_zh_TW: CTPI2 是第三代 SLC25A1 抑制劑，可延緩老年小鼠衰弱症的發生，此結果以經驗證的 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，同時伴隨毛皮狀況、協調性、平衡感與握力的改善。在老年組織中，CTPI2 可抑制骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中與 SASP 相關的發炎基因表現，同時不改變 p16 與 p21，且循環中的發炎細胞激素亦降低，顯示發炎負擔獲得全身性的減輕。這些效益的產生並未伴隨廣泛的代謝重編程：體重、身體組成、代謝率、呼吸交換比、活動量與脂質代謝途徑大多不受影響。

label: p16
description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: Cancer Stem Cells
description: Ivermectin preferentially targets and inhibits cancer stem cells, suppressing Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 expression through the PAK1-STAT3 axis. This kills CSCs therapeutically in breast cancer but simultaneously lowers the reprogramming factors needed for Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 優先標靶並抑制癌幹細胞，透過 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 表現。這在乳癌中治療性地殺死 CSC，但同時降低 Yamanaka 因子回春所需的重編程因子。

label: XIAP
description: XIAP, the archetypal inhibitor of apoptosis protein, binds and inhibits executioner Caspase-3 (and -7) and initiator Caspase-9; Smac/DIABLO released from mitochondria neutralizes XIAP to relieve the brake — a control layer the graph's link prediction flagged for a direct IAP-family edge.
description_zh_TW: XIAP 是凋亡抑制蛋白的典型代表，結合並抑制執行者 Caspase-3（及 -7）與起始者 Caspase-9；由粒線體釋放的 Smac/DIABLO 中和 XIAP 以鬆開煞車——圖的連結預測標記此控制層應有直接 IAP 家族邊。

label: ERK1_2
description: MKP-3 inactivates ERK by hydrolyzing the phosphothreonine and phosphotyrosine residues of its activation loop. This provides a negative feedback brake on proliferative RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling. ERK1/2 is the canonical MAPK substrate of MKP-3.
description_zh_TW: MKP-3 透過水解 ERK 激活環上的磷酸蘇氨酸與磷酸酪氨酸殘基，使 ERK 失活。這為增殖性 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK 訊號傳導提供了負回饋煞車。ERK1/2 是 MKP-3 的經典 MAPK 受質。

label: Metastasis
description: SIRT3 overexpression suppresses ovarian cancer metastasis via Twist-downregulation-driven EMT inhibition. In contrast SIRT3 promotes viability in glioma by stabilizing the Ku70-Bax interaction, and in cervical cancer it promotes invasion and metastasis by reprogramming fatty acid synthesis through ACC1 upregulation. The metastatic effect of SIRT3 is therefore tumor-type dependent.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 過度表現透過 Twist 下調驅動的 EMT 抑制，抑制卵巢癌轉移。相對地，SIRT3 在膠質瘤中透過穩定 Ku70-Bax 交互作用促進存活，而在子宮頸癌中透過 ACC1 上調重編程脂肪酸合成來促進侵犯與轉移。因此 SIRT3 的轉移效應依腫瘤類型而異。

label: Senolytic Therapy
description: SCAPs (senescence-cell anti-apoptotic pathways) are the ensemble of pro-survival mechanisms that allow senescent cells to persist despite SASP and DNA damage. Senolytic therapies kill senescent cells by targeting these anti-apoptotic pathways.
description_zh_TW: SCAPs（衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑）是讓衰老細胞儘管有 SASP 與 DNA 損傷仍能存續的促存活機制總和。Senolytic 療法透過靶向這些抗凋亡途徑殺死衰老細胞。

label: Gastric Cancer
description: SIRT6 is downregulated in gastric cancer where low expression negatively correlates with tumor size and pathological grade and predicts poor prognosis. It inhibits the JAK2/STAT3 pathway to suppress growth, and SIRT6 silencing overcomes sorafenib resistance by promoting ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 在胃癌中下調，其中低表現與腫瘤大小與病理分級負相關，並預測不良預後。它抑制 JAK2/STAT3 路徑以抑制生長，且 SIRT6 靜默透過促進鐵蛋白死亡克服 sorafenib 抗性。

label: LKB1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: LKB1, through AMPK activation, feeds back on SIRT1 via NAD+-dependent coupling (AMPK raises NAD+), but is also listed as a negative pathway regulator in Table 3: under certain conditions AMPK/LKB1 signaling opposes SIRT1-promoted anabolic programs, reflecting context-dependent cross-talk of the energy-sensing network.
description_zh_TW: LKB1 透過 AMPK 活化，透過 NAD+ 依賴性耦合對 SIRT1 進行回饋（AMPK 提高 NAD+），但也被列為通路的負向調節因子：在某些條件下，AMPK/LKB1 信號拮抗 SIRT1 促進的合成代謝程序，反映了能量感知網絡的環境依賴性交叉對話。

label: Senomorphic
description: JAK-STAT3 signaling is a major driver of the pro-inflammatory SASP, and its inhibition is a senomorphic strategy that dampens SASP while sparing the growth arrest. This makes the JAK-STAT axis a target for senomorphic interventions.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號是促發炎 SASP 的主要驅動者，其抑制是壓制 SASP 同時保留生長停滯的 senomorphic（促衰老表型調節）策略。這使 JAK-STAT 軸成為 senomorphic 介入的標靶。

label: Cognition
description: Neurogenesis is the process by which neurons are produced from neural stem and progenitor cells, persisting in adult brain regions like the hippocampus. It is regulated by exercise, caloric restriction, and BDNF, and its decline with aging is associated with cognitive decline.
description_zh_TW: 神經新生是神經元由神經幹細胞與前驅細胞產生的過程，在海馬迴等成人大腦區域持續存在。它受運動、熱量限制與 BDNF 調控，其隨衰老的下降與認知衰退相關。

label: miR-378
description: miR-378a is encoded within the first intron of the PPARGC1B gene (PGC-1beta) on chromosome 5q32. Because it sits inside the metabolic master regulator locus, its dysregulation couples mitochondrial metabolic decline with the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: miR-378a 編碼在染色體 5q32 的 PPARGC1B 基因（PGC-1beta）第一個內含子中。由於它位於代謝主調控基因座內，其失調將粒線體代謝衰退與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸耦合起來。

label: Glutathione Peroxidase
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Intracellular AGE modification of proteins reduces the activity of several antioxidant enzymes, including glutathione peroxidase, catalase, and glutathione reductase. Glutathione peroxidase normally reduces hydrogen peroxide and lipid peroxides using glutathione, and its inhibition by glycation increases cellular oxidative stress. These alterations of antioxidant enzyme activities contribute to the pro-oxidant state seen in aging and diabetic tissues, and represent one mechanism by which glycation impairs cellular function. This is distinct from the extracellular cross-linking and RAGE-mediated effects of AGEs.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質的 intracellular AGE modification 降低多種 antioxidant enzymes 的活性，包括 glutathione peroxidase、catalase 與 glutathione reductase。Glutathione peroxidase 通常使用 glutathione 來 reduce hydrogen peroxide 與 lipid peroxides，其受 glycation 抑制會增加細胞 oxidative stress。這些 antioxidant enzyme activities 的 alterations 促成 aging 與 diabetic tissues 中可見的 pro-oxidant state，並代表 glycation impairs cellular function 的一種機制。這不同於 AGEs 的 extracellular cross-linking 與 RAGE-mediated effects。

label: Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci
description: ASF1a is a core member of the HIRA chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). By delivering newly synthesized H3–H4 dimers to HIRA/UBN1, ASF1a supports the heterochromatic compaction that accompanies permanent growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需之 HIRA 伴護蛋白複合體的核心成員。透過將新合成的 H3–H4 二聚體交給 HIRA/UBN1，ASF1a 支持伴隨永久生長停滯的異染色質壓縮。

label: Bcl-2 family
description: Bad is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bad, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bad the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bad 是 Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從 Bcl-2 family 向 Bad，因此 Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bad 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Epigenetic Drift
description: Reprogramming is the proof that aging is substantially epigenetic: information loss (epigenetic drift) rather than pure damage accumulation. The ICE mouse experiments and reprogramming share this mechanistic frame, with aging positioned as a reversible epigenetic state.
description_zh_TW: Reprogramming 證明年齡在很大程度上是表觀遺傳性的：是資訊流失（表觀遺傳漂移）而非單純的損害累積。ICE 小鼠實驗和重編程共享此機制框架，將老化定位為可逆的表觀遺傳狀態。

label: Ubiquitin Ligase
description: Ubiquitin Ligase tags substrate proteins for the Proteasome: by conjugating K48-linked polyubiquitin chains to specific substrates, the E3 ligase marks them for recognition and degradation by the 26S proteasome, making ubiquitination the principal route that feeds proteins into proteasomal proteolysis.
description_zh_TW: Ubiquitin Ligase 會為 Proteasome 標記受質蛋白：E3 連接酶將 K48 連接的多元泛素鏈接合到特定受質上，使受質被 26S 蛋白酶體辨識並降解，讓泛素化成為將蛋白質送入蛋白酶體分解的主要途徑。

label: Catechols
description: Catechols are inactivated by COMT-mediated O-methylation, a reaction that consumes one methyl group (transferred from SAMe) per catechol molecule. When exogenous catechols such as high-dose Quercetin, Fisetin, Luteolin, or green-tea EGCG are introduced in slow-COMT individuals, the added substrate load raises methyl-group demand on the Methylation Cycle, the pathway that regenerates SAMe from homocysteine remethylation. Sustained catechol load can therefore tax methylation capacity, linking catechol exposure to methyl-donor burden and explaining why catechol-rich supplements are often poorly tolerated in slow COMT carriers.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 藉由 COMT 催化的 O-甲基化反應被去活化，每個 catechol 分子消耗一個由 SAMe 轉移的甲基。當慢速 COMT 個體攝入外源性 catechols（如高劑量 Quercetin、Fisetin、Luteolin 或綠茶 EGCG）時，增加的受質負荷會提高 Methylation Cycle 的甲基需求，而 Methylation Cycle 是藉由 homocysteine 再甲基化再生 SAMe 的路徑。持續的 catechol 負荷因此可能耗損甲基化能力，將 catechol 暴露與甲基供體負擔連結起來，也解釋了為何富含 catechol 的補充劑在慢速 COMT 帶原者中常不易耐受。

label: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine
description: Adrenochrome is an intermediate for adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, a hemostatic agent formed when aminoguanidine reacts with the freshly generated adrenochrome. This hydrazone derivative both stabilizes the chemically unstable adrenochrome and serves as a useful medicine. Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine obtained by the bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process is far less colored than that prepared by the method using potassium ferricyanide, and its identity is confirmed by UV absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅是腎上腺紅單胺基胍的中間體，後者為胺基胍與新鮮生成的腎上腺紅反應所形成的止血劑。此腙衍生物既能穩定化學上不穩定的腎上腺紅，又可用作有用的藥物。經鉍催化過硫酸鹽法所得的腎上腺紅單胺基胍，其色澤遠低於以鐵氰化鉀法製備者，其身份經348 nm和445 nm的紫外線吸收極大值確認。

label: Berberine
description: Berberine does not inhibit COMT because it lacks the catechol (1,2-dihydroxybenzene) structural motif required for both substrate binding and competitive inhibition of the enzyme. Because it neither blocks COMT nor donates methyl groups, berberine can be used therapeutically without perturbing catecholamine or catechol-drug metabolism mediated by COMT. This makes it a metabolically clean anti-inflammatory option for individuals concerned about COMT interactions, particularly those with slow COMT who are sensitive to methyl donors and enzyme inhibitors. Its structural difference from catechol-bearing flavonoids is central to this safety profile.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 不會抑制 COMT，因為它缺乏底物結合和酶的競爭性抑制所需的兒茶酚（1,2-二羥基苯）結構基序。由於小檜鹼既不阻斷 COMT 也不貢獻 methyl groups，因此可以在不干擾 COMT 介導的兒茶酚胺或兒茶酚藥物代謝的情況下用於治療。這使得它成為關注 COMT 相互作用的個體的代謝清潔抗炎選擇，特別是那些對甲基供體和酶抑製劑敏感的 COMT 緩慢的個體。它與含兒茶酚類黃酮的結構差異是這種安全性的核心。

label: Caspase-10
description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Breast Cancer
description: SIRT1 is elevated in breast cancer tissue versus adjacent normal tissue and predicts poor prognosis. In triple-negative breast cancer it regulates EMT-associated programming that drives invasion and metastasis, while also repressing ER-alpha-mediated estrogen proliferative responses. It promotes metadherin-driven chemoresistance and causes tamoxifen resistance through MRP2 upregulation via FoxO1 deacetylation, so SIRT1 inhibition augments paclitaxel and doxorubicin cytotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在乳癌組織中相較於鄰近正常組織升高，並預測不良預後。在三陰性乳癌中，它調節驅動侵犯與轉移的 EMT 相關編程，同時也抑制 ER-alpha 介導的雌激素增生反應。它促進 metadherin 驅動的化療抗性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化上調 MRP2 造成 tamoxifen 抗性，因此抑制 SIRT1 可增強 paclitaxel 與 doxorubicin 的細胞毒性。

label: FOXO1
description: SIRT2 inhibits FOXO1 by deacetylation (e.g., NF-κB, p53, FOXO1), generally restraining their transcriptional/apoptotic output.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化抑制 FOXO1（例如 NF-κB、p53、FOXO1），通常抑制其轉錄/凋亡輸出。

label: Osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: SIRT1 is protective in osteoarthritis by reducing chondrocyte apoptosis and ECM degradation via Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, reversing homocysteine-induced changes through the PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma cascade, inhibiting EGFR ubiquitination, and inhibiting chondrocyte senescence. SIRT1 therefore maintains cartilage homeostasis on multiple axes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在骨關節炎中具保護性，透過 Wnt/beta-catenin 訊號減少軟骨細胞凋亡與 ECM 降解，經由 PGC-1alpha/PPAR-gamma 級聯逆轉同半胱氨酸誘發的變化，抑制 EGFR 泛素化，並抑制軟骨細胞衰老。SIRT1 因此在多軸線上維持軟骨穩態。

label: AGK2
description: AGK2 liberates caspase-2/3-dependent apoptosis in nucleated cells, engaging sirtuin-caspase crosstalk. In platelets it instead triggers caspase-independent calpain-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在有核細胞中釋放依賴 caspase-2/3 的細胞凋亡，啟動 sirtuin-caspase 交互作用；而在血小板中則改為觸發不依賴 caspase 的 calpain 介導細胞死亡。

label: Gemcitabine
description: Gemcitabine's diphosphate (dFdCDP) irreversibly inactivates the RRM1 subunit of ribonucleotide reductase and depletes dNTP pools, especially dCTP, self-potentiating its own incorporation into DNA. This makes RNR a central target of gemcitabine's anticancer action.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 的二磷酸形式（dFdCDP）會不可逆地使核醣核苷酸還原酶的 RRM1 次單元失活，並耗竭 dNTP 池（尤其是 dCTP），自我增強其嵌入 DNA。這使 RNR 成為 Gemcitabine 抗癌作用的中心靶點。

label: Oxidized LDL
description: Ubiquinol, the reduced form of Coenzyme Q10, reduces oxidized LDL levels when supplemented at 150-300 mg per day in the context of atherosclerosis. By preventing LDL oxidation, CoQ10 lowers a key atherogenic trigger and improves flow-mediated dilation. This positions CoQ10 as clinically useful in early cardiovascular-disease prevention.
description_zh_TW: 在 atherosclerosis 的背景下，以每天 150-300 mg 補充 ubiquinol（Coenzyme Q10 的還原形式）可降低 oxidized LDL 水平。透過防止 LDL 氧化，CoQ10 降低了關鍵的致動脈粥狀硬化觸發因素，並改善血流介導的血管擴張。這使 CoQ10 在早期 cardiovascular disease 的預防中具有臨床用途。

label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore
description: Activated BAX (with BAK) drives opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, causing cytochrome c to diffuse into the cytosol where it nucleates the apoptosome with Apaf-1 and caspase-9. BH3-only activators (Bid, Bim, PUMA) can directly engage BAX/BAK, while sensitizers (Bad, Noxa, Bik) displace the anti-apoptotic Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Mcl-1 restraint. The pore event is the point of no return separating transcriptional death decisions from caspase execution.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 BAX（與 BAK）會驅動粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟，使 cytochrome c 擴散進入細胞質，並與 Apaf-1 及 Caspase-9 組裝凋亡體。BH3-only 活化因子（Bid、Bim、PUMA）可直接結合 BAX/BAK，而敏化因子（Bad、Noxa、Bik）則置換抗凋亡的 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 與 Mcl-1。孔道開啟是區分轉錄層面死亡決定與 caspase 執行的不可逆節點。

label: ELK4
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK4 (SAP-1) belongs to the ETS-domain ternary complex factor (TCF) subfamily of transcription factors, defined by a conserved ETS DNA-binding domain. Within sirtuin biology, ELK4 is notable for interacting with SIRT7 and stabilizing the deacetylase at target gene promoters, where SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of histone H3 and represses tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, ELK4's identity as an ETS factor underlies its promoter-targeting function. This links the ETS transcription factor family to the pro-oncogenic SIRT7-H3K18ac axis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: ELK4（SAP-1）屬於 ETS 結構域三元複合物因子（TCF）轉錄因子亞家族，其特徵是保守的 ETS DNA 結合結構域。在 sirtuin 生物學中，ELK4 因與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處而引人注目，在那裡 SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。方向性上 ELK4 作為 ETS 因子的身份奠定了其啟動子靶向功能。這將 ETS 轉錄因子家族與癌症中的促致癌 SIRT7-H3K18ac 軸線聯繫起來。

label: Selective Autophagy
description: Mitophagy is a specialized, evolutionarily conserved form of selective autophagy dedicated to the degradation of damaged or dysfunctional mitochondria. Under stress such as excessive ROS, nutrient deficiency, or cellular aging, mitochondria undergo depolarization and are selectively engulfed and eliminated. The process proceeds through recognition of damaged mitochondria, recruitment of adaptors or receptors, autophagosome formation, and fusion with lysosomes. This ensures mitochondrial quality control and cellular homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Mitophagy 是選擇性自噬的一種特化、演化上保守的形式，專門降解受損或功能失常的粒線體。在過量 ROS、營養缺乏或細胞老化等壓力下，粒線體發生去極化並被選擇性吞噬和清除。此過程歷經辨識受損粒線體、招募接合蛋白或受體、自噬體形成，以及與溶酶體融合。這確保了粒線體品質控制和細胞恆定性。

label: ULK1
description: The phagophore assembly site (PAS) is the location where autophagy is initiated, organized around the ULK1 initiation complex (ULK1-ATG13-ATG101-FIP200). This complex recruits the autophagy-specific Vps34 complex to nucleate and elongate the phagophore.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點（PAS）是自噬起始的位置，圍繞 ULK1 起始複合體（ULK1-ATG13-ATG101-FIP200）組織。此複合體招募自噬特異的 Vps34 複合體以形成並延伸吞噬泡。

label: Adenosylcobalamin
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden.
