This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: Modafinil
description: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting agent approved for narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea-related sleepiness, and shift-work sleep disorder, acting via dopamine transporter inhibition and orexin system modulation. It improves daytime alertness and reduces excessive sleepiness with a lower abuse liability than classical psychostimulants such as amphetamines. Its efficacy provides the clinical anchor for its off-label cognitive and nootropic uses. It is a key tool in sleep medicine and in performance-enhancement contexts.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 是一種覺醒促進劑，被批准用於治療 narcolepsy、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止症相關的嗜睡和輪班工作睡眠障礙，透過多巴胺轉運蛋白抑制和食慾素系統調節發揮作用。它可以提高白天的警覺性並減少過度嗜睡，並且比安非他明等經典精神興奮劑的濫用可能性更低。其功效為其標籤外認知和 nootropic 用途提供了臨床依據。它是睡眠醫學和提高表現的關鍵工具。

label: Hydroxocobalamin
description: Hydroxocobalamin serves as an alternative to methylcobalamin for individuals sensitive to methyl-donating B12, because as a non-methylated precursor it avoids acute increases in methyl burden that can trigger mood side effects in slow COMT individuals. It still ultimately supports methylation once converted to methylcobalamin, but in a titratable, demand-driven manner rather than by direct donation. This makes it a preferred B12 form in personalized protocols for slow COMT and in general B12 supplementation. It also provides adenosylcobalamin for mitochondrial function.
description_zh_TW: 對於對甲基供體 B12 敏感的個體，Hydroxocobalamin 可作為甲基鈷胺素的替代品，因為作為非甲基化前體，它可以避免可能觸發 mood side effects in slow COMT 個體的甲基負荷急劇增加。一旦轉化為甲鈷胺，它最終仍然支持甲基化，但以可滴定的、需求驅動的方式，而不是直接捐贈。這使其成為慢速 COMT 個人化方案和一般 B12 補充中的首選 B12 形式。它還為粒線體功能提供腺苷鈷胺素。

label: Physical Activity
description: The doubly labelled water (DLW) technique is the gold-standard method for measuring total daily energy expenditure and the physical activity component of the energy budget in free-living humans. Subjects drink water labeled with the stable isotopes deuterium and oxygen-18; carbon dioxide production is calculated from the differential loss rates of the two isotopes, and energy expenditure is derived using standard equations. In the studies reviewed by Speakman, DLW has been used to quantify total daily energy expenditure (TEE) over 7-14 day periods, showing that within-individual day-to-day variability of TEE is small even when physical activity varies.
description_zh_TW: 雙標記水（DLW）技術是測量自由生活人類每日總能量支出和能量預算中體力活動成分的黃金標準方法。受試者飲用含有穩定同位素氘和氧-18標記的水；二氧化碳產生量根據兩種同位素的差異損失率計算，能量支出使用標準方程式得出。在Speakman回顧的研究中，DLW被用於量化7-14天期間的每日總能量支出（TEE），顯示即使體力活動變化，個體內每日TEE變異性也很小。

label: MXL-3
description: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

label: COMT Val158 allele
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: The COMT Val158 allele increases the thermostability of the enzyme, thereby increasing its level of activity compared to the 158 Met allele. This higher activity increases dopamine turnover in cortical synapses. A common polymorphism resulting in increased COMT activity has been associated with poorer cognitive performance and increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val158 等位基因增加酶的熱穩定性，從而相對於 158 Met 等位基因提高其活性水平。這種較高的活性增加皮質突觸的多巴胺代謝。導致 COMT activity 增加的常見多態性已與較差的認知表現和精神疾病易感性增加相關。

label: LXRα
description: ABCA1 is regulated by LXRalpha, as the nuclear receptor directly drives ABCA1 transcription in response to oxysterol ligands, coordinating cholesterol efflux. This places ABCA1 downstream of LXR-controlled reverse-cholesterol-transport programs. The directionality is LXRalpha activation to ABCA1 expression. A caveat is that PPARgamma and other transcription factors also regulate ABCA1, so LXRalpha is a major but not exclusive controller. This LXR-ABCA1 axis is also redox-responsive, since oxidative modifications of LDL generate LXR ligands that upregulate the transporter as a protective response.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 受 LXRalpha 調節，因為核受體響應氧甾醇配體直接驅動 ABCA1 轉錄，協調 cholesterol 流出。這將 ABCA1 置於 LXR 控制的反向 cholesterol 傳輸程式的下游。方向性是LXRalpha活化至ABCA1表達。需要注意的是，PPARgamma 和其他轉錄因子也調節 ABCA1，因此 LXRalpha 是主要但不是唯一的控制者。此 LXR-ABCA1 軸也具有氧化還原反應性，因為 LDL 的氧化修飾會產生 LXR 配體，從而上調轉運蛋白作為保護性反應。

label: SIRT1 and SIRT2
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074, an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor, was tested with other kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 because sirtuins and protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site. It showed SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory properties in the low micromolar range, placing it alongside the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 as a kinase-scaffold sirtuin inhibitor. Directionally, GW5074's scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, underscoring the value of structure-based follow-up for selectivity.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 最初是作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物，與其他激酶抑制劑一起被測試對 SIRT2 的活性，因為 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點。它在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制特性，與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 一起被歸類為激酶骨架 sirtuin 抑制劑。方向性上 GW5074 的骨架結構使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了針對選擇性進行結構導向後續研究的價值。

label: TFE3
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFE3 regulates osteoclast development by promoting the transition of mononucleated to multinucleated osteoclasts. This activation occurs downstream of the growth factors M-CSF and RANK and requires MAPK-dependent TFE3 phosphorylation. TFE3 thereby contributes to skeletal formation and remodeling through its control of osteoclast maturation. The role highlights TFE3's function in cell lineage decisions beyond lysosomal biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 透過促進單核細胞向多核破骨細胞的轉變，調節破骨細胞發育。此活化發生於生長因子 M-CSF 和 RANK 下游，並需要依賴 MAPK 的 TFE3 磷酸化。因此 TFE3 透過控制破骨細胞成熟，促成骨骼形成和重塑。此角色凸顯 TFE3 在細胞譜系決定中超越溶酶體生物發生的功能。

label: Iron
description: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent cell death pathway in which the accumulation of lipid peroxides becomes toxic to cells. Pam Maher, the Salk senior author, discovered the pathway and named it (originally 'oxytosis') in 2001. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that can stave off ferroptosis. Ferroptosis has been increasingly linked to neurodegeneration - Maher's lab recently reported that chronic iron overexposure in neurons makes them less resilient over time and more vulnerable to neurodegeneration - and targeting the pathway has become a promising therapeutic strategy for age-related diseases alongside senescence research.
description_zh_TW: Ferroptosis是一種依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，其中脂質過氧化物的累積對細胞產生毒性。Salk研究所的資深作者Pam Maher於2001年發現此途徑並加以命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。Ferroptosis日益與神經退化相關——Maher的實驗室近期報告指出，神經元長期過度暴露於鐵會使其隨時間韌性下降，並更容易發生神經退化——而標靶此途徑已與衰老研究一同成為年齡相關疾病的具前景治療策略。

label: KRAS
description: KRAS is mutated in approximately 90% of pancreatic cancers, with G12D the most common alteration. These mutations impair GTPase activity and lock KRAS in the active GTP-bound state. KRAS mutation is a defining driver of pancreatic tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: KRAS 在約 90% 的胰臟癌中發生突變，其中 G12D 是最常見的改變。這些突變會損害 GTPase 活性，並使 KRAS 鎖定在活化的 GTP 結合狀態。KRAS 突變是胰臟腫瘤發生的決定性驅動因子。

label: Mitochondrial Dynamics
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: mTORC2
description: FKBP12 binds the FKBP12-FRB interface of mTOR and is the cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage the mTOR complexes. While the canonical target is mTORC1, FKBP12-mediated engagement is also relevant to mTORC2 regulation by rapalogs.
description_zh_TW: FKBP12 結合 mTOR 的 FKBP12-FRB 介面，是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與 mTOR 複合體的輔因子。雖然典型目標是 mTORC1，FKBP12 介導的參與也與 rapalog 對 mTORC2 的調節相關。

label: Hypochlorous acid
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) uses hydrogen peroxide as a substrate to catalyze the two-electron oxidation of halides, mainly chloride, into hypohalous acids, with the primary reaction converting chloride to hypochlorous acid (HOCl): MPO + H2O2 + Cl- produces HOCl + H2O. Hypochlorous acid is a potent antimicrobial oxidant that damages microbial proteins, lipids, and DNA, and this halogenation cycle is central to the neutrophil's oxidative burst. The same oxidant can damage host tissues when released in excess, linking MPO to tissue injury, atherosclerosis, and chronic inflammatory diseases.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）以hydrogen peroxide為substrate，催化halides（mainly chloride）的two-electron oxidation生成hypohalous acids，其主要reaction將chloride轉化為hypochlorous acid（HOCl）：MPO + H2O2 + Cl- produces HOCl + H2O。Hypochlorous acid是一種potent antimicrobial oxidant，可damages microbial proteins、lipids與DNA，此halogenation cycle是neutrophil's oxidative burst的核心。當此oxidant過量released時，同樣會damages host tissues，將MPO與tissue injury、atherosclerosis及chronic inflammatory diseases聯繫起來。

label: Extrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Extrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Extrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Extrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Extrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are a heterogeneous population of immature myeloid cells with potent immunosuppressive activity, expanded under pathological stress including cancer and chronic inflammation. Their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state rather than a single lineage, with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets recognized. In senescence contexts, MDSCs are recruited by SASP factors and blunt anti-tumor and anti-senescence immunity, shifting the immune balance away from clearance. They represent a key immunosuppressive cell type bridging aging, inflammation, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: MDSCs（骨髓源性抑制細胞）是一群異質、未成熟骨髓細胞，在發炎與癌症中擴張並具免疫抑制功能。其歸類為未成熟骨髓細胞將其定位於骨髓生成與免疫調節的交會點，且其在衰老中重要性上升。在衰老脈絡中，MDSC 累積貢獻免疫抑制與監視受損。其未成熟本質使其對發炎細胞激素與趨化因子高度反應，成為衰老相關免疫逃脫的關鍵角色。

label: PRDX6
description: Beyond ROS scavenging, NAC is a selective inhibitor of the peroxidase activity of PRDX6 (IC50 ~15.5 uM), a distinct antioxidant-enzyme interaction. This dual action underscores why NAC, used as a timed redox buffer in hormetic protocols, can also blunt adaptive signaling when taken chronically.
description_zh_TW: 除 ROS 清除外，NAC 是 PRDX6 過氧化物酶活性的選擇性抑制劑（IC50 ~15.5 uM），一種不同的抗氧化酵素交互作用。此雙重作用說明為何在促效應方案中使用作為定時 redox 緩衝的 NAC，長期服用時亦能減弱適應性訊號。

label: Tumorigenesis
description: Caspase-2 is a bona fide tumor suppressor: knockout mice develop centrosome excess, aneuploidy and carcinogen-hypersensitive tumorigenesis; it also cleaves Beclin-1, coupling tumor suppression, autophagy suppression and apoptosis upstream of p53 (PMID 19339967).
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 是名副其實的腫瘤抑制子：剔除小鼠出現中心體過量、非整倍體與致癌物高敏感腫瘤生成；它也切割 Beclin-1，在 p53 上游耦合腫瘤抑制、自噬抑制與細胞凋亡（PMID 19339967）。

label: HMGB1
description: RAGE binds HMGB1 (amphoterin), as well as members of the S100 protein family, amyloid beta oligomers, and other ligands, making it a multi-ligand pattern-recognition receptor. This broad ligand repertoire positions RAGE as a sensor for damage-associated molecular patterns in sterile inflammation. Each ligand class activates overlapping but distinct downstream signaling profiles.
description_zh_TW: RAGE 結合 HMGB1（amphoterin），以及 S100 protein family 成員、amyloid beta 寡聚體和其他配體，使其成為多配體模式識別受體。這種廣泛的配體庫使 RAGE 成為無菌性發炎中損傷相關分子模式的感測器。每一類配體都活化重疊但截然不同的下游訊號輪廓。

label: H3.3
description: H3.3 is a replication-independent histone variant deposited by dedicated chaperones, principally HIRA at gene bodies and enhancers. Because senescent cells have exited the cell cycle, H3.3 deposition becomes increasingly reliant on the HIRA complex.
description_zh_TW: H3.3 是非複製依賴的組蛋白變異體，由專屬伴護蛋白（主要是在基因體與增強子處的 HIRA）沉積。由於衰老細胞已退出細胞週期，H3.3 沉積日益依賴 HIRA 複合體。

label: Free Radicals
description: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

label: FOXO
description: SIRT2 activates FOXO via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 FOXO（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

label: DNA Repair
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SIRT1 functions in DNA repair, one of its core physiological roles tied to NAD+-dependent deacetylation and caloric-restriction-mediated longevity. SIRT1 relocalizes to DNA double-strand breaks, where it deacetylates H4K16 and other targets to promote homologous-recombination repair and maintain heterochromatin, supporting genomic stability with age (Oberdoerffer et al., 2008, PMC2853975). Its decline with falling NAD+ impairs this repair coupling, connecting sirtuin biology to the DNA-damage response.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在 DNA 修復中發揮功能，這是其與 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯化和熱量限制介導的長壽相關的核心生理功能之一。SIRT1 再定位至 DNA 雙股斷裂處，在那裡去乙醯化 H4K16 及其他靶點以促進同源重組修復並維持異染色質，支持隨年齡增長的基因組穩定性（Oberdoerffer et al., 2008, PMC2853975）。隨著 NAD+ 下降而導致的其功能減弱損害了這種修復耦合，將 sirtuin 生物學與 DNA 損傷反應聯繫起來。

label: NAMPT
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAMPT (nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ salvage pathway, converting nicotinamide into nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in an energetically costly step. NAMPT activity therefore determines how much NAD+ precursor is available to fuel sirtuins and other NAD+-consuming enzymes such as CD38 and the poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases. Directionally, NAMPT sits upstream of NAD+ pool size and sirtuin activity. Because NAMPT couples cellular energy state to NAD+ biosynthesis, it is a primary node linking metabolism to sirtuin function and a key target for interventions aimed at restoring NAD+ during aging.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT（菸鹼醯胺磷酸核糖轉移酶）是NAD+補救合成途徑的限速酶，在一個耗能的步驟中將菸鹼醯胺轉化為菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）。因此NAMPT活性決定了有多少NAD+前體可用於驅動sirtuin和其他NAD+消耗酶（如CD38和多聚ADP-核糖聚合酶）。方向上，NAMPT位於NAD+池大小和sirtuin活性的上游。因為NAMPT將細胞能量狀態與NAD+生物合成耦合，它是連結代謝與sirtuin功能的主要節點，也是旨在恢復老化過程中NAD+的介入措施的關鍵靶點。

label: Sirtinol
description: Sirtinol, a hydroxynaphthaldehyde derivative discovered in a phenotypic screen, is active against multiple sirtuin isoforms and has cytotoxic activity against cancer cells of different origins, including breast, lung, prostate, and leukemia cell lines. This broad anticancer activity made sirtinol the founding member of the beta-naphthol inhibitor family and seeded structure-activity programs that produced salermide, cambinol, and splitomicin. Directionally, sirtinol-mediated inhibition of sirtuin activity sits upstream of its cytotoxic effects on malignant cells, though its full target spectrum extends beyond sirtuins.
description_zh_TW: Sirtinol 是一種在表型篩選中發現的羥基萘醛衍生物，對多種 sirtuin 同工型具有活性，並對不同來源的癌細胞具有細胞毒活性，包括乳腺癌、肺癌、前列腺癌和白血病細胞系。這種廣泛的抗癌活性使 Sirtinol 成為 β-萘酚抑制劑家族的創始成員，並啟動了產生 salermide、cambinol 和 splitomicin 的構效關係研究。方向性上 Sirtinol 介導的 sirtuin 活性抑制位於其對惡性細胞細胞毒作用的上游，儘管其完整的作用靶標範圍超越了 sirtuin。

label: Cambinol
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In hepatocellular and lung cancer cells, Cambinol impairs migration and invasion in a dose-dependent manner, consistent with sirtuin inhibition reducing metastatic behaviors. Directionally, Cambinol sits upstream of suppressed motility. This suggests sirtuin blockers may limit metastasis, complementing Cambinol's chemotherapy-sensitizing effects. By inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2, Cambinol disrupts the survival and migration programs that cancer cells depend on. The anti-migratory effect adds a metastatic dimension to the anticancer profile of sirtuin inhibitors, supporting their evaluation as anti-metastatic agents.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞癌和肺癌細胞中，Cambinol 以劑量依賴方式損害遷移和侵襲，與 sirtuin 抑制減少轉移行為一致。在方向性上，Cambinol 位於抑制運動性的上游。這表明 sirtuin 阻斷劑可能限制轉移，與 Cambinol 的化療增敏效應互補。透過抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2，Cambinol 破壞癌細胞依賴的存活和遷移程式。抗遷移效應為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌特徵增添了轉移維度，支持其作為抗轉移藥物的評估。

label: Salermide
description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

label: Folinic acid
description: Folinic acid supports COMT function by feeding folate-derived one-carbon units into the Methylation Cycle and SAMe production without imposing the abrupt methyl load of high-dose Methylfolate. Since COMT consumes SAMe to O-methylate catecholamines, a steady but gentle supply of methyl capacity helps slow-COMT individuals maintain catecholamine clearance without overstimulation or 'overmethylation' side effects. This makes folinic acid a preferred folate support when COMT activity is genetically reduced.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 透過將葉酸來源的一碳單元送入 Methylation Cycle 與 SAMe 生成來支持 COMT 功能，而不像高劑量 Methylfolate 那樣造成突然的甲基負荷。由於 COMT 消耗 SAMe 對兒茶酚胺進行 O-甲基化，穩定而溫和的甲基能力供應有助於慢速 COMT 個體維持兒茶酚胺清除，同時避免過度刺激或「過度甲基化」副作用。因此在 COMT 活性基因性偏低時，folinic acid 是較受偏好的葉酸支持選項。

label: Cell Cycle Arrest
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Activation of ATM by DNA double-strand breaks initiates cell-cycle arrest, a principal functional output of the kinase. Through CHK2 and p53, ATM enforces arrest that provides time for repair. This makes ATM a master coordinator of the damage checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: ATM 因 DNA 雙股斷裂而激活，進而啟動細胞週期停滯，這是該激酶的主要功能性輸出。透過 CHK2 和 p53，ATM 強制實施停滯，為修復爭取時間。這使 ATM 成為損傷檢查點的主要協調者。

label: Small-cell lung cancer
description: Small-cell lung cancer is treated with Chemotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment: concurrent platinum plus etoposide with thoracic radiotherapy for limited-stage disease, and platinum-based chemotherapy combined with a PD-L1 inhibitor for extensive-stage disease.
description_zh_TW: 小細胞肺癌（Small-cell lung cancer）以化療（Chemotherapy）治療。含鉑化療是 SCLC 治療的骨幹：侷限期以含鉑加 etoposide 並合併胸部放射治療，廣泛期則以含鉑化療合併 PD-L1 抑制劑治療。

label: Bcl-xL
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Bcl-xL keeps SIRT1 intact and nuclear during apoptotic stimulation. In HeLa cells expressing Sir2α, TNF-α drove the deacetylase from nucleus to cytoplasm, but co-expression of Bcl-xL — like dominant-negative caspase-9 — held Sir2α in the nucleus and prevented cleavage. This places SIRT1 dismantling strictly downstream of apoptosome activation and mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization: as long as the mitochondrial gate stays closed, the survival deacetylase survives.
description_zh_TW: Bcl-xL 在凋亡刺激下維持 SIRT1 的完整與核內定位。在表達 Sir2α 的 HeLa 細胞中，TNF-α 會驅動此去乙醯酶由細胞核進入細胞質，但共同表達 Bcl-xL——如同顯性負向 Caspase-9——可將 Sir2α 保留在細胞核內並阻止切割。這表示 SIRT1 的瓦解嚴格位於凋亡體活化與粒線體外膜通透化之下游：只要粒線體閘門維持關閉，這個存活去乙醯酶就能存活。

label: Myeloperoxidase
description: Myeloperoxidase, released by activated neutrophils during the respiratory burst, catalyzes the formation of adrenochrome by accelerating the oxidation of epinephrine. This enzymatic route complements non-enzymatic oxidation driven by reactive oxygen species. It links neutrophil infiltration and inflammation to localized adrenochrome production.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase 在呼吸爆發期間由活化的嗜中性球釋放，透過加速 epinephrine 的氧化來催化 adrenochrome 的形成。此酶促途徑補充了由 reactive oxygen species 驅動的非酶促氧化。它將嗜中性球浸潤與發炎連結到局部的 adrenochrome 生成。

label: Activin A
description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

label: Spermidine
description: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。

label: STAT3
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Ivermectin promotes proteasomal degradation of PAK1, which in turn suppresses STAT3. This damps IL-6 transcription, Th17 inflammaging in aging CD4+ T cells, and the OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 stemness loop — entering the same inflammaging/SASP axis that metformin targets, but via PAK1 rather than AMPK.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 促進 PAK1 的蛋白酶體降解，後者進而抑制 STAT3。這減弱 IL-6 轉錄、老化 CD4+ T 細胞中的 Th17 發炎性老化，以及 OCT4/NANOG/SOX2 幹性迴路——進入 metformin 標靶的相同發炎性老化／SASP 軸，但經由 PAK1 而非 AMPK。

label: G1 Phase
description: G1 Phase is regulated by RB1, the retinoblastoma tumor suppressor that governs the G1/S restriction point: hypophosphorylated RB1 binds and represses E2F transcription factors, withholding S-phase genes until cyclin D-CDK4/6 phosphorylation inactivates RB1 and releases E2F. Loss of RB1 therefore drives unrestrained G1 progression in cancer.
description_zh_TW: G1 Phase 受 RB1（視網膜母細胞瘤腫瘤抑制因子）調控，後者掌管 G1/S 限制點：低磷酸化的 RB1 會結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子，阻止 S 期基因表現，直到 cyclin D-CDK4/6 磷酸化使 RB1 失活並釋放 E2F 為止。因此 RB1 缺失會導致癌細胞中不受控的 G1 進展。

label: Striatum
description: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning depends on dopamine signaling within the Striatum, where dorsolateral and dorsomedial striatal circuits integrate cortical and dopaminergic input at medium spiny neurons and enable corticostriatal long-term potentiation. Because striatal dopamine tone is shaped locally by COMT given sparse dopamine transporter expression, COMT activity modulates how readily S-R associations are acquired: elevated COMT accelerates dopamine clearance and slows S-R learning, whereas slower COMT preserves dopamine and facilitates habit formation.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 依賴 Striatum 內的多巴胺訊號傳遞，背外側與背內側紋狀體迴路在 medium spiny neurons 處整合皮質與多巴胺輸入，並促成皮質-紋狀體長期增益。由於紋狀體多巴胺張力在多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏的情況下由 COMT 局部塑造，COMT 活性會調節 S-R 關聯習得的難易：COMT 升高會加速多巴胺清除並減緩 S-R 學習，而 COMT 較慢則保留多巴胺並促進習慣形成。

label: Adrenochrome formation
description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) acts as an antioxidant and reducing agent that inhibits the oxidation of epinephrine to adrenochrome. It scavenges reactive oxygen species that drive catechol oxidation and reduces oxidized intermediates back to epinephrine, effectively reversing the early steps of the reaction. In laboratory settings vitamin C has been shown to inhibit the pink-to-red discoloration of adrenaline solutions caused by adrenochrome formation, and it is used as a stabilizing agent in pharmaceutical epinephrine preparations. Antioxidants such as ascorbic acid therefore represent a natural brake on the adrenochrome pathway in both formulations and biological systems.
description_zh_TW: Ascorbic acid（維生素 C）作為 antioxidant 與 reducing agent，抑制 epinephrine 氧化成 adrenochrome。它清除驅動兒茶酚氧化的 reactive oxygen species，並將氧化的中間產物還原回 epinephrine，有效逆轉反應的早期步驟。在實驗室環境中，維生素 C 已被證實能抑制 adrenaline 溶液因 adrenochrome 形成而產生的粉紅至紅色變色，並被用作藥用 epinephrine 製劑中的 stabilizing agent。因此，ascorbic acid 等 antioxidants 在製劑與生物系統中，都代表了對 adrenochrome pathway 的天然制動作用。

label: Yamanaka Factors
description: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
description_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

label: Neuroinflammation
description: Round-2 fuel-line trace: Nicotinamide Riboside carries the typed edge 'reduces → Neuroinflammation' (conf 0.9); NR reaches the adrenochrome trigger via 8 co-shortest paths (bridges SIRT1, SIRT3, TNFalpha, IL-6, Neuroinflammation, Amyloid Beta, Hematopoietic Stem Cell), PPR #86 — though 7 of 8 paths terminated on a contested NF-kappaB edge.
description_zh_TW: 第二輪燃料線追蹤：Nicotinamide Riboside 帶類型邊「reduces → Neuroinflammation」（conf 0.9）；NR 經 8 條同等最短路（橋樑 SIRT1、SIRT3、TNFalpha、IL-6、Neuroinflammation、Amyloid Beta、Hematopoietic Stem Cell）到達 adrenochrome 觸發器，PPR #86——但 8 條中有 7 條終止於有爭議的 NF-kappaB 邊。

label: SREBP-1c
description: SIRT6 improves systemic insulin sensitivity and prevents ectopic lipid accumulation by repressing the lipogenic transcription factor SREBP-1c. Repression of SREBP-1c inhibits fatty-acid synthesis in the liver and promotes oxidative disposal of lipids rather than storage. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of suppressed lipogenic gene programs. This keeps hepatic triglyceride production in check and limits fat deposition in tissues such as the liver and muscle. By opposing de novo lipogenesis, SIRT6 protects against hepatic steatosis, insulin resistance, and the metabolic sequelae of a chronic nutrient surplus.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過抑制脂肪生成轉錄因子SREBP-1c來改善全身胰島素敏感性並防止異位脂質積累。SREBP-1c的抑制阻礙了肝臟中的脂肪酸合成，促進脂質的氧化處置而非儲存。方向上，SIRT6位於脂肪生成基因程序抑制的上游。這使肝臟三酸甘油酯的產生受到控制，並限制肝臟和肌肉等組織中的脂肪沉積。透過對抗從頭脂肪生成，SIRT6保護機體免受肝脂肪變性、胰島素阻抗和慢性營養過剩的代謝後果。

label: Ischemia-reperfusion Injury
description: Cardiac-specific overexpression of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) reduces infarct size after ischemia-reperfusion injury and improves survival, preserving contractile reserve, mitochondrial complex activity, and membrane potential. This cardioprotection is lost in middle-aged mice due to nitrative inactivation of Trx1.
description_zh_TW: 心臟特異性的 Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 過度表現可減少缺血再灌流損傷後的心肌梗塞面積並改善存活，維持收縮儲備、粒線體複合物活性與膜電位。此心臟保護作用在中年小鼠中會因 Trx1 的硝化失活而喪失。

label: MethylB12
description: MethylB12 (methylcobalamin) supports the Methylation Cycle as the methyl-group carrier for methionine synthase: it provides the methyl group that remethylates homocysteine to methionine, regenerating the SAMe pool that the cycle distributes to methyltransferases such as COMT. Together with Methylfolate, methylB12 is one of the two B-vitamin cofactors that keep homocysteine remethylation, and therefore SAMe-dependent catecholamine clearance, running efficiently.
description_zh_TW: MethylB12（甲基鈷胺）作為 methionine synthase 的甲基載體支持 Methylation Cycle：它提供將 homocysteine 再甲基化為 methionine 所需的甲基，再生該循環分配給 COMT 等甲基轉移酶的 SAMe 池。與 Methylfolate 一樣，methylB12 是維持 homocysteine 再甲基化（以及依賴 SAMe 的兒茶酚胺清除）順暢運作的兩種 B 群維生素輔因子之一。

label: Endothelial dysfunction
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: The SASP induces endothelial dysfunction through the chemokine CXCL12, which is the most highly upregulated SASP factor in senescent endothelial cells with vascular aging. CXCL12 causally drives endothelial dysfunction by suppressing nitric oxide, promoting mitochondrial ROS, and inducing endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition. The senolytic fisetin normalizes CXCL12 to rescue vascular function.
description_zh_TW: SASP 透過趨化因子 CXCL12 誘導 endothelial dysfunction，在血管老化中，CXCL12 是衰老內皮細胞中上調幅度最高的 SASP 因子。CXCL12 透過抑制 nitric oxide、促進粒線體 ROS 並誘導 endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition，因果性地驅動 endothelial dysfunction。Senolytic fisetin 能使 CXCL12 正常化以挽救血管功能。

label: Cyclopentenyl cytosine
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine is a type of Antimetabolite: this synthetic cytidine nucleoside analog acts as a metabolic antagonist that depletes pyrimidine nucleotides, chiefly by inhibiting CTP synthetase, which underlies its candidate use in cancer chemotherapy and antiviral research.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於 Antimetabolite（抗代謝物）的一種：此合成胞苷核苷類似物扮演代謝拮抗劑，主要透過抑制 CTP synthetase 耗竭嘧啶核苷酸，這是其在癌症化療與抗病毒研究中作為候選藥物的基礎。

label: Senescence Surveillance
description: The immune system clears oncogene-induced senescent cells in benign lesions; surveillance failure accelerates tumorigenesis. p16/p21 double-knockout raises cancer rates, evidencing that senescence in benign/premalignant lesions is tumor-suppressive and that retaining it is beneficial.
description_zh_TW: 免疫系統清除良性病灶中的致癌基因誘發衰老細胞；監測失敗加速腫瘤發生。p16/p21 雙重基因敲除提高癌症率，證明良性／癌前病灶中的衰老具腫瘤抑制性，且保留它是有益的。

label: Cisplatin
description: SIRT1 promotes cisplatin resistance in lung cancer via VEGF-A signaling, whereas SIRT2 upregulation and SIRT3 (via the FoxO3/CDT1 axis) each increase cisplatin sensitivity. SIRT3 also promotes DNA repair and radioresistance through ATM-Chk2. The opposing SIRT1 vs SIRT2/SIRT3 actions define the chemo-resistance balance in NSCLC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在肺癌中透過 VEGF-A 訊號促進 cisplatin 抗性，而 SIRT2 上調與 SIRT3（經由 FoxO3/CDT1 軸）各自增加 cisplatin 敏感性。SIRT3 亦透過 ATM-Chk2 促進 DNA 修復與放射抗性。相反的 SIRT1 對 SIRT2/SIRT3 作用定義了 NSCLC 中的化療抗性平衡。

label: Glycation
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Glycation is a non-enzymatic reaction of reducing sugars with free amino groups that forms advanced glycation end-products (AGEs). The accumulation of AGE cross-links in tissues such as blood vessels and skin increases with aging, causing loss of elasticity and function.
description_zh_TW: 糖化是還原糖與游離氨基的非酵素反應，會形成晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）。AGE 交聯在血管與皮膚等組織中的累積隨年齡增加，造成彈性與功能的喪失。

label: Heterochromatin
description: SIRT3 maintains heterochromatin integrity in human mesenchymal stem cells (hMSCs), postponing replicative senescence. It forms macromolecular assemblies with nuclear lamina constituents and heterochromatin-associated proteins supporting chromatin compaction and genomic stability. Absence of SIRT3 triggers structural abnormalities in the nuclear envelope, disarray of heterochromatin organization, and reactivation of silenced repetitive sequences, accelerating premature cellular aging; restoration of SIRT3 re-establishes chromatin organization and mitigates senescence phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在人類間充質幹細胞（hMSCs）中維護異染色質完整性，延緩複製性衰老。它與核層成分和異染色質相關蛋白形成大分子複合體，支持染色質緊縮和基因組穩定性。SIRT3 的缺失觸發核膜結構異常、異染色質組織紊亂和沉默重複序列的重新活化，加速過早細胞老化；恢復 SIRT3 可重建染色質組織並減緩衰老表型。

label: Histone Acetylation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: Histone Deacetylase
description: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
description_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

label: Superoxide Radicals
description: During the Q-cycle in mitochondrial Complex III, the ubisemiquinone intermediate formed at the Qo site can leak electrons to molecular oxygen, generating superoxide radicals. This superoxide production increases sharply when the membrane potential is high or when Complex I is impaired. Thus CoQ10's redox state is directly linked to mitochondrial ROS generation despite its overall antioxidant role.
description_zh_TW: 在粒線體 Complex III 的 Q-cycle 中，Qo 位點形成的 ubisemiquinone 中間體可將電子洩漏給分子氧，產生 superoxide radicals。當膜電位升高或 Complex I 受損時，這種超氧化物產生會急劇增加。因此，儘管 CoQ10 整體上扮演抗氧化角色，其氧化還原狀態仍與 mitochondrial ROS 的生成直接相關。

label: Therapy-Induced Senescence
description: Bleomycin is a glycopeptide antibiotic that causes DNA double-strand breaks and is a standard tool for generating therapy-induced senescence (TIS) in vitro. Sub-lethal bleomycin treatment produces a canonical senescence phenotype with elevated SA-beta-gal and DNA-damage-response foci.
description_zh_TW: Bleomycin 是一種糖肽抗生素，會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，是體外誘發治療誘導性衰老（TIS）的標準工具。次致死劑量的 bleomycin 處理會產生典型的衰老表現型，包括升高的 SA-β-gal 與 DNA 損傷反應焦點。

label: Microgliosis
description: Microglia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Microglia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Microglia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Microglia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Suramin
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: NF675 is the product of optimizing the suramin scaffold and is the most potent and selective molecule in the series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. Suramin itself inhibits SIRT1/SIRT2 at nanomolar concentrations with apparent SIRT1 preference, has anticancer activity, and has been studied in clinical trials. Directionally, NF675 inherits suramin's binding mode while improving isoform selectivity. Despite good potency and selectivity, suramin-derived compounds have modest drug-likeness owing to high molecular weight and anionic character, limiting therapeutic translation.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是優化 Suramin 骨架的產物，是該系列中最具活性和選擇性的分子，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。Suramin 本身在奈摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2，具有明顯的 SIRT1 偏好性，具有抗癌活性，並已在臨床試驗中研究。方向性上 NF675 繼承了 Suramin 的結合模式同時提高了同工型選擇性。儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性，Suramin 衍生物由於高分子量和陰離子特性而具有中等的類藥性，限制了治療轉化。

label: David Sinclair
description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: CD38 inhibitor 78c
description: CD38 inhibitor 78c prevents degradation of NMN, prolonging its availability as an NAD+ precursor and amplifying NAD+ and sirtuin activation.
description_zh_TW: CD38 抑制劑 78c 防止 NMN 被降解，延長其作為 NAD+ 前體的可用性，放大 NAD+ 與 sirtuin 活化。

label: DISC
description: Caspase-10 is activated at DISC. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The directionality runs from DISC toward Caspase-10, so DISC is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 在 DISC 啟動。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。方向性從 DISC 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 DISC 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: MTHFD1
description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

label: Mitochondrial Fission
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: VEGFc
description: Full-length VEGF-C preferentially activates VEGFR-3 and promotes lymphatic vessel sprouting, driving lymphangiogenesis. In senescence, this contributes to lymphatic remodeling and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes, shaping how immune cells access senescent tissue. The relationship is the canonical lymphangiogenic function of VEGF-C and expands the vascular consequences of the SASP beyond blood vessels. It is supported by studies of lymphatic development and tumor-associated lymphangiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 全長 VEGF-C 偏好活化 VEGFR-3 並促進淋巴管出芽，驅動淋巴生成。在衰老中，這貢獻淋巴重塑並可能影響免疫細胞遷移路徑，塑造免疫細胞如何接近衰老灶。其淋巴特異性角色補充 VEGF-A 的血血管生成，使 SASP 的血管效應具雙重性。它是連結細胞衰老到淋巴系統重塑的關鍵因子。

label: MET gene
description: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
description_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

label: Rutin
description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

label: Mitochondrial Fusion
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through fusion and fission, two opposing yet coordinated processes that determine mitochondrial number, shape and function. Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network, enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide, and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity; it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion. Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane, and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fusion and fission 兩個 opposing yet coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，determining mitochondrial number, shape and function。Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network，enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide，and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity；it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion。Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane，and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis。

label: Sir2 (yeast)
description: Sir2p protects yeast from toxic accumulation of self-replicating extrachromosomal rDNA circles (ERCs); deletion of the replication-fork-blocking protein Fob1p rescues the short lifespan of sir2 mutants, establishing ERC suppression as the first mechanistic explanation for Sir2's longevity effect. Directionally, Sir2p suppresses ERC accumulation to extend lifespan. By preventing the toxic buildup of these circular DNA molecules, Sir2 preserves genome stability and replicative capacity. This was the first molecular mechanism linking Sir2 to longevity and remains a foundational finding in sirtuin research.
description_zh_TW: Sir2p保護酵母免受自我複製的染色體外rDNA環（ERC）毒性積累的損害；刪除複製叉阻斷蛋白Fob1p可挽救sir2突變體的短壽命，確立ERC抑制是Sir2長壽效應的第一個機制性解釋。方向上，Sir2p抑制ERC積累以延長壽命。透過防止這些環狀DNA分子的毒性積累，Sir2維持基因組穩定性和複製能力。這是第一個將Sir2與長壽聯繫的分子機制，至今仍是sirtuin研究的基礎性發現。

label: HLA-E
description: PD-1 is an inhibitory receptor that, when engaged by its ligands, suppresses T-cell cytotoxicity and is a target of checkpoint inhibitors. In the immune-evasion axis, HLA-E engages the parallel CD94/NKG2A receptor, and both PD-1 and NKG2A pathways blunt killer-cell function against senescent and tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: PD-1 是抑制性受體，被其配體接合時會抑制 T 細胞細胞毒性，是檢查點抑制劑的標靶。在免疫逃逸軸中，HLA-E 接合平行的 CD94/NKG2A 受體，PD-1 與 NKG2A 途徑皆削弱殺手細胞對衰老與腫瘤細胞的功能。

label: Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH)
description: The oxidative deamination of glutamate by GDH yields alpha-ketoglutarate, which feeds the tricarboxylic acid cycle as an anaplerotic substrate. This conversion is central to coupling amino-acid catabolism to energy production in liver, kidney, and brain.
description_zh_TW: GDH 對穀氨酸的氧化脫氨產生 α-酮戊二酸，作為回補受質供應三羧酸循環。此轉化是將胺基酸分解代謝與肝、腎和腦中的能量產生偶聯的核心。

label: Avermectin
description: Avermectin B1a is the natural macrocyclic-lactone precursor of ivermectin (22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a), the semi-synthetic lead derivative developed for human and veterinary medicine.
description_zh_TW: Avermectin B1a 是伊維菌素（22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a）的天然大環內酯前體，伊維菌素是為人類和獸醫開發的半合成先導衍生物。

label: stimulus-response learning
description: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning depends on dopamine signaling within the Striatum, where dorsolateral and dorsomedial striatal circuits integrate cortical and dopaminergic input at medium spiny neurons and enable corticostriatal long-term potentiation. Because striatal dopamine tone is shaped locally by COMT given sparse dopamine transporter expression, COMT activity modulates how readily S-R associations are acquired: elevated COMT accelerates dopamine clearance and slows S-R learning, whereas slower COMT preserves dopamine and facilitates habit formation.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 依賴 Striatum 內的多巴胺訊號傳遞，背外側與背內側紋狀體迴路在 medium spiny neurons 處整合皮質與多巴胺輸入，並促成皮質-紋狀體長期增益。由於紋狀體多巴胺張力在多巴胺轉運蛋白表現稀疏的情況下由 COMT 局部塑造，COMT 活性會調節 S-R 關聯習得的難易：COMT 升高會加速多巴胺清除並減緩 S-R 學習，而 COMT 較慢則保留多巴胺並促進習慣形成。

label: Senolytics
description: Senolytic efficacy and toxicity can reverse between the sexes: fisetin is male-beneficial in C57BL/6 mice (↓SASP, ↑glucose/energy metabolism, ↑cognition) while D+Q is detrimental in females (↑WAT, ↑SASP, ↓cognition); in tauopathy mice both D+Q and fisetin enhanced female cognitive performance; no sex-stratified navitoclax data exist (open gap).
description_zh_TW: 衰老溶解療法的療效與毒性可在兩性間逆轉：fisetin 在 C57BL/6 小鼠中對雄性有益（↓SASP、↑葡萄糖/能量代謝、↑認知），而 D+Q 對雌性有害（↑WAT、↑SASP、↓認知）；在 tau 病小鼠中 D+Q 與 fisetin 皆增強雌性認知表現；navitoclax 尚無性別分層數據（開放缺口）。

label: TGFβ
description: SIRT6 inactivates TGF-beta1/Smad2 signaling to prevent myofibroblast differentiation, inhibits TGF-beta-induced cellular senescence, and blocks EMT during IPF through TGF-beta1/Smad3. SIRT6 is thus a master suppressor of the fibrotic cascade in lung fibrosis, whereas SIRT7 decline has a profibrotic effect via Smad3 changes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 使 TGF-beta1/Smad2 訊號失效以阻止肌纖維母細胞分化，抑制 TGF-beta 誘發的細胞衰老，並在 IPF 中透過 TGF-beta1/Smad3 阻斷 EMT。SIRT6 因此是肺纖維化中纖維化級聯的主抑制因子，而 SIRT7 下降透過 Smad3 變化具有促纖維化效應。

label: Hydroxyurea
description: Hydroxyurea quenches the tyrosyl radical in the RRM2 small subunit of ribonucleotide reductase, inactivating the enzyme. It is used clinically in myeloproliferative neoplasms and is a canonical inducer of DNA replication stress and senescence.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 會淬滅核醣核苷酸還原酶 RRM2 小次單元中的酪胺醯自由基，使酵素失活。它在臨床上用於骨髓增生性腫瘤，並是 DNA 複製壓力與衰老的典型誘導劑。

label: Vitamin E
description: The SELECT trial (Lippman et al., 2009, JAMA, PMID 19066370) found vitamin E supplementation (400 IU/day) increased prostate cancer risk by 17% in healthy men, cited as a key example of antioxidant supplementation failure. The HOPE trial similarly showed no cardiovascular benefit and a trend to increased heart failure.
description_zh_TW: SELECT 試驗（Lippman 等人，2009，JAMA，PMID 19066370）發現維生素 E 補充（400 IU/天）在健康男性中將攝護腺癌風險增加 17%，被引為抗氧化補充失敗的關鍵例子。HOPE 試驗同樣顯示無心血管益處且有心臟衰竭增加的趨勢。

label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues. mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability, reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output. Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction is an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion across aging tissues。mtDNA mutations impair respiration and reshape metabolite availability，reprogramming epigenetic states that govern quiescence, lineage commitment, and regenerative output。Erosion of mitochondrial quality control (fission-fusion balance, mitophagy, UPRmt) permits persistence of ROS-producing organelles and lowers containment of mitochondrial danger signals。In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells, and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence, and diminished regenerative capacity。

label: Amyloid Beta
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Lecanemab (Leqembi) is an FDA-approved anti-amyloid monoclonal antibody for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease with confirmed amyloid; it clears parenchymal Aβ protofibrils and slows cognitive decline by roughly 25–35% while carrying ARIA (edema/microhemorrhage) risk.
description_zh_TW: Lecanemab（Leqembi）是獲 FDA 核准的抗類澱粉單株抗體，用於經確證類澱粉的早期症狀性阿茲海默症；它清除實質 Aβ 原纖維並減緩認知衰退約 25–35%，但帶有 ARIA（水腫／微出血）風險。

label: Diabetes Mellitus
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: SIRT3 is protective in diabetes mellitus: knockout impairs insulin-stimulated muscle glucose uptake leading to insulin resistance. In diabetic cardiomyopathy SIRT3 regulates fibrosis, inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress, attenuating damage via reduced p53 acetylation and PFKFB3 upregulation. Deficiency aggravates hyperglycemic mitochondrial damage, ROS, necroptosis, and NLRP3 activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在糖尿病 mellitus 中具有保護性：基因敲除損害胰島素刺激的肌肉葡萄糖攝取，導致胰島素抗性。在糖尿病性心肌病中，SIRT3 調節纖維化、發炎、凋亡與氧化壓力，經由降低 p53 乙醯化與 PFKFB3 上調來減弱損傷。缺失加劇高血糖粒線體損傷、ROS、壞死性凋亡與 NLRP3 活化。

label: Regulatory T cells
description: Per the 'Old Friends' hypothesis, commensal bacteria, saprophytic mycobacteria and helminths calibrate immune tolerance by inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs); farm exposure and gut Bacteroides/Clostridium pools promote tolerogenic dendritic cells → Treg differentiation, so removing microbial training signals is linked to rising allergy and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: 依「老友」假說，共生菌、腐生分枝桿菌與蠕蟲透過誘導調節性 T 細胞（Tregs）校準免疫耐受；農場暴露與腸道 Bacteroides/Clostridium 族群促進耐受性樹突細胞 → Treg 分化，因此移除微生物訓練訊號與過敏及自體免疫增加相關。

label: Methemoglobin
description: Pulse oximetry non-invasively estimates oxygen saturation, but methemoglobin (and methylene blue) artifactually lowers the reading. In methemoglobinemia, arterial blood gas with co-oximetry should be used instead to resolve the methemoglobin fraction.
description_zh_TW: 脈搏血氧儀非侵入性估算血氧飽和度，但變性血紅素（及 methylene blue）會人為地降低讀數。在變性血紅素血症中，應改用動脈血氣分析與 co-oximetry 以解析變性血紅素比例。

label: HLH-30
description: HLH-30 prevents aging and extends lifespan in C. elegans; hlh-30 mutants are short-lived, and loss of hlh-30 suppresses the longevity conferred by mxl-3 deletion. By driving autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity embodies the conserved mechanism by which enhanced clearance promotes longevity across species. The epistasis with mxl-3 places HLH-30 downstream as the effector of the pro-longevity program.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中防止老化並延長壽命；hlh-30 突變體壽命短，且 hlh-30 的缺失抑制了 mxl-3 缺失所賦予的長壽。透過驅動自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性體現了增強清除能跨越物種促進長壽的保守機制。與 mxl-3 的遺傳上位性將 HLH-30 置於下游，作為促長壽程序的效應物。

label: Silver compounds
description: Silver(I) oxide is used to prepare other silver compounds, serving as a versatile silver precursor in synthetic chemistry. Because it is a stable, readily handled oxidant and silver source, it can be converted into soluble silver salts, coordination complexes, and metal nanoparticles, including the silver oxide nanoparticle dispersions used in antimicrobial and electronic applications. The compound also appears in consumer and industrial products, where its reported functional uses include antimicrobial activity, biocidal action, batteries, and personal care formulations.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)用於製備其他銀化合物，作為合成化學中的多功能銀前體。因其是穩定且易於處理的氧化劑和銀源，可轉化為可溶性銀鹽、配位複合物和金屬奈米粒子，包括用於抗菌和電子應用的氧化銀奈米粒子分散液。該化合物也存在於消費和工業產品中，其報導的功能用途包括抗菌活性、殺菌作用、電池和個人護理配方。

label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
description: Gomez-Cabrera et al. (2008, PMID 18175748) showed oral vitamin C decreases muscle mitochondrial biogenesis and hampers training-induced endurance adaptations. This is among the cleanest human studies showing antioxidant interference with a hormetic stressor (exercise), blunting the necessary acute ROS signal.
description_zh_TW: Gomez-Cabrera 等人（2008，PMID 18175748）顯示口服維生素 C 降低肌肉粒線體生成並妨礙訓練誘發的耐力適應。這是最乾淨的人體研究之一，顯示抗氧化劑干擾促效應壓力源（運動），減弱必要的急性 ROS 訊號。

label: MOMP
description: AIF relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: AIF 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: NADPH Oxidase
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: NADPH oxidase (NOX) enzymes generate superoxide as their primary product and are a major pathological ROS source in the kidney. In angiotensin II-induced nephropathy, SIRT3 counteracts iron overload and inhibits NADPH oxidase-mediated ROS overproduction, attenuating renal fibrogenesis and delaying CKD progression.
description_zh_TW: NADPH 氧化酶（NOX）酵素以超氧陰離子為主要產物，是腎臟中主要的病理性活性氧來源。在血管張力素 II 誘導的腎病變中，SIRT3 對抗鐵過載並抑制 NADPH 氧化酶介導的活性氧過度產生，減輕腎纖維化並延緩 CKD 進展。

label: cGAS-STING Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP. Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。

label: OPA1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。

label: MTRR
description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is a flavoprotein reductase that sustains the activity of methionine synthase by reducing its oxidized cobalt center back to the active Co1+ state. Without continuous reduction by MTRR, the cobalt center becomes oxidized to an inactive form, halting methyl transfer. This reductase step preserves methylation flux.
description_zh_TW: MTRR（methionine synthase reductase）是黃素蛋白還原酶，透過將其氧化的鈷中心還原回活性的 Co1+ 狀態來維持 methionine synthase 的活性。若沒有 MTRR 的持續還原，鈷中心會氧化為不活躍形式，停止甲基轉移。此還原步驟維持甲基化通量。

label: MyD88
description: MyD88 is a cytoplasmic adaptor protein serving as the central hub of Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling, linking receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Its classification as an adaptor reflects its role in assembling signaling complexes rather than performing enzymatic catalysis, and it does so through death domain and TIR domain interactions. In senescence, MyD88 transduces IL-1alpha signals that sustain the SASP, placing it at the interface of innate immunity and senescence. It is a foundational innate immune signaling scaffold conserved across species.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是一種銜接蛋白（adaptor protein），將先天免疫受體如 IL-1R 與 TLR 的胞質訊號域連結到下游 IRAK 激酶與 TRAF6。作為 Toll/IL-1R（TIR）訊號的主要轉接器，其歸類為銜接蛋白反映其在組裝訊號複合體中的支架角色。在衰老中，MyD88 是將 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器連結到 NF-κB 與 SASP 的核心節點。其銜接功能使其成為衰老發炎級聯的中央中樞。

label: Oleacein
description: Oleacein carries a catechol (ortho-dihydroxyphenyl) moiety, making it a classic substrate for COMT O-methylation. It is itself O-methylated by the enzyme, consuming SAMe and methyl groups. This makes oleacein a catechol-bearing phenol that engages COMT as a substrate.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 帶有兒茶酚（鄰二羥苯基）部分，使其成為 COMT O-甲基化的典型受質。它本身會被酶 O-甲基化，消耗 SAMe 和 methyl groups。這使 oleacein 成為以受質身分接合 COMT 的含兒茶酚酚類。

label: Lifespan
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: In the triples graph's parallel-relation inventory, Rapamycin → Lifespan carries both 'extends' (0.96) and 'extends_lifespan_in' (0.96) edges encoding the rapamycin longevity literature (mTOR inhibition); the pair-level union keeps a single relation for the default combined dataset.
description_zh_TW: 在 triples 圖的平行關係清單中，Rapamycin → Lifespan 同時帶有「extends」（0.96）與「extends_lifespan_in」（0.96）兩條邊，編碼 rapamycin 延壽文獻（mTOR 抑制）；成對聯集在預設 combined 資料集中保留單一關係。

label: Nitrative Stress
description: Nitrative stress produces 3-nitrotyrosine (3-NT), the most characteristic and biomedically relevant protein modification of this pathway. 3-NT forms when peroxynitrite-derived radicals (NO2 and carbonate radical) oxidize tyrosine phenolate groups and couple with NO2. Because 3-NT is a stable, unrepairable post-translational modification, it serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of tissue injury in many diseases.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 產生 3-nitrotyrosine（3-NT），這是此途徑最具特徵性且與生物醫學最相關的蛋白質修飾。當 peroxynitrite 衍生的自由基（NO2 和 carbonate radical）氧化酪氨酸酚基並與 NO2 偶聯時，會形成 3-NT。由於 3-NT 是穩定且不可修復的轉譯後修飾，它在許多疾病中既是生物標記也是組織損傷的介導者。

label: ATM Kinase
description: Activation of ATM by DNA double-strand breaks initiates cell-cycle arrest, a principal functional output of the kinase. Through CHK2 and p53, ATM enforces arrest that provides time for repair. This makes ATM a master coordinator of the damage checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: ATM 因 DNA 雙股斷裂而激活，進而啟動細胞週期停滯，這是該激酶的主要功能性輸出。透過 CHK2 和 p53，ATM 強制實施停滯，為修復爭取時間。這使 ATM 成為損傷檢查點的主要協調者。

label: Caspase-2
description: 14-3-3ζ directly inhibits caspase-2 by binding it in a phosphorylation-dependent manner and protecting the Ser135 phosphorylation (deposited by CaMKII) that keeps the apical caspase inactive. This shield is acetylation-sensitive: 14-3-3ζ deacetylated by SIRT1 binds caspase-2 robustly, whereas acetylated 14-3-3ζ dissociates. In Xenopus egg extract, glucose-6-phosphate — which promotes caspase-2/14-3-3ζ binding — enhanced 14-3-3ζ-directed sirtuin activity, while sirtuin inhibition promoted 14-3-3ζ release and caspase-2 activation in both extract and human cells.
description_zh_TW: 14-3-3ζ 以磷酸化依賴方式直接結合 caspase-2 並保護維持其不活化狀態的 Ser135 磷酸化（由 CaMKII 負責），藉此抑制 caspase-2。此保護罩對乙醯化敏感：被 SIRT1 去乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 能穩固結合 caspase-2，而乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 則會解離。在非洲爪蟾卵萃取液中，可促進 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 結合的 glucose-6-phosphate 會增強 14-3-3ζ 導向的 sirtuin 活性；抑制 sirtuin 活性則促使 14-3-3ζ 釋出並活化 caspase-2（於萃取液與人類細胞皆然）。

label: Hormesis
description: IC50 assumes a monotonic dose-response, whereas hormesis produces an inverted-U curve where a drug may be most effective at an intermediate concentration. Hormetic curves therefore challenge the IC50-based framework used in drug development.
description_zh_TW: IC50 假設單調劑量-反應，而毒物興奮效應產生倒 U 型曲線，藥物可能在中間濃度最有效。因此毒物興奮曲線挑戰藥物開發中基於 IC50 的框架。

label: Mitochondrial ROS
description: MnSOD (manganese superoxide dismutase) is the mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme that eliminates superoxide generated during respiration. Its activity is regulated by acetylation, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation increasing MnSOD activity. When NR raises NAD+ and activates SIRT3, MnSOD acetylation decreases, mitochondrial MnSOD activity rises, and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species levels fall. This reduced mitochondrial ROS burden lessens oxidative damage and supports mitochondrial quality control, contributing to NR's protective effects against oxidative stress, inflammasome activation, and age-related mitochondrial dysfunction in tissues such as the myocardium, skeletal muscle, and neurons.
description_zh_TW: MnSOD（錳超氧化物歧化酶）是在呼吸過程中消除所產生的超氧化物的粒線體抗氧化酶。其活性受乙醯化調控，其中 SIRT3 介導的去乙醯化會增加 MnSOD 活性。當 NR 提升 NAD+ 並活化 SIRT3 時，MnSOD 乙醯化下降，粒線體 MnSOD 活性上升，粒線體活性氧物種水平降低。這種減少的粒線體 ROS 負擔減輕了氧化損傷並支持粒線體品質控制，有助於 NR 對氧化壓力、發炎體活化以及心肌、骨骼肌和神經元等組織中與年齡相關的粒線體功能障礙的保護作用。

label: Luteolin
description: Luteolin is a naturally occurring flavone, a subclass of flavonoids, with the chemical structure 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxyflavone. It is abundant in parsley, celery, broccoli, green peppers, thyme, and chamomile. It is among the most studied dietary polyphenols for anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective activities.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 是天然存在的黃酮（flavone），是 Flavonoids 的一個亞類，化學結構為 3',4',5,7-四羥基黃酮。它大量存在於歐芹、芹菜、綠花椰菜、青椒、百里香和洋甘菊中。它是研究最多的膳食多酚之一，具有抗發炎和神經保護活性。

label: Heart Failure
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Levels of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) are significantly decreased in cardiomyocytes from individuals with advanced heart failure, along with MnSOD and Bcl-xL. This loss of the protective thioredoxin system is thought to reduce cardiac resistance to pathologic insults in end-stage disease.
description_zh_TW: 在晚期心臟衰竭患者的心肌細胞中，Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 的濃度會顯著下降，MnSOD 與 Bcl-xL 亦然。此保護性硫氧還蛋白系統的喪失被認為會降低末期疾病中心臟對病理傷害的抵抗能力。

label: Nitric Oxide
description: Myeloperoxidase (MPO) has 'NO oxidase' activity, consuming nitric oxide and thereby contributing to endothelial dysfunction. Because nitric oxide is a key vasodilator, its MPO-mediated consumption shifts the local redox balance and is one way MPO promotes cardiovascular pathology. Elevated MPO levels and activity are associated with increased oxidative stress, cardiovascular risk, and chronic inflammation, and MPO serves as both a biomarker and a mediator of these processes, with its oxidants also modifying LDL into more atherogenic forms.
description_zh_TW: Myeloperoxidase（MPO）具有「NO oxidase」activity，consuming nitric oxide從而contributing to endothelial dysfunction。由於nitric oxide是key vasodilator，其MPO-mediated consumption shifts the local redox balance，是MPO promotes cardiovascular pathology的one way。Elevated MPO levels與activity與increased oxidative stress、cardiovascular risk及chronic inflammation相關，且MPO serves as both a biomarker與a mediator of these processes，其oxidants亦modifying LDL into more atherogenic forms。

label: Methylfolate
description: Methylfolate (L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the primary methyl donor in the Methylation Cycle: it supplies the methyl group that methionine synthase transfers to homocysteine, using MethylB12 as cofactor, to regenerate methionine and ultimately SAMe. As the main circulating folate and the sole folate form that readily crosses the blood-brain barrier, methylfolate directly feeds the methyl pool consumed by COMT; in slow-COMT individuals, high doses can flood the cycle and provoke overmethylation symptoms such as anxiety, irritability, and insomnia.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（L-5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 Methylation Cycle 中的主要甲基供體：它提供 methionine synthase 以 MethylB12 為輔因子轉移至 homocysteine 的甲基，以再生 methionine 並最終生成 SAMe。作為主要循環葉酸且是唯一容易通過血腦屏障的葉酸形式，methylfolate 直接補充 COMT 所消耗的甲基池；在慢速 COMT 個體中，高劑量可能使循環過載，引發焦慮、易怒與失眠等「過度甲基化」症狀。

label: Caspase-8
description: In the extrinsic (death receptor) pathway, FasL or TNF-α engagement assembles the DISC, activating initiator caspase-8 (with caspase-10), which directly cleaves the executioner caspase-3 in type I cells. In type II cells caspase-8 instead cleaves Bid, routing through mitochondria. Caspase-8 sits at the crossroads of apoptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis because its active form also cleaves RIPK1 and RIPK3, preventing necroptosis — so caspase-8-to-caspase-3 flow is simultaneously a death signal and a necroptosis suppressor.
description_zh_TW: 在外在（死亡受體）路徑中，FasL 或 TNF-α 的結合組裝出 DISC，活化起始 caspase-8（與 caspase-10），其在 type I 細胞中直接切割執行者 Caspase-3；在 type II 細胞中 caspase-8 則切割 Bid，改經粒線體路徑。Caspase-8 位於細胞凋亡、程序性壞死與細胞焦亡的十字路口，因為其活化形式也會切割 RIPK1 與 RIPK3 從而阻止程序性壞死——因此 caspase-8 至 Caspase-3 的流動既是死亡訊號，也是程序性壞死的抑制者。

label: CamKIIα
description: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) is a serine/threonine protein kinase central to neuronal signaling, activated by the Ca2+-calmodulin complex downstream of NMDA receptor activation and voltage-gated calcium influx. It is highly abundant in postsynaptic densities, where it phosphorylates numerous substrates including AMPA receptors to encode synaptic strength and plasticity. Its autophosphorylation produces persistent, calcium-independent activity that sustains long-term potentiation. It is therefore a key molecular substrate of activity-dependent plasticity and memory.
description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) 是一種對神經元訊號傳導至關重要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，由 NMDA 受體活化和電壓門控鈣流入下游的 Ca2+-鈣調蛋白複合物活化。它在突觸後密度中高度豐富，可磷酸化包括 AMPA 受體在內的多種底物，以編碼突觸強度和可塑性。其自身磷酸化產生持久的、不依賴鈣的活性，維持長期增強作用。因此，它是活動依賴性可塑性和記憶的關鍵分子底物。

label: Bcl-2
description: Bad is a BH3-only sensitizer: rather than activating BAX/BAK directly, it displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family restraint (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1), indirectly liberating the effectors. IKK-mediated phosphorylation of Bad at Ser26 inactivates it and confers TNFα resistance, and the BH3 mimetic compounds act on the same principle — competitively disrupting Bcl-2/Bcl-xL binding to beclin-1 as well, which releases beclin-1 for autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Bad 是 BH3-only 的敏化因子：它不直接活化 BAX/BAK，而是置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族（Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1）的抑制，間接解放效應蛋白。IKK 對 Bad Ser26 的磷酸化會使其失活並賦予 TNFα 抗性；BH3 擬似劑也基於相同原理——競爭性破壞 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 與 beclin-1 的結合，同時釋出 beclin-1 以促進自噬。

label: Resting Metabolic Rate
description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: Norepinephrine transporter
description: NET terminates noradrenergic signaling by reuptaking norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft back into the presynaptic terminal. It is the principal mechanism for clearing norepinephrine in most brain regions and the periphery. This reuptake is driven by the sodium gradient maintained by Na+/K+-ATPase.
description_zh_TW: NET 透過將 norepinephrine 從突觸間隙再攝取回突觸前終端來終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導。它是大多數 brain 區域和周邊清除 norepinephrine 的主要機制。這種再攝取由 Na+/K+-ATPase 維持的鈉梯度驅動。

label: Thymopoiesis
description: The thymus is a vital organ for homeostatic maintenance of the peripheral immune system. Within its two compartments, the true thymic epithelial space (TES, comprising cortex and medulla) and the perivascular space (PVS), T cells develop, mature, and undergo induction of self-tolerance in a process called thymopoiesis. The cortex hosts early thymocyte development including T cell receptor gene rearrangement and positive selection, while the medulla carries out negative selection to remove autoreactive T cells. The perivascular space, composed of adipocytes, peripheral lymphocytes and stroma, is a non-thymopoietic component.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺是外周免疫系統穩態維持的重要器官。在其兩個隔室——真正的胸腺上皮空間（TES，包含皮質和髓質）和血管周圍空間（PVS）——中，T 細胞發育、成熟並經歷稱為胸腺生成的自身耐受誘導過程。皮質主持早期胸腺細胞發育，包括 T 細胞受體基因重排和陽性選擇，而髓質執行陰性選擇以清除自身反應性 T 細胞。血管周圍空間由脂肪細胞、外周淋巴細胞和基質組成，是非胸腺生成的成分。

label: IDO1
description: IDO1 is controlled post-translationally: phosphorylation of its ITIM motifs recruits SOCS3, leading to ubiquitination and degradation of IDO1 as a negative feedback mechanism. This degradation pathway limits IDO1 activity and terminates its immunosuppressive effects, representing a key regulatory checkpoint. IDO1 can also mediate non-enzymatic signaling such as PI3K activation. IDO2 may compete for heme and act as a negative regulator in some settings. These regulatory layers are important for therapeutic targeting of IDO1, as they influence the durability and magnitude of tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production in the tumor microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: IDO1在翻譯後被控制：其ITIM基序的磷酸化招募SOCS3，導致IDO1的泛素化和降解，作為負反饋機制。這種降解途徑限制IDO1活性並終止其免疫抑製作用，代表一個關鍵的調節檢查點。IDO1還可以介導非酶信號，如PI3K激活。IDO2可能在某些情況下競爭血紅素並作為負調節因子。這些調節層對於IDO1的治療靶向很重要，因為它們影響腫瘤微環境中色氨酸耗竭和犬尿氨酸產生的持久性和幅度。

label: eNOS
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: eNOS-derived nitric oxide activates SIRT1, and SIRT1 deacetylates eNOS to maintain its activity, forming a reciprocal endothelial-protective loop that declines with age; this NO/SIRT1 axis supports cardiovascular healthspan (Mattagajasingh et al., 2007; listed as a positive regulator in the source review's Table 3).
description_zh_TW: eNOS 衍生的一氧化氮活化 SIRT1，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化 eNOS 以維持其活性，形成一個隨年齡衰退的內皮保護性互惠迴圈；這種 NO/SIRT1 軸支持心血管健康跨度（Mattagajasingh et al., 2007；在文獻綜述表 3 中列為正向調節因子）。

label: Hydroxyl Radicals
description: Peroxynitrite generates hydroxyl radicals when its conjugate acid peroxynitrous acid (ONOOH) undergoes homolytic cleavage, producing hydroxyl radical and nitrogen dioxide with roughly a 30 percent yield. The hydroxyl radical is among the most reactive biological oxidants, mediating local lipid peroxidation and DNA damage. This decomposition route extends peroxynitrite's damaging radius beyond the parent molecule.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 在其共軛酸 peroxynitrous acid（ONOOH）進行均裂時生成 hydroxyl radicals，以約 30% 的產率產生羥基自由基和 nitrogen dioxide。Hydroxyl radical 是最具反應性的生物氧化劑之一，介導局部 lipid peroxidation 與 DNA damage。此分解途徑將 peroxynitrite 的破壞半徑延伸至母分子之外。

label: PGC-1α
description: Overexpression of SIRT3 improves the resistance of colorectal cancer (CRC) cells to anticancer drugs in part through regulation of PGC-1α, enhancing mitochondrial biogenesis/antioxidant programs. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of MnSOD-dependent protection in CRC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 過量表現透過調節 PGC-1α、增強粒線體生物合成/抗氧化程序，部分改善大腸直腸癌（CRC）細胞對抗癌藥物的抗性。方向上，SIRT3 位於 CRC 中 MnSOD 依賴性保護的上游。

label: Longevity
description: Dietary protein restriction (PR) is a robust geroprotective regimen that extends lifespan in yeast, flies, and rodents and improves healthspan. Rodent studies demonstrate lifespan extension across many strains (for example, 34.9% in male C57BL/6J mice on a 21% vs 7% protein diet, and large extensions in flies), while restriction of specific essential amino acids - particularly methionine, isoleucine, and valine - recapitulates many of PR's benefits. FGF21-null mice do not live longer on PR, identifying FGF21 as essential for the longevity benefits. The Okinawan population's ~9% protein diet is cited as a human parallel to PR's lifespan effects.
description_zh_TW: 飲食蛋白質限制（PR）是一種強健的抗老化方案，在酵母、果蠅和囓齒動物中延長壽命並改善健康span。囓齒動物研究顯示多種品系的壽命延長（例如，21%對7%蛋白質飲食的雄性C57BL/6J小鼠延長34.9%，果蠅中也有大幅延長），而特定必需胺基酸——特別是甲硫氨酸、異亮氨酸和纈氨酸——的限制重現了PR的許多益處。FGF21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長，確定了FGF21對壽命益處的必要性。沖繩人口約9%蛋白質飲食被引用為人類中與PR壽命效應平行的例子。

label: Colon Cancer
description: Colon Cancer is driven by Wnt Signaling. Constitutive Wnt/β-catenin signaling—initiated by APC loss—is the initiating driver in the majority of sporadic colon cancers, leading to dysplastic aberrant crypt foci and progression along the adenoma-carcinoma sequence.
description_zh_TW: 大腸癌（Colon Cancer）由 Wnt 訊息傳遞（Wnt Signaling）所驅動。由 APC 缺失所啟動的持續 Wnt/β-catenin 訊息傳遞是多數散發性大腸癌的起始驅動因子，導致發育不良的異常隱窩病灶，並沿腺瘤-癌序列進展。

label: Thioredoxin-1
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。

label: DNMT1
description: SIRT1 modulates the activity of DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1) by deacetylating it. Deacetylation of DNMT1 at certain lysine residues improves its methyltransferase activity, alters its transcription suppression activity, and impairs its ability to silence tumour suppressor genes. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of DNMT1 enzymatic activity and thus influences DNA methylation patterns and gene silencing, providing a direct molecular link between sirtuins and the epigenetic machinery.
