description_zh_TW: SIRT1透過去乙醯化來調節DNA甲基轉移酶1（DNMT1）的活性。DNMT1在特定賴氨酸殘基的去乙醯化改善了其甲基轉移酶活性，改變了其轉錄抑制活性，並損害了其沉默腫瘤抑制基因的能力。方向上，SIRT1位於DNMT1酵素活性的上游，從而影響DNA甲基化模式和基因沉默，提供了sirtuin與表觀遺傳機制之間的直接分子聯繫。

label: Estrogen
description: Estrogen (E2) transcriptionally upregulates MnSOD (SOD2), giving premenopausal females higher SOD2 protein abundance and enhanced mitochondrial antioxidant capacity that lowers oxidative damage. This female advantage is lost at menopause as estrogen declines, and the SOD2 Ala16Val polymorphism shows sex-specific cancer associations (stronger in males for prostate/lung, females for breast).
description_zh_TW: 雌激素（E2）在轉錄層面上調 MnSOD（SOD2），使停經前女性具較高的 SOD2 蛋白豐度與較強的粒線體抗氧化能力，進而降低氧化損傷。此女性優勢會因停經後雌激素下降而喪失，SOD2 Ala16Val 多型性亦呈現性別特異的癌症關聯（男性較強於攝護腺/肺癌，女性於乳癌）。

label: HIF-1α
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: SIRT3 destabilizes hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha), thereby attenuating the Warburg effect, a characteristic metabolic adaptation of rapidly proliferating tumors. Transcriptomic profiling in castration-resistant prostate cancer reveals that SIRT3 also suppresses aconitase 2 activation, disrupting glutamine-driven lipogenesis, supporting SIRT3's predominantly tumor-suppressive metabolic role in early oncogenic transformation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 不穩定化缺氧誘導因子 1alpha（HIF-1alpha），從而減輕 Warburg 效應——快速增殖腫瘤的特徵性代謝適應。去勢抗性前列腺癌的轉錄體分析顯示 SIRT3 還抑制烏頭酸酶 2 的活化，干擾穀氨醯胺驅動的脂肪合成，支持 SIRT3 在早期致癌轉化中以腫瘤抑制性代謝角色為主。

label: Glycolysis
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SIRT6 suppresses glycolysis and metabolic reprogramming in hepatocellular carcinoma by deacetylating hnRNP A1, and USP48-stabilized SIRT6 further attenuates glycolysis. In lung cancer the same metabolic suppression enhances radiosensitivity, although SIRT6 has a pro-carcinogenic dual role there through snail-dependent transrepression of KLF4 that drives EMT and metastasis. Overall SIRT6 acts as a metabolic tumor suppressor across most cancers.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化 hnRNP A1 抑制肝細胞癌中的糖解與代謝重編程，且 USP48 穩定的 SIRT6 進一步減弱糖解。在肺癌中，相同的代謝抑制增強放射敏感性，儘管 SIRT6 在該處透過 snail 依賴的 KLF4 轉錄抑制（驅動 EMT 與轉移）具有促癌的雙重角色。整體而言，SIRT6 在多數癌症中作為代謝腫瘤抑制因子。

label: Ascorbic Acid
description: Ascorbic acid reduces adrenochrome (conf 0.75) and inhibits adrenochrome formation (conf 0.9) by scavenging the oxidizing species that drive epinephrine oxidation — the redox-counterpart edge placing ascorbate on the trigger side of the graph's Fiedler seam.
description_zh_TW: 抗壞血酸還原 adrenochrome（conf 0.75）並藉清除驅動腎上腺素氧化的氧化物種抑制 adrenochrome 形成（conf 0.9）——此氧化還原對應邊把抗壞血酸置於圖 Fiedler 接縫的觸發器側。

label: Lysosome
description: Atg14L promotes the fusion of mature autophagosomes with the lysosome by binding the tethering factor Syntaxin 17, completing autophagic flux. This positions Atg14L not only in initiation but also in the lysosomal degradation step of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Atg14L 透過結合繫鏈因子 Syntaxin 17 促進成熟自噬體與溶酶體的融合，完成自噬流。這使 Atg14L 不僅參與起始，也參與自噬的溶酶體降解步驟。

label: Silver
description: Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47. It occurs naturally in its pure, free form, as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Silver itself is generally not toxic to humans, although most silver salts are toxic, and chronic accumulation can deposit metallic silver in tissues, producing the permanent blue-gray condition known as argyria that is disfiguring but not otherwise harmful to health. The distinction between benign elemental silver and toxic ionic silver salts is fundamental to understanding silver exposure.
description_zh_TW: 銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47。它自然存在於純淨游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。銀本身通常對人體無毒，但大多數銀鹽有毒，慢性積累可在組織中沉積金屬銀，導致稱為argyria的永久性藍灰色病變，雖毀容但對健康無其他損害。良性的元素銀與有毒的離子銀鹽之間的區別對理解銀暴露至關重要。

label: Methyl groups
description: Methyl groups, the one-carbon units transferred by methylation reactions, are regenerated by the Methylation Cycle: after SAMe donates a methyl group (e.g., to COMT for catechol inactivation), the resulting homocysteine is remethylated back to methionine using Methylfolate and MethylB12, so the methyl-donor pool is continuously replenished. The Methylation Cycle is therefore the metabolic engine that sustains methyl-group supply for COMT and other methyltransferases.
description_zh_TW: Methyl groups 是甲基化反應所轉移的一碳單元，由 Methylation Cycle 再生：SAMe 捐出甲基（例如給 COMT 用於 catechol 去活化）後，產生的 homocysteine 會藉由 Methylfolate 與 MethylB12 再甲基化回 methionine，使甲基供體池持續補充。因此 Methylation Cycle 是維持 COMT 及其他甲基轉移酶甲基供應的代謝引擎。

label: Melatonin
description: Melatonin upregulates SIRT3, which promotes mitophagy to mitigate oxidative stress-induced damage, and SIRT3 knockout completely abolishes melatonin's benefits against contrast-induced AKI. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin promotes autophagy, reduces apoptosis, and mitigates mitochondrial dysfunction by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154 acting as a pivotal molecular switch for mitophagic flux.
description_zh_TW: Melatonin 上調 SIRT3，後者促進粒線體自噬以減輕氧化壓力誘導的損傷，且 SIRT3 基因敲除完全消除 melatonin 對比劑誘導 AKI 的保護益處。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙，其中 SIRT3 介導的 TFAM 在 Lys154 處的去乙醯化作為粒線體自噬通量的關鍵分子開關。

label: Paracrine Senescence
description: Paracrine (bystander) senescence is induced when SASP factors secreted by senescent cells act on neighboring healthy cells, pushing them into a senescent arrest. Factors such as IL-1a, TGFb, VEGF, and CCL2 transmit the signal, often via NF-kB and SMAD pathways in recipients, and the process can be amplified by inflammasome-mediated IL-1 family signaling. This spreads the arrested phenotype through tissues, amplifying senescence impact beyond the initiating cells. The directionality is outward and feed-forward, though it requires susceptible recipient cells.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌（旁觀者）衰老由衰老細胞分泌的 SASP 因子作用於鄰近健康細胞、將其推入衰老停滯而誘發。IL-1α、TGFb、VEGF 與 CCL2 等因子傳遞訊號，常經由受體細胞中的 NF-κB 與 SMAD 路徑，且此過程可被發炎體介導的 IL-1 家族訊號放大。這透過組織擴散停滯表型，放大超出起始細胞的衰老影響。其方向性向外且正向迴圈，但需易受影响的受體細胞。

label: Heart Rate Variability
description: Chronically elevated cortisol, from stacked stressors or poor recovery, suppresses heart-rate variability (HRV) and impairs mitochondrial biogenesis. Acute cortisol release supports the fight-or-flight response, but sustained elevation undermines parasympathetic recovery and HRV rebound.
description_zh_TW: 長期升高的 cortisol（源自疊加壓力或恢復不足）會抑制心率變異度（HRV）並損害粒線體生合成。急性 cortisol 釋放支持戰或逃反應，但持續升高會破壞副交感恢復與 HRV 反彈。

label: D2 receptor
description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: Insulin Resistance
description: High circulating branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) levels - leucine, isoleucine, and valine - are associated with obesity, insulin resistance, and mortality in humans. High-BCAA diets promote obesity, insulin resistance, inflammation, and decreased lifespan in rodents, whereas dietary restriction of BCAAs promotes metabolic health, reduces frailty, and extends lifespan, recapitulating many benefits of protein restriction. BCAA restriction reduces mTORC1 signaling, induces Fgf21, reduces hepatic cellular senescence, and in human studies improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis while increasing circulating FGF21. Although BCAAs are often considered as a group, each individual BCAA plays distinct roles in aging.
description_zh_TW: 循環中高濃度的支鏈胺基酸（BCAA）——白胺酸（leucine）、異白胺酸（isoleucine）與纈胺酸（valine）——與人類的肥胖、胰島素阻抗及死亡率相關。高BCAA飲食會在囓齒類中促進肥胖、胰島素阻抗、發炎並縮短壽命；而膳食限制BCAA則可促進代謝健康、減少衰弱並延長壽命，重現蛋白質限制的許多益處。限制BCAA可降低mTORC1訊息傳導、誘導Fgf21、減少肝臟細胞衰老；在人體研究中則可改善胰島素敏感性與葡萄糖/胰島素恆定，同時提高循環中的FGF21。儘管BCAA常被視為一個群體，但每一種BCAA在衰老中都扮演著不同的角色。

label: Partial Reprogramming
description: Reprogramming encompasses Partial Reprogramming as its in vivo, cyclic, non-pluripotent regime: short pulses of OSKM factor expression erase epigenetic age marks without full loss of cell identity, avoiding teratoma risk and targeting rejuvenation of aged tissues.
description_zh_TW: Reprogramming 涵蓋 Partial Reprogramming 此一體內、間歇性、不進入多能性的重編程模式：短暫的 OSKM 因子表現脈衝能在不完全喪失細胞身份的情況下清除表觀年齡標記，避免畸胎瘤風險，並以年老組織的年輕化為目標。

label: Cellular Reprogramming
description: Cellular reprogramming erases somatic DNA methylation and other epigenetic marks to reset the cell to a pluripotent state. During iPSC generation, the Yamanaka factors promote active and passive demethylation of pluripotency gene promoters while somatic gene methylation is lost, and this global epigenetic reset is required for establishing the pluripotency gene network. The erasure of DNA methylation is a defining feature of the stochastic and deterministic phases of reprogramming. This epigenetic reset is what enables a differentiated cell to regain full developmental potential.
description_zh_TW: 細胞重編程會消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化和其他表觀遺傳標記，從而將細胞重置為多能狀態。在 iPSC 生成過程中，山中因子促進多能性基因啟動子主動和被動去甲基化，同時體細胞基因甲基化丟失，這種全局表觀遺傳重置是建立多能性基因網絡所必需的。 DNA 甲基化的消除是重編程隨機階段和確定性階段的決定性特徵。這種表觀遺傳重置使分化細胞能夠重新獲得全部發育潛力。

label: Lung Cancer
description: Serum SIRT3 distinguishes lung cancer patients from healthy controls with an AUC of 0.918, sensitivity of 86.4%, and specificity of 94%. High SIRT1-3 expression correlates with poor survival in NSCLC. In the tumor SIRT3 reduces cisplatin resistance through the FoxO3/CDT1 axis and promotes DNA repair and radioresistance via ATM-Chk2, illustrating how a single sirtuin affects both diagnosis and therapy response.
description_zh_TW: 血清 SIRT3 區分肺癌患者與健康對照，AUC 為 0.918，敏感度 86.4%，特異度 94%。SIRT1-3 高度表現與 NSCLC 不良存活相關。在腫瘤中 SIRT3 透過 FoxO3/CDT1 軸降低 cisplatin 抗性，並經由 ATM-Chk2 促進 DNA 修復與放射抗性，說明單一 sirtuin 如何同時影響診斷與治療反應。

label: Integrin
description: Integrin couples to Metabolism through adhesion- and ligand-dependent signaling: integrin engagement activates PI3K-AKT, and the alphaVbeta5 heterodimer serves as the endocrine receptor for the myokine Irisin, transducing exercise-related cues into metabolic, bone, and neurotrophic responses in osteocytes, adipocytes, and other targets.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 透過黏附與配體依賴性訊息傳遞與 Metabolism 相耦聯：integrin 結合配體後活化 PI3K-AKT，而 alphaVbeta5 異源二聚體作為肌動素 Irisin 的內分泌受體，將運動相關訊號轉導為骨細胞、脂肪細胞及其他標的細胞中的代謝、骨骼與神經營養反應。

label: MicroRNA
description: The double-stranded RNA-binding domain (dsRBD) binds double-stranded RNA in a structure-specific manner and positions RNA substrates for processing enzymes. DGCR8 and Dicer use tandem dsRBDs to recognize and process microRNA precursors.
description_zh_TW: 雙股 RNA 結合結構域（dsRBD）以結構特異方式結合雙股 RNA，並將 RNA 受質定位給加工酶。DGCR8 與 Dicer 利用串聯 dsRBD 來辨識與加工 microRNA 前驅物。

label: Tubulin
description: SIRT1 deacetylates α-tubulin (confidence ~0.9 in the source review), a direct substrate edge recovered by the node analysis as part of the sirtuin target/substrate catalogue.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 α-tubulin（來源回顧中置信度約 0.9），是節點分析從 sirtuin 受質目錄中還原的直接受質邊。

label: Akt
description: Akt signaling is associated with inhibition of SIRT2-dependent cell-cycle and stress outputs (e.g., cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates SIRT2 at Ser331 to reduce its deacetylase activity), placing AKT signaling among negative regulators of the SIRT2 pathway (Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304).
description_zh_TW: Akt 信號與 SIRT2 依賴性的細胞週期和壓力輸出的抑制相關（例如 cyclin E-CDK2 在 Ser331 處磷酸化 SIRT2 以降低其去乙醯酶活性），將 AKT 信號列為 SIRT2 通路的負向調節因子（Pandithage et al., 2008, J Cell Biol, PMID 18504304）。

label: Caspase-9
description: During apoptosis the initiator caspase-9 directly cleaves SIRT1 (Sir2α), the NAD+-dependent deacetylase that normally restrains p53- and FOXO-driven death programs. Cleavage is caspase-dependent: dominant-negative caspase-9 blocks both the lower-molecular-weight SIRT1 band and its nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization in TNF-α-treated HeLa cells. Because caspase-9 sits at the top of the intrinsic cascade, SIRT1 dismantling begins early in the apoptotic process rather than as a late cleanup event. This is the founding observation of the caspase-to-sirtuin feedback direction.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞凋亡過程中，起始半胱天冬酶-9（Caspase-9）會直接切割 SIRT1（Sir2α）——這個通常抑制 p53 與 FOXO 死亡程序的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶。切割是 caspase 依賴性的：顯性負向 Caspase-9 同時阻斷了 TNF-α 處理的 HeLa 細胞中較低分子量的 SIRT1 條帶及其由細胞核向細胞質的重新定位。由於 Caspase-9 位於內在級聯的頂端，SIRT1 的瓦解在細胞凋亡早期即已開始，而非晚期的清理事件。這是 caspase 至 sirtuin 回饋方向的奠基性觀察。

label: Information Theory of Aging
description: The Information Theory of Aging posits that aging arises from the loss of epigenetic and nuclear-architectural information. The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a mechanistic instantiation of this theory, in which repeated modifier relocalization erodes the epigenetic landscape.
description_zh_TW: 老化資訊理論主張老化源於表觀遺傳與核架構資訊的喪失。染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說是此理論的機制性落實，其中修飾因子反覆易位會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀。

label: BAX
description: Activated BAX (with BAK) drives opening of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, causing cytochrome c to diffuse into the cytosol where it nucleates the apoptosome with Apaf-1 and caspase-9. BH3-only activators (Bid, Bim, PUMA) can directly engage BAX/BAK, while sensitizers (Bad, Noxa, Bik) displace the anti-apoptotic Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Mcl-1 restraint. The pore event is the point of no return separating transcriptional death decisions from caspase execution.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 BAX（與 BAK）會驅動粒線體通透性轉換孔開啟，使 cytochrome c 擴散進入細胞質，並與 Apaf-1 及 Caspase-9 組裝凋亡體。BH3-only 活化因子（Bid、Bim、PUMA）可直接結合 BAX/BAK，而敏化因子（Bad、Noxa、Bik）則置換抗凋亡的 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 與 Mcl-1。孔道開啟是區分轉錄層面死亡決定與 caspase 執行的不可逆節點。

label: Glutaminase
description: CB-839 (telaglenastat) selectively inhibits glutaminase GLS1, blocking the conversion of glutamine to glutamate and cutting off the anaplerotic glutamine flux into the TCA cycle. As monotherapy it shows limited efficacy in unselected triple-negative breast cancer; but in MYC-high tumors — which rewire the TCA cycle to glutamine-derived carbon — CB-839 combined with Complex I inhibitors (mubritinib, metformin) collapses both anaplerosis and NAD+ regeneration, creating a synthetic-lethal vulnerability.
description_zh_TW: CB-839（telaglenastat）選擇性抑制麩胺酸酶 GLS1，阻斷麩胺醯胺轉換為麩胺酸，並切斷進入 TCA 循環的回補性麩胺醯胺通量。作為單一藥物，其在未經選擇的三陰性乳腺癌中療效有限；但在 MYC-high 腫瘤——其 TCA 循環已重接為麩胺醯胺碳源——CB-839 與 Complex I 抑制劑（mubritinib、metformin）併用會同時瓦解回補作用與 NAD+ 再生，形成合成致死的脆弱性。

label: Metformin
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Metformin, a first-line treatment for diabetes, prevents the progression of heart failure and improves left ventricular function by activating AMPK and PGC-1alpha within the mitochondrial dynamics regulation pathway. It thereby modulates fusion/fission balance in the failing heart. Beyond metformin, other drugs such as melatonin and liraglutide reduce cardiac fibrosis, inflammatory responses and myocardial death by promoting mitophagy, while valsartan inhibits Parkin activity or mitophagy, alleviating left ventricular hypertrophy and increasing mitochondrial biogenesis in experimental hypertension.
description_zh_TW: Metformin是糖尿病的一線治療藥物，通過在粒線體動態調節路徑中活化AMPK和PGC-1alpha來防止心臟衰竭惡化並改善左心室功能。 thereby調節衰竭心臟中的融合/分裂平衡。除了metformin，其他藥物如melatonin和liraglutide通過促進mitophagy來減少心臟纖維化、炎症反應和心肌細胞死亡，而valsartan則抑制Parkin活性或mitophagy，緩解實驗性高血壓中的左心室肥大並增加粒線體生物發生。

label: Liver
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Once absorbed into the circulation, urolithin A undergoes further metabolism through multiple metabolic pathways, with the liver playing a central role. Metabolic enzymes present in the liver convert urolithin A into its mercaptan and sulfate forms. Hepatic enzyme inducers such as rifampicin and carbamazepine can increase the activity of these metabolic enzymes, accelerating urolithin A metabolism and reducing its half-life in the body, whereas enzyme inhibitors such as clarithromycin slow its metabolism and clearance and can lead to accumulation of urolithin A.
description_zh_TW: 一旦吸收進入循環系統，urolithin A 會經由多條代謝途徑進一步代謝，其中肝臟扮演核心角色。肝臟中的代謝酶將 urolithin A 轉化為其硫醇（mercaptan）與硫酸鹽（sulfate）形式。肝臟酶誘導劑如 rifampicin 與 carbamazepine 可提升這些代謝酶的活性，加速 urolithin A 的代謝並縮短其在體內的半衰期；而酶抑制劑如 clarithromycin 則減緩其代謝與清除，可能導致 urolithin A 蓄積。

label: Nicotinamide
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide, a product of the sirtuin deacetylation reaction itself, is a micromolar non-competitive inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 that interacts with the C (nicotinamide) pocket of the catalytic site. It was one of the first endogenous compounds studied as a sirtuin inhibitor and inspired the search for NAD+ and nicotinamide analogs. SIRT1 inhibition with nicotinamide was reported to have anticancer activity in B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia and prostate cancer. Its limitations, and those of NAD+ analogs, lie in modest potency and limited therapeutic potential, which motivated development of more potent scaffolds.
description_zh_TW: 尼可醯胺是 sirtuin 去乙醯化反應本身的產物，是 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的微摩爾級非競爭性抑制劑，與催化位點的 C（尼可醯胺）口袋相互作用。它是最早被研究作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的內源性化合物之一，並啟發了 NAD+ 和尼可醯胺類似物的搜索。利用尼可醯胺抑制 SIRT1 據報導在 B 細胞慢性淋巴性白血病和前列腺癌中具有抗癌活性。其局限性，以及 NAD+ 類似物的局限性，在於效能有限和治療潛力不足，這促進了更強效骨架結構的開發。

label: Senescent Cells
description: Targeting mitochondrial citrate metabolism suppresses inflammation across tissues and improves tissue function and healthspan during ageing without detectable changes in p16 or p21 expression, consistent with SASP modulation rather than senolytic clearance of senescent cells. In aged muscle, senescent-like nuclei defined by the CoreScence gene signature are present at similar abundance and distribution across conditions despite reduced SASP-associated transcription and chromatin accessibility at loci such as Ccl2 and Igfbp4. In the liver, the abundance of p16-positive and/or p21-positive cells remains unchanged while their nuclear histone acetylation is reduced by CTPI2 treatment.
description_zh_TW: 靶向線粒體枸櫞酸代謝抑制多個組織中的炎症，並在老化過程中改善組織功能和健康壽命，而p16或p21表達沒有可檢測到的變化，這與SASP調節而非衰老細胞的senolytic清除一致。在老年肌肉中，由CoreScence基因特徵定義的衰老樣細胞核在不同條件下以相似的豐度和分佈存在，儘管SASP相關轉錄和染色質可及性在Ccl2和Igfbp4等位點降低。在肝臟中，p16陽性和/或p21陽性細胞的豐度保持不變，而它們的細胞核組蛋白乙酰化被CTPI2治療降低。

label: Hydrogen Peroxide
description: MnSOD (SOD2) dismutates mitochondrial superoxide into hydrogen peroxide (O2- → H2O2), positioning SOD2 as a 'source of H2O2' (He et al., Trends Biochem Sci 2016) rather than merely a superoxide sink. The H2O2 it generates is then the substrate of the peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin water-evolving arm.
description_zh_TW: MnSOD（SOD2）將粒線體超氧化物歧化為過氧化氫（O2- → H2O2），使 SOD2 被定位為「H2O2 的來源」（He et al., Trends Biochem Sci 2016），而非單純的超氧化物清除者。其所產生的 H2O2 隨後成為過氧化還原酶／硫氧還原蛋白產水臂的受質。

label: Neuroprotection
description: SIRT1 confers neuroprotection by deacetylating FOXO and PGC-1alpha to drive antioxidant and mitochondrial programs, suppressing NF-kB-mediated neuroinflammation, and promoting non-amyloidogenic APP processing via ADAM10; it protects against beta-amyloid toxicity and supports BDNF expression through Hes1 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 FOXO 和 PGC-1alpha 來驅動抗氧化和粒線體程序，抑制 NF-kB 介導的神經發炎反應，並透過 ADAM10 促進非類澱粉樣 APP 處理，從而賦予神經保護作用；它保護免受 β-類澱粉毒性並透過 Hes1 去乙醯化支持 BDNF 表達。

label: Tumor Microenvironment
description: Immune evasion is a hallmark of cancer whereby cells subvert immune surveillance through checkpoint molecules and an immunosuppressive milieu. The tumor microenvironment is a constellation of elements that can exclude or tolerize cytotoxic lymphocytes, reinforcing evasion.
description_zh_TW: 免疫逃逸是癌症的特徵，細胞透過檢查點分子與免疫抑制環境規避免疫監視。腫瘤微環境是能排除或耐受化細胞毒性淋巴球的元素集合，強化逃逸。

label: Protein Restriction
description: FGF21 is the primary endocrine mediator of protein restriction's metabolic benefits. PR robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats, and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of PR's effects - increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure, and extended lifespan. Other geroprotective diets including calorie restriction, methionine restriction, BCAA restriction, and isoleucine restriction also induce FGF21. Mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30% (males) and ~40% (females) lifespan extension, while Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR. FGF21 also suppresses senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue and reduces hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in obese models.
description_zh_TW: FGF21是蛋白質限制代謝益處的主要內分泌介質。PR在小鼠、大鼠和人類中強力提升FGF21，FGF21是PR許多效應所必需的——增加食物攝入、減少體重、增加能量消耗和延長壽命。其他抗老化飲食包括熱量限制、甲硫氨酸限制、BCAA限制和異亮氨酸限制也誘導FGF21。過表達Fgf21的小鼠顯示約30%（雄性）和約40%（雌性）的壽命延長，而Fgf21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長。FGF21也抑制白色脂肪組織的衰老和發炎，並減少肥胖模型中的肝臟脂肪變性和纖維化。

label: Aspirin
description: Aspirin not only reduces inflammation, a hallmark of aging, it also reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease, thrombosis and cancer; low-dose aspirin prevents one-third of colorectal, gastric and esophageal cancers. Millions of people take aspirin daily to prevent cardiovascular disease and cancer, and it was calculated that the benefits of aspirin are greater than its risks despite side effects including life-threatening gastric bleeding. The author argues that the benefits of the anti-aging effects of rapamycin and everolimus may be even greater, and that aspirin can be combined with rapamycin in an anti-aging formulation.
description_zh_TW: 阿斯匹靈（aspirin）不僅能減少發炎——衰老的特徵之一——還能降低心血管疾病、血栓與癌症的風險；低劑量阿斯匹靈可預防三分之一的結直腸癌、胃癌與食道癌。數百萬人每天服用阿斯匹靈以預防心血管疾病與癌症；據估算，儘管有包括危及生命的胃出血等副作用，阿斯匹靈的益處仍大於風險。作者主張，雷帕黴素（rapamycin）與依維莫司（everolimus）的抗衰老效果益處可能更大，且阿斯匹靈可與雷帕黴素合併納入抗衰老配方。

label: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
description: Transient OSKM expression erases cell identity and yields induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). iPSCs enable patient-specific disease modeling, drug discovery, and regenerative applications, including the first iPSC clinical trial for macular degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 短暫的 OSKM 表現會抹除細胞身分並產生誘導多能幹細胞（iPSC）。iPSC 促成患者特異性的疾病建模、藥物發現和再生應用，包括第一個黃斑部退化 iPSC 臨床試驗。

label: Irisin
description: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.
description_zh_TW: Irisin 是運動誘導的 FNDC5 裂解產物，在糖尿病牙周炎模型中發揮抗氧化和骨保護作用，這些作用需要 SIRT3：慢病毒 SIRT3 沉默消除其對抗破骨細胞性牙槽骨吸收和活性氧過度產生的保護，確立 SIRT3 為必要訊號節點。

label: IL-6
description: IL-6 is a defining component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that drives inflammaging and feed-forward tissue dysfunction (recorded as 'is_a_component_of' 0.96 and 'is_upregulated_in' 0.95 on the parallel pair IL-6 → SASP).
description_zh_TW: IL-6 是衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的定義性組分——衰老細胞促發炎分泌體，驅動發炎性老化與前饋式組織失能（平行對 IL-6 → SASP 上記為「is_a_component_of」0.96 與「is_upregulated_in」0.95）。

label: Lipid Peroxidation
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Ferroptosis is a regulated cell death pathway driven by the toxic accumulation of lipid peroxides. Cells die in ferroptosis when they lose the ability to regulate fats, and polyunsaturated fatty acids in membranes become the substrates for peroxidative damage. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that staves off ferroptosis. The pathway is iron-dependent and has been linked to aging and neurodegeneration, including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. Understanding lipid-peroxide accumulation as the central executioner mechanism explains why membrane lipid remodeling - such as that caused by acid ceramidase - can sensitize cells to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: Ferroptosis是一種受調控的細胞死亡途徑，由脂質過氧化物的毒性累積所驅動。當細胞失去調節脂肪的能力時，便會死於ferroptosis，而膜中的多元不飽和脂肪酸成為過氧化損傷的受質。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。此途徑依賴鐵，並已被連結至老化與神經退化，包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症。理解脂質過氧化物累積作為核心執行者機制，說明了為何膜脂質重塑——例如由酸性神經醯胺酶（acid ceramidase）所引起的重塑——能使細胞對ferroptosis敏感化。

label: Methemoglobinemia
description: Pulse oximetry non-invasively estimates oxygen saturation, but methemoglobin (and methylene blue) artifactually lowers the reading. In methemoglobinemia, arterial blood gas with co-oximetry should be used instead to resolve the methemoglobin fraction.
description_zh_TW: 脈搏血氧儀非侵入性估算血氧飽和度，但變性血紅素（及 methylene blue）會人為地降低讀數。在變性血紅素血症中，應改用動脈血氣分析與 co-oximetry 以解析變性血紅素比例。

label: Epigenetic Clock
description: Reprogramming — from Yamanaka-factor iPSC generation to cyclic partial reprogramming in vivo — is the only intervention shown to reverse DNA methylation age while restoring chromatin organization, mitochondrial function, and senescence burden toward youthful states. Partial reprogramming interrupts the process early enough to erase epigenetic marks without losing cell identity, making the epigenetic clock both the readout and the target. This is also the strongest causal evidence that aging is substantially information loss rather than damage accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 重編程——從 Yamanaka 因子的 iPSC 生成到體內的週期性部分重編程——是目前唯一被證明可逆轉 DNA 甲基化年齡的介入方式，同時使染色質組織、粒線體功能與老化負擔朝年輕狀態恢復。部分重編程會在足夠早期的階段中止，以在不喪失細胞身份的前提下抹除表觀遺傳標記，使表觀遺傳時鐘既是測量指標也是作用標的。這也是「老化主要是資訊丟失而非損傷累積」這一論點最強的因果證據。

label: Flavonoids
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Dietary catechols include flavonoids such as quercetin, fisetin, and luteolin, which bear the ortho-dihydroxy motif recognized by COMT. These flavonoid catechols can inhibit COMT competitively and modulate methylation load. In slow COMT individuals, high-dose catechol flavonoids may further inhibit an already sluggish enzyme.
description_zh_TW: 飲食中的 Catechols 包含類黃酮，例如槲皮素、非瑟酮和木犀草素，它們帶有 COMT 可識別的鄰二羥基結構。這些類黃酮兒茶酚可競爭性抑制 COMT 並調節甲基負荷。在緩慢的 COMT 個體中，高劑量的兒茶酚類黃酮可能進一步抑制本已遲緩的酶。

label: synaptic plasticity
description: CaMKIIalpha is essential for synaptic plasticity, including long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD), by phosphorylating AMPA receptor subunits and structural proteins that consolidate changes in synaptic efficacy. Inhibition or knockout of CaMKIIalpha abolishes LTP at many synapses, confirming its necessity. Its autophosphorylation at threonine 286 generates calcium-independent activity that maintains potentiated transmission over time. It thus serves as a molecular switch converting transient calcium signals into lasting synaptic memory.
description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha 對於 synaptic plasticity 至關重要，包括長時程增強 (LTP) 和長時程抑制 (LTD)，透過磷酸化 AMPA 受體亞基和結構蛋白來鞏固突觸功效的變化。抑製或敲除 CaMKIIalpha 可消除許多突觸的 LTP，證實了其必要性。其蘇氨酸 286 處的自磷酸化產生不依賴鈣的活性，可隨著時間的推移維持增強的傳輸。因此，它充當分子開關，將瞬態鈣訊號轉換為持久的突觸記憶。

label: RAGE
description: RAGE binds HMGB1 (amphoterin), as well as members of the S100 protein family, amyloid beta oligomers, and other ligands, making it a multi-ligand pattern-recognition receptor. This broad ligand repertoire positions RAGE as a sensor for damage-associated molecular patterns in sterile inflammation. Each ligand class activates overlapping but distinct downstream signaling profiles.
description_zh_TW: RAGE 結合 HMGB1（amphoterin），以及 S100 protein family 成員、amyloid beta 寡聚體和其他配體，使其成為多配體模式識別受體。這種廣泛的配體庫使 RAGE 成為無菌性發炎中損傷相關分子模式的感測器。每一類配體都活化重疊但截然不同的下游訊號輪廓。

label: Thymic Involution
description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

label: DRP1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family. Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes. DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts).
description_zh_TW: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family。Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes。DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts)。

label: Melanoma
description: Oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) is the permanent cell-cycle arrest triggered in cells carrying BRAF/RAS/MYC mutations. The benign melanocytic nevus (mole) is the in-vivo embodiment of OIS and prevents melanoma; bypass of OIS via p53/PTEN loss or TERT activation is required for malignancy. Capped, arrested growth is therefore tumor-suppressive.
description_zh_TW: 致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS）是在帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 突變的細胞中觸發的永久性細胞週期停滯。良性黑色素細胞痣（痣）是 OIS 的體內體現，並防止黑色素瘤；經由 p53/PTEN 缺失或 TERT 活化繞過 OIS 是惡性化所必需的。受封頂、停滯的生長因此是腫瘤抑制性的。

label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
description: SIRT3 expression is lower in HCC tissue than in adjacent tissue. Modulating SIRT3 enhances sorafenib therapy, and SIRT3 downregulates GST-pi1 to enhance chemo- and sorafenib-induced apoptosis. Its loss therefore correlates with tumor aggressiveness and reduced treatment efficacy in hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 HCC 組織中的表現低於鄰近組織。調節 SIRT3 可增強 sorafenib 治療，且 SIRT3 下調 GST-pi1 以增強化療與 sorafenib 誘發的凋亡。因此，其缺失與肝細胞癌中的腫瘤侵襲性與治療效能降低相關。

label: Chemical memory
description: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Peroxynitrite
description: Peroxynitrite oxidizes and inactivates Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) along with mitochondrial permeability transition pore components. This oxidation contributes to mitochondrial swelling and apoptosis, linking nitrative stress to mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 過氧亞硝酸鹽會與粒線體通透性轉換孔組成一起氧化並使 Thioredoxin-2 (Trx2) 失活。此氧化作用會促成粒線體腫脹與細胞凋亡，將硝化壓力與粒線體功能障礙連結起來。

label: Glutathione
description: Glutaredoxins use electrons from reduced glutathione (GSH) instead of thioredoxin reductase, passing them through a dithiol or monothiol mechanism to reduce protein disulfides and reverse protein S-glutathionylation. This makes glutaredoxin the GSH-coupled half of the cellular disulfide-reducing system.
description_zh_TW: Glutaredoxin 使用來自還原態麩胱甘肽（GSH）的電子而非硫氧還蛋白還原酶，透過雙硫醇或單硫醇機制還原蛋白質雙硫鍵並逆轉蛋白質的 S-麩胱甘肽化。這使 Glutaredoxin 成為細胞雙硫還原系統中與 GSH 偶聯的一半。

label: FSP1
description: Ferroptosis is held in check by two parallel systems: the canonical GPX4–glutathione axis and the GPX4-independent FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis. FSP1 suppresses ferroptosis by maintaining a ubiquinol radical trap at the plasma membrane, so loss of FSP1 alone is survivable only if GPX4 is intact.
description_zh_TW: 鐵死亡受到兩個平行系統的抑制：典型的 GPX4–glutathione 軸，以及不依賴 GPX4 的 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸。FSP1 透過在質膜上維持泛醇自由基陷阱來抑制鐵死亡，因此只有在 GPX4 完整時，單獨喪失 FSP1 才可存活。

label: p38 MAPK
description: SB203580 is a selective inhibitor of p38 MAPK (MAPK14), blocking its phosphorylation and activation. It was used as a pharmacological tool to verify p38 MAPK's contribution to SASP expression in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: SB203580 是 p38 MAPK（MAPK14）的選擇性抑制劑，阻斷其磷酸化與活化。它被用作藥理學工具，驗證 p38 MAPK 對衰老細胞中 SASP 表現的貢獻。

label: DNA Damage
description: Genomic instability is a hallmark of aging characterized by an increased tendency to acquire mutations and structural alterations. It is both a cause and consequence of aging, with DNA damage accumulating as repair efficiency declines with age.
description_zh_TW: 基因體不穩定是衰老的特徵，其特徵是獲得突變與結構改變的傾向增加。它既是衰老的原因也是結果，隨年齡增長修復效率下降，DNA 損傷隨之累積。

label: Catalase
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: SIRT3 protects against cardiac hypertrophy by inducing the antioxidant protein Catalase; lowering mitochondrial ROS inhibits AKT signaling and hypertrophy-associated gene expression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of Catalase-dependent antioxidant defense and hypertrophy suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過誘導抗氧化蛋白 Catalase 來防止心臟肥大；降低粒線體 ROS 會抑制 AKT 訊息傳遞與肥大相關基因表現。方向上，SIRT3 位於 Catalase 依賴性抗氧化防禦與肥大抑制的上游。

label: Coenzyme Q10
description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibition by statins diverts mevalonate flux away from CoQ10, collapsing the ubiquinone pool; with no substrate to reduce, FSP1 cannot regenerate ubiquinol even with abundant NAD(P)H — so statins (like FIN56) sensitize to ferroptosis independently of GPX4 status.
description_zh_TW: Statins 對 HMG-CoA 還原酶的抑制使 mevalonate 流量偏離 CoQ10，使 ubiquinone 池崩潰；沒有受質可還原時，即使 NAD(P)H 充足 FSP1 也無法再生成 ubiquinol——因此 statins（如 FIN56）以不依賴 GPX4 狀態的方式使細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

label: Caspase-3
description: The executioner caspase-3 also directly cleaves SIRT1 during apoptosis. Because both the initiator caspase-9 and executioner caspase-3 process Sir2α, cleavage and the accompanying nuclear-to-cytoplasmic dislocation occur throughout the apoptotic process, not at a single checkpoint. In Ara-C-treated embryonic mouse brain, over 130 of 150 cells with cytoplasmic Sir2α had pyknotic nuclei, confirming in vivo that the caspase-3-era SIRT1 fragments mark terminally dying cells. Cleavage therefore converts an anti-apoptotic survival factor into processed fragments precisely when the death program becomes irreversible.
description_zh_TW: 執行者半胱天冬酶-3（Caspase-3）在細胞凋亡期間同樣會直接切割 SIRT1。由於起始 Caspase-9 與執行者 Caspase-3 都會處理 Sir2α，切割與伴隨的核質易位發生在整個細胞凋亡過程中，而非單一檢查點。在 Ara-C 處理的胚胎小鼠腦中，150 個細胞質型 Sir2α 細胞裡有超過 130 個呈現核固縮，證實在體內帶 caspase-3 特徵的 SIRT1 片段標記著走向終末的死亡細胞。當死亡程序變得不可逆時，切割便將抗凋亡的存活因子轉化為處理後的片段。

label: Acid ceramidase
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, encoded by ASAH1) is the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acids. By controlling ceramide levels, ACase affects the abundance of many lipid species relevant to cell fate decisions, including sphingomyelin, ceramide-1-phosphate, and free fatty acids. In the context of replicative senescence, this ceramide catabolism releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that feed polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) and PUFA-phospholipid synthesis, remodeling the membrane lipid profile.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase, 编码基因 ASAH1) 是一种溶酶体酶，它将甘油酯分解为神经因子和游离脂肪酸。通过控制甘油酯水平，ACase 影响了许多与细胞命运决策相关的脂质物种的丰度，包括神经因子-1-磷酸酯和游离脂肪酸。在复制性衰老的情况下，这种甘油酯分解释放出饱和和单不饱和脂肪酸，这些脂肪酸为不饱和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 和 PUFA-磷脂合成提供营养，从而重塑膜脂质谱。

label: CD38
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: CD38, the major NADase in many mouse tissues, increases with age and depletes cellular NAD+ pools, thereby compromising sirtuin function. Mice lacking CD38 show elevated NAD+ levels and increased SIRT1 activity, coupled with protection from diet-induced obesity. Directionally, age-related CD38 upregulation sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and reduced sirtuin activity. Because sirtuins depend on NAD+ as a co-substrate, the rising NAD+ consumption by CD38 during aging starves sirtuin enzymes of their fuel. This makes CD38 a key target for NAD+-restoring interventions, and CD38 inhibition is being explored as a way to preserve NAD+ and support sirtuin function during aging.
description_zh_TW: CD38是許多小鼠組織中的主要NADase，隨年齡增長而增加並耗竭細胞NAD+池，從而損害sirtuin功能。缺乏CD38的小鼠表現出升高的NAD+水平和增加的SIRT1活性，並對飲食誘導的肥胖具有保護作用。方向上，與年齡相關的CD38上調位於NAD+耗竭和sirtuin活性降低的上游。因為sirtuin依賴NAD+作為共同底物，CD38在老化過程中NAD+消耗的增加使sirtuin酶缺乏燃料。這使CD38成為NAD+恢復介入的關鍵靶點，CD38抑制正在被探索為在老化過程中保存NAD+和支持sirtuin功能的方法。

label: DNA Methylation
description: DNA Methylation governs the expression of miR-543 through the imprinted DLK1-DIO3 cluster on chromosome 14q32 that hosts the microRNA; parent-of-origin methylation controls the locus, making miR-543 both an effector and a sensor of the epigenome and linking epigenetic drift to the SIRT1-NF-kB inflammatory axis.
description_zh_TW: DNA Methylation 透過位於染色體 14q32 上、帶有親源印記的 DLK1-DIO3 基因叢調控 miR-543 的表現；該基因座由親源甲基化控制，使 miR-543 既是表觀基因組的效應分子也是感應分子，並將表觀遺傳漂變與 SIRT1-NF-kB 發炎軸相連。

label: Prefrontal Cortex
description: The COMT Val158Met polymorphism modulates Prefrontal Cortex dopamine tone because, in the PFC, dopamine clearance depends principally on COMT rather than the dopamine transporter. The Met (slow) allele preserves higher extracellular dopamine, which can benefit certain working-memory tasks but increases anxiety vulnerability, whereas the Val (fast) allele lowers PFC dopamine and reduces cognitive efficiency unless boosted. Val158Met is therefore a key genetic determinant of PFC-dependent cognition, stress reactivity, and neuropsychiatric risk.
description_zh_TW: COMT 的 Val158Met 多型性調節 Prefrontal Cortex 的多巴胺張力，因為在前額葉皮質中，多巴胺清除主要依賴 COMT 而非多巴胺轉運蛋白。Met（慢速）等位基因保留較高的細胞外多巴胺，可能有助於某些工作記憶任務，但也增加焦慮脆弱性；Val（快速）等位基因則降低前額葉多巴胺並減損認知效率（除非受到藥物增強）。因此 Val158Met 是依賴前額葉皮質的認知、壓力反應性與神經精神疾病風險的關鍵遺傳決定因素。

label: Alzheimer's Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Biochemical evaluation of Alzheimer's disease (AD) brains demonstrates significantly increased DRP1 and FIS1 and reduced MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1 mRNA and protein levels, correlating with mitochondrial fragmentation and compromised neuronal energy production. Excessive mitochondrial fission interferes with OXPHOS complex assembly and cristae integrity, and S-nitrosylation of DRP1 induced by amyloid beta triggers mitochondrial fission and neuronal damage. Significantly increased DRP1 phosphorylation at Ser616 stimulates DRP1 translocation to mitochondria and fission activity in AD brain, and impaired axonal transport and reduced mitophagy accompany AD progression.
description_zh_TW: 對阿茲海默症（AD）腦部的生化評估顯示，DRP1與FIS1的mRNA及蛋白質表現量顯著增加，而MFN1、MFN2與OPA1則降低，此變化與粒線體碎裂及神經元能量產生受損相關。過度的粒線體分裂會干擾OXPHOS複合體組裝與嵴（cristae）完整性，而由類澱粉蛋白β（amyloid beta）誘發的DRP1 S-亞硝基化則會觸發粒線體分裂與神經元損傷。AD腦中DRP1在Ser616的磷酸化顯著增加，刺激DRP1轉位至粒線體並增強分裂活性，而軸突運輸受損與粒線體自噬（mitophagy）減少伴隨AD病程進展。

label: Inflammation
description: MLKL-driven plasma membrane rupture releases damage-associated molecular patterns (DAMPs), which immune cells recognize to eliminate harmful cells and initiate repair. When the inflammatory response remains uncontrolled, this same mechanism drives pathology: cancer, Alzheimer's, parkinsonism, multiple sclerosis, pulmonary, liver, enteric, and cardiac diseases. MLKL-mediated DAMP release is therefore the mechanistic bridge between necroptosis as a host-defense program and necroinflammatory chronic disease.
description_zh_TW: MLKL 驅動的細胞膜破裂會釋出損傷相關分子模式（DAMP），免疫細胞藉此辨識並清除有害細胞、啟動修復。當發炎反應失控時，同一機制便成為病理推手：癌症、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症、多發性硬化症、肺、肝、腸道與心臟疾病。MLKL 介導的 DAMP 釋放因此是「程序性壞死作為宿主防禦程序」與「壞死性發炎慢性疾病」之間的機制橋樑。

label: Medium spiny neurons
description: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

label: Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis
description: Chromatin modifiers are the central class of proteins in the Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis. They are recruited away from their native loci to DNA repair sites, and repeated relocalization with imperfect resetting erodes the epigenetic landscape and drives aging.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子是染色質修飾因子易位（RCM）假說中的核心蛋白類別。它們被招募離開原生基因座至 DNA 修復位點，反覆易位與不完美的重置會侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀並驅動衰老。

label: Quercetin
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Beyond direct K-type SIRT1 activation, quercetin (with apigenin) inhibits CD38, an NAD+ hydrolase, thereby boosting cellular NAD+ availability — a NAD+-boosting mechanism distinct from allostery. This dual role means quercetin sits in both the direct-STAC and the NAD+-modulator camps.
description_zh_TW: 除了直接 K 型活化 SIRT1，quercetin（與 apigenin）還抑制 CD38（一種 NAD+ 水解酶），從而提升細胞 NAD+ 可及性——這是不同於別構的 NAD+ 提升機制。此雙重角色使 quercetin 同時處於直接 STAC 與 NAD+ 調節劑兩個陣營。

label: Humanin
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。

label: Mitochondria
description: In senescent cells the mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, increasing the availability of acetyl-CoA to support histone acetylation at SASP gene loci. Although acetyl-CoA can be generated from alternative sources such as acetate, fatty acid oxidation and amino acid metabolism, in senescent cells mitochondria constitute a dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification, creating a dependence on mitochondrial acetyl-CoA to sustain epigenetic activation of inflammatory gene programmes. Pathways controlling cytosolic acetyl-CoA production, including mitochondrial citrate export and its conversion by ATP-citrate lyase, are upregulated during senescence.
description_zh_TW: In senescent cells，mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis 被 upregulated，增加 acetyl-CoA 可用性以支持 SASP gene loci 的 histone acetylation。雖然 acetyl-CoA 可從 alternative sources 如 acetate、fatty acid oxidation 和 amino acid metabolism 產生，但在 senescent cells 中 mitochondria 構成 dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification，創造對 mitochondrial acetyl-CoA 的依賴以維持 inflammatory gene programmes 的 epigenetic activation。控制 cytosolic acetyl-CoA production 的 pathways，包括 mitochondrial citrate export 和其 conversion by ATP-citrate lyase，在 senescence 期間 upregulated。

label: Epinephrine
description: Graph node-analysis: COMT links directly to Epinephrine (1 hop) and carries the strongest latent link pull (Adamic-Adar 0.721) of any source–target pair, placing it as the systemic catecholamine-metabolism hub in the wiki graph.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：COMT 直接連結 Epinephrine（1 跳）並帶有所有來源–標的對中最強的潛在連結拉力（Adamic-Adar 0.721），在 wiki 圖譜中居於系統性兒茶酚胺代謝樞紐。

label: BDNF
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

label: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), an NAD+ precursor, restores NAD+ in intestinal stem cells and reverses mtDNA-mutation-driven dysfunction via UPRmt, linking the NAD+ fuel line to stem-cell resilience.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）作為 NAD+ 前體，可恢復腸道幹細胞的 NAD+，並經 UPRmt 逆轉 mtDNA 突變驅動的功能障礙，將 NAD+ 燃料線與幹細胞韌性連結。

label: Atherosclerosis
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: SIRT1 protects against atherosclerosis through multiple mechanisms: endothelial SIRT1 overexpression activates eNOS, SRT1720 activation ameliorates endothelial dysfunction, and SIRT1 reduces Lox-1-mediated foam cell formation via NF-kB. It also protects vascular smooth muscle cells from DNA damage via NBS1. Collectively SIRT1 is a consistent anti-atherosclerotic factor in the endothelium and vasculature.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過多種機制保護對抗動脈粥樣硬化：內皮 SIRT1 過度表現活化 eNOS、SRT1720 活化改善內皮功能障礙，且 SIRT1 經由 NF-kB 減少 Lox-1 介導的泡沫細胞形成。它亦透過 NBS1 保護血管平滑肌細胞免於 DNA 損傷。整體而言，SIRT1 在內皮與血管中是穩定的抗動脈粥樣硬化因子。

label: MnSOD
description: SIRT3 protects against cardiac hypertrophy by inducing the antioxidant protein MnSOD; lowering mitochondrial ROS inhibits AKT signaling and hypertrophy-associated gene expression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of MnSOD-dependent antioxidant defense and hypertrophy suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過誘導抗氧化蛋白 MnSOD 來防止心臟肥大；降低粒線體 ROS 會抑制 AKT 訊息傳遞與肥大相關基因表現。方向上，SIRT3 位於 MnSOD 依賴性抗氧化防禦與肥大抑制的上游。

label: Exercise
description: Exercise generates acute ROS bursts that drive mitochondrial biogenesis, antioxidant upregulation, and metabolic adaptation via NRF2 and PGC-1alpha. Post-workout high-dose synthetic antioxidants (vitamin C/E) blunt this necessary ROS signal, so letting endogenous adaptation occur is the therapeutic goal.
description_zh_TW: 運動產生急性 ROS 爆發，透過 NRF2 與 PGC-1alpha 驅動粒線體生成、抗氧化上調與代謝適應。運動後高劑量合成抗氧化劑（維生素 C/E）減弱此必要的 ROS 訊號，因此讓內生適應發生是治療目標。

label: Mitophagy
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitophagy is a form of selective autophagy in which damaged and dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments are engulfed by double-membraned autophagosomes and delivered to the lysosome for degradation by hydrolytic enzymes. It is triggered by cues that mark mitochondrial damage, such as imbalance in mitochondrial fission-fusion dynamics, and is mediated either by specific outer mitochondrial membrane receptors such as BNIP3, BNIP3L/NIX and FUNDC1, or by ubiquitin molecules conjugated to mitochondrial surface proteins. Mitophagy is a core mitochondrial quality control mechanism closely related to cell fate decisions including senescence, apoptosis and necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體自噬是一種選擇性自噬形式，其中受損和功能失調的粒線體片段被雙膜自噬體吞噬，並輸送到溶酶體進行水解酶降解。它由標記粒線體損傷的線索觸發，如粒線體分裂-融合動力學的失衡，並由粒線體外膜上的特定受體如 BNIP3、BNIP3L/NIX 和 FUNDC1 介導，或由與粒線體表面蛋白結合的泛素分子介導。粒線體自噬是與細胞命運決定密切相關的核心粒線體品質控制機制，包括衰老、細胞凋亡和壞死性凋亡。

label: NRF2
description: DJ-1 stabilizes Nrf2 by blocking KEAP1, driving GLO1/GLO2 transcription for enhanced dicarbonyl clearance and HO-1/NQO1 for antioxidant defense.
description_zh_TW: DJ-1 透過阻斷 KEAP1 穩定 Nrf2，驅動 GLO1/GLO2 轉錄以增強二羰基清除，以及 HO-1/NQO1 以進行抗氧化防禦。

label: mTOR
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) maintains the kinase mTOR in its reduced, active state by protecting the oxidation-sensitive Cys1483 residue. Loss of Trx1 oxidizes mTOR, impairs substrate phosphorylation (S6K, 4EBP1), and suppresses nuclear-encoded mitochondrial gene expression and respiration, linking redox state to anabolic and mitochondrial signaling.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 透過保護對氧化敏感的 Cys1483 殘基，使激酶 mTOR 維持在還原且活化的狀態。失去 Trx1 會使 mTOR 氧化、損害受質磷酸化（S6K、4EBP1），並抑制核基因編碼的粒線體基因表現與呼吸作用，將氧化還原狀態與合成代謝及粒線體訊息傳遞連結起來。

label: Fenbendazole
description: Fenbendazole binds the colchicine site of β-tubulin, preventing polymerization into microtubules. This causes mitotic spindle disruption, G2/M arrest, and mitotic catastrophe.
description_zh_TW: Fenbendazole 結合 β-tubulin 的 colchicine 位點，阻止聚合為微管。這造成有絲分裂紡錘體破壞、G2/M 停滯與有絲分裂災難。

label: Cellular Senescence
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。

label: NAD+
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: NAD+ is efficiently regenerated through the salvage pathway, which recycles nicotinamide produced as a byproduct of sirtuin reactions and other NAD+-consuming enzymes. The pathway converts nicotinamide back to NMN via NAMPT and then to NAD+ via NMN adenylyltransferases (NMNATs). Directionally, the salvage pathway sits upstream of the NAD+ pool that sirtuins depend on as obligate co-substrate. Because recycling is far more economical than de novo synthesis, the salvage pathway is the dominant route of NAD+ maintenance in most tissues. This is why NAMPT and the salvage pathway are central to strategies that restore NAD+ and re-engage sirtuin activity during aging.
description_zh_TW: NAD+透過補救合成途徑高效再生，該途徑回收作為sirtuin反應和其他NAD+消耗酶副產品產生的菸鹼醯胺。此途徑透過NAMPT將菸鹼醯胺轉回NMN，再透過NMN腺苷醯轉移酶（NMNAT）轉化為NAD+。方向上，補救合成途徑位於sirtuin所依賴的NAD+池的上游。由於回收遠比從頭合成經濟，補救合成途徑是大多數組織中NAD+維持的主要途徑。這就是為什麼NAMPT和補救合成途徑成為恢復老化過程中NAD+並重新啟動sirtuin活性策略的核心。

label: Apigenin
description: The plant flavone Apigenin halts cell cycle progression in cancer cells at either the G1 or G2/M phase depending on cell type. This block is linked to induction of the CDK inhibitors p21 and p27 and inhibition of Rb phosphorylation. Apigenin-induced cell cycle arrest is central to its anticancer and chemopreventive activity.
description_zh_TW: 植物黃酮 Apigenin 會使癌細胞的細胞週期進程停滯在 G1 或 G2/M 期，取決於細胞類型。此阻斷與 CDK 抑制劑 p21 和 p27 的誘導以及 Rb 磷酸化的抑制有關。Apigenin 誘導的細胞週期停滯對其抗癌與化學預防活性至關重要。

label: mTORC1
description: Protein restriction inhibits the master nutrient sensor mTORC1 in the liver, heart, muscle, adipose tissue, and brain, and this inhibition is required for PR's benefits - without it, the benefits are lost. mTORC1 inhibition suppresses protein synthesis by reducing phosphorylation of S6K1 (whose genetic ablation extends lifespan) and of 4E-BP1, blocking eIF4E from initiating translation, while simultaneously promoting autophagy via ULK1 initiation of autophagosome formation. Normal aging is characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation in many tissues, whereas pharmacological or genetic inhibition of mTORC1 extends lifespan in many species. Amino acid scarcity is sensed in part through leucine signaling to mTORC1 in specific neurons via a voltage-gated calcium channel (Cav3.1).
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制抑制肝臟、心臟、肌肉、脂肪組織和腦中的主營養感知器mTORC1，這種抑制是PR益處所必需的——沒有它，益處就會喪失。mTORC1抑制透過減少S6K1（其基因缺失延長壽命）和4E-BP1的磷酸化來抑制蛋白質合成，阻斷eIF4E啟動翻譯，同時透過ULK1啟動自噬體形成促進自噬。正常老化以許多組織中組成型mTORC1活化為特徵，而mTORC1的藥理學或基因抑制在許多物種中延長壽命。胺基酸稀缺部分透過亮氨酸透過電壓依賴性鈣通道（Cav3.1）向特定神經元中的mTORC1訊號傳導來感知。

label: Inflammaging
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction is not merely a hallmark of aging but an upstream driver of stem cell exhaustion and inflammaging, the chronic low-grade inflammation characteristic of aging. Mitochondrial damage is decoded as inflammation through cytosolic mtDNA activating cGAS-STING and NF-κB pathways, while dysfunctional mitochondria persisting due to defective mitophagy remain metabolically active yet generate excessive ROS that sustains SASP signaling. Mitochondrial lipid peroxidation byproducts (4-HNE, oxidized cardiolipin) further stimulate inflammatory pathways via toll-like receptors and inflammasomes.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dysfunction 不僅僅是 aging 的 hallmark，更是 stem cell exhaustion 和 inflammaging（aging 特徵的 chronic low-grade inflammation）的 upstream driver。Mitochondrial damage 通過 cytosolic mtDNA 激活 cGAS-STING 和 NF-κB pathways 被解讀為 inflammation，而 dysfunctional mitochondria 由於 defective mitophagy 持續存在，卻產生 excessive ROS 維持 SASP signaling。Mitochondrial lipid peroxidation byproducts（4-HNE、oxidized cardiolipin）進一步通過 toll-like receptors 和 inflammasomes 刺激 inflammatory pathways。

label: Sirtuins
description: Amurensin G is a resveratrol tetramer natural product reported among compounds that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations and endowed with anticancer activity. It belongs to a series that includes aristoforin, polyphenols, and tanikolide identified through general screens of structurally diverse natural products. Directionally, amurensin G suppresses sirtuin deacetylase activity. Its isoform selectivity and mechanism are incompletely characterized, and its anticancer effect may involve both sirtuin inhibition and additional natural-product bioactivities.
description_zh_TW: Amurensin G 是一種白藜蘆醇四聚體天然產物，據報導屬於在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的化合物，並具有抗癌活性。它屬於包括 aristoforin、多酚類和 tanikolide 在內的系列，透過對結構多樣化天然產物的廣泛篩選而鑑定。方向性上 amurensin G 抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。其同工型選擇性和作用機制尚未完全表徵，其抗癌效果可能同時涉及 sirtuin 抑制和天然產物的其他生物活性。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: SAMD elevates reactive oxygen species (ROS) through dysfunctional electron transport chain complexes and impaired antioxidant buffering in senescent cells. The elevated ROS causes oxidative DNA damage, further activating the DDR and amplifying the growth arrest, and it also activates NF-kB and p38 MAPK, reinforcing the SASP. This makes ROS a feed-forward loop sustaining both the arrested state and inflammation, and it links mitochondrial dysfunction to oxidative stress as a driver of senescence. ROS therefore represent both a consequence and a cause of the senescent phenotype.
description_zh_TW: SAMD 透過衰老細胞中功能障礙的電子傳遞鏈複合體與受損的抗氧化緩衝升高活性氧（ROS）。升高的 ROS 造成氧化 DNA 損傷，進一步活化 DDR 並放大生長停滯，且也活化 NF-κB 與 p38 MAPK，強化 SASP。這使 ROS 成為同時維持停滯狀態與發炎的會降低正向迴圈，並將粒線體功能障礙連結到作為衰老驅動者的氧化壓力。因此 ROS 既是衰老表型的結果也是其原因。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Epicatechin is a flavanol with potent anti-glycation and AGE-breaking properties. In vitro it destroys preformed glycated serum albumin, and in vivo it decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. The nucleophilic C6 and C8 carbons of epicatechin's A-ring can attack the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures, breaking AGE cross-links. Epicatechin's dual capacity to inhibit glycation and break existing AGEs makes it a promising natural agent for reducing AGE burden, and its effects are similar to or stronger than those of aminoguanidine.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種具有強效抗糖化與 AGE 裂解特性的黃烷醇。在體外，它能破壞已形成的糖化血清白蛋白；在體內，它降低了注射外源性 AGE 之大鼠視網膜組織中的 AGE 累積。Epicatechin 之 A 環具親核性的 C6 與 C8 碳原子可攻擊 AGE 結構的吡咯環碳原子，切斷 AGE 交聯。Epicatechin 同時抑制糖化並裂解既有 AGE 的雙重能力，使其成為降低 AGE 負擔的極具潛力天然物質，且其效果與 aminoguanidine 相似或更佳。

label: Honokiol
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol's small, aromatic, lipophilic structure allows it to cross the blood-brain barrier, enabling its CNS actions. This property underpins its neuroprotective, anxiolytic, and sleep-promoting effects and allows it to inhibit CNS tumor growth.
description_zh_TW: Honokiol 的小型芳香親脂結構使其能穿越血腦屏障，實現其中樞神經系統作用。此特性支撐其神經保護、抗焦慮和促進睡眠的作用，並使其能抑制中樞神經系統腫瘤生長。

label: Aminoguanidine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aminoguanidine is the tightest-coupled exogenous protocol agent to the adrenochrome trigger: direct chemical edge 'reacts_with' (conf 0.9, PPR #4 seeded at Adrenochrome) originating from the US4501923A adrenochrome-preparation patent document in the vault.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是與 adrenochrome 觸發器耦合最緊密的外源協定劑：直接化學邊「reacts_with」（conf 0.9，以 Adrenochrome 為種子時 PPR #4），源自庫中的 US4501923A adrenochrome 製備專利文件。

label: Ivermectin
description: Ivermectin preferentially targets and inhibits cancer stem cells, suppressing Nanog, Oct4, and Sox2 expression through the PAK1-STAT3 axis. This kills CSCs therapeutically in breast cancer but simultaneously lowers the reprogramming factors needed for Yamanaka-factor rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 優先標靶並抑制癌幹細胞，透過 PAK1-STAT3 軸抑制 Nanog、Oct4 與 Sox2 表現。這在乳癌中治療性地殺死 CSC，但同時降低 Yamanaka 因子回春所需的重編程因子。

label: Mitohormesis
description: In C. elegans, glucose restriction normally raises mitochondrial respiration and ROS, inducing catalase and extending lifespan; NAC pre-treatment completely abolished both the ROS rise and the longevity benefit. NAC is the strongest direct evidence that scavenging the ROS signal blocks mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 在 C. elegans 中，葡萄糖限制通常升高粒線體呼吸與 ROS，誘發 catalase 並延長壽命；NAC 預處理完全廢除 ROS 升高與長壽益處。NAC 是最強的直接證據，顯示清除 ROS 訊號會阻斷粒線體促效應。

label: Dopamine
description: Graph node-analysis (networkx/scipy, 15 Aug 2026): COMT sits 1 hop from both Dopamine and Epinephrine with the highest Adamic-Adar latent pull (0.51–0.72) and #3 personalized-PageRank rank for both — the direct enzymatic gateway/hub of catecholamine handling, versus MAO which is peripheral.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析（networkx/scipy，2026-08-15）：COMT 距 Dopamine 與 Epinephrine 皆 1 跳，具最高的 Adamic-Adar 潛在連結拉力（0.51–0.72）與兩者皆 #3 的個人化 PageRank 排名——是兒茶酚胺處理的直接酵素樞紐/閘門，相對於周邊的 MAO。

label: Urolithin A
description: Urolithin A is a mitophagy-enhancing intervention that selectively removes damaged mitochondria, improving muscle health in aged models. It represents one of the leading mitochondria-targeted anti-aging strategies, alongside NAD+ repletion (nicotinamide riboside, NMN), mitochondrial biogenesis activation (AMPK activators, PGC-1α pathway), mitochondrial transplantation (nMITO bioengineered mitochondria), mtDNA editing (mitoTALENs, mitoZFNs), and scalable mitochondrial transfer platforms.
description_zh_TW: 尿石素 A 是一種增強線粒體自噬的干預措施，選擇性地清除受損線粒體，改善老化模型中的肌肉健康。它代表了領先的線粒體靶向抗衰老策略之一，與 NAD+ 補充（菸鹼胺核苷、NMN）、線粒體生物發生啟動（AMPK 啟動劑、PGC-1α 通路）、線粒體移植（nMITO 生物工程線粒體）、mtDNA 編輯（mitoTALENs、mitoZFNs）和可擴展的線粒體轉移平台並列。

label: Ferroptosis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: ACSL4 is a canonical positive regulator of ferroptosis. By charging long-chain PUFAs (e.g., arachidonic acid) to their acyl-CoA thioesters for re-esterification into membrane phospholipids (Lands cycle), ACSL4 enriches the sn-2 position of phosphatidylethanolamines with oxidizable PUFAs — the direct substrates of lipid peroxidation. ACSL4 overexpression raises ferroptosis sensitivity; knockdown protects against RSL3/GPX4 inhibition.
description_zh_TW: ACSL4 是鐵死亡的典型正向調節因子。它將長鏈 PUFA（如花生四烯酸）活化為其醯基-CoA 硫酯，重新酯化進膜磷脂（Lands cycle），使磷脂醯乙醇胺的 sn-2 位置富含可氧化的 PUFA——也就是脂質過氧化的直接受質。ACSL4 過表現會提高鐵死亡敏感性；敲低則能抵抗 RSL3/GPX4 抑制。

label: SIRT4
description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

label: AMPK
description: SIRT4 reduces AMPK signaling by opposing upstream LKB1/energy-sensing inputs, blunting catabolic (fatty-acid-oxidation) signaling in favor of anabolic metabolism; AMPK is reciprocally listed among SIRT4 negative regulators in Table 3 (e.g., via ADP/ATP-driven activation opposing SIRT4's anabolic bias; reviewed in the source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過拮抗上游 LKB1/能量感知輸入來降低 AMPK 信號，減弱分解代謝（脂肪酸氧化）信號，有利於合成代謝；AMPK 作為 SIRT4 的負向調節因子列於表 3 中（例如透過 ADP/ATP 驅動的活化拮抗 SIRT4 的合成代謝偏向；參見文獻綜述）。

label: Val158Met
description: The COMT Val158Met polymorphism modulates Prefrontal Cortex dopamine tone because, in the PFC, dopamine clearance depends principally on COMT rather than the dopamine transporter. The Met (slow) allele preserves higher extracellular dopamine, which can benefit certain working-memory tasks but increases anxiety vulnerability, whereas the Val (fast) allele lowers PFC dopamine and reduces cognitive efficiency unless boosted. Val158Met is therefore a key genetic determinant of PFC-dependent cognition, stress reactivity, and neuropsychiatric risk.
description_zh_TW: COMT 的 Val158Met 多型性調節 Prefrontal Cortex 的多巴胺張力，因為在前額葉皮質中，多巴胺清除主要依賴 COMT 而非多巴胺轉運蛋白。Met（慢速）等位基因保留較高的細胞外多巴胺，可能有助於某些工作記憶任務，但也增加焦慮脆弱性；Val（快速）等位基因則降低前額葉多巴胺並減損認知效率（除非受到藥物增強）。因此 Val158Met 是依賴前額葉皮質的認知、壓力反應性與神經精神疾病風險的關鍵遺傳決定因素。

label: SIRT7
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT7 is stabilized at the promoters of its target genes through interaction with the ETS-family transcription factor ELK4, which tethers the deacetylase to chromatin. Once anchored, SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of histone H3 (H3K18ac), repressing tumor suppressor genes and maintaining cancer hallmarks such as anchorage-independent growth and loss of contact inhibition. Directionally, ELK4-mediated stabilization precedes and enables SIRT7's H3K18 deacetylation. Consistent with this axis, SIRT7 depletion reduces the tumorigenicity of human cancer xenografts, underscoring the ELK4-SIRT7 connection as a therapeutic vulnerability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過與 ETS 家族轉錄因子 ELK4 的相互作用穩定於其靶基因的啟動子處，ELK4 將去乙醯酶錨定到染色質上。一旦錨定，SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸（H3K18ac），抑制腫瘤抑制基因並維持锚定非依賴性生長和接觸抑制喪失等癌症特徵。方向性上 ELK4 介導的穩定化先於並使 SIRT7 的 H3K18 去乙醯化成為可能。與此軸線一致的是，SIRT7 的耗竭降低人類癌症異種移植的致瘤性，凸顯 ELK4-SIRT7 連結作為治療脆弱性的價值。

label: Caloric Restriction
description: Caloric restriction raises the level of almost all sirtuins except SIRT4; SIRT2 is among those increased by CR (observed in white fat and kidney of CR mice). Directionally, CR is the upstream stimulus and elevated SIRT2 a downstream mediator. This generalizes the CR-sirtuin axis beyond SIRT1/SIRT3.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高除 SIRT4 外幾乎所有 sirtuin 的水平；SIRT2 是被 CR 提高的 sirtuin 之一（在 CR 小鼠的白色脂肪和腎臟中觀察到）。方向性上 CR 是上游刺激，SIRT2 升高是下游介導因子。這將 CR-sirtuin 軸線從 SIRT1/SIRT3 推廣到更廣泛的範圍。

label: SIRT5
description: SIRT5 activates multiple fatty acid beta-oxidation enzymes through desuccinylation, including very-long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (MCAD), and the alpha subunit of enoyl-CoA hydratase (ECHA). Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatic activation of these enzymes sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. Deficiency of SIRT5 compromises fatty acid metabolism, leading to acylcarnitine accumulation and decreased ATP production.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過去琥珀醯化作用活化多種脂肪酸β-氧化酶，包括極長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（VLCAD）、長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）、中鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（MCAD）和烯醯CoA水合酶的α亞基（ECHA）。方向上，SIRT5對這些酶的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。SIRT5的缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝，導致醯基肉鹼積累和ATP產量減少。

label: Fisetin
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Fisetin is a mixed-type COMT inhibitor with IC50 2.6-5.8 µM. It is also a COMT substrate — itself O-methylated to geraldol — making inhibition concentration-dependent and genotype-sensitive.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種混合型 COMT 抑制劑，IC50 為 2.6–5.8 µM。它也是 COMT 受質——本身被 O-甲基化為 geraldol——使得抑制呈濃度依賴且對基因型敏感。

label: Senescence
description: Executioner caspases are the terminal proteases of the apoptotic cascade that dismantle the cell. In aging, senescent-cell resistance to executioner-caspase killing via SCAPs is a barrier to senescent-cell clearance, linking executioner-caspase biology to senescence persistence.
description_zh_TW: 執行型 caspase 是分解細胞的細胞凋亡級聯末端蛋白酶。在衰老中，衰老細胞經由 SCAPs 對執行型 caspase 殺傷的抵抗是衰老細胞清除的障礙，將執行型 caspase 生物學與衰老持續相連結。

label: Rapamycin
description: In the triples graph's parallel-relation inventory, Rapamycin → Lifespan carries both 'extends' (0.96) and 'extends_lifespan_in' (0.96) edges encoding the rapamycin longevity literature (mTOR inhibition); the pair-level union keeps a single relation for the default combined dataset.
description_zh_TW: 在 triples 圖的平行關係清單中，Rapamycin → Lifespan 同時帶有「extends」（0.96）與「extends_lifespan_in」（0.96）兩條邊，編碼 rapamycin 延壽文獻（mTOR 抑制）；成對聯集在預設 combined 資料集中保留單一關係。

label: Methylene blue
description: Methylene blue carries the edge 'suppresses → Glycolysis' (conf 0.88) as part of its redox wiring; this metabolic-suppression edge, alongside bypassing Complex I/III and shunting electrons to cytochrome c, frames MB as an ETC-bypass electron shuttle that also rewires cancer metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue 帶「suppresses → Glycolysis」邊（conf 0.88）作為其氧化還原佈線的一部分；此代謝抑制邊與繞過 Complex I/III、把電子分流至 cytochrome c 共同把 MB 框架為也重接癌症代謝的 ETC 繞行電子穿梭體。

label: Neuromelanin
description: Neuromelanin binds and chelates redox-active iron in the substantia nigra, buffering toxic metal deposition; this protective capacity inverts once the intracellular neuromelanin burden crosses the pathogenic threshold, when iron-redox cycling and proteostasis collapse converge to drive Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 在黑質中結合並螯合具氧化還原活性的鐵，緩衝毒性金屬沉積；一旦胞內 neuromelanin 負載超過致病閾值，鐵氧化還原循環與蛋白質恆定崩潰匯合驅動帕金森氏症，此保護能力即反轉。

label: Creatine
description: Creatine synthesis consumes an estimated 40% of the body's daily methyl-group flux, making it the single largest sink in the methylation cycle. Endogenous creatine synthesis competes with other SAM-dependent reactions, and supplementing creatine spares methyl groups for other pathways.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸合成消耗身體每日甲基通量約 40%，是甲基化循環中最大的單一消耗端。內源性肌酸合成與其他 SAM 依賴反應競爭，而補充肌酸可為其他途徑節省甲基。

label: Resveratrol
description: Resveratrol (RSV) significantly diminishes mtROS generation by enhancing SIRT3 accumulation within mitochondria, which upregulates FOXO3A-dependent transcription of mitochondrial genes (ATP6, CO1, Cytb, ND2, ND5), improving complex I activity and ATP synthesis. RSV also enhances SIRT3 transcription through ERRalpha-dependent transcription via the AMPK/PGC-1alpha/ERRalpha/SIRT3 signaling cascade, with benefits abrogated by AMPK inhibition or SIRT3 siRNA.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol（RSV）透過增強 SIRT3 在粒線體中的累積顯著減少 mtROS 生成，後者上調粒線體基因（ATP6、CO1、Cytb、ND2、ND5）的 FOXO3A 依賴性轉錄，改善複合物 I 活性和 ATP 合成。RSV 還透過 AMPK/PGC-1alpha/ERRalpha/SIRT3 訊號級聯中的 ERRalpha 依賴性轉錄增強 SIRT3 轉錄，其益處在 AMPK 抑制或 SIRT3 siRNA 時被消除。

label: Autophagy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Mitophagy is a form of selective autophagy in which damaged and dysfunctional mitochondrial fragments are engulfed by double-membraned autophagosomes and delivered to the lysosome for degradation by hydrolytic enzymes. It is triggered by cues that mark mitochondrial damage, such as imbalance in mitochondrial fission-fusion dynamics, and is mediated either by specific outer mitochondrial membrane receptors such as BNIP3, BNIP3L/NIX and FUNDC1, or by ubiquitin molecules conjugated to mitochondrial surface proteins. Mitophagy is a core mitochondrial quality control mechanism closely related to cell fate decisions including senescence, apoptosis and necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體自噬是一種選擇性自噬形式，其中受損和功能失調的粒線體片段被雙膜自噬體吞噬，並輸送到溶酶體進行水解酶降解。它由標記粒線體損傷的線索觸發，如粒線體分裂-融合動力學的失衡，並由粒線體外膜上的特定受體如 BNIP3、BNIP3L/NIX 和 FUNDC1 介導，或由與粒線體表面蛋白結合的泛素分子介導。粒線體自噬是與細胞命運決定密切相關的核心粒線體品質控制機制，包括衰老、細胞凋亡和壞死性凋亡。

label: TFEB
description: AMPK is the only first-order neighbor shared by all three defense programs (Mitohormesis, Autophagy, Sirtuins) in the quartet study; fasting/energy deficit activates AMPK → TFEB → lysosomal biogenesis → autophagy, the metabolic switch underlying intermittent-fasting hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 在四點研究中，AMPK 是三個防禦程式（Mitohormesis、Autophagy、Sirtuins）共享的唯一一階鄰點；禁食／能量赤字活化 AMPK → TFEB → 溶酶體新生 → 自噬，這是間歇性禁食荷爾蒙背後的代謝開關。

label: Nicotinamide Riboside
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Restoring NAD+ with nicotinamide riboside (NR) reactivated mitochondrial metabolism, upregulated prohibitin proteins, and induced UPRmt, delaying stem cell senescence and extending lifespan in aged contexts. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence and diminished regenerative capacity, and NR treatment reverses this by restoring mitochondrial function. NR is a key NAD+ repletion strategy alongside NMN that restores sirtuin activity, enhances the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, and improves mitochondrial membrane potential, thereby supporting regeneration and resilience in aged stem cell c...
description_zh_TW: 使用煙醯胺核糖苷（NR）恢復NAD+重新激活粒線體代謝，上調prohibitin蛋白，並誘導UPRmt，延緩幹細胞衰老並延長老年環境中的壽命。在老年肌肉幹細胞、神經幹細胞和黑素細胞幹細胞中，NAD+耗竭導致衰老、靜止喪失和再生能力降低，NR治療透過恢復粒線體功能逆轉這一過程。NR是與NMN並列的關鍵NAD+補充策略，可恢復sirtuin活性，增強粒線體未折疊蛋白反應，並改善粒線體膜電位，從而支持老年幹細胞 compartment 的再生和恢復力。

label: Parkinson's Disease
description: Neuromelanin is a characteristic marker of Parkinson's disease: PD selectively kills the most neuromelanin-laden dopaminergic neurons of the substantia nigra pars compacta; the pathogenic-threshold model posits neuromelanin is protective until its burden crosses a late-life ceiling. Neuromelanin-sensitive MRI is an emerging PD biomarker.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 是帕金森氏症的特徵性標記：PD 選擇性殺死黑質緻密部中負載最多 neuromelanin 的多巴胺神經元；致病閾值模型主張 neuromelanin 在負載跨過晚年天花板前具有保護作用。Neuromelanin 敏感 MRI 是新興 PD 生物標記。

label: p53
description: The tumor suppressor p53 transactivates RRM2B (p53R2) in response to DNA damage and replication stress. p53R2 then assembles with RRM1 to provision dNTPs for DNA repair and mitochondrial DNA synthesis in arrested or non-cycling cells.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制子 p53 在 DNA 損傷與複製壓力下轉錄活化 RRM2B（p53R2）。接著 p53R2 與 RRM1 組裝，在停滯或非增殖細胞中供應 DNA 修復與粒線體 DNA 合成所需的 dNTP。

label: SIRT2
description: AC93253 is a small molecule that inhibits SIRT2 at micromolar concentrations. In leukemia cells, SIRT2 inhibition with AC93253 is accompanied by Akt acetylation, de-phosphorylation, and consequent inhibition, producing antileukemia effects. The directionality is that AC93253 blocks SIRT2, which then removes deacetylation-based control over Akt, shifting it toward an inactive state. This positions AC93253 as both a research tool for SIRT2 biology and an anticancer lead, and connects sirtuin inhibition to PI3K/Akt pathway suppression.
description_zh_TW: AC93253 是一種在微摩爾濃度下抑制 SIRT2 的小分子。在白血病細胞中，AC93253 伴隨 Akt 乙醯化、去磷酸化及隨後的抑制，產生抗白血病效果。方向性上 AC93253 阻斷 SIRT2，進而去除對 Akt 的去乙醯化控制，使其轉向非活化狀態。這使 AC93253 既作為 SIRT2 生物學的研究工具，也作為抗癌先導化合物，並將 sirtuin 抑制與 PI3K/Akt 途徑抑制聯繫起來。

label: Apoptosis
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: SIRT1 is a stress-activated survival factor: Sir2α-deficient cells are hypersensitive to ionizing radiation, staurosporine, and oxidative stress. Mechanistically it deacetylates p53 (blunting transactivation) and FOXO3/FOXO4 (shifting output from death to repair), so cells with high SIRT1 activity resist pro-apoptotic stimuli. The 2006 Ohsawa-Miura study adds the inverse arm — once apoptosis does trigger, caspases cleave SIRT1 — making SIRT1 both a gatekeeper and, after cleavage, a casualty of the death program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是壓力誘導的存活因子：缺乏 Sir2α 的細胞對游離輻射、staurosporine 與氧化壓力高度敏感。機制上它去乙醯化 p53（減弱其轉錄活化）以及 FOXO3/FOXO4（將輸出由死亡轉向修復），因此高 SIRT1 活性的細胞能抵抗促凋亡刺激。2006 年 Ohsawa-Miura 的研究補上了反向的一臂——一旦細胞凋亡啟動，caspases 便會切割 SIRT1——使 SIRT1 既是守門者，也是切割後的犧牲品。

label: NF-kappaB
description: Mitochondrial dysfunction activates redox-sensitive pathways such as NF-κB, enhancing production of IL-6 and TNF-α and contributing to the mitochondrial-inflammaging axis. Damaged mitochondria accumulate in senescent cells due to defective mitophagy, remaining metabolically active yet dysfunctional and excessively generating ROS that sustains SASP signaling. Reduced SIRT3 activity due to NAD+ depletion weakens antioxidant defenses and mitochondrial detoxification, amplifying ROS-driven NF-κB activation. Mitochondrial ROS thus acts as a causal driver feeding forward into inflammaging, coupling organelle dysfunction to systemic chronic inflammation through redox-sensitive transcription.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體功能障礙會活化氧化還原敏感途徑如 NF-κB，增強 IL-6 和 TNF-α 的產生，並促成粒線體-炎性衰老軸。受損的粒線體因粒線體自噬缺陷而在衰老細胞中積累，保持代謝活躍但功能失調，並過度產生 ROS，維持 SASP 訊號。因 NAD+ 耗竭導致的 SIRT3 活性降低，削弱了抗氧化防禦和粒線體解毒作用，放大了 ROS 驅動的 NF-κB 活化。因此，粒線體 ROS 作為因果驅動因素，透過氧化還原敏感的轉錄，將胞器功能障礙與系統性慢性炎症相連結。

label: Oxidative Stress
description: SIRT3 deacetylates and activates SOD2 (MnSOD) at Lys68/Lys122 and supports glutathione-dependent antioxidant pathways, reducing mitochondrial ROS; aging-associated SIRT3 decline increases oxidative stress, and SIRT3 knockout mice show accelerated aging phenotypes (source review; Qiu et al., 2010).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在 Lys68/Lys122 處去乙醯化並活化 SOD2（MnSOD），支持穀胱甘肽依賴性的抗氧化通路，減少粒線體 ROS；衰老相關的 SIRT3 下降增加氧化壓力，SIRT3 敲除小鼠顯示加速的衰老表型（文獻綜述；Qiu et al., 2010）。

label: Aging
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Somatic mtDNA mutations accumulate with age due to high replication frequency, proximity to mitochondrial ROS, and relatively inefficient DNA repair compared to nuclear DNA. This mutational burden can be framed both as a hallmark of aging (clonal mosaicism and rising heteroplasmy in aged tissues) and as a driver of stem cell aging by inducing respiratory insufficiency that feeds into inflammatory signaling and durable metabolic-epigenetic reprogramming. Compromised electron transport shifts availability of epigenetically active metabolites (alpha-ketoglutarate, succinate, fumarate, acetyl-CoA) that gate chromatin-modifying enzymes, reshaping stem cell fate decisions.
description_zh_TW: Somatic mtDNA mutations 累積隨年齡增長 due to high replication frequency、proximity to mitochondrial ROS，以及 relatively inefficient DNA repair compared to nuclear DNA。這種 mutational burden 可以 framed both as a hallmark of aging（clonal mosaicism 和 rising heteroplasmy in aged tissues）and as a driver of stem cell aging by inducing respiratory insufficiency  feeding into inflammatory signaling 和 durable metabolic-epigenetic reprogramming。Compromised electron transport shifts availability of epigenetically active metabolites（alpha-ketoglutarate、succinate、fumarate、acetyl-CoA） gating chromatin-modifying enzymes，reshaping stem cell fate decisions。

label: Cancer
description: Leukemia is a clonal hematologic malignancy arising from abnormal hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells.
description_zh_TW: Leukemia 是一種由異常造血幹/祖細胞引起的克隆性血液惡性腫瘤。

label: SIRT6
description: SIRT6 negatively regulates the insulin-signaling cascade by suppressing upstream signaling through the insulin receptor and insulin receptor substrates. This restraint reduces downstream Akt phosphorylation, preventing excessive glucose uptake and helping to maintain metabolic balance in peripheral tissues. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of dampened insulin-PI3K-Akt signaling. Loss of SIRT6 elevates this signaling, contributing to insulin resistance and metabolic dysfunction. By toning down insulin-driven anabolic responses, SIRT6 protects cells from nutrient overload and supports the metabolic flexibility that is lost in obesity and type 2 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過抑制胰島素受體和胰島素受體底物的上游訊號來負向調節胰島素訊號級聯。這種抑制降低了下游Akt磷酸化，防止過度的葡萄糖攝取，並幫助維持周邊組織的代謝平衡。方向上，SIRT6位於胰島素-PI3K-Akt訊號減弱的上游。SIRT6的缺失提升了此訊號，導致胰島素阻抗和代謝功能障礙。透過調節胰島素驅動的合成代謝反應，SIRT6保護細胞免受營養過載，並支持在肥胖和第二型糖尿病中失去的代謝靈活性。

label: Adrenochrome
description: Carbazochrome is adrenochrome monosemicarbazone ('is_derivative_of', conf 0.95), formed by condensing adrenochrome's quinone carbonyl with semicarbazide to make a relatively chemically inactive derivative — resolving the Round-2 amplifier-conflict ticket as an evidence-based null for carbazochrome redox-cycling at Complex I.
description_zh_TW: Carbazochrome 是 adrenochrome 單縮氨基脲（「is_derivative_of」，conf 0.95），由 adrenochrome 的醌羰基與縮氨基脲縮合而成的一種相對化學惰性衍生物——把第二輪放大器衝突票裁定為 carbazochrome 在 Complex I 氧化還原循環的以證據為基礎的空結果。

label: SASP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP).
