Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。

label: COMT
description: Fisetin is a mixed-type COMT inhibitor with IC50 2.6-5.8 µM. It is also a COMT substrate — itself O-methylated to geraldol — making inhibition concentration-dependent and genotype-sensitive.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種混合型 COMT 抑制劑，IC50 為 2.6–5.8 µM。它也是 COMT 受質——本身被 O-甲基化為 geraldol——使得抑制呈濃度依賴且對基因型敏感。

label: SIRT3
description: SIRT3 protects against cardiac hypertrophy by inducing the antioxidant protein Catalase; lowering mitochondrial ROS inhibits AKT signaling and hypertrophy-associated gene expression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of Catalase-dependent antioxidant defense and hypertrophy suppression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過誘導抗氧化蛋白 Catalase 來防止心臟肥大；降低粒線體 ROS 會抑制 AKT 訊息傳遞與肥大相關基因表現。方向上，SIRT3 位於 Catalase 依賴性抗氧化防禦與肥大抑制的上游。

label: SIRT1
description: SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a in multiple cell types, including neurons and fibroblasts, shifting its target-gene program toward stress resistance and away from apoptosis. Deacetylated FOXO3a induces antioxidant enzymes such as MnSOD and catalase, promotes autophagy and mitophagy through BNIP3, and reduces death-gene expression, biasing cells toward repair and survival. Directionally, SIRT1 modifies FOXO3a, and the altered transcription follows downstream. This stress-resistant switch is central to SIRT1-mediated protection in aging and neurodegeneration, and it links sirtuin activity to redox homeostasis and cellular quality control.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 在多種細胞類型（包括神經元和纖維母細胞）中去乙醯化 FOXO3a，將其靶基因程序轉向壓力抗性並遠離凋亡。去乙醯化的 FOXO3a 誘導抗氧化酶（如 MnSOD 和 catalase），通過 BNIP3 促進自噬和粒線體自噬，並降低死亡基因表達，使細胞偏向修復和存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 修飾 FOXO3a，隨後的轉錄改變發生在下游。這種壓力抗性開關是 SIRT1 介導的在衰老和神經退行性疾病中保護的核心，將 sirtuin 活性與氧化還原穩態和細胞品質控制聯繫起來。

label: Michaelis-Menten Kinetics
description: Michaelis-Menten kinetics describe enzyme-catalyzed reaction rate as a saturable function of substrate concentration. The saturated enzymatic regime occurs when the Michaelis-Menten constant is very small relative to substrate, making the reaction rate insensitive to substrate changes.
description_zh_TW: Michaelis-Menten 動力學將酶催化反應速率描述為受質濃度的飽和函數。當 Michaelis-Menten 常數遠小於受質時即為飽和酶學機制，使反應速率對受質變化不敏感。

label: MTHFR
description: The methylation cycle transfers methyl groups for DNA methylation and neurotransmitter synthesis, with central metabolites including SAMe and folate. The cycle is regulated by enzymes such as MTHFR, and dysregulation is linked to cardiovascular disease, neurodegeneration, and aging.
description_zh_TW: 甲基化循環為 DNA 甲基化與神經傳導物質合成轉移甲基，中心代謝物包括 SAMe 與葉酸。循環由 MTHFR 等酶調控，其失調與心血管疾病、神經退化及衰老相關。

label: MDM2
description: MDM2 is amplified in Cancer. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward MDM2, so Cancer is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: MDM2 在 Cancer 中被放大。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 MDM2，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

label: E2F
description: RRM2 expression is transcriptionally gated to S phase by the E2F transcription factor, and the protein is degraded when cells exit S phase or enter quiescence. This makes RRM2 the cell-cycle-controlled switch for de novo dNTP synthesis and a direct index of proliferation.
description_zh_TW: RRM2 的表現由 E2F 轉錄因子在轉錄層面局限於 S 期，當細胞離開 S 期或進入靜止期時蛋白質會被降解。這使 RRM2 成為 de novo dNTP 合成的細胞週期控制開關，以及增殖的直接指標。

label: Neurotransmitters
description: Neurotransmitters are endogenous chemical messengers that relay signals between neurons, and the catecholamines dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine are paramount in neuromelanin research. Their oxidative metabolism generates the aminochromes that polymerize into neuromelanin.
description_zh_TW: 神經傳導物質是神經元間傳遞訊號的內源性化學信使，而兒茶酚胺（dopamine、norepinephrine、epinephrine）在 neuromelanin 研究中至關重要。其氧化代謝產生聚合為 neuromelanin 的 aminochrome。

label: H3K36me3
description: H3K36me3 is a gene-body trimethyl mark deposited co-transcriptionally by SETD2 and removed by KDM4 (JMJD2) JmjC demethylases. Its dynamics regulate transcribed gene bodies including SASP loci.
description_zh_TW: H3K36me3 是由 SETD2 共轉錄沉積、由 KDM4（JMJD2）JmjC 去甲基酶移除的基因體三甲基標記。其動態調控包括 SASP 基因座在內的轉錄基因體。

label: YAP1
description: Node-analysis of the repurposing cluster lists Ivermectin's out-star broadcasting into signaling suppression — Akt, mTOR, Wnt, YAP1, STAT3, NF-kappaB, PAK1 — alongside cell-death induction, resistance reversal and stemness suppression; YAP1 is among the Hippo-pathway targets (conf 0.7).
description_zh_TW: 重新定位簇的節點分析把 Ivermectin 的出向之星列為廣播到訊號抑制——Akt、mTOR、Wnt、YAP1、STAT3、NF-kappaB、PAK1——同時包含細胞死亡誘發、抗藥性反轉與幹性抑制；YAP1 是 Hippo 路徑標靶之一（conf 0.7）。

label: Satoshi Ōmura
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: AGE-modified proteins
description: Cathepsin B is a lysosomal cysteine protease that, together with cathepsin D, is a major enzyme responsible for breaking down AGE-modified proteins. Glycated proteins are directed to lysosomes for degradation, and these cathepsins ensure that proteins damaged by non-enzymatic glycation are cleared rather than allowed to accumulate. The activity of such lysosomal proteases declines with age and under UV exposure, which correlates with accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Maintaining lysosomal cathepsin function is therefore important for proteolytic clearance of glycated material and limiting AGE burden.
description_zh_TW: 組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B）是一種溶酶體半胱氨酸蛋白酶，與組織蛋白酶 D 一起是負責分解 AGE 修飾蛋白的主要酵素。糖化蛋白被導向溶酶體進行降解，而這些組織蛋白酶確保因非酵素性糖化而受損的蛋白質被清除而非堆積。此類溶酶體蛋白酶的活性隨年齡增長與紫外線暴露而下降，這與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，維持溶酶體組織蛋白酶功能對於糖化物質的蛋白水解清除與限制 AGE 負擔十分重要。

label: Heart
description: Troponin is a heterotrimeric complex regulating striated muscle contraction, and cardiac troponin I and T are highly cardiac-specific gold-standard biomarkers of myocardial injury. Troponin release from the heart signals myocardial damage.
description_zh_TW: 肌鈣蛋白（troponin）是調控橫紋肌收縮的異三聚體複合體，而心肌肌鈣蛋白 I 與 T 是高度心臟特異的心肌損傷金標準生物標記。心臟釋放的肌鈣蛋白指示心肌損傷。

label: Kinase-inhibitor scaffold
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: GW5074 is an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor; like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220, it was repurposed as a sirtuin inhibitor after screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 based on the shared adenosine-binding site between sirtuins and kinases. GW5074 shows SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory activity in the low micromolar range. Directionally, its identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, highlighting the need for selectivity optimization in dual kinase/sirtuin inhibitor design.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 是一種最初作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物；與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 類似，它在基於 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享腺嘌呤結合位點的原理篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性後被重新定位為 sirtuin 抑制劑。GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制活性。方向性上其作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了在雙重激酶/sirtuin 抑制劑設計中選擇性優化的必要性。

label: Synthetic STAC
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: SRT1460 is a second-generation synthetic sirtuin-activating compound (STAC) of the imidazothiazole class, developed with SRT1720 and SRT2183 as chemically diverse and more potent activators than the initial polyphenolic STACs. These compounds were reported to have anticancer activity, but their mechanism is controversial: activation could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, and in vivo effects may be indirect (e.g., via the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway) rather than direct SIRT1 binding. Directionally, SRT1460 belongs to the synthetic STAC class whose biology underlies the ongoing debate about STAC-mediated SIRT1 activation.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 是一種咪唑噻唑類的第二代合成 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），與 SRT1720 和 SRT2183 一起作為化學結構多樣且比初始多酚類 STAC 更強效的活化劑而開發。這些化合物據報導具有抗癌活性，但其機制存在爭議：活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質驗證，且體內效果可能是間接的（例如透過 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）而非直接 SIRT1 結合。方向性上 SRT1460 屬於合成 STAC 類別，其生物學構成了關於 STAC 介導的 SIRT1 活化的持續爭論。

label: Rubicon
description: Rubicon and UVRAG reciprocally regulate the Vps34 complex: Rubicon restrains Vps34 lipid kinase activity and endosomal maturation, while UVRAG promotes them. They compete within overlapping complexes to modulate autophagy and endocytic trafficking.
description_zh_TW: Rubicon 與 UVRAG 對 Vps34 複合體進行相互調控：Rubicon 抑制 Vps34 脂質激酶活性與內體成熟，UVRAG 則促進之。它們在重疊複合體中競爭以調控自噬與內吞運輸。

label: MICU1
description: MICU1 and MICU2 are regulatory subunits of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter complex. MICU1 endows the uniporter with a steep threshold response, while MICU2 reinforces pore closure at rest, and they act cooperatively to prevent pathological matrix Ca2+ overload.
description_zh_TW: MICU1 與 MICU2 是粒線體鈣單向轉運體複合體的調控亞基。MICU1 賦予轉運體陡峭的閾值反應，MICU2 則在靜止時強化孔道關閉，兩者合作防止病理性基質 Ca2+ 超載。

label: TRAIL
description: Apoptosis is induced by TRAIL. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Apoptosis, so TRAIL is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 TRAIL 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 向 Apoptosis，因此 TRAIL 是主動主體，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CDK4
description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: Dietary AGE Restriction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Intervention studies in mice show that reduced dietary AGEs attenuate insulin resistance, increase prevention of diabetes, and, in diabetic mice, reduce diabetic vascular and renal complications and improve impaired wound healing. The positive outcomes of caloric restriction in mice may be explained in part by a decrease in AGE intake and a concomitant decrease in oxidative stress. These findings indicate that the glycation load of the diet is not merely a bystander but can modulate insulin sensitivity and metabolic health, reinforcing the idea that dietary AGE restriction is a viable intervention against metabolic dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠的介入研究顯示，減少飲食性 AGE 可減緩胰島素抗性、增加糖尿病預防，且在糖尿病小鼠中減少糖尿病血管與腎臟併發症並改善受損傷口癒合。小鼠中熱量限制（caloric restriction）的正面結果可能部分可由 AGE 攝取減少與伴隨的氧化壓力下降來解釋。這些發現指出，飲食的糖化負載不只是旁觀者，而是能調節胰島素敏感度與代謝健康，強化了飲食 AGE 限制是對抗代謝功能障礙之可行介入手段的觀念。

label: Senescent cell anti-apoptotic pathways
description: Senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis because they upregulate Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs), including Bcl-2 family pro-survival proteins and the PI3K/Akt axis. Different senescent cell types rely on different SCAPs, which is why no single senolytic clears all senescent cells — and why SCAP-targeting drugs such as Fisetin, D+Q, and Navitoclax show cell-type selectivity.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞因上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs，包括 Bcl-2 家族促存活蛋白與 PI3K/Akt 軸）而抵抗細胞凋亡。不同衰老細胞類型依賴不同的 SCAPs，因此沒有任何單一 senolytic 能清除所有衰老細胞——這也是為何攻擊 SCAPs 的藥物如 Fisetin、D+Q 與 Navitoclax 呈現細胞類型選擇性的原因。

label: PAK1
description: PAK1 is a key target of Ivermectin in ovarian cancer, whose inactivation inhibits proliferation. PAK1 signaling contributes to the dysregulated survival network in ovarian cancer. It is therefore studied as a molecular node for repurposed drug action.
description_zh_TW: PAK1 是 Ivermectin 在卵巢癌中的關鍵靶點，其失活會抑制增殖。PAK1 訊號傳導促成卵巢癌中失調的存活網路。因此它被研究作為再利用藥物作用的分子節點。

label: Pheomelanin
description: Benzothiazine-derived units are the hallmark structural motifs of Pheomelanin, the sulfur-containing yellow-to-red melanin. The 1,4-benzothiazine system contains nitrogen and sulfur heteroatoms that confer redox activity and metal-binding capability. Pheomelanin is chemically defined by its benzothiazine units, which distinguish it from the indolic eumelanin.
description_zh_TW: Benzothiazine 衍生的單元是 Pheomelanin 的標誌性結構基序，Pheomelanin 是含硫的黃至紅色黑色素。1,4-benzothiazine 系統含有賦予氧化還原活性和金屬結合能力的氮和硫雜原子。Pheomelanin 在化學上由其 benzothiazine 單元所定義，這使它有別於吲哚類型的 eumelanin。

label: SIRT3 deficiency
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: In mice and cultured cells, SIRT3 deficiency favors cell transformation in response to oncogenic Ras or Myc, and the same loss stabilizes HIF-1α with consequent induction of the glycolytic program of the Warburg effect. Because SIRT3 normally governs mitochondrial metabolism, ROS production, and genome stability, its absence releases a permissive environment for oncogenic signaling and metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT3 acts upstream: reduced SIRT3 allows transformation and Warburg metabolism to proceed, defining its tumor-suppressive role in this context.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠和培養細胞中，SIRT3 缺乏有利於致癌性 Ras 或 Myc 引起的細胞轉化，且同一缺失穩定 HIF-1α 並導致 Warburg 效應的糖酵解程序誘導。由於 SIRT3 正常情況下掌控粒線體代謝、活性氧生成和基因組穩定性，其缺失釋放了一個允許致癌訊號和代謝重編程的環境。方向性上 SIRT3 位於上游：SIRT3 降低允許轉化和 Warburg 代謝進行，定義了其在此情境下的腫瘤抑制角色。

label: DGCR8
description: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
description_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

label: NQO1
description: Coenzyme Q10 is regenerated from its oxidized ubiquinone to the reduced ubiquinol form by NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1) and by the thioredoxin/glutaredoxin systems. This recycling maintains the antioxidant capacity of ubiquinol after it quenches lipid radicals. It links CoQ10 function to the broader glutathione and thioredoxin antioxidant networks.
description_zh_TW: Coenzyme Q10 由 NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1（NQO1）以及 thioredoxin/glutaredoxin 系統從其氧化態 ubiquinone 再生成還原態 ubiquinol。這種回收在 ubiquinol 淬滅脂質自由基後維持其抗氧化能力。它將 CoQ10 的功能與更廣泛的 glutathione 和 thioredoxin 抗氧化網絡連結起來。

label: mtDNA
source_file: _document_ - JCI -Expanding roles of cGAS-STING signaling in neuroinflammation.md
description: SAMD releases mtDNA into the cytosol via minority MOMP -- sublethal, intermittent mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization that leaks mtDNA without triggering full apoptosis. The escaped mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern activating cGAS-STING, which drives type-I interferon and NF-kB-dependent SASP, and SCAPs restrain this process to prevent complete cell death. This release is a pivotal link between mitochondrial stress and innate immune activation in senescence. It exemplifies how senescent cells walk a fine line between life and death.
description_zh_TW: SAMD 經由少數 MOMP——次致死、間歇的粒線體外膜透化——將 mtDNA 釋放至胞質，使 mtDNA 滲漏而不觸發完全凋亡。逃出的 mtDNA 作為損傷相關分子模式活化 cGAS-STING，驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP，且 SCAPs 抑制此過程以防完全細胞死亡。此釋放是粒線體壓力與先天免疫活化間的關鍵連結，例示衰老細胞如何在生與死之間走鋼索。

label: Senotherapy
description: Senotherapy encompasses senolytics, the cell-elimination arm that selectively induces apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling SCAPs. This is one of the two principal divisions of senotherapy, the other being senomorphics, and the term captures the spectrum of interventions aimed at the senescent cell. Encompassing senolytics underscores the elimination-based strategy's centrality to the field, given its strong preclinical and early clinical evidence. Senolytic agents range from navitoclax to the D+Q combination and fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapy 涵蓋 senolytics，即透過失能 SCAPs 選擇性誘發衰老細胞凋亡的細胞消除臂。這是 senotherapy 兩個主要分支之一，另一為 senomorphics，且此詞涵蓋針對衰老細胞的介入光譜。涵蓋 senolytics 強調消除為本策略對該領域的中心性，考量其強健的臨床前與早期臨床證據。Senolytic 藥劑從 navitoclax 到 D+Q 組合與 fisetin 皆有。

label: Rapalogs
description: Rapalogs are analogs of rapamycin that inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. They share rapamycin's core pharmacology, including mTORC1 inhibition, autophagy induction, and lifespan effects.
description_zh_TW: Rapalog 是 rapamycin 的類似物，透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面抑制 mTORC1。它們共享 rapamycin 的核心藥理學，包括 mTORC1 抑制、自噬誘導與壽命效應。

label: OSKM
description: Pluripotent reprogramming is induced by transient expression of the Yamanaka factors Oct4, Sox2, Klf4 and c-Myc (together OSKM). Reprogramming kinetics and barrier factors such as p53 shape the efficiency of OSKM-driven reset.
description_zh_TW: 多能性重編程由 Yamanaka 因子 Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc（合稱 OSKM）的短暫表現誘導。重編程動力學和 p53 等屏障因子決定 OSKM 驅動重置的效率。

label: HAT
description: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
description_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

label: Cholesterol
description: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

label: Pluripotency
description: Teratoma formation is the gold-standard assay of pluripotency, validating induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC) and embryonic stem cells (ESC) for rejuvenation medicine. This is an instrumental, research-level benefit of a benign tumor rather than an organismal longevity benefit.
description_zh_TW: 畸胎瘤形成是分化多能性的黃金標準檢定，驗證誘導性多能幹細胞（iPSC）與胚胎幹細胞（ESC）用於回春醫學。這是良性腫瘤的器械性、研究層級益處，而非生物體層級的長壽益處。

label: Thioredoxin
description: Thioredoxin proteins are recycled to their active reduced state by thioredoxin reductase in an NADPH-consuming cycle. Together with the glutathione system, thioredoxin and thioredoxin reductase constitute the bulk of cellular antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白透過硫氧還蛋白還原酶在耗用 NADPH 的循環中被回收至活化的還原態。與麩胱甘肽系統一起，硫氧還蛋白與硫氧還蛋白還原酶構成了細胞抗氧化能力的主要部分。

label: Nucleoside Analog
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine belongs to the nucleoside analog class of antimetabolites, replacing the ribose of cytidine with a cyclopentene ring. The structural change permits phosphorylation to the active triphosphate but prevents productive incorporation into nucleic acids.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine 屬於核苷類似物類別的抗代謝物，以環戊烯環取代胞苷的核糖。此結構改變允許其磷酸化為活性三磷酸，但防止其被有效地嵌入核酸。

label: anti-inflammatory properties
description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

label: Chemotherapy Resistance
description: Cancer Stem Cells drive Chemotherapy Resistance. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with Cancer Stem Cells acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 驅動Chemotherapy Resistance。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer Stem Cells 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Neurogenesis
description: Neurogenesis is the process by which neurons are produced from neural stem and progenitor cells, persisting in adult brain regions like the hippocampus. It is regulated by exercise, caloric restriction, and BDNF, and its decline with aging is associated with cognitive decline.
description_zh_TW: 神經新生是神經元由神經幹細胞與前驅細胞產生的過程，在海馬迴等成人大腦區域持續存在。它受運動、熱量限制與 BDNF 調控，其隨衰老的下降與認知衰退相關。

label: HMGA1
description: HMGA1 cooperates with the RB1 (retinoblastoma) pathway to promote formation of repressive heterochromatin at proliferation-promoting loci. This reinforcement of the heterochromatic state helps lock cells into permanent growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: HMGA1 與 RB1（視網膜母細胞瘤）途徑合作，在促進增殖的基因座處促進抑制性異染色質的形成。此對異染色質狀態的強化有助於將細胞鎖入永久生長停滯。

label: SAMe production
description: By remethylating homocysteine to methionine, MethylB12 supports the production of methionine, the precursor of SAMe, the universal methyl donor consumed by COMT. MethylB12 therefore indirectly influences the rate of COMT-mediated methylation of catecholamines. Its status is coupled to overall methyl-group supply.
description_zh_TW: 透過將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸，MethylB12 支持蛋氨酸的產生，蛋氨酸是 COMT 消耗的通用 methyl donor SAMe 的前驅物。因此 MethylB12 間接影響 COMT 介導的兒茶酚胺甲基化速率。其狀態與整體甲基供應相關。

label: Rb
description: Dephosphorylated (hypophosphorylated) Rb maintains cell cycle arrest in its active, growth-suppressive form. Inhibition of Rb phosphorylation during arrest preserves this tumor-suppressive state. Rb is thus a central mediator of cell cycle arrest, particularly at the G1 checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: 去磷酸化的 Rb 以其活性、抑制生長的形式維持細胞週期停滯。在停滯期間抑制 Rb 磷酸化可保留此腫瘤抑制狀態。因此 Rb 是細胞週期停滯（尤其是 G1 檢查點）的核心媒介。

label: Drug Repositioning
description: Drug repositioning includes fenbendazole, an established benzimidazole anthelmintic now studied for its interference with microtubules, glycolysis, and p53 in tumors. The approach aims to convert a safe veterinary/human agent into a cancer therapeutic. The relationship is directional and reflects the logic of repurposing known drugs. Clinical validation for fenbendazole in oncology is still lacking.
description_zh_TW: Drug Repositioning 包括芬苯達唑，一種成熟的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，目前正在研究其對腫瘤微管、糖酵解和 p53 的幹擾。該方法旨在將安全的獸醫/人類藥物轉化為癌症治療劑。這種關係是方向性的，反映了重新利用已知藥物的邏輯。芬苯達唑在腫瘤學的臨牀驗證仍缺乏。

label: NOX4
description: NOX4 produces hydrogen peroxide rather than superoxide because it is constitutively active and dismutates its product internally, releasing H2O2 as the main extracellular and matrix signaling oxidant. This makes NOX4 a major source of the diffusible second messenger in fibroblasts and the kidney. The directionality is enzyme activity to H2O2 signaling. A caveat is that NOX4's H2O2 output is context-dependent and can be both profibrotic via TGF-beta signaling and protective depending on tissue. NOX4 is unique among NOX isoforms in being constitutively active and regulated primarily at the transcriptional level, for instance by TGF-beta and hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: NOX4 產生 hydrogen peroxide 而不是超氧化物，因為它具有組成活性並在內部歧化其產物，釋放 H2O2 作為主要的細胞外和基質信號傳導氧化劑。這使得 NOX4 成為成纖維細胞和腎臟中可擴散第二信使的主要來源。方向性是酵素對 H2O2 訊號傳導的活性。需要注意的是，NOX4 的 H2O2 輸出是上下文相關的，並且可以透過 TGF-beta 訊號傳導促進纖維化，也可以根據組織提供保護作用。 NOX4 在 NOX 同工型中是獨特的，因為它具有組成型活性，並且主要在轉錄層面上受到調節，例如透過 TGF-beta 和缺氧調節。

label: slow COMT
description: In slow COMT variants, catechol clearance is reduced so endogenous catecholamines may accumulate, enhancing stress reactivity. Exogenous catechols can further inhibit the already sluggish enzyme and add methyl-group demand on the methylation cycle. This underlies the stress sensitivity and supplement intolerance often reported by slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: 在緩慢的 COMT 變異中，兒茶酚清除減少，因此內源性 catecholamines 可能累積，增強壓力反應性。外源性兒茶酚可進一步抑制本已遲緩的酶，並增加對 methylation cycle 的甲基需求。這正是緩慢 COMT 個體常回報的壓力敏感性和補充劑不耐受的基礎。

label: FKBP12
description: Rapalogs inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. FKBP12 is therefore the essential cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage and suppress mTORC1 signaling.
description_zh_TW: Rapalog 透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面來抑制 mTORC1。因此 FKBP12 是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與並抑制 mTORC1 訊號所需的必需輔因子。

label: Cathepsin D
description: Lysosomal proteases are responsible for degrading glycated proteins intracellularly. Cathepsin D, an aspartic protease, and Cathepsin B, a cysteine protease, are major enzymes that break down AGE-modified proteins after they are directed to lysosomes for degradation. A decrease in Cathepsin D expression or activity, which occurs during aging and UV exposure, directly correlates with the accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Cathepsin-dependent lysosomal degradation therefore represents the third line of defense against AGE accumulation, removing established glycated proteins that prevention and repair enzymes cannot handle.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體蛋白酶負責在細胞內降解糖化蛋白。組織蛋白酶 D（Cathepsin D，一種天冬胺酸蛋白酶）與組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B，一種半胱氨酸蛋白酶）是將 AGE 修飾蛋白在導向溶酶體降解後分解的主要酵素。組織蛋白酶 D 表現或活性在老化與紫外線暴露期間下降，直接與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，依賴組織蛋白酶的溶酶體降解代表對抗 AGE 堆積的第三道防線，移除預防與修復酵素無法處理的已建立糖化蛋白。

label: Minority MOMP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Minority MOMP (sublethal mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization) allows mtDNA release from mitochondria into the cytosol without full apoptotic execution, providing a non-lethal route for mitochondrial danger signals to engage innate immunity. Cytosolic mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern that activates the cGAS-STING axis, inducing type I interferon responses and reinforcing senescence-linked cytokine circuits and the SASP.
description_zh_TW: Minority MOMP（sublethal mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization）允許 mtDNA 從 mitochondria 釋放到 cytosol，而無需 full apoptotic execution，提供了一條 non-lethal route 讓 mitochondrial danger signals 參與 innate immunity。Cytosolic mtDNA 作為 damage-associated molecular pattern 激活 cGAS-STING axis，誘導 type I interferon responses 並強化 senescence-linked cytokine circuits 和 SASP。

label: Deacetylation
description: Histone deacetylation condenses chromatin by restoring the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, strengthening their electrostatic interaction with DNA and promoting nucleosome compaction. This condenses the chromatin fiber, reducing the accessibility of DNA to transcription factors and repressing gene expression. Deacetylation is catalyzed by histone deacetylases, which counterbalance the chromatin-opening effects of histone acetyltransferases and are targets of HDAC-inhibitor drugs.
description_zh_TW: Histone 去乙醯化透過恢復組蛋白尾部離胺酸殘基的正電荷來濃縮染色質，加強其與 DNA 的靜電相互作用並促進核小體壓縮。這會壓縮染色質纖維，降低 DNA 對轉錄因子的可及性並抑制 gene expression。 Deacetylation 由組蛋白去乙醯化酶催化，可抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的染色質打開作用，並且是 HDAC 抑制劑藥物的標靶。

label: chromatin condensation
description: AIF induces chromatin condensation. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chromatin condensation is a terminal morphologic hallmark of death in which DNA is compacted, classically by caspase or AIF action. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: AIF 誘發chromatin condensation。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 chromatin condensation 是死亡的終末形態學標誌，其中 DNA 被壓縮，通常是透過 caspase 或 AIF 作用實現的。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 chromatin condensation 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Gasdermin E
description: Caspase-3 cleaves gasdermin E (GSDME), releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain and converting apoptosis into pyroptosis. The outcome is dictated by GSDME expression level: in GSDME-high cancer cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 drives pyroptotic lysis; in GSDME-low settings, GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3, reinforcing classical apoptosis. This caspase-3/GSDME switch is the clearest demonstration that the caspase substrate — not the caspase itself — determines the death modality.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 會切割 gasdermin E（GSDME），釋出其成孔的 N 端片段，使細胞凋亡轉為焦亡。結果由 GSDME 的表達量決定：在 GSDME 高表達的癌細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 驅動焦亡裂解；在 GSDME 低表達的情境下，GSDME 反而作為 Caspase-3 的上游活化因子，強化典型細胞凋亡。Caspase-3/GSDME 開關最清楚地表現出：決定死亡型態的是 caspase 的受質，而非 caspase 本身。

label: Pancreatic Cancer
description: KRAS is mutated in approximately 90% of pancreatic cancers, with G12D the most common alteration. These mutations impair GTPase activity and lock KRAS in the active GTP-bound state. KRAS mutation is a defining driver of pancreatic tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: KRAS 在約 90% 的胰臟癌中發生突變，其中 G12D 是最常見的改變。這些突變會損害 GTPase 活性，並使 KRAS 鎖定在活化的 GTP 結合狀態。KRAS 突變是胰臟腫瘤發生的決定性驅動因子。

label: Platelets
description: Platelet aggregation is the process whereby activated platelets bind to one another through fibrinogen bridging the integrin receptor, forming the terminal common pathway of primary hemostasis. Activated platelets aggregate to form thrombi and support coagulation.
description_zh_TW: 血小板凝集是活化的血小板透過纖維蛋白原橋接整合素受體而彼此結合的過程，是初級止血的終末共同途徑。活化的血小板凝集成血栓並支持凝血。

label: Dopamine Transporter
description: The dopamine transporter is sparse in the prefrontal cortex compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine clearance there relies far more on diffusion, extracellular enzymatic O-methylation by COMT, and uptake by the norepinephrine transporter. This anatomical fact is the reason COMT genotype so strongly influences prefrontal dopamine and cognition, since DAT cannot rapidly buffer synaptic dopamine. Reduced DAT expression shifts the burden of inactivation to COMT and NET. It is a cornerstone of the regional dopamine regulation model.
description_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質中的多巴胺轉運蛋白稀疏，這意味著那裡的多巴胺清除更依賴擴散、COMT 的細胞外酶促 O-甲基化以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白的攝取。這項解剖事實是 COMT genotype 如此強烈影響前額葉多巴胺和認知的原因，因為 DAT 無法快速緩衝突觸多巴胺。減少的 DAT expression 將失活的負擔轉移到 COMT 和 NET。它是區域多巴胺調節模型的基石。

label: MMP
description: MMP promotes Metastasis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MMP 促進Metastasis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: SRC kinase
description: Bik is degraded by SRC kinase. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. SRC is a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that promotes survival and, notably, phosphorylates and inactivates caspase-8 and Bik. The directionality runs from SRC kinase toward Bik, so SRC kinase is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Bik 被 SRC kinase 降級。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 SRC 是一種非受體酪胺酸激酶，可促進存活，尤其是磷酸化 caspase-8 和 Bik 並使其失去活性。方向性從SRC kinase 朝向Bik，因此SRC kinase 是活性劑，Bik 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Myocardium
description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

label: Docetaxel
description: Ivermectin reversed docetaxel resistance in PC3 prostate cancer cells via HSP27 modulation.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 通過 HSP27 調節在 PC3 前列腺癌細胞中逆轉 docetaxel 抗藥性。

label: Base Excision Repair
description: APE1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1) cleaves the DNA backbone 5' to abasic (AP) sites generated by spontaneous base loss or by DNA glycosylases such as OGG1, initiating base excision repair. It also removes 3'-blocking groups, making it a rate-limiting hub in the repair of oxidative DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: APE1（無嘌呤/無嘧啶核酸內切酶 1）在自發性鹼基缺失或 OGG1 等 DNA 糖苷酶所產生的無鹼基（AP）位點 5' 端切割 DNA 主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復。它也移除 3' 阻斷基團，使其成為氧化性 DNA 損傷修復中的速率限制樞紐。

label: CD73
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: CD73, the rate-limiting ectonucleotidase that converts AMP to immunosuppressive adenosine in the tumor microenvironment, is downregulated following intermittent fasting. Reduced CD73 expression leads to diminished extracellular adenosine, which can relieve adenosine-mediated immune suppression and enhance anti-tumor immunity. The regulation is observed in vitro under fasting-mimetic conditions, linking IF to both metabolic and immunological remodeling. Because adenosine signaling promotes tumor evasion, CD73 downregulation represents a plausible mechanism by which fasting improves cancer therapy outcomes.
description_zh_TW: CD73是腫瘤微環境中將AMP轉化為免疫抑制性腺苷的限速胞外核苷酸酶，在間歇性斷食後下調。CD73表現降低導致細胞外腺苷減少，可緩解腺苷介導的免疫抑制並增強抗腫瘤免疫。此調節在體外斷食模擬條件下觀察到，將IF與代謝和免疫重塑連結。由於腺苷訊號促進腫瘤逃避免疫，CD73下調代表斷食改善癌症治療結果的一個合理機制。

label: ABT-263
description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor developed to overcome the poor solubility of the earlier pan-BH3 mimetic ABT-737. Both agents inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Bcl-w, but ABT-263 enabled clinical translation. The relationship is directional in drug-development lineage rather than biological mechanism. Its Bcl-xL inhibition still causes on-target thrombocytopenia, limiting the achievable dose.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是口服生物可利用的繼任者，旨在克服早期泛 BH3 模擬物 ABT-737 溶解度差的問題。兩種藥物均抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w，但 ABT-263 能夠達到臨牀轉化。這種關係在藥物開發譜系中是定向的，而不是生物機制。它的抑制仍然會導致靶向血小板減少，從而限制了可達到的劑量。

label: BRAF
description: Oncogenic BRAF (V600E), RAS, or MYC drive a hyperproliferative burst that causes DNA replication stress and a DNA damage response, permanently arresting the cell via p53/p21 and p16/Rb. OIS is therefore induced by oncogenic signaling yet confronts it with a tumor-suppressive barrier in benign lesions.
description_zh_TW: 致癌性 BRAF（V600E）、RAS 或 MYC 驅動高增生爆發，造成 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷反應，經由 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 永久性停滯細胞。OIS 因此由致癌訊號誘發，卻在良性病灶中以腫瘤抑制屏障對抗之。

label: IRS1
description: IRS1 is a signaling adaptor in insulin signaling whose phosphorylation by S6K provides negative feedback that dampens PI3K-Akt signaling. In the incoherent bivalent motif network model, such negative-feedback nodes underlie hormetic dose responses of pathway inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: IRS1 是胰島素訊號中的訊號銜接蛋白，其被 S6K 磷酸化提供抑制 PI3K-Akt 訊號的負回饋。在不一致雙價模體（incoherent bivalent motif）網路模型中，此類負回饋節點是途徑抑制劑毒物興奮劑量反應的基礎。

label: S6K1/2
description: S6K1/2 are primary downstream effectors of mTORC1, and rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 suppresses S6K1/2 activity. This places S6K1/2 on the rapamycin-sensitive axis regulating protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2 是 mTORC1 的主要下游效應器，rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 會壓制 S6K1/2 活性。這使 S6K1/2 位於調控蛋白質合成的 rapamycin 敏感軸上。

label: TXNIP
description: In pancreatic beta-cells, SIRT6 preserves glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) and cell survival by repressing expression of TXNIP, a pro-oxidant and pro-apoptotic protein. This repression is achieved through histone deacetylation, with SIRT6 removing acetylation marks at H3K9 and H3K56 in the TXNIP regulatory region. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TXNIP suppression via chromatin modification. By keeping TXNIP low, SIRT6 protects beta-cells from glucotoxic damage and maintains their capacity to secrete insulin in response to glucose. This links SIRT6's epigenetic function directly to pancreatic beta-cell health and the preservation of glucose homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 在胰島β細胞中，SIRT6透過抑制TXNIP的表達來維持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌（GSIS）和細胞存活，TXNIP是一種促氧化和促凋亡蛋白。此抑制透過組蛋白去乙醯化實現，SIRT6在TXNIP調控區域移除H3K9和H3K56的乙醯化標記。方向上，SIRT6透過染色質修飾位於TXNIP抑制的上游。透過保持TXNIP低水平，SIRT6保護β細胞免受葡萄糖毒性的損傷，並維持其對葡萄糖反應分泌胰島素的能力。這將SIRT6的表觀遺傳功能直接與胰島β細胞健康和葡萄糖恆定的維持聯繫起來。

label: Fructosamine-3-kinase
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is an intracellular enzyme that initiates protein deglycation by phosphorylating fructosamine, the Amadori residues on glycated proteins, converting them into fructosamine-3-phosphate. This phosphorylated compound is highly unstable and spontaneously decomposes, regenerating the original, undamaged amino acid and releasing 3-deoxyglucosone, which is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes. By repairing early glycation intermediates before they progress to irreversible AGEs, FN3K provides the repair arm of the enzymatic defense against AGE accumulation, complementary to prevention by dicarbonyl detoxification.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶（Fructosamine-3-kinase, FN3K）是一種細胞內酵素，透過磷酸化果糖胺（即糖化蛋白上的阿馬多里殘基）來啟動蛋白質去糖化，將其轉化為果糖胺-3-磷酸（fructosamine-3-phosphate）。此磷酸化化合物高度不穩定並自發分解，再生原始的未受損胺基酸並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone，隨後被解毒酵素中和。透過在不可逆 AGE 形成之前修復早期糖化中間產物，FN3K 提供了對抗 AGE 堆積之酵素防禦的修復臂，補充二羰基解毒的預防作用。

label: Adrenoleukodystrophy
description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

label: adrenochrome synthesis
description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

label: TCA cycle
description: Valine metabolism involves conversion to succinyl-CoA, which enters the TCA cycle to produce ATP, making valine a gluconeogenic and anaplerotic amino acid. Restricting valine alone reduces body weight, improves metabolic health, reduces hepatic senescence, and extends lifespan of male mice, while in female mice valine restriction is protective in Alzheimer's disease progression. Dysregulated valine catabolism (via 3-hydroxyisobutyrate) contributes to insulin resistance in diabetic rats. Human plasma analysis found reduced circulating valine is associated with aging and moderate cognitive impairment, but valine supplementation worsens glucose tolerance and induces gut inflammation and hepatic lipid deposition, suggesting the role of valine in healthy aging may vary between species.
description_zh_TW: 纈胺酸代謝涉及轉化為琥珀醯-CoA，後者進入 TCA 循環產生 ATP，使纈胺酸成為一種生糖和回補胺基酸。單獨限制纈胺酸可減輕體重、改善代謝健康、減少肝臟衰老並延長雄性小鼠壽命，而在雌性小鼠中纈胺酸限制對阿茲海默病進展具有保護作用。纈胺酸分解代謝失調（通過 3-羥基異丁酸）導致糖尿病大鼠的胰島素抵抗。人類血漿分析發現，循環纈胺酸降低與衰老和輕度認知障礙相關，但纈胺酸補充會惡化葡萄糖耐受性並誘發腸道炎症和肝臟脂質沉積，表明纈胺酸在健康衰老中的作用可能因物種而異。

label: SIRT1 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 overexpression protects against obesity-associated metabolic derangement via deacetylation of metabolic transcription factors.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過表達透過去乙醯化代謝轉錄因子來保護免受肥胖相關的代謝紊亂。

label: SIRT3 activation
description: MIP-2 (CXCL2) is a CXC chemokine recruiting neutrophils via CXCR2. SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced MIP-2 expression alongside TNF-alpha and IL-6, and diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in preclinical models, via NF-kappaB suppression.
description_zh_TW: MIP-2（CXCL2）是一種透過 CXCR2 招募嗜中性球的 CXC 趨化因子。SIRT3 活化與 TNF-alpha 和 IL-6 一起與 MIP-2 表現減少一致相關，以及臨床前模型中多形核白血球浸潤的減少，透過 NF-kappaB 抑制實現。

label: AMPK activation
description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
description_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

label: Atrial natriuretic peptide
description: Atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) binds natriuretic peptide receptor-A, a membrane guanylyl cyclase, raising intracellular cGMP to drive natriuresis, diuresis, and vasodilation. cGMP is the second messenger mediating ANP's counter-regulatory cardiovascular actions.
description_zh_TW: 心房利鈉肽（ANP）結合利鈉肽受體-A（一種膜鳥苷酸環化酶），提高細胞內 cGMP 以驅動利鈉、利尿與血管舒張。cGMP 是介導 ANP 反向調節心血管作用的第二信使。

label: TRPML1
description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

label: SLC7A11
description: Erastin, the prototype class-I ferroptosis inducer, blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter system xc- (SLC7A11), depleting intracellular cysteine and thereby glutathione. Without GSH, GPX4 cannot reduce lipid peroxides, and iron-driven Fenton chemistry plus LOX-mediated oxidation accumulate lethal lipid peroxides. Erastin additionally induces ER stress that activates the CHOP-PUMA axis, recruiting apoptosis on top of ferroptosis — a combined-death approach relevant to cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Erastin 是第一類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型，會阻斷胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運蛋白 system xc-（SLC7A11），耗竭細胞內胱胺酸進而耗盡麩胱甘肽。缺乏 GSH 時，GPX4 無法還原脂質過氧化物，鐵驅動的 Fenton 化學與 LOX 介導的氧化便累積致命的脂質過氧化物。Erastin 還會誘導內質網壓力、活化 CHOP-PUMA 軸線，在鐵死亡之上疊加細胞凋亡——這是與癌症治療相關的複合死亡策略。

label: Nicotinic acid
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels, and it is used to treat dyslipidemia, although it is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day. In contrast, nicotinamide (NAM) does not affect lipid blood levels, yet it can exhibit sirtuin-inhibiting effects at higher doses, while nicotinamide riboside (NR) does not cause flushing because it does not activate GPR109A. The distinct physiological responses of the NAD+ precursors NA, NAM, and NR, despite all three raising NAD+ and NADP+ levels, are important for selecting the appropriate precursor for specific therapeutic indications.
description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）展現降低血脂水平的效果，並被用於治療血脂異常，儘管其在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關。相對地，nicotinamide（NAM）不影響血脂水平，但其在較高劑量下可展現抑制 sirtuin 的效果，而 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）因不活化 GPR109A 而不會造成潮紅。NAD+ 前驅物 NA、NAM 與 NR 儘管三者皆提升 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 水平，其截然不同的生理反應對於選擇適當前驅物以用於特定治療適應症相當重要。

label: elevated homocysteine
description: Several MTHFD1 polymorphisms, such as the G1958A/R653Q missense variant, have been associated with altered enzyme kinetics and biomarkers of impaired folate metabolism. These variants are linked to elevated homocysteine and modified risk for neural tube defects and certain cancers. As with MTHFR, they can reduce the efficiency of methyl-group provision.
description_zh_TW: 若干 MTHFD1 多態性，例如 G1958A/R653Q 錯義變異，已與改變的酶動力學和葉酸代謝受損的生物標記相關。這些變異與 elevated homocysteine 以及神經管缺陷和某些癌症的風險改變有關。與 MTHFR 一樣，它們會降低甲基供給的效率。

label: Ferroptosis in IDD
description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

label: SAH
description: SAH (S-adenosylhomocysteine) is the hydrolysis product formed when SAM donates its methyl group, and it is a potent competitive inhibitor of nearly all methyltransferases. Accumulation of SAH globally suppresses methylation, including histone methylation, perturbing epigenetic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SAH（S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸）是 SAM 捐出甲基時形成的水解產物，是幾乎所有甲基轉移酶的強效競爭性抑制劑。SAH 累積會全面抑制甲基化（包括組蛋白甲基化），擾亂表觀遺傳恆定。

label: LipA
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: SIRT2 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT2 inhibition or downregulation appears counterproductive in certain cancer contexts, particularly when combined with microtubule inhibitors, because loss of SIRT2 prolongs chronic mitotic arrest and makes cancer cells resistant to these agents. The enzyme normally helps cells exit mitosis cleanly; without it, cells linger in a prolonged arrested state that selects for survival. Directionally, low SIRT2 activity sits upstream of this resistance phenotype. This caveat limits the general anticancer rationale for SIRT2 inhibition and argues for careful context- and regimen-specific use.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 抑制或下調在某些癌症情境中看似適得其反，特別是在與微管抑制劑合併使用時，因為 SIRT2 的缺失延長了慢性有絲分裂停滯，使癌細胞對這些藥物產生抗性。該酵素正常情況下幫助細胞順利退出有絲分裂；沒有它時，細胞會停留在延長的停滯狀態中，有利於存活。方向性上低 SIRT2 活性位於此抗性表型的上游。這一注意事項限制了 SIRT2 抑制的通用抗癌依據，並主張在使用時需謹慎考慮具體情境和治療方案。

label: SARS-CoV-2
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: The combined layer carries the single typed edge 'sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism', which pulls the virus into the CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging attribute space; severe COVID-19 drives CD38-NADase-mediated NAD+ depletion confirmed in 2020–21 literature (Heer et al., JBC 2020) — a mechanistic corridor the triples layer still lacks.
description_zh_TW: combined 層攜帶單一類型邊「sars_cov_2 —[disrupts]→ NAD+_metabolism」，把病毒拉入 CD38/PARP/sirtuin/inflammaging 屬性空間；重症 COVID-19 驅動的 CD38-NADase 介導 NAD+ 耗竭已由 2020–21 文獻證實（Heer et al., JBC 2020），是 triples 層仍缺乏的機制走廊。

label: mTORC1 to lysosomes
description: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation, positioning mTORC1 for activation; amino-acid starvation inactivates Rags and disperses mTORC1, de-repressing autophagy. The Rags therefore act as amino-acid sensors that bridge nutrient availability to mTORC1 spatial activation. Their regulation by the Ragulator and GAPs (e.g., GATOR complexes) is central to nutrient signaling.
description_zh_TW: Rag GTPases（RagA/B 和 RagC/D）作為異二聚體發揮功能，結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重新定位至活化劑 Rheb 所在的溶酶體表面。胺基酸充足有利於活化的 Rag 構象，將 mTORC1 定位以進行活化；胺基酸飢餓則使 Rags 失活並分散 mTORC1，解除對自噬的抑制。因此 Rags 作為胺基酸感測器，將營養可得性橋接到 mTORC1 的空間活化。它們受 Ragulator 和 GAPs（例如 GATOR 複合物）調節，是營養信號的核心。

label: Sirtuin deacetylation reaction
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: During the sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation of a lysine, NAD+ is cleaved between its nicotinamide and ADP-ribose moieties, and the acetyl group is transferred to the ADP-ribose to generate 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose (OAADPr) plus free nicotinamide. OAADPr is a stoichiometric by-product, released in equimolar amounts with the deacetylated substrate on every catalytic cycle. This molecule is not merely waste: it binds and activates the TRPM2 cation channel, linking sirtuin activity to calcium signaling and cellular stress responses. A caveat is that OAADPr accumulation can itself feed back on cellular metabolism, and its levels reflect the integrated deacetylase flux of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 在 sirtuin 催化的離胺酸去乙醯化過程中，NAD+ 在菸鹼醯胺和 ADP-核糖基團之間被裂解，乙醯基被轉移到 ADP-核糖上，生成 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose（OAADPr）和游離的菸鹼醯胺。OAADPr 是化學計量的副產物，在每個催化週期中以等摩爾量與去乙醯化的受質一起釋放。這個分子不僅僅是廢物：它能結合並活化 TRPM2 陽離子通道，將 sirtuin 活性與鈣離子訊號傳導和細胞壓力反應聯繫起來。需要注意的是，OAADPr 的積累本身可以反饋影響細胞代謝，其水平反映了細胞整體的去乙醯酶通量。

label: Tenovins
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: Zellweger syndrome
description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

label: IL-7
description: Thymic epithelial cells produce a number of colony stimulating factors and hematopoietic cytokines, including IL-1, IL-3, IL-6, IL-7, TGF-β, oncostatin M, and leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF). Intrathymic and systemic production of these cytokines and growth factors regulates the complex process of thymopoiesis and is responsible for stromal cross-talk within the thymic microenvironment. IL-7 in particular is a crucial cytokine for thymocyte survival and T cell development, making the thymic cytokine milieu a candidate target for therapies aimed at reversing age-induced thymic involution. Loss of TEC-derived IL-7 production with age contributes to declining thymic output.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺上皮細胞產生多種集落刺激因子和造血細胞因子，包括 IL-1、IL-3、IL-6、IL-7、TGF-β、oncostatin M 和白血病抑制因子（LIF）。胸腺內和全身性的這些細胞因子和生長因子的產生調節胸腺生成的複雜過程，並負責胸腺微環境內的基質交談。IL-7 尤其是胸腺細胞存活和 T 細胞發育的關鍵細胞因子，使胸腺細胞因子環境成為旨在逆轉年齡相關胸腺退化的治療候選靶點。隨著年齡增長，TEC 來源的 IL-7 產生減少導致胸腺輸出下降。

label: Vasodilation
description: Under normal conditions nitric oxide is a crucial signaling molecule that relaxes vascular smooth muscle via activation of soluble guanylyl cyclase and cGMP production. However, during severe inflammation, injury, or shock, overproduction of NO - primarily by inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) - leads to excessive vasodilation, vascular leakage, and tissue damage. This is the pathway targeted by both aminoguanidine, which blocks NO synthesis at iNOS (upstream), and methylene blue, which blocks NO action at sGC (downstream).
description_zh_TW: 正常情況下，一氧化氮是通過激活可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶和cGMP產生來放鬆血管平滑肌的關鍵信號分子。然而，在嚴重炎症、損傷或休克期間，NO的過度產生（主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）產生）導致過度血管舒張、血管滲漏和組織損傷。這正是氨基胍（在iNOS水平阻斷NO合成，上游）和亞甲藍（在sGC水平阻斷NO作用，下游）共同靶向的通路。

label: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a prominent advanced glycation end product formed from glycated proteins. There is a marked correlation between the serum concentration of CML and vessel stiffness in elderly individuals, reflecting the role of AGE accumulation and ECM cross-linking in arterial stiffening. CML also accumulates in heart tissue with age, and dietary CML-enriched protein induces functional arterial aging in a RAGE-dependent manner in mice. Serum CML is therefore used as a biomarker of glycation burden and age-related vascular pathology.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是由 glycated proteins 形成的重要 advanced glycation end product。Elderly individuals 血清 CML concentration 與 vessel stiffness 之間存在顯著相關性，反映了 AGE accumulation 與 ECM cross-linking 在 arterial stiffening 中的作用。CML 也隨年齡堆積於 heart tissue，而 dietary CML-enriched protein 在 mice 中以 RAGE-dependent manner 誘發 functional arterial aging。因此，血清 CML 被用作 glycation burden 與 age-related vascular pathology 的 biomarker。

label: CK2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated at Ser157 by CK2, one of several kinase inputs that regulate this initiator caspase. Alongside CDK1/CYCLIN B1 (Ser308) and CaMKII (Ser164), CK2 contributes to the phosphorylation-dependent control of caspase-2. These modifications modulate its activity and its susceptibility to 14-3-3 binding.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 在 Ser157 被 CK2 磷酸化，這是調控此啟動型半胱天冬酶的幾個激酶輸入之一。與 CDK1/CYCLIN B1（Ser308）和 CaMKII（Ser164）並列，CK2 也參與對 caspase-2 的磷酸化依賴性調控。這些修飾調節其活性及其對 14-3-3 結合的敏感性。

label: Caspase-12
description: Caspase-12 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-12 is an ER-localized protease that mediates apoptotic signaling arising specifically from endoplasmic-reticulum stress. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-12, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-12 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-12 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-12 是一種內質網定位的蛋白酶，可介導由內質網壓力引起的細胞凋亡訊號傳導。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-12，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-12 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Brown Adipose Tissue
description: SIRT6 supports thermogenesis in brown and beige adipose tissue, which is induced under cold exposure, thereby contributing to energy expenditure and protection from obesity. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of thermogenic gene programs in brown adipose tissue. This pro-thermogenic role opposes SIRT7, which suppresses brown-adipose function, illustrating opposing actions within the sirtuin family on energy expenditure. By maintaining the capacity of brown and beige fat to burn calories, SIRT6 helps the body dissipate energy as heat rather than store it. Supporting SIRT6 activity is therefore considered a potential approach for counteracting weight gain and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6支持棕色和米色脂肪組織中的生熱作用，該作用在冷暴露下被誘導，從而有助於能量消耗和對抗肥胖。方向上，SIRT6位於棕色脂肪組織中生熱基因程序的上游。此促生熱作用與抑制棕色脂肪功能的SIRT7相對抗，說明了sirtuin家族在能量消耗方面的對立作用。透過維持棕色和米色脂肪燃燒卡路里的能力，SIRT6幫助身體將能量以熱量形式散失而非儲存。因此支持SIRT6活性被認為是對抗體重增加和代謝疾病的潛在方法。

label: Navitoclax
description: OIS cells in benign/premalignant lesions are vulnerable to Navitoclax-class senolytics. Eliminating them may paradoxically promote tumor growth by removing a cell-autonomous cancer barrier — the senolytic paradox — so retaining certain benign tumors is functionally protective against cancer.
description_zh_TW: 良性／癌前病灶中的 OIS 細胞易受 Navitoclax 類去衰老藥物攻擊。清除它們可能矛盾地透過移除細胞自主的癌症屏障而促進腫瘤生長——即去衰老悖論——因此保留某些良性腫瘤在功能上對抗癌症具保護性。

label: L-Tyrosine
description: Tyrosinase catalyzes the rate-limiting hydroxylation of L-Tyrosine to L-DOPA and the subsequent oxidation to dopaquinone. This is the first committed step of melanogenesis. The reaction is central to both cutaneous and neural pigment synthesis, linking skin and brain melanin biology.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 催化 L-Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA 的限速反應，以及隨後氧化為 dopaquinone。這是黑色素生成的第一個承諾步驟。該反應對皮膚和神經色素的合成都至關重要，連結了皮膚和大腦的黑色素生物學。

label: Dasatinib
description: The D+Q combination (dasatinib + quercetin) is detrimental in females in some models while beneficial in tauopathy females; the sex-specific benefit depends on which senescence arm dominates and sex-hormonal status. Senolytic benefit therefore depends as much on sex as on senescent burden.
description_zh_TW: D+Q 組合（dasatinib + quercetin）在某些模型中對雌性有害，而在 tau 病雌性中卻有益；性別特異的益處取決於何種衰老分支主導與性荷爾蒙狀態。因此衰老溶解療法的益處取決於性別與衰老負擔同樣多。

label: Exosomes
description: ALIX regulates Exosomes. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Exosomes are nanovesicles shed by tumor cells that traffic immune-checkpoint ligands and growth signals within the microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon Exosomes rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 Exosomes。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Exosomes 是腫瘤細胞脫落的奈米囊泡，在微環境中傳遞免疫檢查點配體和生長訊號。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 Exosomes 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: SK61_2
description: S6K1/2 (SK61_2), activated by mTORC1 phosphorylation, inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylating it, forming the negative feedback loop that is central to the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis. This feedback arm is the backward reaction from the inhibited target (mTORC1) toward the Input node (IRS1, controlled by S6K1/2), and its low Michaelis-Menten constant in the saturated regime strongly increases the probability of biphasic dose-responses. S6K1/2 also deactivates mTORC2, and a significant negative correlation exists between the inhibition of the IRS1-insulin complex and mTORC2 deactivation by the same enzyme S6K1.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2（SK61_2）被mTORC1磷酸化激活，通過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成rapamycin hormesis基礎的incoherent bivalent motif核心的負反饋迴路。這個反饋臂是從被抑製的靶點（mTORC1）向輸入節點（IRS1，由S6K1/2控制）的backward reaction，並且其低Michaelis-Menten常數在飽和條件下強烈增加了雙相劑量反應的可能性。S6K1/2還使mTORC2失活，並且在IRS1-胰島素复合物的抑製和同一酶S6K1對mTORC2的失活之間存在顯著的負相關。

label: CTPI2
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
description_zh_TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

label: ATFS-1
description: ATFS-1 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor in C. elegans that serves as the primary regulator of the mitochondrial unfolded protein response (UPRmt). Under mitochondrial stress it translocates to the nucleus to drive the protective UPRmt gene program.
description_zh_TW: ATFS-1 是線蟲（C. elegans）中鹼性螺旋-環-螺旋轉錄因子，是粒線體未折疊蛋白反應（UPRmt）的主要調控者。在粒線體壓力下它轉位至細胞核以驅動保護性的 UPRmt 基因程式。

label: HIIT
description: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is a cornerstone mitohormetic stimulus: brief maximal efforts generate an acute ROS spike and lactate accumulation that trigger PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）是核心的毒物興奮（mitohormetic）刺激：短暫的最大努力產生急性 ROS 峰值與乳酸累積，觸發粒線體生合成的總管 PGC-1α。

label: Cell Cycle
description: The G1 Phase (Gap 1) is the first gap phase of the cell cycle in eukaryotic cell division, following mitosis or exit from quiescence and preceding S phase. During G1 the cell grows, synthesizes RNAs and proteins, and monitors its environment before committing to DNA replication.
description_zh_TW: G1 期（第一間隙期）是真核細胞分裂中細胞週期的第一個間隙期，緊接有絲分裂或退出靜止期，並先於 S 期。在 G1 期，細胞生長、合成 RNA 和蛋白質，並在決定進行 DNA 複製前監測其環境。

label: Kidney
description: The kidneys perform filtration, reabsorption, and endocrine functions, and chronic kidney disease accelerates vascular calcification, AGE accumulation, and cardiovascular risk. Renal dysfunction intersects with systemic aging through impaired clearance and glycation.
description_zh_TW: 腎臟執行過濾、再吸收與內分泌功能，而慢性腎病加速血管鈣化、AGE 累積與心血管風險。腎功能障礙透過清除與糖化受損與全身性衰老交織。

label: JAK-STAT3
description: The JAK-STAT3 signaling axis promotes a pro-inflammatory SASP by interacting with p38 MAPK and mTOR and by transducing cues from SASP cytokines such as IL-6. STAT3 activation contributes to age-related frailty and to the immune-modulatory and tumor-promoting facets of the secretome. JAK1/2 inhibitors (e.g., ruxolitinib) reduce SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8, validating the axis as a senomorphic target. The pathway is especially important for the feed-forward, self-reinforcing inflammation characteristic of chronic senescence.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 訊號軸透過與 p38 MAPK 和 mTOR 交互作用，以及轉導來自 SASP 細胞激素如 IL-6 的訊號，促進促發炎性 SASP。STAT3 活化促成年齡相關衰弱，以及分泌組的免疫調節與促腫瘤面向。JAK1/2 抑制劑（如 ruxolitinib）降低 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8，證實此軸作為 senomorphic 標靶。該路徑對慢性衰老特有的正向、自我強化發炎尤為重要。

label: Mcl-1
description: Resistance to ABT-737 is commonly driven by Mcl-1, a pro-survival Bcl-2 family protein that ABT-737 does not inhibit. Because Mcl-1 remains available to bind and sequester pro-apoptotic effectors, MOMP is not fully engaged. The relationship is directional and defines a specific, targetable vulnerability rather than a general failure. Co-targeting Mcl-1 restores the apoptotic commitment that ABT-737 alone cannot achieve.
description_zh_TW: 對 ABT-737 的抗性通常由 Mcl-1 驅動，這是 ABT-737 不抑制的一種促生存 Bcl-2 family 蛋白。由於 Mcl-1 仍可結合和隔離促凋亡效應子，因此 MOMP 並未完全發揮作用。這種關係是定向的，定義了特定的、可針對的漏洞，而不是一般的故障。共同靶向 Mcl-1 恢復了單獨 ABT-737 無法實現的凋亡承諾。

label: p15INK4b
description: p15INK4b is a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor of the INK4 family that binds and inhibits CDK4/CDK6, preventing Rb phosphorylation. By keeping the retinoblastoma protein hypophosphorylated, p15INK4b enforces a durable G1 cell-cycle block central to senescence.
description_zh_TW: p15INK4b 是 INK4 家族的細胞週期蛋白依賴激酶抑制劑，結合並抑制 CDK4/CDK6，防止 Rb 磷酸化。透過使視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白保持低磷酸化，p15INK4b 強制執行衰老核心的持久 G1 細胞週期阻斷。

label: Adrenochrome Semiquinone Radical
description: Adrenochrome undergoes one-electron reduction to the adrenochrome semiquinone radical, a highly reactive intermediate species. Common cellular reducers that drive this reaction include mitochondrial Complex I using NADH, NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase, and non-enzymatic reductants such as ascorbate and adrenaline itself. The semiquinone radical is central to adrenochrome redox cycling, as it rapidly auto-oxidizes to regenerate adrenochrome while producing superoxide anion at a fast rate. This radical-mediated redox loop means that adrenochrome can catalytically amplify reactive oxygen species and oxidative damage, and it has been studied in cardiac tissue where high catecholamine exposure and mitochondrial density make the cycle particularly relevant.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 經受單電子還原成為高度反應性的中間物種 adrenochrome 半醌自由基。驅動此反應的常見細胞還原劑包括使用 NADH 的粒線體 Complex I、NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase，以及抗壞血酸與 adrenaline 本身等非酶性還原劑。半醌自由基是 adrenochrome 氧化還原循環的核心，因為它迅速自氧化以再生 adrenochrome，同時以快速速率產生超氧陰離子。此自由基介導的氧化還原迴圈意味著 adrenochrome 能催化放大活性氧物種與氧化損傷，且已在兒茶酚胺暴露高與粒線體密度高的心臟組織中被研究，使此循環特別相關。

label: Saturated Enzymatic Regime
description: Michaelis-Menten kinetics describe enzyme-catalyzed reaction rate as a saturable function of substrate concentration. The saturated enzymatic regime occurs when the Michaelis-Menten constant is very small relative to substrate, making the reaction rate insensitive to substrate changes.
description_zh_TW: Michaelis-Menten 動力學將酶催化反應速率描述為受質濃度的飽和函數。當 Michaelis-Menten 常數遠小於受質時即為飽和酶學機制，使反應速率對受質變化不敏感。

label: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff
description: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Konstantin Nikolaevich Tretiakoff 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: PIDDosome
description: Caspase-2 is activated by PIDDosome. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The directionality runs from PIDDosome toward Caspase-2, so PIDDosome is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-2 由 PIDDosome 啟動。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。方向性從 PIDDosome 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 PIDDosome 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Fructosyl-Amino Acid Oxidases
description: Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases (FAOD), also known as amadoriases, are enzymes found primarily in fungi and bacteria, such as Aspergillus species, that catalyze the oxidation of Amadori products. The reaction yields an unmodified amino acid, a glucosone, and hydrogen peroxide. Because they deglycate early glycation intermediates, FAOD are actively researched for therapeutic and cosmetic applications, and some research explores pairing FAOD with fructosamine-3-kinase to synergistically deglycate damaged structural proteins such as skin collagen. These enzymes represent a repair-based strategy for reducing AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-胺基酸氧化酶（Fructosyl-amino acid oxidases, FAOD），亦稱為 amadoriases，是主要存在於真菌與細菌（如麴菌屬 Aspergillus 物種）中的酵素，催化阿馬多里產物的氧化。此反應產生未修飾的胺基酸、葡萄糖酮（glucosone）與過氧化氫。由於它們使早期糖化中間產物去糖化，FAOD 被積極研究用於治療與美容應用，且部分研究探討將 FAOD 與果糖胺-3-激酶配對，以協同地去糖化受損的結構蛋白如皮膚膠原蛋白。這些酵素代表一種基於修復的減少 AGE 堆積策略。

label: catechol flavonoid
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Fisetin is a catechol-containing flavonoid, a flavonol found in fruits and vegetables such as strawberries and apples, and its catechol ring makes it both a substrate for and a potential inhibitor of COMT. As a dietary catechol, it is O-methylated by COMT during metabolism, linking its pharmacokinetics to COMT genotype. At high supplemental doses it can compete with endogenous catechols for the enzyme, though physiological dietary intake is generally modest. It is studied for its antioxidant, senolytic, and neuroprotective properties.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種含兒茶酚的黃酮類化合物，是一種存在於草莓和蘋果等水果和蔬菜中的黃酮醇，其兒茶酚環使其既是 COMT 的底物，又是 COMT 的潛在抑制劑。作為一種膳食兒茶酚，它在代謝過程中被 COMT O-甲基化，從而將其藥物動力學與 COMT genotype 聯繫起來。在高補充劑量下，它可以與內源性兒茶酚競爭酶，儘管生理飲食攝取量通常是適度的。人們對其抗氧化劑、senolytic 和 neuroprotective properties 進行了研究。

label: Foam Cells
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Glycated low-density lipoprotein is taken up by macrophages in the arterial wall, and this uptake of modified LDL leads to foam cell formation. Because glycation reduces LDL uptake by the normal cell receptor pathway, modified LDL accumulates, and its subsequent engulfment by macrophages produces lipid-laden foam cells, the hallmark cells of atherosclerotic plaques. The formation of foam cells from modified LDL represents an initiating step of atheroma development and explains why AGE-mediated modification of LDL is considered pro-atherogenic. This pathway links glycation chemistry directly to the cellular pathology of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: Glycated low-density lipoprotein被arterial wall中的macrophages攝取，而此uptake of modified LDL leads to foam cell formation。由於glycation reduces LDL uptake by the normal cell receptor pathway，modified LDL accumulates，其subsequent engulfment by macrophages produces lipid-laden foam cells——atherosclerotic plaques的hallmark cells。由modified LDL形成foam cells represents an initiating step of atheroma development，並explains why AGE-mediated modification of LDL is considered pro-atherogenic。此pathway links glycation chemistry directly to the cellular pathology of atherosclerosis與cardiovascular disease。

label: Puma
description: Nuclear p53 transcriptionally activates PUMA (p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis), a BH3-only protein that binds and inhibits the anti-apoptotic BCL-xL. Because PUMA can act both as a direct activator of BAX/BAK and as a sensitizer that displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members, p53-PUMA signaling lowers the mitochondrial threshold for cytochrome c release. Cytoplasmic p53 additionally retains the ability to activate BAX and BAK directly.
description_zh_TW: 細胞核內的 p53 會轉錄活化 PUMA（p53 上調凋亡調控因子），一種可結合並抑制抗凋亡 BCL-xL 的 BH3-only 蛋白。由於 PUMA 既能直接活化 BAX/BAK，也能作為置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員的敏化因子，p53-PUMA 訊號降低了粒線體釋出 cytochrome c 的門檻。此外，細胞質型的 p53 仍可直接活化 BAX 與 BAK。

label: Caspase-5
description: Active caspase-4/5/11 cleave gasdermin D between its N-terminal pore-forming domain and C-terminal inhibitory domain, releasing the N-terminal fragment to form plasma-membrane pores. This drives inflammatory cell death (pyroptosis) and IL-1alpha release in senescent and responding cells, and the pores also permit release of IL-1beta and IL-18 prior to membrane rupture. The relationship is the canonical execution step of noncanonical inflammasome signaling and links the pathway to both cell death and SASP amplification, creating a feed-forward inflammatory loop in senescent tissue.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 caspase-4/5/11 切割 gasdermin D 其 N 端成孔域與 C 端抑制域之間，釋放 N 端片段形成質膜孔洞。這驅動發炎性細胞死亡（pyroptosis）與衰老及反應細胞中的 IL-1alpha 釋放，且孔洞允許 DAMPs 與細胞激素外逸以放大發炎。透過將非典型發炎體連結到膜透化，此切割將細胞死亡形態與 SASP 耦合，影響衰老細胞存留與免疫清除。

label: Vagus Nerve
description: Heart rate variability (HRV) reflects the balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic branches of the autonomic nervous system. The parasympathetic branch, governed largely by the vagus nerve, allows greater beat-to-beat fluctuation and raises HRV.
description_zh_TW: 心率變異度（HRV）反映自主神經系統交感與副交感分支的平衡。主要由迷走神經（vagus nerve）主導的副交感分支允許更大的逐跳波動並提高 HRV。

label: ABT-737
description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor developed to overcome the poor solubility of the earlier pan-BH3 mimetic ABT-737. Both agents inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Bcl-w, but ABT-263 enabled clinical translation. The relationship is directional in drug-development lineage rather than biological mechanism. Its Bcl-xL inhibition still causes on-target thrombocytopenia, limiting the achievable dose.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是口服生物可利用的繼任者，旨在克服早期泛 BH3 模擬物 ABT-737 溶解度差的問題。兩種藥物均抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w，但 ABT-263 能夠達到臨牀轉化。這種關係在藥物開發譜系中是定向的，而不是生物機制。它的抑制仍然會導致靶向血小板減少，從而限制了可達到的劑量。

label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Beyond its well-known mono-ADP-ribosylation of glutamate dehydrogenase, SIRT4 also functions as a lipoamidase that regulates the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. By removing lipoate modifications, SIRT4 can influence pyruvate dehydrogenase activity and thereby control entry of glucose-derived carbon into the tricarboxylic acid cycle. Directionally, SIRT4's lipoamidase activity sits upstream of pyruvate dehydrogenase regulation. This broadens SIRT4's control of mitochondrial substrate oxidation and adds to its role in metabolic flexibility.
description_zh_TW: 除了其眾所周知的對穀氨酸脫氫酶的單-ADP-核糖基化外，SIRT4還作為硫辛醯胺酶發揮作用，調節丙酮酸脫氫酶複合物。透過移除硫辛酸修飾，SIRT4可以影響丙酮酸脫氫酶活性，從而控制葡萄糖衍生碳進入三羧酸循環。方向上，SIRT4的硫辛醯胺酶活性位於丙酮酸脫氫酶調節的上游。這擴展了SIRT4對粒線體底物氧化的控制，並增加了其在代謝靈活性中的角色。

label: GDH
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: GDH is the primary substrate through which SIRT4 suppresses glutamine metabolism, yet GDH is also listed among negative regulators in Table 3: high GDH activity can outpace SIRT4 ADP-ribosylation under energetic stress, switching cells toward glutaminolysis/fuel oxidation and away from SIRT4-mediated restraint.
description_zh_TW: GDH 是 SIRT4 抑制穀胺酸代謝的主要底物，但 GDH 也被列為表 3 中的負向調節因子：在能量壓力下，高 GDH 活性可能超過 SIRT4 的 ADP-核糖基化，使細胞轉向穀氨醯胺分解/燃料氧化，脫離 SIRT4 介導的限制。

label: Melanogenesis
description: MC1R regulates the melanogenic pathway by switching Melanocytes from pheomelanin to eumelanin synthesis. Upon binding alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, MC1R signals via Gs to stimulate adenylyl cyclase and cAMP, activating the eumelanogenic program in Melanogenesis. Loss-of-function variants reduce signaling and shift synthesis toward Pheomelanin.
description_zh_TW: MC1R 透過將 Melanocytes 從 pheomelanin 合成切換為 eumelanin 合成來調節黑色素生成途徑。在結合 alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone 後，MC1R 透過 Gs 發出信號以刺激 adenylyl cyclase 和 cAMP，啟動 Melanogenesis 中的 eumelanogenic 程序。功能缺失變異會降低信號傳導並使合成轉向 Pheomelanin。

label: Lysosomal Membrane Permeabilization
description: Mild lysosomal membrane permeabilization releases cathepsins that cleave Bid and other apical caspases, engaging apoptosis. Extensive LMP floods the cytosol with hydrolases, causing necrosis-like death, while moderate LMP bridges to the apoptotic program.
