description_zh_TW: 輕度溶酶體膜通透化釋放組織蛋白酶，剪切 Bid 與其他頂端 caspase 以啟動細胞凋亡。重度 LMP 以水解酶淹沒細胞質造成類壞死死亡，中度 LMP 則橋接至細胞凋亡程式。

label: Superoxide
description: MnSOD is the primary mitochondrial enzyme that dismutates superoxide (O2-) into hydrogen peroxide and oxygen, intercepting it at its site of generation in the electron transport chain. By converting the reactive superoxide radical into the less damaging hydrogen peroxide, MnSOD constitutes the first line of defense against mitochondrial oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: MnSOD 是主要的粒線體酶，將超氧陰離子（O2-）歧化為過氧化氫和氧氣，並在電子傳遞鏈的產生源頭將其攔截。透過將反應性強的超氧自由基轉化為傷害較小的過氧化氫，MnSOD 構成對抗粒線體氧化壓力的第一道防線。

label: FAK
description: FAK promotes Angiogenesis. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with FAK acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: FAK 促進Angiogenesis。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，FAK 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Rejuvenation
description: Partial reprogramming through short, cyclic OSKM pulses in vivo reverses epigenetic age without teratoma risk or identity loss, targeting rejuvenation rather than pluripotency. It is the translational arm linking reprogramming to rejuvenation and the information theory of aging.
description_zh_TW: 透過體內短暫、週期性的 OSKM 脈衝進行部分重編程，可在無畸胎瘤風險或身分喪失的情況下逆轉表觀遺傳年齡，目標是回春而非多能性。這是將重編程與回春及老化資訊理論連結起來的轉譯分支。

label: Lactate
description: Lactate can downregulate SIRT3, which in turn increases acyl-CoA synthetase long chain family member 4 (ACSL4) lactylation, thereby promoting ferroptosis and accelerating the decline of nucleus pulposus cell functionality in intervertebral disc degeneration. This cascade connects disc metabolic dysregulation (hypoxia, lactate accumulation) to SIRT3 loss and ferroptotic cell death via the lactylation mark.
description_zh_TW: 乳酸可以下調 SIRT3，後者反過來增加脂肪醯-CoA 合酶長鏈家族成員 4（ACSL4）的乳醯化，從而促進鐵死亡並加速椎間盤退化中髓核細胞功能的衰退。此級聯將椎間盤代謝失調（低氧、乳酸累積）透過乳醯化標記與 SIRT3 缺失和鐵死亡性細胞死亡聯繫起來。

label: CDK1
description: Cell cycle arrest at the G2/M phase is associated with decreased expression and kinase activity of CDK1 (cdc2) and Cyclin B. Removing the cyclin B-CDK1 drive halts the transition into mitosis. This downregulation is a hallmark of G2/M arrest induced by agents such as Apigenin.
description_zh_TW: G2/M 期的細胞週期停滯與 CDK1（cdc2）和 Cyclin B 表現及激酶活性下降有關。移除 cyclin B–CDK1 驅動力會阻止進入有絲分裂。這種下調是 Apigenin 等藥物誘導之 G2/M 停滯的標誌。

label: Cardiovascular System
description: The cardiovascular system is one of the domains affected by chronic low-grade inflammation (inflammaging), which contributes to arterial stiffening and cardiovascular disease with age. Interventions that lower background inflammation may preserve cardiovascular hemodynamic aging.
description_zh_TW: 心血管系統是受慢性低度發炎（inflammaging）影響的領域之一，發炎老化會隨年齡促成動脈硬化與心血管疾病。能降低背景發炎的介入措施可能有助於保存心血管血流動力老化。

label: DunedinPACE
description: Because DunedinPACE captures the rate of aging, it is suited to testing whether interventions slow the aging process itself, linking directly to healthspan. It predicts later physical and cognitive functioning and incidence of multiple age-related diseases from a single blood sample.
description_zh_TW: 由於 DunedinPACE 捕捉老化速率，它適合測試介入措施是否減緩老化過程本身，直接與健康壽命（healthspan）相連結。它可從單一血液樣本預測後續身體與認知功能及多種年齡相關疾病的發生。

label: Etoposide
description: Etoposide is a topoisomerase inhibitor used in small-cell lung cancer chemotherapy, combined with a platinum agent and, in limited-stage disease, thoracic radiotherapy. It is a backbone agent of SCLC treatment. Etoposide is therefore central to SCLC therapy.
description_zh_TW: Etoposide 是用於 Small-cell lung cancer 化療的拓撲異構酶抑制劑，與鉑類藥物聯用，並在局限性疾病中與胸部放療聯用。它是 SCLC 治療的主幹藥物。因此 Etoposide 對 SCLC 治療至關重要。

label: OGG1
description: APE1 processes abasic sites generated downstream of the DNA glycosylase OGG1 in base excision repair of oxidative DNA lesions such as 8-oxo-dG. The 3'-OH primer it creates is then processed by DNA polymerase beta and ligated by LIG3/XRCC1.
description_zh_TW: 在氧化性 DNA 病變（如 8-oxo-dG）的鹼基切除修復中，APE1 處理在 DNA 糖苷酶 OGG1 下游所產生的無鹼基位點。它所產生的 3'-OH 引子接著由 DNA 聚合酶 beta 處理，並由 LIG3/XRCC1 接合。

label: Nutlins
description: Cancer is treated by Nutlins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward Cancer, so Nutlins is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 由 Nutlins 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 Cancer，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Ruxolitinib
description: JAK-STAT3 is inhibited by ruxolitinib, a JAK1/2 inhibitor that reduces SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 in senescent fibroblasts. By blocking JAK-STAT3 signaling downstream of SASP cytokines, it interrupts the inflammatory feed-forward loop that sustains the secretome, and its established clinical use in myelofibrosis supports its translational potential as a senomorphic. The inhibition is direct, well validated, and among the most clinically translatable senomorphic mechanisms. It positions ruxolitinib as a leading candidate for dampening senescence-associated inflammation.
description_zh_TW: JAK-STAT3 被 ruxolitinib 抑制，ruxolitinib 是一種降低衰老纖維母細胞中 SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 的 JAK1/2 抑制劑。透過阻斷 SASP 細胞激素下游的 JAK-STAT3 訊號，它中斷維持分泌組的發炎正向迴圈，且其於骨髓纖維化既有的臨床使用支持其作為 senomorphic 的轉譯潛力。此抑制直接、良好驗證，且是臨床上最易轉譯的 senomorphic 機制之一。它使 ruxolitinib 成為減弱衰老相關發炎的領先候選。

label: Oncogene
description: Driver events for tumorigenic potential include activating oncogene mutations such as RAS and MYC. Together with tumor suppressor loss, these overcome tumor-suppressor loss-induced senescence and oncogene-induced senescence to enable tumor formation.
description_zh_TW: 致瘤潛力的驅動事件包括 RAS 和 MYC 等活化致癌基因突變。這些與腫瘤抑制因子缺失一起，克服腫瘤抑制因子缺失誘導的衰老和致癌基因誘導的衰老，使腫瘤形成成為可能。

label: Uric Acid
description: Uric acid scavenges peroxynitrite, acting as a physiologic antioxidant in humans (who lack the uricase that degrades it) at the high plasma concentrations typical of the species. It reacts with peroxynitrite to limit tyrosine nitration and lipid oxidation. The directionality is scavenger to oxidant neutralization. A caveat is that urate is also pro-oxidant and pro-inflammatory at high levels and contributes to gout, so its net effect is concentration- and context-dependent. Because humans and great apes lost uricase, urate circulates at near-saturating concentrations, providing a constitutive antioxidant buffer in plasma.
description_zh_TW: Uric acid 清除 peroxynitrite，在人類（缺乏降解它的尿酸酶）中在該物種典型的高血漿濃度下充當生理抗氧化劑。它與 peroxynitrite 反應，限制 tyrosine 硝化和脂質氧化。方向性是清除劑至氧化劑中和。需要注意的是，高水平的尿酸鹽還具有促氧化和促炎作用，並會導致痛風，因此其淨效應取決於濃度和環境。由於人類和類人猿失去了尿酸酶，尿酸鹽以接近飽和的濃度循環，在血漿中提供了組成型抗氧化緩衝劑。

label: Gossypol
description: Apoptosis is induced by Gossypol. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The directionality runs from Gossypol toward Apoptosis, so Gossypol is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 Gossypol 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。方向性從 Gossypol 向 Apoptosis，因此 Gossypol 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: SARM1
description: SARM1 is an NAD+-consuming enzyme that, along with PARP1, PARP2, and CD38, can deplete cellular NAD+ pools and compromise sirtuin function. Directionally, SARM1 activity sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and impaired sirtuin signaling. Its activity is particularly relevant in neuronal contexts, where NAD+ depletion drives axonal degeneration. By consuming NAD+ upon injury or stress, SARM1 can starve sirtuins of their co-substrate at the very moment when their protective functions are most needed. This makes SARM1 an attractive therapeutic target for neurodegenerative conditions, where preventing NAD+ loss could preserve both axonal integrity and sirtuin activity.
description_zh_TW: SARM1是一種NAD+消耗酶，與PARP1、PARP2和CD38一起，可以耗竭細胞NAD+池並損害sirtuin功能。方向上，SARM1活性位於NAD+耗竭和sirtuin訊號受損的上游。其活性在神經元環境中尤為重要，因為NAD+耗竭驅動軸突退化。透過在損傷或壓力下消耗NAD+，SARM1可以在sirtuin的保護功能最需要的時刻使其缺乏共同底物。這使SARM1成為神經退行性疾病的有吸引力的治療靶點，在這些疾病中防止NAD+流失可以同時保留軸突完整性和sirtuin活性。

label: methyl donor supplements
description: People with slow COMT enzyme variants may find that supplements affecting the methylation cycle can affect their neurotransmitter levels. A sudden influx of methyl groups from high doses of methyl donor supplements can cause irritability, anger, or anxiety. Clinicians often recommend against taking methyl donor supplements for slow COMT (rs4680 A/A).
description_zh_TW: 具有緩慢 COMT 酶變異的人可能發現，影響 methylation cycle 的補充劑會影響其神經傳導物質水平。高劑量甲基供體補充劑帶來的甲基群突然湧入可能導致煩躁、憤怒或焦慮。臨床醫師常建議緩慢 COMT (rs4680 A/A) 者不要服用甲基供體補充劑。

label: MKP-3
description: MKP-3 binds Bcl-2 and removes phosphate groups at Thr56, Thr74, and Ser87, which normally prime Bcl-2 for ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. By dephosphorylating Bcl-2, MKP-3 prevents its turnover and elevates cellular Bcl-2 levels. This is the non-canonical apoptosis-relevant function of MKP-3.
description_zh_TW: MKP-3 結合 Bcl-2，並移除 Thr56、Thr74 和 Ser87 上的磷酸基團，這些位點的磷酸化通常會使 Bcl-2 準備進行泛素化與蛋白酶體降解。透過去磷酸化 Bcl-2，MKP-3 防止其周轉並提升細胞內 Bcl-2 水平。這是 MKP-3 與細胞凋亡相關的非經典功能。

label: KAP1
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: The RING-domain E3 ligase TRIM28/KAP1 polyubiquitinates SIRT1 (K48-linked) and targets it for proteasomal degradation following severe DNA damage (doxorubicin, etoposide, camptothecin, UV). TRIM28 knockdown or CRISPR knockout stabilizes SIRT1 and reduces its ubiquitination; reconstitution of wild-type TRIM28 — but not the E3-dead C65/68A mutant — restores SIRT1 turnover in vivo and in a purified in vitro ubiquitination assay with UBE1/UBE2L6. TRIM28 is thus both necessary and sufficient as the damage-induced SIRT1 E3.
description_zh_TW: RING 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶 TRIM28/KAP1 會對 SIRT1 進行 K48 型多泛素化，並在嚴重 DNA 損傷（doxorubicin、etoposide、camptothecin、UV）後將其送往蛋白酶體降解。TRIM28 的 knockdown 或 CRISPR 基因敲除會穩定 SIRT1 並降低其泛素化；重新表達野生型 TRIM28——但不含 E3 失活的 C65/68A 突變株——可在體內與以 UBE1/UBE2L6 進行的試管內泛素化試驗中恢復 SIRT1 的代謝。因此 TRIM28 對損傷誘導的 SIRT1 E3 角色既必要且充分。

label: Superoxide anion
description: NADPH oxidase is the enzyme system in activated neutrophils that generates superoxide radicals, the primary oxidants driving adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome. The superoxide and derived reactive oxygen species produced by this system account for over 80% of adrenaline oxidation in the presence of stimulated neutrophils at low micromolar adrenaline concentrations, making it the major catabolic route for adrenaline under these inflammatory conditions. Hydrogen peroxide generated by NADPH oxidase also serves as the substrate for myeloperoxidase, which can further contribute to catecholamine oxidation.
description_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase是activated neutrophils中生成superoxide radicals的enzyme system，而superoxide radicals是驅動adrenaline oxidation to adrenochrome的主要oxidants。在低micromolar adrenaline concentrations下，此system產生的superoxide及其derived reactive oxygen species佔stimulated neutrophils存在時adrenaline oxidation的80%以上，使其成為這些inflammatory conditions下adrenaline的主要catabolic route。NADPH oxidase生成的hydrogen peroxide亦作為myeloperoxidase的substrate，可進一步促進catecholamine oxidation。

label: Frontotemporal Dementia
description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

label: Autophagy Inducer
description: Autophagy-inducing interventions have been shown to rejuvenate features of adaptive immune aging, a process characterized by thymic involution, reduced naïve T cell output, and diminished responses to vaccination and infection. By clearing damaged mitochondria and improving proteostasis in lymphocytes, autophagy inducers restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance memory CD8+ T cell generation. Pharmacological or dietary activation of autophagy counteracts the functional defects that accumulate in immune cells with age. These effects position autophagy enhancement as a plausible strategy to mitigate immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: 誘導自噬的介入已被證明可恢復適應性免疫老化的特徵，此過程以胸腺退化、初始T細胞產出減少以及對疫苗和感染的反應減弱為特徵。透過清除受損粒線體並改善淋巴細胞中的蛋白質穩態，自噬誘導劑恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成。藥理或飲食性活化自噬可抵消免疫細胞隨年齡累積的功能缺陷。這些效應將增強自噬定位為減緩免疫老化的合理策略。

label: Leucine
description: Leucine is a potent activator of the master nutrient sensor mTORC1 and stimulates skeletal muscle anabolism. Leucine signals to mTORC1 in specific neurons by binding to and activating a voltage-gated calcium channel (Cav3.1). In humans, leucine supplementation increases muscle protein synthesis but does not improve muscle function, and its effects on fat mass are mixed. Leucine's cardiovascular effects are divergent: some studies show supplementation accelerates atherosclerotic plaque progression in an mTORC1-dependent manner and its metabolite isovaleric acid accelerates atrial fibrillation, while others report improved vascular function. Notably, leucine supplementation does not extend mouse lifespan, suggesting changes in leucine are unlikely to be responsible for protein restriction benefits.
description_zh_TW: 白胺酸是主要營養感測器 mTORC1 的強效活化劑，並刺激骨骼肌合成代謝。白胺酸在特定神經元中透過結合並活化電壓依賴性鈣通道（Cav3.1）向 mTORC1 傳遞訊號。在人體中，白胺酸補充增加肌肉蛋白質合成，但不會改善肌肉功能，其對脂肪量的影響則好壞參半。白胺酸的心血管效應存在分歧：一些研究顯示補充會以 mTORC1 依賴方式加速動脈粥狀硬化斑塊進展，其代謝物異戊酸會加速心房顫動，而其他研究則報導血管功能改善。值得注意的是，白胺酸補充不會延長小鼠壽命，顯示白胺酸的改變不太可能是蛋白質限制益處的原因。

label: Senotherapeutic
description: The term 'senotherapeutic' is an umbrella encompassing both senolytics (which eliminate senescent cells) and senomorphics (which suppress the SASP). Senolytics act on the cellular driver, while senomorphics act on the secretory effector, together spanning the intervention space against senescence. This inclusive definition reflects the field's two-pronged therapeutic philosophy and accommodates agents with dual activity, such as fisetin. Recognizing both under one term aids classification and communication of anti-senescence strategies.
description_zh_TW: 「senotherapeutic」一詞是涵蓋 senolytics（消除衰老細胞）與 senomorphics（抑制 SASP）的傘詞。Senolytics 作用於細胞驅動者，senomorphics 作用於分泌效應器，共同涵蓋對抗衰老的介入空間。此包容性定義反映該領域的雙管齊下治療哲學，並容納具雙重活性的藥劑如 fisetin。在單一詞下辨識兩者有助於抗衰老策略的分類與溝通。

label: Estrogen Receptor
description: Estrogen receptor drives luminal breast cancer and its expression guides endocrine therapy. Flavonoids such as apigenin show biphasic estrogenic/anti-estrogenic activity via ER-binding-dependent and -independent mechanisms, with apigenin exerting anti-estrogenic effects in breast cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: 雌激素受體驅動管腔型乳癌，其表現指引內分泌治療。諸如 apigenin 等黃酮類透過 ER 結合依賴與非依賴機制表現雙相雌激素/抗雌激素活性，apigenin 在乳癌細胞中發揮抗雌激素作用。

label: CRISPR
description: CRISPR-based genome editing is used in cellular reprogramming to delete or modify genes that limit the generation of induced pluripotent stem cells. In the classic example, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout of the transcription factor Oct4 in reprogramming studies demonstrates how targeted gene disruption can probe the requirements of pluripotency. Beyond knockouts, CRISPRi and CRISPRa allow transient modulation of reprogramming factors and pathways, enabling more efficient and controllable iPSC generation and lineage conversion.
description_zh_TW: 基於 CRISPR 的基因組編輯用於細胞重編程，以刪除或修改限制誘導多能幹細胞生成的基因。在經典範例中，重編程研究中 CRISPR-Cas9 介導的轉錄因子 Oct4 敲除證明了標靶基因破壞如何能夠偵測多能性的要求。除了敲除之外，CRISPRi 和 CRISPRa 還可以瞬時調節重編程因子和途徑，從而實現更有效率、更可控的 iPSC 生成和譜系轉換。

label: Retinoblastoma Protein
description: p15INK4b is a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor of the INK4 family that binds and inhibits CDK4/CDK6, preventing Rb phosphorylation. By keeping the retinoblastoma protein hypophosphorylated, p15INK4b enforces a durable G1 cell-cycle block central to senescence.
description_zh_TW: p15INK4b 是 INK4 家族的細胞週期蛋白依賴激酶抑制劑，結合並抑制 CDK4/CDK6，防止 Rb 磷酸化。透過使視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白保持低磷酸化，p15INK4b 強制執行衰老核心的持久 G1 細胞週期阻斷。

label: Thrombocytopenia
description: Thrombocytopenia is a reduction in circulating platelets and one of the hematological cytopenias linked to chronic mTOR inhibitor use. Mild, reversible thrombocytopenia is among the most common hematological side effects of chronic high-dose rapamycin.
description_zh_TW: 血小板減少症是循環血小板減少，是與慢性 mTOR 抑制劑使用相關的血液細胞減少症之一。輕度可逆的血小板減少是慢性高劑量 rapamycin 最常見的血液學副作用之一。

label: Mice
description: In Pérez et al. (Aging Cell 2009), systemic overexpression of MnSOD (with CuZnSOD, catalase, glutathione peroxidase) did not extend mouse lifespan. MnSOD's contribution is essentially catalytic — it must sit inside the hormetic window (the K68 'Goldilocks' acetylation dial), and its overexpression buffers ROS without unlocking new signal.
description_zh_TW: 在 Pérez et al.（Aging Cell 2009）中，全身性 MnSOD（與 CuZnSOD、catalase、glutathione peroxidase）過度表現並未延長小鼠壽命。MnSOD 的貢獻本質上是催化性的——必須落在荷爾蒙窗口內（K68「金髮姑娘」乙醯化旋鈕），過度表現只是線性緩衝 ROS，不會開啟新訊號。

label: basal ganglia
description: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

label: Glucocerebrosidase
description: Glucocerebrosidase and Alpha-synuclein are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Glucocerebrosidase and Alpha-synuclein may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Glucocerebrosidase 和 Alpha-synuclein 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Glucocerebrosidase 和 Alpha-synuclein 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Mevalonate pathway
description: The substrate for FSP1 — ubiquinone/CoQ10 — is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Perturbations that suppress mevalonate output toward cholesterol (e.g., statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) starve FSP1 of its ubiquinone substrate, collapsing the FSP1 axis and predicting ferroptosis sensitivity. This makes the mevalonate pathway intersect ferroptosis at two nodes: selenocysteine-tRNA maturation for GPX4 and CoQ10 supply for FSP1.
description_zh_TW: FSP1 的受質——泛醌/CoQ10——是甲羥戊酸（mevalonate）路徑的非固醇產物。抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的擾動（例如 statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會使 FSP1 缺乏泛醌受質，瓦解 FSP1 軸並預示鐵死亡敏感性。這使甲羥戊酸路徑在兩個節點與鐵死亡交會：GPX4 所需的硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟，以及 FSP1 所需的 CoQ10 供應。

label: Omi/HtrA2
description: Omi/HtrA2 promotes Apoptosis. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Omi/HtrA2 促進 Apoptosis。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species generation
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Regular physical exercise effectively inhibits reactive oxygen species generation and improves the activities of antioxidant enzymes. Because the protein glycation reaction is driven and accelerated by ROS, the inhibition of AGE formation by regular exercise is considered the main mechanism of exercise-associated antioxidant activity. Exercise also reduces oxidative stress in rodent models and improves glycemic control, both of which limit AGE accumulation. These effects make physical exercise a non-pharmacological strategy for attenuating glycation stress during aging.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動能有效抑制活性氧（ROS）的生成，並提升抗氧化酵素的活性。由於蛋白質糖化反應受 ROS 驅動並加速，因此規律運動抑制 AGE 形成被視為運動相關抗氧化活性的主要機制。運動亦能降低囓齒類動物模型的氧化壓力並改善血糖控制，兩者皆能限制 AGE 累積。這些效應使身體運動成為減緩老化過程中糖化壓力的非藥物策略。

label: Topologically Associating Domain
description: A topologically associating domain (TAD) is a contiguous genomic region within which DNA sequences contact one another more frequently than with outside sequences. TADs are fundamental units of chromosome folding that constrain enhancer-promoter communication and looping.
description_zh_TW: 拓撲關聯結構域（TAD）是其中 DNA 序列彼此接觸頻率高於與外部序列的連續基因體區域。TAD 是約束增強子-啟動子溝通與環化的染色體摺疊基本單位。

label: Mitosis
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Symmetrical mitochondrial fission is closely orchestrated with the cell cycle to promote equal segregation of two functional daughter mitochondria during cell division, known as replicative fission. Mitochondria and cytoskeletal components work together to promote cell dichotomy and equal mitochondrial separation, including cytosolic contents and mtDNA, into the two daughter cells. Proliferation of vascular smooth muscle cells, myofibroblasts and pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells is inhibited by loss of DRP1, and fission defects lead to abnormally enlarged mtDNA nucleoids clustering in fused mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: Symmetrical mitochondrial fission is closely orchestrated with the cell cycle to promote equal segregation of two functional daughter mitochondria during cell division，known as replicative fission。Mitochondria and cytoskeletal components work together to promote cell dichotomy and equal mitochondrial separation, including cytosolic contents and mtDNA, into the two daughter cells。Proliferation of vascular smooth muscle cells, myofibroblasts and pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells is inhibited by loss of DRP1, and fission defects lead to abnormally enlarged mtDNA nucleoids clustering in fused mitochondria。

label: DNA-SCARS
description: DNA-SCARS are persistent nuclear foci of unresolved DNA damage that are enriched in phosphorylated gamma-H2A.X (H2A.X). They sustain the DNA-damage response that maintains senescence growth arrest and promotes SASP cytokine secretion.
description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 是未解決 DNA 損傷的持久性核焦點，富含磷酸化的 γ-H2A.X（H2A.X）。它們維持維持衰老生長停滯並促進 SASP 細胞激素分泌的 DNA 損傷反應。

label: H3K122ac
description: H3K122ac is a core-domain acetylation that destabilizes the nucleosome and is enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. Alongside H3K27ac and H3K18ac, it marks the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers.
description_zh_TW: H3K122ac 是使核小體不穩定的核心結構域乙醯化，富集於衰老活化的超級增強子。與 H3K27ac 及 H3K18ac 並列，它標記 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態。

label: Protein Carbonylation
description: Hydroxyl radicals cause protein carbonylation, an irreversible oxidative modification introduced when the radical attacks susceptible amino-acid side chains (notably Lys, Arg, Pro, Thr) or when lipid-peroxidation products adduct to proteins. Carbonylated proteins lose function and are targeted for degradation by the 20S proteasome. The directionality is from radical insult to stable, diagnostically useful protein modification. A caveat is that carbonylation is a downstream and cumulative marker rather than an acute, quantitative readout of hydroxyl-radical flux.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 導致 protein carbonylation，這是一種不可逆的氧化修飾，當自由基攻擊易受影響的氨基酸側鏈（特別是 Lys、Arg、Pro、Thr）或脂質過氧化產物加成 proteins 時引入。 Carbonylated proteins 失去功能，成為 20S proteasome 降級的目標。方向性是從徹底的損傷到穩定的、診斷上有用的蛋白質修飾。需要注意的是，羰基化是下游和累積標記，而不是羥基自由基通量的精確定量讀數。

label: ADP-ribosylation
description: SIRT4 functions principally as a mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase, using NAD+ to attach a single ADP-ribose group to target lysines rather than removing acetyl marks. Its best-characterized ADP-ribosylation target is glutamate dehydrogenase, whose activity it inhibits to dampen amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion. This enzymatic orientation means SIRT4 generally acts as a metabolic suppressor within mitochondria, opposing anabolic and growth signals. A caveat is that SIRT4's deacetylase activity is weak in vitro, so ADP-ribosylation is its physiologically dominant modality.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 主要作為單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶發揮功能，利用 NAD+ 將單個 ADP-核糖基團附加到目標離胺酸上，而非移除乙醯標記。其最具特徵的 ADP-核糖基化靶標是穀氨酸脫氫酶，SIRT4 抑制其活性以抑制胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌。這種酶學取向意味著 SIRT4 通常在粒線體內充時代謝抑制因子，對抗合成代謝和生長信號。需要注意的是，SIRT4 的去乙醯酶活性在體外較弱，因此 ADP-核糖基化是其生理上的主要作用模式。

label: Senomorphics
description: Senotherapeutics encompass senomorphics as the SASP-suppressing arm of the anti-senescence strategy, complementary to senolytics. Senomorphics modulate rather than remove senescent cells, preserving beneficial acute senescence, and their inclusion under the senotherapeutic umbrella highlights the diversity of mechanisms (mTOR, NF-kB, JAK-STAT, BET, sirtuins). The term thus unifies elimination- and modulation-based approaches within a single conceptual framework. This classification supports the rational design and comparison of anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapeutics 涵蓋 senomorphics 作為抗衰老策略中抑制 SASP 的臂，與 senolytics 互補。Senomorphics 調節而非移除衰老細胞，保留有益的急性衰老，其納入於 senotherapeutic 傘下凸顯機制的多樣性（mTOR、NF-κB、JAK-STAT、BET、sirtuins）。此詞因此將消除與調節為本的途徑統一於單一概念框架。此分類支持抗老化介入的合理設計與比較。

label: MAO
description: Graph node-analysis: MAO (degree 2, k-core 2) reaches Dopamine only through Epinephrine (no direct edge), with ~3–4× larger commute distance and near-null resistance z (Dopamine z = −0.70) — a peripheral metabolic spoke versus COMT's hub status.
description_zh_TW: 圖譜節點分析：MAO（degree 2、k-core 2）僅能透過 Epinephrine 到達 Dopamine（無直接邊），通勤距離約大 3–4 倍且阻力 z 近於零（Dopamine z = −0.70）——相對於 COMT 的樞紐地位，它是周邊的代謝輻條。

label: H2A.J
description: H2A.J is a vertebrate-specific H2A variant induced in senescent cells and at sites of persistent DNA damage, where it promotes an inflammatory gene-expression program. In radiation-induced senescence it decorates chronic damage foci and triggers the secretory phenotype.
description_zh_TW: H2A.J 是脊椎動物特異的 H2A 變異體，在衰老細胞與持續 DNA 損傷位點被誘導，並促進發炎基因表現程式。在輻射誘導衰老中它裝飾慢性損傷焦點並觸發分泌表現型。

label: GCN2
description: Protein restriction activates GCN2, an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase triggered by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, suppressing global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key activator of stress response and autophagy genes. Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, and deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, while overexpression extends lifespan. During PR, GCN2 is initially required for FGF21 induction and also activates hepatic gluconeogenesis in response to decreased amino acid availability.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制活化GCN2，這是一個 evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase，由胺基酸限制透過未充電的tRNAs以及核糖體停滯和碰撞觸發。活化的GCN2磷酸化eIF2alpha，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性促進ATF4的翻譯，ATF4是壓力反應和自噬基因的關鍵活化因子。缺乏Gcn2的黑腹果蠅在胺基酸限制時死亡，酵母中Gcn2的缺失阻斷飲食限制壽命延長，而過表達則延長壽命。在PR期間，GCN2最初對FGF21誘導是必需的，並在胺基酸可用性降低時激活肝臟糖質新生。

label: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: Hemostatics
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is a hemostatic agent formed by reacting aminoguanidine with adrenochrome, an unstable ortho-quinoid intermediate. Along with carbazochrome, it is one of the hydrazine derivatives of adrenochrome that serve as useful medicines with hemostatic activity. In the patented process, stabilization with aminoguanidine is carried out at pH 2 to 5, and the purified compound shows characteristic ultraviolet absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm that confirm its identity. The product is isolated by filtration, washed and dried to a powder, and may be further purified by active carbon treatment and recrystallization.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅單胺基胍是由胺基胍與腎上腺紅（一種不穩定的鄰醌式中間體）反應形成的止血劑。與carbazochrome一起，它是腎上腺紅的肼衍生物之一，可作為具有止血活性的實用藥物。在該專利方法中，以胺基胍進行穩定化的操作在pH 2至5下進行，純化後的化合物呈現348 nm和445 nm的特徵紫外線吸收極大值，確認其身份。產物經過濾分離、洗滌並乾燥成粉末，並可進一步經活性碳處理和重結晶純化。

label: Nutlin 3a
description: Nutlin 3a suppresses the pro-inflammatory SASP by inhibiting MDM2, the E3 ligase that marks p53 for degradation, thereby stabilizing the tumor suppressor; stabilized p53 in turn restrains NF-kB-driven expression of SASP cytokines and chemokines. This mechanism exploits the natural tumor-suppressive rheostat of p53 rather than broadly blocking inflammation, and it is consistent with the observation that loss of p53 dramatically amplifies secretome output. The compound is primarily a research tool with limited clinical development, which constrains its translational confidence, but mechanistically its SASP-suppressive action is well grounded in p53's restraint of the inflammatory secretome.
description_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 透過抑制 MDM2（標記 p53 降解的 E3 連接酶）而穩定腫瘤抑制因子，從而抑制促發炎性 SASP；穩定的 p53 反過來抑制 NF-κB 驅動的 SASP 細胞激素與趨化因子表現。此機制利用 p53 天然的腫瘤抑制變阻器，而非廣泛阻斷發炎，且與 p53 缺失大幅放大分泌組輸出的觀察一致。此化合物主要是研究工具、臨床開發有限，限制了其轉譯信度，但在機制上其 SASP 抑制作用是立基於 p53 對發炎分泌組的抑制。

label: Everolimus
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Everolimus, a rapamycin analog (rapalog), is FDA approved for anti-seizure therapy in tuberous sclerosis complex after many years of off-label use. The EXIST-3 multicenter phase III study evaluated adjunctive everolimus in patients with treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC and showed significant reduction in seizure frequency, with approximately 40% of patients in the high-dose group achieving at least a 50% reduction in seizures compared to only 15% in placebo. The success reflects TSC's clearly defined molecular etiology, with highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation making the pathway an actionable target.
description_zh_TW: Everolimus是雷帕黴素類似物（rapalog），在多年仿單外使用後，獲FDA核准用於結節性硬化症（tuberous sclerosis complex）的抗癲癇治療。EXIST-3多中心第三期研究評估everolimus作為輔助治療用於因TSC導致難治性癲癇的患者，結果顯示癲癇發作頻率顯著降低，高劑量組約有40%的患者癲癇發作減少至少50%，而安慰劑組僅15%。此成功反映了TSC明確的分子病因學，高外顯率的突變驅動mTOR過度活化，使該路徑成為可施作的治療標靶。

label: Cardiac fibrosis
description: SIRT4 contributes to cardiac fibrosis; global SIRT4 knockout in mice confers resistance to angiotensin-II infusion by suppressing fibrotic deposition. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of profibrotic signaling. This aligns with SIRT4's general tendency to promote pathological remodeling, contrasting with the antifibrotic SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 members. SIRT4's profibrotic action likely reflects its inhibition of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and promotion of oxidative stress. The opposing roles of SIRT4 versus the protective sirtuins in cardiac fibrosis illustrate the functional antagonism within the sirtuin family and the importance of the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 促進心臟纖維化；SIRT4 的全身敲除通過抑制纖維化沉積賦予對血管張力素 II 輸注的抗性。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於促纖維化信號的上游。這與 SIRT4 促進病理性重塑的總體趨勢一致，與抗纖維化的 SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 成員形成對比。SIRT4 的促纖維化作用可能反映其對粒線體氧化代謝的抑制和對氧化壓力的促進。SIRT4 與保護性 sirtuin 在心臟纖維化中的對立角色說明了 sirtuin 家族內的功能拮抗以及 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的重要性。

label: Pterostilbene
description: Pterostilbene is a calorie-restriction mimetic that directly activates SIRT1 and upstream energy sensors such as AMPK. It recapitulates the molecular signature of nutrient scarcity, enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and antioxidant defense.
description_zh_TW: 紫檀芪是熱量限制模擬劑，直接活化 SIRT1 與 AMPK 等上游能量感應器。它重現營養稀缺的分子特徵，增強脂肪酸氧化與抗氧化防禦。

label: PTEN
description: PTEN is the main phosphatase that indirectly inactivates PI3K in the mTOR-PI3K signaling cascade, providing the antagonistic deactivating arm that balances PI3K activation. Alongside PP2A, which counteracts the effect of mTORC1 in the activation of S6K1/2, PTEN is one of the two key phosphatases modeled as kinase-phosphatase opposing pairs. The balance between activating and deactivating reactions at key nodes, such as the positive correlation between activation and deactivation of mTORC2, is consistent with the requirement for opposite reactions to underlie biphasic dose-responses.
description_zh_TW: PTEN是mTOR-PI3K訊號級聯中主要的磷酸酶，間接使PI3K失活，提供平衡PI3K活化的拮抗性失活臂。與抵消mTORC1對S6K1/2活化影響的PP2A一起，PTEN是兩個關鍵磷酸酶之一，被建模為激酶-磷酸酶對抗對。關鍵節點上活化和失活反應之間的平衡，例如mTORC2活化和失活之間的正相關，與相反反應作為雙相劑量反應基礎的要求一致。

label: SIRT6 overexpression
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Acute overexpression of SIRT6 in cancer cell lines of different histology induces apoptosis, supporting a tumor-suppressive role for this nuclear sirtuin. The pro-apoptotic activity appears linked to SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function rather than its deacetylase activity. Directionally, increasing SIRT6 abundance or enzymatic activity triggers cell death in tumor cells. This contrasts with SIRT1's context-dependent duality and stresses that sirtuin outputs in cancer depend on the specific isoform and its dominant catalytic modality.
description_zh_TW: 在不同組織學類型的癌細胞系中急性過量表現 SIRT6 可誘導凋亡，支持此核 sirtuin 具有腫瘤抑制功能。此促凋亡活性似乎與 SIRT6 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能而非去乙醯酶活性相關。方向性上，增加 SIRT6 的豐度或酵素活性會在腫瘤細胞中觸發細胞死亡。這與 SIRT1 因情境而異的雙重性形成對比，強調 sirtuin 在癌症中的輸出取決於特定的同工型及其主要的催化模式。

label: Mediterranean Diet
description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: SIRT7 depletion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Global SIRT7 depletion contributes to premature ageing, especially in the backbone, white adipose tissue, and the heart.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 的全身性缺乏促成早衰，尤其是在脊柱、白色脂肪組織和心臟中。

label: STACs
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。

label: UCP1
description: SIRT3 controls thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue by deacetylating regulatory targets upstream of the uncoupling protein UCP1, maintaining the mitochondrial function required for adaptive heat production. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of UCP1-dependent thermogenic capacity. By preserving mitochondrial oxidative function and reducing oxidative stress in brown fat, SIRT3 ensures that mitochondria can sustain the proton leak through UCP1 that generates heat. This makes SIRT3 important for cold-induced thermogenesis and overall energy balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3透過去乙醯化位於解偶聯蛋白UCP1上游的調節靶標來控制棕色脂肪組織中的生熱作用，維持適應性產熱所需的粒線體功能。方向上，SIRT3位於UCP1依賴性生熱能力的上游。透過維持棕色脂肪的粒線體氧化功能並降低氧化壓力，SIRT3確保粒線體能夠維持通過UCP1的質子洩漏以產生熱量。這使SIRT3對冷誘導的生熱和整體能量平衡非常重要。

label: Selenocysteine
description: Melanoma is supported by Selenocysteine. Micrometastatic melanoma cells upregulate selenocysteine biosynthesis; efficient Sec insertion—dependent on the Um34 tRNA modification installed by FTSJ1—supports translation of antioxidant selenoproteins (e.g., GPx4, thioredoxin reductase) that buffer ROS and are required for metastatic colonization.
description_zh_TW: 黑色素瘤（Melanoma）依賴 Selenocysteine 支持。微轉移的黑色素瘤細胞會上調硒代半胱氨酸（Selenocysteine）生合成；有效插入 Sec——依賴由 FTSJ1 安裝的 Um34 tRNA 修飾——可支持抗氧化硒蛋白（如 GPx4、硫氧還蛋白還原酶）的轉譯，這些蛋白緩衝 ROS 並為轉移定植所必需。

label: Proto-lysosomal Tubules
description: Proto-lysosomal tubules are dynamic membrane extensions arising from endolysosomes during lysosome reformation. They represent an intermediate stage in recycling lysosomal membrane and content, ultimately giving rise to new proto-lysosomes that mature into functional lysosomes.
description_zh_TW: 原溶酶體小管（proto-lysosomal tubules）是溶酶體再形成期間由內吞溶酶體產生的動態膜延伸。它們是回收溶酶體膜與內容物的中間階段，最終產生成熟為功能性溶酶體的新原溶酶體。

label: CLEAR Network
description: The CLEAR network drives a coordinated lysosomal-autophagic transcriptional program that expands lysosomal capacity and autophagic throughput during stress. By upregulating lysosomal hydrolases and biogenesis genes it supports proteostasis and clearance of damaged organelles.
description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網路驅動協調的溶酶體-自噬轉錄程式，在壓力期間擴增溶酶體容量與自噬通量。透過上調溶酶體水解酶與生合成基因，它支持蛋白質恆定與受損胞器的清除。

label: DNA Hypomethylation
description: SIRT1 deacetylates histone H3 at lysine 79, and this modification promotes DNA hypomethylation and favors the formation of tightly compacted chromatin associated with gene silencing. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic modification of H3K79 sits upstream of altered DNA methylation patterns. This connects SIRT1's histone deacetylase activity to the epigenetic regulation of telomeric chromatin and gene expression. By influencing both histone acetylation and DNA methylation, SIRT1 can exert long-lasting effects on chromatin state that are relevant to aging and genomic stability. The interaction between histone and DNA modifications illustrates how a single sirtuin shapes the epigenetic landscape.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化組蛋白H3第79位賴氨酸，此修飾促進DNA低甲基化並有利於與基因沉默相關的緊密壓縮染色質的形成。方向上，SIRT1對H3K79的酵素修飾位於DNA甲基化模式改變的上游。這將SIRT1的組蛋白去乙醯酶活性與端粒染色質和基因表達的表觀遺傳調節聯繫起來。透過同時影響組蛋白乙醯化和DNA甲基化，SIRT1可以對染色質狀態產生與老化和基因組穩定性相關的持久影響。組蛋白與DNA修飾之間的相互作用說明了單一sirtuin如何塑造表觀遺傳景觀。

label: Respiratory Chain Complex I
description: Literature adjudication (Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923; Bindoli et al. 1990): Complex I reduces adrenochrome to its semiquinone, which auto-oxidizes to superoxide — a redox cycle that amplifies ROS. Adrenochrome is therefore an electron acceptor at Complex I ('redox_cycles_at', conf 0.9).
description_zh_TW: 文獻裁決（Genova et al. 2006, PMID 16487923；Bindoli et al. 1990）：Complex I 把 adrenochrome 還原成半醌，半醌自氧化成超氧化物——一個放大 ROS 的氧化還原循環。因此 adrenochrome 是 Complex I 的電子受體（「redox_cycles_at」，conf 0.9）。

label: Keap1
description: Under basal conditions Nrf2 is sequestered in the cytosol by its inhibitor Keap1, a substrate adaptor of a Cullin-3 E3 ligase that targets Nrf2 for proteasomal degradation. Oxidative insults modify Keap1 cysteines, disrupting this interaction and stabilizing Nrf2.
description_zh_TW: 在基礎條件下，Nrf2 被其抑制劑 Keap1 隔離在細胞質，Keap1 是 Cullin-3 E3 連接酶的受質銜接蛋白，將 Nrf2 標定進行蛋白酶體降解。氧化性刺激修飾 Keap1 的半胱氨酸，破壞此交互作用並穩定 Nrf2。

label: GDF15
description: The SASP is composed of growth-differentiation factor 15 (GDF15), a growth factor secreted by senescent cells. GDF15 contributes to colon carcinogenesis and promotes osteoarthritis from senescent chondrocytes, and its serum level is highly correlated with age and sex in individuals with age-related frailty. It is also proposed as a component of SASP biomarker panels.
description_zh_TW: SASP 由 growth-differentiation factor 15（GDF15）組成，這是衰老細胞分泌的一種生長因子。GDF15 促成結腸致癌，並由衰老軟骨細胞促成 osteoarthritis，且在年齡相關衰弱個體中，其血清水平與年齡和性別高度相關。它也被提議作為 SASP 生物標記組合的組成之一。

label: Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Fisetin suffers from intrinsically poor bioavailability that restricts its clinical translation. Its water solubility is very low (below 10 ug/mL), and the compound is sensitive to light, heat, and oxidative degradation. After oral administration fisetin is rapidly metabolized in the gut and liver to glucuronide and sulfate conjugates, so systemic exposure of the parent compound is minimal. The review documents that oral fisetin has short half-life and low plasma concentrations, and it attributes these problems to the BCS class II/IV characteristics of fisetin, motivating the development of macro- and nano-formulations to improve its absorption.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin受到本質上較差的生體可用率所苦，這限制了其臨床轉譯。其水溶性非常低（低於10 ug/mL），且此化合物對光、熱與氧化降解敏感。口服給藥後，fisetin在腸道與肝臟中迅速代謝為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸接合物，因此母體化合物的全身暴露量極小。該綜述記載口服fisetin的半衰期短、血漿濃度低，並將這些問題歸因於fisetin的BCS第II/IV類特性，促使開發巨觀與奈米配方以改善其吸收。

label: Zone 2 Cardio
description: Zone 2 cardio is low-to-moderate intensity aerobic training at a conversational pace that builds the aerobic base and increases mitochondrial volume. It is the recovery-day complement to HIIT, sustaining metabolic stimulus without the sympathetic load of high-intensity work.
description_zh_TW: Zone 2 有氧是對話節奏的低至中度強度有氧訓練，建立有氧基礎並增加粒線體體積。它是 HIIT 的恢復日互補，在無高強度工作的交感負荷下維持代謝刺激。

label: Adrenaline-quinone
description: Epinephrine (adrenaline) is the starting catecholamine in a well-characterized oxidative degradation pathway that ultimately produces adrenochrome. Through oxidation, which can occur spontaneously via autoxidation at physiological pH or through enzymatic activity, epinephrine loses electrons to form the highly reactive electrophilic intermediate adrenaline-quinone. Adrenaline-quinone is the immediate two-electron oxidation product of the catechol side chain; it is a potent electrophile whose formation commits the molecule to cyclization into the indole ring system. Because adrenaline-quinone is central to both epinephrine breakdown in pharmaceutical formulations and to endogenous catecholamine oxidation under oxidative stress, understanding it is key to adrenochrome chemistry and to the discoloration of epinephrine drug products.
description_zh_TW: Epinephrine (adrenaline) 是 well-characterized oxidative degradation pathway 的起始 catecholamine，最終產生 adrenochrome。通過氧化，可在生理 pH 下自發通過 autoxidation 或通過 enzymatic activity 發生，epinephrine 失去電子形成 highly reactive electrophilic intermediate adrenaline-quinone。Adrenaline-quinone 是 catechol side chain 的 immediate two-electron oxidation product；它是 potent electrophile，其 formation 使分子 cyclization into the indole ring system。由於 adrenaline-quinone 對於 pharmaceutical formulations 中的 epinephrine breakdown 和 oxidative stress 下的 endogenous catecholamine oxidation 至關重要，理解它對於 adrenochrome chemistry 和 epinephrine drug products 的 discoloration 是關鍵。

label: ADAM10
description: SIRT1 induces expression of ADAM10, the principal alpha-secretase that cleaves APP away from amyloidogenic beta-secretase (BACE1) processing, reducing beta-amyloid production; this underlies SIRT1's protective role in Alzheimer's disease models. Directionally, SIRT1 upregulates ADAM10 to promote non-amyloidogenic APP processing. By shifting APP cleavage away from the amyloidogenic pathway, SIRT1 reduces the production of toxic beta-amyloid peptides. This mechanism, together with SIRT1's anti-inflammatory and antioxidant actions, underlies its protection in Alzheimer's models and supports the idea that sirtuin activation could delay amyloid pathology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1誘導ADAM10的表達，ADAM10是主要的α-分泌酶，將APP從澱粉樣β-分泌酶（BACE1）加工途径中切割，減少β-澱粉蛋白的產生；這構成了SIRT1在阿茲海默症模型中保護作用的基礎。方向上，SIRT1上調ADAM10以促進非澱粉樣的APP加工。透過將APP切割從澱粉樣途径轉移，SIRT1減少了有毒β-澱粉蛋白肽的產生。此機制加上SIRT1的抗發炎和抗氧化作用，構成了其在阿茲海默模型中的保護基礎，並支持sirtuin活化可能延緩澱粉樣病理的觀點。

label: RRM1
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM1 provides the large catalytic (alpha) subunit carrying the active site and the allosteric specificity/activity sites. RRM1 assembles with either the RRM2 or RRM2B small subunit to form the active holoenzyme.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM1 提供大型催化（alpha）次單元，帶有活性位點以及別構特異性/活性位點。RRM1 與 RRM2 或 RRM2B 小次單元組裝形成活性全酶。

label: H3K18ac
description: H3K18ac is often co-deposited with other enhancer acetyl marks including H3K27ac at active regulatory elements. Both are enriched together with H3K4me1 at senescence-activated super-enhancers that drive SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: H3K18ac 常與包括 H3K27ac 在內的其他增強子乙醯標記在活性調控元件上共同沉積。兩者皆與 H3K4me1 一起富集於驅動 SASP 表現的衰老活化超級增強子。

label: Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase
description: Methylene blue acts as an inhibitor of soluble guanylyl cyclase (sGC), the downstream receptor for nitric oxide. Even when nitric oxide has already been produced, methylene blue prevents NO from triggering sGC-mediated cyclic GMP production, thereby blocking the vasodilation and hypotension that result from excessive NO signaling in conditions such as septic shock. By acting downstream at sGC rather than at NOS enzymes, methylene blue can rescue blood pressure even when NO levels are already high.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue作為可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶（sGC）的抑制劑發揮作用，sGC是一氧化氮的下游受體。即使一氧化氮已經產生，methylene blue也能防止NO觸發sGC介導的環磷酸GMP產生，從而阻斷在敗血症等情況下過度NO信號傳導導致的血管舒張和低血壓。通過在sGC而不是NOS酶的下游起作用，methylene blue甚至在NO水平已經很高時也能挽救血壓。

label: Chromatin Remodeling
description: Methylated DNA is recognized by methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins that recruit chromatin remodeling factors and histone deacetylases to the site. These recruited complexes remove acetyl groups and deposit repressive histone modifications, promoting condensation of the chromatin into a transcriptionally inactive state. This cross-talk between DNA methylation and histone modification establishes a self-reinforcing repressive loop that maintains stable gene silencing across cell divisions, and it is a major route by which promoter methylation converts active genes into silenced heterochromatin.
description_zh_TW: 甲基化 DNA 被甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白識別，將染色質重塑因子和組蛋白去乙醯化酶募集到該位點。這些招募的複合物去除乙醯基並沉積抑制性組蛋白修飾，促進染色質凝結成轉錄失活狀態。 DNA甲基化和組蛋白修飾之間的這種串擾建立了一個自我強化的抑制環，在細胞分裂過程中維持穩定的基因沉默，並且它是啟動子甲基化將活性基因轉化為沉默的異染色質的主要途徑。

label: NMRK1
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, which suggests that Nmrk1 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 1) might be the key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of nicotinamide riboside (NR). Two possible mechanisms of neuroprotection have been proposed: increasing mitochondrial NAD+ to support SIRT3 and preserving axonal NAD+ to supply damage-induced SARM1 activation. NMRK1 is expressed ubiquitously and converts NR to NMN in the salvage pathway for NAD+ synthesis. This neuroprotective role of NMRK1 supports the potential use of NR against excitotoxicity-induced axonal degeneration and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，這顯示 Nmrk1（nicotinamide ribose kinase 1，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 1）可能是 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。已提出兩種可能的神經保護機制：提升粒線體 NAD+ 以支持 SIRT3，以及保留軸突 NAD+ 以供應損傷誘發的 SARM1 活化。NMRK1 廣泛表現，並在 NAD+ 合成的回收路徑中將 NR 轉化為 NMN。NMRK1 的此一神經保護角色支持了 NR 用於對抗興奮毒性誘發的軸突退化與神經退化的潛在用途。

label: NF-kB
description: By silencing SIRT1, miR-217 removes a key brake on inflammatory signaling, leading to hyperacetylation of RelA/p65 at Lys310 and stabilization of active NF-kB. This drives chronic inflammation and connects miRNA dysregulation to inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: 透過沉默 SIRT1，miR-217 移除發炎訊號的一個關鍵制動器，導致 RelA/p65 在 Lys310 過度乙醯化並穩定活化的 NF-kB。這驅動慢性發炎，並將 miRNA 失調與發炎性衰老連結起來。

label: Lamins
description: Caspase-3 cleaves Lamins. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Lamins are the intermediate-filament proteins of the nuclear lamina whose cleavage by caspases drives nuclear collapse during apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon Lamins rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 劈開 Lamins。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Lamins 是核纖層的中間絲蛋白，在細胞凋亡過程中被半胱天冬酶裂解驅動核塌陷。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 Lamins 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: Regulated Cell Death
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Ferroptosis is a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway in which cells lose their ability to regulate fats and eventually die, as distinct from unregulated necrotic death or other programmed death programs like apoptosis. It was discovered and named (originally 'oxytosis') by Pam Maher in 2001. The hallmark mechanism is accumulation of lipid peroxides to toxic levels, normally kept in check by glutathione, and the pathway is increasingly linked to neurodegeneration and age-related diseases. Because ferroptosis is druggable and genetically regulatable, it has become a promising therapeutic target alongside cellular senescence for supporting healthy aging and clearing dysfunctional cells.
description_zh_TW: 鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）是一種受調控、依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，細胞在此途徑中失去調節脂肪的能力並最終死亡，有別於不受調控的壞死性死亡或其他如細胞凋亡（apoptosis）的程式性死亡。它由Pam Maher於2001年發現並命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。其標誌性機制是脂質過氧化物累積至毒性濃度，此過程通常由麩胱甘肽（glutathione）加以控制，且此途徑日益與神經退化及年齡相關疾病相關。由於ferroptosis可被藥物調控且在遺傳上可調節，它與細胞衰老（cellular senescence）一同成為支持健康老化與清除功能失常細胞的具前景治療標靶。

label: CCL2
description: CCL2 (MCP-1) is a SASP chemokine regulated by IL-1a and IL-1b that is a potent chemoattractant for monocytes and CCR2+ myeloid precursors, recruiting macrophages and myeloid-derived suppressor cells. It links the senescent secretome to innate and suppressive immune infiltration and contributes to paracrine senescence and inflammaging. CCL2's recruitment functions make it a central communicator between senescent cells and the immune milieu, and its receptor CCR2 is a target for modulating myeloid infiltration. Its presence explains the myeloid accumulation around senescent foci.
description_zh_TW: CCL2（MCP-1）是一種受 IL-1α 與 IL-1β 調節的 SASP 趨化因子，是單核球與 CCR2+ 骨髓前驅細胞的強效趨化劑，招募巨噬細胞與髓源性抑制細胞。它將衰老分泌組連結到先天與抑制性免疫浸潤，並貢獻旁分泌衰老與 inflammaging。CCL2 的招募功能使其成為衰老細胞與免疫微環境間的核心溝通者，且其受體 CCR2 是調節骨髓浸潤的標靶。其存在解釋衰老灶周圍的骨髓細胞累積。

label: Smac DIABLO
description: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins are antagonized by Smac-DIABLO. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The directionality runs from Smac-DIABLO toward Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins, so Smac-DIABLO is the active agent and Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: 被 Smac-DIABLO 對抗。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。方向性從 Smac-DIABLO 朝向 ϵ，因此 Smac-DIABLO 是活性劑，並且 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: RAIDD
description: PIDDosome is composed of RAIDD. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. The directionality runs from RAIDD toward PIDDosome, so RAIDD is the active agent and PIDDosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: PIDDosome 由 RAIDD 組成。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。方向性從 RAIDD 朝向 PIDDosome，因此 RAIDD 是主動主體，PIDDosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: MFN1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial fusion is orchestrated by three main dynamin-related GTPases: mitofusin 1 (MFN1), mitofusin 2 (MFN2) and OPA1. MFN1 and MFN2 are outer mitochondrial membrane transmembrane GTPases required for outer membrane fusion, while OPA1 mostly mediates inner membrane fusion. When MFN1 binds and hydrolyzes GTP, conformational changes in its GTPase domains lead to oligomerization, promoting clustering of the two opposing outer membranes and subsequent fusion. MFN1 and MFN2 are highly homologous with redundant functions; low MFN1 expression can be compensated by MFN2, and knockout of either in mice leads to embryonic lethality.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合由三個主要的 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶協調：mitofusin 1（MFN1）、mitofusin 2（MFN2）和 OPA1。MFN1 和 MFN2 是位於粒線體外膜的跨膜 GTP 酶，是外膜融合所必需的，而 OPA1 主要介導內膜融合。當 MFN1 結合和水解 GTP 時，其 GTP 酶結構域的構象變化導致寡聚化，促進兩個對向外膜的聚集及後續融合。MFN1 和 MFN2 具有高度同源性和功能冗餘；低 MFN1 表達可由 MFN2 補償，而小鼠中任一基因的敲除會導致胚胎致死。

label: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy
description: Chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA) is a selective form of lysosomal degradation in which individual soluble cytosolic proteins bearing a pentapeptide KFERQ-like targeting motif are recognized by the cytosolic chaperone HSC70. The substrate-chaperone complex is then delivered to the lysosomal membrane, where the receptor LAMP-2A monomers translocate the unfolded substrate across the membrane into the lumen for degradation. Unlike macro- and microautophagy, CMA degrades one protein at a time and does not require membrane engulfment or autophagosome formation. CMA activity declines with age and is implicated in neurodegeneration and cancer, and it is subject to regulation by mTORC2 and other signaling nodes.
description_zh_TW: 伴護蛋白介導的自噬（CMA）是一種選擇性的溶酶體降解形式，其中帶有五肽KFERQ樣標靶基序的個別可溶性細胞質蛋白被細胞質伴護蛋白HSC70辨識。隨後受質—伴護蛋白複合體被遞送至溶酶體膜，由受體LAMP-2A單體將未折疊的受質跨膜轉運至腔內進行降解。不同於巨自噬和微自噬，CMA一次降解一個蛋白質，且不需要膜吞噬或自噬體形成。CMA活性隨年齡下降，並與神經退化和癌症有關，且受mTORC2和其他訊號節點的調控。

label: Glutamate
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Glutamate dehydrogenase catalyzes the reversible oxidative deamination of L-glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate, providing carbon intermediates for the TCA cycle and ATP production. In the brain it buffers neurotransmitter glutamate and guards against excitotoxicity, and in pancreatic beta-cells it provides an amino-acid-sensing branch of insulin secretion.
description_zh_TW: 穀氨酸脫氫酶催化 L-穀氨酸可逆地氧化脫氨為 α-酮戊二酸，為 TCA 循環和 ATP 產生提供碳中間體。在大腦中它緩衝神經傳遞物質穀氨酸並防止興奮性毒性，在胰腺 β 細胞中則提供胺基酸感應的胰島素分泌分支。

label: Bim
description: By blocking SIRT2 activity and the downstream phospho-JNK/FOXO3a cascade, AGK2 prevents Bim activation and subsequent caspase-3 cleavage in ischemic conditions. This is part of its neuroprotective mechanism against apoptotic cell death.
description_zh_TW: 透過阻斷 SIRT2 活性和下游 phospho-JNK/FOXO3a 級聯，AGK2 在缺血條件下阻止 Bim 活化和隨後的 caspase-3 裂解。這是其對抗凋亡性細胞死亡的神經保護機制的一部分。

label: Aminochrome
description: Aminochrome is the cyclized, oxidized form of dopamine that can polymerize into the protective pigment neuromelanin. It is a pivotal branch-point intermediate whose normal polymerization builds neuromelanin while aberrant reactions form neurotoxic species.
description_zh_TW: Aminochrome 是多巴胺環化氧化後的產物，可聚合形成具保護性的色素 neuromelanin。它是關鍵的分支中間物，正常聚合時建構 neuromelanin，異常反應時則形成神經毒性物質。

label: T Cell
description: The SASP recruits T cells along with macrophages, natural killer cells, and neutrophils to the tissue microenvironment. This immune-cell recruitment is beneficial for limiting tumorigenesis by promoting immune clearance of senescent cells. However, excessive SASP factors can also suppress clearance by impairing macrophage phagocytosis.
description_zh_TW: SASP 招募 T cells，以及巨噬細胞、自然殺手細胞與嗜中性球至組織微環境。這種免疫細胞招募透過促進衰老細胞的免疫清除，有利於限制腫瘤發生。然而，過量的 SASP 因子也可能透過損害巨噬細胞吞噬作用來抑制清除。

label: Retrograde Signaling
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Mitochondria communicate stress to the nucleus through retrograde signaling pathways. In yeast this involves the Rtg1/Rtg3 transcription factors, whose activation extends replicative lifespan; in mammals the retrograde response involves calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation and may include the Retinoid X receptor alpha, PGC-1alpha, JNK, and ROS generation. Mitochondrial perturbations such as mtDNA deletion, respiratory chain inhibition, misfolded matrix proteins, or stalled ribosomes all elicit coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression that reconfigure metabolism and induce cytoprotective programs.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 通過 retrograde signaling pathways 與細胞核溝通壓力。在 yeast 中，這涉及 Rtg1/Rtg3 轉錄因子，其激活可延長 replicative lifespan；在 mammals 中，retrograde response 涉及 calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation 且可能包括 Retinoid X receptor alpha、PGC-1alpha、JNK 和 ROS 生成。Mitochondrial perturbations 如 mtDNA deletion、respiratory chain inhibition、misfolded matrix proteins 或 stalled ribosomes 都會引發 coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression，重新配置代謝並誘導 cytoprotective programs。

label: RRM2
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2 provides the small (beta) subunit housing the diferric-tyrosyl radical cofactor. RRM2 is S-phase restricted and the primary target of hydroxyurea and triapine.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2 提供容納雙鐵-酪胺醯自由基輔因子的（beta）小次單元。RRM2 局限於 S 期表現，並是 hydroxyurea 與 triapine 的主要靶點。

label: Bad
description: Bad is a BH3-only sensitizer: rather than activating BAX/BAK directly, it displaces anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family restraint (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1), indirectly liberating the effectors. IKK-mediated phosphorylation of Bad at Ser26 inactivates it and confers TNFα resistance, and the BH3 mimetic compounds act on the same principle — competitively disrupting Bcl-2/Bcl-xL binding to beclin-1 as well, which releases beclin-1 for autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Bad 是 BH3-only 的敏化因子：它不直接活化 BAX/BAK，而是置換抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族（Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1）的抑制，間接解放效應蛋白。IKK 對 Bad Ser26 的磷酸化會使其失活並賦予 TNFα 抗性；BH3 擬似劑也基於相同原理——競爭性破壞 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 與 beclin-1 的結合，同時釋出 beclin-1 以促進自噬。

label: HER2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: HER2 amplification is a key molecular driver and biomarker in gastric cancer, targeted by the antibody trastuzumab. HER2 status guides therapy selection in advanced disease. HER2-positive gastric cancer is a distinct, targetable subtype.
description_zh_TW: HER2 擴增是胃癌的關鍵分子驅動因子與生物標記，由抗體 trastuzumab 靶向。HER2 狀態指導晚期疾病的治療選擇。HER2 陽性胃癌是一個獨特、可靶向的亞型。

label: Neuromelanin synthesis
description: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra. In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment. Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome, or related aminochromes, can form as an intermediate in neuromelanin synthesis, particularly in dopaminergic neurons such as those of the substantia nigra。In this context, oxidation of catecholamines and their cyclization products feed into the polymerization that produces neuromelanin, a normal physiological pigment。Excess accumulation of these reactive intermediates may relate to oxidative damage in catecholaminergic neurons, and this pathway connects adrenochrome chemistry to neurodegenerative processes involving oxidative stress in the brain。

label: Dopamine o-quinone
description: Dopamine is biochemically converted into Dopamine o-quinone through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Dopamine acts as the substrate and Dopamine o-quinone as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Dopamine o-quinone。從機制上講，Dopamine 作為底物，Dopamine o-quinone 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: COMT Inhibitors
description: COMT inhibitors such as entacapone, tolcapone, and opicapone block catechol-O-methyltransferase, one of the principal enzymes that degrades catecholamines by methylation. Inhibiting COMT therefore increases synaptic and circulating levels of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, and this is exploited clinically in Parkinson's disease, often combined with MAO inhibitors and levodopa, to prolong dopaminergic effects and reduce off time. The resulting higher catecholamine levels, together with inhibition of MAO-mediated clearance, provide more substrate for oxidative conversion to adrenochrome, though this effect is mostly theoretical in clinical use and benefits are generally judged to outweigh risks.
description_zh_TW: COMT 抑制劑如 entacapone、tolcapone 與 opicapone 阻斷 catechol-O-methyltransferase，這是透過甲基化降解兒茶酚胺的主要酶之一。因此，抑制 COMT 會升高多巴胺、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的突觸與循環濃度，這在臨床上用於帕金森氏症，常與 MAO 抑制劑及 levodopa 併用以延長多巴胺能效應並減少 off time。所導致的較高兒茶酚胺濃度，加上 MAO 介導清除的抑制，提供了更多氧化轉化為 adrenochrome 的受質，儘管此效應在臨床使用中多屬理論性，且效益通常被認為大於風險。

label: ALIX
description: ALIX regulates Exosomes. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Exosomes are nanovesicles shed by tumor cells that traffic immune-checkpoint ligands and growth signals within the microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon Exosomes rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 Exosomes。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Exosomes 是腫瘤細胞脫落的奈米囊泡，在微環境中傳遞免疫檢查點配體和生長訊號。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 Exosomes 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Flavone
description: Luteolin is a naturally occurring flavone, a subclass of flavonoids, with the chemical structure 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxyflavone. It is abundant in parsley, celery, broccoli, green peppers, thyme, and chamomile. It is among the most studied dietary polyphenols for anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective activities.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 是天然存在的黃酮（flavone），是 Flavonoids 的一個亞類，化學結構為 3',4',5,7-四羥基黃酮。它大量存在於歐芹、芹菜、綠花椰菜、青椒、百里香和洋甘菊中。它是研究最多的膳食多酚之一，具有抗發炎和神經保護活性。

label: Axonal Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Among three tested NAD+ precursors (nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside) including NAD+ itself, only NR could prevent axonal degeneration by altering the local NR metabolism within the axon. Axonal degeneration is an early event in acute cerebral injury and in chronic neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, and it is caused by excitotoxicity, which induces strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, suggesting that Nmrk1 is a key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of NR.
description_zh_TW: 在測試的三種 NAD+ 前驅物（nicotinic acid、nicotinamide 與 nicotinamide riboside）以及 NAD+ 本身之中，唯有 NR 能透過改變軸突內局部的 NR 代謝來預防軸突退化。軸突退化是急性腦損傷以及包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症在內的慢性神經退化性疾病的早期事件，且由興奮毒性所引起，後者會誘發神經元中強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，顯示 Nmrk1 是 NR 神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。

label: MAPK
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: MKP-3 is a dual-specificity phosphatase of the MAP kinase phosphatase family that shuts off ERK1/2 signaling. It tempers mitogenic signaling by inactivating ERK within the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade. MKP-3 thereby provides negative feedback control over the MAPK pathway.
description_zh_TW: MKP-3 是 MAP 激酶磷酸酶家族的雙特異性磷酸酶，可關閉 ERK1/2 訊號傳導。它透過使 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK 級聯中的 ERK 失活來調節有絲分裂訊號。因此 MKP-3 對 MAPK 途徑提供負回饋控制。

label: Low-Density Lipoprotein
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Advanced glycation end products damage the cardiovascular system in part by glycating low-density lipoproteins (LDL) on both the apolipoprotein B and phospholipid components of the particle. Glycated LDL is more susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall than non-glycated LDL, and it is not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway, so it accumulates in the vessel wall. Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation and the development of atheroma. This glycoxidative modification of LDL is thus a direct route through which AGEs promote atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products部分透過對low-density lipoproteins（LDL）顆粒上的apolipoprotein B與phospholipid components進行glycating，來damages the cardiovascular system。Glycated LDL比non-glycated LDL更susceptible to crosslinking with collagen on the arterial wall，且它not taken up into cells through the normal receptor pathway，因此accumulates in the vessel wall。Macrophage uptake of these modified LDL particles leads to foam cell formation與atheroma的development。因此，此glycoxidative modification of LDL是AGEs promote atherosclerosis的direct route。

label: Pioneer Factor
description: A pioneer factor can bind its motif within closed, nucleosome-occupied chromatin and initiate local chromatin opening. In senescence, pioneer factors such as AP-1 are the initial drivers that open enhancers at SASP and senescence genes.
description_zh_TW: 先驅因子能在封閉、核小體佔據的染色質內結合其模體並啟動局部染色質開啟。在衰老中，諸如 AP-1 等先驅因子是開啟 SASP 與衰老基因增強子的初始驅動者。

label: Eumelanin
description: Melanocytes synthesize Eumelanin, the black and brown protective melanin, within melanosomes via the pathway of Melanogenesis. Eumelanin acts as a broad-band radical scavenger and UV absorber. This dark pigment is exported to neighboring keratinocytes for photoprotection.
description_zh_TW: Melanocytes 透過 Melanogenesis 途徑在 melanosomes 內合成 Eumelanin，即黑色和棕色的保護性黑色素。Eumelanin 充當寬頻自由基清除劑和 UV 吸收劑。這種深色色素被輸出到鄰近的 keratinocytes 以提供光保護。
